Are you a problem solver? Can you help others identify their goals and get them from where they are to where they want to be? job.description:
Location: NY-Long Island

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Long Island Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

 

This position is 100% commission based. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience. 

  

Benefits for Full-Time roles include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner) 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options

Location: FL-Tampa

Job Title:  Engineering Manager - Tampa Radio

 

Position Overview

Tampa Radio is looking for a Manager of Engineering who will be responsible for executing all broadcast related engineering functions for Cox Media Group (CMG) radio stations in the local market. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, all radio frequency (RF) operations, broadcast and digital distribution systems, studio equipment, tower site operations, IP-based broadcast infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, backup and recovery, and security systems. Planning, execution, and timely completion of all projects, maintenance, upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization initiatives while ensuring compliance with all FCC, FAA, FEMA, OSHA, and company rules, regulations, and guidelines. Maintain, maximize, and service the station’s transmitter, studio, digital distribution, networking, and station facilities. Advise management in the long-range planning for the replacement, modernization, resilience, and secure operation of station equipment and systems. The Manager of Engineering is responsible for improving operational capabilities and supporting all revenue and audience-producing efforts. They will work closely with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, operations, and other departments in the maintenance and operation of their equipment and technical systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and support all broadcast equipment including transmission systems, transceivers, satellite receivers, and broadcast automation equipment for optimum performance 
  • Mange remote, on-location broadcast scheduling, site coordination, timely broadcast equipment setup and operation.  Safely store and maintain remote broadcast equipment 
  • Document equipment installation, wiring, maintenance, repair, and replacement 
  • Ensure that all projects are properly implemented and executed per agreed-upon schedule 
  • Work varied and extended hours may include some weekends, holidays, on-call, and required local travel for scheduled after-hours projects or when emergencies or failure of critical equipment occurs to the operation of the station 
  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems at studio, transmitter, and translator locations 
  • Ensure operation and oversee maintenance of company vehicles with the safety of the operator, other personnel, and the public in mind, according to the guidelines of the station and CMG 
  • Update, improve and implement our business continuity plan and contribute as a member of our crisis management team 
  • Support IP-based broadcast infrastructure, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless systems, AoIP platforms, remote control systems, and monitoring tools
  • Support cybersecurity, patching, endpoint protection, access control, secure configuration, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation practices across critical technical systems
  • Plan and execute preventative maintenance, technology upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization projects that strengthen reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, and operations teams to understand business needs, solve technical problems, and deliver dependable service-oriented support

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, radio technical operations, media technology, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio operations, automation, audio chains, remote control systems, and digital distribution workflows.
  • Hands-on experience supporting IP-connected infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, NTP, SNMP, and wireless systems.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, patching, endpoint protection, backup and recovery, and secure system configuration.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, especially during outages or time-sensitive station operations.
  • Strong communication, documentation, project management, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to support station facilities, transmitter sites, and remote locations as needed.
  • Ability to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call support when critical systems require immediate response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Society of Broadcast Engineers certification or relevant IT, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or vendor certifications.
  • Experience with radio automation, AoIP systems, HD Radio, high-powered AM/FM transmission, broadcast monitoring/control platforms, or remote broadcast technology.
  • Familiarity with virtualized or cloud-connected infrastructure, Windows Server, Active Directory/Azure, Linux, backup platforms, Fortinet, Cisco, Veeam, Wheatstone, WideOrbit, Burk, or comparable platforms.

Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Executive Business Partner - CMG

 

Position Overview

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence.

 

By anticipating needs, identifying risks and bottlenecks, and proactively driving follow-through, the Executive Business Partner helps maximize organizational effectiveness and the impact of executive leader(s) and their teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Support & Coordination

  • Provides comprehensive support to executive and senior leaders, including complex calendar management, scheduling prioritization, meeting coordination, travel planning, expense reporting, and administrative support.
  • Proactively manages the executive’s time, energy and strategic priorities by identifying conflicts, anticipating emerging issues, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared for meetings and positioned for effective decision making and execution.
  • Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Maintains awareness of key business priorities, organizational developments, and leadership initiatives to help proactively coordinate activities; identify scheduling considerations, dependencies, risks, and opportunities; and items requiring executive attention.

 

Meeting & Communication Management

  • Develops meeting agendas, presentation materials, executive briefings, summaries, reports, and communications that support productive discussions and informed leadership conversations.
  • Coordinates follow-up communications, tracks action items, and maintains documentation of meeting outcomes and commitments to ensure accountability for critical deliverables.
  • Serves as a liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, and discretion.

 

Project & Process Support

  • Supports special projects and business initiatives through organization, coordination, information gathering, documentation, and progress tracking.
  • Tracks key deliverables, deadlines, and commitments and follows up with stakeholders to support timely completion and clear accountability.
  • Creates and maintains project trackers, dashboards, templates, and other tools that support efficient execution and visibility.
  • Assists with coordination across departments, project teams, and executive support partners to promote alignment and effective communication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Operational Excellence

  • Leverages technology and productivity tools, including AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline administrative and operational tasks.

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

job.title: Director of Engineering - WPXI TV
job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Director of Engineering - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI Pittsburgh TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
  • Partner with station leadership to align engineering priorities with operational goals, audience needs, local news production, company initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Plan, execute, and track annual operating and capital budgets, including forecasting, business case development, bid solicitation, vendor selection, documentation, and project delivery.
  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.

job.description:

The New York Times International desk is looking for a Video Journalist to produce and edit stories with multimedia correspondents. You will join a team tasked with creating new approaches to our international reporting in video, working with a growing group of foreign correspondents who work in video as well as text.

The goal is to help our audience understand the world through powerful video stories, reaching our core audience as well as new viewers who increasingly consume journalism in video. We will experiment with a mix of direct, immersive vertical video forms that can bring our audience with us on the ground.

You will join a multi-disciplinary team of video journalists that will shape this work. This role is based in our New York office, working remotely with correspondents in the field to produce, edit and publish stories. You should have a refined understanding of video production and storytelling, including video editing, shooting and writing for narration, with a clear sense for how to creatively use graphics and animation to illustrate complex ideas. 

Your news judgement about what makes a good story in video will be crucial, as will creative ideas for how to reenvision the basic elements of foreign correspondence, across news, features and analysis. You must be an effective collaborator and a strong communicator who can work closely with regional editors and video colleagues to shape our approach to this coverage.

This position is based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. 

Responsibilities:

  • Write, produce, edit and publish videos with hybrid correspondents, in close partnership with regional editors.
  • Devise new approaches to digital video storytelling both on and off platform.
  • Work with correspondents to create a playbook for how to cover a region or beat in video.
  • Collaborate closely with International editors, correspondents and video colleagues.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • The role reports to the Senior Producer, International in New York.

  • 4+ years of video storytelling, video editing and production experience at a news organization.
  • A strong portfolio, preferably of inventive short-form video.
  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.
  • Broad knowledge of current events and news.
  • Deep curiosity about video habits and users and platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in the trenches of production, including editing, shooting and field production.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Sr Mgr, Social Media Audience Growth

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager of Social Media and Audience Growth. This role is responsible for helping shape and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy.

 

This role drives audience growth, engagement, content distribution, platform innovation, and monetization opportunities across all major social platforms. It will establish enterprise-wide social media standards, identify emerging opportunities, analyze performance trends, and partner with local stations to maximize the impact and reach of CMG journalism across social platforms.

 

This role will work closely with CMG Content Leaders, News Directors, Digital Leaders, Marketing Teams, Sales, and on-air talent to ensure social media supports CMG’s broader audience and content distribution strategy while building audience loyalty and expanding reach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent audience growth across CMG social platforms
  • Increased engagement, referral traffic, and loyalty across key social platforms
  • Strong and consistent execution of social best practices across the company
  • Growth of platform-native, original, vertical, and video content
  • Growth of sustainable social revenue and partnership opportunities
  • Stronger integration of social media into daily newsroom and digital workflows
  • Expanded reach and visibility of CMG journalism and journalists
  • Successful adoption of emerging platforms, formats, and technologies
  • Increased use of data and audience insights to drive social decision-making

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Social Media & Audience Growth

  • Helps develop and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on social platforms, audience behavior, content distribution, and emerging trends
  • Establishes platform standards and best practices
  • Drives audience growth, engagement, and referral traffic
  • Leads innovation in vertical video, platform distribution, and emerging channels
  • Identifies external partnerships and opportunities that could enhance CMG’s social strategy, audience reach, and business objectives

Social Media Strategy & Leadership

  • Provides social platform expertise, audience insights, and recommendations to help shape and continuously refine CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Establishes platform-specific standards, best practices, and publishing guidelines
  • Partners with station leadership to align social efforts with audience, content, and business objectives
  • Identifies emerging platforms, technologies, and audience opportunities

Audience Growth & Engagement

  • Drives measurable audience growth and engagement across social platforms
  • Develops strategies that increase referral traffic and platform loyalty
  • Analyzes audience behavior and engagement patterns
  • Establishes performance benchmarks, key performance indicators, and growth goals
  • Identifies opportunities to reach new audiences and expand the reach of CMG journalism
  • Uses data and audience insights to continuously refine content and distribution strategies

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Content Distribution & Platform Optimization

  • Leads social distribution strategies for breaking news, weather, investigations, community coverage, major events, and other high-impact journalism
  • Creates frameworks that help stations maximize the value and reach of content across platforms
  • Develops best practices for audience engagement, including vertical video, platform-native storytelling, and social-first content
  • Partners with newsroom and digital leaders to integrate social strategy into daily editorial workflows
  • Ensures social content remains aligned with CMG editorial standards

Analytics, Revenue & Innovation

  • Analyzes performance metrics, trends, and audience insights
  • Identifies growth opportunities across social platforms
  • Evaluates platform changes, emerging technologies, and distribution opportunities
  • Leads testing and pilot programs for new social products and initiatives
  • Shares learnings, successful strategies, and best practices across CMG markets

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital audience development, or digital content distribution, preferably within a media, news, or content organization
  • Proven track record of driving measurable social media growth and high-performing content
  • Strong editorial judgment and understanding of news values, journalism, and digital storytelling
  • Experience creating and optimizing short-form vertical video content and platform-native content strategies
  • Proven ability to use data and analytics to develop strategy, identify opportunities, and measure performance
  • Demonstrated ability to work across teams, influence stakeholders, and drive adoption of enterprise initiatives
  • Deep expertise in Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform algorithms, audience behavior, analytics, trends, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of digital audience development, content distribution, referral strategy, and platform-native storytelling
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing digital media environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading social media or audience strategy for a multi-market media organization
  • Experience with social media analytics, monetization, audience measurement, social listening, and publishing tools
  • Background in video editing and mobile-first production workflows
  • Experience launching or testing new platforms, products, content formats, or audience-growth initiatives
  • Understanding of SEO, referral traffic, digital analytics, and broader audience-development strategies

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.

    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

  • Help FT readers maximise the benefits of their trial and/or subscription, driving conversion rates and building engagement habits, by walking readers through the website and mobile app. Asking probing questions to effectively match their interests to content, tools, features and services available on FT.com.

  • Ability to build customer rapport, verbally engaging and guiding customers through a digital product in a personalised manner
  • Lead with curiosity - confidently and skillfully asking questions and demonstrating active listening

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Systems Analyst II

 

Position Overview

The Digital Customer Support (DCS) Systems Analyst II provides Tier 2 technical and operational support for Cox Media Group's business-critical applications and digital platforms. This role focuses on troubleshooting, incident resolution, application administration, and maintaining reliable services for internal customers.

 

The ideal candidate is a customer-focused problem solver with strong technical, analytical, and communication skills. The position includes participation in an after-hours on-call rotation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 2 support for enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and associated integrations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application incidents and service requests escalated through the Service Desk.
  • Support CMG's Content Management Systems (CMS) and WideOrbit revenue platform, including troubleshooting, user provisioning, and account management.
  • Participate in on-call support, major incident response, and technical escalations.
  • Support and cross-train on Change Management and Critical Problem Management processes to ensure team-wide coverage, operational continuity, and backup support when needed
  • Collaborate with vendors, application owners, and other IT teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain support documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce recurring incidents, and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Support and cross-train on Change Management and Critical Problem Management processes to ensure team-wide coverage, operational continuity, and backup support when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or IT operations.
  • Experience troubleshooting enterprise applications and SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with IT service management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Understanding of Incident, Problem, and Change management processes.
  • Experience with user provisioning, account administration, and application troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple issues and work effectively across technical teams.
  • Experience supporting Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience supporting CMS, WideOrbit, or other digital media applications.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices and application monitoring tools.
  • Experience with automation, application integrations, or process improvement.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a highly creative, curious, and deeply collaborative Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications, to work directly with AccuWeather forecasters and the Writing Committee to further elevate the detail, clarity, precision, and distinctiveness of the language used to describe forecasts for our users. This role is designed for a graduate student or an individual with equivalent writing experience who brings fresh thinking about how complex weather information can be expressed in ways that are more detailed, precise, clear, engaging, and scientifically sound.

Embedded closely with Forecast Operations, this position will learn from meteorologists, participate in the forecast-writing process, and help develop new approaches, terminology, and descriptive frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more informative and better than what is available from any other source. The emphasis is on improving the consumer forecast experience - not traditional public relations - by helping forecasters communicate what the weather will be, what the impact will be, how it will evolve, what it may look like, and what details matter most to people making decisions. This includes a laser focus on developing stronger displays, greater artistry, and more effective visual communications that amplify the advantages of AccuWeather forecasts and content.

The Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications will serve as a bridge between meteorological expertise and exceptional consumer-facing writing, helping AccuWeather deliver forecast descriptions with greater depth, nuance, consistency, and usefulness while preserving the scientific accuracy and authority at the core of the AccuWeather brand.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Language, Detail & Description:

  • Work side-by-side with forecasters to craft and refine accurate, detailed, consumer-focused descriptions of daily weather, changing conditions, major storms, seasonal patterns, and forecast developments.
    • Elevate forecast language beyond basic conditions by identifying the most useful details, nuances, timing, impacts, transitions, and sensory descriptions that help users better understand what to expect. Use bold, catchy and descriptive language.
    • Translate complex meteorological concepts into clearer, more detailed, consumer-friendly language without sacrificing scientific meaning, accuracy, or appropriate expressions of forecast confidence.
    • Develop new descriptive approaches, vocabulary, sentence structures, and frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more distinctive, informative, and useful than competing forecast experiences.
    • Help establish consistent terminology for recurring weather patterns while preserving enough flexibility for forecasters to communicate the unique character and details of each forecast.

 

Forecaster & Writing Committee Collaboration:

  • Embed with AccuWeather forecasters to understand how forecasts are created, where language choices can add value, and how writing can better communicate meteorological insight to users.
    • Work closely with the AccuWeather Writing Committee to test, evaluate, and introduce new approaches to forecast writing and description.
    • Bring an outside writing perspective to established forecast workflows, asking thoughtful questions and proposing new ways of thinking, writing, and working.
  • Challenge conventional approaches to forecast description and explore new ways to communicate weather that provide users with greater detail, context, understanding, and value.
    • Gather feedback from meteorologists and other stakeholders, iterate on language, and help turn successful approaches into practical writing guidance and repeatable standards.
    • Support a collaborative environment in which meteorological expertise and strong writing work together to create a richer forecast experience.

 

Consumer Forecast Experience & Innovation:

  • Review forecast descriptions across AccuWeather consumer experiences and identify opportunities to add specificity, context, clarity, and useful detail.
    • Develop and test language that helps users better understand the timing, intensity, duration, variability, uncertainty, and real-world impacts of weather events.
  • Explore new ways to make routine forecasts more useful, engaging, descriptive, and impactful, bringing the same level of creativity and attention to detail to both high-impact weather coverage and everyday conditions such as temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, humidity, visibility, and changing conditions.
    • Help ensure forecast descriptions are clear and effective across digital platforms while retaining the depth and detail that distinguish AccuWeather.
    • Contribute ideas that reinforce AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™ through the quality, precision, and usefulness of the forecast language itself.

 

Writing Standards & Continuous Improvement:

  • Help evolve AccuWeather’s authoritative, trustworthy, detailed, and forward-looking forecast voice.
    • Identify new ways to describe weather phenomena that are vivid, memorable, consumer-relevant, and scientifically sound.
    • Contribute to forecast-writing standards, terminology guidelines, examples, and best practices used by forecasters and content teams.
    • Study how forecast language performs in practice and recommend improvements based on clarity, usefulness, consistency, and differentiation.
    • Encourage experimentation and fresh thinking while respecting operational requirements, meteorological accuracy, and established review processes.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Writing, or a closely related writing-intensive field is required.
    • Current graduate student in communications, writing, journalism, English, creative writing, technical writing, or a related discipline, or equivalent advanced or professional writing experience.
    • Exceptional command of written language, including tone, clarity, precision, descriptive detail, structure, and audience awareness.
    • Demonstrated ability to take complex or technical information and make it clear, specific, useful, and engaging for a broad audience.
    • Strong collaborative skills and genuine interest in working closely with meteorologists, subject-matter experts, and a writing committee.
    • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn meteorological concepts and forecast workflows.
    • Ability to receive expert feedback, revise quickly, and improve language through an iterative process.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in or familiarity with meteorology, weather forecasting, climate, environmental science, science communication, or technical writing.
    • Experience developing descriptive language, style guidance, editorial standards, or writing frameworks.
    • Experience collaborating directly with technical or scientific subject-matter experts.
    • Portfolio examples demonstrating precise, vivid, explanatory, or detail-rich writing.

 

Skills & Competencies:

  • Creative thinking grounded in accuracy, precision, and credibility.
    • Exceptional descriptive and explanatory writing.
    • Ability to identify and elevate the details that matter most to users.
    • Strong editing, revision, and language-development skills.
    • Curiosity about weather and willingness to learn from forecasters.
    • Collaborative, workshop-oriented approach to writing.
    • Ability to develop practical writing standards while continuing to experiment with new approaches.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
    • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of an embedded team.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

The Video department is looking for a Senior Producer to work on the multi-disciplinary Reporter Video team of video journalists who create powerful videos featuring the expertise of our world-class journalists. Based in London, this role will focus on covering breaking news and major international developments in short-form video, producing a mix of quick-turnaround videos, explanatory and analysis pieces, as well as major enterprise and investigations. 

The Senior Producer will report to a London supervisor and work with the rest of the Reporter Video team in New York and other video hubs, becoming the key manager of the department’s content during the hours that London acts as the main Times hub.

A subsidiary of Real Chemistry, 21GRAMS is a purpose-driven organization, striving to be the "first at what's next" in health. This general opportunity posting is a way to connect with 21GRAMS about opportunities that align with your experience and interests, rather than apply for one specific role. Responsibilities and qualifications will vary by position, team, and level.

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

This is not a traditional medical writer role. We’re looking for someone with healthcare advertising experience who can concept, collaborate, and write across a range of promotional and scientific materials while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and brand voice.

The Medical Copywriter is responsible for developing medically sound, strategically sharp, and emotionally resonant copy across healthcare/pharma campaigns. This is a great opportunity for a writer who loves the challenge of making complex science feel human, relevant, and creatively powerful. You’ll work at the intersection of medical rigor and brand storytelling, helping shape work that is strategically grounded, emotionally intelligent, and deeply impactful.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, San Francisco, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville or Carmel.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a New Business Lead to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry seeks an accomplished and strategically minded Head of New Business to lead the agency’s growth function and drive best-in-class business development for 21GRAMS. In this role, you will establish and refine new business processes, develop a high-performing growth team, and serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior leadership, directly impacting pipeline development, win rates, and revenue growth.

This position is integral to 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, a healthcare advertising and communications firm dedicated to making healthcare more human through innovative, client-centered work conducted with integrity and excellence. You will lead all aspects of new business development, from opportunity identification through pitch execution. You will ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized experience, fostering collaboration, efficiency and confidence at every stage.

Additionally, you will help own the new client onboarding process, ensuring that day-to-day brand teams are fully equipped with the insights, timelines, and resources needed to service each brand from day one. This critical handoff function bridges the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work, setting the foundation for long-term client partnerships.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

New Business Process Development

  • Establish, refine, and enforce new business processes and standards across the agency
  • Create repeatable frameworks for how opportunities are evaluated, pursued, and executed

Growth Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing new business team
  • Ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized, and collaborative experience

Pipeline Management

  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities 
  • Manage the full pipeline from initial opportunity through close 
  • Track and report on win rates, pipeline health, Saleforce integration, and revenue impact 

Pitch Leadership

  • Lead and support pitch efforts across the agency and with Real Chemistry Partners
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams through the pitch process 
  • Foster confidence and collaboration at every stage of the pursuit

Strategic Partnership with Senior Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to agency leadership on all growth matters 
  • Inform and influence go-to-market strategy across therapeutic areas including launch planning

New Client Onboarding

  • Help own the end-to-end onboarding process for all newly won clients 
  • Ensure day-to-day account teams are fully equipped with the insights, context, and resources needed to service each brand from day one 
  • Bridge the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution
  • 12+ years of new business, account management, or project management experience in a healthcare advertising setting
  • Minimum 5+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity managing high-performing, cross-functional teams in high-pressure environments
  • Demonstrated expertise in pharmaceutical advertising, healthcare communications, or life sciences agency environment with hands-on experience managing teams and new business opportunities
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical promotion standards, FDA/OPDP guidance, and healthcare communications
  • Demonstrated ability in data analysis, reporting, and translating metrics into actionable business insights
  • Working knowledge of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid approaches, with ability to select appropriate methodology for each pitch opportunity
  • Proven track record of leading, developing, and motivating teams to high performance
  • Executive-level communication skills—ability to present complex information clearly to C-suite audiences, stakeholders, and clients
  • Strong written and verbal communication with ability to adapt messages for diverse audiences
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, make decisions under uncertainty, and balance competing priorities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Deep expertise in pharmaceutical advertising and healthcare communications, particularly with experience in oncology, rare disease, specialty pharmaceuticals, or other complex therapeutic areas
  • Demonstrated results from process improvement initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency gains, cost reduction, or quality improvement
  • Client relationship management experience at a senior level, including presenting to pharmaceutical and biotech executives

CORE COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES

Professional Competencies

  • Strategic Business Leadership: Setting vision and direction; aligning operations with business objectives; thinking beyond immediate execution to organizational capability building
  • Process Excellence: Designing, implementing, and continuously improving standardized processes and workflows that scale across new business
  • Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining effective relationships with executives, clients, cross-functional partners, and team members; navigating competing interests
  • Organizational Development: Building high-performing teams, developing talent, creating culture, and leading organizational change

Required Leadership Attributes

  • Change-Positive, Growth-Oriented

You actively seek smarter, faster, and more effective ways to operate. You are not threatened by AI, innovation, new tools, or new ways of working—you're energized by them. You challenge legacy thinking thoughtfully, experiment with confidence, and view change as an advantage rather than a disruption. You don't defend the status quo because "it works"; you see every process, system, and methodology as a candidate for improvement. You are quick to spot opportunities to expand how we operate collectively and you bring others along on that journey. You stay current with emerging PM tools and methodologies because you're genuinely curious about better ways forward, not because compliance requires it.

  • Commercially and Market Aware

You operate beyond internal agency mechanics and understand the bigger picture. You know your clients' business contexts, therapeutic landscapes, and commercial realities well enough to make informed decisions, ask smarter questions, and connect execution to real-world impact. You don't need to be a medical expert, but you are an industry-savvy operator who understands pharma economics, launch timelines, competitive dynamics, and patient access challenges. You ask "why does this matter commercially?" and "what does success look like for the client?" regularly. This commercial acumen informs how you scope projects, allocate resources, and prioritize decisions. You help your team see beyond deliverables to outcomes.

  • Confident Driver of Progress

You embrace being a driver, not just a facilitator or administrator. You create momentum, push for clarity and decisions when you see ambiguity, hold teams accountable constructively without micromanaging, and move work forward even when information is imperfect or circumstances are complicated. You don't wait for consensus to take action; you make smart calls and bring people along. You recognize that indecision is a decision, and you're willing to take that on. You drive toward clear wins and celebrate progress, which energizes your teams and builds confidence across the organization.

  • Steward of Team Balance and Performance

You actively shape the health of the system, not just the output. You recognize burnout early—in individuals and in teams—and you recalibrate workload, expectations, or resources proactively before people break. You also recognize underperformance with equal clarity and you raise the bar constructively, providing support and accountability. You design operating rhythms, sprint cycles, and governance structures that support both sustainable, high performance and uncompromising standards. You understand that how people feel about their work is as important as what they produce, and that sustainable excellence requires both.

  • Ownership Mindset and Creative Agency

You do not wait for permission to elevate the work. You bring forward ideas on how to operate better, propose smarter ways of organizing projects, design stronger plans, and take responsibility for improving outcomes beyond your assigned scope. You see gaps and fill them. You spot inefficiencies and fix them. You don't assume "that's someone else's problem"—you own the enterprise. This doesn't mean doing everything yourself; it means taking initiative to identify what needs to change and driving toward solutions. Your ownership extends to your team's success, your clients' outcomes, and the health of the broader organization.

  • Strong Judgment and Prioritization Instincts

You consistently make good calls under pressure and constraint. You distinguish signal from noise in a sea of competing demands. You make smart trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk with sound instinct—not by formula. You prioritize effectively, recognizing what matters most and what can wait. You have good instincts about people, situations, and strategic priorities, and you trust those instincts while remaining open to new information. When you have to move fast, you do. When you need to be deliberate, you are. You know the difference, and you rarely get it wrong.

  • Courage and Comfort with Productive Discomfort

You are willing to push when it's uncomfortable and challenge constructively when you see a better path. You hold tension without smoothing it away prematurely; you recognize that some of the best solutions come from sitting with uncomfortable questions rather than resolving them quickly. You make difficult calls when needed—hard conversations, tough decisions, unpopular stands—with confidence rather than approval-seeking. You bring backup (data, reasoning, alternatives) to every discussion. You operate with the confidence of someone who takes responsibility for their decisions and is willing to defend them, but you're also genuinely open to being wrong and course-correcting when new information warrants it.

Pay Range: $250,000-$290,000

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has done a lot in its first 5+ years. Known for our creativity, we've just been ranked as the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. It takes a team to do ambitious things, and our ambition is to help people connect with healthcare – by making advertising less of an interruption and more worth people’s time because it gets them. As an agency with the full capabilities of Real Chemistry at our fingertips, we’ve got endless potential.   

At ROOM42 — 21GRAMS' in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — we are seeking an AI-Forward Technical Lead who is simultaneously a craftsperson, a creative partner, and an accelerator. This person moves fluidly between writing production-quality code, protecting design intent through every build decision, and orchestrating AI tooling to compress the distance from concept to shipped experience. Whether the starting point is a client brief, a Figma file, or a napkin sketch, this Technical Lead is the person who figures out the fastest, most technically sound path to a working, beautiful, compliant deliverable — and builds it. 

This role spans the full ROOM42 output spectrum: marketing websites, microsites, conference kiosks and panel experiences, interactive apps, and data-driven digital tools for healthcare and pharma clients. The ideal candidate has mastered the traditional web development lifecycle and is actively transforming it — using AI at every meaningful stage. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you’ll do:  

Build and Architect 

  • Own end-to-end technical execution for ROOM42 deliverables — websites, microsites, interactive apps, conference kiosk and panel experiences, and real-world evidence platforms 

  • Write and review production-quality code across the full stack; maintain a target of 50% direct hands-on contribution alongside leadership responsibilities 

  • Architect solutions that balance speed-to-market with long-term maintainability, security, and accessibility compliance 

  • Lead technical solutioning on new engagements — translating UX wireframes and creative briefs into clearly scoped, achievable builds 

DevOps and Delivery Infrastructure: 

  • Own Git workflows, branching strategy, and code review standards across all active ROOM42 builds 

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for ROOM42's primary hosting environments (WP Engine, Pantheon, Acquia, Netlify/Vercel for JAMstack); make deployments repeatable and low-risk 

  • Manage staging, UAT, and production environment configurations; provision and document access for all ROOM42 developers 

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across the DevOps lifecycle — from scaffolding new projects to post-deploy validation 

 

AI-Augmented Design-to-Code Pipeline: 

  • Operate Figma MCP server integration to accelerate design handoff — extracting tokens, components, and layout specs directly into code-ready outputs; eliminating manual interpretation cycles 

  • Leverage AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor AI) as daily build accelerators — not novelties — across front-end, back-end, and configuration work 

  • Define and document ROOM42's AI-augmented build workflows for each deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner 

  • Stay ahead of emerging agentic tooling (MCP servers, AI browser agents, generative UI frameworks) and evaluate when adoption creates genuine delivery leverage 

 

QA and Test Automation: 

  • Implement AI-assisted QA automation across ROOM42 project types — visual regression testing, accessibility scanning, cross-browser checks, and functional testing pipelines 

  • Establish a QA automation baseline for repeatable deliverable types (CMS sites, kiosk apps, email builds) so that human QA effort concentrates on edge cases and client-specific requirements 

  • Triage technical defects surfaced by QA — classify root cause, assign or resolve remediation, verify fix integrity before re-advancing to UAT  

Standards, Mentorship, and Team Health: 

  • Define and maintain ROOM42's technical standards across deliverable types — coding conventions, repo structure, accessibility requirements, security baselines, deployment protocols 

  •  Conduct code reviews for all ROOM42 developers before deliverables advance to QA; enforce standards consistently and use reviews as teaching moments 

  • Partner with RC's VP of Technology on standards alignment, tooling strategy, and team architecture as the practice scales 

  • Lead technical onboarding for new ROOM42 hires — tool access, standards orientation, and first-week productivity within two weeks of start date 

  • Serve as primary technical escalation point when blockers threaten delivery; resolve environment, integration, and access issues within 24 hours of identification 

 

Technical Delivery: 

  • Partner with Producers and TDMs on SOW scoping — translate creative and functional requirements into accurate technical estimates for hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout 

  • Own the technical delivery lifecycle for key ROOM42 engagement from kickoff through post-launch, work with technical delivery managers to ensure timeline integrity, milestone readiness, and handoff completeness 

  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across all active projects; proactively flag risks to Delivery Managers before they surface in status calls 

  • Drive milestone gates: work closely with QA lead to ensure that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready — not optimistically ready 

  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping APIs, licensing constraints) and surface conflicts before they collide 

  • Own technical documentation throughout each engagement: architecture decisions, environment setup, API integration specs, deployment runbooks — so no knowledge lives only in one person's head 

  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, demo walkthroughs — presenting clearly and without jargon 

 

Quality Outcomes: 

  • Define 'done' for every deliverable type — not just 'it works' but that it is performant, accessible, secure, cross-browser validated, and visually faithful to approved design 

  • Own quality accountability end-to-end: if something ships broken, looks wrong, or fails an MLR technical review, this role is accountable for the root cause and the remediation 

  • Work with QA lead to establish and maintain a ROOM42 quality checklist for each deliverable type — covering functional, visual, performance, accessibility, and security checks — so quality is structural, not ad hoc 

  • Review developer output not only for code correctness but for UX implementation fidelity: does the built experience actually look and behave like the approved design? 

  • Lead post-launch quality reviews on major engagements; document defect patterns and translate them into upstream process improvements 

  • Champion performance as a quality dimension: page load, animation smoothness, kiosk responsiveness, and interactive load times are quality metrics, not afterthoughts 

  • Maintain zero tolerance for preventable defects reaching client UAT — own the internal quality bar so clients aren't the ones finding the obvious problems 

 

Design Eye, UX/UI Partnership, and Creative Collaboration: 

  • Speak UX fluently — understand information architecture, user flows, interaction patterns, and content hierarchy well enough to actively contribute to UX decisions, not just receive them 

  • Evaluate wireframes and prototypes through both a user experience lens and a technical feasibility lens simultaneously: identify where a flow creates friction before it's built, and where a design pattern creates technical debt before it ships 

  • Read a Figma file not just for spec values but for design intent — understand what the designer was solving for and protect that intent through every build decision, especially when specs have gaps or edge cases aren't covered 

  • Catch UX implementation drift before QA does: spot when a multi-step interaction is off-sequence, a loading state is missing, an error condition is unhandled, or a mobile breakpoint breaks the intended user journey 

  • Catch visual implementation drift with the same discipline: notice when padding is off, a typeface is rendering incorrectly, a hover state feels wrong, or a component is pixel-perfect in isolation but contextually broken in the live layout 

  • Participating actively in UX and design reviews as a technical partner — able to say 'that interaction pattern will feel laggy on kiosk hardware' or 'here's how we can get the same UX outcome with a lighter implementation' or 'this flow needs an empty state that the design doesn't account for' 

  • Understand foundational UX/UI principles — user task flow design, progressive disclosure, feedback and affordance, responsive and adaptive layout, motion and timing — well enough to make confident decisions when the design file doesn't cover every scenario 

  • Bridge the gap between design and engineering vocabulary; translate UX intent and creative direction into precise technical implementation notes that developers can execute without ambiguity or interpretation risk 

  • Push back constructively when a UX or design spec is technically infeasible at the required timeline or budget — and always bring an alternative that preserves the experience intent, not just a 'no' 

  • Appreciate that in healthcare and pharma, the human story being told is someone's life — and that the quality of the experience we build, how it feels to use, how clearly it communicates, how gracefully it handles errors, is not separate from the mission 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.  

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.  

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

 

What you should have:   

  • 7+ years of hands-on development experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead, staff engineer, or architect role 

  • Demonstrable full-stack proficiency — not a generalist who dabbles; someone who can build, review, and unblock at every layer 

  • A genuine design eye with UX/UI depth: able to evaluate user flows and interaction patterns for experience quality, read a Figma file for intent, catch UX and visual implementation drift, and make confident decisions at the design-code boundary without designer supervision 

  • Technical delivery experience: has owned milestone tracking, risk communication, and deployment readiness across concurrent projects — not just individual coding output 

  • Demonstrated accountability for quality outcomes: has owned defect triage, post-launch quality reviews, and upstream process improvements when things go wrong 

  • Active, daily practitioner of AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code) — able to define team-wide workflows around them 

  • Hands-on experience with Figma MCP server or comparable design-to-code AI tooling; familiar with design token standards and component handoff patterns 

  • QA automation experience: visual regression, accessibility automation, or AI-assisted test generation in a production environment 

  

Pay Range: $119,000 - $140,000
