job.title: Senior AI Transformation Analyst
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is seeking an  AI Transformation Senior Analyst to help reimagine how our business runs. You will join our transformation team, working alongside ambitious, supportive, and hard-working colleagues who always seek to do things better, faster, and smarter.

As an AI Transformation Senior Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in mapping how work gets done today and designing how it should get done in an AI-enabled future. Starting with our General & Administrative (G&A) functions, including finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, and internal communications, you will document current-state processes and operating models, design future-state alternatives, and help bring them to life across several AI transformation initiatives. You will also build the business case for each opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on the value they deliver. You will look holistically across people, processes, systems, and vendors to determine what should be automated or redesigned and which solution best fits each need, from a reusable AI skill to an end-to-end Copilot Cowork workflow or a coordinated team of AI agents. This position reports to the Vice President, Strategy and Revenue Analytics.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Map current-state processes: Lead process discovery with G&A stakeholders across finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, internal communications, and more to document how work gets done today, including handoffs, systems, data flows, vendors, pain points, and the time and cost behind each step.
  • Design future-state operating models: Translate current-state findings into practical future-state designs that rethink roles, responsibilities, governance, and ways of working, rather than simply digitizing today's processes.
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities: Assess where AI and automation can eliminate, streamline, or augment manual work, build business cases that size the impact, and shape a prioritized transformation roadmap.
  • Match the right solution to the problem: Determine the right fit for each need, whether a reusable AI skill, a Copilot Cowork workflow, a coordinated swarm of AI agents, an enhancement to an existing system, or a process change with no new technology at all, and partner with technical teams to pilot and scale solutions.
  • Get more from current automations: Inventory and assess the automations and tools already in place, identify gaps and redundancies, and recommend how to extract more value from existing investments.
  • Rethink sourcing and vendors: Analyze what we outsource versus perform in-house, assess vendor fit and cost, and determine where AI enablement means outsourced work should instead be automated or brought in-house.
  • Drive change and adoption: Partner with function leaders to plan and execute transitions, including change management, training, communications, and success measures that make new ways of working stick.
  • Advise leadership: Develop clear, executive-ready materials, including process maps, operating model blueprints, business cases, and roadmaps, and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if you:

  • Think like a consultant and act like an owner, bringing structured problem solving and a bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges.
  • Are energized by rethinking traditional processes for the age of AI, and stay curious about emerging tools, agents, and automation approaches.
  • See the whole picture across people, processes, systems, vendors, and data, and understand how a change in one area ripples through the others.
  • Are highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, adept at managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment while delivering results under tight deadlines.
  • Build trust quickly with stakeholders at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership, and can guide teams confidently through change.

What you should have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in strategy, transformation, or digital consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Deloitte Digital, or similar firms, large or boutique), or in a corporate strategy, transformation, or M&A integration role.
  • Hands-on experience with transformation work, such as digital transformation, M&A integration, acquisitions, or divestitures, including process mapping, integration or separation planning, Day 1 readiness, or operating model design.
  • Demonstrated experience mapping current- and future-state processes and designing target operating models, ideally across G&A or back-office functions.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI assistants, AI agents, workflow automation platforms such as Power Automate or Workato, or RPA) and the ability to translate business needs into practical automation use cases.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and analysis tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings simply and confidently to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • PR, communications, advertising, healthcare, or agency experience a plus.

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MBA, MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, business, marketing, communications, or related discipline.

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products.  These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

  • Work related diversity, equity and inclusion involvement a plus

If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.

Role Purpose

Our MWs play a fundamental role in our business by contributing to day-to-day project delivery within an account to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for a proactive communicator with a passion for science, a keen interest in AI, and a keen eye for detail who is looking to develop their medical writing career further.  

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Has a good understanding of assigned therapeutic areas
    • Effectively analyses and interprets scientific data to work on a wide range of assigned projects
  • Strategic knowledge:
    • Understands the medical affairs and commercial spaces within which clients work
    • Reviews literature and competitive information to continually expand understanding of brand/marketplace and emerging competitors and shares findings and implications with teams
    • Participates in meetings and strategic discussions with clients, authors, and advisors
  • AI
    • Confidently and efficiently uses AI tools to support assigned tasks, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in their work
    • Seeks out new opportunities to apply AI tools in to improve personal workflow and task management
  • Project ownership:
    • Takes some responsibility for day-to-day delivery of scientific content under supervision of MW2 or SMW and higher
    • Ensures communication objectives are met on assigned projects
  • Editorial:
    • Adapts writing style to suit different audiences (e.g. primary and secondary care physicians, nurses or patients)
    • Structure and writes more commercially focused or complicated materials such as story flows/strategic frameworks, competitor intelligence, advisory board reports, etc. with clear supervision from SMW or higher
  • Quality control:
    • Ensures all work is referenced appropriately and is provided with a full reference pack
    • Ensures all work is tagged appropriately on VVPM
    • Is fully adherent to and shows a good working knowledge the ABPI code of conduct
    • Demonstrates knowledge of good practice/industry guidelines and ensures project work is compliant with these with supervision from senior team
  • On site: May go on-site across a variety of events and interacting with clients and faculty to develop and finalise content
  • Client liaison: Has begun to have client contact for content development on straight-forward projects and escalates queries in more challenging scenarios
  • Project management
    • Adheres to project schedules and briefs
    • Understands key dates in project timelines and keeps the account team apprised of status on projects by providing timely and accurate communication
    • Proactively clarifies how a project status is tracking versus the number of hours available
    • Participates in the tracking of project deliverables, identifying impact of out-of-scope changes
    • Adheres to project budgets, or proactively provides appropriate reasons not to
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on writing and company processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and have a keen eye for detail
  • You should bring previous experience as a (junior) medical writer at an agency or within a pharmaceutical organisation

Role Overview

Real Chemistry is looking for an experienced Senior Analyst (Omnichannel Analytics) to help us build and scale our business intelligence practice for our media and omnichannel clients through advanced analytics, insights, and attribution modeling. We are looking for someone with hands-on-keyboard experience crafting analyses that answer clients’ key business questions about media performance. Reporting to the Director, Beyond Insights, this position will be client facing, with the opportunity to speak to ongoing deliverables and work with cross-functional media, strategy, and technology teams. You will get to use a new set of data partners to seamlessly integrate media and channel data flowing from partners into Tableau dashboards and ultimately client-facing performance reports. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Build, manage, and deliver time-based performance reporting for media and omnichannel campaigns (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting) 
  • Integrate media, channel, and partner data sources into Tableau dashboards and client-facing performance reports 
  • Conduct data exploration, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and mining across structured media and marketing data sources 
  • Develop quantitative analyses, predictive models, and attribution approaches that explain how media programs are performing and where to optimize 
  • Craft analyses and insights that answer clients’ key business questions, and present findings directly to client and internal stakeholders 
  • Partner with media, strategy, data engineering, and marketing technology teams on measurement methodology and campaign execution 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence/advanced analytics/data analytics working closely with data 
  • Pharmaceutical media and marketing experience, with hands-on exposure to HCP and/or consumer omnichannel campaigns 
  • Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis, including the development of algorithms leveraging SQL, R or Python 
  • Experience working with relational databases and with Snowflake or Databricks 
  • Experience with visualization tools/packages such as Tableau or PowerBI, and with creating dashboards 
  • Experience with reporting in media tools like Google Campaign Manager, Doubleclick Campaign Manager and Adobe Experience Manager 
  • Experience building reports in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations to senior clients externally or to senior internal stakeholders 
  • Formal training/education in quantitative/data analysis, and an understanding of causal inference 
  • Understanding of visual information design principles 
  • Knowledge of agile principles/project management and experience with agile tools and methodologies 

The Ideal Candidate 

  • Creative. You are energized by turning messy, multi-source media data into clear answers to real business questions. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers 
  • Customer first. You enjoy client-facing work and can explain your analysis and its implications to a non-technical audience 
  • A collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional teams and are comfortable working across Media, Analytics, Strategy, and Technology partners 
  • A culture carrier. You embody Real Chemistry’s values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I.”

You will combine strong research and analytical foundations with creative strategic thinking. You will explore markets, audiences and competitors, turn insights into clear strategic recommendations, and help shape work that resonates with clients and their audiences. The role will mainly support senior strategists while offering strong scope to learn, collaborate internationally and progress as the team continues to grow.

  • Conduct primary and desk research to build a clear understanding of markets, sectors, audiences and behaviours. 
  • Develop consumer and stakeholder insights that help shape creative and brand strategy. 
  • Carry out category and competitor analysis, identifying the most relevant opportunities and challenges. 
  • Support senior strategy colleagues across global account work, strategic projects and client deliverables.

  • Work closely with Creative, Client Services, Medical Education and wider cross-functional teams. 
  • Support new business pitches through research, insight development and strategic thinking. 
  • Present thinking confidently to internal teams and, as experience grows, to clients. 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are curious, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in understanding people and what drives them. 
  • You are a clear and engaging communicator who enjoys presenting ideas and contributing to discussion. 
  • You bring positive energy, ambition and a desire to develop within strategy. 
  • You can balance detailed research with the ability to step back, identify the key insight and tell a compelling story. 
  • You are collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across different disciplines and with colleagues in other markets. 
  • You are adaptable, organised and able to deliver high-quality work against deadlines. 
  • Our Company values - Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” - really speak to you.

We're looking for a senior social-first content creator who lives and breathes digital culture and knows exactly what stops the scroll. job.title: Promotion/Social Media Specialist - KS95
job.description:
Promotion/Social Media Specialist - KS95

#26-1339

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio-Twin Cities is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater Minneapolis-Saint Paul community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Promotions Coordinator/Social Media Strategist serves as the primary liaison for contest winners, manages prize fulfillment, coordinates station events, and works closely with programming, sales, and promotional partners to ensure flawless execution of station campaigns and experiences. The role also provides support for the station's digital and social media strategy by analyzing audience engagement, evaluating campaign performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping shape content strategies that strengthen listener connection and brand impact.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and moving pieces.

Job Responsibilities

Contest & Promotion Management

Coordinate and execute all on-air and online contests and giveaways.

Manage winner selection, verification, paperwork collection, and prize fulfillment.

Process contest-related documentation, including tax forms and check requests.

Track winner paperwork and ensure compliance with station, legal, and accounting requirements.

Maintain accurate records of prize inventory and distribution.

Monitor and respond to promotions email and phone lines.

Event Coordination

Execute station events, appearances, and promotional activations.

Coordinate event staffing, logistics, and communication with sales, talent, and street team.

Create event materials, schedules, and briefing sheets.

Maintain event supplies, promotional inventory, and station vehicles.

Attend and support station events, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy

Create a station social media strategy for KS95. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance station/brand content performance, audience growth, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Assist with content planning and social media calendars, ensuring consistent and strategic messaging across platforms.

Coach and direct the team on best practices in social media posting by platforms.

Analyze social media, digital marketing, and audience engagement performance to identify trends, successes, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Help execute sponsor and client deliverables across social media platforms.

Assist in promoting station events, contests, and community initiatives.

Stay informed on emerging social media trends across platform changes, algorithm updates, digital marketing best practices, and new advertising opportunities across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging digital channels.

Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, or similar platforms.

Ability to analyze audience, social media, and promotional campaign data; identify what is driving engagement and results; and make strategic recommendations for future content, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and Holidays.

Preferred

Experience in radio, media, entertainment, promotions, marketing, or event coordination.

Familiarity with WordPress, VPromo, Asana, Audience, and Canva

Experience with contesting, prize fulfillment, and event logistics.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The hourly rate of pay for this position is $24.04 per hour.

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Fellow, News Video
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Join the 2027 New York Times fellowship as a video journalist in New York.

The News Video fellow will serve in a video producer capacity on our daily news/breaking news team. You will have a focus in two areas: producing videos for our new Watch tab and producing video coverage on our live journalism team. This is a chance to be on the forefront of our newest initiatives and to participate in some of the biggest breaking news stories. You will be part of the first line of defense on developing stories, helping with innovating digital video news and doing ground-level reporting.

You should have newsroom experience and a solid foundation of how to scout social platforms for video content, verify that content and identify video-storytelling opportunities. You should have a grasp of video production, from editing and shooting to scripting. You can work across breaking news, enterprise and investigations. 

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Research and develop news stories for video, including sourcing relevant footage from social media, archives and news wires 
  • Help manage source material, and translation and transcription needs
  • Verify the accuracy and authenticity of media reported across the web and social
  • Contribute to video scripts and social copy 
  • Help coordinate the post-production process for video stories
  • Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the newsroom
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

  • No more than five years of full-time, professional journalism experience, excluding internships
  • Strong news judgment
  • Ability to research, compile and analyze media
  • Familiarity with fact-checking and the ability to parse misinformation and disinformation, and support those findings with evidence
  • Can work with colleagues and reporters to synthesize newsgathering and/or investigations into a tight, informative and engaging video

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in news and media verification and/or fact-checking
  • At least one year of experience as an associate producer or producer in a professional video journalism environment
  • Experience sourcing and verifying news video from social media
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere
  • Ability to adapt to change in an unpredictable news and production environment

To apply, upload a résumé and cover letter. You should also include a link to a portfolio of your work. The application will prompt you when to upload materials and ask you for the link to your portfolio. Applications that fail to include any of these materials or follow these instructions will not be considered.

You must be authorized to work in the United States. We will not sponsor work visas for the fellowship, but we will consider applicants with valid work authorization or a valid student visa that can be extended with Optional Practical Training.

You may apply to only one fellowship position per year. For instance, if you apply as a video journalist, you should not apply for any other positions in the fellowship. Duplicate applications will be discarded.

The application deadline is 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on Nov. 20.

The Times Fellowship generates a high level of interest, so we cannot acknowledge the status of applications upon receipt or during the vetting process, which can take eight weeks or more. We cannot accept applications that are mailed or emailed to us. We will contact you for interviews as needed.

The fellowship program will begin on or about June 7, 2027, and end on May 26, 2028, subject to satisfactory performance. There is no guarantee of a full-time position upon completion of the program.

For more information about the Times Fellowship, visit here.

 

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of New York.

job.title: Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. The Omnichannel Strategy team sits at the center of this ecosystem, partnering closely with Media, Analytics, CRM, Engagement, Creative, Technology, and Client Services teams to design customer-centric experiences that align business objectives, audience needs, and channel activation. Our strategists help clients move beyond channel planning to deliver coordinated engagement across the full customer journey. 

The Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead the development of omnichannel engagement strategies for assigned brands, products, and business challenges, grounded in a strong understanding of media strategy and how paid media connects across the broader customer experience. This role translates audience insights, customer needs, media behaviors, market dynamics, and business objectives into actionable journey architectures, media and channel strategies, and engagement plans that drive measurable outcomes.   As a strategic leader, you will guide audience segmentation, customer journey development, media and channel planning, engagement strategy, and orchestration design while serving as a trusted strategic partner to clients and internal teams. You will collaborate across Media, Analytics, CRM, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services to create integrated experiences that connect customer needs with business goals.

What you’ll do 

  • Architect omnichannel engagement strategies with media strategy at the core, connecting paid media with owned, earned, CRM, field, and digital channels.
  • Lead audience segmentation, persona development and customer prioritization across healthcare professional, patient, caregiver and other relevant audiences. 
  • Design end-to-end customer journeys that identify audience needs, barriers, behaviors, triggers and engagement opportunities. 
  • Develop media and channel orchestration frameworks that define the role of paid media and connect it effectively across owned, earned, field, CRM, and digital touchpoints.
  • Lead client and internal workshops focused on audience strategy, journey design and engagement planning. 
  • Define measurement frameworks, testing plans and strategic requirements for CRM, analytics and engagement platforms. 
  • Translate client needs, market research, media and campaign performance, and audience insights into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams.
  • Oversee supporting strategists, delegate work and review deliverables for strategic quality and consistency. 
  • Contribute to scoping conversations and manage multiple client workstreams to established timelines and utilization expectations. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have 

  • Demonstrated experience developing media strategy, ideally within healthcare, pharmaceutical marketing, or another highly regulated or complex industry.
  • Strong understanding of paid media strategy and how channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, and other digital media work together within an omnichannel ecosystem.
  • Experience leading client workshops, strategic planning sessions or collaborative working sessions.
  • Strong understanding of how paid media connects with owned channels, CRM, field engagement, content and digital experiences.
  • Ability to translate research, data, media performance and campaign results into strategic recommendations. 
  • Experience overseeing junior strategists and providing feedback, training or quality review.
  • Strong client communication, presentation development and facilitation skills. 

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$115,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

*Notice: Real Chemistry and its affiliates' names are being misused by scammers through messaging services, fake websites, and apps. Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As a Senior Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium to large projects. As a client account lead or captain (depending on the size of the account), you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead and/or sponsor.

 

You should have a clear understanding of the programme as a whole (not just the projects you are working on) across your accounts, increasing your involvement in the strategic planning and financial management of your accounts and focusing on developing your leadership style to actively manage up and down, based on project needs.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client (leading updates on more complex projects); anticipate client needs; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Application Delivery
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The Developer Platforms mission at The New York Times builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and paved paths that help product teams ship high‑quality experiences quickly and safely. Our Application Delivery team owns the shared software delivery platform (CI/CD, artifact management) and deployment workflows used by hundreds of engineers across News, Cooking, Games and Audio to ship software.

As the Times leans into AI‑assisted and agentic development, Application Delivery is where those changes become real. You will set the technical direction for how AI‑generated and agent‑driven change flows safely, observably, and at scale through CI/CD.

You'll help teams reduce release risk with modern deployment patterns, and turn effective delivery practices into reusable pipelines and templates that scale across the organization, much like our GenAI platform roles turn internal practices into reusable tools and agents. When you improve this platform, you change how The New York Times ships software.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the DevEx Application Delivery team. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical direction of software delivery as a shared product: shape paved paths in our shared platform that improve code health, release quality, and delivery speed for product teams.

  • Set the technical direction for agent‑ready delivery: design the policy, guardrails, and paved paths that turn AI‑generated and agent‑driven changes (migrations, test generation, pipeline maintenance) into safe, observable releases at scale by partnering with our Developer AI team.

  • Collaborate with Product, engineering leaders, and internal users to shape the roadmap for the delivery platform and bring measurable impact on quality and speed.

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and observable software delivery systems and workflows that improve reliability, and overall software quality and velocity.

  • Champion engineering excellence in delivery by setting best practices for testing, deployment strategies, progressive delivery, and observability that are easy to adopt through the platform.

  • Mentor engineers across the mission, contribute to hiring, and help foster an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture centered on shared platforms and high‑quality software delivery.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our mission and values and a commitment to our purpose to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KFVS:

KFVS12 is the #1 local TV station serving as the CBS/CW/MeTV/Outlaw/Telemundo/Oxygen/GRIT affiliate in the Cape Girardeau, Missouri/Paducah, Kentucky/Harrisburg, Illinois market. Founded in 1954, KFVS12 has a rich heritage of serving "America's Heartland" with the best local news and weather information, along with a legacy of community service and disaster relief. KFVS12 produces more local news than any other station in the market, currently offering over 50 hours of news content every week, along with special high-profile, topical local programming. Heartland News on KFVS12 consistently leads the competition in award-winning journalism having been honored this year with numerous Missouri and Illinois Broadcasters' Awards as well as the prestigious Edward R. Murrow Awards.

The Cape Girardeau market covers 45 counties in four states and is home to four division-one universities. It is where the North meets the South and the East meets the West. The area is rich with many diverse communities, including historic riverfront towns, that offer a variety of unique benefits and recreational opportunities. It is also conveniently located for easy travel to St. Louis, Memphis, Nashville, and Chicago.

The station has an exceptional staff that is committed to maintaining the legacy of the institution of KFVS. They are forward-thinking with news coverage in on-air newscasts and 24/7 on numerous digital platforms, consistently leading the competition in digital traffic across the board. This provides exciting opportunities throughout the station including News, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and more.

Job Summary/Description:

KFVS is seeking applicants for bilingual interns in partnership with Southeast Missouri State University and three universities located in Puerto Rico that belong to the Hispanic Educational Technology Services (HETS) program. Applicants should be in their junior or senior year at a HETS partner University and willing to live in Cape Girardeau, Missouri for a semester while attending Southeast Missouri State University. These positions will teach producing, shooting, and editing skills while contributing and creating content for Spanish-speaking Gray Television outlets. Partnership Universities include:

  • Inter-American University – Universidad Inter American De Puerto Rico
  • Sacred Heart University -- Universidad Del Sagrado Carazon
  • Ana G. Mendez University – Universidad Ana G. Mendez

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Meet enrollment criteria above
* Train with digital producer to produce/write/edit for KFVS digital properties.
* Work with a photojournalist to learn camera operation basics.
* Shadow Multi-Media Journalist to learn how to shoot/write/edit news stories for broadcast and/or streaming.
* Translate relevant stories from English to Spanish for digital properties.
* Enrolled in a HETS-affiliated school.
* Proficient in English and Spanish.

*** Intern rate of pay can range from minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour ***

(Current employees who are interested in this position can apply through the Gray-TV UltiPro self-service portal)

KFVS-TV/Gray Media, Inc. is a drug-free company

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, Financial Data Reporting

 

Position Overview

The Director, Financial Data Reporting leads the strategy, architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise ﬁnancial data and business intelligence solutions. This role combines deep expertise in data engineering, warehousing, analytics, ﬁnancial systems, and technical leadership to improve business processes, expand access to trusted information, and enable timely, informed decision-making.

 

The Director owns the full systems development life cycle for complex reporting and data initiatives—from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, production support, and continuous optimization. The role also directs the conﬁguration of interactive dashboards, including global and local ﬁlters, to meet a broad range of ﬁnance and business requirements.

 

Serving as a trusted partner to executive leadership, Corporate Finance, IT, Security, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director translates business needs into scalable technical solutions, strengthens data governance and controls, resolves performance challenges, and advances the organization’s ﬁnancial reporting capabilities.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic leadership: Connects data and technology priorities to business strategy and long-term enterprise needs.
  • Business partnership: Builds credibility across Finance, IT, Security, operations, vendors, and executive leadership.
  • Execution and accountability: Converts complex requirements into reliable solutions and delivers measurable results across competing priorities.
  • Continuous improvement: Uses data, technology, and disciplined problem-solving to simplify processes and improve performance.
  • Communication and inﬂuence: Presents complex information clearly and drives alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy, design, development, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehouse, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Manage the full systems development life cycle across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring solutions align with stakeholder requirements, technical standards, delivery commitments, and business priorities.
  • Own the AWS (RDS MySQL, S3) and SQL Server reporting databases, including moving the remaining legacy reporting to AWS.
  • Own month-end close data processing: WideOrbit, programmatic, digital and MAI revenue loads and the journal entry/invoice ﬁles into SAP, including reconciliations and controls.
  • Own the Power BI estate: reports, data models, scheduled refreshes and subscriptions, including daily revenue pacing and the daily liquidity summary.
  • Lead digital analytics data engineering on Google Cloud (BigQuery) and the Tableau-to-Power BI migration.
  • Direct the contractors and vendors supporting data and reporting.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks and backup coverage so no critical process depends on one person.
  • Evaluate and recommend system architecture that improves scalability, reliability, availability, performance, and access to critical ﬁnancial data.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Build and optimize data processes that integrate multiple disparate data sets into a trusted reporting environment, reducing executive reporting cycle times.
  • Partner with Corporate Finance and cross-functional teams to identify reporting needs, resolve data and warehouse performance issues, and deliver timely, actionable insights.
  • Oversee the integration of WideOrbit, WideOrbit Programs, MAI, Concur, Costar, Darwin, Operative, ADP, Blackline, Magnit, and related vendor systems with SAP and the broader reporting environment.
  • Design and conﬁgure interactive dashboards using global and local ﬁlters to support a diverse matrix of ﬁnancial and operational requirements.
  • Establish data governance, validation, reconciliation, documentation, and quality-control practices that support accurate, consistent, secure, and audit-ready ﬁnancial reporting.
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and Security to maintain appropriate data access, privacy, retention, and information-security standards.
  • Provide production support and operational oversight, including monitoring, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, change management, and business continuity for critical reporting solutions.
  • Deﬁne and monitor success measures for data availability, reporting accuracy, system performance, user adoption, project delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Provide technical leadership, communicate complex data concepts clearly, manage key vendor relationships, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders, business partners, and technical teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related ﬁeld; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, or ﬁnancial systems, including at least ﬁve years leading enterprise initiatives, technical teams, or cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated success delivering executive reporting solutions and leading complex systems integrations, cloud or data warehouse migrations, and ERP transformations.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL-based environments, cloud data platforms, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, dashboard design, data quality practices, and ﬁnancial reporting architecture.
  • Experience with project management, SDLC governance, quality assurance, production support, and vendor management in a complex operating environment.
  • Proven ability to inﬂuence senior leaders, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and support multiple business units.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and executive-presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to ﬁnancial, operational, and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a related ﬁeld.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, AWS MySQL, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and enterprise ﬁnancial or media-industry systems.
  • Relevant certiﬁcation such as CPA, CMA, CBIP, Microsoft Power BI, AWS, GCP, SAP, PMP, or CSM.

Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Delivery Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager join our growing team!

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has been ranked the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. ROOM42 is 21GRAMS’ in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — the team that turns briefs, Figma files, and napkin sketches into working, beautiful, compliant digital deliverables for the top pharma and biotech companies in the world.

We are looking for an AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) to run technical delivery across the full ROOM42 output spectrum — marketing websites, microsites, emails (including Veeva rep-triggered and approved email), banners, IVAs, conference kiosks and interactive experiences — built with in-house developers and specialist vendor partners. This is the person who owns whether the right work gets to the right build team, whether the estimate is real, whether it ships to spec and on time, and who is increasingly using AI to make all of that faster and more consistent. The project manager and account teams own the client relationship and the date. The TDM owns whether that date is achievable and gets the work built — qualifying intake, routing to the right build team, running the review-and-QA lifecycle, holding vendors to standard, and applying AI where it creates genuine delivery leverage, not novelty.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Intake & Technical Qualification

  • Triage incoming requests from Workfront and Jira; assign deliverable type, complexity tier, and dependency flags (Veeva, MLR, client restrictions) within a defined SLA.
  • Return incomplete requests rather than absorbing them — no handoff to build without specs, assets, link matrix, CTAs/UTMs, and a real level-of-effort estimate.
  • Own or validate the estimate before any build commitment, using ROOM42’s estimation tooling and rate card. 

Build Team Routing & Vendor Management

  • Decide in-house vs. vendor partner per project against MSA offshore rules, client restrictions, Veeva dependency, and capacity — and escalate routing decisions that carry cost or transition implications.
  • Run day-to-day vendor delivery: standing syncs, staging-date accountability, cap-burn visibility against SOW, and knowledge-transfer documentation during vendor transitions.
  • Escalate quality issues to the vendor lead and commercial issues to the Digital & Technology leadership.

Technical Delivery Lifecycle

  • Own delivery from kickoff through post-launch: dev kickoff, staging links, review-round sequencing (R1/R2/R3), MLR/PRC submission readiness, QA gate, and go-live.
  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across a concurrent portfolio; proactively flag risks to Producers and Delivery leadership before they surface in status calls.
  • Drive milestone gates with QA — confirm that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready, not optimistically ready.
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping timelines, licensing, PDUFA-anchored dates) and surface conflicts before they collide.

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate the delivery workflow — status synthesis, ticket hygiene, QA support, specification drafting, and documentation — not as novelties but as real accelerators.
  • Partner on ROOM42’s AI-augmented QA and design-to-code workflows (visual regression, accessibility scanning, Figma-to-code handoff) so quality is structural and repeatable across deliverable types.
  • Help define and document AI-assisted delivery playbooks per deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner, and evaluate emerging tooling for genuine leverage.
  • Apply judgment to AI output — know where AI-assisted work needs human review before it reaches a client, and keep quality from degrading as volume scales.

Quality, Standards & Portfolio Hygiene

  • Define ‘done’ for each deliverable type with the technical lead and QA — not just ‘it works,’ but performant, accessible, cross-browser validated, MLR-clean, and visually faithful to approved design.
  • Own quality accountability for your portfolio: if something ships broken or fails an MLR technical review, own the root cause and the remediation.
  • Enforce Jira/Workfront field discipline and status accuracy so the portfolio is legible to leadership and reporting is reliable.
  • Lead post-launch reviews on major engagements; translate defect patterns into upstream process improvements.

Partnership & Communication

  • Serve as the technical delivery counterpart to Producers, account teams, UX/UI, developers, and QA — translating between them without jargon.
  • Partner with Producers on SOW scoping: turn creative and functional requirements into accurate hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout plans.
  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical delivery credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, and demo walkthroughs.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Hands-on AI implementation experience in a real delivery context — you have built or stood up AI-assisted workflows that shipped, not just experimented with tools. This means applying AI to concrete delivery problems (specification drafting, estimation, ticket and status synthesis, QA support, documentation, triage classification, deployment), measuring whether it actually saved time, and exercising judgment over the output before it reaches a client.
  • Daily, practical fluency with AI build and delivery tooling — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Figma-to-code integrations, AI-assisted QA — and the discernment to tell genuine leverage from hype and to catch where AI output degrades quality at scale.
  • 5+ years of digital project or technical delivery management in an agency or production environment, running concurrent digital builds from intake through launch.
  • Hands-on experience delivering across web (WordPress and/or Drupal), email, and banners; exposure to IVAs, Veeva, or interactive experiences a strong plus.
  • Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-delivery experience — familiarity with MLR/PRC review cycles, compliance gates, and fixed regulatory launch dates.
  • Vendor and cross-functional coordination: routing work, holding external partners to standard, and managing offshore/nearshore delivery.
  • Fluency in delivery tooling: Jira, Workfront or comparable, and a working understanding of QA, staging/UAT/production flow, and design-to-code handoff.
  • Enough technical literacy to hold a credible build conversation with developers and vendors, scope realistically, and know when to pull in the technical lead — without needing to write production code.

Nice to have

  • Experience defining and documenting AI-augmented delivery playbooks so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner across a team or vendor pod.
  • Hands-on work with agentic tooling — MCP servers, AI browser agents, or generative UI frameworks — and a point of view on where each creates real delivery leverage.
  • Built AI-assisted QA automation in production: visual regression, accessibility scanning, or AI-generated test coverage.
  • Veeva certification (approved email and/or IVA).
  • Experience standing up delivery processes, studios, or standards from the ground up.

Pay Range: $95,000-$100,000
The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

What You’ll Do: 

Social Leadership, Strategy & Business Impact

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Meteorologist - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB-TV in Atlanta is seeking a Meteorologist to join Severe Weather Team 2. The Atlanta area experiences all four seasons, making forecasting a central part of our coverage. Severe weather is a major focus, and we’re seeking a candidate with strong on-air delivery who can provide breaking weather coverage with a clear, authoritative presence.

 

The ideal candidate is creative and clear in their presentation and graphic support, has a digital-first mindset and connects authentically with viewers both on-air and online. This Meteorologist will also contribute to daily editorial meetings and turn stories.

 

Please submit your resume, link to demo reel (including breaking weather coverage), and examples of digital/social content in your application.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver clear, accurate, and engaging forecasts across multiple newscasts
  • Provide confident, in-depth coverage during severe and breaking weather events
  • Contribute to storm tracking and team coverage during high-impact weather
  • Create and publish timely, compelling content for digital, app, streaming, and social platforms
  • Produce weather explainers and enterprise content that enhances viewer understanding
  • Utilize The Weather Company and Baron Lynx weather systems to build visually compelling graphics and presentations
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to integrate weather coverage across all platforms
  • Represent the station at community events and public appearances

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
  • Minimum 3–5 years of on-air broadcast meteorology experience (major or competitive mid-major market preferred)
  • Proven experience covering severe weather and extended storm events
  • Strong working knowledge of The Weather Company system
  • Excellent live presentation, ad-libbing, and storytelling skills
  • Demonstrated digital-first approach, including social media and app engagement
  • Flexible scheduling, including weekends and holidays, is required, along with participation in an on-call rotation
  • This is an on-site, in-station role in the WSB-TV Newsroom
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active AMS Seal of Approval (CBM or CDM preferred)

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com
