job.title: Senior Manager, Evidence & Insights (RWE & HEOR)
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for an Senior Manager join our growing Evidence & Insights team! 

The Senior Manager, Evidence & Insights provides strategic and scientific support across real-world evidence (RWE), health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and evidence generation. This role co-leads client engagements end-to-end, helping to shape evidence strategies, oversee analytics and deliverables, and advise biopharma and related stakeholders. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do: 

  • Co-lead and support RWE and HEOR strategy across client programs, including evidence planning, study design, and interpretation of findings to inform value, access, and payer and health system decision-making. 
  • Design and support evidence generation plans (e.g., RWE studies, retrospective database studies, economic models) aligned to product lifecycle needs and client requirements. 
  • Develop and oversee the process for systematic literature reviews (SLRs), including the development of study protocols, execution of study searches, delegation of screening, and oversight of data extraction and reporting (leveraging the Nested Knowledge platform where possible).
  • Translate complex real-world datasets and outcomes evidence into clear, defensible insights and recommendations for clients (clinical, economic, and utilization outcomes). 
  • Serve as a client co-lead alongside Director and VP: build trusted relationships, guide strategic direction, and ensure work products meet scientific rigor, timelines, and client expectations. 
  • Directly manage staff planning, internal and external project timelines, internal and external communications, and budgets to ensure projects are adequately staffed, managed, and executed.
  • Stay current on evolving evidence standards and trends impacting access decisions, including: 
    • HTA requirements and value frameworks 
    • Payer evidence expectations and comparative effectiveness 
    • RWE guidance and regulatory considerations 
    • Measurement/reporting of quality, performance, and outcomes 
  • Co-lead scoping and resourcing for engagements: define scope of work, timelines, budgets, and staffing plans; proactively manage risks and changes. 
  • Partner cross-functionally to connect evidence strategy to broader client objectives and account growth. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have: 

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience in HEOR, RWE, SLR, epidemiology, outcomes research, market access strategy, or closely related fields (consulting and/or biopharma experience preferred). 
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in health economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, or related discipline. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in HEOR/RWE study design and execution and ability to translate evidence into access-relevant strategy. 
  • Strong project/program leadership experience, including managing teams on complex, multi-workstream engagements and ensuring scientific and editorial quality. 
  • Excellent writing, editing, and executive communication skills; ability to craft clear narratives from technical analyses. 
  • Strong analytical fluency and comfort engaging with complex datasets and statistical outputs (hands-on analytics not required but highly valued).

job.title: Lifestyle Host/Reporter
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the NBC TEGNA-owned affiliate in St. Louis, Missouri is looking for a dynamic, creative and engaging Lifestyle Host & Multimedia Journalist to join Show Me St. Louis, our locally produced lifestyle and entertainment program. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms.
St. Louis is filled with incredible people, neighborhoods, restaurants, businesses, nonprofits, attractions and experiences, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to tell their stories.


The ideal candidate is an engaging on-air personality and strong storyteller who is equally comfortable hosting in the studio, reporting in the field and working behind the camera. This person should know how to take an idea from concept to air, whether that means interviewing a guest live, shooting and editing a feature story, creating an engaging live shot or working with a local business or community partner to develop compelling content. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:
•    Host Show Me St. Louis and deliver on-air content in an engaging, conversational and accurate manner.
•    Shoot, write, edit and report compelling lifestyle and community stories.
•    Conduct engaging interviews both in studio and in the field.
•    Develop original content showcasing the people, places, businesses, food, entertainment, nonprofits and experiences that make the St. Louis region unique.
•    Pitch fresh, creative and timely story ideas and help shape future Show Me St. Louis programming.
•    Generate fun, creative and content-driven live shots and field segments.
•    Work professionally and collaboratively with advertising clients and community partners to turn their ideas into compelling television.
•    Create content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
•    Maintain an active and professional social media presence while finding new ways to engage with viewers.
•    Use photography and editing tools to create polished, visually engaging stories.
•    Contribute to sponsored content, station initiatives, special programming and community events.
•    Collaborate with producers, photographers, sales teams and other departments to execute content across platforms.
•    Manage multiple stories and projects while consistently meeting deadlines.

Requirements:
•    2–4 years of experience in broadcast journalism, multimedia journalism, lifestyle television, hosting or a related field preferred.
•    Strong on-camera presence with an authentic, approachable personality.
•    Strong interviewing, writing and storytelling skills.
•    Experience shooting and editing video.
•    Ability to independently take a story from idea to finished product.
•    Comfortable working with advertising clients, local businesses, nonprofits and community organizations.
•    Creative thinker who understands how to make lifestyle content informative, entertaining and visually compelling.
•    Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to perform under tight deadlines.
•    Experience in creating content for social and digital platforms.
•    Experience with ENPS and EDIUS is preferred.
•    Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.

Who We're Looking For
We want someone who is curious about St. Louis and genuinely excited to explore it. Someone who can walk into a restaurant kitchen, community event, local business or live studio interview and immediately make people feel comfortable.
This person should bring personality and creativity to the show while also having the journalistic and production skills to find a story, shoot it, write it, edit it and tell it well.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to help viewers discover something new about St. Louis every day.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. job.title: Senior Digital Designer
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design how Semafor's journalism is presented across digital products, bringing rigorous typography, clear information hierarchy, and strong editorial layout to every story, newsletter, and feature.
  • Work with Product and Editorial to envision and design new news products and formats, exploring multiple visual and structural approaches while keeping readability and usability top of mind.
  • Partner closely with Editorial, Product, and Engineering to design and launch elegant, technically feasible solutions, from story templates to special editorial packages.
  • Hold a high bar for the Semafor reading experience, ensuring our products feel cohesive, considered, and unmistakably ours.
  • Own and evolve typographic standards within Semafor's design system and brand guidelines; ensure visual consistency across platforms and teams globally.
  • Support Marketing and Audience teams in creating brand materials that align with Semafor's digital products.
  • Collaborate with freelancers and other designers, offering critique and feedback that keeps design output consistently high quality.
  • Help build a collaborative, productive design culture as a member of Semafor's design team.
  • Bring a strong point of view on how other news and media brands design for readers: what they do well, where they fall short, and how Semafor can break through.

What Makes You Qualified

  • 5+ years of digital and visual design experience, ideally in media, publishing, or high-growth consumer companies.
  • Sophisticated design sensibilities, with deep command of typography, information hierarchy, grid, and layout.
  • Editorial design experience: you know how to make complex information clear, scannable, and compelling for readers.
  • A portfolio that shows typographic and editorial work alongside shipped digital products.
  • Ability to produce high-quality, production-ready designs with a high degree of independence.
  • Solid grounding in product and interaction design for web and mobile.
  • Experience working with, and ideally developing, design systems.
  • Enthusiasm for collaborating with engineers, editors, product managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working on diverse teams with colleagues from many different backgrounds.
  • Comfort incorporating AI tools into your workflow while holding a strong point of view on craft and quality.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-moving environment, with flexibility and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.
  • An entrepreneurial drive and an eagerness to learn and grow as the company scales.
  • Passion for the media industry and great journalism.
  • Willingness to work in person four days per week in New York and to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

The base salary for this position ranges from $130,000 - $170,000 per year. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

Additional Job Details:

This position is based in our New York City office with a hybrid work arrangement (in-office Monday-Thursday, remote Friday).  Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

job.title: Intern Strategic Corporate & Transaction Communication
job.description:
Intern Strategic Corporate & Transaction Communication

FGS Global helps the world's most influential leaders move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments. 

We work as one team across geographies and disciplines - bringing together specialists with backgrounds in communications, finance, law, government, journalism, data science, and digital. Whatever the moment demands, we combine multidimensional perspectives to help leaders anticipate what's next, engage the stakeholders who matter, and drive meaningful outcomes.

Across 31 global offices, we draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. This collaborative approach has established FGS as a market leader: we are consistently ranked Band 1 for Crisis & Risk Management and Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners, and were ranked the #1 Global M&A PR firm by deal value and deal count for four consecutive years (Mergermarket, 2025).

 

Join our team in Amsterdam as Intern Strategic Corporate & Transaction Communication starting February 1st 2027.

 

What tasks can you look forward to?

  • As an intern, you will be part of the team from day one and experience everyday life as a communications consultant at first hand.
  • You will support the project teams in the development and implementation of communication strategies for national and international clients in matters of strategic corporate communication and positioning.
  • The topics range from M&A transactions, IPOs and strategic realignments to the communication of digitalization and transformation strategies.
  • Together with our team, you will design compelling communications materials for internal and external stakeholders (e.g., communications plans, press releases, corporate presentations).
  • You follow, monitor and understand Dutch and European media.
  • You help with ad-hoc requests and questions from other offices about the media, economy, and society in the Netherlands.
  • For research and analysis, you will dig deep into relevant topics, exciting companies, media coverage and trends.
  • You bring in fresh, inspiring ideas and innovative communications formats.

 

What should you bring along?

  • You are at the end of your undergraduate or master's degree - the subject is less important than your enthusiasm for communication.
  • Ideally, you have already gained practical experience during your studies, for example in communications, finance, journalism, politics and/or strategy consulting.
  • You are a quick learner and it is recommended that you communicate fluently in Dutch and very well in English.
  • You have a good understanding of the Dutch media landscape.
  • You love variety and new challenges and really thrive when working in a team.

 

What we can offer you

  • The opportunity to get to know strategic communications consulting
  • Insights into the activities of a leading strategic communications consultancy as well as into various industries and areas of expertise as part of our integrated project teams
  • Exciting and varied tasks in an international and inspiring working environment
  • The opportunity to benefit from training & development opportunities
  • Induction and individual support as well as detailed feedback from an experienced consultant
  • A committed, collegial and constantly growing team in which mutual appreciation and team spirit are paramount
  • A company culture that combines excellence with team spirit
  • The opportunity to work flexibly both in our offices and from home
  • Our beautiful office in the heart of Amsterdam- Zuid

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? Please don’t worry! Studies have shown that some groups like women or people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. At FGS Global, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role and our company but your previous professional experience doesn’t match perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we would like to encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or another role.

We look forward to your complete application (incl. all relevant academic and professional certificates and/or reference letters). Feel free to contact us by email via careers-eu@fgsglobal.com.

 More information: FGS Global

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. job.title: Community Connections Coordinator, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is searching for a Community Connections Coordinator. We're looking for a driven, people-first professional to join our team and serve as the vital link between our newsroom and the communities we cover. In this role, you'll cultivate meaningful relationships, surface credible story leads, coordinate community events and listening sessions, and help our journalists connect with the trusted local voices that make our coverage matter. Whether you're in the field building source networks, managing audience tips, or supporting breaking news coverage, your work will directly shape how WEWS serves the people of Greater Cleveland every day.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/04 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations, residents, leaders, and trusted sources to gather community insights and identify emerging issues, events, and story opportunities.
  • Monitor, track, and route audience tips, questions, and leads from community channels, ensuring timely communication and escalation to newsroom teams.
  • Support newsroom listening efforts, community conversations, and source development by connecting journalists with credible and diverse community voices.
  • Assist with breaking and developing news coverage by gathering community context, maintaining source networks, and providing timely intelligence to newsroom staff.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for community organizations and residents, fostering positive relationships and trust.
  • Coordinate outreach, maintain partner and contact records, and represent the station at community meetings, events, and activities.
  • Support newsroom talent by coordinating interviews, identifying community contacts, gathering background information, and facilitating community appearances.
  • Coordinate logistics and execution for community conversations, listening sessions, public programs, newsroom events, special coverage initiatives, and station appearances.
  • Manage event-related activities including outreach, scheduling, partner coordination, participant communications, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Support audience engagement across digital and in-person channels, including live discussions, community groups, neighborhood platforms, and other audience interaction opportunities.
  • Maintain community calendars, project plans, contact databases, and engagement records to support execution of the market community strategy.
  • Track community insights, engagement outcomes, story leads, and best practices, preparing summaries and reports that help inform newsroom and community engagement priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in journalism, communications, community engagement, nonprofit work, events, public relations or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong listening, relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish rapport with diverse community members and organizations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, follow-through and attention to detail
  • Ability to identify and communicate relevant community information quickly and accurately
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with journalists and station teams
  • Comfort working independently in the community and adapting to newsroom needs
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/contact systems, social platforms and collaboration tools
  • Solid news judgment, comfort with newsroom urgency, ability to verify and relay information quickly, and understanding of how community tips can develop into stories
  • Ability to communicate clearly and accurately across digital platforms, maintain professionalism in public-facing conversations and collaborate closely with reporters, producers, anchors, meteorologists and newsroom leaders

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city of neighborhoods, grit, and genuine heart — and it's having a moment. Situated on the southern shore of Lake Erie, Cleveland combines a rich cultural heritage with a revitalized downtown and a food and arts scene that consistently surprises newcomers. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the world-class Cleveland Museum of Art (with free general admission), and Playhouse Square — the largest performing arts center in the U.S. outside of New York City — give the city a cultural depth that is hard to match. Walkable neighborhoods like Ohio City, Tremont, and Little Italy each bring their own distinctive character, cuisine, and community.


Sports are woven into the fabric of Cleveland life. Cheer on the Cleveland Guardians at Progressive Field, follow the Cleveland Cavaliers at Rocket Arena, and join the passionate faithful who rally behind the Cleveland Browns every season. The sense of community pride around Cleveland's teams is infectious, and game days turn the city into one big celebration.


The outdoors are never far away. Cuyahoga Valley National Park — the only national park in Ohio — sits just south of the city, offering miles of hiking, biking, waterfalls, and scenic railroad excursions. Cleveland Metroparks wraps the city in a beloved "Emerald Necklace" of parks and trails, and Lake Erie's shoreline provides year-round recreation from sailing to fishing. With a lower cost of living than many comparable metros, a growing tech and healthcare economy, and a community-first spirit you can feel on every block, Cleveland is a fantastic place to build a career and a life.

#LI-SM2 #LI-Onsite

Annual Salary: $60,000.00 - $70,000


 

Pursuant to state and local salary transparency laws, the salary range posted is specific to candidates who will perform this work in Ohio.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

As an equal employment opportunity employer, The E.W. Scripps Company and its affiliates do not discriminate in its employment decisions on the basis of race, sex, sexual orientation, transgender status, gender, color, religion, age, genetic information, medical condition, disability, marital status, citizenship or national origin, and military membership or veteran status, or on any other basis which would be in violation of any applicable federal, state or local law. job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. The role includes responding to time-sensitive technical issues in a live broadcast environment and providing support outside regular business hours as part of the department’s assigned coverage schedule.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Fraud Prevention to be responsible for addressing, interpreting, understanding, and applying all applicable laws and regulations to financial processes, practices and procedures. Includes defining the financial compliance strategy and monitoring organizational compliance. 

 

What Will You Do?

  • Manage fraud team daily operations – Identifies priorities, oversees agent scheduling and KPI monitoring. 
  • Oversee development of policies and procedures to reduce fraudulent activities and recover any incurred losses. 
  • Own responsibility for Team development roadmap including;  identifying strategic priorities, advocating for resources, staffing and tool/system analysis and procurement. 
  • Collaborate with other departments as a SME for Global Fraud, Chargebacks and Payments ops. 
  • Provide input to decisions that affect the functional area; gives input into the budget. 
  • Manage team performance through timely feedback as well as the formal performance review process to ensure delivery of exceptional services and engagement, motivation, and team development. 

 

What will you Bring?

  • 7+ years of experience Fraud Prevention 
  • 2 + years experience managing teams  
  • Strong understanding of Payment operations and anti-Fraud and chargeback systems 
  • Familiarity with SQL or scripting Languages 
  • Strong Excel 
  • Adept at collaboration and teamwork 
  • Familiarity with Project Management

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KTHV-TV Little Rock, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Little Rock, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of CBS broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Little Rock's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5 years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

With the assistance of producers, editing audio and video

30-second daily element written, voiced and mixed by anchor, to promote subsequent day’s show.

job.title: Multiskilled Journalist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WWL WUPL-TV New Orleans, the CBS/MNTV TEGNA affiliate,  is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist to help maintain our tradition of superior reporting and newsgathering. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms with a mix of outstanding photography and unforgettable editing. If you're a creative storyteller who understands true multi-platform journalism and who is not bound by the methods of traditional TV news – we want to hear from you! 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Perform authoritative, compelling live shots in a developing story or in breaking news situations
  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.
  • Maintain and develop sources who will help bring our reporting to the next level.
  • Shoot, write, produce and edit on air and online content within deadlines.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.
  • Use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.
  • Attend editorial meetings and offer story ideas daily.
  • Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner.

Requirements: 

  • 1-3 years reporting experience preferred.
  • Must possess solid news judgment, display strong communication skills, creativity, and ethical decision-making skills.
  • Strong writing skills, production skills and tease writing abilities.
  • ENPS, EDIUS and Axis graphics experience is preferred.
  • Must be organized with the ability to work under constant deadlines.
  • Must be able to calmly handle live breaking news situations and changing events.
  • Proven social and digital content creation ability.
  • Knowledge of New Orleans a plus ​

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

job.title: Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, Morning Edition & Up First
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour
  • Manage the editorial operation of the control room during the live broadcast
  • Coordinate with teams for live updates for later news feeds
  • Work directly with show hosts, guests and reporters to prep, record and edit live and taped interviews for the show and podcast on a tight deadline
  • Line edit various scripts for the live show while maintaining NPR’s editorial standards for all parts of the final product
  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated awareness of intersectional identities and ability to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Other duties as assigned

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3  years of experience managing direct reports in a newsroom or operation
  • At least 5  years of experience writing and editing broadcast journalism content
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily news journalism content for a national or international news organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with audio production and mixing techniques
  • Experience working in a live control room
  • Experience being the lead producer or editor for a radio or podcast show 
  • Experience editing news content for various platforms
  • Familiarity in another written language other than English, such as Spanish or Mandarin

EDUCATION REQUIREMENT

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, DC .

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Mastery in project management such as managing deadlines and time management
  • Expert knowledge and demonstrated skill in news-writing techniques for varied formats such as guest interviews, breaking news,  feature stories
  • Mastery in AP style writing and editing skill for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and experience in writing and editing news copy for varied platforms including broadcast, podcast, social, mobile, newsletters and other digital platforms, especially during breaking news situations
  • Proficiency in people management skills such as delivering constructive feedback, clear communication and conflict resolution.
  • Proficiency in independent, problem solving. 
  • Ability to adapt and accommodate differing styles of editorial workflows and communication.
  • Ability to negotiate and compromise.
  • Professional communication skills when representing the NPR organization.

Job Type

  • This is a full time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $145,000-155,000 a year plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

#LI-ONSITE

job.title: General Counsel
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a dynamic General Counsel to join its leadership team. The General Counsel leads AccuWeather's Legal Services team and serves as chief legal advisor to the CEO and business leaders across a global B2C digital media business, and enterprise B2B weather-data and insights business, and a linear broadcast/OTT network. This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.
  • Build and own the company's internal AI governance framework and advise the business on legal and regulatory risk arising from its own use and development of AI.
  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

Commercial & Corporate Transactions

  • Negotiate and draft high-value commercial agreements, including content and technology licensing, strategic partnerships and alliances, and ad-tech platform arrangements.
  • Serve as lead legal advisor on M&A, divestitures, joint ventures, and corporate investment transactions.
  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

Data Privacy, Cybersecurity & Regulatory

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

Corporate Governance & Board Support

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • JD and 15+ years of relevant experience, including service as General Counsel or senior in-house counsel in a corporate environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI legal tools and a demonstrated record of using AI to drive legal-department efficiency (not just familiarity, but hands-on experience selecting, implementing, or championing AI tools in a legal setting).
  • Broad intellectual property experience, including patent law, IP licensing, and IP due diligence.
  • Working familiarity with employment law and compliance investigations (DOL/OFCCP).
  • Proven ability to negotiate and draft complex, high-value contracts and to quickly analyze agreements from varied origins.
  • Strong executive presence; able to advise and present to senior management, the Board, and international clients and partners.
  • Experience managing a team of attorneys and legal support staff and managing outside counsel cost-effectively.
  • Experience with corporate governance matters involving a Board of Directors.
  • General knowledge of tax laws and standards as they relate to corporate transactions.
  • Must reside in State College, PA, or be willing to relocate to the State College area.

Preferred

  • Experience in digital media, broadcast/OTT, or a comparable data- or platform-driven industry.
  • Exposure to board governance, M&A processes, or strategic planning cycles.
  • Experience directing strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Experience managing or coordinating cross-functional teams without direct authority.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

 

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Entertainment & Sport will develop, negotiate, and execute strategic partnerships for specific healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts. Working closely with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams, this role will connect brands with entertainment and sport properties, teams, leagues, and talent. The position requires deep industry relationships, strong commercial judgment, and agency-or buyer-side experience building brand partnerships from strategy through activation.

Title: Senior Director, Entertainment & Sports

 

Responsibilities

 

Client Partnership Strategy

  • Develop entertainment and sports partnership strategies for healthcare, health, and wellness client accounts, in collaboration with Real Chemistry leadership and integrated client teams.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities with properties, teams, leagues, talent, rights holders, and other industry partners based on each client’s objectives.
  • Translate client objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into differentiated partnership platforms and activation ideas.

 

Deal Development, Negotiation & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end partnership process, including opportunity sourcing, valuation, proposal development, rights packaging, negotiation, contracting support, and activation planning.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations that balance brand impact, audience relevance, budget, risk, and measurable value.
  • Partner with legal, finance, creative, strategy, experiential, influencer, social, and media teams to deliver programs on time and within scope.
  • Oversee partnership activation and optimization, ensuring contractual rights are fully leveraged and programs meet brand and compliance requirements.

 

Client Leadership & Industry Relationships

  • Serve as a senior advisor on assigned client accounts, partnering with Real Chemistry leadership to guide partnership choices and present recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and agency partners.
  • Use market intelligence and relationships to create access, uncover opportunities, and strengthen negotiating positions for clients.

 

Business Development & Team Contribution

  • Support new business pitches, proposals, and organic growth opportunities by contributing partnership expertise, recommendations, and industry insights.
  • Partner with Real Chemistry leadership to strengthen entertainment and sports resources, partner networks, evaluation tools, case studies, and best practices.
  • Represent Real Chemistry at relevant industry events and stay current on emerging properties, talent, platforms, audience behaviors, and partnership models.
  • Share expertise with team members and foster collaborative, rigorous, and commercially minded ways of working.

 

Qualifications and Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in entertainment and sports partnerships, sponsorships, brand marketing, or a related field.
  • Significant agency- or buyer-side experience developing, negotiating, and executing partnerships for brands.
  • Deep, active relationships across entertainment and sports, including properties, teams, leagues, talent, agents, rights holders, and relevant intermediaries.
  • Demonstrated expertise in rights valuation, deal structure, negotiation, contracting processes, activation planning, and partnership measurement.
  • Experience in healthcare, health and wellness, or another highly regulated category is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of brand strategy, consumer audiences, culture, media, experiential marketing, social platforms, and talent-led programs.
  • Excellent client leadership, communication, presentation, and financial skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex partnerships and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, detail-oriented, and energized by building new capabilities and offerings.

 

Pay Range: $135,000 - $180,000
