job.title: Director, Strategy
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times advertising department's mission is to create work that helps brands make their mark in the world, and our canvas is the full breadth of The New York Times and its associated media platforms, including digital, mobile, audio, print, events and more.

The Advertising Strategy team's award-winning work includes activations across digital, audio, and print and spans the breadth of NYT's portfolio, like Cooking, Wirecutter, Games, and The Athletic, as well as our premier editorial events like the Dealbook conference.

The Director, Strategy will bring experience working cross-category and possess a passion for uncovering how different categories intersect with media and culture to spark inspiring creative ways-in and ideas. Strategy is a team sport, and you will be an expert collaborator with experience leading versatile teams, including creative, program management, sales, and planning, toward a common goal. Success within the advertising strategy team requires the ability to uncover human and cultural truths across multiple categories like finance, media, entertainment, healthcare, and consumer goods as well as a passion for big ideas expressed through media, a love of The New York Times, and a high standard for creating visual presentations.

  • Management and Mentorship: You are a skilled manager with practice and proficiency in teaching and guiding teams through the strategic process.
  • Operational Skills: You have some experience with strategic resourcing of team members and managing stakeholders around workflows
  • Research, Insights, and Creative Brief Development: You are an expert at using proprietary tools, third-party resources and desk research to uncover meaningful insights, human truths and whitespace opportunities that will lead to a compelling way in for creative and media.
  • Creative Briefing: You are experienced in writing compelling creative briefs, briefing creative teams, and being an inspiring strategic partner to creative teams.
  • Media Strategy: You are experienced in making recommendations for how to use media to bring ideas to life in ways that meet clients' campaign objectives. Although you will not be responsible for writing media plans, you are comfortable and expert in guiding internal teams as well as clients in making smart and creative media choices.
  • Client Deliverable Development: You are experienced in owning and creating client-ready visual proposals that are polished and inspiring.
  • Category Fluency: You are constantly learning and reading about macro trends in business and culture.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage 3-6 strategists across 2-3 Categories
  • Co-lead resourcing across the Strategy Team
  • Consult with Sales leadership to improve processes, practices and strategic deliverables
  • Engage with teams across the Ad Department to guide cross-functional solutions and innovations
  • Use research and data to articulate and support sales stories
  • Author and deliver creative briefs on sometimes-tight turnarounds
  • Create and guide others in the creation of powerful proposals with effective storytelling that responds to client needs and telegraphs the value of NYT media offerings
  • Develop a broad understanding of all New York Times assets
  • Lead and project manage across relevant departments (including Sales, Ad Product, T Brand Studio, Ad Operations, Research, Marketing, Events) to create integrated programs for clients
  • Develop, articulate and share innovative programs, partnerships, innovations and opportunities
  • Research, write, and guide others in the creation of content strategy briefs
  • Attend key sales calls to pitch advertising and media ideas to mid/senior-level executives
  • Manage internal senior team members, communicating proposal and program status to management
  • Educate and keep the Strategy team/department abreast of trends and what opportunities or challenges they might present for our business
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Executive Strategy Director

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of cross-platform Advertising experience in brand and media strategy
  • Interest in managing high-volume categories
  • Experience working on RFPs
  • Experience working in collaborative sales and marketing processes, including working with sales teams or in a sales environment
  • An understanding of the current social, branded content, digital, audio and mobile media landscapes
  • Experience with how to translate the long-term goals of advertisers into solutions and recommendations that can be provided by The New York Times

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience

REQ-020650

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

job.title: Data Journalist, Ignites and BoardIQ
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to a fair and inclusive workplace

At the FT, we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone has equal opportunity to succeed. We welcome and value different perspectives and strive to ensure all employees are heard and supported. We believe people do their best work when they can be themselves and have the flexibility they need to balance their work and personal lives. We are an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination.

The role / Position overview

FT Specialist is seeking a Data Journalist to join our growing data journalism team, producing exclusive, data-driven reporting and visual storytelling for Ignites and BoardIQ.

This role sits at the intersection of journalism, data analysis and visual design. You will be responsible for sourcing, cleaning, analysing and interpreting complex datasets to uncover original stories covering various aspects of the mutual fund and ETF industry as well as the boards that oversee those products on behalf of investors. You will also create engaging visualisations and interactive content that help our journalism stand out and deliver insights readers cannot find elsewhere.

Working as part of a six-person Data Visualization team, you will collaborate closely with reporters and editors across both publications while reporting to the Managing Editor of Data Visualization. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable developing ambitious long-term investigative and analytical projects as well as delivering shorter-turnaround stories that respond to emerging industry trends and news events.

We are looking for a curious, collaborative and entrepreneurial journalist who is passionate about using data to reveal meaningful stories and who is committed to continually developing their skills in a fast-evolving newsroom environment.

Important: This is an editorial journalism role, not a data analyst or data science position. Candidates must have professional journalism or reporting experience. Applications from candidates whose experience is primarily in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, without demonstrated reporting experience, will be automatically rejected.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop original, data-driven stories covering the mutual fund and ETF industry as well as directors and boards that oversee those products.

  • Source, collect, clean and analyse structured and unstructured datasets using a range of journalistic and analytical techniques.

  • Build compelling charts, graphics and interactive visualisations that enhance storytelling and audience engagement.

  • Identify trends, anomalies and opportunities within datasets that lead to exclusive reporting.

  • Deliver both long-term analytical projects and shorter-turnaround assignments driven by current events and industry developments.

  • Collaborate closely with reporters, editors and visual journalists across Ignites and BoardIQ.

  • Support colleagues in applying data journalism techniques and interpreting quantitative information accurately.

  • Use public records, databases, APIs, web scraping techniques and proprietary datasets to uncover new reporting opportunities.

  • Ensure all reporting and analysis meets the highest standards of accuracy, transparency and journalistic integrity.

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of data journalism capabilities across FT Specialist.

Required skills / experience

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify meaningful insights from complex information.

  • Experience communicating data, research findings or business insights clearly to a range of audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent collaboration and partner management skills, with experience working across teams and subject areas.

  • Curiosity and a proactive approach to uncovering opportunities, trends and areas for deeper investigation.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Experience using data, research or quantitative analysis to support decision-making, storytelling or audience engagement.

  • An interest in developing or expanding technical skills in areas such as Python, R, data visualisation, databases or related analytical tools.

  • Knowledge of FT products, audiences, editorial standards or internal workflows that can help accelerate impact in the role.

We welcome applications from colleagues across Editorial, Product & Technology, Audience, Research, Commercial and other FT business areas who can demonstrate transferable analytical, storytelling or data-focused skills.

Candidates looking to take the next step in their career and grow into a more specialised data journalism role are encouraged to apply.

Please submit your application by Monday, November 30th 2026 by 5pm ET.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $75,000–$80,000. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skills; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs. The disclosed range estimate is for our NYC office and has not been adjusted for other locations.

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

Operational reporting and team support

  • Provide first-line support for master data issues raised by downstream consumers and business users.
  • Contribute to operational reporting on stewardship volumes, exception trends, match rates, and resolution times.

Support data migration and reconciliation activities during source system onboarding and platform changes.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in a data stewardship, data administration, or master data management role.
  • Practical understanding of MDM concepts including golden records, matching, survivorship, and entity resolution.
  • Familiarity with enterprise master data management and data governance solutions (e.g. Informatica MDM, Informatica Data Governance) or equivalent platforms is desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data investigation, validation, and reporting.
  • Understanding of data governance principles including data classification, ownership, and stewardship workflows.
  • Willingness to work with AI and machine learning tools as part of day-to-day stewardship operations, including reviewing AI-suggested matches, classifications, and enrichments.
  • Experience working with ERP or HCM data (Workday, SAP, Dynamics, or similar) is an advantage.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies methodically.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent stewardship tasks and priorities.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to document and explain findings clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data problems.
  • Enthusiasm for developing expertise in master data management, data governance, and AI-assisted data operations.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

job.title: VP, Media Technology Engineering
job.description:
FOX Corporation is seeking a high-impact Vice President, Media Technology Engineering to lead the engineering, implementation, and operational reliability of the technology environment supporting FOX News Media and Fox Television Stations.

This leader will oversee the teams responsible for operating and continuously improving the critical infrastructure that supports news gathering, live broadcast, production, post-production, playout, master control, transmission, and digital media distribution.

The role will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for network, compute, storage, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, broadcast systems, disaster recovery, and platform resiliency. The successful candidate will have deep experience operating highly available media environments and implementing complex broadcast technology transformations, including SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP systems.

Reporting to the SVP, Media Technology & Engineering, this role will partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture and other technology leaders. The VP of Architecture will establish future-state architecture, standards, and technical direction. This role will own engineering execution, implementation, operational readiness, reliability, lifecycle management, and incident response.

Role Scope

The major areas of responsibility include:

  • Broadcast technology engineering and operations
  • SMPTE ST 2110 implementation and operational reliability
  • Network, compute, storage, and virtualization engineering
  • Hybrid cloud infrastructure operations
  • Station automation and delivery platforms
  • OTT, streaming, and OTA technology support
  • News and local production support
  • Media technology and transmission
  • Disaster recovery and platform resiliency
  • 24/7 technical operations and incident response

Responsibilities

Engineering Operations and Reliability

  • Lead the day-to-day engineering and operational support of mission-critical broadcast and media technology environments.
  • Ensure 24/7/365 availability, reliability, and operational readiness across broadcast, production, distribution, and transmission platforms.
  • Establish operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and incident response practices.
  • Partner with Critical Response and Operations teams to manage major incidents, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Monitor system health and ensure timely resolution of reliability, performance, and availability issues.

Broadcast Systems Implementation and Support

  • Lead the engineering implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of broadcast technology platforms.
  • Support live news gathering, contribution, production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, and transmission workflows.
  • Implement and operate SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP environments, including routing, timing, packet integrity, latency, and system interoperability.
  • Support the transition from SDI-based workflows to synchronized, software-defined IP media facilities in partnership with the Media Architecture team.
  • Maintain operational compatibility across existing systems while implementing new technology platforms.

Network and Infrastructure Engineering

  • Lead engineering execution across WAN, LAN, contribution networks, routing, switching, QoS, multicast, and high-capacity media connectivity.
  • Operate and optimize on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, enterprise virtualization, containerized environments, compute, storage, and related platforms.
  • Manage infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, capacity planning, patching, migrations, integrations, and technology refreshes.
  • Implement approved architecture and security standards in partnership with Media Architecture, Network Engineering, and Information Security.
  • Ensure infrastructure supports high-throughput, low-latency media workflows and enterprise data distribution.

Resiliency and Disaster Recovery

  • Implement and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, redundancy, failover, and resiliency capabilities.
  • Conduct readiness testing and ensure recovery procedures are documented, current, and operationally viable.
  • Identify single points of failure and lead remediation efforts.
  • Partner with architecture and security teams to ensure resiliency requirements are incorporated into new implementations and major upgrades.

Project and Program Delivery

  • Partner with the PMO and Critical Response teams to deliver technology upgrades, expansions, migrations, integrations, and operational improvements.
  • Translate approved architecture and technical requirements into executable engineering plans.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, resource requirements, milestones, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate testing, documentation, training, and support plans.
  • Coordinate production cutovers and post-implementation support.

Performance Management and Optimization

  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level measures for availability, reliability, capacity, latency, incident response, and recovery.
  • Optimize monitoring, alerting, and alarming systems to reduce noise and improve response effectiveness.
  • Use performance data and operational trends to identify risks, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, tools, and support models.

Vendor and Service Management

  • Manage operational relationships with key technology vendors and service providers.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service-level expectations.
  • Coordinate escalations, technical support, maintenance, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Architecture and Procurement teams to validate technical requirements and support vendor evaluations.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain accurate documentation for network, infrastructure, broadcast, transmission, security, and recovery environments.
  • Ensure engineering procedures align with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, security policies, and internal controls.
  • Maintain current system diagrams, runbooks, asset information, configuration records, recovery procedures, and support documentation.
  • Support operational audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.

Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization supporting complex, highly available media environments.
  • Establish clear team structures, accountabilities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
  • Mentor engineering leaders and technical talent.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, manage expectations, and deliver reliable solutions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture to execute approved technical strategies and standards.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering, Information Security, Broadcast Operations, Media Services, Digital Platforms, News, Local Production, and Transmission teams.
  • Provide engineering input into architecture decisions based on operational requirements, reliability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Serve as the engineering voice during technology planning, implementation, and operational readiness reviews.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging technologies for operational value, reliability, supportability, and compatibility with the FOX media environment.
  • Drive adoption of tools, frameworks, and methodologies that improve engineering effectiveness and standardize deployment procedures.
  • Maintain backward compatibility while modernizing technology platforms and operating practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, resiliency, and engineering productivity.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent executive experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in media technology, broadcast engineering, enterprise infrastructure, or related environments.
  • At least 5 years of senior leadership experience managing engineering or technology operations teams.
  • Proven experience leading engineering implementation and operational support for large-scale broadcast or media technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and operating SMPTE ST 2110 uncompressed IP video production systems.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise networking, including routing, switching, QoS, multicast, WAN, LAN, and contribution networks.
  • Strong experience with on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, virtualization, compute, storage, and containerized environments.
  • Experience leading disaster recovery, resiliency, high availability, incident response, and business continuity programs.
  • Experience supporting news gathering, live production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, transmission, OTT, streaming, or OTA delivery environments.
  • Strong project and program management skills focused on implementation, operational readiness, and reliability.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, service providers, escalations, and service-level performance.
  • Knowledge of DCIM, CMDB, IPAM, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure management systems.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical transformations while maintaining operational stability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment.
  • Occasional domestic travel, up to 25%.

About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KFSM 5NEWS, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Fayetteville–Fort Smith, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor / Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our weekend morning newscasts and report stories that matter across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. This journalist will help viewers start their day informed, prepared and connected to their communities.
We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. • Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.

job.description:
AccuWeather’s Digital Team is seeking an Editorial Intern for Spring 2027. Join us in a hands-on newsroom role where you'll help shape daily weather coverage for AccuWeather.com. You’ll collaborate closely with editors and meteorologists to pitch compelling story ideas, research developing weather events, and write digital-first articles that inform and engage our audience. This role offers the opportunity to build real-world newsroom experience, sharpen your writing skills, and learn how data, SEO, and emerging AI tools support modern digital publishing. You’ll also assist with sourcing and clearing user-generated content to help bring impactful weather stories to life across platforms.

This paid internship spans 5 months and requires a commitment of approximately 20 hours per week. Morning and daytime availability is preferred, though some evening hours may be accommodated.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

● Finding and gathering information to pitch timely, weather-related story ideas for AccuWeather.com.

● Writing multiple digital stories per month for publication on AccuWeather.com.

● Conducting source gathering and research to support accurate, compelling weather coverage.

● Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to edit content, test prompts, and optimize stories for digital platforms.

● Sourcing and clearing user-generated content for use in articles and on social platforms.

● Collaborating with editors, meteorologists, and the social team to align coverage across platforms.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

● Pursuing a 4-year Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Meteorology or a related field that requires experience in writing and research.

● Strong writing, editing, and research skills with attention to accuracy and detail.

● Interest in weather, climate, and science-based storytelling.

● Basic understanding of SEO and digital publishing best practices is a plus.

● Demonstrated ability to be self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

● Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

● Must be willing to work occasional evenings or weekends as needed.

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the role

Wirecutter is seeking a motivated Marketing Intern to support our team across a variety of initiatives and channels. This role offers a well-rounded, hands-on learning experience to help build and maintain our day-to-day marketing engine, supporting audience growth, reader engagement, and brand awareness.

Under the guidance of the marketing team, you’ll learn how to turn overall goals into well-executed deliverables. You will assist with drafting copy, coordinating assets, quality-checking campaigns before they launch, and learning how we utilize different channels—such as email, social media, and on-site placements—to reach our audience.

This is a highly collaborative role for an organized, aspiring marketer who enjoys variety and careful execution. You will shadow and assist marketing, audience, creative, and operations partners to support campaigns that serve our readers and grow Wirecutter’s business.

  • Cross-Functional Support: Shadow and assist the team in working with design, editorial, and legal partners, helping to route campaign materials for review and approval.
  • Reporting Basics: Help pull basic performance metrics for recent campaigns to learn how to analyze what messaging resonates best with our audience.
  • Team Operations: Assist in maintaining clear documentation of campaign calendars, meeting notes, and shared team resources.
  • Demonstrates support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Editor
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Editor—21GRAMS to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

The Senior Editor maintains quality control of agency deliverables during all stages and is a liaison for the Editorial Department to other colleagues to own and reinforce established standard operating procedures. Grows professional relationships with internal brand team members and works collaboratively to ensure best practices. Performs all functions necessary to keep workflow running smoothly and able to maintain a good level of quality control even with crunched timelines.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

  • Establishes solid working relationships internally and with internal brand team accounts to which they are assigned; proactively and collaboratively engages with Copy, Medical, Account, Art/Studio, and Project Management teams to provide support

  • Is the lead editor for 1 or more accounts

  • Raises a red flag with brand teams and/or senior managers when timelines are too tight, additional resources are needed, or when there is a disruption to normal workflow, among other concerns

  • Maintains oversight for their own jobs to complete them on schedule whether by managing their own time or delegating promptly and responsibly to other resources
  • Supports and reinforces team and agency initiatives established by senior managers
  • Participates in team meetings and contributes to fostering a team mentality
  • Practices a positive “can do” attitude at all times
  • Mentors and trains new and/or junior employees and freelancers

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

 

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher desirable
  • 2+ years’ experience in medical advertising, medical publishing, and/or medical education, with 0+ years’ experience in medical advertising
  • Expected to be 95%+ billable
  • Advertising, marketing, business, English, or related degree preferred
  • Ability to interact with diverse internal population (e.g., account, creatives, project management)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and some Excel) and Adobe, and familiarity with digital routing/commenting platforms, spell-check/auto compare programs
  • Ability to comprehend scientific content and data to ensure accuracy of all claims made by agency or its clients

Pay Range: 105,000-120,000
The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. job.title: Associate Producer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KENS 5, the CBS affiliate in San Antonio, Texas, is seeking a highly motivated, organized, and creative Associate Producer to join our weekday morning lifestyle program, Great Day SA. This position is ideal for someone looking to grow their television production career while contributing to a dynamic, live-broadcast environment.


The Associate Producer will play a key role in the day-to-day execution of the show by helping develop engaging content, coordinating guests, managing production logistics, and supporting broadcast, digital, and social media initiatives. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, thrives under tight deadlines, embraces collaboration, and has a passion for storytelling, audience engagement, and creative content development. If this is you, apply today!


Responsibilities
•    Assist producers with the planning, coordination, and execution of daily LIVE broadcasts.
•    Research and develop segment ideas, trending topics, community stories, local events, and guest opportunities.
•    Coordinate and book guests for in-studio, remote, and pre-recorded segments.
•    Serve as a primary point of contact for guests, clients, and community partners before, during, and after their appearances.
•    Write and format segment scripts, teases, graphics information, and supporting show materials.
•    Assist with daily show rundowns and ensure all production elements are accurate, organized, and ready for air.
•    Support pre-show preparation, live production needs, and post-show follow-up.
•    Manage studio logistics, including set preparation, prop placement, display setup, and guest microphone coordination.
•    Collaborate closely with producers, hosts, editors, photographers, sales teams, and other members of the production staff.
•    Lead and manage Great Day SA's social media presence across multiple platforms.
•    Create, schedule, and publish engaging daily content that promotes upcoming segments, highlights memorable moments, and strengthens audience engagement.
•    Develop original digital content and innovative segment ideas that enhance and extend the Great Day SA brand.
•    Write compelling and accurate social media copy, website content, and promotional materials.
•    Monitor social media trends, audience analytics, and engagement metrics to identify growth opportunities and optimize performance.
•    Utilize Cuez to manage show rundowns, coordinate workflows, and facilitate communication across the production team.
•    Produce and manage original content for KENS 5 streaming platforms, including planning, writing, and executing recorded streaming shows.

Requirements
•    Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Television Production, Film, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
•    Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills.
•    Ability to create and adapt content for broadcast, digital, web, and social media platforms.
•    Demonstrated ability to generate fresh, creative content ideas and proactively pitch segment and digital opportunities.
•    Strong understanding of social media platforms, content creation strategies, and audience engagement best practices.
•    Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
•    Creative storyteller with strong editorial judgment and news awareness.
•    Self-starter who can work independently while contributing effectively in a collaborative team environment.
•    Positive, solution-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills.
•    Ability to adapt quickly and problem-solve in a fast-paced live television environment.
•    Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Photoshop.
•    Experience with Cuez or similar newsroom and production workflow systems is preferred.
•    Prior television, digital media, or content production experience is a plus.


Work Environment
•    Primarily based in a television studio and office setting.
•    Requires occasional lifting of props and production materials, standing for extended periods, and assisting with studio setup and breakdown.
•    Must be comfortable working early morning hours and adapting to changing production needs.
•    Minimal travel required, generally less than 10%.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. job.title: Product Engineer, Membership and Front-End
job.description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. 

We will stop accepting applications for this role on Monday, November 30th @ 11:59PM ET.

ProPublica is hiring a software engineer to work primarily on the systems and services that power our audience data platforms. This important role serves to advance ProPublica’s mission — publishing journalism with real-world impact — by enabling systems that bring us greater understanding of our audiences and donors.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer who believes in our mission and thrives in multifaceted roles, contributing both to the long-term product road map and to hands-on development. Your responsibilities will include shipping high-quality and resilient code and collaborating with designers, product managers, data analysts, other engineers and agency partners. You’ll write code, configure no- and low-code integrations, contribute to our documentation, share your expertise and proactively solve problems.

As a member of our expanding, crossfunctional product team, you’ll work with colleagues across ProPublica’s engineering, audience and membership operations, ensuring that our capabilities align with our principles and advance our organizational objectives. This position reports to our director of product engineering and will work closely with the audience data and insights analyst.

What you’ll do

  • Build and ship reader-facing features that drive membership — calls to action, donation flows, and account and authentication experiences — with clean, resilient code.
  • Integrate the systems behind them: messaging tools, payments and donation processing platforms, user accounts, CDP and CRM, and the data infrastructure that connect them.
  • Instrument the audience and donor journey. Set up accurate and actionable event tracking so every meaningful step is captured cleanly and becomes data we can act on.
  • Support making experimentation routine. Build the infrastructure for A/B testing and, with internal business teams, run experiments regularly so our decisions rest on evidence instead of guesswork.

job.title: Measurement Data & Analytics
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Measurement Data & Analytics role serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas. 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

job.description:

FGS Global (FGS) partners with the world's most influential leaders to move minds and markets. job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

WPP Shared Service Centre (SSC)

The WPP SSC provides transactional financial services to WPP companies in the UK, including:

-             Accounts Payable, including Intercompany transactions

-             Accounts Receivable (Billing, Credit Control & Cash Allocation)

-             Treasury

-             Accounting and Reporting

-             Statutory Reporting

By consolidating activities, the WPP SSC takes advantage of volume to deliver increased efficiency.  This is achieved by standardising, streamlining, and aligning relevant processes, and introducing tools and technology to drive effectiveness across our operations. By taking over transactional financial activities, the WPP SSC enables our agencies to focus on commercial activities, client management as well as revenue and cost management.

In 2021, the WPP SSC UK organisation transferred specific process and transactional activities to the WPP SSC in India. The WPP SSC teams in the UK and India work together to provide services to WPP companies in the UK.

Why we're hiring:

The WPP SSC is on a global transformation journey, and this is an opportunity to join the UK team to help us deliver exceptional financial services to our UK companies.

What you'll be doing:

Management and delivery of the Statutory reporting for all UK registered entities at Companies House.  This role will report into the Head of Global Statutory Reporting.

  • The team manages the delivery of approximately 150 UK statutory accounts annually;
  • End-to-end production of statutory accounts using both an excel template for data collection and input on our statutory reporting software system, including generation of iXBRL files;
  • Key contact along with the Head of Global Statutory Reporting for CFOs, Finance Directors and Financial Controllers on statutory reporting requirements, issues and associated questions;
  • Working with the Head of Global Statutory Reporting to onboard a number of new operating companies supported by GBS UK for their statutory reporting needs;
  • Key point of contact for external auditors on statutory audit related issues and questions; to provide guidance and advice on auditing, audit tests and SoX guidelines across GBS UK;
  • Collation of corporation tax packs, working with the operating company teams on submission to the Group’s tax consultants to ensure timely submission of corporate tax returns;
  • The department also assists with the dissolutions of WPP Holding and operating companies in conjunction with WPP Legal, WPP Tax and the operating companies;
  • Review accounting step plans for dissolutions and assist WPP Legal in writing up the legal documentation surrounding dissolutions;

What you'll need:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA) with strong technical accounting skills
  • Experience of reporting under IFRS and in a SOX control environment;
  • Experience producing UK statutory accounts for multiple entities using statutory reporting software (ideally Caseware or Workiva);
  • Experience dealing with external auditors and ability to drive the audit process;
  • Excellent communication skills – able to communicate effectively both internally and externally, verbally and in writing, as well as at different levels of an organization;
  • Commercially focused with a proactive service-oriented approach;
  • Able to build and maintain strong internal and external working relationships;
  • Excellent IT skills (Microsoft Office at intermediate to advanced level), particularly MS Excel, which should be intermediate/advanced (pivot tables; conditional formatting etc.)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail;
  • Managing of own workload to ensure consistent service levels;
  • There may also be a requirement to work additional hours occasionally due to tight deadlines and month-end processes.

Who you are:

You’re open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You’re optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You’re extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we deliver extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, driven people – We champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge? 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

job.title: Product Director
job.description:
Description

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group is the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! 

Our Next Digital Product is Hope Media Group's first digital product: a music app built for Christians, offering a generosity-funded alternative to ad-driven and algorithm-driven streaming. Rather than inferring what to play from behavioral data, The Next Digital Product starts by asking how you're doing and curates a path in response. It's built to give back to the people who use it, not extract from them. 


Product Director

Job Summary:

This role is the business owner for Next Digital Product: accountable for the platform's overall performance, from product and partnerships through growth. It sets the plan that content, rights, and product engineering work toward, and is the point of escalation when those pieces need to align. 


Essential Functions:

Strategy and Go-to-Market:

  • Set Next Digital Product's business and platform strategy. Aligning content, partnerships, engineering, and growth around one plan. 
  • Own go-to-market strategy and sequencing, from launch through scale. 
  • Own the Next Digital Product brand and partner with marketing on acquisition channels and campaigns. 

Business Ownership:

  • Own the P&L: revenue performance, cost discipline, and the path to sustainability. 
  • Hold the product organization accountable to growth and engagement outcomes, not just feature delivery. 
  • Shape how the Next Digital Product earns: subscription tiers, giving programs, sponsorship, and pricing. 
  • Define the measures the business runs on, and work with data science to keep them honest. 

Team and Leadership:

  • Hire, lead, and coordinate the roles that build and run Next Digital Product's content and partnerships, growing the team as the platform scales, based on budget allocation and CIO approval. 
  • You serve as the Primary Representative for Next Digital Product to Hope Media Group's executive leadership. 

Risk and Stewardship:

  • Manage vendor and consultant relationships that touch product or business strategy. 
  • Own risk management for the platform: track what could keep it from working, and mitigate it. 
  • Balance headcount and budget responsibly alongside growth as the team comes online. 

Demonstrated Faith:

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ 
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate 
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies 
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry's Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs 
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed 
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG's media platforms for evangelism and discipleship 
  • Exhibit a strong moral character 
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church 


Requirements

Non-Essential Functions:

  • Other duties as requested. 

Requirements and Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Product Management, Media, or a related field, or at least 10 years of equivalent experience. 

Experience:

  • 7+ years in product leadership with direct P&L or business-unit ownership, ideally in streaming media, audio, or subscription apps. 
  • A track record taking a consumer product from pre-launch through its first years of growth. 
  • Comfort owning a number the business is counting on, not just a roadmap. 
  • Cross-functional leadership across product, content, and partnerships-adjacent teams. 
  • Alignment with a generosity-funded, non-extraction model rather than an ad- or data-driven one. 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Experience in Christian/faith media or a comparable subscription-and-giving nonprofit product. 
  • Prior work with music licensing or rights-holder relationships. 
  • Startup or 0-to-1 product experience at an early stage
  • Heart for Christian ministry 
  • Strong moral character 
  • Has a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Spiritually grounded and working knowledge of scripture 
  • Must be an active member of a Bible believing local church 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • The Head of Music & Streaming Content and the Head of Music Partnerships & Rights, plus later hires as the team grows. 

Working Conditions and Environment:

Travel: 

  • As needed for industry events, conferences, and label and partner meetings. 

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional evenings, weekends, or holidays may be required for board meetings, ministry events, fundraising events, urgent employee matters, or organizational needs.

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

  • Flexible Savings Accounts

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Mission Overview & Responsibilities: 

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the design evolution of the Wirecutter Store. You will be the lead designer for our shopping experience, balancing high-conversion UX design with rigorous visual standards. You will oversee the visual and structural integrity of our store, designing intuitive interfaces for our homepage, product detail pages (PDPs), and checkout flows.

You are a strategic partner who will help shape the future of our retail experience. We are looking for someone to bring their expertise in e-commerce best practices, user psychology, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) to help us identify opportunities we haven't seen yet.

This is a remote friendly position.

  • Translate complex business requirements into elegant, high-fidelity designs. You will wireframe, prototype, and refine the interface to create a cohesive store experience across desktop and mobile.

  • Analyze the shopping funnel to identify friction points. You'll design solutions that improve navigation, product discovery, and the overall checkout process.

  • Be the subject matter expert on e-commerce design trends. Audit the site experience to identify growth opportunities and propose improvements to site architecture.

  • Partner with the business team to drive our A/B testing roadmap. You will design and implement UI experiments (e.g., layout variations, navigation updates, promotional treatments) and use data to iterate on those designs.

  • Use your knowledge of the Shopify platform to build, configure, and manage pages. You understand the capabilities and constraints of the platform, allowing you to design features that are both beautiful and technically feasible.

  • Be the design advocate in meetings with our technical partners to ensure our visual standards are maintained during technical implementation.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of relevant design experience.

  • A portfolio showcasing your ability and process to design for e-commerce. You show an understanding of information architecture, interaction design, and visual hierarchy.

  • Experience designing for Shopify. You know how to navigate the theme editor, manage product assets, and collaborate with developers to bring custom layouts to life.

  • Experience designing templates for e-commerce email platforms (e.g., Klaviyo, Shopify Email). You understand how email layout, typography, and clear CTAs impact click-through and open rates.

  • Experience using analytics to understand site performance. You use insights to influence your design process and prioritize changes.

Preferred Qualifications:
