job.title: LA Galaxy, Program Operations Coordinator
job.description:
LA Galaxy is where soccer, culture, and community come together. As one of Major League Soccer’s most storied clubs, the Galaxy deliver unforgettable matchdays and moments that connect fans across Los Angeles and beyond.

Owned by AEG, the LA Galaxy are powered by teams who bring energy, creativity, and commitment to everything they do, from matchday operations and fan engagement to the work that happens behind the scenes. Every role plays a part in shaping the experience on and off the pitch and building a club that reflects the city it represents.   If you want to be part of a team where your work shows up live, in real time, and in front of passionate fans, there’s a place for you here. Because on matchday, it happens here.

Job Summary

The Program Operations Coordinator plays a hands-on role in the delivery, quality, and growth of LA Galaxy Youth soccer programs, combining strong soccer knowledge with the operational skills needed to create organized, engaging experiences for players, families, and coaches. Supporting Galaxy Juniors, Skills Training, Grassroots, Camps, and the Galaxy Discovery Program, this position works on-site and serves as a key resource for coaches, participants, and families. The Coordinator supports assigned program processes and initiatives, while contributing to coach development, program operations, local marketing and outreach, and the identification of opportunities for new or expanded programming that expand the LA Galaxy pathway, community impact, and long term program growth across Southern California.

Essential Functions

  • Facilitate the on-site execution of assigned youth programs by preparing spaces, coordinating setup and teardown, organizing equipment and materials, supporting staff readiness, managing participant check-in, and ensuring the site is prepared for a successful program experience.
  • Create a welcoming and professional experience for players and families by serving as a visible LA Galaxy representative, responding to questions and concerns, addressing day-to-day participant needs, and helping resolve issues with care and efficiency.
  • Assist with coach development through on-site observations, constructive feedback, regular communication, and follow-up on coaching needs, and escalating performance or development concerns.
  • Support operational processes including registration information, program communications, administrative tasks, program materials, and other systems that support efficient program delivery.
  • Coordinate marketing and outreach efforts by helping promote youth programming, providing program information and resources, and identifying opportunities to increase awareness, enrollment, and participation.
  • Research and evaluate potential locations for new or expanded youth programming by considering facility suitability, community access, program demand, and operational requirements, and share recommendations with the Department Leadership.
  • Contribute to program equipment and inventory by preparing supplies in advance, maintaining organized storage and distribution processes, monitoring inventory levels, and identifying replenishment, replacement, or other operational needs.
  • Collaborate with the Programming team on new program ideation, development, and execution to assist with pathway expansion, increased participation, brand awareness, and revenue growth.
  • Perform other programming department duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred)
  • 2-4 years Related work experience
  • Coaching and event related work experience preferred
  • Commitment to the mission, vision and core values of the LA Galaxy
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work assignments in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to be a clear thinker, analyze and resolve problems, exercising good judgement
  • Ability to work cooperatively and professionally with other departments
  • Experience with working with youth (ages 1.5-16)
  • Knowledge of youth soccer landscape in Southern California
  • Proficient in account management database systems and ability to learn required business systems
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Must be proficient with Microsoft Excel and Outlook
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly motivated, with a positive attitude
  • Detail oriented and ability to work independently
  • Fluency in Spanish preferred

job.title: Sr Product Manager, Resale Platform Experience
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today. 

We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment. Together we keep the world cheering. 

 

Position Summary: 

AXS is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of our Resale platform. This role is responsible for the core marketplace engine that powers secondary ticketing across the AXS ecosystem, including resale listings ingestion and distribution, inventory and pricing services, event and venue data models, partner and marketplace integrations, public-facing APIs, and the platform services that connect fan demand with resale supply across thousands of events each year.  

Success requires balancing platform scalability, data integrity, marketplace health, and delivery velocity while evolving the core engine to support new partners, markets, and fan experiences.  

The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a deep technical foundation and a systems-modeling mindset. You are comfortable leading engineering teams through domain and data modeling, API and data contract design, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and platform integrations while translating those capabilities into measurable business and marketplace outcomes. You are execution-focused and thrive on turning ambiguous problems into clear requirements, well-sequenced roadmaps, and shipped software.   

You will work closely with Engineering (including onshore and offshore delivery teams), Architecture, Data, Payments, Partner Experience, and business stakeholders to deliver a scalable, reliable resale platform that grows marketplace liquidity and improves the fan experience across the live event lifecycle. 

Essential Functions: 

As a Senior Product Manager you will be accountable for: 

  • Defining product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the core Resale platform engine across the AXS ecosystem. 
  • Establish platform priorities that balance scalability, reliability, modernization, and marketplace growth.  
  • Own platform capabilities delivered through APIs, data contracts, integrations, event-driven services, and backend systems that power resale listings, inventory, and pricing.  
  • Lead systems and domain modeling for core resale entities, including events, venues, seating, listings, inventory, and transactions, to create a durable and extensible platform foundation. 
  • Serve as the day-to-day product leader for Engineering, driving sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria through delivery. 
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture to define API standards, service-level objectives, reliability goals, and operational readiness standards. 
  • Drive product decisions using marketplace metrics, platform telemetry, observability, and performance data. 
  • Own capacity planning and delivery sequencing with engineering leadership, managing dependencies across onshore and offshore teams. 
  • Partnering with the Partner Experience team to ensure platform capabilities, APIs, and integrations are ready for external partner and developer adoption. 
  • Identifying and prioritizing improvements that reduce technical debt, data quality issues, and integration friction across the resale ecosystem. 
  • Develop a deep understanding of secondary ticketing, marketplace supply and demand dynamics, and resale workflows.  
  • Lead modernization efforts across legacy resale and listing systems while maintaining marketplace continuity.  
  • Define and monitor KPIs related to platform reliability, data quality, listing coverage, performance, and delivery predictability. 
  • Communicate roadmap, risks, priorities, and outcomes clearly across technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
  • Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and influence decisions through data-driven insights and customer understanding. 

 

We are looking for: 

 

Required Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering complex software products in Agile environments. 
  • Demonstrated success owning technical products, platforms, APIs, SDKs, integrations, or enterprise software solutions. 
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering teams to deliver platform, integration, or infrastructure-adjacent products within modern distributed architectures. 
  • Experience supporting mission-critical workflows where reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency are essential. 
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, operational telemetry, observability, and data-driven product decision making. 
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex ecosystems spanning modern platforms, legacy systems, integrations, and operational processes. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define ambiguous problems, synthesize data, and deliver measurable outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints while driving product strategy and execution. 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align technical and non-technical stakeholders across organizational boundaries. 
  • Systems thinker with a platform-oriented mindset who can connect business processes, technical systems, operational workflows, and customer experiences to build scalable solutions. 
  • Curious, data-driven, and comfortable operating in complex environments, with a strong bias toward continuous improvement, experimentation, and measurable outcomes. 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

 

  • Background building platform products that enable external partners through APIs, SDKs, integrations, or developer ecosystems. 
  • Track record of modernizing legacy operational systems while balancing migration risk, business continuity, and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Familiarity with software-plus-hardware ecosystems, including mobile applications, hardware integrations, edge devices, or operational technology environments. 
  • Understanding of service reliability, operational readiness, performance objectives, and incident management practices. 
  • Proven ability to design configurable platform capabilities that support regional variation while maintaining a scalable core product. 
  • Exposure to complex global organizations and products serving multiple international markets. 
  • Domain expertise in live entertainment, ticketing, venue operations, access control, identity, payments, transportation, hospitality, logistics, or other operationally intensive industries.

 

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

 

Pay Scale: $127.000-$135,000

Bonus:  This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. 

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 *Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes
  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work
  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client
  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions
  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members
  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects
  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)
  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

job.title: (Senior) Data Engineer – Data Modeling & Core Systems
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why We’re Hiring

We are scaling the core engineering capability behind real-time, high-throughput ad-tech infrastructure that processes large-scale audience data at global scale.

This is not a role for basic ETL scripts or glue code. In this role, data engineering is treated as a true software engineering discipline. You will take deep technical ownership of complex, multi-layered data models (canonical schemas, high-dimensional behavioral signals, and vector embeddings) that power live targeting and measurement decisions for advertisers worldwide.

You’ll help evolve a distributed, production-grade data platform while collaborating with a high-trust engineering team that values clean architecture, continuous improvement (kaizen), and modern development standards.

 

Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with fellow engineers across backend systems, Quality Assurance, Analytics, and connector teams. We value teamwork over ego, collaboration over competition, open and honest communication, strong opinions held with curiosity, and delivering well-tested, maintainable code.

Our Technology Environment

  • Languages & Core: Scala, functional programming, strongly typed distributed services
  • Processing & Streaming: Apache Spark for large-scale distributed processing, event-driven architectures
  • Cloud & Storage: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Parquet
  • Engineering Standards: Automated CI/CD, robust unit & integration testing, Git workflows, and Tyda (our open-source, automation-driven SDLC process)

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve production data models spanning input/output models, schema evolution, field types, and partitioning strategies across multi-stage distributed pipelines.
  • Maintain and extend our audience framework, normalizing high-velocity raw inputs into standardized, canonical formats across behavioral signals, demographics, and brand affinity.
  • Design and manage models handling relational structures, real-time behavioral signals, high-dimensional embeddings, and anomaly detection.
  • Develop and maintain Spark-based data services in Scala and GCP, adhering to software design patterns, modular architecture, and edge-case resilience.
  • Lead by example with automated unit/integration testing, strict code reviews, Git branching discipline, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with QA, Analytics, and downstream product teams to guarantee contract integrity, data correctness, and reliable system consumption.

 

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade distributed data systems.
  • Production experience writing quality code in Scala OR another statically typed language (Java, Kotlin, C#, Go). If your background is in Java/Kotlin/Go, you are eager and excited to build in a Scala-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating on large codebases with automated testing (unit/integration testing), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and structured code reviews.
  • Proven ability to design and reason about complex, multi-layered data architectures (e.g., canonical schemas, dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or domain-driven data design).
  • Solid experience with Apache Spark (or similar distributed frameworks) handling high-volume datasets.
  • Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) or equivalent cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • The ability to explain complex data models, schema trade-offs, and technical designs clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

What Makes This Role Different? Real Software Rigor. You won't just be stitching together SaaS tools; you'll be writing modular, compiled, testable code for real-time systems.

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.

  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.

  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.

job.title: Human Resources Ministry Partner
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

The Human Resources Ministry Partner is an experienced human resources professional responsible for providing comprehensive HR support to team members and leaders across the Ministry. This role requires expertise in employee relations, compliance, onboarding, orientation, HRIS administration, and HR operations.  Will also serve as the first point of contact for HR related questions or concerns.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for the HR team, including, but not limited to: development of correspondence for both confidential and non-confidential matters regarding people operations and employee relations processes.
  • Act as the first point of contact for HR related questions or concerns – redirecting team members and elevating issues as appropriate. Clearly and positively communicate solutions with exceptional follow through. Effectively and efficiently route and answer questions within scope of knowledge and authority.
  • Enter and maintain team member data within the HRIS system, ensuring a high level of accuracy, confidentiality, compliance, and timeliness with internal standards. This includes keying new hires, terminations, compensation adjustments, and other changes to team member status.
  • Facilitate new hire onboarding and new hire orientations, ensuring a smooth transition for team members into the Ministry and promoting engagement from day one.
  • Ensure the organization of team member files; maintain confidential records, I-9 documents, and other related employment documentation.
  • Support the VP of Human Resources with conducting investigations into team member complaints, policy violations, worker’s compensation investigations, vehicle accidents, and other workplace issues, ensuring thorough documentation in the Ministry’s case management system.
  • Advise leaders on corrective actions, performance improvement plans, and performance support procedures in alignment with Ministry policies and legal requirements.
  • Partner with payroll to submit Team Member vacation cash out requests, retro-pay amounts, bonus payments (i.e., relocation, sign on, or discretionary bonus amounts).
  • Maintain list of active team members on the Ministry Driver’s Insurance policy. Notifying vendor of changes.
  • Partner with the HR team as needed for Leave of Absences, Workers Compensation, Disability, Unemployment, Employment Verifications, EEO reporting, Public Student Loan Forgiveness, and other related projects.
  • Partner on exit paperwork and interviews.
  • Collaborate with HR leadership and other HR team members to support Ministry initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
  • Assist in the administration of the compliance portal where team members acknowledge policies and trainings.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
  • PHR and/or SHRM-CP an added plus.
  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years focused on employee relations.
  • Proficiency in HRIS system (ADP preferred), Microsoft Office Suite, and HR reporting tools.
  • Strong knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and HR best practices.
  • Experience facilitating onboarding and orientation programs for new team members.
  • Proven ability to manage complex employee relations cases with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills for building genuine business/ministry relationships.
  • Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Ministry-focused, with a sense of urgency and exceptional follow-through.
  • Adaptable and positive, maintaining productivity amid change.
  • Professional representation of Ministry and team members, ensuring confidentiality.
  • Collaborative team player with a strong customer service orientation.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • High initiative with strong problem-solving abilities.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. job.description:
Operations & Innovation Specialist 

(ESPN Network | Milwaukee, WI)

The ESPN Radio Network and Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Operations & Innovation Specialist to join the Home Office Innovation Team, with a dedicated focus on supporting ESPN Network teammates.


This role will help teammates work smarter by identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation, and technology.


The ideal candidate is curious, creative, analytical, and action-oriented. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how things work, challenging the status quo, experimenting with new technology, and turning ideas into meaningful operational improvements.


Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build strong relationships with ESPN Network teammates to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes across ESPN Network departments and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate existing workflows, recommend improvements, and design, build, test, implement, and maintain AI-enaabled solutions and automations that improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Partner with ESPN Network leadership and the Home Office Innovation Team to prioritize projects and execute improvements.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to identify new ways to improve productivity and operations.
  • Develop clear processes, documentation, and training materials that help teammates adopt new solutions.
  • Support the successful rollout and ongoing adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of innovation initiatives, including time saved, improved efficiency, and increased operational capacity.
  • Collaborate with the Home Office Innovation Team and other teammates across Good Karma Sports to share successful solutions, improve workflows, and implement best practices.
  • Complete additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports by demonstrating our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for AI, emerging technology, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows and translate challenges into practical solutions.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code/no-code tools, CRM systems, or reporting tools is a plus.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and support change across teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance experimentation, execution, accuracy, and responsible technology use.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn new platforms and systems.
  • Valid driver’s license required.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a full-time, in-office, exempt salaried position offering a competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for growth as responsibilities and impact expand.

The position may require occasional evenings and weekends depending on project needs and operational priorities.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 18, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY. 

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Manager of Music & Streaming Content
job.description:
Description

About Hope Media Group

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group is the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! The Next Digital Product is Hope Media Group's first digital product: a music app built for Christians, offering a generosity-funded alternative to ad-driven and algorithm-driven streaming. Rather than inferring what to play from behavioral data, the Next Digital Product starts by asking how you're doing and curates a path in response. It's built to give back to the people who use it, not extract from them.


Manager of Music & Streaming Content


Job Summary:

Hope Media Group is seeking a Head of Music & Streaming Content to lead the overall music and content strategy for the Next Digital Product. This role owns the sound, content direction, playlist philosophy, programming standards, and listener content experience, working closely with product engineering to make sure the platform reflects the intended vision. It directs contractors who execute playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and it directs the Director of Digital Audio Streams.

Essential Functions:

Content Strategy and Sound:

  • Own the Next Digital Product's content strategy and sound direction: genre mix, mood and path curation logic, tone.
  • Set and uphold content standards grounded in a Christian worldview, applied to every song on the platform regardless of where it comes from.
  • Own the Next Digital Product's audio identity: imaging, voiceover, and sound design.
  • Shape how content strategy shows up in-product — the check-in flow, path structure, discovery surfaces.

Programming Standards:

  • Set and maintain programming standards. Decide what qualifies for a path, how playlists are built, and how the catalog is curated across moods and life moments.
  • Build the editorial and programming framework future content roles will execute against day to day.
  • Own the content taxonomy: the mood, genre, and activity attributes that drive curation and personalization.
  • Monitor listening data — skips, completions, saves, repeat listening — to refine programming over time. 

Team Leadership:

  • Direct contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and manage the production budget.
  • Lead and develop the Director of Digital Audio Streams, delegating day-to-day streaming operations while retaining ownership of standards.
  • You serve as the Next Digital Product's primary representative within the Christian music industry.

Demonstrated Faith

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry's Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG's media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church


Requirements

Non-Essential Functions

  • Other duties as requested.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Music, Communications, Media, or a related field, or at least 10 years of equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 7+ years in music programming, editorial, or content strategy at a streaming service, radio network, or comparable audio platform.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a playlist or programming philosophy at scale, not just execution of someone else's standards.
  • Experience directing contractors or a small team delivering production work against a budget and deadline.
  • Working knowledge of the Christian/gospel music industry, or a demonstrated ability to build that knowledge fast.
  • Comfort operating without an established playbook.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Direct experience with Christian radio or Christian streaming programming.
  • Experience building or scaling a listening product's editorial function from near-zero.
  • Familiarity with licensing and rights constraints on programming decisions.
  • Heart for Christian ministry
  • Strong moral character
  • Has a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Spiritually grounded and working knowledge of scripture
  • Must be an active member of a Bible believing local church


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • The Director of Digital Audio Streams, and contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming.

Working Conditions and Environment

Travel:

  • As needed for industry events, conferences, and label and partner meetings.

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional evenings, weekends, or holidays may be required for board meetings, ministry events, fundraising events, urgent employee matters, or organizational needs.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.


Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains

Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

Proven ability to work effectively with management to establish acceptable sales budgets; meet revenue goals and objectives as a result of an effectively coordinated, organized and well-executed sales team effort.

Proven ability to develop systems procedures to regularly monitor and evaluate progress.

Proven ability to coach and supervise staff, including-but not limited to, organizing, delegating, training, interviewing and motivating others to produce at their maximum potential.

Knowledge and success with NTR, with emphasis on vendor programs.

Proven ability to monitor modify current sales strategies to insure viability in a constantly changing marketplace.

job.description:
Location: OH-Dayton

Job Title:  Account Executive - Dayton Radio

 

Position Overview

Are you a problem solver? Can you help others identify their goals and get them from where they are to where they want to be? We win when our local business clients get a return on their investment thanks to our creative and innovative digital media solutions. We aim to be more than just exceptional partners; our tools and services are game changers for their businesses.

 

As an Account Executive for Cox Media Group, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and partner to help achieve them. In this role, you will collaborate with local sales managers to evangelize solutions that will help customers reach their target audience. As a CMG employee, you’ll have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips. We’ll also provide ongoing training and professional development across our full range of products, and you’ll be an integral part of a results-driven, close-knit team that is driving growth for CMG.


 
At Cox Media Group we are building the future of media and have an opening for a skilled Account Executive! Cox Media Group is a forward-thinking, fast-paced, and positive culture of top performing sales professionals that work together to produce results.


 
Cox Media Group has a Training Program that will guide you on your way to launching a successful and lucrative career as an Account Executive! Through the program you will be matched with a personal mentor, practice collaborative teamwork

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for generating revenue through the development of new accounts
  • Responsible for generating revenue by growing existing advertising revenue from current clients.
  • Able to develop effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Able to obtain budgets and meet deadlines.
  • Responsible for ensuring superior client relations.
  • Superior management of sales through the entire sales cycle.
  • Use of CRM sales tool for reporting and prospecting
  • Prepare and present both written and oral presentations.
  • Prepare effective advertising schedules.
  • Effectively negotiate advertising rates.
  • Collection of accounts receivable, as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record of digital and TV sales success in local media setting
  • Ability to work alone and as part of a team
  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience required
  • Excellent presentation, verbal and written skills
  • Hard-working, integrity, relationship-builder with a winning attitude
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  • Work with brand teams, ad operations and finance to provide client satisfaction
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and CRM tools
  • Valid driver's license with clean driving record required
  • Relationship building skills are key and candidate must have a winning, positive attitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience preferred

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Greenville, NC Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive - Greenville, NC 
This is the ideal role for a marketing and sales professional who is looking to join a growing digital and radio business. As our Account Executive, you will be responsible for selling digital and radio campaigns across a wide range of digital products and radio stations in Greenville, NC. Account Executive to work directly with VP of Sales, Digital Coordinator, Digital Team Leader, and Executive VP of radio stations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Account Management: Works directly with clients, prospects, and company account executives to support their needs and communicate client expectations.
  • Going on in-field calls with prospective clients utilizing the sales process of creating digital and radio campaigns for prospective clients utilizing the Client Needs Analysis, Client Pitch Presentations to Closing of the Sale.
  • Ability to achieve revenue goals and expectations without hesitation.
  • Responsible for building and maintaining a billing book of business with guidance from VP of Sales.
  • Work directly with our Digital Coordinator in processing requests for proposals, insertion orders, sample spec ads and reporting. (for digital only)
  • Project Management: the ability to track timelines and due dates for deliverables, reviews, and approval for campaign launches.
  • Continuity with graphics team: Ensure all ads are being worked on and deadlines are being achieved so all schedules can run on time.
  • Maintain working knowledge of radio and digital products offered by the company through continuous training.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure all campaigns are hitting the promised impressions goals and spots during their flights. Adjust priority levels as appropriate.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or the campaign ends, review performance reports for all digital and radio campaigns and present results to the client.
  • Client communication: Work directly with clients to ensure campaign execution and performance meet their standards.
Qualifications:
  • Organization and follow-through are critical skills for this position.  Logical, process-oriented person, who is effective and strategically contributes to campaigns.
  • Strong work ethic, self-motivated and high achiever with a sales drive.
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients.
  • Demonstrates the ability to successfully collaborate with various team environments with dynamic priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions regarding various responsibilities.
  • In-depth knowledge of performance marketing with special focus on radio and digital capabilities.
  • Self-motivated and strategic thinker with a bias towards action while also being a strong team player.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and ability to work in a fast-paced environment; Comfort dealing with ambiguity.
  • Strong partnership and influencing skills.
  • Comfort working with Senior Management.
  • Ability to uncover new opportunities to acquire customers efficiently and on a scale through well-developed relationships with core channel partners and media agencies.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications/Marketing preferred and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum experience working in sales: 1-3 years preferred.

Job Summary: Job Requirements SUMMARY The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's direct-to-consumer product strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences. You will play a key role in building out ESPN's product analytics function from the ground up, serving as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for the ESPN product and product engineering teams. You will lead the foundational work streams for ESPN app measurement: standing up a governed, centralized source of truth for ESPN app performance metrics — canonical definitions, consistent logic, and numbers the business can align on — and building the self-serve tooling that lets stakeholders not only see that a KPI moved, but locate what drove the movement. You will also be the experimentation partner to the product organization, shaping how ESPN app features are tested and how those results are read. This role is hands-on and technical. You will design and maintain the aggregation logic and metric tables that sit underneath executive reporting, and you will be expected to defend the numbers you publish — including the measurement caveats that travel with them. RESPONSIBILITIES • Own and evolve the source-of-truth metric layer for ESPN app performance — headline KPIs (DAU, time spent, watch minutes), their definitions, their dimensional breakouts, and the documented caveats that accompany each • Design and maintain pre-aggregated metric tables and serving views in Snowflake, and the scheduled pipelines that refresh them, ensuring metrics are correct at every level of aggregation • Build the monitoring and decomposition logic that identifies when a KPI movement is real and where it is concentrated — baselines, significance thresholds, contribution ranking, and volume-versus-mix splits • Distinguish genuine behavioral movements from measurement artifacts and instrumentation breakage, and partner with product engineering to close the analytics QA gap on client releases • Build dashboards and self-serve tooling in Looker that reduce stakeholder reliance on ad-hoc analyst pulls • Conduct analyses using SQL and Python to access and manipulate multivariate product and behavioral data, and ideate new metrics and analytical approaches for in-app user behavior • Partner with product and engineering on experimentation end-to-end — translating a product question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat • Reconcile ESPN app metrics across teams and systems, and drive alignment on definitions with Research, Data Product, and data engineering partners • Serve as a dedicated point of contact and thought partner for ESPN product and product engineering teams, taking projects end-to-end from vague business need to socialized insight • Communicate results through compelling data storytelling to product leadership and the broader ESPN business BASIC QUALIFICATIONS • Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience • 5+ years of relevant work experience in analytics, product analytics, and/or business intelligence • Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries, and to reason about correctness of aggregation logic (for example, why a distinct-count metric cannot be summed across segments) • Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, and pipeline work • Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling — how metric tables are structured, refreshed, and served to downstream consumers • Applied statistical judgment: constructing baselines, assessing whether a change is meaningful versus noise, and handling seasonality and day-of-week effects • Hands-on product experimentation experience — designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay • Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences • Experience taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products • Strong and effective communication and presentation skills PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Hands-on experience with digital clickstream or behavioral analytics data (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), including its identity and measurement limitations • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing • Experience establishing metric governance — canonical definitions, reconciliation across teams, and change management on metric logic • Experience with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with scaling experimentation practice across product teams • Familiarity with identity resolution across web, app, and connected TV, and the practical consequences of cookie-based measurement • Prior experience in Sports or Media/Entertainment #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $124,900 - $167,400 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. job.title: Manager, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global (FEG) is FOX Entertainment's centralized content sales division, providing the worldwide multi-platform marketplace with exclusive access to its diverse, rapidly expanding production pipeline and library of owned original programming and co-production partnerships. A central component of FOX Entertainment's long-term growth strategy is to fortify its globally recognized, world-class brand and owned distribution platforms spanning broadcast and streaming with FOX Entertainment Global's singular focus on broadly distributing the company's full portfolio of owned intellectual property across all genres of scripted, unscripted, and animated programming, including both film and television titles.

FOX Entertainment is seeking a Manager, Business & Legal Affairs to serve as a hands-on attorney supporting FEG.  

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Draft, review, and negotiate various agreements as assigned, across all media windows (Network, Pay Cable, Pay TV, FAST, AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, EST, and digital platforms), possibly including distribution agreements, tape license agreements, format license agreements, amendments, non-disclosure agreements, etc.
  • Conduct detailed contract analysis and rights research to confirm underlying rights, holdbacks, exclusivity, windowing, territorial restrictions to prevent rights conflicts
  • Field day-to-day legal inquiries from internal stakeholders (Sales, Deal & Rights Management, Marketing, Digital, Publicity) and legal team
  • Compile, manage, interpret and synthesize advertising & edit restrictions and disseminate to Operations for exploitation of programming
  • Maintain accuracy of deal tracker and ensure agreements are being assigned and processed in a timely manner
  • Handle general corporate issues as assigned and support the legal with any special projects that may arise from time-to-times

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active bar admission in good standing (California Bar or Registered In-House Counsel preferred)
  • 2+ years of attorney experience in entertainment transactional law, preferably within a television studio, network, media distributor, streaming platform, or entertainment law firm
  • Equal proficiency in contract drafting and rights research, with demonstrated experience reviewing license agreements, and distribution terms
  • High precision and attention to detail when analyzing contracts, including specific language, rights, holdbacks, exclusivity, etc.
  • Working knowledge of media distribution
  • Excellent time management and self-motivation, with a proven ability to prioritize assignments and manage a high volume of active deals in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of personnel and cross-functional departments

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Hands-on experience navigating rights management systems and databases (e.g., Rightsline, Salesforce)
  • Familiarity with international television licensing, international format rights, or foreign distribution nuances
  • Direct background working with rights management, content operations, or marketing teams within a content sales organization)

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Video Production & Studio Manager
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a Video Production & Studio Manager, to support day-to-day studio and technical production operations from our New York office. This role is responsible for owning onsite and remote production workflows, maintaining studio systems, supporting creators’ technical production needs, and ensuring reliable execution across live and recorded productions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on production professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is comfortable stepping into multiple production roles as needed. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and a proactive approach to maintaining high-quality production standards.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and readiness of Red Seat Ventures’ production studios

  • Configure, operate, and maintain production equipment, including cameras, studio microphones, lighting, sets, background displays, video switchers, recording systems, and transmission paths

  • Support onsite and remote productions by operating technical equipment and stepping into key production roles as needed

  • Assist with technical production functions, including camera shading, audio level management, intercom programming, and remote guest feed management

  • Operate and support live productions using TriCaster and vMix production switchers

  • Perform preventative maintenance and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware and software issues

  • Coordinate production equipment requests and technical support for creators and internal teams

  • Maintain accurate documentation for production systems, workflows, procedures, and equipment

  • Support media operations through content capture, media management, and delivery workflows

  • Coordinate hardware and software updates to maintain production system reliability

  • Travel as needed to support productions and technical operations

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. We are searching for individuals who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – CBS Sports Digital

Req: 45930 | Department: CBS Sports.com Technology | Type: Full-Time, On-Site Locations: Nashville, TN; Louisville, KY; Fort Lauderdale, FL

 

 

 

About the Role

Join CBS Sports Digital and help build the web experiences that millions of sports fans use every day across CBSSports.com and our apps. We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer to join our Content Management team, a small engineering group that partners closely with design and product to turn ideas into fast, accessible, production-grade fan experiences.

 

You will own the quality of what fans see and feel: how fast pages load, how components behave, and how reliably we ship. Candidates with Lead-level scope are also encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

  • Build Front-End Features: Design and ship production-grade features for web using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, from prototype through launch.

  • Own Performance: Improve and protect Core Web Vitals through rendering strategy, code splitting, lazy loading, and image and asset optimization.

  • Contribute to Standards: Build and evolve reusable components and shared patterns that scale across the organization.

  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work with design and product to quickly design, develop, and test solutions to key business challenges.

  • Raise the Bar on Code Quality: Review code for style, testability, accessibility, and efficiency, and mentor engineers on front-end best practices.

  • Type Safety: Contribute to TypeScript standards (strict mode, shared types, codegen) so our codebases stay maintainable and refactor-safe.

  • Monorepo Workflows: Use and contribute to monorepo tooling (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web applications.

  • Operational Excellence: Build with reliability in mind, including testing, front-end monitoring, and alerting.

  • Document: Contribute clear documentation and diagrams to help onboard other engineers.

  • Use AI Tools: Use AI development tools to speed up your workflow and share what works with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications with React and Next.js.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

  • Experience consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages and task pipelines.

  • Experience with component libraries or design systems and with testing front-end code (unit, integration, end-to-end).

  • Working knowledge of Node.js for server-side rendering and API layers.

  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, OpenTelemetry).

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple styling approaches (StyleX, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens.

  • Exposure to CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.

  • Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails (rules, commands, skills, sub-agents) to keep AI-generated code clean and production-ready.

  • Familiarity with Generative AI and RAG concepts, or experience building AI-powered features.

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and familiarity with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage.

job.title: Consumer Product Strategist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

The Associated Press seeks a Consumer Product Strategist for AP News based in New York City. We are a hybrid environment, with employees on site Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.  

  

About the Role  

As a Consumer Product Strategist, you will help AP News better understand its audience and use those insights to shape the future of our digital products and user experience. You will look beyond the numbers to uncover the story of how users discover, experience and engage across web and app platforms, turning those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, experimentation and long-term growth.  

 

This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, product strategy and analytics. The ideal candidate is naturally curious about consumers, comfortable digging into data and skilled at communicating what the data means with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

  

What You'll Do: 

  • Analyze how audiences discover, navigate and engage with AP News by building repeatable analyses and dashboards in BigQuery, Looker, Omni and Hex to identify patterns in user behavior, feature adoption, engagement and friction points 

  • Connect behavioral data across journeys, funnels, features and retention to explain not just what is happening, but why 

  • Support tracking implementation in Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager to ensure the right data is captured to answer critical product and business questions  

  • Translate complex product and user data into clear recommendations that inform product priorities, audience growth and monetization decisions  

  • Identify strategic opportunities to improve user journeys, feature design and engagement funnels to deepen loyalty   

  • Development and evaluate product experiments and A/B tests, turning results into actionable product recommendations  

  • Build trusted relationships across product, editorial and technical teams to bring consumer insights into product decisions 

  • Translate business questions into meaningful analysis and clearly communicate what the data means  

  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data infrastructure supports critical decisions 

  

Who You Are:  

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in digital product analytics, product strategy, growth analytics, audience insights, user analytics or a related role  

  • You have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as communications, journalism, Data Science, Marketing or equivalent professional experience 

  • You communicate effectively and are a strong storyteller who can take complex or ambiguous data and turn it into a clear narrative about consumers, products and business opportunities 

  • You have demonstrated ability to analyze user behavior, product performance and using those insights to influence product or business decisions 

  • You bring curiosity, consumer empathy and sound judgment to open-ended questions and are comfortable making recommendations  

  • You have strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for querying large datasets, identifying trends and building repeatable analyses  

  • You have hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as BigQuery, Hex, Omni and Looker

  • You have experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including event tracking and measurement strategy  

  • You are comfortable collaborating with product managers, engineers, editorial teams and other cross-functional stakeholders 

 

What will set you apart:  

  • Experience using consumer insights to influence the strategy or development of a digital consumer product 

  • Experience in digital publishing, media subscription, marketplace or other content-driven consumer products  

  • Background working with BigQuery or other large-scale data warehousing platforms  

  • Familiarity with content recommendation systems or personalization strategies  

  • Experience with experimental design and A/B testing platforms  

  

  

Why join us:  

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.   

  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.   

  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.      

  

The anticipated salary range for this position is $103,000 – $128,000, based on a candidate’s skills and qualifications. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:      

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage      

  • Retirement benefits      

  • Company paid life insurance      

  • Paid vacation and sick days      

  • Paid parental leave for any new parent      

  • Mental well-being resources

We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Finance Analyst - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Merch Collective is a strategic merchandise partner connecting our clients to their fans. We are an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talented—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

As a Finance Analyst at The Merch Collective you’ll work closely with the Assistant Controller overseeing financial operations, with a concentration on Artist Royalties and Accounts Receivable. Your role will encompass assisting with providing variance analysis and recommended corrective actions to improve financial performance. Success in the role will be dependent on strong analytical skills. 

What you'll do:
