job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role

  • Enjoy presenting to clients of sales opportunities and post-sale successes

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit

  • Positive and friendly with a willingness to collaborate

  • High energy and passion for sales

  • Flexible, creative and curious

  • Digitally savvy
  • 3+ years in Media Sales background preferred

Pay Range

USD $3,500.00 - USD $4,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
    Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

 

For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WIS:

WIS is the #1 local media organization in the capital city market of Columbia, South Carolina. It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. WIS is also the hub for Palmetto Sports & Entertainment, a statewide broadcast sports network, and an affiliate of Telemundo SC.

Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

As a Technical Animator (Rigging) you will be creating rigs for characters and animated objects. You will refine skin-weights, work on cloth simulation, and physical objects. As a rigger, you will improve character setups and game engine workflows to overcome the technical challenges associated with creating animations for our games.

  • Skinning of human character meshes, animated props and interactive objects.
  • Setting up physics for cloth objects, accessories and props.
  • Integrating characters into the game and maintaining rigs for DCC and ingame.

  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve animation bugs across tools, pipelines, and in-game setups.

En tant qu’animateur technique (Rigging), vous créerez des rigs pour les personnages et les objets animés. Vous peaufinerez les pondérations de skinning, travaillerez sur la simulation de tissus ainsi que sur les objets physiques.   • Examiner, diagnostiquer et résoudre les bogues d’animation dans les outils, les pipelines et les configurations en jeu.
  • Optimiser les rigs de personnages et les assets d’animation afin de respecter les budgets de mémoire et de fréquence d’images sans compromettre la qualité visuelle.

  • Expertise working with Unreal Engine, Motionbuilder and Maya.

The Manager, Product role will spearhead the product side of Enterprise Rights Management, including the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and execution of complex technology initiatives. The role combines senior product leadership, technical product management, and direct people management. It will lead and develop Product Managers and related product resources while partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders.

A primary focus will be the successful implementation and evolution of a modern Rights Management System (RMS), supported by integrated data capabilities, workflow automation, and responsible use of AI. The role must be able to translate business and rights-management needs into clear product direction, technically sound solutions, executable roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership
    • Define and drive the product vision, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and delivery strategy for RMS and the broader Enterprise Rights product portfolio.
    • Translate business objectives, operational pain points, and user needs into product capabilities, investment priorities, and sequenced delivery plans.
    • Provide oversight across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams, balancing strategic priorities, delivery dependencies, risks, and available capacity.
    • Establish clear product governance, decision rights, success measures, and communication practices across the portfolio.
    • Partner with senior stakeholders to align product investments with enterprise technology strategy and business outcomes.
  • Technical Product and Solution Leadership
    • Act as the senior product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Data, and platform teams throughout discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and adoption.
    • Guide product decisions involving SaaS platforms, enterprise integrations, APIs, data models, workflow orchestration, cloud services, security, and scalability.
    • Ensure business requirements are translated into clear product requirements, capabilities, epics, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities.
    • Establish and reinforce effective use of Jira and Confluence for backlog management, requirements traceability, product documentation, decision tracking, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Challenge assumptions, identify technical and process dependencies early, and help teams make informed tradeoffs across scope, value, timing, risk, and maintainability.
    • Provide product leadership for vendor evaluations, implementation partners, and third-party platforms where applicable.
  • RMS Implementation and Transformation
    • Lead the product side of the RMS implementation, including business alignment, capability definition, prioritization, roadmap management, readiness, and adoption.
    • Coordinate product activities across rights, content acquisition, legal, distribution, finance, operations, engineering, data, and other impacted functions.
    • Ensure RMS delivery is connected to the broader Rights ecosystem, including source systems, downstream consumers, reporting, integrations, and the enterprise data layer.
    • Drive transparent reporting of progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, and required leadership actions.
    • Promote sustainable product practices that support implementation delivery as well as long-term platform ownership and continuous improvement.
  • AI, Data, and Intelligent Automation
    • Define and prioritize opportunities to use AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to improve rights workflows, decision support, data quality, and user experience.
    • Partner with Data, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business teams to evaluate AI use cases and move appropriate concepts from discovery into delivery.
    • Ensure AI-enabled product capabilities are grounded in reliable data, clearly defined business value, measurable outcomes, and responsible governance.
    • Champion reusable data and AI capabilities that complement RMS and strengthen the future-state Rights platform.
    • Monitor relevant technology trends and recommend practical opportunities for innovation without losing focus on core delivery commitments.
  • People Leadership and Product Operating Model
    • Directly manage, coach, and develop Product Managers and other product resources, setting clear expectations, priorities, and development goals.
    • Create a consistent product management operating model across discovery, planning, requirements, delivery, stakeholder engagement, and outcome measurement.
    • Lead the product delivery operating model across Agile teams, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, capacity management, sprint execution, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement, adapting the approach to the needs of each initiative.
    • Assign ownership across initiatives and ensure Product Managers have the context, support, and accountability needed to lead their workstreams.
    • Build a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on customer value, technical credibility, transparency, and execution.
    • Assess team capacity and capability needs and recommend appropriate staffing, role design, and external support when required.
  • Stakeholder, Change, and Executive Communication
    • Serve as a primary product leadership contact for Enterprise Rights and represent the portfolio in cross-functional and leadership forums.
    • Facilitate alignment across business and technology teams, resolve competing priorities, and escalate decisions when necessary.
    • Communicate roadmap status, delivery health, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise and decision-oriented manner.
    • Partner with change-management, training, and operational teams to support adoption and successful transition to new capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, business solutions, technology product leadership, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience, including coaching and developing product professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise product portfolios or large-scale technology transformations from strategy through implementation.
  • Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, and enterprise platform teams.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS implementations, systems integration, APIs, data platforms, cloud services, workflow automation, or related technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies and product-delivery practices, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage product backlogs, document requirements and decisions, track delivery, and maintain clear communication across product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Scrum, Agile, or product management certification, such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), SAFe certification, or an equivalent credential, is preferred.
  • Practical understanding of AI-enabled products, automation, analytics, data governance, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational-change skills.
  • Experience in media and entertainment, rights management, licensing, content operations, intellectual property, or a similarly complex domain is strongly preferred.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on delivery leadership.
  • Can move comfortably between business outcomes, product details, and technical discussions.
  • Builds clarity in ambiguous environments and creates structure across complex, interdependent work.

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff
  • Serve as a primary audit contact for assigned business and technology functions, developing trusted relationships and providing risk-based insights to management and executive teams
  • Perform special assignments, including business process reviews, due diligence activities, investigations, and strategic risk assessments, as directed by the Vice President of Internal Audit
  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities
  • Stay informed on emerging risks and trends in cybersecurity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, media technology, privacy regulations, and technology governance
  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking an experienced, technically rigorous Senior IT Systems Engineer to join our IT Systems team. In this role, you will serve as a primary technical lead responsible for the design, deployment, administration, and optimization of NPR’s core virtualized data center infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in VMware vSphere, enterprise Storage Area Networks (SAN/NAS), and Cisco Unified Computing System (UCS) environments.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the high availability, scalability, performance, and security of our enterprise systems while partnering across Technology to advance infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives in support of our nationwide public media mission.

Responsibilities

Data Center Architecture & Storage Administration

  1. Architect Virtualized Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core virtualized data center infrastructure, leading enterprise VMware vSphere environments, Cisco UCS compute platforms, and SAN/NAS storage arrays.
  2. Administer Enterprise Compute & Storage: Execute routine server builds, security patch management, virtual machine lifecycle administration, and enterprise storage capacity allocation.
  3. Advance Cloud & Hybrid Integration: Evaluate systems architecture and hybrid-cloud strategy, taking operational ownership of the maintenance and integration of cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).

Systems Governance & Disaster Recovery

  1. Govern Disaster Recovery Strategies: Design, maintain, and rigorously test business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including enterprise backups, data replication, and automated site failovers.
  2. Manage Structured Change Processes: Recommend, test, and implement system enhancements in strict adherence to established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  3. Publish System Documentation & SOPs: Author and maintain comprehensive systems architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation for IT colleagues and system stakeholders.

Incident Escalation & Operational Automation

  1. Lead Tier-3 Escalations & Root Cause Analysis: Serve as the senior technical escalation point for enterprise technology teams, isolating root causes and resolving complex production incidents.
  2. Automate Infrastructure Operations: Design and execute automation scripts using modern scripting languages to streamline routine administrative tasks, infrastructure provisioning, and systems health reporting.
  3. Maintain Operational Communications: Provide timely status reporting on system health to engineering leadership, manage incident response on a 24x7 rotation, and articulate outage impact clearly to technical and operational partners.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Systems or Infrastructure Engineer supporting, administering, and troubleshooting systems in an enterprise data center environment.
  • Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing complex VMware vSphere environments (clustering, DRS, HA, vMotion).
  • Extensive experience with Cisco UCS Manager, configuring service profiles, templates, and physical hardware deployment.
  • Strong background in configuring and managing enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays and storage networking protocols.
  • 2+ years of experience planning, designing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Windows Server (2016+), Active Directory, Azure AD, Office 365, IIS, SQL, DFS, DHCP, and DNS.
  • Experience creating detailed systems documentation and flow charts.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to successfully handle multiple projects in a high-pressure, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and a 2-week onsite rotation every two months (or as required).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrastructure Automation & Scripting: Experience utilizing configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet) and writing automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, or Bash).
  • Identity, Access & Messaging Services: Practical experience managing enterprise SSO/MFA solutions, Exchange Online/Hybrid environments, or Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).
  • Industry Certifications: Active professional certifications in VMware (VCP), Cisco (CCNA/CCNP Data Center), Microsoft, or AWS/Azure solutions architecture.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex hardware, software, and performance issues under pressure.
  • Deep understanding of networking concepts (VLANs, routing, switching, LACP, DNS, DHCP) as they relate to virtualization and server infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of security best practices for data center infrastructure and virtualization platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical challenges to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead infrastructure upgrades and migrations independently.
  • Self-motivated team player with a willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and perform after-hours maintenance.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location for a two-week block approximately every two months. The employee will also be  expected to be onsite as needed to support onsite projects.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $125,000 - $145,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Desktop & A/V Support Engineer
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #


Job overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented individual with strong Mac devices and Audio Visual skills. This role will be part of our existing team of desktop engineers, primarily focused on Macs and Audio Visual support, with a secondary focus on Windows support.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer prioritizes and ensures timely responses and resolutions to requests and incidents for our Mac and conference room users. This role will provide IT support for hardware and business applications while also supporting AV functions such as video conferencing and events with AV components. Additionally, the Desktop & A/V Support Engineer will shift and adjust priorities based on changing business needs in our dynamic environment, while also remaining task-oriented to ensure completion of work from start to finish with appropriate solutions. This role will provide high-touch concierge support for senior ASCAP executives.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer within the Global Technology Solutions department is based in our New York office and reports to the Director, Support Services. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex Mac/PC hardware and software issues with a focus on device security.
  • Support and continually review enterprise Mac/PC client hardware / software standards and strategy.
  • Support client OS, application, mobile, virus, and hardware issues for users.
  • Design, implement, and maintain both Mac desktop group policy using JAMF and PC desktop group policy using BigFix and Intune.
  • Support and troubleshoot conferencing systems including platforms such as Webex, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, as well as hardware room systems.
  • Support the AV production at internal & external events.
  • Work with vendors to design and maintain hardware and software standards.
  • Develop automated workflows and technologies to efficiently manage Mac endpoints.
  • Maintain an inventory database, assign hardware and software assets, and manage warranty and service agreement information.
  • Assist with root cause analysis as it relates to Apple/PC computers and all peripheral devices.
  • Interact with IT and AV vendors, and management, to ensure solutions are being provided for all escalating tickets.
  • Independently resolve complex, break/fix issues in person or via telephone.
  • Be available as needed and provide high-touch technical support to onsite and remote members of ASCAP Senior Management.
  • Write, maintain and implement systems documentation for incident responses and recurring issues.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, or a related field preferred.
  • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) and/or Apple Certified IT Professional (ACITP) Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant working experience, including troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex Mac/MS and PC hardware and software issues.
  • Ability to communicate seamlessly and work productively with peers and senior management.
  • Experience with Mac endpoint patching platforms and administration procedures using JAMF.
  • Experience supporting Webex, Zoom, MS Teams, and Google Meet.
  • Experience supporting AV production environments and events.
  • Experience with Microsoft desktop imaging and distribution platforms such as Intune and BigFix.
  • Hands-on desktop support experience in a large enterprise environment preferred.
  • Experience working with anti-virus platforms preferred.
  • In-depth understanding of Mac based hardware, software, and peripherals.
  • Experience with Cisco conferencing hardware including room kits, boards, and peripherals.
  • Shell scripting experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, adjusting set shift hours or days when needed.
  • Ability to travel to other satellite offices when needed.
  • Interest in audio engineering and event production is a plus.
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office three days per week.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option, including a company match for pre-tax and Roth contributions
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary legal plans
  • Voluntary ID protection coverage

This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

job.title: Analyst, Licensing Accounting
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: Responsible for processing billing adjustments on licensee accounts, assisting with the daily cash deposit and helping ensure accurate and timely recording of receivable-related activity. Provides responsive support to internal partners and licensees, assists with reconciliations and reporting and cross-trains with team members to support other functional areas as needed.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Billing Adjustments and Account Maintenance

Process billing adjustments on licensee accounts, including; fee adjustments, write-offs, refunds and related account corrections for all licensing markets.

Prepares and provides invoices, adjustment computations, fee reports or other account documentation to customers and internal partners upon request.

Process, review and image report forms in accordance with established procedures.

Cash Application and Daily Deposit Support

Assists with the daily cash deposit, including lockbox receipts, remote deposits, wire payments and credit card transactions according to the team rotation schedule.

Help reconcile deposit activity and ensure payments are accurately recorded and supported.

Reconciliations and Month-End Activities

Perform daily reconciliation of CRM system to the general ledger as assigned.

Process and image report forms, assists with month-end close activities and supports the preparation and mailing of monthly statements as assigned.

Support month-end close activities as assigned, including preparation and distribution of monthly statements.

Customer, Team and Cross-Functional Support:

Respond to internal and external customer inquiries within established service level expectations..

Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives.

Troubleshoot system and transaction issues, escalating when appropriate.

Participate in system testing to support enhancements and process improvements.

General

Regular attendance.

Perform additional duties as assigned.

Support our BMI Core Values and cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion.

Education:   Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in related field preferred.

Experience: Minimum 2 years related accounting/bookkeeping experience.

Experience in high-volume transaction environments preferred

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial processing.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with CRM and financial systems preferred..

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

job.title: Associate Director, Local Client Partnerships
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a growth-stage media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring an Associate Director, Local Client Partnerships to accelerate revenue growth across our local markets through new partner acquisition and intentional account expansion. 

Why it matters: This is a high-impact, revenue-driving role responsible for building pipeline, closing new business and expanding Axios’ footprint across local markets. You will report to the Managing Director of Regional Client Partnerships. 

Go Deeper: Ideal candidates bring a hunter’s mentality, strong commercial instincts, and the ability to translate market opportunity into revenue. This role requires both individual production and strategic thinking at the territory level.

In this role you’ll:

  • Own and grow a local territory by developing and executing a clear outbound sales strategy, with a focus on net-new revenue and category expansion
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline through consistent prospecting, networking, and market engagement
  • Identify, prioritize, and win new business with local and regional advertisers, leading the full sales cycle from outreach to close

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and passion for Axios’ mission. This position requires the following:

  • 5+ years’ experience in sales, specifically in the digital media/news industry, with a strong emphasis on outbound/new business development 
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue targets, particularly through new logo acquisition
  • Strong presence and confidence in selling to senior decision-makers
  • Experience developing territory or category-level sales strategies
  • Understanding of digital media, online marketing technology, and Axios’ competitive landscape
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to lead deal execution across internal teams
  • Existing relationships within local/regional advertiser and agency ecosystems preferred
  • Highly motivated, resilient, and energized by prospecting and closing
  • Willingness to travel and represent Axios in-market

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $66,000 - $87,000 plus a commission structure with on-target earnings (OTE) up to $145,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Note that the total compensation offered for this role includes incremental variable compensation based on sales territory, which is contingent upon the successful achievement of predetermined sales targets.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks, depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Tele-mental health services through Headspace
  • OneMedical membership, including tele-health services

  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies

  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

job.title: Senior Director of Analytics
job.description:
Company And Culture

Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.

Why We're Hiring

Data and analytics are critical to how Complex makes decisions, but this role is about much more than dashboards, reporting, or tracking KPIs. We’re looking for a senior analytics leader who can turn complex, imperfect data into clear business insights and strategic action.

Complex operates across eCommerce, Content, Advertising, and Live Events, creating a uniquely rich—and often complicated—data environment. Understanding how these businesses work individually, and how they intersect, is a core part of the opportunity. The right person will embrace that complexity, quickly identify what matters, and help leadership make better decisions across the organization.

This role requires a strategic thinker who can move fluidly between high-level business questions and detailed analysis. You will partner directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, solve important business problems, and determine where data can have the greatest impact. You will be expected to use AI and emerging analytics tools to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive work, explore new questions, and move from question to insight to action faster.

The goal isn't to build more dashboards. The goal is to help Complex make better decisions and drive better business outcomes.

This role will be on-site 5 days a week at our NYC office or our Los Angeles, CA office.

job.title: Editorial Data Analyst
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join our Editorial Analytics team. You’ll use data to help understand how our journalism reaches and engages readers, and supports decision making across the newsroom and wider business. 

 

About the role

  • Provide insights on reader engagement and content performance to inform newsroom strategy.
  • Develop an understanding of editorial workflows, audience behaviour and business priorities, and apply this context when interpreting data.
  • Communicate findings clearly, tailoring outputs to different audiences and explaining context and limitations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and other teams to support feature development, experimentation and performance analysis.
  • Work responsibly and ethically with data, following privacy and governance standards.

 

About you

  • Experience working with data using SQL (in a professional or academic setting).
  • Understanding of core analytical concepts (e.g. averages, distributions, basic statistical testing).
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker).
  • Ability to think logically about problems and break them down into manageable analyses.
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders and building positive working relationships.

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely. 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV. You don't need to provide a cover letter. Instead, we have included a question on the application questionnaire relating to editorial analytics that we would like applicants to complete. This question should take about 5 minutes to answer, so please factor in the extra time when applying.

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

 

The closing date for applications is Wednesday 18th November 2026. 

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

 

Guardian News and Media is proud to be a London Living wage employer. The minimum salary for any full-time role within the organisation is £30,000 per annum. Salary ranges are dependent on skills and experience.

job.title: 21GRAMS- Art Supervisor
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Art Supervisor to join our growing team!  

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

21 Grams is in search of Art Supervisor is a brand steward and category champion, responsible for having a deep understanding of the brand, its benefits, and driven differentiation. Working with Copy partners and reporting to Associate Creative Director, the Art Supervisor will own all day-to-day design responsibilities for assigned healthcare/pharma-related HCP accounts. The ideal candidate will have the skills and experience to think strategically, supply creative ideas and concepts, and execute across a range of mediums.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Responsible for art direction and design across a variety of digital tactics, including websites, interactive visual aids, videos, banners, landing pages, and emails, for branded and unbranded HCP clients
  • Convey scientific information into compelling and memorable messages for HCP campaigns
  • Champion creative thinking for campaigns and initiatives that advance creative strategy and brand personality
  • Prepare materials for client copy approval submissions, ensuring pieces are referenced and annotated according to AMA style, without supervision
  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Designers, and Developers from job initiation to digital deployment, and partner with Account and Strategy teams at all points
  • Ability to independently run multiple projects, sometimes for different brands/industries
  • Potential for leading more junior members of the Art team
  • Clearly and expertly present work to internal members of the team, including Creative leads, Account team members, and Partners
  • Participate in client presentations (when appropriate), verbalizing the thoughts behind the idea while tying it back to the communication objective

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • 5+ years healthcare/pharmaceutical art direction and design
  • College degree in a related field preferred
  • Experience in the healthcare/pharmaceutical industry in an agency setting required
  • Proficiency in Adobe CS required, other relevant design software programs a plus
  • Portfolio or PDF of relevant work samples required
  • A comprehensive creative portfolio, demonstrating strong conceptual capabilities and ability to produce work in high-science pharma categories

 

Pay Range: $110,000-$130,000

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
Opportunity  

Our Brunswick Arts team, known as B’Arts, is an international communications consultancy specialising in championing and protecting the reputations and interests of leading arts, cultural and charitable organisations worldwide. With teams in London, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, New York and Hong Kong, we work alongside some of the most prestigious institutions and exciting initiatives across the global cultural landscape.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and adaptable Executive Assistant to join our London team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is a pivotal role providing high-level support to two Partners, ensuring the smooth running of their day-to-day activities and anticipating their needs in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The role is based in our London office Monday to Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. The ideal candidate will be a confident self-starter who thrives in a creative and collaborative environment, bringing exceptional organisational skills, sound judgement, discretion and a genuine interest in the arts and cultural sector.

About the Role

As an Executive Assistant at Brunswick Arts, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive diary, inbox, and communications management for two Partners.
  • Organise and maintain Partner inboxes and diaries with a clear, structured system, using colour coordination and folders to ensure efficiency and visibility.
  • Prepare daily briefs and materials, ensuring leaders are fully equipped and informed for client meetings, events, and travel.
  • Draft, prioritise, and triage communications on behalf of senior leaders — from client correspondence to internal notes.
  • Manage complex international travel arrangements, including visas, itineraries, and on-the-ground logistics.
  • Coordinate high-profile client dinners, cultural events, and hospitality with creativity and attention to detail.
  • Oversee financial administration including expenses, billing, and budget tracking.
  • Submit and manage timesheets on behalf of the Partners, ensuring timely and accurate completion each week.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients and their offices, building relationships with professionalism, warmth, and discretion.
  • Ensure the quality and presentation of client-facing deliverables, from proposals to event materials.
  • Conduct research and compile insights to support client engagements and leadership decision-making.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of systems and workflows across the team.

What We're Looking For

We’re seeking someone who brings:

  • A genuine interest in the arts, culture and charitable sectors, with an enthusiasm for the work of Brunswick Arts (B’Arts) and the organisations and institutions we support across the global cultural landscape.
  • At least 4 years’ experience supporting senior leaders at Partner, Director or C-suite level, ideally within professional services, consultancy or the creative industries.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and sound judgement, with the ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing demands and maintain a high level of accuracy and discretion.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a polished, professional and adaptable communication style.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, alongside the confidence and willingness to embrace new digital tools and systems.
  • Strong financial administration skills and meticulous attention to detail, with experience managing expenses, invoicing, timesheets and budget tracking.
  • Proven relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage effectively and establish trust with senior stakeholders, colleagues and clients.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to anticipate challenges, exercise initiative and navigate demanding situations with professionalism and diplomacy.
  • A calm composed and adaptable manner, with the ability to anticipate needs, remain one step ahead and deliver consistently under pressure.
  • A collaborative and team-oriented mindset, with a genuine commitment to contributing to a supportive, inclusive and high-performing assistant team.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client-facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: GRAY MEDIA TRAINING PROGRAM SPRING '27 - KWCH
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KWCH:

KWCH-TV (12 News) is a CBS television affiliate operated by Gray Television with one of the best corporate and local cultures in the country. Our top-rated station is located in the beautiful south-central region of Kansas. KWCH-TV is the market leader, with viewers relying on news and weather coverage. Along with strong programming ratings, the #1 website, CBS Sports, and CBS Primetime, we deliver results for our advertisers.

The Training Program:

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job; you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award -winning team from day one. The intern rate of pay can range from the minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

General Requirements: 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online). 
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen; think social media, streaming apps, and web stories—because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook. 
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies.
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 113 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand. 
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift. 
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence. 
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule. 
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn—this is a paid internship.
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

Qualifications/Requirements: 

▪️ Be currently enrolled in a college/university (preferred: Junior/Senior)
▪️ Strong work ethic and organizational skills
▪️ Earning a degree in Journalism/Communications, News, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry

If you are interested in interning in these areas, the station may have openings in these departments for you:

- Sports
- Weather
- News MMJ

Ready to stop practicing and start performing? Let’s build the future of media together

The intern rate of pay can range from the minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

▪️ Interested in the program?  Go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, type "KWCH" (in the search bar)

job.title: Associate, Marketing Science & Strategy- (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The NFL Marketing Strategy & Insights team serves as the voice and advocate of NFL fans, leveraging diverse data sources to generate actionable insights that help inform League-wide business decisions and optimization. The Associate, Marketing Science and Strategy will support research and analysis across media, marketing, and key fan development priorities. This role is ideal for a curious, flexible, and detail-oriented professional who can help design and execute research, analyze syndicated and proprietary data, and translate findings into clear, strategic insights for internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the planning, execution, analysis, and reporting of primary research projects for the NFL.
  • Manage research initiatives by coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors to help ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget.
  • Create story-driven reports that translate research findings into strategic insights for teams across NFL Media, Marketing, Sponsorship, Club and other key areas.
  • Serve as a research resource and voice of the fan by supporting study development, methodology selection, survey design, data weighting, and reporting recommendations.
  • Use research tools and platforms, including MarketSight, Sports Poll, YouGov, and AceMetrix, to pull, analyze, and interpret data.
  • Provide support across Consumer Insights projects, including ad hoc analyses and custom research studies throughout the year.
  • Ensure research and insights work reflects best-in-class diversity, equity, and inclusion practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, analytics, consumer behavior, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of quantitative research, including the ability to write surveys aligned to business questions and research objectives.
  • Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, creative, and insightful reports for a diverse business audience.
  • Strong project management, relationship-building, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience with a range of research methods preferred.
  • Understanding of the application of various analytic techniques preferred.
  • Experience with analytical platforms such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • 40 Hours per week
  • This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL.

job.title: Manager, Production Finance
job.description:
Tennis Channel’s Production Finance Manager manages day-to-day production accounting and financial analysis for domestic and international production activities. Reporting to the Director of Production Finance, the role supports live events, studio productions, original content, and digital initiatives through accurate close, event cost reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial controls. The manager works closely with Production, FP&A, and Accounting, coordinating broader accounting requirements with the Director of Accounting. This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will do the following:

  • Manage the production-related monthly close in accordance with corporate deadlines, including production and program costs by line of business, prepaid assets, accrued liabilities, amortization entries, and account reconciliations. Maintain job-cost schedules and supporting calculations; reconcile production records to the general ledger and investigate discrepancies.
  • Support the Director of Production Finance in preparing annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, long-range planning schedules, variance analyses, and monthly reporting packages for Finance and Production leadership.
  • Maintain event-level estimates of total expected costs, incorporating actual spending, outstanding commitments, and remaining costs. Review assumptions with Production, explain cost drivers, and escalate potential overruns, forecast changes, and financial risks promptly.
  • Track production costs, vendor obligations, talent commitments, and open purchase orders. Prepare recurring event cost reports and post-event analyses, including budget-to-actual comparisons and recommendations for future planning.
  • Review crew payroll, timecards, overtime, labor coding, and related production labor costs for accuracy, budget impact, supporting documentation, and required approvals. Coordinate exceptions with Production, HR, and payroll providers in accordance with established responsibilities and approval authority.
  • Review production payables, purchasing card activity, employee expense reimbursements, and per diem payments for appropriate coding, documentation, approvals, and compliance with policy. Approve transactions within delegated authority and coordinate with Corporate AP and expense systems, including Concur.
  • Support financial review of production agreements and vendor commitments for cost tracking, accounting treatment, payment timing, and budget impact. Escalate exceptions to the Director of Production Finance and coordinate technical accounting questions with the Director of Accounting.
  • Serve as a day-to-day finance contact for Production on project setup, chart of accounts, transactional workflows, policies, and procedures. Coordinate with Production on financial requirements while Production retains responsibility for talent, hotel, and crew booking and operational logistics.
  • Prepare production-related audit schedules and supporting documentation, coordinating submissions and requests through the Director of Accounting. Support Corporate tax requests related to production, including international costs and tax/VAT documentation, as directed by Accounting and Corporate Tax.
  • Coordinate production accounting priorities, close deadlines, and supporting work with Finance and Accounting team members. Maintain clear process documentation, reporting calendars, and follow-up on unresolved items.
  • Improve production accounting, forecasting, and reporting processes through standardized templates, reconciliations, and approved automation and AI-enabled tools. Maintain cost benchmarks, savings trackers, and operational metrics across vendors, staffing, travel, and other production spending.
  • Support production-related corporate initiatives, parent-company integration, and system upgrades under the Director of Production Finance, coordinating with the Director of Accounting and VP Finance/Controller as appropriate.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or a relevant master’s degree preferred.
  • Five to seven years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including hands-on budgeting, forecasting, production or project job costing, monthly close, and reconciliations.
  • Experience in live sports, production finance, entertainment, or media preferred; familiarity with domestic and international production costs is valuable.
  • Ability to build and maintain event cost forecasts, analyze actuals and commitments, and translate financial results into clear explanations for production managers and Finance leadership.
  • Strong understanding of accrual accounting, financial controls, production labor and vendor cost review.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and financial modeling; experience with Oracle or a comparable ERP/project accounting system preferred.
  • Strong communication, organization, and judgment; ability to manage competing deadlines, work independently, collaborate across teams, and deliver accurate work with appropriate review.
  • Experience documenting processes and improving reporting workflows; familiarity with BI tools and approved automation is a plus.

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Nashville, TN | Hybrid (Remote + In-territory + 1 day in-office)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.
