Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Manager, AI Engineering and Vendor Operations
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build-versus-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work-life balance.

Responsibilities

  • People Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth.
  • Delivery: Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders.
  • Engineering Standards: Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team.
  • Code Quality and Architecture: Review designs and code, and contribute hands-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards.
  • Testing and Evaluation: Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team.
  • Production Support: Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow-up reviews to prevent repeat problems.
  • Vendor Evaluation: Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner.
  • NPR-wide AI Tool Review: Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve.
  • Vendor Relationships: Take over day-to-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. 
  • Responsible Scaling: Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers.
  • Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards.
  • Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews.
  • Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Hands-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Experience working across technical and non-technical teams, including explaining technical and cost trade-offs to people without a technical background and working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution.
  • Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team.
  • Experience designing harnesses for AI coding agents, including permissions, approval steps, and automated checks.
  • Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search.
  • Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation
  • Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama.
  • Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat-based and usage-based pricing.
  • Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role include duties that are better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office, preferably at the Washington, DC location, at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of onsite days they choose.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $180,000 - 206,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.description:

Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

job.title: Database Administrator III
job.description:
Want to be part of a team that keeps AccuWeather's critical database environments reliable, secure, performant, and available around the clock for a global audience? We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with deep hands-on expertise in SQL Server and PostgreSQL who can take ownership of the health and reliability of our production database systems while helping modernize our database infrastructure for the future. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this role will serve as a hands-on database administration expert responsible for the day-to-day operational health and long-term reliability of AccuWeather's database environments. Key responsibilities include performance tuning and optimization, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, capacity planning, monitoring and maintenance, and incident and root-cause analysis. The DBA will work closely with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish strong database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns. This role will also play an important part in the migration of select backend databases to cloud-based environments, helping assess existing workloads, plan and execute migrations, optimize databases for their target environments, and ensure appropriate performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition. It is an opportunity to combine deep database administration expertise with meaningful involvement in the continued modernization of AccuWeather's data infrastructure.

 

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Administer SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases end to end — performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis.

· Design, implement, and regularly test backup, replication, and disaster recovery procedures for databases, ensuring high availability across production environments.

· Manage database security — roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.

· Monitor and plan for database capacity — storage growth, connection pooling, and resource allocation.

· Manage database version upgrades, patching cycles, and configuration tuning.

· Perform routine database maintenance — index/statistics upkeep, vacuuming, storage optimization, and space reclamation — to sustain performance over time.

· Proactively monitor database health and performance, identifying and resolving issues before they affect production.

· Manage cloud cost optimization and capacity planning, including license reporting and true-ups, resource forecasting, and optimization of Azure compute spend through Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and related strategies.

· Partner with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns.

· Plan and execute database migrations to the cloud, optimizing configurations for target environments, and ensuring performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition.

· Build strong working relationships with engineering teams, communicating database constraints and recommendations in terms they can act on.

· Share database expertise and best practices with less experienced administrators and engineering team members.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data operations or database administration, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o Demonstrated experience as a database administrator with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, and capacity planning.

o Advanced SQL/T-SQL proficiency, with working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python or PowerShell) for database automation.

o Ability to design and implement monitoring solutions for database health, performance, and capacity.

o Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, migrating databases to cloud-based environments (e.g., Microsoft Azure).

o Awareness of the monetary costs associated with operational work.

o Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching less experienced engineers.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience with advanced replication topologies (e.g., multi-region, active-active) for SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.

o Experience administrating, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing backup/recovery of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL or similar systems).

o Familiarity with, or willingness to grow into, modern cloud data platforms, including Databricks and Snowflake. Experience with CI/CD automation.

o Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for building, orchestrating, and maintaining reliable data ingestion and loading pipelines.

o Experience participating in structured post-mortems and root cause analysis for significant incidents.

o Familiarity with data governance practices (quality checks, lineage documentation, access control).

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking; understands how failure in one system cascades to others across a portfolio.

o Sound judgment balancing database performance, availability, security, and cost trade-offs.

o Excellent written communication; operational health reports are usable by data consumers and leadership without interpretation.

job.title: Senior Lightning Scientist
job.description:
The Senior Lightning Scientist is a subject-matter expert responsible for advancing AccuWeather’s lightning detection, analysis, and interpretation capabilities. This role combines deep scientific understanding of lightning physics with practical expertise in RF systems, sensor networks, and algorithm development. The Senior Lightning Scientist plays a critical role in improving lightning detection accuracy, developing new methodologies, guiding technical strategy, and collaborating across science, engineering, and product teams to deliver industry-leading lightning intelligence products.

Working closely with data science, hardware, and software engineering teams, this role drives innovation in lightning detection technologies, signal processing, and real-time analysis systems that support AccuWeather’s operational, commercial, and public safety offerings.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a technical and scientific authority on lightning physics, detection methodologies, and operational interpretation.
  • Lead the development, evaluation, and improvement of lightning detection algorithms using techniques such as TOA, TDOA, interferometry, and hybrid approaches.
  • Analyze RF signals across relevant frequency bands used in lightning detection, including waveform characterization, noise mitigation, and signal classification.
  • Collaborate with hardware and electrical engineering teams on sensor design, RF front-end considerations, antenna design, placement, and calibration strategies.
  • Develop and refine signal processing pipelines for real-time and post-processed lightning data.
  • Design, test, and validate algorithms for lightning geolocation, flash clustering, classification (e.g., CG vs IC), and quality control.
  • Evaluate network performance, detection efficiency, location accuracy, and timing precision using ground truth and statistical methods.
  • Contribute to the integration of lightning data into forecasting, nowcasting, severe weather detection, and machine learning systems.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to scientists and engineers working on lightning-related systems.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, system limitations, and scientific findings for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product, operations, and research teams to translate scientific advances into scalable, customer-facing solutions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (PhD or MS with significant experience) in Atmospheric Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Geophysics, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of lightning physics, electromagnetic emissions from lightning, and storm electrification processes.
  • Strong background in RF systems, signal processing, and spectral analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with lightning detection techniques such as TOA, TDOA, interferometry, or related geolocation methods.
  • Proficiency in algorithm development and data analysis using Python, C++, or similar scientific computing environments.
  • Experience working with large-scale, real-time observational data systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing or working directly with lightning detection hardware, sensors, or ground-based networks.
  • Background in antenna theory, antenna design, and RF propagation effects.
  • Familiarity with FPGA, SDR, or embedded systems used in RF signal acquisition.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
  • Published research or patents related to lightning detection, RF sensing, or atmospheric electricity.
  • Experience collaborating with operational forecasting or severe weather teams.
  • Familiarity with machine learning applications applied to lightning or RF signal classification.

job.title: Alert Team Lead I
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

SiriusXM Connect (SiriusXM CV) is a leading provider of connected services to vehicle manufacturers, delivering one of the most broadly adopted connected vehicle platforms in North America for the last 25 years. Named the 2020 Company of the Year in the Telematics Industry by Frost & Sullivan, we provide safety, security and convenience services to millions of vehicle owners across major automotive brands. Our teams are continuously working to develop leading-edge technology that can not only add convenience to the daily lives of so many drivers across the country but our advancements in safety and security could also help save their lives.


How you’ll make an impact:
As an Alert Team Lead I, you will play a critical role in supporting the daily operations of the SiriusXM Connect Help Desk and Response Center. This position serves as a second-level support resource for contact center agents, internal business partners, and external customers. The Alert Team Lead I is responsible for resolving complex customer escalations, troubleshooting technical and service-related issues, coordinating with internal support teams, and assisting with time-sensitive safety and security requests.

You will also provide guidance to frontline agents, support operational processes, and help ensure customer concerns are handled accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established procedures. Success in this role requires strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, attention to detail,
and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do:

Operational Support & Escalation Management
• Serve as a second-level support resource for contact center agents, internal departments and external customers.
• Research, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer concerns involving connected vehicle services, account management, billing, enrollment, and service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer interactions professionally, demonstrating empathy, accountability, and effective de-escalation techniques.
• Provide real-time guidance to frontline agents to support accurate issue resolution and minimize unnecessary escalations.

• Assist with complex service requests, including account adjustments, refund research, subscription issues, and other operational activities.
• Manage multiple priorities while maintaining service quality, accuracy, and responsiveness.

Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Management
• Investigate technical issues involving connected vehicle functionality, remote services, provisioning, enrollment, and system-related errors.
• Research account information, service history, system activity, and technical errors to identify potential causes and appropriate next steps.
• Create, document, monitor, and escalate technical support tickets through established incident management processes.
• Collaborate with internal technical teams to investigate system defects, service interruptions, and recurring technical issues.
• Communicate known system issues, approved workarounds, and troubleshooting procedures to frontline agents and operational teams.
• Follow up on unresolved technical issues and provide timely updates to appropriate stakeholders.

Safety, Security & Stolen Vehicle Support
• Support Stolen Vehicle Location (SVL) requests in accordance with established company procedures and security requirements.
• Coordinate with law enforcement agencies, Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs), and authorized third parties when handling specialized or time-sensitive requests.
• Assist with exigent requests, missing/endangered person cases, and other safety-related escalations as authorized by company policy.
• Verify required information and documentation while maintaining customer privacy and compliance with established procedures.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to support timely and accurate handling of safety and security requests.
• Maintain accurate case documentation and follow established escalation and
communication protocols.

Agent Support, Quality & Development
• Provide guidance and support to contact center agents regarding complex procedures, troubleshooting, and customer escalations.
• Reinforce established processes, service standards, and customer experience
expectations.
• Identify recurring agent knowledge gaps and communicate coaching or training opportunities to leadership.
• Assist with quality monitoring, interaction reviews, and performance feedback as assigned.
• Support new and existing agents by sharing knowledge, clarifying procedures, and promoting consistent service delivery.

• Contribute to achieving operational performance, service quality, and customer satisfaction objectives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Support
• Partner with Account Managers and internal business teams to research customer concerns and support client relationships.
• Provide accurate updates regarding escalated issues, service tickets, and operational concerns.
• Collaborate with technical support teams, operations, and other departments to resolve issues affecting customers or service delivery.
• Communicate process changes, system updates, and operational guidance to
appropriate teams.
• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce repeat contacts, and enhance operational efficiency.

Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
• Maintain accurate and complete documentation of customer interactions, escalations, service tickets, and operational activities.
• Assist with operational reporting, quality reviews, audits, and special projects as assigned.
• Monitor recurring issues and identify trends that may require additional investigation or process improvements.
• Support compliance with established policies, procedures, privacy requirements, and quality standards.
• Perform administrative duties and other responsibilities as assigned by leadership.

What You'll Need:

Required Qualifications
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Minimum of one year of experience in a fast-paced customer service or contact center environment.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex information clearly and professionally.
• Demonstrated customer service skills, including empathy, active listening, conflict resolution, and de-escalation.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to research complex issues, exercise sound judgment, and determine appropriate resolution or escalation paths.
• Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
• Willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and operational procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and cross-functional partners.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and other standard business applications.
• Must have legal authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications
• One to two years of operations, customer service leadership, or contact center support experience.
• Experience providing agent guidance, coaching, training, or second-level operational support.
• Familiarity with contact center performance metrics, quality standards, and escalation procedures.
• Experience with customer relationship management (CRM), ticketing, or incident management systems.
• Familiarity with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Genesys, or similar applications.
• Technical troubleshooting experience involving connected services, mobile applications, account provisioning, or system-related issues.
• Knowledge of automotive connected vehicle services, safety and security operations, or telematics.
• Experience working with internal technical teams, external business partners, or law enforcement agencies.

Key Competencies
• Customer Focus & Accountability.
• Technical Troubleshooting & Critical Thinking.
• Communication & De-escalation.
• Operational Excellence & Attention to Detail.
• Leadership & Team Collaboration.
• Adaptability & Continuous Improvement.
• Sound Judgment & Confidentiality.

Research & Development at The New York Times explores how emerging technologies can be applied in service of journalism. We collaborate with designers, developers, reporters, photographers and editors to bring new forms of storytelling to life, from prototyping to publishing.

At The Times, technology permeates every aspect of our business, from our thought-provoking coverage of technological trends to the digital-first transformation of our own business to the changing world of our readers. The Research & Development team explores the new opportunities that emerging technologies may provide the New York Times and our commercial and strategic goals.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a background in applied AI to develop applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) in service of The Times mission and journalistic standards.

You will report to the Executive Director of R&D.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement LLM-backed APIs – driving improvements to reach target outcomes through evaluation, grounding and fine-tuning best practices.
  • Deploy reliable services within cloud environments (such as GCP or AWS) to support high-traffic LLM applications.
  • Manage the transition of features from experimental prototypes to stable production systems in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements.
  • Collaborate with designers, product managers and stakeholders to translate detailed requirements into technical tasks, providing accurate estimates and progress updates.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation to facilitate feature handoff and future maintenance.
  • Stay at the forefront of the evolving AI and LLM landscape, identifying and advocating for the use of new technologies and best practices.
  • Demonstrate understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

You are comfortable building projects by yourself and enjoy collaboration with a larger team. You are both curious about and skeptical of new technologies. You're excited to apply new tools, but aim to do so in service of solving important problems and making a difference for users. You take pride in your craft and understand the need to capture patterns and support future development.

  • 5+ years of professional software development or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency with Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Professional experience architecting and shipping applications that use LLMs. Experience with multi-step chaining and human-in-the-loop workflows.

Go deeper: As a BDA, you will develop and execute business-development initiatives across assigned industries, markets, or products. You will work alongside Client Partners to evaluate opportunities, prioritize accounts, understand prospective advertisers’ business needs, and determine effective approaches to engagement.

  • The role combines research and analysis with direct prospect engagement, performance evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
  • You will exercise judgment in selecting accounts and stakeholders, developing messaging, evaluating advertiser fit, and recommending next steps.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Shape prospecting priorities: Analyze industry trends, buying signals, account potential, and alignment with Axios audiences and products to develop prioritized account recommendations. Explain the rationale, potential value, and trade-offs behind proposed priorities, and reassess them as market conditions and prospect needs change.
  • Partner on account strategy: Develop account briefs that synthesize prospective advertisers’ business priorities, relevant stakeholders, potential needs, and engagement opportunities. Recommend messaging and engagement approaches, and partner with Client Partners to evaluate alternatives and determine next steps aligned with advertiser needs and revenue goals.
  • Develop prospective relationships: Create targeted outreach connecting prospect objectives with Axios audiences, products, and proof points. Adapt engagement based on responses and results.
  • Evaluate early opportunities: Assess advertiser fit, needs, timing, and potential; nurture interest and equip Client Partners with context and recommended next steps.
  • Improve performance: Analyze outreach effectiveness, prospect feedback, and pipeline progression to identify barriers and evaluate alternative approaches. Recommend and implement approved improvements to targeting, messaging, follow-up, and handoffs, and assess whether those changes improve results.
  • Refine tools and workflows: Test AI and automation with leadership, Revenue Operations, and Enablement to improve effectiveness, validate quality, and create capacity.
  • Build shared expertise: Translate successful campaigns, industry insights, and workflow improvements into practical playbooks and resources for the broader team.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios’ mission, and the following skills:

  • Experience in business development, advertising, sales, marketing, or a related client-facing role; at least one year preferred.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to translate market information and performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Sound commercial judgment and the ability to evaluate opportunities, weigh alternatives, and explain priorities.
  • Experience developing targeted outreach and managing early-stage sales opportunities.
  • Ability to build productive partnerships and contribute ideas to shared account and business-development strategies.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to connect advertiser needs with a relevant value proposition.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with initiative and accountability.
  • Proficiency with CRM and sales-engagement tools, and curiosity about using AI and automation to improve results. 
  • A willingness to test approaches, learn from feedback, and share successful practices with others.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $65,000 - $75,000 annually and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high-deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage

  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers

job.title: Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Business Director to join Translation!

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

Drive Business & Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead on assigned accounts, serving as a strategic partner who uncovers and addresses core client challenges and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders, proactively offering strategic counsel rooted in a deep understanding of their business, category, and competitive dynamics.
  • Partner closely with Program Management to align on priorities and ensure our collective approach delivers on both business objectives and operational rigor.
  • Keep a constant pulse on the health of client relationships and business performance, identifying risks or growth opportunities early and collaborating with agency leadership to proactively address them.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, and other internal teams to ensure our work solves real business problems and capitalizes on cultural opportunities.
  • Champion the development of strategies and creative solutions that are grounded in business insights and tied to clear performance metrics.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and cultural shifts to bring fresh, informed thinking that drives innovative solutions for clients.
  • Partner with production leads, creative teams and program management to execute creative work that fully brings to life the approved creative concepts within the allocated time and budget
  • Advocate for additional budget and or push the boundaries with clients to create the most compelling executions possible 

Team & Partnership Leadership

  • Guide and inspire cross-discipline partners, fostering a culture of strategic curiosity, accountability, and partnership excellence.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Program Management, who will lead the operational planning, scoping, budgeting, and executional excellence—freeing you to focus on driving the business agenda and strategic growth.
  • Together with Program Management, ensure seamless integration across disciplines, maintaining the highest standards in client service and delivery.

Champion Growth & Client Success

  • Proactively identify opportunities to grow agency partnerships within existing accounts, aligning agency capabilities with the client’s long-term business goals. Responsible for creating and actioning growth plans for assigned clients
  • Play a key role in broader business development efforts, participating in pitches and strategic growth initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep understanding of the QSR or restaurant category, with an appreciation for cultural nuances that inform creative strategies.
  • Experience leading multicultural or African American targeted work
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp client industry dynamics and uncover opportunities for impactful creative solutions.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to provide strategic counsel to clients and inspire internal teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading integrated work across multiple channels, with a strong sense for how creative and strategic solutions drive business results.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the optimism and resilience to tackle challenges and move work forward.
  • Passion for culturally relevant work that delivers against both business objectives and consumer engagement.
  • Proven track record of leading creative initiatives that drove real business change or results for clients

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated campaigns, engaging with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with QSR brands. Culturally driven brand experience is also a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $115,000 - 135,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Temporary Copywriter
job.description:
UnitedMasters

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a versatile, culture-obsessed part-time Copywriter to join our team on a part-time basis. 

The Role

This role will sit at the intersection of music, tech, and media, supporting both the UnitedMasters brand and the 16Bars platform.

The ideal candidate has a sharp ear for voice, a deep understanding of music culture, and the ability to pivot between high-level brand storytelling and punchy social communications. You will collaborate closely with the Integrated Marketing, Social and Creative teams to drive engagement across our digital ecosystem.

What You’ll Do 

  • Digital & Web: Draft compelling website copy for landing pages and product launches, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM): Develop clear, impactful messaging for brand initiatives and new feature rollouts.
  • CRM & Editorial: Write engaging weekly newsletters and email marketing campaigns that drive conversion and community loyalty.
  • Social Media: Craft platform-specific copy (Instagram, TikTok, X) that resonates with independent artists and music fans.
  • Creative Development: Assist in writing creative treatments and "big idea" pitches for brand partnerships.
  • Content Scripts: Script short-form video content (Reels/TikToks) that feels authentic, trendy, and on-brand.

Who You Are 

  • 4-7 years of experience: working on internal and external facing brand copy across digital and social platforms
  • Culture-First Mindset: You’re plugged into music and culture, specifically the independent artist landscape.
  • Versatile Portfolio: Proven experience writing for tech, music, or lifestyle brands across web, email, and social.
  • Adaptability: Ability to switch voices between the professional/empowering tone of UnitedMasters and the editorial/sharp tone of 16Bars.
  • Efficiency: Capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Collaboration: A team player who can take feedback from integrated marketing leads and turn it into polished prose.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $45 - $55/ hr 

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

job.title: Senior Medical Writer
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Position Summary:

The Senior Medical Writer serves as an integral part of the Real Chemistry Medical Communications division in developing scientific content in support of a variety of omnichannel medical communication tactics, as assigned to particular therapeutic areas and client brands. The Senior Medical Writer must have the ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific data and translate these into compelling and relevant clinical communications and commercial/medical messages. The Senior Medical Writer collaborates closely with the Medical Director and cross-functional teammates in the development and execution of scientific strategies and tactics. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, Lambertville (NJ), or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you'll do:

  • Develop core deliverables (eg, PowerPoint slides, manuscripts, video scripts, executive summaries) and ancillary materials (eg, participant handouts, moderator guides) for medical communication projects, including promotional/medical presentations, advisory board meetings, product theaters as well as various educational videos and digital solutions
  • Perform and analyze literature searches and scientific research regarding clinical data and key scientific information for content development projects to meet client needs for relevant, up-to-date, evidenced-based, and accurate medical communication content
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director, in partnership with Creative and Client Services, on medical storytelling, drawing upon client insights, landscape intelligence, and relevant evidence-based medical literature to provide informed and relevant strategic recommendations
  • Partner with Presentation and Graphic Designers on various illustrations, animations, and creative applications of medical and scientific information
  • As assigned, develop relationships and collaborate closely with clients and key opinion leaders to develop scientific content and execute medical communication strategy to communicate complex scientific information to medical professionals 
  • Conduct quality checks on all content-related materials, including annotated deliverables, to ensure scientific integrity and accuracy, and support Veeva submissions of all medical communication deliverables for client medical/legal/regulatory reviews by highlighting all relevant references and creating detailed reference notes
  • Support project management within the cross-functional team by effectively communicating and aligning with Account and Project Managers, and actively participating in all internal and client meetings
  • Train and mentor more junior medical writers under the guidance of the Medical Director
  • Maintain full compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements as well as all applicable US laws and regulations
  • Perform any other duties as reasonably assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations warrant 

Working Conditions:

  • Work Schedule/Hours: This position requires occasional nonstandard work hours in accordance with project needs, deadlines, deliverables, and urgent client requests    
  • Business Travel: This position requires moderate overnight/weekend travel (up to 20%) based upon client geography
  • This position has no direct reports and does not perform supervisory tasks 

What you should have: 

  • Advanced degree (eg, MD, PhD, PharmD, MPH, MS) in a healthcare-related field required 
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in medical education, scientific research, or clinical practice/insights preferred, or 2-3 years of experience in medical education in a pharmaceutical company or medical communications agency required, with experience in promotional/medical communication to healthcare professionals preferred
  • Experience with medical, legal, and regulatory reviews preferred
  • Expert verbal and written communication skills in the field of medical science 
  • Intermediate ability to analyze the scientific relevance, validity, and credibility of the published medical literature
  • Intermediate level of conceptual and functional understanding of modern digital marketing practices and the applications of artificial intelligence technology 

Core Competencies:

Whether acting in a promotional or nonpromotional nature, we serve as envoys for our clients’ messages, a resource for their customers, and stewards of the money they invest with us. As such, Real Chemistry holds employees to a high standard when it comes to communication, culture, and collaboration, specifically: 

  • Model corporate values—Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability With an “I”—in interactions with colleagues, clients, vendors, and HCPs as well as exercise impeccable professionalism and sound judgement when representing the agency
  • Demonstrate strong work efficiency by managing time, meeting deadlines, and achieving billability expectations
  • Display excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as a high level of emotional intelligence, as demonstrated by advanced verbal, writing, and presentation skills as well as a strong ability to influence and impact others through meaningful and persuasive delivery

Global advertising agencies are finally innovating in AdTech—and we're leading. We're literally on the edge of what's possible in supply-side targeting and cross-channel orchestration.

AdTech Expertise

Execution Excellence

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

Maintenance Technician

Prince George, BC

Pattison Media is looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician to join our Technical Services team in Prince George.

This is a hands-on technical position supporting our radio and television operation in Prince George. We are looking for someone with a strong technical background who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology, and learning how complex systems work. Broadcast experience would certainly be an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates coming from electronics, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video, RF, or other related technical fields.

The successful candidate will support day-to-day operations and participate in equipment installations, system upgrades, technical projects, and the ongoing modernization of Pattison Media's broadcast infrastructure. The position works closely with our broader Technical Services team, which will provide support and help the successful candidate become familiar with our specialized radio and television systems.

What you'll do
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and install radio and television studio and broadcast equipment.
  • Maintain and support radio and television transmission systems, including transmitters, RF systems, and associated equipment.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot audio and video systems, including studio, production, and signal-distribution equipment.
  • Support computers, servers, network equipment, and other technology used throughout the Prince George operation.
  • Support broadcast and production systems, including automation, newsroom, audio, video, and content-delivery systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting on-air, production, newsroom, and business operations.
  • Install and commission new technical equipment and systems.
  • Diagnose problems across complete broadcast workflows, from studio and production systems through transmission and distribution.
  • Work with IP networking, server infrastructure, and increasingly IP-based and cloud-connected broadcast systems.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, records, and system drawings.
  • Work closely with programming, news, television production, sales, and other departments to provide reliable day-to-day technical support.
  • Help ensure technical systems follow Pattison Media standards for reliability, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure.
What we're looking for
  • A graduate of a recognized Electronics Technician, Electronics Engineering Technologist, Broadcast Technology, or related technical program, or a combination of relevant education and practical technical experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to logically diagnose technical and electronic systems.
  • Experience working with electronics, electrical systems, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical equipment.
  • Good working knowledge of computers, IP networking, and modern IT infrastructure.
  • Comfort learning and working with radio and television studio, transmission, audio/video, automation, and production systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and see tasks through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently while also being part of Pattison Media's larger Technical Services team.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with a practical, positive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Comfort working at transmitter sites and other technical facilities as required.
  • A valid driver's license.
Experience we're particularly interested in

Previous radio or television broadcast experience would be an asset, but it is not essential.

We recognize that strong technical candidates can come from many different backgrounds. We are interested in people with solid hands-on experience in electronics, telecommunications, IT and networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical fields. Someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting skills, and a willingness to learn the specialized systems used in broadcasting could be an excellent fit.

Experience with broadcast automation, production, or newsroom systems would also be an asset. Pattison Media uses systems such as WideOrbit in radio and Broadstream OASYS in television, along with newsroom and other supporting broadcast technologies.

About Pattison Media

Pattison Media is one of Canada's leading independent media companies, operating radio, television, and digital platforms across Western Canada. We continue to invest in modern broadcast technology, IP and cloud-based systems, and new workflows that support reliable multi-platform content delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of technology. One day may involve troubleshooting a radio studio or computer system, while another may involve television production equipment, networking, servers, or a transmission system.

If you enjoy solving problems, working with technology, and keeping radio and television operations running reliably, we'd like to hear from you.

How to apply

When applying, please identify that you are applying for the Prince George Maintenance Technician position.

You can apply online below or submit a cover letter, resume, and a completed Pattison Media Self ID Form before Friday, November 30th, 2026, to:

Bill Stovold

Director, Technical Services

job.description:
Director of Digital News & Audience – New Jersey 101.5

* This is a full-time, in-office position in Trenton that involves working closely and collaboratively with our New Jersey content teams. * 

 

Lead the Next Evolution of Digital News & Audience Growth

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

This is a digital-first, hands-on content leadership role at the intersection of journalism, content, audience, and growth. You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital News & Audience, you’ll help shape our digital content strategy while staying deeply involved in day-to-day execution. You’ll serve as both a leader and a hands-on editor, helping shape the digital voice of our local brands. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading digital news and content strategy for New Jersey 101.5, helping identify, develop, and execute compelling original and breaking-news coverage across platforms
  • Creating, editing, publishing, and packaging content across websites, apps, social media, video, newsletters, and other digital channels
  • Partnering with journalists, on-air personalities, producers, and creators to turn strong ideas and existing content into platform-specific digital experiences
  • Elevating our social and video storytelling, including platform-native hooks, headlines, captions, thumbnails, pacing, formats, and creative approaches for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms
  • Coaching and collaborating with content teams on digital storytelling, SEO, audience development, social strategy, and evolving best practices
  • Using audience and content analytics to understand performance, identify opportunities, test new ideas, and make data-informed editorial decisions
  • Expanding content distribution through SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and other audience-growth channels
  • Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives
  • Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities
  • Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment
  • A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience
  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news
  • Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video
  • Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others
  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development
  • Experience collaborating with and coaching reporters, writers, personalities, producers, or other content creators
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms, social publishing tools, analytics platforms, and digital/video production workflows
  • Curiosity about emerging platforms, creator trends, changing audience behaviors, and new technologies
  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan

job.title: Regional Market Engineering Manager
job.description:
Regional Market Engineering Manager - Yakima

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities – Richland/Kennewick/Pasco, Yakima, and Wenatchee stations. 

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Regional Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facilities in the Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. 

 

Essential Functions:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with FCC technical rules and perform duties of Chief Operator
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Cognitive & Communication:

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Safety & Physical Requirements:

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, visually inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

  • After-hours and weekend work as required
  • On-call availability for emergency response

 

Disclaimer:

This job description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. The incumbent will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility
  • Company provided laptop
  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Company discounts
  • Pet Insurance
  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

 

About Us:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing web sites, search engine optimization, social platforms and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local terrestrial radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com and Loudwire.com.
