About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facility in the Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. 

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations. The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

 

Essential Functions:

The following duties are essential functions of this position. The ability to perform each of these functions, with or without reasonable accommodation, is a condition of employment.

Independent Judgment and Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment to assess, prioritize, and resolve technical failures affecting station broadcast continuity, including real-time decisions during on-air emergencies where delays directly impact revenue and regulatory standing
  • Evaluate equipment performance and determine appropriate corrective action, including the authority to take systems offline, reroute signals, or authorize emergency repairs without prior approval when broadcast continuity is at risk
  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

Technical Operations

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Travel and Emergency Response

  • Maintain a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends; this role requires on-call availability reflecting the position’s independent authority over broadcast operations
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Cognitive and Communication Requirements

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports, technical documentation, and correspondence
  • Communicate effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with the Senior Vice President of Engineering, Senior Vice President of
  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

Safety and Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

Required

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible broadcast engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

Preferred

  • SBE certification or computer-related certification
  • Experience with Zetta and Wheatstone systems

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)

  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility

  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

job.description:

Motion and content

  • Partner with the video producer on graphics packages, lower thirds, and in-game elements.

Team and collaboration

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina Statehouse.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

NBCUniversal recherche un·e Artiste Principal·e VFX pour contribuer à façonner la qualité visuelle et technique des effets temps réel d’un projet interactif ambitieux et à grande échelle.   • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for visual quality, consistency, editability, and suitability for real-time integration. 
  • Partner with Technical Art and Engineering to combine generative AI, procedural systems, and automation into repeatable production workflows. 
  • Compare experimental approaches with existing methods to determine where they improve iteration, reduce repetitive work, or support production at scale. 
  • Contribute to visual benchmarks and technical standards with the Lead VFX Artist and Art Direction.

job.title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms
job.description:
Position Title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms Department: Enterprise Products & Services Corporate Area: PBS Technology Status: Regular, Full time Exempt Manager Title: Director, Product Management

Position Overview

The Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms is responsible for defining, documenting and managing the business requirements for the mbank API layer and the microservices that connect mbank with external media metadata sources, specifically EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry) and IMDb. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and software developers, translating business needs into clear API specifications, integration requirements and acceptance criteria. The Business Analyst III owns the integration backlog, monitors the health and quality of the data exchanged between mbank and its partner services, and supports user acceptance testing and quality efforts. The role requires a strong understanding of media identifiers and metadata, key business processes and drivers, and the short- and long-term strategies and related technologies of the Data Products & Platforms team.

Key responsibilities

will include, but are not limited to: Serves as business owner and subject matter expert for the mbank API and the microservices that integrate mbank with EIDR and IMDb, aligning technical solutions with business strategies across moderate to complex business processes. Gathers, analyzes and documents business, functional and non-functional requirements for API endpoints, data mappings, and microservice workflows, including user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows. Defines and maintains API specifications and integration documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman collections, data dictionaries and mapping documents) in partnership with developers and architects. Manages the integration between mbank and EIDR, including identifier registration, lookup, matching and reconciliation of titles, editions and versions; tracks changes to EIDR schemas, services and registry rules and assesses their impact on mbank. Manages the integration between mbank and IMDb, including data ingestion, field mapping, match logic and refresh cadence; monitors licensing, terms-of-use and usage constraints of the data with Legal and the data owners. Establishes strong, positive relationships with business units, Product Managers and external data providers to identify and document requirements and serves as the point of contact for partner-service questions and issues. Prioritizes business demands; participates in planning and prioritization meetings and maintains a prioritized backlog of enhancements, defect fixes, report requests and other mbank integration work that reflects organizational priorities. Defines data quality rules, validation and exception-handling requirements; monitors API and microservice performance, error rates and data discrepancies, and coordinates root-cause analysis and resolution. Plans and executes user acceptance testing, regression testing and release validation for API and microservice changes; supports deployment, change management and post-release review. Supports data governance and metadata standards by documenting identifier crosswalks, authoritative sources, data lineage and ownership between mbank, EIDR, IMDb and downstream consumers. Collaborates with product and project teams, business partners, IT and security leaders, and often leads planning efforts; manages ambiguity, creates accurate effort estimates, and recognizes the implications of business strategy changes. Develops training materials, process documentation, SOPs and help guides; supports and trains staff and business partners on mbank data and API capabilities. Investigates, resolves and escalates problems, and serves as an escalation point for others. Supports the Scrum Master and acts as a facilitator in all phases of the application lifecycle except development. Requirements for success: 7 years’ related experience, including: Gathering process requirements for IT systems, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria Defining, documenting or testing REST APIs and microservices (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman, JSON/XML payloads) Data migration, integration and governance Developing support materials, including SOPs and Help Guides Tracking risks and changes

Experience

with media or entertainment metadata, identifiers or registries (e.g., EIDR, IMDb, EIDR-based title/edition/version models) preferred Bachelor’s degree in a technology-related field Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA) preferred Skills/Abilities required: Working knowledge of API and microservices architecture, including REST, authentication/authorization, versioning and rate limiting Ability to read and map data models and payloads across systems, and to define match, merge and reconciliation rules Strong understanding of user

experience

and risk management best practices Skilled in business process engineering and information governance Demonstrated knowledge of at least one software development methodology (Agile/Scrum preferred) Demonstrated ability to communicate technical/complex information both verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical audiences Ability to manage relationships with external data providers and registries Possesses a “can-do” style and a demonstrated interest in understanding the business Effective time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and respond to emergency situations effectively Strong leadership skills coupled with a drive to innovate Ability to work well both independently and in a team, establishing and maintaining cooperation, understanding, trust and credibility Ability to function and adapt to new goals, practices, etc. within a dynamic work environment Proactively stays current in requisite skills within job scope, and incorporates knowledge and other feedback into work The base pay range for this position at the beginning of employment is expected to be between $130,000/year to $140,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will also include other elements for eligible employees, including: (i) eligibility for discretionary bonuses; (ii) various insurance options, including medical, dental, vision, hearing, life, accidental death and dismemberment, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance; (iii) identity protection program; (iv) employee assistance program; (v) financial and retirement savings

benefits

including the PBS Retirement Plan 403(b); (vi) paid time off (17 days per year), paid sick time

benefits

(12 days per year), paid parental leave (60 days / 12 weeks ), and paid holidays (12 days per year). Details of these benefit plans will be provided upon request. The application window for this position is expected to close on 11/16/2026. If hired, the employee will be in an “at-will position,” and the Company reserves the right to modify the base hourly rate/salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. in accordance with the EEOC and the Commonwealth of Virginia. job.title: Senior Producer, Metro
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The Metro desk at The Times is seeking a creative, knowledgeable and collaborative Senior Producer for its video journalism. Metro's journalism spans fast-moving breaking news, enterprise and investigations on a range of beats, from politics and education to transportation and criminal justice. We bring the issues of New York and its surrounding tri-state region to readers around the world, with deeply-reported narratives and unexpected tales.

You will bring a passion for news, a commitment to fast, authoritative coverage of breaking and developing stories, and the news judgment to identify enterprise stories and exclusives. An experienced video journalist and a manager, you'll help broaden Metro's coverage in a range of video formats. You are a talented storyteller and strong people manager who is passionate about breaking news, live journalism and enterprise.

Metro is known across the newsroom for its collegial culture. You'll work closely with Metro editors and reporters, and build strong relationships across the newsroom — especially Video and Photo — and partner with Metro leadership to shape and drive coverage. You'll bring an innovative, collaborative approach to motivating and inspiring teams to scale video on the desk and deliver fast-turnaround and ambitious work.

You will oversee everything from live streams and news clips to enterprise projects and Reporter Video, managing a team of video journalists to execute on each of those priorities. Your sharp visual and editorial skills will ensure that the right stories are assigned. Before videos are published onsite and on social media, you will ensure that they meet the editorial standards, style and quality of the Times.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • You will drive innovative, exclusive video coverage across a range of video formats, from short-form live-blog updates to Reporter Videos featuring Times journalists, enterprise stories and columns, and occasional field deployments.

  • You will manage and help hire video journalists on the desk.

  • You will help colleagues assess whether a story is suited to video and whether it should be told primarily or exclusively in that format, and mentor them as they develop their video storytelling skills.

  • You will lead story development and story edits.

job.title: Senior Manager, Workplace Experience

You're the one who notices what's not landing, figures out why, and fixes it before anyone has to ask. Our Senior Manager, Workplace Experience sits at the center of a lot of moving parts: you'll build and iterate on in-office operations and programming, stand up systems that let workplace experience scale across four sites while keeping our human, music-centered touch, plan and run the operational and financial aspects of major office-based events and company offsites, and act as the cross-functional partner between Workplace and IT, Security, Finance, Communications, Music, Brand, and Executive Assistants, to name but a few. job.title: Application Support Analyst (D365 F&O)
job.description:
The Application Support Analyst provides administration, technical and functional support, maintenance, and continuous improvement for enterprise business applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). This role owns the operational processing and validation of financial data within D365 F&O, including billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, to support accuracy, financial integrity, and compliance with applicable requirements.

The Application Support Analyst monitors financial batch jobs, manages application configurations, troubleshoots issues, and supports reliable integrations and workflows across business functions. This position serves as a liaison among business stakeholders, IT, developers, and external vendors to resolve issues, improve application performance, and promote effective system utilization. This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports.

MAIN JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the operational processing and validation of billing, payments, revenue, and expense data within D365 F&O. Monitor and execute scheduled financial batch jobs, validate timely and accurate completion, troubleshoot failures, and resolve or escalate issues to support financial integrity, business deadlines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Serve as the primary contact for application support requests and the primary owner of triaging technical and functional configuration issues across D365 F&O modules and related enterprise applications. Manage incidents through the enterprise ticketing system, investigate root causes, identify recurring issues, and coordinate resolution or escalation of complex application, infrastructure, integration, and code-related problems.

• Configure and maintain application settings, workflows, security roles, user access, and system controls in accordance with approved business requirements and security standards. Coordinate configuration changes across D365 F&O modules and associated upstream and downstream processes to maintain reliable operations and appropriate access.

• Monitor and validate application integrations, interfaces, and related batch jobs to support accurate and reliable data flow. Partner closely with Application Support Engineers, developers, and vendors to maintain, enhance, test, and support custom code, D365 objects, and system integrations.

• Coordinate application upgrades, patches, maintenance, and enhancement deployments to minimize business disruption. Gather requirements, support or lead user acceptance testing, document changes, and assist with implementation and post-deployment stabilization in accordance with IT change management processes.

• Maintain application inventories, architecture diagrams, configuration records, technical specifications, operational runbooks, and knowledge base content. Develop user guides and training materials, and deliver onboarding and ongoing guidance to improve system utilization and adoption of effective practices.

• Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate enhancement requests and identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting, and operational efficiency. Use approved AI tools, low-code platforms, and automation technologies to support documentation, ticket analysis, and process improvements, and collaborate with technical teams to test and validate solutions.

• Coordinate with business units, IT teams, and external vendors to support service continuity, resolve escalations, and manage support needs, licensing compliance, and supported application versions. Prioritize assigned work independently, communicate service impacts and resolution status.

• Other duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field and at least four years of progressive experience supporting enterprise or business-critical applications; or at least six years of relevant progressive experience in lieu of a degree.

• Hands-on experience providing technical and functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including financial processing, application configurations, and scheduled batch jobs.

• Working knowledge of financial workflows involving billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, including related data validation and system controls.

• Experience troubleshooting application issues, managing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and supporting users in a business-critical environment.

• Working knowledge of integrations, APIs, middleware, and interface technologies, including experience investigating data flow issues and coordinating technical resolution.

• Experience creating, maintaining, or supporting reports using Power BI, SQL, or equivalent reporting tools.

• Experience using enterprise ticketing systems, such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk, to document, prioritize, resolve, and escalate support requests.

• Experience supporting application configuration, user access, security roles, workflows, testing, and change management activities.

• Strong documentation, organization, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, IT teams, and vendors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supporting multiple D365 F&O modules and their upstream and downstream integrations.

• Experience partnering with developers to support custom D365 code, objects, extensions, and integrations.

• Experience with middleware, automation, or integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or comparable iPaaS solutions.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, approved AI tools, or other low-code technologies used for workflow automation and operational improvements.

• Experience supporting media, publishing, manufacturing, or multi-entity business environments.

• Familiarity with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace.

• Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, or ITIL service management practices.

• Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or ITIL certification.

job.title: Commercial Sales Manager, FT Live Fixed Income Events
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

FT Live is the global events division of the Financial Times, delivering over 200 conferences, forums and virtual events annually. Our Fixed Income Events business brings together senior decision-makers from across the global debt capital markets through a portfolio of leading bond and structured finance conferences, including the CEE Forum, Borrowers & Bond Investors Forum and Covered Bonds Congress.

We are looking for a motivated and commercially driven Commercial Sales Manager to accelerate revenue growth across our bond market events portfolio.

In this role, you will identify and develop new sponsorship opportunities. You will grow existing commercial partnerships and establish long-term connections with senior decision-makers in the international debt capital market sector.    

You will play an important role in shaping the next phase of growth for this established portfolio, combining proactive new business development with strategic account management and consultative selling.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced B2B sales professional who enjoys forming relationships, exceeding commercial targets and working with influential global organisations.

Key responsibilities

  • Identify, pitch and secure new sponsorship and commercial partnership opportunities across the FT Live bond events portfolio.

  • Proactively lead, develop and grow existing accounts, including global investment banks, law firms, asset managers and other financial services providers.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers, finding opportunities to deliver long-term commercial value.

  • Lead client meetings, both in person and virtually, developing tailored sponsorship proposals and negotiating commercial agreements.

  • Collaborate closely with FT Live's content, marketing and operations teams to deliver high-quality sponsor experiences and measurable partner value.

  • Work with colleagues across FT Live's global business to deliver impactful sponsor activations and support year-round client engagement.

  • Attend relevant industry events and FT Live conferences to strengthen relationships, develop market knowledge and identify new commercial opportunities.

  • Monitor industry trends, emerging themes and competitor activity to inform commercial strategy and find opportunities for portfolio growth.

Required skills and experience

  • A demonstrated ability in commercial B2B events, media or sponsorship sales.

  • A consistent track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets, with experience running complex sales cycles and closing high-value commercial agreements.

  • Strong consultative selling and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior partners.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills, coupled with the capacity to develop compelling commercial proposals.  

  • A proactive approach to business development, with the confidence to find opportunities and build new client relationships.  

  • Strong organisational skills, capable of running multiple accounts, prioritising contending deadlines and performing effectively in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform to run sales activity, opportunities and client relationships.

Desirable

  • A general understanding of capital markets, alongside an interest in developing deeper knowledge of the global bond market.

  • Previous experience working with financial services clients, particularly investment banks, private credit managers or legal advisers.

  • Experience collaborating across international teams or within a matrixed organisation.

  • An ambitious approach, with a passion for commercial growth, accountability and ownership.

  • The ability to combine critical thinking with hands-on execution to deliver commercial results.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Burson faz parte da WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), a empresa de transformação criativa. Para mais informações, visite bursonglobal.com e siga-nos no LinkedIn e Instagram.

job.title: Manager, Client Media Solutions
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. Our teams bring together media, omnichannel strategy, analytics, CRM, creative, influencer, technology, and client services capabilities to create connected customer experiences that drive business results across the healthcare ecosystem. 

The Manager, Client Media Solutions serves as a day-to-day leader responsible for the successful planning, execution, and stewardship of integrated media programs for pharma and life sciences clients. This role combines strong media planning fundamentals, financial and operational rigor, client partnership, and project leadership to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and aligned to client objectives. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own media plans, flowcharts, budget summaries, project trackers, timelines, and workflow documentation across assigned accounts and brands. 
  • Execute and manage campaign work orders, service requests, deliverable rotations, approvals, and project timelines from planning through launch. 
  • Support the development of integrated media recommendations by conducting research, gathering marketplace intelligence, evaluating vendor opportunities, and managing RFP processes. 
  • Collaborate with media partners and vendors to identify direct-buy opportunities and negotiate recommendations with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Monitor campaign pacing, budget performance, and financial health, proactively identifying variances and partnering with Business Operations on invoicing, reconciliation, and reporting. 
  • Serve as a day-to-day client contact, providing project updates, meeting recaps, and ongoing communication across internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Lead campaign stewardship efforts, ensuring plans are executed accurately and align with approved client objectives and budgets. 
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Analytics, Omnichannel Strategy, Activation, Creative, Influencer, CRM, and Client Services teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
  • Translate strategic direction from senior team members into accurate, high-quality deliverables and actionable recommendations. 
  • Support the development of junior team members by reviewing work, providing feedback, and helping ensure quality and process adherence. 

 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If 

  • Our values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I" genuinely reflect how you work and collaborate. 
  • You are equally comfortable discussing campaign strategy, managing details, and ensuring flawless execution. 
  • You enjoy owning projects from start to finish and can effectively balance multiple priorities across brands and clients. 
  • You are naturally organized and thrive in environments that require strong attention to detail, budget management, and project coordination. 
  • You are a proactive problem solver who can independently navigate day-to-day challenges while escalating larger strategic or commercial decisions appropriately. 
  • You enjoy building relationships with clients, partners, and cross-functional teams and are viewed as a dependable, solutions-oriented contributor. 
  • You can communicate clearly and confidently, tailoring information appropriately for internal and external audiences. 
  • You embrace new technologies, data, and AI-enabled tools that help improve planning, collaboration, and performance. 

 

What You Should Have 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • 3-5 years of experience in media planning, media account management, client services, integrated marketing, or agency environments. 
  • Experience managing media plans, budgets, timelines, and campaign documentation across multiple stakeholders and workstreams. 
  • Strong understanding of digital media channels, including programmatic, social, search, endemic, and other paid media tactics. 
  • Experience partnering with media vendors and supporting RFP, proposal evaluation, and recommendation development processes. 
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience managing budgets, pacing, invoicing, reconciliations, and reporting. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight. 
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. 
  • Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and media planning tools such as Prisma, Mediaocean, Comscore, Pathmatics, Kantar, Telmar, or similar platforms. 
  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences marketing experience is preferred. 
  • Experience mentoring junior team members or interns is a plus. 

 

Pay Range: $60,000-$80,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. We are working to stop these unauthorized activities and protect our community. Read more here.

job.description:

Overview:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff
  • Serve as a primary audit contact for assigned business and technology functions, developing trusted relationships and providing risk-based insights to management and executive teams
  • Perform special assignments, including business process reviews, due diligence activities, investigations, and strategic risk assessments, as directed by the Vice President of Internal Audit
  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities
  • Stay informed on emerging risks and trends in cybersecurity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, media technology, privacy regulations, and technology governance
  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization
  • Some domestic travel may be required

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive audit experience, including 2+ years of leadership experience in IT audit/accounting 
  • Experience within a top public accounting company, consulting organization, or internal audit function of a large public company preferred
  • Prior IT consulting, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technical operational experience is a plus
  • BS or MS in Information Systems, Accounting, Information Systems Auditing, Computer Science, or a related field required
  • Ability to work successfully with senior business and technology leaders and establish credibility across all levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated team management capabilities, with a track record of developing high-performing audit teams
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex engagements simultaneously
  • Ability to understand the Company’s operational and technology environment, business objectives, key processes, and associated risks
  • Advanced knowledge of IT governance, cybersecurity, cloud security controls, infrastructure operations, application development and support, data privacy, and technology risk management practices
  • Experience applying IT and information security frameworks (e.g., NIST, SOX, COBIT) to audit testing and risk assessments
  • Strong comprehension of system development and implementation lifecycle methodologies and related controls
  • Experience auditing automated environments, enterprise applications, cloud technologies, and complex global security and compliance functions
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, and drive successful outcomes in a matrixed organization through collaboration rather than direct authority
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, audit management tools, Microsoft Office applications, and collaboration platforms
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences
  • Sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to think strategically and creatively

  • Experience with Oracle and/or SAP environments preferred

job.title: Digital Journalist - Global News Edmonton
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Global Edmonton - News Gathering

Work Status: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: Edmonton, AB (On-site)

About the Role

Global Edmonton’s News Department is seeking two permanent, full-time Digital Journalists to join its News Gathering team.

This is an on-site, multiplatform journalism role that requires candidates to report, write, shoot, edit and produce content for television and digital platforms.

Candidates must be available to work a variety of shifts, including early mornings, days, evenings and permanent weekends.

This is a Group H position in accordance with the current collective agreement.

You Will Contribute By

The following represents the primary responsibilities of the role but does not include all duties that may be assigned:

• Research, develop and produce original, enterprising news stories and guest ideas.

• Report, shoot, write and edit stories for multiple daily newscasts and globalnews.ca.

• Write clear, compelling news content for television and digital platforms.

• Produce and line up dynamic newscasts, creating strong content for both live and server-based shows.

• Produce local news content using video gathered in the field, as well as affiliate, national and international material.

• Report live on location and in studio as required.

• Meet multiple daily deadlines to write, publish, promote, update and curate local, regional and national content for globalnews.ca.

• Respond quickly and effectively to breaking news and evolving stories.

• Collaborate with the Edmonton newsroom, local radio newsroom, Resources Desk, National News Desk and Online teams to coordinate coverage.

• Use production graphics and other visual elements creatively to enhance storytelling.

• Participate in editorial and assignment meetings and contribute ideas for daily and future coverage.

• Be a strong advocate, role model and mentor for digital journalism and a video-first workflow.

• Work collaboratively with colleagues based in Lethbridge and Calgary.

• Participate in Global Edmonton promotional and community initiatives.

• Perform other duties as required.

Skills and Experience You Will Bring

The successful candidates will have:

• A degree or diploma in journalism from a recognized post-secondary institution.

• A minimum of one year of reporting experience, with demonstrated on-air presentation skills, including live remotes and unscripted material.

• Proven video shooting and editing experience.

• Strong writing skills for both broadcast and digital platforms, supported by excellent traditional and online research skills.

• Sound editorial judgment and the confidence to make timely editorial decisions.

• The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal and organizational skills.

• The ability to make quick, effective decisions under pressure and manage competing deadlines.

• A willingness and ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies, platforms and newsroom workflows.

• A valid driver’s license with a clear driver’s abstract.

When applying, please include a portfolio or examples of your work, such as demo reels, reporting clips, video samples, or links to published broadcast and/or digital content. Applications that do not include relevant work samples will not be considered.

Application Deadline: November 23, 2026

job.title: Vice President of Donor Engagement
job.description:
Description

 Join a company that truly impacts others!


Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope.

Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. 

We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! 


Summary: 

The Vice President, Donor Engagement provides leadership for Hope Media Group's entire donor engagement and fundraising strategy, ensuring an integrated donor journey from acquisition through transformational giving. The VP leads the strategy and performance of donor care, donor communications, mid-level giving, major and catalyst donor engagement, and other donor-facing initiatives, with accountability for donor retention, revenue growth, stewardship, and long-term donor value. As a senior leader within Donor Engagement, this role develops leaders, drives cross-functional alignment, uses data and analytics to inform investment and strategy, and partners with the Chief of Donor Engagement and organizational leadership to advance HMG's ministry and revenue objectives.  

 

Essential Functions

Strategic Direction: 

  • Develop and lead HMG's comprehensive donor engagement strategy, establishing the vision, priorities, goals, and measures of success for donor acquisition, cultivation, retention, stewardship, and growth across the donor lifecycle. 
  • Use data and analytics to evaluate donor behavior, fundraising performance, and engagement trends, informing strategies across the donor lifecycle and identifying opportunities for growth, retention, and increased donor value. 
  • Establish and maintain clear donor pathways that move individuals from initial engagement through mid-level, major, and catalyst giving. 
  • Provide strategic leadership and input into fundraising campaigns and initiatives that generate resources to expand ministry impact. 
  • Collaborate with ministry and organizational leaders to ensure a cohesive, integrated donor journey across HMG brands and platforms. 
  • Establish key performance indicators and regularly evaluate progress toward donor engagement, retention, and revenue objectives. 

Organizational & Executive Leadership: 

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief of Donor Engagement in establishing fundraising priorities, revenue strategies, and long-term donor engagement goals.
    • Translate organizational strategy into clear priorities and measurable objectives across Donor Engagement teams.
    • Partner with senior leaders across HMG to align donor strategy with programming, marketing, digital, finance, data, and ministry initiatives.
    • Provide executive-level insight into donor trends, fundraising performance, opportunities, and risks.
    • Represent Donor Engagement in organizational planning and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team, equipping directors and managers to effectively lead their functions and teams. 
  • Ensure alignment, accountability, and effective decision-making across Donor Engagement functions while empowering leaders to execute within their areas of responsibility. 

Donor Engagement & Program Oversight 

  • Provide strategic oversight of HMG's donor engagement programs, ensuring alignment and effectiveness across donor care, communications, mid-level, major, catalyst, events, and other donor-facing initiatives. 
  • Oversee the mid-level donor advisor program, ensuring effective portfolio strategy, donor cultivation, stewardship, and pathways to major giving. 
  • Lead Donor Communications strategy, including collaboration with fundraising consultants, ensuring cohesive multi-channel stewardship and solicitation across print, digital, on-air, and other donor touchpoints. 
  • Provide strategic oversight to Donor Care, ensuring donors receive responsive, compassionate, and effective support. 
  • Guide strategies that strengthen donor acquisition, retention, engagement, stewardship, and long-term donor value. 
  • Ensure alignment between fundraising leadership and HMG's overall donor engagement strategy. 

Department Operations & Performance: 

  • Ensure Donor Engagement has effective systems, processes, tools, and resources necessary to achieve departmental objectives. 
  • Establish expectations for operational excellence, accountability, documentation, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration across Donor Engagement. 
  • Identify organizational or departmental barriers to effectiveness and partner with Donor Engagement leaders and cross-functional teams to implement solutions. 
  • Provide executive oversight of key departmental projects and initiatives, ensuring appropriate ownership, prioritization, and accountability. 
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, and other organizational functions to ensure Donor Engagement leaders and teams have the resources and support necessary to achieve fundraising and donor engagement objectives. 

Budget Management:

  • Partner with the Chief of Donor Engagement and Finance to develop annual departmental budgets, fundraising revenue goals, and forecasts. 
  • Regularly evaluate departmental spending and fundraising performance against budget and forecast, identifying risks, opportunities, and necessary adjustments. 
  • Ensure departmental resources are strategically allocated toward initiatives that advance donor engagement and fundraising objectives. 
  • Provide FP&A monthly input to accurately forecast costs and revenue. 
  • Ensure departmental spending complies with HMG financial, credit card, travel, and purchasing policies. 

 Demonstrated Faith: 

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ 
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate 
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies 
  • Live Christian principles defined by the Ministry Statement of Faith 
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed 
  • Passion for leveraging the platform of radio for evangelism and discipleship 
  • Exhibit a strong moral character 
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church 

Requirements

 Non-Essential Functions:

  • Perform other duties as requested 

Requirements and Qualifications: 

Education: 

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred 

Experience: 

  • 7–10 years nonprofit fundraising, donor engagement, or donor communications experience.  
  • Demonstrated success in donor program design and execution, including mass, mid, and major stewardship programs.   
  • Experience managing and coaching diverse teams.  
  • Familiarity with direct mail, digital campaigns, and donor care strategies 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

  • Heart for Christian ministry.  
  • Strong moral character and personal relationship with Jesus Christ.  
  • Strategic thinker with ability to use data for decision-making.  
  • Skilled communicator with ability to build rapport and inspire trust.  
  • Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.  
  • Ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams.  
  • Knowledge of donor databases, fundraising systems, and Microsoft Office Suite. 

Supervisory Responsibilities: :

  • Immediate supervision over a unit, section, or department. Recommends candidates for hiring, termination; prepares and conducts performance appraisals and salary reviews and applies company policies. 

Working Conditions and Environment 

Travel: 

  • Occasional overnight travel required for donor meetings, events, and organizational gatherings 

Nights/Weekends/Holidays: 

  • May be required occasionally for donor events or fundraisers 

Physical Requirements 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers including pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than the whole hand as in handling.  

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work. 

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. 


 Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains 

Third-Party Recruiter Policy: We are grateful for the interest of those who wish to support our hiring efforts. However, Hope Media Group does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from external staffing agencies or search firms. Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

Multi-Media Account Executive

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Augusta/Waterville stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a key member of our Augusta sales team, you’ll take full ownership of building and managing a book of business. You’ll focus on bringing in new clients while maintaining long-term relationships with existing accounts. This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships
  • Cross-sell and upsell to expand your clients’ reach and ROI
  • Partner with internal teams and collaborate on campaign execution and strategy
  • Work directly with your Market Leadership to meet and exceed individual and team goals

This is a consultative sales position where success is defined by your ability to build trust, deliver results, and help local businesses thrive.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales goal
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and securing new business
  • Strong work ethic, drive, and competitiveness
  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)

Every now and then a great opportunity presents itself, that time is now, for you, at Townsquare Media in Bangor.  At Townsquare, we are a team of driven individuals who push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally.  We have a current opening which includes an existing book of business that requires a strong marketing professional.  You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and above average pay. 

We have a rare opening for the right person to bring our best-in-class marketing solutions to local businesses in eastern and central Maine. We’re the number one local media company in each of the markets we serve. Our top-rated radio stations, our market exclusive digital media solutions and our exciting live events are a winning combination for you, and our customers.

job.title: Content Operations Specialist
job.description:
Content Operations Specialist

Overall Responsibilities

The Content Operations Specialist is responsible for managing and ensuring the technical and broadcast quality of all inbound and outbound content feeds, including video and audio signals, for live and recorded programming at Weather Group Television (WGT). This role combines responsibilities from media acquisitions and master control operations and longform content preparation for Entertainment Studios eight digital channels. As this position supports a 24x7 news/weather environment, candidates must have flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed and without advance notice.

Specific Responsibilities

ESN - Network Content Operations

  • Review the next day’s list of “barter shows” and editing requirements.

  • Edit barter show segments for two channels, match file titles, segment lengths, and proper transmission standards.  

  • Make necessary adjustments and verify all file segments for final delivery and playback.

  • Review playlists and associated content for missing segments or other incomplete assets

  • Purge older content files, per policy and procedures.

  • Verify all assets for all channels' playlists are correct and ready for playback

  • Verify timing for all playlists for the current day/weekend days.  

  • Communicate playlist or file issues to the appropriate internal or external partner and work toward a solution prior to air time. 

  • Process dub list for promotional/commercial assets

  • Upload/download files to/from the assigned storage repository (local or cloud)

WGT - MEDIA ACQUISITIONS

  • Ensure broadcast quality of all inbound/outbound video and audio feeds using scopes, analyzers, and level monitoring equipment.

  • Monitor multiple networks for high-standard quality control and report technical issues to appropriate departments.

  • Operate video/audio/L-Band routers, route remote feeds, and perform corrective actions to maintain broadcast signal integrity.

  • Manage content acquisition platforms, including LiveU, Dejero, TVU, LTN, and The Switch.

  • Use newsroom content systems to manage recordings and elements for live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate remote resources (IRDs, encoders, and format converters), adjusting levels and troubleshooting in real time.

  • Operate playout automation across networks to edit, load, and update playlists for live programming.

  • Perform daily checks on critical broadcast gear to maintain industry standards and proactively resolve system issues.

  • Utilize technical software tools, including FTP clients, satellite/scheduling software, MAM, MS Office, and Google Workspace.

TWC - MASTER CONTROL OPERATION

  • Responsible for editing, loading, and monitoring The Weather Channel (TWC) playlist using the automation systems.  

  • Work with Editorial and Programming teams to alter the playlist, within approved guidelines to maintain operational “on-air” continuity. 

  • Monitor multiple TWC feeds (uplinks, downlinks, STAR feeds, etc.) and those of other Allen Media & Entertainment Studios networks. 

  •  Provide Tier 1 technical support to internal technical teams by reporting/requesting Engineering  / IT assistance.   

  • Work closely with Engineering on any signal issues, alarms, or technical issues related to monitored network feeds. 

  • Perform operational checks, monitor video/audio quality, and proactively resolve system defects or failures.

  • Maintain shift logs, outage notifications, service request forms, and operational documentation.

  • Communicate status updates and repair workflows with management, engineering teams, and MCR clients.

  • Participate in technical training and adapt to changing operational demands.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Broadcasting, Communications, a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in news environments, teleport operations, cable, or national broadcast environments.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate professionally with multiple internal technical teams and external vendors. 

  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills, with the ability to manage time effectively and operational resources in a dynamic, 24/7 environment with critical deadlines.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of satellite news gathering (SNG) processes, digital satellite equipment, waveform and vector scopes, and spectrum analyzers.

  • Understanding of broadcast automation systems and how to monitor signal workflow for troubleshooting

  • Experience understanding file formats, including codecs, wrappers, and technical specs

  • Proficiency in HDTV, SDI, ASI, and IP formats, as well as conversion technologies

  • Experience with electronic news/field gathering, teleport, and satellite truck operations, including ingest operations, is desired.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to respond quickly to technical issues and implement solutions under operational constraints.

  • Ability to interact effectively and collaboratively across departments and with management, maintaining professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Sensitivity to the unique needs and challenges of a 24/7 operation, ensuring operational continuity and quality.

  • Ability to work in a project and live broadcast environment simultaneously

  • Basic understanding of closed captions, including formats and regulations.

Behavior Requirements

  • Unquestionably high ethical standards

  • Customer-focused and team player mentality

  • Flexible and adaptable attitude in an ever-changing environment

  • Ability to get along well with others, willing and able to deal with a diverse cultural & customer base in numerous types of challenging situations

  • Willingness to work in a team environment or on individual projects on an as-needed basis

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift and move equipment as required
