As Lead Tools Programmer, you are responsible for defining, building, and guiding tools and workflows that empower content creators and developers across the project. This role spans in‑engine tooling, standalone desktop applications, and optional web‑enabled tools, enabling efficient production at scale on an AAA title. You provide technical leadership for tools architecture while collaborating closely with Design, Art, Production, and Engineering to ensure tools are robust, scalable, and production‑ready.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Lead the design and implementation of tools supporting content creation, iteration, validation, and debugging.
  • Define and maintain tools architecture spanning Unreal Engine editor tools and standalone applications.
  • Design and oversee standalone desktop tools using frameworks such as Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI, or similar cross‑platform solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for tools written in C++, with supporting layers in Python or C# where appropriate.
  • Act as the primary technical partner for artists, designers, and developers, translating workflow needs into effective tools.
  • Mentor and support tools programmers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best‑practice development.
  • Collaborate with Pipeline, Gameplay, UI, and Production teams to integrate tools into daily workflows.
  • Oversee performance, stability, usability, and maintainability of tools used across disciplines.
  • Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and testing strategies for tools development.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and drive improvements through tooling, automation, and data‑driven solutions.
  • Guide the evolution of tools toward extensibility, cross‑project reuse, and long‑term scalability.
  • Debug complex tools issues involving engine integration, file I/O, data pipelines, and external services.
  • Stay current with industry trends in tools development, automation, and developer experience.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

À titre de Programmeur ou programmeuse outils Lead, vous êtes responsable de définir, développer et orienter les outils et les flux de travail qui permettent aux créateurs et créatrices de contenu ainsi qu’aux équipes de développement de travailler efficacement à l’échelle du projet. Ce rôle couvre les outils intégrés au moteur, les applications de bureau autonomes et, au besoin, les outils connectés au web, afin de soutenir une production AAA efficace à grande échelle. Vous assurez le leadership technique de l’architecture des outils tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Design, Art, Production et Ingénierie afin de garantir que les outils sont robustes, évolutifs et prêts pour la production.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Diriger la conception et l’implantation d’outils soutenant la création de contenu, l’itération, la validation et le débogage.
  • Définir et maintenir l’architecture des outils couvrant les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et les applications autonomes.
  • Concevoir et superviser des outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de frameworks tels que Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI ou d’autres solutions multiplateformes comparables.
  • Fournir un leadership technique pour les outils développés en C++, avec des couches complémentaires en Python ou en C# lorsque pertinent.
  • Agir comme principal partenaire technique des artistes, des concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que des développeurs et développeuses, en traduisant les besoins liés aux flux de travail en outils efficaces.
  • Encadrer et soutenir les programmeurs et programmeuses outils grâce aux revues de code, à l’orientation technique et aux pratiques exemplaires de développement.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Pipeline, Gameplay, UI et Production afin d’intégrer les outils aux flux de travail quotidiens.
  • Superviser la performance, la stabilité, la convivialité et la maintenabilité des outils utilisés par les différentes disciplines.
  • Établir les normes de codage, les pratiques de documentation et les stratégies de test pour le développement d’outils.
  • Identifier les goulots d’étranglement dans les flux de travail et piloter les améliorations au moyen d’outils, d’automatisation et de solutions fondées sur les données.
  • Orienter l’évolution des outils vers une plus grande extensibilité, la réutilisation entre projets et une évolutivité à long terme.
  • Déboguer des problèmes complexes liés aux outils, notamment l’intégration moteur, les entrées-sorties de fichiers, les pipelines de données et les services externes.
  • Se tenir à jour quant aux tendances de l’industrie en matière de développement d’outils, d’automatisation et d’expérience des développeurs et développeuses.

Basic Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in C++, with extensive experience developing tools or editor‑focused systems.
  • At least 8+ years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped titles or equivalent AAA production experience.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine editor tooling and engine integration.
  • Strong understanding of tools architecture, data‑driven systems, and content creation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or technically guiding programmers on a production team.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to design robust systems under production constraints.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Perforce or Git.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience building standalone desktop tools using Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms), or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python for tooling, automation, and glue code.
  • Familiarity with web‑enabled tools using technologies such as REST APIs, Electron, or lightweight web dashboards.
  • Strong empathy for end‑users and a focus on usability and iteration speed.
  • A passion for enabling teams through high‑quality tools and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base :

  • Solide maîtrise du C++, avec une vaste expérience dans le développement d’outils ou de systèmes axés sur les éditeurs.
  • Au moins 8 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux vidéo, avec des titres commercialisés ou une expérience équivalente dans des productions AAA.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et leur intégration au moteur.
  • Solide compréhension de l’architecture des outils, des systèmes pilotés par les données et des flux de création de contenu.
  • Expérience démontrée de leadership, de mentorat ou d’accompagnement technique de programmeurs et programmeuses au sein d’une équipe de production.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de résolution de problèmes et capacité à concevoir des systèmes robustes dans un contexte de contraintes de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec diverses disciplines.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de versions tels que Perforce ou Git.

Atouts souhaités :

  • Expérience dans le développement d’outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms) ou de frameworks comparables.
  • Expérience avec des langages de script tels que Python pour les outils, l’automatisation et le code d’intégration.
  • Connaissance des outils connectés au web utilisant des technologies telles que les API REST, Electron ou des tableaux de bord web légers.
  • Forte sensibilité aux besoins des utilisateurs et utilisatrices et souci de la convivialité ainsi que de la rapidité d’itération.
  • Passion pour soutenir les équipes grâce à des outils et des flux de travail de grande qualité.

NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • NBC News Mobile App Development: The team is responsible for designing, developing and testing NBC News’s flagship Android/iOS applications. The intern will be working on native mobile applications across all the NBC News brands and collaborate with developers, product and project management in shipping out features. The intern will be mentored by senior developers in the team and will be guided in their work. The intern will be working on various team initiatives following engineering best practices and writing quality code.
  • NBC News Digital, Software Engineering: As a Software Engineer Intern, you will partner with the Product, Operations, Design, and Editorial teams to bring NBC News Digital content to life. You will be a significant influence on our product roadmap, bringing a technical and strategic perspective. You will work alongside fellow inspired developers in a fast-paced environment using technologies like Sass, React.js and GraphQL to help shape the future of digital news.

 

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Global Video Engineering, Video-On-Demand SRE: The Jupiter SRE Team is a SRE Team that is embedded as part of the Video on Demand (VOD) team in the Global Video Engineering Group. The VOD team is a mix of software engineers and video engineers, that define and maintain the VOD workflow (The Path a piece of content follows to get on to the streaming Platform).  The SRE Team is responsible for deploying and maintaining availability of all Infrastructure and applications that are part of this workflow. Currently the VOD team uses a mixture of vendor and in house-built applications to implement this workflow. However, we are in the middle of an exciting transition bringing many of these workflows in-house and therefore this internship is an exciting opportunity to get real world exposure to all the work necessary to get content ready for streaming.
  • Global Delivery, Quality Engineering: Our Global Quality Engineering Team is responsible for broad scale of quality by testing integrated systems and the client applications focused on delivering flawless experience for our customers. Our teams analyse requirements, create test plans and perform feature testing for Peacock & all of its propositions which includes backend integration of components and application front end across all the major device platforms. Our goal is to educate the interns on Software Development Life Cycle and importance of Software Quality Assurance.
  • Video-On-Demand Engineering, Workflows: The VOD Engineering team is hiring a summer intern to join the VOD Workflows team, which builds and supports the automated media pipeline that delivers video-on-demand (VOD) content to NBCUniversal’s streaming platforms. The intern will work with engineers on business-critical video workflows and cloud services. They will gain exposure to how the team troubleshoots VOD workflows and playback and configures encoding for video, audio, and subtitles across platforms. Day to day, the work is scoped and guided: contributing to the pipeline, learning how media-processing and cloud delivery systems are operated, and helping improve them.

These are the paths viewers hit when they watch a live game, press play, and see an ad. The work is user-facing and revenue-critical, and it has to stay up while millions of people are watching at once. Play covers playback, and the services that get a stream to the device. DAI covers ad decisioning and inserting ads into live and on-demand video. An intern will work with engineers who ship code and operate what they ship. They see how a live event is prepared and run, how an ad decision becomes a break in the stream, and how playback failures show up in metrics, logs, and traces. They will contribute to real systems with a focus on improving reliability, performance, observability, and automation that removes repetitive operational work.
  • Global Streaming Tech, Live Play & DAI: Our Backend Video Engineering team builds and maintains the technology that powers video content and advertising delivery across NBCUniversal’s digital platforms. The team develops scalable backend services and APIs using Go (Golang), helping ensure reliable and efficient video experiences for audiences. job.title: Sr DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.


Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 

You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

 

What you will do: 

  • Develop and maintain a platform (applications, integrations and infrastructure) supporting gaming department

  • Partner closely with software architects, game developers, QA, and operations to remove bottlenecks and improve delivery 

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Is fully self‑reliant and can take responsibility for future deliverables, 

  • Value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contributing to the team's overall effectiveness,  

  • Equally enjoys coding applications and managing infrastructure 

  • Keep up to date with modern web technologies,   

  • Want to actively participate in decision making and fully understand products they work on,   

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Very good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Proficient in coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#) 

  • Experienced in code collaboration and proficient in Git, 

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Deep knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience in code collaboration using Perforce 

  

We keep our technologies up-to-date, and have a major impact on the tool set: 

  • CI/CD & Automation: Horde, Jenkins, ArgoCD 

  • Infrastructure & Platform: OCI, Terraform, Ansible 

  • Containers & Virtualization: Kubernetes, Podman, Proxmox, KVM 

  • Observability & Reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic 

  • Game Development: Unreal Engine 

  • Source Control Management: Perforce, Git 

  • Operating Systems: Linux, Windows 

 

We offer: 

  • Employment contract, 

  • Multisport card + private medical care, 

  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products,

  • Access to e-learning and self-development platforms, 

  • Office library, 

  • English and Polish language lessons, 

  • We participate in and speak at conferences, also join/ run public meet-ups, 

  • In-house activities: tech talks, hackathons, 

  • You can use 10% of your working time to pursue your personal development, and side projects, 

  • Active global inclusion and CSR groups, 

  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more,

  • Well located, modern office with lots of amenities – adjustable desks, electronics toolkit, 3D printer ready for you to use, pool table, console, table tennis, massage chair.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Consumer Platform Engineering owns the API layer that sits between Paramount's client apps (Web, iOS, Android, Roku, CTV, Apple TV, Fire TV, and more) and the downstream content, identity, and commerce systems that power them. The org is organized into three domains — Identity & Commerce, Experiences, and Discovery. Discovery domain engineers build and operate the backend services powering content discovery across search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata. Our systems focus on helping viewers discover content at scale—delivering low-latency, high-concurrency services across millions of devices ranging from legacy TVs to modern streaming boxes. 

 

Role Summary 

We are hiring a Lead Engineer to be the senior technical anchor for a team of backend engineers building the services that power content discovery across Pluto TV and Paramount+. You will drive architecture and design for the domain's most complex initiatives, set the technical bar through hands-on coding and code/design review, and mentor engineers — while partnering with your Engineering Manager, Product, Data Science & Personalization, and adjacent platform domains to ship performant services that drive viewer engagement. 

 

This is a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through technical depth and influence, not through formal people-management authority. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture 

    • Drive the architecture and design for the domain's backend services and APIs (search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata), balancing feature delivery against platform health, scalability, and technical debt.

    • Serve as the hands-on technical authority in design reviews — making the call on service boundaries, caching strategies, and data models for high-throughput systems, and staying close enough to the code to lead by example. 

    • Break large-scale architectural initiatives (such as personalization engine overhauls and new recommendation surfaces) into shippable, measurable phases, and personally lead delivery of the highest-complexity or highest-risk pieces. 

    • Set and uphold engineering standards for the team: code quality, testing practices, API design conventions, and documentation. 

  • Operational Ownership 

    • Ensure backend services meet availability, low-latency, and high-concurrency targets for APIs consumed across Pluto TV and Paramount+ client apps. 

    • Lead on-call engineering practices, incident response, and postmortems for the team's services; be the senior escalation point for the most complex production issues. 

    • Define, track, and optimize operational KPIs (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, and API adoption), and drive the technical investments needed to keep them healthy.

  • Cross-functional Partnership

    • Partner with Product Management and the Data Science & Personalization teams as the technical voice for the domain, translating engagement goals into concrete technical designs. 

    • Represent the team in cross-functional and cross-domain technical discussions with Identity & Commerce and Experiences, ensuring backend APIs integrate cleanly with entitlement, playback, and UI client layers. 

    • Communicate technical trade-offs, design decisions, and risks clearly to your Engineering Manager, peer leads, and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Technical Mentorship & Team Enablement

    • Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code review, design pairing, and hands-on guidance — raising the technical level of the team over time.

    • Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical aspects of hiring (interviewing, technical bar-raising) and onboarding new engineers. 

    • Foster a culture of technical ownership and operational accountability, giving engineers context and room to drive their own implementation decisions. Support coordination with distributed or offshore engineering partners on technical execution and design alignment. 

  • Process & Delivery 

    • Contribute to and help run agile workflows (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives), with a focus on technical sequencing and de-risking dependencies. Own comprehensive documentation for system architecture, API contracts, domain data models, and operational runbooks. 

 

Basic Qualifications and Experience 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a solid track record as a senior hands-on contributor on backend and distributed systems in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another high-traffic consumer platform. Demonstrated experience owning the design and delivery of high-concurrency APIs or platforms consumed at scale across heterogeneous client surfaces (web, mobile, legacy TVs, and modern streaming devices). Deep familiarity with core discovery domains: search indexing, recommendation pipelines, content metadata, or ranking systems. 

  • Technical Acumen - - - - Deep, current, hands-on expertise in distributed systems, API design, caching strategies, and data modeling for high-throughput, low-latency services. Ability to serve as the technical tie-breaker in architecture reviews — evaluating system trade-offs, service boundaries, and design choices under ambiguity, and defending decisions with data. Hands-on expertise with Java-based backend services, cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), and modern CI/CD practices. Proven experience operating services under strict SLAs, leveraging metrics (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, A/B test data) to guide technical and operational decisions. 

  • Leadership & Collaboration - - - - Track record of mentoring and raising the bar for engineers through code review, design guidance, and pairing — without formal management authority. Strong communicator who bridges technical and non-technical partners — translating product visions into scoped, actionable technical designs. Skilled at navigating competing priorities across cross-functional groups, including Product Management, Data Science & Personalization, and adjacent platform teams. Comfortable working alongside geographically distributed engineering teams across time zones, including partner or offshore engineering teams. 

  • Mindset - - - Strong bias toward incremental, measurable delivery over big-bang system launches. Genuine curiosity about how content discovery and personalization drive viewer engagement — you care as much about the "why" (watch time, engagement) as the "how" (systems, APIs). Proactive ownership mindset toward operational health and system reliability, building resilient production services rather than just reacting to incidents. 

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with recommendation systems, ML-adjacent infrastructure, or search technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch, Solr). 

  • Prior experience in multi-brand or multi-app streaming platforms (AVOD, SVOD, FAST).

  • Experience working alongside vendor and offshore engineering resources on technical delivery.

Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Saint Louis, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Saint Louis's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

This is a department-wide sales support position and is not dedicated exclusively to individual Account Executives. Responsibilities and priorities may shift based on the operational, Account Manager, sales and leadership needs of the department.
  The position will support sales leadership, assist Account Executives as needed, provide backup Account Manager coverage, and develop knowledge of KWES's broadcast, streaming and digital sales solutions. This role is also designed to provide professional development and exposure that may prepare a successful employee for a future Account Executive opportunity as business needs and openings arise.
Four Core Areas of Responsibility
1. Director of Sales & Department Support
Serve as a primary support resource to the Director of Sales and overall
KWES sales organization.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist the DOS with sales reports, presentations, meeting preparation
and follow-up. • Support preparation for weekly sales meetings, revenue discussions
and sales initiatives.
• Assist with revenue, inventory and sales activity reporting.
• Maintain current sales materials, programming information,
sponsorship opportunities and other department resources.
• Track department deadlines, outstanding items and projects requiring
follow-up.
• Assist with special sales initiatives, client events and station
opportunities.
• Coordinate information and workflow between Sales and other
departments, including Traffic, Creative Services, Finance, Digital and
Sales Fulfillment.
• Assist with organization and execution of seasonal programming,
sports, political and special sales opportunities.
• Provide administrative and project support as assigned by the DOS.
• Take on additional responsibilities based on changing department
priorities and business needs.
2. Account Executive & Sales Support
Provide operational and administrative support to Account Executives as
needed and based on department priorities to allow sellers to maximize
client-facing and new-business development time.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist with order entry, revisions and schedule changes.
• Support campaign setup and maintenance.
• Monitor active schedules and campaign delivery.
• Assist with makegoods, preemptions and discrepancy resolution. • Prepare and update client presentations, proposals and sales
materials.
• Assist with avails and inventory coordination.
• Coordinate commercial materials, scripts and creative needs.
• Follow up with Traffic, Creative Services and Sales Fulfillment on
outstanding items.
• Assist with routine client and agency administrative requests.
• Support campaign recaps and post-campaign reporting.
• Help maintain accurate client, account and campaign information.
• Assist with Matrix/CRM administrative support while maintaining AE
accountability for prospecting activity, opportunities and pipeline
management.
The Sales Assistant supports the business of the sales department rather
than being permanently assigned to any individual Account Executive.
3. Account Manager Coverage & Operational Support
Develop proficiency in Account Manager responsibilities to provide reliable
backup coverage during vacations, PTO, vacancies, periods of increased
workload or other business needs.
Responsibilities include:
• Become proficient in WO Media Sales and applicable sales systems.
• Enter and revise orders accurately.
• Understand Traffic workflow, deadlines and requirements.
• Assist with schedule maintenance and campaign stewardship.
• Coordinate makegoods and resolve scheduling discrepancies.
• Assist with billing and invoice questions as appropriate.
• Track commercial materials and creative requirements. • Understand MediaFerry and applicable creative workflows.
• Provide professional client and agency administrative communication.
• Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaign fulfillment.
• Maintain continuity of sales operations when Account Manager
coverage is needed.
The expectation is that this employee becomes a dependable cross-trained
resource who can step into operational gaps without disrupting service to
clients or the sales team.
4. Account Executive Development
Develop the foundational skills, product knowledge and sales experience
necessary to potentially advance into a future Account Executive position.
Development opportunities may include:
• Participate in sales and product training.
• Develop knowledge of KWES/KIDY/KXVA broadcast programming and
sales opportunities.
• Learn TEGNA's Total TV approach: Broadcast + Streaming + Digital.
• Develop working knowledge of Premion, CTV/OTT, Audience
Marketplace and other digital solutions.
• Learn Matrix CRM and proper pipeline management.
• Participate in prospect research and new-business development
exercises.
• Learn effective prospecting techniques.
• Observe and participate in client discovery.
• Attend selected client meetings and AE ride-alongs.
• Assist with development of integrated client recommendations.
• Learn proposal development and presentation skills. • Gain exposure to pricing and inventory strategy.
• Develop understanding of campaign measurement, stewardship and
renewal.
• Participate in role-play, presentation and sales-development exercises.
• Demonstrate the ability to communicate the value of
KWES/KIDY/KXVA and TEGNA solutions to local businesses.
Career Development Opportunity
This position is designed to provide broad exposure to the KWES/KIDY/KXVA sales organization and may serve as a developmental pathway toward a future Account Executive opportunity. As the employee demonstrates proficiency in their core responsibilities, additional opportunities may be provided to develop prospecting, discovery, presentation, client relationship and new-business skills. Advancement into an Account Executive position is not guaranteed and will depend upon individual performance, demonstrated sales readiness, business needs and future position availability.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Professional written and verbal communication.
• Strong customer-service mindset.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Comfort learning new software, systems and processes.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Teams,
PowerPoint and Excel. • Ability to analyze information and identify potential problems before
they affect clients.
• Initiative and willingness to take ownership of assignments.
• Interest in sales, marketing, advertising and business development.
• Ability to work independently while functioning as part of a larger
sales team.
• Desire to learn and grow within the organization.
Experience in media, advertising, sales support, customer service or account
management is beneficial but not necessarily required for the right
candidate.
Measures of Success
Success in this position will be measured by:

• Reliability of AE and AM support.
• Ability to manage and follow through on assigned projects.
• Reduction of administrative and operational workload on sellers and
sales leadership.
• Quality of internal and external communication.
• Campaign and order accuracy.
• Ability to identify and resolve issues proactively.
• Growth in product, system and sales knowledge.
• Demonstrated readiness to assume increasing responsibility.     Role Philosophy
The purpose of this position is straightforward: Support the sales operation. Protect the client experience. Give sellers more time to sell. Provide the DOS with additional operational support. Build organizational depth. Develop future sales talent.

Amplified Digital, a division of Lee Enterprises, is seeking a highly skilled and analytical Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager to manage, optimize, and scale digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, with a primary focus on Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic demand-side platforms (DSPs).

This position will be responsible for the hands-on execution of paid media campaigns, advanced conversion tracking and attribution, and in-depth performance analysis to drive measurable business outcomes for our clients. Position Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Optimization: Build, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), Meta (Facebook and Instagram), and programmatic DSPs.

Performance Analysis: Conduct detailed campaign performance evaluations, identifying trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and overall advertising effectiveness.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement, troubleshoot, and maintain conversion tracking and attribution solutions utilizing Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI).

Advanced Analytics: Perform deep-dive analysis across advertising platforms, website analytics, and customer conversion data to assess the complete customer journey, identify attribution gaps, and recommend data-driven improvements.

Strategic Growth Opportunities: Proactively identify campaign expansion, budget reallocation, cross-channel advertising, and upsell opportunities based on performance data, audience insights, and client business objectives.

Cross-Channel Strategy: Evaluate performance across Google, Meta, and programmatic channels to develop cohesive strategies that maximize advertising effectiveness throughout the customer journey.

Reporting & Insights: Develop actionable performance insights and recommendations utilizing GA4 and other reporting platforms. Translate complex datasets into clear findings for internal teams and client-facing discussions.

Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve tracking discrepancies, conversion reporting issues, campaign delivery challenges, and platform integration problems.

Campaign Quality & Compliance: Ensure campaigns adhere to platform advertising policies, internal best practices, budget pacing requirements, and established quality assurance standards.

Automation & Efficiency: Leverage platform automation, AI-powered bidding strategies, and campaign management technologies to improve operational efficiency and campaign performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Client Experience, Sales, Product, and technical teams to develop advertising strategies, resolve performance concerns, and deliver recommendations that support client growth.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and performance deadlines.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment with an emphasis on accountability, continuous optimization, and measurable client outcomes.

Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying performance improvements and growth opportunities.

Certifications:

Google Ads Search Certification required.

Google Analytics Certification required or willingness to obtain within 90 days.

Meta Blueprint and The Trade Desk Edge Academy certifications preferred.

Work Environment: Remote position with collaboration across distributed teams. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings or company events.

Demonstrated experience managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and budget levels.

Minimum 2 years of experience working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and digital advertising conversion tracking.

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

The Trade Desk, DV360, Madhive, or similar DSPs

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position offers opportunities to earn performance-based bonuses tied to individual contributions and measurable business outcomes. Bonus considerations may include:

Achievement of campaign performance and optimization goals.

Operational efficiencies and improvements in campaign execution.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST November 19th, 2026

Intro to Position

This editor brings enthusiasm and fresh ideas to the coverage of cultural insights and deep respect for the curious audience. In collaboration with the Arts & Culture Hub editors and platform leads, this senior editor will be responsive to the news and drive NPR’s cultural insights coverage for broadcast and digital. They will work to identify and explain the values, beliefs, and social dynamics that shape our culture and guide the reporting team to explain and contextualize emerging trends with verve, speed and accuracy. This mandate includes providing insights into current artistic movements and trends, as well as deep dives to explain meaningful cultural change. This editor’s leadership will help the team break news and ideas. Because of the breadth of this beat, this editor will be a key decision-maker on the shape and design of day-to-day news coverage for the entire team. 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Generate story ideas and review story pitches with reporters on the Society & Culture desk, which includes coverage of movies, books, sports, religion and education, among other things.

  • Help develop storytelling approaches and sources, and determine the best platform for coverage.
  • Direct daily news and feature coverage of beat in collaboration with all platform leads, desks and others as appropriate;
  • Ability to fill-in or supplement editing of sports coverage, which may include some weekend work
  • Engage digital and visuals teams at the earliest stage of story and event planning and idea generation;
  • Proactively produce multiplatform coverage plans for major events and stories in collaboration with divisions and teams throughout NPR when necessary;
  • Edit stories for broadcast, digital, social, and newsletters, supporting critics and correspondents in developing and executing stories with speed, voice, and nuance.
  • Ability to advise show programmers and hosts on coverage threads, booking guests and interview questions.
  • Competent at audio production;
  • Competent in SEO, headline writing and other engagement best practices to ensure that all digital stories produced by the team are ready for posting;
  • Participate in, edit, and direct news coverage when needed, including the flexibility to work some evenings or weekends when needed, and also occasional holiday assignments.
  • Ensure that desk content meets NPR’s standards and practices (including accuracy, fairness, honesty, and impartiality). 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience editing arts, entertainment and culture coverage.
  • Experience editing for radio and/or podcasting.
  • Experience with coverage of arts and culture, including but not limited to: movies, TV, visual arts, and books.
  • Experience in digital media, including editing copy, visuals and coordination with news apps as well as familiarity with content management systems and collaboration tools.
  • A strong record of multi-platform thinking and execution in daily news as well as feature and enterprise coverage.
  • Experience in editorial decision-making, including assigning reporters/correspondents.
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under stringent timeframes and changing priorities/conditions.
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently under deadline pressure.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts.
  • Demonstrated team collaboration and leadership skills.
  • Expertise in writing, with excellence in news, headline and broadcast writing as well as copy editing. 
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and effectively in challenging situations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with NPR member stations and the public media system.
  • Some experience and understanding of sports and sports journalism 
  • Flexibility, creativity and eagerness to innovate and embrace change.
  • Long-standing relationships and contacts in the entertainment industry are a plus. 

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • SAG-AFTRA Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. / Culver City / New York City location at least 2-3 days per week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia / Culver City / New York City.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $127,500 - $137,499 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Head of Shows, New York Magazine
job.description:
THE ROLE

New York Magazine is seeking a Head of Shows to lead our multiplatform show strategy across audio and video programming. This person will identify the most promising opportunities across our editorial brands, develop original franchises, and build a sustainable slate of shows that extend the reach and impact of New York Magazine across audio, video, social, and live platforms.

The ideal candidate is both a creative leader and a skilled production operator: someone who has successfully developed and launched multiple shows out of newsrooms, understands the audio and video landscape, and can recognize distinctive editorial voices and talent that translate into compelling programming.

In this role, you will work across New York Magazine’s portfolio, including The Cut, Vulture, and its four additional verticals, to identify talent, concepts, and audience opportunities that can become signature New York franchises.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and execute a long-term video and audio strategy for New York Magazine, identifying the largest audience, editorial, and business opportunities across the magazine’s brands, coverage areas, and talent roster.
  • Conceive, develop, and launch new show concepts from idea through pilot, testing, and release, including the creation of multiple pilots and proof-of-concept projects in the first year.
  • Oversee all aspects of show development, including editorial direction, host development, visual approach, production workflows, and programming.
  • Build a long-term roadmap and development pipeline for a portfolio of multiplatform shows that support audience growth, engagement, and revenue objectives.
  • Partner with audience, video, and social teams to develop programming and distribution strategies for YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels, including episode packaging, clips, and original social content.
  • Use audience insights and performance data to refine formats, grow existing shows, and inform development and investment decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate the potential to acquire or partner with existing external shows, creators, and talent when there is an opportunity to strengthen coverage areas aligned with the magazine’s audio and video strategy.
  • Build and manage a team, recruiting producers, external creative partners, and talent as needed, and oversee production budgets and schedules.
  • Work with the editorial team to integrate show appearances and video opportunities into major editorial bookings.
  • Partner with editors and production teams to develop author-read audio versions of major stories at a regular cadence.
  • Lead broader cross-functional stakeholder management and execution, e.g., collaborating with the audience team to develop multiplatform growth strategies and partnering with ad sales and subscription teams to build out franchise business opportunities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 10+ years of experience developing, launching, and growing original video programs, podcasts, or multiplatform franchises.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking shows from concept to launch and audience growth, with experience across both video and audio.
  • Strong editorial instincts and experience translating culture, politics, business, lifestyle, or entertainment coverage into compelling audio and video formats.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist, Content Understanding
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

At SiriusXM and Pandora, understanding content is critical to delivering high-quality search, recommendation, discovery, and personalization experiences. As a Senior Machine Learning Scientist, Content Understanding, you will develop advanced machine learning solutions that help extract meaning, context, and structure from audio, text, and multimodal content. Your work will directly support content enrichment, metadata generation, semantic understanding, and emerging AI-powered experiences that improve how listeners discover and engage with content.

Working independently on complex technical challenges, you will partner with cross-functional teams to develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact for users and the business.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, deploy, and improve machine learning models that support content understanding across audio, text, and multimodal content sources.

  • Apply modern machine learning techniques, including deep learning, transformer architectures, large language models, and multimodal learning approaches to solve content understanding challenges.

  • Own complex machine learning projects from problem definition through model development, deployment, evaluation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate offline metrics, experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes to drive continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Data teams to identify opportunities and deliver impactful machine learning solutions.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of data pipelines, feature engineering processes, experimentation workflows, and model evaluation methodologies.

  • Stay current with emerging advancements in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and content understanding technologies, identifying opportunities to apply new approaches where appropriate.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior scientists and contribute to a culture of collaboration, learning, and technical excellence.

  • Contribute to technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution design efforts within the team.

  • Support production machine learning systems through monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and continuous improvement activities.

  • This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

What You'll Need:

  • Education: M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field required; Ph.D. preferred.

  • Experience: 3+ years of production experience developing and deploying machine learning models at scale, including experience working on complex machine learning initiatives and delivering measurable business impact.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong experience with machine learning approaches used in content understanding, including deep learning, transformer architectures, large language models, natural language processing, and multimodal learning techniques.

  • Production ML: Experience developing, deploying, monitoring, and optimizing machine learning systems in production environments.

  • Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems, analyze large datasets, and develop scalable machine learning solutions.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively across product, engineering, analytics, and data science teams to deliver impactful results.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated, curious, and driven to solve challenging problems while continuously developing technical expertise and business understanding.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the role

The HR Operations Specialist supports employees across the company by coordinating HR transactions, resolving production issues, and responding to questions. This role partners with employees, department managers, HR Partners, Payroll, and other teams to keep HR processes running smoothly and employee data accurate. You will report to the HRIS Operations Supervisor.

This is a hybrid role based in our Norfolk, Virginia office. You can typically expect to work in the office three days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Be the primary contact for employee HR inquiries, partnering with the appropriate teams to provide clear, guidance.
  • Work with department managers and HR Partners to gather information, process employee transactions, and maintain accurate employee data in Workday.
  • Process complex administrative transactions and participate in Workday HR system workflows.
  • Troubleshoot Workday production issues across HCM modules, including HCM Core, Recruiting, Time and Attendance, and Compensation; resolve related support tickets involving HR processes and employee data.
  • Support biweekly payroll processing by reviewing and validating payroll transactions and inputs, processing vacation payouts, and managing paid time off (PTO) adjustments in Workday following established procedures.
  • Work with Payroll and other teams, handling confidential information.
  • Help with user acceptance testing, configuration and reporting requests, and testing for biannual Workday releases.
  • Build and upload Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) files for employee and company changes.
  • Help employees use HR-related technology by answering questions and contributing to user enablement and training.
  • Develop training materials using Google Sites.
  • Manage end-user channels and the team email group, responding to inquiries from employees, HR Partners, and managers.
  • Audit HR processes and employee transactions to support data quality and integrity; follow security and data-handling protocols.
  • Process employment verification requests.
  • Manage a varied daily workload, reprioritizing to complete incoming transactions and department requests.
  • Take on other tasks as assigned.

Basic qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience working with Workday HCM processing HR transactions.
  • Solid awareness of how human resources transactions influence payroll processing, financial reporting, and broader operational tasks.
  • At least one year of experience using Microsoft Excel, including formulas and pivot tables.
  • You know how to provide clear, professional guidance.
  • Care for the impact your work can have across related processes.
  • You are resolution-oriented.
  • You have strong attention to detail.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday Payroll processing.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Familiarity with additional Workday modules and teams, such as Benefits, Payroll, Finance, Security and Integrations.

job.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
job.description: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

job.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success.

Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

job.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it.

As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

job.title: Jr. Royalties Analyst
job.description:
Who we are 

As a new industry alternative for independent artists, UnitedMasters provides premium music distribution services and facilitates unique partnerships between artists and the world’s biggest brands. We enable artists to maintain full ownership over their master recording rights while introducing them to millions of new fans worldwide through our direct brand partnerships.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Instagram, Dropbox, Complex, VICE and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation. 

Essential Responsibilities You’ll Own

  • Participate in the monthly royalty payout run process 
  • Preparation of monthly royalty payment reports and support documentation
  • Reviewing contracts to determine royalty payment requirements
  • Assists in the review of new contracts received from Licensors
  • Enter required contractual data points into the rights management system
  • Review and upload royalty reports including identification and resolution of any data conflicts
  • Liaise with agents to ensure timely receipt of royalty statement reporting
  • Prepare monthly 3rd party royalty statements
  • Work closely with Corporate Finance/Accounting team
  • Ad hoc requests and analytics to support Sales and Finance team
  • Process and review Artist royalty statements for contract compliance
  • Record transactions in our Royalty system
  • Track statements to be processed and update with status of outstanding issues
  • Prepare licensing and royalty data for reporting out to internal business partners
  • Other duties as assigned, including assist with month-end close, assist in preparation of participation reporting to parent company and other parties, assist with licensee audit program, assist with development of standards, processes, and procedures

What will set you up for success

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business/Music Business or closely related field
  •  2+ years of royalty experience
  • Must be detail-oriented and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Flexible work style: able to adjust to multiple demands and a changing and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise professional judgment
  • Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy required
  • Required technical skills: Advanced MS Excel (knowledge of pivot tables, subtotal, sort, filter, if statements, vlookups, etc. required)

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $65,000 – $75,000

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world's leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

Our Marketing Automation teams operate as a Centre of Excellence, bringing together journey expertise, platform capabilities, experimentation, personalisation and measurement to drive customer and commercial value.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing Automation (Consumer or B2B), you'll be responsible for ensuring we're automating and improving the right customer experiences.

Sitting between lifecycle strategy and execution, this is a journey architecture, orchestration and optimisation role. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing and other collaborators to understand customer needs and commercial objectives, translating these into effective automated experiences.

You'll take a comprehensive view of the automated journey portfolio, finding opportunities to improve how journeys, campaigns, triggers and customer or account states work together. You'll assess existing activity, identify gaps or overlaps, and recommend whether journeys should be optimised, extended, redesigned, consolidated or retired.

Rather than focusing primarily on building individual campaigns, you'll lead the thinking behind journey design and optimisation, developing actionable recommendations and coordinating delivery through Marketing Automation Specialists and Executives.

You'll also work closely with your counterpart in the Consumer or B2B Marketing Automation team, sharing expertise and helping establish consistent standards, experimentation approaches and guidelines across the Centre of Excellence.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the FT's customer experience, ensuring automated journeys are connected, measurable and continuously improving.

Key responsibilities

Journey architecture and orchestration

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing and other collaborators to understand business objectives, customer needs, target audiences and lifecycle challenges.

  • Translate strategic briefs into effective automation opportunities, challenging proposed solutions where necessary to address the underlying customer or commercial problem.

  • Maintain a comprehensive view of the automated journey portfolio, ensuring journeys, campaigns, triggers and customer or account states work together coherently.

  • Map and visualise customer journeys, identifying gaps, overlaps, friction and opportunities to improve reach, relevance and effectiveness.

  • Determine whether objectives are best achieved by optimising existing journeys, introducing new pathways, adjusting triggers, content or sequencing, or retiring existing activity.

  • Design automated experiences using appropriate audiences, channels, behavioural signals, personalisation, decisioning and timing.

  • Define journey sequencing, eligibility, hierarchy and suppression rules to handle interactions between customer experiences.

  • Work with Data, Technology, Creative and Marketing Automation colleagues to translate journey designs into delivered experiences.

Portfolio optimisation and prioritisation

  • Own and maintain the journey opportunity and optimisation roadmap, prioritising activity according to customer and commercial impact, reach, effort and strategic importance.

  • Regularly audit automated journeys to find opportunities for improvement, redesign, consolidation or retirement.

  • Investigate underlying audience, data, design and execution issues to understand journey performance.

  • Find opportunities to improve customer experiences through behavioural triggers, segmentation, personalisation and multichannel orchestration.

  • Ensure journeys are continuously reviewed and optimised rather than treated as one-off launches.

  • Work with the Head of Marketing Automation to align optimisation priorities with the wider strategy and available capacity.

Measurement, testing and learning

  • Establish clear objectives, KPIs and measurement approaches for significant journey interventions.

  • Incorporate testing and experimentation into journey design, including hypotheses, control groups and learning objectives where appropriate.

  • Use customer, account, behavioural and commercial data to assess journey effectiveness and find opportunities.

  • Evaluate broader journey outcomes alongside individual campaign performance, focusing on measurable customer and commercial impact.

  • Translate analysis and experimentation into actionable recommendations and future improvements.

  • Contribute to shared learning, measurement frameworks and procedures across the Centre of Excellence.

Delivery leadership and collaboration

  • Translate journey recommendations into clear, actionable briefs for Marketing Automation Specialists and Executives.

  • Work with delivery teams to define audience requirements, triggers, branching logic, personalisation, sequencing, testing and data dependencies.

  • Provide architectural direction, reviewing implementation proposals and identifying risks or opportunities for improvement.

  • Coach and support colleagues in journey design, optimisation and effective use of automation capabilities.

  • Collaborate with Consumer and B2B counterparts to share expertise, find opportunities and develop consistent approaches.

  • Contribute to Centre of Excellence playbooks and standards for journey design, testing, personalisation and orchestration.

Platform and capability development

  • Apply a strong understanding of marketing automation and customer data platforms to design effective journeys.

  • Find opportunities to make better use of existing automation capabilities and work with technical colleagues where further development may be required.

  • Combine customer and account data, behavioural signals, segmentation and decisioning to improve relevance and effectiveness.

  • Support the development and adoption of scalable, reusable Marketing Automation standards and ways of working.

Required skills and experience

  • Significant experience in marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related field.

  • Strong expertise in customer journey architecture, design and orchestration, with the ability to think across interconnected customer experiences rather than individual campaigns.

  • Experience handling or optimising a portfolio of automated journeys, identifying gaps, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.

  • Ability to translate customer and commercial challenges into clear journey strategies and practical automation solutions.

  • Strong understanding of automation principles, including triggers, segmentation, personalisation, decisioning, channel selection, frequency and journey sequencing.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using customer, behavioural and commercial data to improve outcomes.

  • Experience developing testing and experimentation approaches and applying insights to journey optimisation.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how automated journeys contribute to acquisition, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention and customer value.

  • Ability to map, visualise and explain sophisticated customer journeys to collaborators with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Strong relationship management, collaboration and influencing skills, including confidence challenging briefs and recommending alternative approaches.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues and supporting the development of others.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise contending opportunities and make evidence-based recommendations.

  • Sufficient technical and platform knowledge to understand implementation requirements, identify dependencies and challenge proposed solutions.

Desirable

  • Experience in subscription, digital media, recurring revenue or other customer lifecycle businesses.

  • Familiarity with sophisticated marketing automation or customer data platforms such as Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo or equivalent.

  • Experience with behavioural decisioning, next-best-action, dynamic content or advanced personalisation.

  • Experience designing or optimising multichannel journeys across email, onsite and other digital channels.

  • Knowledge of account-based marketing, multi-contact buying journeys or complex B2B customer relationships.

  • Experience developing reusable journey frameworks, playbooks or operating standards.

  • Experience working across B2C and B2B audiences or within a Centre of Excellence.
