job.title: Technical Security Governance Lead - Exposure Management
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a lead for Exposure Management to provide deep technical investigation of suspected security exposures across WPP's global technology estate. 

Working within TSG, this role will investigate vulnerabilities and attack opportunities across a highly diverse environment spanning cloud, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, applications, AI and emerging technologies. You will use modern security, exposure and adversarial-testing capabilities to understand whether weaknesses are genuinely exploitable, how they could combine into realistic attack paths, and which exposure deserves attention first. 

This is a hands-on technical role with enterprise-wide reach. You will investigate complex security questions, challenge assumptions with evidence, identify systemic patterns, and translate technical findings into clear priorities for the teams responsible for remediation. You will not own every fix. Your role is to establish technical reality, determine what matters, and direct attention towards the improvements that will most meaningfully reduce WPP's exposure. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

What you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as WPP’s technical Principal for Exposure Management, providing senior technical judgement on attack paths and systemic exposure across the global technology environment.
  • Investigate suspected vulnerabilities across infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications, data and AI.
  • Follow the evidence beyond the tool output, combining information from multiple sources to determine what is genuinely exploitable, how weaknesses connect, and what actually matters.
  • Assess attack paths and systemic exposure, maintaining enough perspective to distinguish significant enterprise risk from isolated or technically interesting findings.
  • Establish technical priorities for mitigation, helping teams focus effort on the exposures most likely to materially improve WPP's security posture.
  • Work with TSG specialists across Cloud, Identity, Data, Infrastructure, Application and AI to understand findings in context and develop technically credible recommendations for system owners.
  • Provide broad technical security expertise on complex security questions, technologies and protective approaches, including areas such as encryption, security tooling and emerging threats.
  • Support major security events where rapid technical investigation, exposure analysis and remediation prioritisation are required.
  • Continuously improve how WPP understands exposure, identifying recurring patterns, challenging assumptions and helping us get better at finding the problems that actually matter. 

What you'll need:

Essential: 

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical security experience, with meaningful practical experience investigating, defending or validating real enterprise technology.
  • Strong foundations across enterprise technology, such as networks, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications or security operations, with enough breadth to understand how weaknesses interact across domains.
  • Practical attacker and defender knowledge, with the ability to reason about vulnerabilities, exploitability, attack paths, defensive controls and realistic attack opportunities.
  • Strong investigative and critical-thinking skills, including the curiosity to challenge assumptions, question tool output and follow evidence until the underlying technical reality is understood.
  • The judgement to prioritise, knowing when to investigate deeply, when enough is known to act, and when an interesting technical issue is not the most important problem.
  • Professional English, sufficient to investigate, collaborate and communicate effectively across WPP's global technology and security organisation.
  • Ability to work primarily from WPP's São Paulo office as part of the wider security team. 

Desirable: 

  • Practical experience in one or more of Red Team, Blue Team, Purple Team, Vulnerability Management, Exposure Management, Security Engineering, Security Research, Vulnerability Research, adversarial validation or attack-path analysis.
  • Experience translating complex technical findings into clear priorities and recommendations that other technology teams can act on.
  • Experience working across multiple technology domains rather than remaining exclusively within a single technical specialism.
  • Experience operating with substantial autonomy, creating structure from ambiguity and maintaining perspective across competing technical problems.
  • Experience influencing technical outcomes through expertise, evidence and collaboration, rather than relying on direct authority.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work equally well with deep technical specialists and senior stakeholders.
  • 10+ years of broader IT or cybersecurity experience, ideally including earlier hands-on experience with enterprise infrastructure, networks, operating systems, applications or security operations.
  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability, attack-surface, exposure, BAS or security-posture platforms, particularly where multiple sources must be correlated to understand the real picture.
  • Experience investigating exposure across cloud, identity, applications, AI or agentic systems.
  • Experience supporting major incidents, urgent remediation programmes or complex technical investigations under time pressure.
  • Experience designing or improving technical security methodologies, processes, metrics or prioritisation approaches.
  • Relevant technical education or certifications. Practical experience and demonstrated technical judgement matter more than certification volume. 

Please submit your CV in English.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Talent Development

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor market KPIs and implement corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Collaborate with corporate leadership to support company initiatives and strategic priorities.

Community Impact

  • Strengthen Beasley Media Group's presence and reputation within the local community.
  • Support local events, charitable initiatives, and public service efforts.
  • Champion diversity, inclusion, and community engagement initiatives.

Required

Ski at some of the best-known resorts in America in the winter and hike, boat, and play outdoors in the summer. The Burlington, Vermont, area is one of the most beautiful places in North America. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job, you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award-winning team from day one. The Intern rate of pay can range from minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online).

  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies. 
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 116 stations.

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand.
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift.
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule.
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn. This is a paid internship. 
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

    ▪️ Strong work ethic and organizational skills
    ▪️ Earning a degree in Journalism/Communications, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, News, Sports, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry

job.title: Seasonal Senior Product Designer
job.description:
The NFL is looking for a Senior Product Designer to bring compelling, innovative and user-centered design digital experiences to life across the NFL portfolio. The ideal candidate will be a passionate product designer, adept in balancing the nuances of user flows, product requirements and UX practices with a love of the details that bring thoughtful, well-crafted designs to life. We will look to you for strategic design thinking as well as best in class execution, along with a passion for collaboration, a curious mind, and an enthusiastic approach to making great products.

This role will work closely with Product Management, Project Management, Engineering, UX and User Research across all products and platforms to creatively solve problems and partner with all facets of the NFL organization to help bring those ideas to life for the incredible NFL fan base.

This is an exciting opportunity to have a major impact on all of the products within the NFL portfolio and help shape our process to continuously improve and ship them.

*Please submit a resume and portfolio (pdf or website link) with your application.

Responsibilities

  • Design compelling, informative, and engaging user experiences & flows.
  • Deliver high-fidelity UI and UX specs that clearly communicate requirements.
  • Be an excellent communicator and storyteller both verbally and visually, bringing ideas to life using sketches, workshops, journeys, comps, prototypes, presentations and more to communicate clearly and move the needle within creative teams and with less design-fluent stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the UX, User Research, Product Managers and Engineering teams to identify needs, determine approaches, create design solutions and iteratively refine ideas through development and launch.
  • Advocate for design and experience priorities within interdisciplinary teams in creating products that consider users, push for innovation, prioritize usability, and balance business objectives from ideation to launch through maintenance on live products.
  • Identify, align, and establish shared user experience patterns across different platform features.
  • Contribute to creating and managing a cohesive design system across the NFL digital portfolio via flexible and reusable components.
  • Be a champion for experience cohesion, helping the expansive NFL digital ecosystem function in one unified voice.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Product Design experience developing user experiences and interface design for digital products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in design, graphic design, fine arts, or equivalent field preferred.
  • Strong portfolio with engaging, diverse designs in the digital space, demonstrating a passion for design.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping end to end products with complicated flows, multiple scenarios and edge cases.
  • A strong understanding of interactivity, accessibility/WCAG, design systems, and the fundamentals of typography, hierarchy, and layout.
  • Motivated, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to work both independently and in highly collaborative settings.
  • Strategic problem-solving skills and the capacity to distill complex information into meaningful concepts, ideas, and designs.
  • Strong experience working in Figma, particularly with building and managing component libraries; a comfort with additional tools for design, collaboration & prototyping is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with other designers, giving and accepting constructive criticism.
  • Experience with the agile development methodology and ability to work in a fast-paced environment, often juggling multiple priorities and successfully balancing immediate short-term needs while maintaining strategic vision for the long-term.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4-year Bachelors Degree in Design, UX or Human-Computer Interaction.
  • 5-7 years of experience working in with a Product teams, Marketing agencies or Digital Media organizations with relevant experience assisting in the design and delivery of design assets.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Have a positive attitude and work well with others on the team.
  • Have a collaborative mindset and aren’t afraid to ask for help or feedback. You understand that open communication leads to better outcomes and stronger design.
  • Eager to learn new skills and take on challenges.

job.title: Director, Technical Product Management – Audience
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

job.title: Audience Insights Intern
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is seeking an inquisitive and organized intern to join the Audience Insights team this summer. Audience Insights is a multidisciplinary team of researchers who conduct qualitative and quantitative research projects to support our product, design, and marketing efforts. Our mission is to help The Times grow by understanding our audience. We uncover and tell stories about our audience’s preferences, behaviors, and needs by conducting user interviews, focus groups, surveys, and many other types of research methods. By examining both sentiment and behavior, we determine the best ways to express our journalism and brand value in order to drive deeper engagement and increased subscriptions. 

In this role, you will engage in audience and product research across the company. You will expand your knowledge of the practice of research and get the chance to contribute to the larger New York Times strategy by leading your own multi- phase research project. You will be exposed to many different streams of work across The New York Times portfolio of products. Depending on your interests and the company’s needs, you will have the opportunity to improve one of our marketing strategies, to refine one of our user flows, or to boost the development of new products and services. 

About Our Summer Internships 

  • The duration is 10 weeks long, starting on June 7, 2027. 
  • The rate of pay for this role is $30.00 per hour. 
  • Interns work 35 hours per week. 
  • This is a hybrid position that must be completed onsite at our office in New York 

Responsibilities: 

  • Completing a literature review 
  • Designing and moderating user interviews 
  • Qualitative research design and analysis 
  • Designing and fielding a survey 
  • Quantitative research design and statistical analysis 
  • Demonstrates support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world. 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Completing a graduate degree in Marketing, Statistics, Psychology, Communications, Human Computer Interaction, or a related field 
  • Experience in moderating or observing research interviews 
  • Experience with developing, writing, and analyzing surveys 
  • Experience compelling research-focused presentations and data visualizations

  • Experience in journalism and digital media (Academic or professional)

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join the Games Web Platform squad. You'll help shape the platform behind The Times' suite of games, building the capabilities that help our teams to deliver engaging, reliable experiences for players. You'll take ownership of complex engineering work across our application, and help the team turn new puzzle ideas into scalable product capabilities.

You'll strengthen the technology behind our existing games and help create the foundation for new experiences. Working with engineers, designers, product managers, and production partners, you'll guide technical decisions from discovery through launch, balancing a high-quality player experience with maintainable, reliable systems. You'll also share your expertise through mentorship, thoughtful technical reviews, and contributions to an engineering organization that values transparency, diversity, learning, and a community of practice.

Our team builds web applications with React, semantic HTML, and SCSS, prioritizing accessibility and performance in the player experience. You'll contribute across the stack: shaping front-end architectures and shared platform capabilities, and designing and building performant Go APIs that support the Games ecosystem. Our infrastructure runs on Amazon Web Services, with Fastly providing edge delivery and caching. We're looking for someone who can make sound architectural tradeoffs, improve the systems they work on, and help other engineers deliver high-quality work.

You will report to the Engineering Manager, Platform squad.

This is a hybrid role based at our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 2-3+ days/week.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and evolution of foundational web platform capabilities and shared component libraries, helping Games teams deliver reliable, accessible, high-quality experiences.

  • Lead the design and operation of performant, scalable Go APIs and services that support the evolving needs of the Games ecosystem.

  • Partner with Product, Design, and Production on complex projects. Shape technical approaches, weigh tradeoffs, and turn creative concepts into reliable product capabilities.

  • Improve performance, accessibility, and reliability across the Games suite, applying modern front-end practices and edge delivery capabilities to create a great player experience.

  • Improve developer experience by building and evolving tools, including Claude Code tooling, that help engineering teams deliver high-quality software.

job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

 

Pay Scale: $95,000 - $109,000

 

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace

 

 

More about AXS

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

 

 

More about AEG

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people feel, share, and remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience over 13,000 live events across five continents, from iconic concerts and major festivals to championship-level sports and entertainment destinations.

We are dedicated to a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and never discriminate based on gender, age, race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

 

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship.  AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

 

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions.  We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Corporate Affairs, Health Policy - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking a Senior Vice President, Health Policy and Public Affairs, to lead one of the agency's most strategically important global healthcare accounts.

This role serves as the senior strategic counselor to client leadership across a portfolio of marketed and pipeline therapies in neurology and rare disease. The EVP will lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for patient advocacy engagement, access and reimbursement policy, stakeholder mobilization, executive visibility, corporate reputation and issues management.

The successful candidate will possess deep healthcare public affairs expertise, exceptional stakeholder engagement experience, and a strong understanding of the evolving policy, regulatory, reimbursement and market access environment impacting innovative medicines globally.

This leader will work at the intersection of science, policy, patient need and reputation, helping shape conversations among patient organizations, professional societies, policymakers, healthcare providers, caregivers and advocacy stakeholders while ensuring communications and engagement strategies support both long-term corporate reputation objectives and product-related priorities.

The ideal candidate combines the strategic instincts of a public affairs leader, the stakeholder expertise of a patient advocacy professional, and the business acumen of a senior agency executive. They are equally comfortable discussing healthcare policy with government stakeholders, scientific innovation with medical leaders, reputation strategy with the C-suite and patient priorities with advocacy organizations.

Most importantly, they understand how policy, science, access, patient advocacy and reputation intersect, and can help global healthcare organizations navigate that complexity to create meaningful impact for patients, caregivers and society.

This Hybrid role is ideally based in New York and Washington DC. 

What you'll do:

Strategic Client Leadership

  • Serve as senior strategic counselor to global and regional client leadership teams.
  • Lead integrated public affairs, corporate reputation and stakeholder engagement programs across neurology and rare disease portfolios.
  • Shape strategic communications approaches that connect policy, patient advocacy, access and reputation objectives into a cohesive narrative.
  • Develop executive-level recommendations informed by evolving healthcare, political, reimbursement and regulatory environments.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex business, reputation and policy challenges.

Public Affairs, Policy & Access Leadership

  • Lead policy and advocacy strategies addressing market access, affordability, reimbursement and healthcare system priorities.
  • Counsel clients on emerging U.S., European and global policy developments affecting innovative medicines.
  • Monitor and advise on pricing, reimbursement and trade-related policy developments, including initiatives such as Most Favored Nation (MFN) pricing models, international reference pricing and healthcare cost-containment efforts.
  • Translate complex policy developments into impactful engagement and communications strategies.
  • Partner with policy experts, economists and scientific leaders to develop evidence-based advocacy initiatives.

Patient Advocacy & Stakeholder Relations

  • Build and strengthen relationships with patient organizations, advocacy coalitions, caregivers, healthcare professional associations and disease community leaders.
  • Design and implement engagement strategies that elevate patient perspectives throughout the disease lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities for trusted partnerships that advance awareness, access, education and health outcomes.
  • Guide stakeholder mapping and influence strategies across advocacy, policy and medical communities.
  • Ensure patient-centered engagement approaches are integrated across all programs.

Neurology & Rare Disease Expertise

  • Provide strategic counsel across brain health, neuroscience and rare disease areas.
  • Help clients advance a more integrated and holistic view of brain health that addresses patient outcomes, access, caregiver needs, public awareness and policy considerations.
  • Develop reputation and thought leadership platforms supporting both established therapies and future innovation.
  • Counsel clients on scientific milestones, breakthrough therapies, disease awareness efforts and emerging healthcare trends.
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle communications for pipeline and marketed assets.

Issues & Reputation Management

  • Lead proactive reputation management and complex issues preparedness initiatives.
  • Develop risk assessments, scenario planning exercises and stakeholder response frameworks.
  • Counsel executives during periods of heightened scrutiny involving pricing, access, clinical development, regulatory matters or public policy debates.
  • Ensure consistency of corporate and product-related narratives across stakeholder groups and geographies.
  • Protect and strengthen organizational reputation during critical moments.

Regulatory & Commercialization Strategy

  • Advise clients throughout the therapy development lifecycle, including:
    • Clinical development and trial communications
    • Regulatory milestones
    • FDA and global regulatory approval processes
    • Launch readiness
    • Market access preparation
    • Lifecycle management
  • Partner with scientific, medical and market access teams to connect innovation stories with stakeholder priorities and policy realities.

Business Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and inspire cross-functional account teams across multiple markets.
  • Drive account growth through expansion opportunities and strategic advisory services.
  • Contribute to new business efforts across the health and public affairs sectors.
  • Mentor and develop senior talent while fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture.
  • Strengthen Burson's intellectual capital across healthcare public affairs, patient advocacy and reputation management.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 15+ years of experience in healthcare public affairs, policy, corporate communications, government affairs, market access, advocacy or related disciplines.
  • Significant experience counseling pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare clients on complex public affairs and reputation issues.
  • Demonstrated expertise in neurology, neuroscience, rare disease, specialty pharmaceutical or adjacent therapeutic areas.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare policy, pricing, reimbursement and access environments in the United States and internationally.
  • Experience developing and executing stakeholder engagement strategies involving patient advocacy organizations, healthcare professional associations, policymakers and caregiver communities.
  • Strong familiarity with FDA approval pathways, clinical trial communications and pharmaceutical commercialization strategies.
  • Proven experience supporting both marketed products and clinical-stage pipeline assets.
  • Knowledge of European and/or global healthcare policy environments and stakeholder ecosystems.
  • Exceptional executive presence and ability to counsel C-suite and senior healthcare leaders.
  • Experience leading large, multi-market client engagements and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex reputation and issues management situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within global pharmaceutical companies, healthcare trade associations, public affairs consultancies or communications agencies.
  • Understanding of rare disease and neurological policy frameworks within key international markets.
  • Familiarity with health technology assessment (HTA), reimbursement decision-making and payer environments.
  • Experience engaging with organizations such as patient advocacy coalitions, specialty medical societies, health policy organizations and caregiver networks.
  • Exposure to global market access, international pricing policy and cross-border regulatory considerations.

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:$125,000—$295,000 USD

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

job.title: Part-Time Social Media Street Team
job.description: Join the Connoisseur Media – San Francisco Bay Area Social Street Team! We are looking for an energetic, outgoing part-time Social Media Street Team member to represent KOIT-FM (96.5 KOIT), KMVQ-FM (99.7 NOW), and KBLX-FM (102.9 KBLX) stations at concerts, live broadcasts, community events, and more. You'll be the face of our brands, interacting with listeners, creating engaging social media content, setting up eye-catching displays, running games and giveaways, and helping bring the fun wherever we go. This is your chance to be part of the action and connect directly with fans in a fast-paced, exciting environment. We’re looking for someone reliable, friendly, and who thrives in a team setting. You should be comfortable taking directions, talking with the public, and handling quick setups and teardowns with a positive attitude, and demonstrate your skills in building engaging social media posts and videos. Must be at least 18 years old or older, and 21 to work events where alcohol is served. If you love music, live events, eye-catching social media content, and creating unforgettable experiences, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities of this position may include the following: Producing engaging social media posts and videos Setting up station events: raising tents, plugging in sound systems, putting up signage/banners. Managing the events while in progress: interacting with listeners, leading games, prize wheels, and speaking on the microphone/PA. We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done. You'll anticipate needs, recognize priorities, take responsibility for assigned projects, and follow through to completion.

Anticipate the needs of the Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and office, staying one step ahead whenever possible.

Manage competing priorities independently, recognizing urgent requests and adjusting accordingly.

Follow up on outstanding tasks, client commitments, and internal requests until they are resolved.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, organization, and efficiency within the sales department and office.

Communicate proactively, providing updates, flagging concerns early, and asking questions when clarification is needed.

Be a reliable, consistent presence in the office who takes pride in supporting the success of the entire team.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience with Canva and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) is required. Candidates must be comfortable using these programs independently and confidently.

Strong Canva skills, with the ability to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, professional work.

The Sales Manager and Sales Representatives can focus more of their time on selling and building client relationships.

Sales orders, campaigns, promotions, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.

Tasks and projects are managed independently with minimal follow-up required.

job.title: Manager, Technology Product Quality & Testing
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Technology

Work Status: Full Time, Hybrid

Location: Toronto, ON

About The Role

Reporting to the Director, Technology Product & Business Application Support, the Manager, Technology Product Quality & Testing, leads a team responsible for testing software and business applications across the Corus application portfolio.

This role balances two priorities. You will lead the team's day-to-day testing delivery, including functional, regression, integration and business-oriented testing, while gradually expanding the team's quality engineering and test automation capability.

Initially, you will work alongside the team to establish a practical and maintainable automation foundation. Over time, your focus will shift toward coaching, technical guidance, test strategy, people leadership and continuous improvement. Automation will complement manual testing and will be applied where it provides clear and sustainable value.

You will contribute by:

• Lead, coach and support a team of QA professionals with varied technical experience

• Develop risk-based test strategies and priorities based on the scope, complexity, likelihood of failure and business impact of changes across the team’s application portfolio

• Plan and coordinate functional, regression, integration, exploratory and release testing

• Ensure test plans, results, defects and release risks are documented and communicated clearly

• Coordinate test environment and test data needs with application, platform, business and vendor teams

• Coordinate defect triage and resolution with application teams, business stakeholders and vendors

• Partner with application, product and business teams early in the change lifecycle to identify quality risks, clarify test requirements and improve testability

• Coordinate business testing and UAT where business validation is required

• Provide a clear quality and release-readiness recommendation to the accountable release stakeholders

• Manage team capacity, workload, hiring, performance and development

• Work hands-on with the team to establish and grow a maintainable test automation approach

• Prioritize automation based on risk, repeatability, business value and long-term maintenance effort

• Identify opportunities to automate testing across user interfaces, APIs, integrations, data exchanges and end-to-end business processes where practical

• Establish and continuously improve the team’s overall testing framework, standards and practices across manual and automated testing

• Coach team members through pairing, review, structured learning and practical application

• Work with platform and technology partners to incorporate automated tests into delivery pipelines where appropriate

• Introduce meaningful quality metrics that support risk, release and improvement decisions, including measures of test effectiveness, automation reliability and escaped defects rather than test volume alone

• Expand the team's testing coverage into additional software and business applications based on business risk, capacity and team readiness

• Continue to improve manual testing, integration testing and business-testing practices alongside automation

Skills and experience you will bring:

• 5 or more years of progressive experience in software testing, quality assurance or quality engineering

• At least 2 years of experience leading or managing QA professionals, including coaching, work allocation or performance responsibilities

• A pragmatic practitioner and coach, comfortable stepping in to help directly when needed

• Strong experience with manual functional, regression and integration testing

• Experience developing test strategies and coordinating testing across complex applications or system integrations

• Hands-on experience creating and maintaining automated tests using at least one modern automation framework

• Ability to help design and establish an automation approach while building capability and ongoing ownership across the team

• Practical understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect management and release validation

• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and how automated tests can be incorporated into delivery workflows

• Experience working with business stakeholders, application teams and third-party vendors

• Ability to communicate testing status, quality risk and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences

• Proficiency with modern automation technologies such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or WebdriverIO

• Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, or comparable programming or scripting languages

• Background working with enterprise applications, packaged software or vendor-managed platforms

• Exposure to performance or load testing

• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar delivery platforms

• Knowledge of broadcast, media, advertising, revenue or financial systems

• Familiarity with ITIL, IT General Controls or audit-sensitive technology environments

• ISTQB, ITIL, Agile or Scrum certification

job.title: ANCHOR/CONSUMER REPORTER - KSLA
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSLA:

KSLA News 12 is the aggressive, National Edward R. Murrow Award-winning CBS affiliate serving the region known as the ArkLaTex. The station is the market’s leader in timely and accurate reporting of breaking news, investigative journalism, award-winning storytelling, and First Alert Weather. KSLA News 12 serves its community on all on-air, digital, and mobile platforms, embracing the innovation of the industry. In the center of the ArkLaTex is the Shreveport/Bossier City metroplex where the best of Louisiana, Texas, and Arkansas culture is combined to create a vibrant and comfortable lifestyle.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the person family and friends call for advice if they’ve been ripped off? Do you have an instinct for spotting a scam and a relentless drive to help people who might have fallen victim? KSLA News 12 is looking for an Anchor/Consumer Reporter who isn't just a face behind a desk, but a champion for the ArkLaTex. We need an artful storyteller who thrives on getting answers and knows how to turn a complex consumer complaint into must-watch content—whether it’s a 30-second social clip or a deep-dive long-form investigation.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do: 

• Champion the consumer: Lead our "Getting Answers" brand by investigating local scams, retail rip-offs, and bureaucratic red tape with a sense of urgency that matches the frustration of our audience. 

• Anchor with authority: Command the desk for both digital and broadcast newscasts, delivering impactful news with the credibility our audience expects.
• Master visual storytelling: Use creative, high-impact visuals to break down complex data, crafting stories that are so visually engaging they leave the viewer wanting more.
• Own the digital space: Create daily, platform-specific content for social media and streaming that doesn't just repeat the broadcast but engages our digital audience where they live.
• Tell community stories: Find the human heart in every consumer issue, telling stories that resonate deeply with our local community and drive real change.

Qualifications/Requirements: 

What You Bring:

• A proven track record: 2-3 years of experience in a newsroom (consumer or investigative reporting experience is a massive plus).
• Visual eye: You understand that how a story looks is just as important as what is said; you’re a pro at using visuals to hook an audience and keep them watching.
• Digital fluency: You know how to stop the scroll on social media and understand that "digital-first" isn't just a buzzword—it's how we win.
• Relentless curiosity: You don't take "no comment" for an answer, and you’re comfortable digging through records to find the truth.
• Versatile storytelling: You can write a tight broadcast script, a compelling web article, and an engaging social thread with urgency and ease.
• On-air presence: You’re authentic, energetic, and authoritative, whether you’re in the field, on the anchor desk, or live streaming from your phone.
• Technical savvy: You’re comfortable with the tools of modern journalism, from mobile editing to navigating streaming platforms.

This dual-focus role leads day-to-day station IT operations and systems administration while serving as the primary backup to the Chief Engineer on core television technologies and broadcast facilities.

The ideal candidate possesses deep, fluent expertise in enterprise IT (networking, virtualization, cybersecurity, directory services, and storage) combined with a solid working knowledge of broadcast television systems (SDI/SMPTE ST 2110 signal flow, production switchers, master control automation, newsroom computer systems, and RF transmission basics). You will ensure uninterrupted on-air operations, maintain IT compliance with corporate standards, and serve as technical operations lead when the Chief Engineer is off-site.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

Information Technology & Systems Administration:
● Manage, configure, and maintain all local station IT infrastructure: Windows Server environments, Active Directory/Azure AD, group policies, and enterprise endpoint workstations (Windows/Mac).

● Manage local network topology, including Cisco/Arista/Dell L2/L3 enterprise switches, VLAN segmentation (separating broadcast production, corporate IT, Dante/AES67, and guest traffic), routing, firewalls, and VPN access.
● Champion station cybersecurity posture in alignment with Gray Media corporate IT: endpoint protection, patch management, access control, multi-factor authentication, and rapid security incident remediation.
● Provide direct IT escalation support for newsroom computer systems (ENPS/iNEWS), non-linear editing workflows (Adobe Creative Cloud, Avid, Edius), and field contribution units (LiveU, Dejero).
● Partner with Regional IT leadership and corporate engineering to plan, deploy, and document technology rollouts and software lifecycle upgrades.

● Act as the designated technical backup to the Chief Engineer, maintaining operational continuity across studio, control room, master control, and transmission facilities during absences or on-call emergencies.
● Support and troubleshoot broadcast production equipment, including production switchers (Grass Valley, Ross), Crispin master control automation, Chyron graphics engines, audio consoles (Wheatstone, Calrec), and multi-viewer/routing infrastructure.
● Understand SDI, HDMI, and IP-based media transport (SMPTE ST 2110, NDI, SRT, Dante/AES67) signal flow, conversion gear, and video monitoring systems.
● Assist in monitoring and basic first-line troubleshooting of transmission systems, microwave studio-to-transmitter links (STL), satellite downlinks, EAS decoders, and transmitter facility infrastructure (HVAC, liquid cooling systems, generators, and UPS units).
● Coordinate with production, news, and operations crews to resolve live on-air technical discrepancies quickly and calmly.
● Maintain accurate, up-to-date station wiring diagrams, network schematics, rack elevations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Leadership & Project Management:
● Lead and execute technology implementation projects from scoping and rack installation to commissioning and user training.
● Manage technical vendor relationships, RMA processes, warranties, and software support agreements.
● Promote a culture of proactive maintenance, cleanliness, security, and continuous improvement across all equipment racks and technical spaces.
● Participate in an engineering on-call rotation to support 24/7/365 news and broadcast operations.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Required Qualifications:
● 5+ years of combined hands-on experience in enterprise Information Technology systems administration and broadcast/media production environments.
● Proven expertise in Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, VMware/virtualized environments, and enterprise backup solutions.
● Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, managed switches, VLAN configurations, subnets, QoS, and network troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, traceroute, etc.).
● Working knowledge of basic television broadcast workflows and equipment (SDI signal paths, video routing switchers, audio distribution, sync/timing, and studio cameras).
● Familiarity with newsroom production systems (e.g., ENPS, iNEWS) and digital media encoding/transcoding formats.
● Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical problems rapidly under live broadcast deadlines.
● Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
● Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
● Availability to work flexible hours, including on-call response for breaking news, severe weather, off-hours maintenance windows, and emergencies.

Preferred Qualifications:
● Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent military/technical training.
● Relevant industry IT certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Certified, or VMware VCP).
● Broadcast engineering certifications such as SBE Certified Broadcast Technologist (CBT) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT).
● Familiarity with modern broadcast IP technologies (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6, Dante, Ravenna, NDI).
● Exposure to transmitter site fundamentals, RF systems, ATSC 1.0/3.0 exciters, or backup power generators.

The TMP is a technical lead for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions and is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are responsible for evaluating and assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. - During a live and/or studio broadcast production, recall video sources, transitions, and effects, and route studio monitors as instructed by Producers.

- Must be able to handle the pressures of live programming and limited time constraints

- Collaborates with Production Engineering, Technical Operations, and Production Management to identify and special-order any equipment needed for live or taped studio broadcast productions

- Knowledge of current industry standards

The Material Movement Specialist position in Lawrence is on 3rd Shift (11:30pm - 7:30am), Sunday night through Friday morning.

The Materials Movement Specialist reports through the Warehouse Department in the Lawrence Production Center.  Individuals in this department transport stock and recycled material to and from the warehouse to the production areas.   

 

The Materials Movement Specialist in Lawrence transports stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks.  Loads and unloads incoming and outgoing trucks.  Locates stock in the warehouse and fills orders for manufacturing using a variety of powered equipment.  Responsible for loading and unloading skids onto the vertical lift and using the elevator as necessary.  Responsible for sorting paper or other materials into proper recycling categories to ensure maximum revenue generation.  Acts as a technical resource to support departments on paper grading.  Operates paper, chip and poly balers to compress recyclable materials into bales.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.  Transports hazardous waste material in accordance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.   Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.  Incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

job.title: Lead Product Designer
job.description:
Tennis Channel is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape the future of our digital experiences across streaming (OTT), mobile, and web. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, craft, and execution. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and content teams to design industry-leading streaming applications that make tennis—and everything around it—more accessible to fans.

 

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking products from 0–1, brings strong design thinking to organizations ready for it, and loves solving complex, strategic problems through systems design. As an early hire in a growing product organization, you’ll help raise the bar for design quality, establish expectations of excellence, and influence how design shows up across the company. You’ll also learn how to take ideas from concept to production, help shift an organization toward a true product mindset, and grow through close 1:1 mentorship as part of a small, high-impact team.

 

We’re a team of tennis obsessives who care deeply about the sport and take pride in building great products together. We work hard, play hard, and genuinely enjoy collaborating with people who are curious, thoughtful, and passionate about what they do.

Tennis Channel operates multiple broadcast and digital platforms, including Tennis Channel, T2, Pickleball TV, and Tennis.com. While this role will focus on our dedicated OTT experiences, responsive web, and native mobile apps, you’ll be designing within a broader ecosystem that reaches fans wherever they watch and engage with the sport.

 

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end product experiences across OTT, mobile, and web — from early concepts and AI-assisted prototyping through high-fidelity execution

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, rapidly prototype and explore solutions using AI-powered tools, and ship high-quality work

  • Contribute to and help evolve the Tennis Channel design system, patterns, and accessibility standards

  • Evolve the brand look and feel across the digital ecosystem

  • Present work clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, articulating design rationale and tradeoffs

  • Participate in critiques and feedback loops, both giving and receiving thoughtful, actionable feedback

  • Conduct or collaborate on research to incorporate insights, testing, and validation into your design process

  • Balance multiple projects and priorities while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability

  • Model strong design processes and collaboration practices within the team, embracing AI-powered tools to accelerate prototyping, experimentation, and iteration.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a product designer working on consumer-facing digital products

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work, including complex flows and systems

  • Experience designing for mobile and web; OTT/TV experience is a strong plus

  • Excellent visual, interaction, and systems design skills with strong attention to detail

  • Comfort working in Figma, including components, libraries, and design systems

  • Experience using AI-powered tools to rapidly prototype, explore interactions, and accelerate design iteration. 

  • Solid understanding of accessibility, usability, and inclusive design principles

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and communicate clearly with non-design partners

  • Ability to think strategically while staying grounded in execution

  • Passion for sports, media, or entertainment products is a plus (tennis fans get bonus points)

  • Ability to work in person in Santa Monica three days per week

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $75,000.00-130,000.00 annually.

TMZ Sports is looking for a dynamic Producer who can break stories, write compelling copy, and become a familiar face on our television show. This isn't a behind-the-scenes role—we're looking for someone with strong editorial instincts, a great personality, and the confidence to regularly appear on camera, delivering sports news in an engaging, authentic way. The ideal candidate is an aggressive story hunter, an exceptional writer, and a natural communicator who knows how to connect with the audience.

If you live and breathe sports, thrive in a fast-paced newsroom, and can seamlessly transition from producing a story to appearing on-air, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Enterprise, pitch, and produce original sports stories with speed and accuracy.
  • Write compelling, fact-based copy for TMZ Sports across digital
  • Regularly appear on TMZ Sports on TV, delivering stories with confidence, personality, and credibility.
  • Develop and cultivate relationships with sources to generate exclusive stories and breaking news.
  • Monitor sports, entertainment, and social media trends to identify stories before everyone else.
  • Collaborate with producers, editors, to create social content
  • React quickly to breaking news while maintaining TMZ's editorial standards and voice.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience producing and writing in a digital or sports news environment.
  • Exceptional news judgment and strong writing skills.
  • Proven ability to enterprise original stories and break news.
  • Comfortable and confident appearing on camera with a natural, engaging presence.
  • Dynamic personality with the ability to connect with viewers and tell stories conversationally.
  • Deep knowledge of the sports landscape, athletes, leagues, and the stories driving conversation.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom while juggling multiple priorities.
  • Strong understanding of social media and emerging platforms as news-gathering tools.

TMZ is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Director, Ad Sales - TMZ
job.description:
The Director is a senior sales executive responsible for driving revenue and maximizing client investment across TMZ's portfolio of content, platforms, and distribution partners. This role develops strategic relationships with advertisers and agencies, delivering innovative marketing solutions that connect brands with TMZ's highly engaged audiences while demonstrating measurable business results. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader with extensive media sales experience, strong business acumen, and a passion for building lasting client partnerships.

Success in this role requires outstanding relationship management, strategic problem-solving, and the ability to deliver customized solutions that create meaningful value for clients and the business.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
Sales Revenue

  • Grow revenue across an assigned portfolio of clients by cultivating new business opportunities while strengthening and expanding existing partnerships
  • Create and deliver strategic, insight-driven proposals that align client objectives with TMZ's cross-platform capabilities, resulting in measurable outcomes and increased revenue
  • Drive advertising sales across TMZ's social media portfolio, developing integrated opportunities that maximize audience engagement and client value

Client Engagement

  • Serve as the lead strategic contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing trusted relationships with senior marketing, advertising, and agency decision-makers

Strategic Thinking

Team Leadership & Culture

job.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead a high-volume Accounts Payable shared services function. This role is responsible for overseeing large-scale invoice processing and company-wide payment operations across multiple business units.

The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure strong internal controls, and lead continuous process improvement initiatives. This role requires a hands-on leader with deep expertise in high-volume environments, AP systems, and scalable procure-to-pay operations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing AP team in a shared services environment
  • Lead automation initiatives (OCR, touchless processing, AI-driven capture tools)
  • Set clear goals, provide ongoing feedback, and conduct performance evaluations
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-driven culture
  • Oversee end-to-end processing of high-volume invoice intake and payment execution across multiple payment methods
  • Oversee AP account reconciliations, return payments, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies
  • Oversee company-wide payment and settlement processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Manage throughput, backlog, and workload distribution to maintain operational efficiency
  • Drive cycle time reduction and improve processing accuracy
  • Increase straight-through processing (STP) and reduce manual intervention
  • Identify and implement scalable process improvements across the procure-to-pay lifecycle
