job.title: Manager Care Ops (LatAm)
job.description:
El puesto de Gerente, Operaciones de Atención al Cliente - LATAM es una posición de liderazgo clave en la intersección entre la ejecución en primera línea y las operaciones estratégicas. Este rol es responsable de habilitar un soporte al cliente escalable y de alta calidad en toda América Latina, brindando a los agentes la guía, las herramientas y los procesos que necesitan para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a los clientes.

Serás el socio operativo principal para el equipo de atención al cliente de LATAM, trabajando de forma multifuncional con los equipos de Atención al Cliente, Marketing, Producto y Tecnología para operacionalizar iniciativas, evaluar impactos y mantener comunicaciones de primer nivel con los agentes. Se requiere dominio del español para asegurar una colaboración genuina con los equipos y stakeholders regionales.

Operaciones de Atención al Cliente y Habilitación de Agentes

  • Ser responsable de impulsar comunicaciones claras y consistentes hacia los agentes a través de múltiples productos e iniciativas, asegurando que los equipos de primera línea estén preparados, informados y capacitados para atender las consultas de los clientes.
  • Diseñar, mantener y gobernar el contenido de la intranet, los procedimientos operativos estándar y las herramientas de ventas/soporte que mejoren la preparación, el compromiso y el desempeño de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la calidad, precisión y consistencia de toda la documentación operativa y dirigida a los agentes.
  • Desarrollar y mantener un conocimiento profundo de las operaciones de Atención al Cliente, incluyendo sistemas, flujos de trabajo y particularidades regionales del mercado de LATAM.
  • Crear, actualizar y gestionar documentación operativa dentro de las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento aprobadas.

Liderazgo de Proyectos Operativos

  • Liderar iniciativas y flujos de trabajo operativos que impactan a Atención al Cliente, aplicando las mejores prácticas de gestión de proyectos, actuando como socio operativo integrado más que como una función formal de PMO.
  • Evaluar y comunicar con claridad el impacto operativo y en la experiencia del cliente de nuevas iniciativas, promociones, lanzamientos de herramientas o cambios en los sistemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para definir requisitos, cronogramas, dependencias y factores de riesgo relacionados con las operaciones de Atención al Cliente.
  • Mantener a los stakeholders informados y alineados sobre el avance de los proyectos, especialmente aquellos que afectan a los agentes y clientes de LATAM.
  • Aplicar resolución de problemas estructurada y disciplina operativa para resolver desafíos de forma rápida y sostenible.

Datos, Insights y Reportes

  • Usar datos para identificar tendencias de desempeño, brechas y oportunidades en las operaciones de atención al cliente y la experiencia de los agentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Analítica, Herramientas y Tecnología, y Marketing para desarrollar y mantener reportes sobre el desempeño de los agentes y los resultados de la experiencia del cliente.
  • Traducir los insights basados en datos en recomendaciones concretas que equilibren la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio.

Colaboración y Liderazgo

  • Ser el socio principal de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente de LATAM, construyendo relaciones multifuncionales sólidas con stakeholders de toda la organización.
  • Defender la experiencia del agente en primera línea y del cliente, alineándose con las metas y prioridades más amplias de la organización.
  • Fomentar una cultura de claridad, responsabilidad y mejora continua dentro de las operaciones de atención al cliente.
  • Promover el intercambio de conocimiento y el desarrollo del equipo dentro de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente.

Eres un(a) profesional experimentado(a) en operaciones de atención al cliente que se desenvuelve con soltura en la intersección entre ejecución y estrategia. Sabes traducir situaciones complejas y ambiguas en acciones operativas claras, y te importa tanto la gente que hace el trabajo como los resultados que genera.

  • Tienes experiencia de liderazgo en entornos de atención al cliente y entiendes lo que se necesita para mantener a los equipos de primera línea capacitados y efectivos.
  • Navegas la ambigüedad con confianza, transformando la complejidad en indicaciones claras y accionables.
  • Equilibras la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio sin perder de vista ninguna de las dos.
  • Eres una persona muy organizada, detallista y proactiva, que anticipa necesidades antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
  • Comunicas con claridad y confianza tanto a audiencias técnicas como no técnicas, desde agentes hasta ejecutivos.
  • Te motiva mejorar la forma en que trabajan los equipos, no solo gestionar tareas, sino construir sistemas y hábitos que escalen.
  • 5-7 años de experiencia en Operaciones de Atención al Cliente, Gestión de Programas o Liderazgo Operativo.
  • Experiencia demostrable trabajando con herramientas y tecnologías de contact center: CRM, plataformas de chat, sistemas de telefonía, bases de conocimiento y herramientas relacionadas.
  • Capacidad demostrada para liderar iniciativas operativas multifuncionales desde la definición del alcance hasta la ejecución.
  • Sólidas habilidades de documentación, comunicación y organización; estableces el estándar de claridad.
  • Tomador(a) de decisiones basado(a) en datos, con capacidad para convertir insights en acción.
  • Se requiere dominio del español (escrito y verbal).
  • Licenciatura o experiencia profesional equivalente.
  • Experiencia previa apoyando operaciones de atención al cliente en LATAM.
  • Familiaridad con Salesforce o plataformas CRM comparables.
  • Experiencia en comunicaciones con agentes, gestión del cambio o disciplinas de gestión del conocimiento.
  • Se valora el manejo de herramientas creativas o de producción (por ejemplo, Adobe Creative Suite).
  • Se requiere horario flexible
  • Es posible que se requieran viajes ocasionales

job.title: Vice President, Legal, FOX News Media
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking a lawyer to support its efforts to develop emerging businesses.  Reporting to the Executive Vice President & General Counsel for FOX News Media, this VP role will draft, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of digital agreements encompassing commerce, sponsored content, syndication, podcasts, and other strategic initiatives.  This role is based in New York City and has a five-day, in-office requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

  • Draft, review, and negotiate agreements for FOX News Media involving licensing, syndication, commerce, sponsored content, digital partnerships, and audio and podcasting, among other initiatives
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on deal structure, legal risk, and strategy for commerce and other strategic initiatives
  • Set legal negotiating strategy and positions for complex, high-value partnerships
  • Prepare and negotiate proof of concept, partnership, master services, SaaS, and other long-form agreements, along with related statements of work
  • Collaborate with legal and business stakeholders across Fox Corporation (e.g., IP, privacy, compliance) to close deals efficiently

  • Review and advise on wide variety of vendor agreements, often on a quick timeline

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Minimum 10 years of experience at a law firm or as an in-house lawyer with a media, technology, or digital focus
  • Extensive experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Experience with agreements related to digital content licensing, syndication, artificial intelligence, audio/podcasting, commerce, affiliate marketing, and digital advertising
  • Strong negotiating, drafting, and communication skills
  • Sound independent judgment and ability to advise senior business stakeholders with confidence
  • Collaborative team player with strong organizational skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Pragmatic, business-minded approach to legal issues
  • Previous experience working in the media industry or with media clients strongly preferred

job.title: Part Time Security Officer
job.description:
The Fox Studio Lot is looking for Part-Time Security Officers. The Fox Security Officer’s top priority is to provide a safe and secure work environment for our employees, guests, clients, and vendors.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Observe and report activities or incidents at an assigned site, providing for the security and safety of studio property and personnel

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

About UDX FRANCHISE, PRODUCTS & PARTNERSHIPS:

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.  www.udxfpp.com

 

 

We are seeking a highly creative and trend-driven Senior Designer to lead the product development of innovative product collections across Seasonal Merchandise, In theater, and Lifestyle categories. This role is responsible for driving concept creation, product design, trend forecasting, and category strategy while partnering closely with merchandising, sourcing, product development, and cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong aesthetic vision with commercial awareness and has experience translating market trends into customer-focused products that deliver both style and business results.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000

Product Design & Development

  • Lead end-to-end design development for Seasonal product categories from concept through production.
  • Proficient in drawing/illustration (including character poses, expressions, and turnarounds), design, perspective, and composition.
  • A solid understanding of 2D to 3D translations.
  • Create original product concepts, mood boards, color palettes, prints, patterns, assets, and product specifications.
  • Develop seasonal collections aligned with brand direction, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  • Ensure design consistency and quality across multiple categories and product lines.
  • Be an expert in all creative assets to provide accurate PD feedback.

Trend Research & Market Analysis

  • Conduct ongoing research on consumer trends, color direction, materials, lifestyle shifts, and competitive landscape.
  • Identify emerging opportunities in home décor, gifting, seasonal events, and lifestyle products.
  • Translate trend insights into commercially viable product strategies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with merchandising, sourcing, suppliers, manufacturers, business teams, and retail leadership to ensure seamless product execution aligned with design vision, cost objectives, and project timelines.
  • Collaborate with overseas vendors and manufacturing partners on product refinements, material selection, and production approvals.
  • Support line reviews, assortment planning, and product presentations.

Technical & Production Support

  • Prepare design packages including CADs, specifications, colorways, materials, and artwork files.
  • Review prototypes, samples, and production submissions.
  • Ensure products meet quality standards, functionality requirements, and cost objectives.
  • Perform other related duties assigned to support the needs of the team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Product Design, Industrial Design, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in product design within home décor, seasonal products, gift, or lifestyle categories.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating commercial product development and trend-forward design.
  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
    • CAD tools
    • Microsoft Office / presentation software
  • Experience working with global sourcing partners and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong understanding of materials, finishes, textiles, trims, packaging, and product construction.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal and able to provide clear direction.
  • Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a dynamic, deadline driven environment that revolves around multiple product development calendars.
  • Experience managing multiple categories simultaneously in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, proactive – a self-starter.
  • Solution oriented.
  • Excellent organization skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Resourceful in troubleshooting issues.
  • Multitasker
  • A team player

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with mass retail, specialty retail, private label, or licensing programs.
  • Background in home décor, tabletop, soft goods, gifting, novelty, or seasonal assortments.
  • Knowledge of trend forecasting platforms and consumer research tools.
  • Experience managing multiple categories simultaneously in fast-paced environments.

Portfolio

  • PORTFOLIO SUBMISSION GUIDLINES: Please submit a professional portfolio 
    demonstrating strong product ideation, sketching, creative problem-solving, and design development is highly preferred. Examples of Home Décor and Seasonal Merchandise, Gifting, and Lifestyle, or other three-dimensional product design are strongly preferred. Portfolios must showcase the full product development lifecycle, from concept to shelf, and include examples of sketches, trend research, pattern and print development, overlays/redlines, technical design packages (tech packs), sampling iterations, and final produced products. All submitted work must be the candidate's original work, with clear examples of their individual design contributions.

 

Additional Requirements:

  • Travel may be required

The ideal candidate is an enterprising, multiplatform journalist with strong live reporting skills, excellent news judgment, and the ability to tell compelling stories for both English- and Spanish-language audiences. This reporter will play an important role in our duopoly approach to news coverage, working seamlessly across both stations to maximize original reporting, share content effectively, and serve the diverse communities of the New York Tri-State area.

The reporter must be equally comfortable covering breaking news, developing enterprise and community-driven stories, conducting live interviews, producing content for multiple platforms, and adapting storytelling for the audiences of WNBC and WNJU.

  • Cover breaking news and major events from the field through live shots, interviews, digital updates, and packaged reports.

  • Contribute to special projects, major event coverage, investigative or enterprise initiatives, and other duopoly-wide editorial efforts.
  • Represent WNBC and WNJU at community events and public appearances as assigned.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of local, national, and international news developments.
  • Uphold NBCUniversal journalistic standards, ethics, and editorial guidelines.
  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of reporting experience in a television news environment.
  • Full proficiency in English and Spanish, including speaking, writing, translating, interviewing, and live reporting.
  • Strong live reporting, interviewing, writing, and storytelling skills.
  • Experience covering breaking news and developing stories under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment.
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to make sound decisions in fast-moving news situations.
  • Ability to work independently in the field and collaborate effectively within a team environment.
  • Experience creating content for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media platforms.
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during major news events.

  • Experience working across English- and Spanish-language news operations or in a bilingual/multicultural newsroom.

job.title: Manager, Internal Audit, Risk and Analytics
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  • Plan and lead risk‑based analytics to support operational audits, advisory work, and special projects across corporate, media, streaming, advertising, and production areas
  • Develop focused project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments aligned to key business priorities
  • Design flexible approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring solid professional judgment
  • Use analytics to evaluate processes, controls, and governance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and growth
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks across areas such as production, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, and revenue
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations
  • Lead or support special projects through data collection, validation, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations
  • Build robust relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners, including SOX, Compliance, Finance, and Legal
  • Communicate results and recommendations clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact in an accessible language
  • Create recommendations that fit the business needs. When needed, promote remediation plans while keeping a focus on solutions
  • Serve as a trusted advisor while maintaining sovereignty and objectivity
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards
  • Advance the team’s shift toward insight‑driven, judgment‑based auditing
  • Contribute to annual risk assessments and audit planning using data and industry insights
  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities
  • Assess audit and operational risks, design effective analytics procedures, identify control gaps, and manage multiple engagements in a dynamic environment
  • Apply sound judgment, professional skepticism, and well-developed communication skills to drive outcomes and maintain high standards of quality and integrity
  Basic Qualifications  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline
  Additional Qualifications  
  • Experience leading or executing analytics-driven reviews, including areas such as T&E, production, vendor payments, or revenue-related processes
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred
  • Professional certification(s) such as CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA, or equivalent (active or in progress) preferred
     

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (Kochava, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship, SalesForce Marketing Cloud).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

• Solid understanding of GraphQL — schema design, resolvers, federation

• Solid knowledge of the HTML DOM and Event APIs

• Experience with microservices and distributed systems

• Experience with GraphQL, PHP

• Working knowledge of Docker and CI tools

As Principal Product Manager, Ads Monetization, you’ll use machine learning and AI to help Paramount+ and Pluto TV earn more from advertising while keeping the viewing experience great. Sitting within our Consumer AI group, you’ll do two things: lead the product direction for ML-driven improvements to our ad systems, and act as the Ads team’s go-to product partner for AI/ML needs. Decisions with significant budget, privacy or advertiser-contract implications are made jointly with the hiring manager or relevant committees.

job.title: Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
The Cincinnati Enquirer/cincinnati.com part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a digital-first reporter to be part of the Breaking News team.

Job Details:

This reporter will be at the center of the region's biggest stories, from breaking crime and public safety news to severe weather. The reporter understands that breaking news is often the front door to deeper accountability and enterprise reporting.  A great breaking news reporter cuts through official-speak and lets the community know what’s happening clearly and concisely. We’re looking for a reporter who goes beyond standard press releases, digging into how and why things happen. Reporters on this team also pursue explainers, features and other enterprise stories that reflect life in Greater Cincinnati.  The position requires urgency, curiosity, accuracy and a willingness to chase news wherever it leads. It also demands strong news judgment and the ability to find and identify stories with impact and reflect the community through the inclusion of a variety of voices.

About The Enquirer:

The Enquirer, founded in 1851, serves communities in southwest Ohio and Northern Kentucky. With major league sports (go Bengals!), a blossoming food and craft beer scene, hundreds of parks, world-class performing arts and eight Fortune 500 companies, Cincinnati offers the amenities of a big city with the comfort and charm of a small town.

Responsibilities:

Monitor real-time news and sniff out stories that are important to our audiences.

Report quickly, clearly and accurately and deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok or any other methods available to reach our audience and develop new audiences.

Use metrics to inform story choices and shape beat strategies.

Work a schedule that may include nights, weekends and whenever news demands.

Work with editors to experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and through alternate story forms. This includes long-tail (evergreen) content.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

2 + years of reporting experience, applicants with less experience and strong clips may be considered.

Proven ability to write on deadline.

Exceptional core journalism skills (reporter, producing, editing). Strong command of AP grammar and style.

Familiarity with public records and their use in reporting.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Photo and video skills.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Knows how to use time effectively in a 24-hour news environment.

Works collaboratively within a cross-functional environment.

Must embrace peer-to-peer feedback and training.

Applies innovative, creative thinking to support the company's goals.

Industry knowledge.

Organizational skills.

Command of media law and Principles of Ethical Conduct.

This position sometimes requires employees to work extended hours, evening, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly.

job.title: Video Producer
job.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video.

The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities.

Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs.

Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards.

Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings.

Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content.

Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential.

Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage.

Create useful explainers that make complex local topics clear, accessible and relevant to the communities our newsrooms serve.

Turn newsroom briefs and published stories into clear video treatments, selecting effective visuals, scripts, on-screen text, audio, pacing and formats.

Adapt local journalism into platform-native vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other platforms.

Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform.

Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights.

Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism.

Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs.

Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation.

Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners.

Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use.

Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

What success looks like:

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs.

More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms.

Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage.

Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency.

Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity.

Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets.

AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism.

A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story.

Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards.

Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs.

Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment.

A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams.

Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production.

Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

Qualifications:

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field.

Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools.

Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to create concise scripts, captions, headlines and on-screen text.

Ability to work independently, make sound editorial decisions on deadline and collaborate across newsrooms and time zones.

Experience working with local newsrooms or producing video from local reporting is preferred.

job.title: Revenue Operations Manager
job.description:
About the role

The Revenue Operations Manager owns everything that happens after a deal closes. You make sure campaigns launch on time, run as planned, and are set up to renew, and you make sure what each campaign teaches us shapes the next one. Sales owns the commercial relationship; you own delivery quality, O&O ad operations, buying, measurement, workflow, vendors and team capacity.

Launch Point runs two sides of one revenue cycle. Presale support (Digital Strategist and Sales Enablement) helps Sales win the work. Post-sale delivery, which you lead, gets it done. Closed deals move between the two through a single documented handoff, and you are the person who accepts it.

What you will own

  • Team leadership. Lead the Campaign Coordinators and Media Operations Lead, with the two Ad Order Entry Specialists reporting through the Media Operations Lead. Set workload, priorities and standards.
  • Handoff and kickoff. Accept closed-won handoffs, run internal kickoffs, and return incomplete submissions to Sales.
  • Delivery workflow. Maintain delivery workflows, QA checklists and turnaround standards across digital, O&O and print.
  • O&O ad operations. Own creative execution and standards for all O&O placements, including premium executions like Home Page Takeovers, and oversee seller submissions and changes. Work with product and technology teams to improve ad position performance, CTR and site speed.
  • Vendors and partners. Manage managed-service vendors and partners, including terms and escalations.
  • Media buying. Oversee buying across Google Ads, Meta, DV360, Basis and other DSPs, including programmatic and CTV. Set buying standards, review plans and optimizations, and step in hands-on on complex or high-value campaigns.
  • Conversion tracking and attribution. Own conversion tracking setup and attribution across campaigns using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, connecting all media platforms (Meta, Basis, Reddit, Google Ads and others) and client CRM data so performance ties back to client goals and ROI.
  • CRM integration and automation. Connect HubSpot with ad platforms, call tracking and client CRMs, and automate handoffs, status updates and reporting to reduce manual work.
  • Book health. Monitor pacing, delivery issues, margin and client retention risk across all accounts.
  • Reporting and insights. Work with Sales Enablement to keep post-sale data in HubSpot and client reporting dashboards accurate. Pair results with insights, open questions and recommended next steps, so each report gives Sales a reason to revisit client priorities and uncover new needs.
  • Campaign learnings. Capture what worked across audiences, creative and channels, and make sure those learnings carry into the next campaign.
  • Visibility. Report delivery health, staffing capacity and issues to the Director, and escalate systemic risks early.

What you will partner on

  • Sales. Clean handoffs in, renewal and upsell conversations out. Sales owns the client relationship and commercial decisions; you bring the performance insights and recommendations that support those conversations.
  • Digital Strategist. Making sure what was sold is what gets delivered, and turning campaign learnings into specific recommendations for the next plan and for broader client growth.
  • Audience-based sponsorships. Help Sales and the Digital Strategist spot high-impact sponsorships that pair O&O assets with the full digital media platform, such as sports, holiday initiatives, music events and other major community moments.
  • Product and technology. Ad position performance, page and ad load issues, and site changes that improve O&O delivery.
  • Sales Enablement. HubSpot fields, the handoff checklist, and reporting templates.
  • Agency. Coordination on accounts over $5,000 per month and other complex opportunities.

What you bring

  • 8 or more years in agency operations, ad operations, account services or campaign delivery at an agency, media company or publisher.
  • Two or more years leading people, including setting priorities and coaching.
  • Hands-on buying experience in Google Ads, Meta and at least one DSP (Basis, DV360 or similar), plus working knowledge of O&O, programmatic, CTV, search and social delivery and managed-service relationships.
  • O&O ad operations experience: creative specs, premium and takeover placements, ad server trafficking (GAM preferred), and working with product or development teams on ad load and site performance issues.
  • Experience setting up conversion tracking and reporting on attribution with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and CRM data, and explaining performance and ROI to clients.
  • Experience integrating a CRM with ad platforms and other tools, and automating workflows and reporting.
  • Process discipline: you build checklists and standards that hold up under volume.
  • Comfort with pacing, budget and margin math, and with CRM reporting.
  • Clear communication with sellers, clients, vendors and leadership, including turning performance data into practical recommendations.

Bonus points: HubSpot administration or integration experience; Google Ads, Google Analytics or Basis certifications; experience with sponsorships or event-driven media packages; print production exposure; experience building an operations function rather than inheriting one.

Why Work at the Tampa Bay Times

  • Be part of an organization committed to public service and journalistic excellence.
  • Support a diverse workforce that includes newsroom, production and corporate teams.
  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.
  • Health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental and vision plans.
  • 100% employer-paid short-term and long-term disability and basic life insurance.
  • Supplemental life insurance and flexible spending account options.
  • Tax-deferred savings plan for retirement.
  • A generous PTO program and much more.

Success requires a commitment to partner service and a drive to grow revenue. Business development will focus on expanding existing relationships across technology and media, primarily in the business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) space. External prospecting is outside this role’s scope.

You will be part of a collaborative team, sharing insights, contributing ideas, and working toward shared goals. You will receive direct training, coaching, and mentorship while taking increasing ownership of your accounts. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through independently, welcomes feedback, and helps improve both our partnerships and how we work together.

What you will do

  • Own partner relationships. Manage a portfolio of technology and media accounts, developing a strong understanding of each partner’s goals, products, audiences, and priorities. Build trust through thoughtful engagement, responsive service, and reliable follow-through.
  • Know the data. Analyze revenue, API usage, audience engagement, referral traffic, and other relevant metrics. Investigate changes, recognize opportunities, and turn findings into recommendations that improve performance and support partner goals.
  • Lead business reviews. Prepare and conduct regular partner meetings and quarterly business reviews that demonstrate value, assess performance, and look ahead. Work with partners to identify priorities, explore opportunities, and agree on actions and next steps.
  • Tell the AccuWeather story. Learn how AccuWeather’s forecast accuracy, scientific expertise, and proprietary offerings—including AccuWeather MinuteCast® and RealFeel®—help partners deliver differentiated experiences and enable users to make more confident decisions.
  • Bring fresh opportunities to partners. Gather relevant product updates, innovations, success stories, awards, and achievements from across AccuWeather. Connect them to each partner’s needs to strengthen their offerings and expand the value of the relationship.
  • Grow existing accounts. Identify where additional AccuWeather capabilities can advance partner goals through expanded usage, new products, new applications, and broader partnerships. Develop account plans, advance commercial opportunities, and achieve revenue growth targets.
  • Collaborate and advocate for partners. Bring partner needs, feedback, and ideas into AccuWeather. Work with product, technical account management, forecasting, marketing, finance, legal, and other teams to resolve issues, develop solutions, and advance shared opportunities.
  • Present with clarity and impact. Develop and deliver presentations for partners and internal audiences. Use compelling narratives, clear visuals, and well-presented data to communicate results, explain opportunities, and support decisions.
  • Use AI to increase effectiveness. Apply AI tools to research, analysis, presentation development, and routine workflows to improve efficiency and the quality of your work. Explore emerging capabilities and use judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information.
  • Maintain account discipline. Keep account plans, CRM records, revenue forecasts, commitments, and follow-up actions accurate and current. Track contractual obligations, renewals, and emerging risks.

What you bring

  • Energy and enthusiasm: You take an active interest in your work, engage thoughtfully with people, and bring momentum to opportunities and challenges.
  • Curiosity and a learning mindset: You ask good questions, seek context, and enjoy building expertise in unfamiliar subjects.
  • Coachability: You listen to feedback, put it into practice, and take responsibility for improving your work.
  • A commitment to partner service: You listen carefully, seek to understand what success means for your partners, and care about helping them achieve it.
  • Commercial motivation: You want to achieve measurable revenue growth by connecting partner needs with valuable business opportunities.
  • An interest in data: You like working with numbers, investigating what drives performance, and explaining what the findings mean.
  • Communication and visual storytelling: You enjoy—or are motivated to develop your ability in—presenting to others and translating complex information into clear conversations, written updates, and visually effective presentations.
  • Self-awareness and ownership: You understand that your actions, communication, and follow-through affect partners and teammates. You take responsibility for your work, acknowledge mistakes, seek help when needed, and act on what you learn.
  • Initiative and independent judgment: You organize your work, solve problems, and move priorities forward while recognizing when to seek guidance.
  • Teamwork and collaboration: You enjoy working within a team, share knowledge and ideas, and support your colleagues. You contribute to shared goals and look for ways to improve how the team works together.
  • AI curiosity and adaptability: You follow emerging AI tools and trends and actively look for ways to use them to improve productivity, strengthen your work, and increase your impact.

Relevant experience and skills

  • Experience in account management, customer success, partnerships, business development, or a related client-facing setting. Relevant experience may come from employment, internships, or substantial academic, volunteer, or leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong organization and the ability to manage multiple relationships, priorities, and commitments.
  • Comfort using spreadsheets to analyze data and presentation tools to communicate findings.
  • Practical familiarity with generative AI tools and a willingness to build proficiency in applying them to business tasks.

Your partners view you as a trusted, proactive resource who understands their business and helps them achieve meaningful results. Responsibilities Research and develop AI music models: Design and develop machine learning models for music generation, transformation, remixing, and creative interaction. Explore emerging technologies: Investigate advances in generative audio, music understanding, audio representation learning, and related areas of machine learning. Translate research into products: Turn research ideas and prototypes into practical, high-quality AI capabilities, working closely with engineering and music technology teams. Collaborate with creative teams: Work closely with producers, musicians, and cross-functional teams to understand creative workflows and develop intuitive, musically meaningful tools. Champion responsible AI development: Consider music rights, training data provenance, artist consent, and attribution throughout model development. Qualifications Advanced degree (PhD or MS) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Signal Processing, Music Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and statistical methods, with experience developing and evaluating ML models. Experience with audio or music-related machine learning, such as generative audio, music understanding, audio representation learning, source separation, or signal processing. Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks, such as PyTorch. Familiarity with audio processing libraries, datasets, and evaluation techniques. Ability to conduct independent applied research and translate research insights into working prototypes and real-world applications. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and creative disciplines. Genuine interest in music, creative tools, and the ways technology can expand musical expression. Bonus Qualifications Experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying generative audio or music models, including diffusion-based, autoregressive, or other neural audio architectures. Experience with audio codecs, neural vocoders, audio tokenization, text-audio models, or multimodal learning. Familiarity with agent frameworks and workflow orchestration tools for building multi-step AI applications. Familiarity with music production workflows, DAWs, audio plugins, or creative software. Experience collaborating directly with producers, musicians, or other creative professionals to develop or evaluate AI-powered tools. Experience building low-latency, interactive audio systems or deploying ML models in production environments. Experience designing evaluation methods for subjective qualities such as musicality, expressiveness, controllability, and creative utility. Knowledge of responsible AI practices for music, including rights-aware dataset development, artist consent, data provenance, and attribution. Research publications or contributions in machine learning, audio processing, generative AI, or music information retrieval. Our Approach to Responsible AI Music At Hook, we believe AI should expand what people can do with music while respecting the people who create it. We build with artists and rightsholders in mind, and we aim to develop AI tools that support creative expression rather than undermine the value of human creativity. This means taking a thoughtful approach to the music and data used in model development, respecting rights and permissions, and considering how our technology affects artists, producers, and the broader music ecosystem. We value researchers who bring both technical ambition and a strong sense of responsibility to their work, and who see ethical considerations as an integral part of building great products. What We Offer The opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered music creation and expression. Freedom to explore ambitious research ideas and influence technical and product direction. Close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, music technologists, and producers. The opportunity to see your research become real tools used in creative workflows. A mission-driven environment focused on making music more interactive, accessible, and expressive while respecting the people behind it. Support for continued learning, research, and professional growth. Competitive compensation and benefits.

job.title: Senior Multimedia Producer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Senior Multimedia Producer to run end-to-end production on branded video and podcast formats in Guardian multimedia products - primarily Guardian Studios’ shows. 

 

About the role

  • Work closely with Guardian editorial teams and talent to develop, execute and deliver creative branded formats integrated into editorial video and podcast shows.
  • Efficiently manage high-volume, multi-title production workflows across a content slate. 
  • Produce branded assets for multiple shows and episodes on a weekly basis
  • Oversee production processes through the full project lifecycle
  • Manage client relationships, being the ‘client in the room’ for shoots and balancing client objectives with editorial integrity.
  • Create and manage budgets and schedules - ensuring each project is delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest possible standards. 

 

About you

  • Must have branded content or commercial producer credits
  • Must have experience with client management 
  • Demonstrable experience line producing video productions and a detailed understanding of the end-to-end production process
  • Strong understanding of the Guardian and Guardian Advertising 
  • Experience working with talent – including experience scripting for talent and directing talent on set.
  • (desirable) experience with cameras and editing software: ability to edit smoothly and accurately at pace 

 

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements. 

 

How to apply

 

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Wednesday 18th November 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Karen Walter on karen.walter@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and Pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

 

Guardian News and Media is proud to be a London Living wage employer. The minimum salary for any full-time role within the organisation is £30,000 per annum. Salary ranges are dependent on skills and experience.

Job Location: Washington, DC or anywhere (Continental US) (If local, on-site Tuesdays and Wednesdays)
Reports To: Director, Engineering
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary:

The Lead Software Engineer for our Portals team will be a key contributor to full lifecycle software development while coaching, leading, and mentoring their small technical team. This role oversees the technical details and day-to-day execution of all new features and operational activities within the development team in collaboration with the technical product owner. The Lead Engineer is a critical element in our agile delivery process for new features and capabilities to support our growing music royalty processing platform.

Essential Functions:

• Provide hands-on technical leadership to a small team of software engineers
• Collaborate across teams to estimate, design, develop, support, test, and deliver data driven solutions
• Facilitate architecture discussions and decision-making both within and across teams
• Interface with key project stakeholders, mentor team members, and promote and improve software engineering practices
• Demonstrate responsibility, accountability, and dedication to engineering team and company success
• Establish and promote use of technologies and processes that lower risk and increase efficiency
• Support and improve software development standards and best practices, including generative coding, peer reviews, and source control
• Support and improve existing software applications and design, or collaborate on designing, new software applications or features
• Take responsibility for full Agile SDLC, especially from refinement to release
• Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear expectations, providing timely feedback, supporting growth, and fostering a collaborative and accountable work environment

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

• Proficiency at designing and developing software using many of the following: Python, Django, SQL (Postgres), AWS (S3, ECS, OpenSearch, RDS, Cloudfront, etc.), JavaScript, Typescript, JPax, Git, Kiro
• Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
• Experience with Vue3 or other UI frameworks
• Experience with migrating legacy application to modern technologies
• Experience building enterprise software with complex business rules and data models
• Experience designing and developing microservices or other distributed systems
• Experience with scaling to work with large data sets
• Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members, peers, and business partners
• Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
• 7 or more years of experience in software engineering
• At least 2 years of experience leading a software engineering team

ADA Specifications:

• This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
• This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

• If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (3-4 times per year).

 

PAY RANGE: $171,000.00 - $209,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

SoundExchange is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.  If you need an accommodation, please email jobs@soundexchange.com.

job.title: Promoter's Assistant, Outdoor Shows
job.description:
Job Summary:

Company: Cuffe & Taylor

Department: Outdoor Promoters

Location: Preston, Lancashire or Farringdon, London

Reports to: Executive Assistant to the Outdoor Promoters

Working Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week with extra weekend working throughout festival season onsite. Some travel required.

Job Type: Permanent

 

Role Description

 

Cuffe & Taylor is one of the UK’s leading live music, theatre and entertainment promoters, delivering major concerts, festivals and tours across the UK and internationally.

 

The company has worked with some of the world’s biggest artists, including Diana Ross, Lionel Richie, Britney Spears, Kylie, Lewis Capaldi, Sam Fender, Stevie Wonder, Justin Timberlake, Noah Kahan, Alanis Morissette, Robbie Williams, Richard Ashcroft, Becky Hill, Biffy Clyro and Fatboy Slim.

 

Its extensive outdoor portfolio includes Lytham Festival, Blackweir, Live at Powderham, Scarborough Open Air Theatre, Live at The Piece Hall, Blenheim Palace Festival, Bedford Summer Sessions, Depot Live at Cardiff Castle, Forest Live and Live at Lincoln Castle.

 

Cuffe & Taylor also operates a successful UK and international theatre touring division, programming thousands of performances across live entertainment, podcasts, screen-to-stage adaptations and musical theatre. In 2023, its original production Hey Duggee – The Live Theatre Show won the Olivier Award for Best Family Show.

 

The Promoter Assistant will be a key member of the Outdoor Promoter team, providing support in the programming and delivery of festivals, concerts and tours. The role covers the administrative side of events, from the offer letter stage right through to settlement, which involves working closely with the Operations, Finance, Ticketing, Marketing and Production and Artist Liaison teams.

 

The role will also involve diary management, scheduling and preparation for meetings, travel logistics for the Promoter team and general administration, including filing and coding of expenses.

 

We are looking for someone with excellent organisational, administrative and communication skills and a keen eye for detail, who can manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced live events environment. Experience in artist management, agency and/or promoter administration would be advantageous, particularly within live music and touring. Flexibility and a willingness to travel and work on site during the summer months, including evenings and weekends, will be required

 

What it’s like to work in the Team

 

Cuffe & Taylor is made up of a diverse group of individuals, but we all share the same passion for putting our employees first. We have a fun atmosphere within the team, which helps us maintain an open, approachable department, and build genuinely authentic and valuable relationships with our employees. We are committed to working as a team and so support each other to achieve wins.

 

Who you are

 

Competencies / Skills / Knowledge / Experience

 

Essential

  • Demonstrable experience of live music or events administration
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure and tight deadlines
  • A self-starter with excellent organisational and administrative skills
  • Excellent IT skills including Microsoft Office and Adobe
  • Excellent formatting skills
  • Exemplary attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills

 

Desirable

  • Experience with Monday.com, Jotform, Claude

 

Behaviours

 

The following attributes determine how the role will be carried out and are required to be a success


  • Extremely well organised and self-motivated
  • High level of integrity and discretion
  • Flexibility – ability to respond to constantly shifting priorities
  • Sound judgement and level-headedness
  • Proactive approach to problem solving
  • Effective communicator with the ability to interact with staff across all levels of the organisation

What the role includes


  • Work closely with the Executive Assistant to the Outdoor Promoters and the wider Promoter team to deliver events and festivals in collaboration with the Operations, Ticketing, Marketing, Finance and Customer Service teams
  • Diary management for the Promoter team
  • Keep accurate financial records for all confirmed shows
  • Mark up all agency confirmations and contracts in line with Live Nation guidelines
  • Schedule show announcements and coordinate relevant teams to ensure the best on-sale experience for all involved
  • Work on site at events and festivals, including evenings and weekends, when required
  • Liaise with heads of department across Cuffe & Taylor, the wider Live Nation group and high-profile external stakeholders
  • Manage Promoter guest ticketing and accreditation requests
  • Book travel and hotels throughout the year, as required
  • Handle all requirements for VIP guests of the company across outdoor shows during the summer season
  • Keep all documentation organised and filed correctly
  • Relay invoices to the finance team for payment
  • Book and manage promoter reps and freelancers across festivals and theatre tours.
  • Undertake ad hoc tasks as required

 

Equal Opportunities

 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender identity, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

 

The Company

 

Cuffe & Taylor is part of Live Nation Entertainment which is the world’s leading live entertainment company comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, LN Media and Artist Nation Management.


APPLICATION DEADLINE: Wednesday 18th November 2026. We reserve the right to close applications at any time.
