job.title: Senior Product Designer, Editorial Technology
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times ranks among the world’s foremost news organisations. It is known globally for its authority, integrity, and accuracy. Its mission is to provide quality information and services across the globe.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, build work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and encourage you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Develop a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our dedication to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our dedication is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are evaluated by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Editorial Technology team, helping build the tools journalists and editors use to compose, manage, and publish world-class journalism.

You’ll build experiences across Spark, our newsroom content management system (CMS), and related editorial tools supporting written stories, video and audio.

This role involves working on intricate products that directly aid journalism production at the FT. Work often starts without a clear brief or defined project. You will need to be comfortable investigating problems, grasping detailed workflows, and helping decide the appropriate course.

Collaborating with product managers, engineers, and newsroom colleagues, you'll merge user research, systems thinking, and strong design skills to develop intuitive, accessible tools for expert users.

You'll also consider how editorial tools interact with the reader experiences they facilitate across our website and apps, partnering with our Customer Products teams as needed.

AI is increasingly crafting editorial workflows, and you'll have chances to explore how new technologies can assist journalists and editors. These include tools that improve editorial quality and accuracy.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end build process, from early problem framing and discovery through information architecture, exploration, prototyping, testing and delivery.
  • Develop a deep understanding of how journalists and editors work, using research, workflow mapping and direct engagement to find opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with product managers and engineers to build product direction, define problems and establish clear priorities, particularly where requirements are ambiguous.
  • Build intuitive, accessible experiences for complex editorial workflows, including the creation and management of written and multimedia content.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to understand technical architecture, data, systems and constraints, ensuring built solutions are practical and achievable.
  • Build positive relationships with newsroom collaborators, bringing their expertise into the development process while applying sound design judgement.
  • Consider how editorial tools connect with customer-facing experiences, collaborating with Customer Products teams to support consistency and shared development patterns.
  • Communicate build decisions, recommendations and trade-offs clearly, helping teams navigate complexity and make informed decisions.
  • Investigate ways AI can assist editorial workflows, such as quality and accuracy checks, while collaborating closely with editorial, product, and engineering colleagues.
  • Use AI-enabled tools such as Codex or Figma Make, where appropriate, to prototype, test ideas and communicate technical assumptions.
  • Stay informed about developments in AI-assisted build and prototyping, bringing relevant approaches and ideas into the team.

Required skills and experience

  • Strong product development experience across user research, UX, visual design, information architecture and prototyping.
  • A portfolio demonstrating high-quality product development work, your individual contribution and measurable impact.
  • Experience crafting and delivering complex digital products, including internal tools and workflows for expert users.
  • Demonstrated capability to carry projects from initial problem identification through research, prototyping, validation, and final delivery.
  • Strong product and systems thinking, with an ability to understand how interconnected tools, workflows and technologies work together.
  • A thoughtful and analytical approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and explore alternative solutions.
  • Experience planning and conducting proportionate user research, combining qualitative and quantitative insights to inform development decisions.
  • Sufficient technical understanding to collaborate effectively with engineers and navigate complex systems, data and technical constraints.
  • Strong Figma and prototyping skills, with practical experience applying accessibility principles.
  • Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or development tools, with the judgement to assess their opportunities and limitations.
  • Excellent communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to build positive relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Confidence working through ambiguity, crafting requirements and helping teams move towards clear, considered solutions.

Desirable

  • Experience crafting content management systems, editorial platforms or newsroom tools.
  • A grasp of digital publishing workflows, including the creation and management of multimedia content.
  • Experience working on products that connect complex internal systems with customer-facing digital experiences.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing outstanding perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, encouraging positive relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please inform us if you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations during the application process or to assist you in attending an interview. If you wish to talk about your needs or have any queries, email talent@ft.com and someone from our team will gladly assist you.

Further information

At the FT, we value innovation and the adoption of technology and accept that applicants may bring AI tools to bear in their application process. Feel free to use AI to aid your application, but all information you provide must be honest and accurately display your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI during the application process might be observed to guarantee a fair and transparent hiring experience for everyone.

Please be cautious of fake job postings and offers pretending to come from the Financial Times. All genuine roles require applications through the official Financial Times careers website. The FT will never request financial details, payments, or third-party referrals during recruitment. If you doubt a job's authenticity or suspect a scam, contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but haven’t found the right position yet? Join our Talent Community to get exclusive updates, highlighted jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

job.title: Data Engineer, Communications Intelligence & Insights
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the Role

 

Are you interested in building the systems that underpin how modern communications intelligence is measured, analysed and scaled?

Burson’s EMEA Intelligence & Insights Hub is a centralised production and engineering capability responsible for developing the data infrastructure, pipelines and workflows that power monitoring, measurement and reporting across the region. Bringing together engineers and analysts, the Hub builds scalable platforms, integrates multiple external data sources and develops AI-enabled workflows that enhance both the efficiency and quality of intelligence delivery.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining and optimising the engineering systems that sit at the heart of the Hub’s delivery model. You will work across core platform engineering, client-specific solutions and AI workflow development, helping to evolve The Fount and Burson’s wider Data & Intelligence technology stack.

Our technology ecosystem is built on a modern, highly integrated cloud and relational database architecture. Core data-processing pipelines are developed using object-oriented Python and run through scalable cloud-compute orchestration and enterprise ETL tools. Managed SQL environments provide our relational system of record, while raw and semi-structured assets are maintained within secure cloud object storage.

Advanced language models are integrated directly into our processing pipelines to automate enrichment at scale, with the wider ecosystem managed through GitHub, Azure DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges while building reliable, scalable and reusable systems that support analysts, client teams and global stakeholders.

 

What you'll do:

 

  • Build, develop and maintain Burson’s core data platform and pipelines, supporting scalable ingestion, transformation, storage and delivery of intelligence data across the EMEA Hub.
  • Design and manage robust ingestion pipelines for media monitoring, social listening, APIs, internal datasets and third-party research and analytics sources.
  • Develop transformation and data-modelling layers using SQL and Python, creating both standardised central data models and bespoke client datasets that support downstream reporting, including Power BI.
  • Design and deliver client-specific data engineering solutions, developing custom pipelines, integrations and datasets where off-the-shelf technology does not meet complex or specialist requirements.
  • Optimise the performance, scalability and reliability of data systems, identifying bottlenecks, resolving data-quality issues and continuously improving pipeline efficiency.
  • Develop reusable engineering frameworks, templates and components that enable the Hub to scale solutions consistently across clients, markets and use cases.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled workflows, embedding language models into data pipelines to automate content analysis, classification, tagging, summarisation, relevance, sentiment and other enrichment processes.
  • Develop and refine prompting frameworks and AI-processing workflows, including monitoring and optimising token usage to ensure effective, efficient and commercially sustainable AI enrichment at scale.
  • Partner with analysts, product teams and communications specialists to translate approved business and reporting requirements into clearly defined technical solutions and identify appropriate opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Work within a structured Agile and ticket-driven engineering environment, contributing to sprint planning, daily stand-ups and technical design discussions while delivering against agreed functional specifications and architectural standards.
  • Maintain strong engineering governance and security standards, including consistent code practices, Git workflows, secure credential management, database security and adherence to agreed directory and repository structures.
  • Own high-quality technical documentation, maintaining clear technical guides, markdown documentation, database schemas and system records while contributing to planned refactoring and technical-debt reduction without disrupting production services.

 

 

Experience that contributes to success:

 

  • Strong experience in data engineering, with a track record of designing, building and maintaining reliable production-grade data pipelines and platforms.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong experience in relational database environments, including data transformation, modelling, optimisation and the creation of data structures for downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Strong Python development capability, including writing clean, readable and object-oriented code, working with pandas and developing concurrent or scalable data-processing workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations and ETL/ELT architectures, with the ability to bring together structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
  • Experience working within cloud-based data environments, ideally Microsoft Azure, including cloud compute, managed databases, object storage and enterprise data-processing services.
  • Strong software-engineering discipline, including experience designing and writing automated unit, integration and regression tests in Python, ideally using pytest.
  • A strong understanding of secure engineering practices, including database security, firewalls and secure secrets and credential management using tools such as Azure Key Vault.
  • Experience with Git-based engineering workflows and CI/CD environments, ideally including GitHub and Azure DevOps, with an appreciation for structured branching, code governance and multi-developer environments.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, ideally Terraform or Terragrunt, and the ability to safely manage or update environment variables, configuration and access controls within established infrastructure frameworks.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-enabled data engineering, including exposure to large language models, prompt-based workflows, automated enrichment or the integration of AI services into production data pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and technical-planning skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and performance issues, scope engineering work effectively and build scalable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • A collaborative and disciplined approach to engineering, comfortable working across multiple projects with analysts, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders while maintaining strong documentation, continuous improvement and adherence to agreed technical standards.

 

 

#LI-NE1

Naszą wizją jest, aby Burson stał się wiodącą firmą, swoistą „akademią” dla specjalistów od komunikacji kreatywnej i przyszłych liderów. You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.title: Associate Account Director (Promotional Medical Education)
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Account Director to join our growing team! 

As an Associate Account Director, you will be responsible for excellence in delivery across projects within medium-to-large and often complex client accounts. You will provide strategic counsel to clients, manage execution of parallel ongoing projects and oversee a cross-functional internal team alongside the account lead.

This role will be supporting on some of our promotional medical education accounts and include projects such as events and patient-based campaigns.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the go-to for clients, managing relationships and setting their expectations
  • Take accountability for a portfolio of projects within at least two medium-to-large client accounts
  • Ensure work is delivered to the highest standard and within agreed timeframes and budgets
  • Troubleshoot and provide solutions to client challenges and last-minute requests
  • Identify areas for organic growth within existing accounts and confidently sell new ideas to clients
  • Identify new business opportunities outside of existing accounts and explore with the support of senior leadership
  • Support the ongoing new business process, assisting in the production of credentials and participating in broader RFP responses when possible
  • Inspire, motivate, and empower your team on a daily basis, leading by example and setting the standard for junior accounts team members
  • Provide line management, coaching and mentoring to junior team members and manage their performance
  • Take responsibility for financial management of your client business and participate actively in the monthly financial process (including developing budgets)
  • Accurately forecast and proactively alert senior leadership to any changes/potential slowing down of business

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience as an Associate Account Director, or Senior Account Manager looking to step up
  • Experience in a medical communications agency
  • Experience working on promotional medical education or commercial medical affairs accounts
  • Ability to work within and lead cross-functional teams internally 
  • Experience with annual planning, resourcing, and forecasting
  • Previous line management experience (ideally have had at least one formal linee)                                                                                                                             

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. job.title: Company Secretary
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, fully qualified Company Secretary to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.

This is a senior role at the heart of Brunswick’s governance framework, providing trusted advice to the Board of Directors and senior leadership. The Company Secretary will lead our corporate governance and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring Brunswick maintains high standards of governance and meets its obligations under the UK Corporate Governance Code and Companies Act 2006.

Reporting to the Group Head of Tax and Partnership Affairs, the role will work closely with the Group Financial Controller and other senior colleagues across the firm, providing thoughtful, pragmatic guidance on governance and corporate matters.

We are open to considering part-time or flexible working arrangements for the right candidate.

About the Role

Your key responsibilities will include:

Board and governance

  • Support the effective operation of the Board, including preparing agendas and papers, drafting minutes, tracking actions and ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Act as a key point of contact for executive and non-executive directors on governance matters.
  • Manage the forward calendar and terms of reference for the Board and its committees.
  • Ensure the Board operates in accordance with the Articles of Association, shareholder arrangements, the Companies Act 2006 and other relevant governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep the Board and senior colleagues informed of relevant developments in corporate governance and regulation.

Committee support

  • Provide company secretarial support to the Audit & Risk Committee.
  • Attend committee meetings and prepare accurate and timely minutes.
  • Track actions and support appropriate follow-up.

Shareholder matters

  • Maintain the shareholder register and oversee quarterly updates presented to the Board.
  • Prepare and coordinate communications and documentation for shareholders.
  • Work with the Head of International Tax to support partners on shareholder and share-related matters.

Annual General Meeting

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of the Annual General Meeting.
  • Prepare notices and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate communications with shareholders.
  • Manage meeting arrangements and prepare minutes.

Share buy-backs

  • Coordinate the documentation and approvals associated with share buy-backs.
  • Manage relevant filing and record-keeping requirements.

Corporate documentation and records

  • Draft resolutions, letters and other corporate documentation for entities and transactions across the Group.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date statutory books and corporate records for the Group’s subsidiaries using Diligent.
  • Maintain authorised signatory records.
  • Own and maintain the Group structure chart.

Statutory filings and compliance

  • Manage the Group’s Companies House filings, including confirmation statements and other statutory returns.
  • Ensure filings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain oversight of filing deadlines and other company secretarial obligations across the Group.

Corporate transactions

  • Lead the company secretarial and governance aspects of corporate and commercial transactions.
  • Support matters including entity closures, share conversions and Group restructurings.
  • Work closely with Legal, Finance, Tax and other colleagues to ensure transactions are appropriately documented and implemented.

Advice and stakeholder support

  • Provide thoughtful and pragmatic corporate governance advice to directors, Finance, Legal and other senior stakeholders across the firm.
  • Support in-house Legal colleagues on company secretarial and governance matters.
  • Work with and provide guidance to Executive Assistants on Board governance and administration.

KYC

  • Coordinate KYC requests relating to directors and senior management.
  • Ensure relevant information is accurate, current and provided efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who brings:

  • Significant corporate secretarial experience, typically gained over 6–8 years, with experience working in a UK-listed, highly regulated or complex international environment.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK Corporate Governance Code, Listing Rules and Companies Act 2006, combined with the judgement to apply this expertise thoughtfully and pragmatically.
  • Excellent written and analytical skills, with the ability to listen carefully, identify what matters and capture complex Board and executive discussions in clear, accurate and considered minutes.
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence and judgement to build trusted relationships across executive and non-executive leadership while maintaining discretion and impartiality.
  • Fellowship or Associate status with the Chartered Governance Institute (CGI, formerly ICSA) is required.
  • A legal degree or professional qualification as a solicitor would be an advantage.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Global PMO Lead - People Technology 12M FTC
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is delivering a significant People Technology transformation, modernising the platforms, processes and data that underpin how we manage and support our people globally.

We’re looking for an experienced PMO Lead to sit at the centre of this transformation, bringing the structure, discipline and visibility needed to successfully deliver a complex, global programme. This is more than a reporting PMO role. You’ll create the governance, integrated planning and delivery controls that enable leaders to make informed decisions and teams to deliver effectively. You’ll connect multiple workstreams, make risks and dependencies visible, ensure actions translate into delivery, and provide a clear view of whether the programme is achieving its objectives and intended benefits.

Working across the intersection of People, Technology, HR processes, data and organisational change, you’ll partner closely with programme leadership, Workstream Leads and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into an executable plan and create the rhythm and discipline needed to deliver transformation at scale.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own and maintain the integrated programme plan, ensuring milestones, dependencies, deliverables and critical paths are clearly understood and actively managed.
  • Establish and maintain effective programme governance, providing appropriate control over scope, cost, timelines, risks and delivery.
  • Lead programme reporting, providing clear and insightful updates on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions and areas requiring intervention.
  • Own the programme RAID process, proactively identifying risks and issues and ensuring clear mitigation, escalation and resolution plans are in place.
  • Coordinate dependencies across workstreams, ensuring actions have clear owners, deadlines and accountability through to closure.
  • Support and facilitate programme governance forums, ensuring decisions are captured and translated into clear actions and outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain the frameworks, processes, templates and programme documentation required to drive consistency and effective ways of working.
  • Ensure programme benefits are clearly defined, baselined and tracked, with appropriate business ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop meaningful metrics and reporting to monitor programme performance and benefits realisation.
  • Partner with Workstream Leads and delivery teams to identify roadblocks, resolve delivery challenges and maintain momentum.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to project and workstream teams, championing strong programme management disciplines and collaborative ways of working.
  • Work across the wider organisation to identify interdependencies with other transformation initiatives and ensure these are reflected in programme planning.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve operational effectiveness and strengthen programme delivery.
  • Champion effective ways of working across globally dispersed and cross-functional teams.
  • Act as Project Manager for selected strategic initiatives or workstreams where additional delivery leadership is required

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience working as a PMO Lead, Senior PMO, Programme Manager or in a similar role within a large-scale transformation environment.
  • Strong programme management capability, with hands-on experience of integrated planning, governance, RAID management, dependency management and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience supporting complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, geographies and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience delivering People Technology, HR transformation or enterprise technology programmes would be highly valuable.
  • Experience working with HRIS/HCM platforms, with an understanding of the processes, data, integrations and business change surrounding enterprise HR technology, is strongly preferred.
  • Workday experience would be advantageous but is not essential. We’re equally interested in candidates with experience of other major enterprise HRIS/HCM platforms who can demonstrate strong technology-enabled transformation experience.
  • Strong understanding of Agile and traditional programme delivery approaches, with the ability to apply an appropriate level of governance depending on the programme environment.
  • Experience developing programme governance, reporting frameworks, delivery standards and ways of working.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex programme information into clear insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Experience establishing and tracking programme benefits, KPIs and delivery metrics.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bring diverse teams together around shared priorities.
  • A practical, action-oriented approach, with strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain control across multiple moving parts.
  • Confidence operating in ambiguity, quickly identifying problems and creating the structure needed to move towards resolution.
  • Experience working with globally dispersed teams through significant organisational or technology transformation.
  • Experience of process improvement approaches such as Lean, Six Sigma or Design Thinking would be advantageous.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid #LI-DNP

 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

You will not own development pipelines, security tooling or software delivery. Instead, you will provide the technical leadership, evidence and challenge that helps engineering teams build security into the way they develop software and continuously improve their security practices. 

Success requires strong technical credibility with engineers, a practical understanding of modern software development, and the ability to influence technical outcomes without direct authority.

  • Act as WPP’s technical lead for Application Security, providing senior judgement on Secure Development, assurance and software-security risk. 
  • Understand how software is designed, built, tested and released across WPP, identifying where common guardrails and engineering capabilities will most improve security. 
  • Define practical Secure Development guardrails across secure design, threat modelling, coding, dependencies, software supply chains, CI/CD, cloud-native and AI-enabled development. 
  • Work directly with software engineers, architects and product managers to help establish the security capabilities and practices needed to meet those guardrails. 
  • Develop technical assurance capabilities that continuously demonstrate whether Secure Development controls are present, operating and effective. 
  • Use engineering evidence, security tooling and targeted validation to identify gaps, challenge assumptions and drive meaningful improvement.

  • Provide evidence and technical challenge where controls are ineffective or risks remain, while keeping implementation and remediation ownership with the teams responsible for the software. 
  • Continuously evolve WPP’s Secure Development approach as engineering practices, technologies and threats change. 
  • Own Application Security Risk Factors through their lifecycle, raising and documenting issues, advising teams on remediation, tracking progress and challenging where exposure is not being addressed effectively.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers and senior management. 
  • Sound technical judgement, balancing security outcomes with engineering constraints and knowing when to challenge and when different approaches can achieve the same outcome. 
  • Ability to lead through technical credibility, evidence and influence rather than direct authority.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, collaborating with colleagues across multiple locations, and working in a fast-paced media environment, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a growing media company. Responsibilities: Provide operational and technical support for core radio automation systems, including Wide Orbit, RCS Zetta, and Nexgen. Configure, install, and maintain network and firewall equipment such as routers, firewalls, and managed switches. Diagnose hardware and software failures, communicate remediation plans to users, and provide status updates. Support proprietary and 3rd-party applications used across the organization. Develop, maintain, and contribute knowledge to internal documentation, diagrams, IT, and Engineering SOPs and training manuals. Maintain a professional attitude and appearance, providing excellent customer service at all times, and building effective working relationships with internal customers and team members. Utilize strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and meet service-level agreements (SLAs). Demonstrate self-motivation and adaptability to learn new technologies, work effectively both independently and in a team, and remain flexible in a fast-paced environment. Support continuous improvement in the process and quality of the operations. Perform any other duties assigned by the Director of IT or the Director of Engineering. Qualifications: Required Technical Skills & Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Systems Administration on the Windows platform, including user/security management, file system administration, and patch management. (Familiarity with Linux is a plus). 5+ years managing and remediating endpoint protection and security systems. 3+ years of experience configuring and maintaining business-class networking equipment, including: Firewalls (NAT/PAT, routing, access rules, VPNs). At WLIO, we bring all four major networks (NBC, CBS, ABC, and FOX) under one roof, giving you an unmatched toolkit to help local businesses dominate the Lima market. If you’re ready to lead a team that’s as energetic as it is innovative, we want to talk to you.

As our Multi-Media Sales Manager specializing in Digital, you are the catalyst for growth in the Lima market. You aren't just managing a team; you are a digital evangelist, a strategic coach, and a consultative partner to our advertisers. You will lead the charge in growing our digital footprint by developing cutting-edge sales strategies across OTT, SEO, social, and web to ensure all budgets and goals are crushed. From overseeing pricing and inventory to mentoring our Multimedia Executives, you’ll own the digital lifecycle and foster a high-energy, winning culture that puts our clients first.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Drive digital revenue: Lead the charge in growing our digital footprint by developing and executing cutting-edge sales strategies across OTT, SEO, social, and web to ensure all budgets and goals are met or exceeded.
  • Coach for greatness: Provide ongoing digital training and subject-matter expertise to the sales team, helping them uncover new opportunities and close complex multi-platform deals.
  • Craft winning solutions: Partner with local businesses to understand their unique challenges and build custom, integrated marketing campaigns—from programmatic to streaming—that deliver real ROI.
  • Own the market: Oversee digital pricing, inventory management, and revenue forecasting in tandem with the Director of Sales to ensure WLIO remains the go-to destination for innovative advertising.
  • Master the execution: Manage the lifecycle of digital campaigns from order entry to completion, ensuring every tag, tracking detail, and creative asset is perfectly aligned for success.
  • Analyze and optimize: Translate campaign data into actionable insights and reporting, providing clients with the "real talk" and performance recommendations they need to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Promote a winning culture: Foster a positive, high-energy environment where accountability and collaboration are the standard, not the exception.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Digital Expertise: Minimum of two years of digital sales experience with a deep understanding of OTT, SEM, social, and programmatic advertising.
  • Proven Leadership: Advanced leadership skills with a track record of achieving budgets and the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and—most importantly—people.
  • Strategic Communication: Strong presentation experience and excellent written/verbal skills; you can take complex data and turn it into a compelling narrative for a business owner.
  • Problem-Solving Prowess: The unique ability to translate client problems into digital opportunities, maintaining ownership of every challenge until it’s resolved.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, social media, and CRM/order-entry systems (experience with Engage is a major plus).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • The "Gray" Factor: A relentless sense of urgency, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for helping local businesses thrive in a digital-first world.

Why You'll Love It Here:

  • Unmatched reach: With four major networks at your fingertips, you have the most powerful advertising platform in the region to play with.
  • A collaborative culture: We’re a dynamic, welcoming team where your ideas aren't just heard—they're celebrated.

job.title: Media Sales Executive | Yakima or Tri-Cities, WA
job.description:
Apple Valley News Now (ABC) + Phase 3 Digital

What if your next job let you help local businesses grow—and bring their stories to life on TV, streaming and digital platforms?

At Apple Valley News Now and Phase 3 Digital, you’ll help businesses across the Yakima and Tri-Cities connect with customers through streaming TV, digital advertising, social media and, when it fits, traditional television. One day you might be learning what makes a neighborhood business stand out; the next, you’re brainstorming a campaign that brings its story to life. You’ll have plenty of variety, room to build relationships and the satisfaction of seeing local ideas make it into the world.

You can be based in our Yakima or Kennewick office.

What you’ll do

  • Get to know local businesses, ask smart questions and uncover what they want to achieve.
  • Develop new client relationships and grow existing ones through thoughtful follow-through.
  • Build and present advertising ideas across connected TV/streaming, digital video, display, social and other media solutions that fit each client’s goals.
  • Work with creative, digital and sales colleagues to launch campaigns, review results and find ways to improve them.
  • Keep learning as audiences, platforms and marketing tools change.
  • Own your pipeline and work toward sales goals.

Who could thrive here

You might come from advertising sales—but you don’t have to. If you’ve built trust, won business or helped customers make decisions in another field, we want to hear from you. That could mean business development, hospitality, retail, real estate, recruiting or another relationship-driven role.

You’re curious about how businesses grow, comfortable starting conversations, organized enough to follow through and excited to turn a client’s challenge into a compelling idea. You can explain your thinking clearly and enjoy learning new tools. Experience selling connected TV or digital advertising is valuable, not required to start the conversation. Experience with traditional TV advertising is welcome, not required.

Why media? Why us?

Media keeps changing—and that’s part of the fun. You can pair the reach of an established local ABC brand that has partnerships with the Seattle Kraken and Seattle Mariners along with digital and streaming options, bring creative people into the conversation and help businesses show up where their customers are. It’s a career built on relationships, ideas and learning, with support to grow your media and digital sales skills.

Compensation and benefits

  • Posted compensation range: $45,000–$100,000 per year, including supplemental pay such as commission. Actual earnings vary; commissions are uncapped.
  • Monthly cell phone and gas allowances.
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.
  • Paid time off; sick, vacation, holidays and a 401(k) with company match.

Ready to make your mark in a field that’s never boring? Apply to be a Media Sales Executive with Apple Valley News Now and Phase 3 Digital. Tell us about the relationships you’ve built, the goals you’ve helped others reach or the new skills you’re eager to learn—even if your career so far hasn’t been in media.

Apple Valley News Now is an equal opportunity employer.

APPLE VALLEY NEWS NOW IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

job.title: Manager, DTC Product Marketing
job.description:
The Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Product Marketing team is a group of strategic brand and product marketers responsible for driving campaign development, brand strategy, media planning, and execution across the DTC portfolio – including NFL+, NFL App, and more.  

As DTC Product Marketing Manager, you will support the go-to-market (GTM) strategy development and lead day-to-day marketing execution for the DTC portfolio. Accelerating subscriptions, minimizing churn, deepening engagement, and delivering fan-first campaigns powered by insights and personalization for NFL+ will be your primary focus. You’ll collaborate closely across departments – from Product to Consumer Insights to Media – and work externally with league partners, agencies, and platform partners to bring innovative plans to life.

  • Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure strategic campaign alignment and tactical implementation

  • Oversee campaign development across owned and paid channels, including audience targets, messaging, creative assets, approvals, and execution

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WXMI (Ionia / Greenville / Lowell / Belding)
job.description:
WXMI, the FOX affiliate in Grand Rapids, Michigan, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company is searching for its next Multimedia Journalist. The MMJ will tell the stories of the Ionia, Greenville, Lowell, and Belding neighborhoods. The right person will dig for stories, write, capture visual content, and edit stories for multiple platforms. Tucked into the scenic Grand River Valley northeast of Grand Rapids, the Ionia, Greenville, Lowell, and Belding area blends small-town Michigan charm with historic downtowns, riverfront trails, and lively community traditions like the Ionia Free Fair. With affordable housing, outdoor recreation at your doorstep, and a proud manufacturing and agricultural heritage, it's a welcoming place. Apply today to join an award-winning team!

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 


WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

#LI-SM2

#LI-ONSITE

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose. 

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps reaches households across the U.S. with national news outlet Scripps News and popular entertainment brands ION, ION Plus, ION Mystery, Bounce, Grit and Laff. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. job.title: Manager, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 
At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 
Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat.    Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 
o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales strategies and elevate our market presence. Your main mission will be to lead our sales team to new heights while fostering a culture of success and motivation. We believe that with the right guidance, our team can achieve remarkable results, and that's where you come in. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!
o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by managing the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.
o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement cutting edge sales and marketing plans that not only amplify our reach but also align with our company goals.
o Team Leadership:  Leading a team of sales professionals is no small feat! You'll mentor and inspire them to hit and exceed their targets while cultivating a collaborative environment.
o Market Analysis: Keeping an eye on market trends and customer needs is essential. You'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.
o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients is crucial. You'll be the face of our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.
o Dynamic Oversight: You'll track sales performance metrics and provide insightful reports to senior management, helping us make data-driven decisions.
What We're Looking For 
o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience in sales management or someone fully ready to take their next career step in sales leadership, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 
o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.
o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 
o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, and make a difference.
o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in transformative environments? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.
The Practical Stuff 
o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 
Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 
o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of an agile team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.
o The Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.
o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)
o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.
AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.       EEO AND INCLUSIVITY  Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Broadcast IT Engineer
job.description:
KDSM has an excellent career opportunity for a full-time IT Engineer to support the Engineering Department on its daily computer and network operations. This position involves maintaining computers and servers related to television transmission and video automation systems, as well as business-side work stations. The candidate will be directly responsible for hands-on support of modern broadcast and IT equipment.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide support in the management of Servers, Network Security and Network Services
  • PC/Mac hardware/software support of on-site installing, servicing and repairing workstations
  • Provide support for the technical needs of the News Department
  • Assist with video equipment set-up and maintenance
  • Assist Engineering with Transmitter and Master Control maintenance
  • Assist with LAN and WAN related hardware and software maintenance
  • Develop knowledge of facility specific IT needs and assist in supporting these systems
  • Apply regular security updates
  • Perform physical inventory of equipment
  • Maintain digital telephone system

Requirements:

  • Associates degree or higher in IT, electronics or computer related field
  • A great team-oriented attitude and dedication to quality
  • Strong familiarity with Microsoft, Mac and Linux operating systems
  • Knowledge and competency in core hardware and computer system technologies, including installation, configuration, diagnosing, preventive maintenance and LAN/WAN networking
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting problems and responding quickly under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Familiarity with Avid related software and hardware products a plus
  • Must have driver's license with clean driving record

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule
  • On-call duty, including weekends and holidays
  • Ability to lift computers and equipment generally less than 50 pounds

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Summer 2027 FOX Sports - Big Ten Network - Internship Program - Chicago, IL
job.description:
Headquartered in Chicago, the Big Ten Network (BTN) is a joint venture between FOX Sports and the Big Ten Conference, dedicated to delivering comprehensive coverage of the nation's premier collegiate conference. As part of the broader FOX Sports portfolio, BTN produces more than 3,100 live events across all platforms, paired with studio shows, game highlights, and original programming across linear and digital platforms. 

FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Legal & Business Affairs will provide strategic legal counsel and business-oriented support to the company's operations across Latin America, with a particular focus on Mexico and Central America.

This role will serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and cross-functional teams, providing practical, commercially focused guidance on a broad range of legal, contractual, regulatory, and corporate matters.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience navigating complex legal and business environments within multinational organizations, demonstrating the ability to assess legal risks, develop effective solutions, and support business objectives while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, sound legal judgment, excellent stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted legal and business advisor to regional leadership and cross-functional teams across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America.
  • Provide strategic, practical, and timely legal guidance on commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate legal implications, identify potential risks, and develop solutions that support business priorities and commercial objectives.
  • Provide legal support for business initiatives, transactions, and operational projects, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and applicable legal requirements.

2. Commercial Contracts & Negotiations

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including marketing, vendor, licensing, service, and other business-related contracts.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual terms, obligations, liabilities, and potential legal or commercial risks.
  • Support contract negotiations with external partners, suppliers, and service providers, balancing legal protections with business needs.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate standards.

3. Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support corporate governance activities, including legal entity management, corporate documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with external legal advisors.
  • Provide legal guidance on regulatory requirements affecting business operations across relevant Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with internal compliance teams to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks.
  • Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments and proactively communicate potential implications for business operations.
  • Support the implementation of appropriate legal and compliance practices in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Legal Risk Management & External Counsel

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial activities, contractual relationships, and regional operations.
  • Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that support informed business decisions.
  • Coordinate and oversee external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and cost-effective legal support.
  • Manage legal matters requiring specialized external advice and facilitate coordination between internal stakeholders and external advisors.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate closely with business, finance, compliance, and operations teams to support regional business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on cross-functional projects and initiatives involving multiple business units or jurisdictions.
  • Facilitate effective communication between legal and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on legal requirements, commercial priorities, and operational needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing legal processes, operational efficiency, and risk management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Law degree from an accredited university or institution.
  • Admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, either as in-house counsel or at a reputable law firm, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on commercial contracts, corporate matters, and business operations.
  • Experience supporting legal and commercial activities across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America, is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, advertising, technology, or other fast-paced industries is considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to provide practical legal advice while balancing regulatory requirements, risk management, and business objectives.

Languages

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required.
  • Ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents and communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial operations and the ability to align legal recommendations with business objectives.
  • Legal Analysis & Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Excellent legal drafting, contract review, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and external advisors.
  • Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate complex legal matters, anticipate potential challenges, and recommend commercially viable solutions.
  • Organization & Prioritization: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Professional Integrity & Judgment: High ethical standards, discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential matters.

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Franchise, Products & Partnerships extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.​

  • Franchise Creative: this intern will help bring characters and worlds to life through illustration, concept development, and visual storytelling.   • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.

  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Ability to communicate ideas clearly through sketches and presentations.
  • Skilled in CS Suite, 3D software and all relevant software for product design & development including Keynote for presentations. 
  • Have a broad understanding of character design and development.
  • Strong understanding of anatomy and perspective.
