job.title: Editorial Producer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

CBS News is seeking a smart, driven, and organized Editorial Producer with booking and political newsgathering skills. Primary responsibilities include booking political newsmakers, including lawmakers, political candidates, analysts, and internal contributors for CBS News platforms, with a strong focus on CBS News 24/7’s The Takeout with Major Garrett, in addition to CBS Mornings and CBS Evening News.   Candidates must have strong communication and interpersonal skills, have the ability to cultivate sources and maintain relationships with key political contacts, and book high-profile guests. The ideal candidate takes initiative, makes calls, and owns projects that are assigned. This position requires attention to detail, persistence, organization, sound editorial judgment, and a command of the political landscape and the Washington news cycle. This person must have the ability to communicate effectively internally with newsroom managers and shows/teams across the news division, as well as externally with guests, communications directors, and other contacts. Candidates must be flexible with occasional travel requirements and schedule changes as news events warrant. This role will report into the Central Booking team and the schedule is Monday through Friday dayside.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Secure multiple guest bookings for daily and future news coverage, including high-profile political newsmakers, experts, and contributors 
  • Develop, cultivate, and maintain relationships with key political sources, communications teams, and Washington-based contacts to generate booking opportunities
  • Partner with producers, newsroom leadership, and cross-functional teams to identify, pitch, and execute guests that support editorial priorities and breaking news coverage
  • Manage multiple bookings and projects simultaneously, exercising strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and adaptability in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a newsroom, with a background in political, Capitol Hill, or Washington news strongly preferred
  • Must have a strong understanding of Congress, the executive branch, campaigns, and the broader political landscape
  • Must have solid news judgment, including the ability to recognize and pitch the right guest for a developing story
  • Strong research skills, including use of public and private records databases such as Lexis Nexis, as well as social media, are preferred
  • Must be an excelled writer with well-developed oral communication skills
  • Must be able to juggle and prioritize multiple projects with different deadlines: short, medium, and long-term
  • Must have the ability to develop and maintain ongoing relationships with external contacts
  • Must be a team player with a positive attitude
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Thrives in high-pressure, time-critical situations, and works with a sense of urgency
  • Degree in broadcast journalism, political science, or a related field is preferred
  • Passion for news, politics, live events, and journalism is required
  • Must be willing and able to work occasional late/overnight and/or weekend shifts as needed

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.title: High School Sports Reporter (Wilmington DE Guild)
job.description:
Inform readers, celebrate achievement and demand accountability.

We are seeking a High School Sports Reporter to help lead our coverage of local teams and athletes while becoming a prominent on-camera voice. The reporter will produce frequent field video and authoritative rankings of teams, players, games and performances that keep fans returning throughout the season. The role also includes breaking news, major events and distinctive enterprise reporting.

Video and high-interest rankings are central to the job. The reporter will create mobile-first updates, interviews, analysis and personality-driven features, along with recurring lists of top teams, players, games and performances. Other coverage will include daily stories, investigations, explainers, profiles, newsletters and service journalism—all designed to build readership and subscriptions.

What you’ll do:

Partner with our current high school reporter to own the high school sports beat by developing deep knowledge of local teams, athletes, coaches, athletic directors and governing organizations.

Shoot and edit vertical video, conduct interviews and become a recognizable on-camera personality who can host and analyze high school sports coverage.

Break news with urgency and accuracy, including off-field developments, policy changes and other issues affecting student-athletes and school communities.

Publish a regular cadence of authoritative rankings and compelling lists of teams, players, games, matchups and standout performances, backed by clear reporting and analysis. Add timely previews, profiles, trend and investigative stories, reader polls and postseason honors.

Build and maintain a diverse network of sources and consistently identify distinctive stories that competitors do not have.

Use newsletters, social platforms, audience data, reader feedback and verified real-time reporting to strengthen engagement, reach new readers and convert loyal audiences into subscribers.

Work independently on deadline and collaborate closely with editors, photographers and other journalists to set priorities and coordinate coverage.

Pitch ambitious enterprise and accountability stories that examine trends, decisions and institutions influencing high school sports.

What you’ll need:

A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

At least two years of journalism experience, with demonstrated reporting and writing ability; sports reporting experience is preferred.

Strong news judgment, high ethical standards and a proven ability to source, report and break news.

Clear, engaging writing and the ability to deliver accurate work on tight deadlines.

Demonstrated video production skills, including shooting and editing, plus the confidence and presence to appear regularly on camera and build a credible, engaging connection with viewers.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance breaking news, daily assignments and longer-term projects.

Experience building and engaging digital audiences, using metrics, emerging tools and responsible applications of artificial intelligence to improve reporting, presentation and reach.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with the initiative to work independently.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and coverage that reflects the breadth of the communities we serve.

Work requirements:

This position requires regular night and weekend work based on the sports calendar, as well as travel to games, practices, interviews and other assignments. Reliable transportation is required. The reporter must be comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and adjusting coverage plans as news develops.

How to apply:

Applicants should submit a resume and three to five work samples that demonstrate reporting, writing and digital storytelling skills. Video or multimedia work samples are required.

job.title: Director, Partnership Management
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is seeking an experienced, strategically minded Director of Partnerships Management to lead high-value client relationships and oversee the delivery of integrated commercial partnerships across live events, digital advertising, custom content, and other Semafor programs.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships Management, the Director will own the strategic relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients. You will build trusted relationships with senior executives, understand their business priorities, and ensure Semafor's partnerships deliver meaningful value.

This role emphasizes strategic account leadership rather than day-to-day project administration. Directors are supported by Project Managers who handle timelines, deliverables, and routine follow-up, freeing you to focus on client strategy, executive engagement, satisfaction, and commercial growth.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as primary strategic relationship owner and trusted advisor for a portfolio of high-value, complex client partnerships.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, communications, marketing, and public affairs leaders.
  • Develop tailored account strategies aligned with each client's business objectives, and lead executive-level conversations and planning sessions.
  • Monitor account health and client satisfaction, and act as the primary escalation point for relationship-sensitive issues.

Partnership Strategy and Delivery Leadership

  • Own accountability for delivering contracted partnerships to Semafor's quality standards.
  • Partner with Sales in late-stage deals and lead kickoffs that set objectives, expectations, and success measures.
  • Provide strategic leadership across integrated programs spanning live events, executive convenings, digital advertising, custom content, podcasts, video, and research.
  • Assess risks, resolve complex challenges, and manage changes to scope, timelines, or deliverables with Sales and leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Connect clients with Semafor teams including Sales, Editorial, Audience, Concierge, Events, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations, and Product.
  • Work with Project Managers to keep visibility into commitments, progress, and risks without duplicating day-to-day administration.
  • Resolve competing priorities with functional leaders and recommend improvements to the broader operating model.

Commercial Growth and Retention

  • Partner with Sales on retention, renewals, and expansion, identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships through additional Semafor offerings.
  • Lead post-program reviews, translate performance reporting into client insights, and make evidence-based recommendations for future investment.
  • Track partnership economics with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to resolve issues affecting scope, revenue, or profitability.

Executive Engagement and Client Experience

  • Design executive engagement strategies that maximize the value of Semafor's global convenings, editorial platforms, and leadership communities.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact at major events and executive interactions, navigating sensitive requests with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Represent Semafor confidently and professionally while maintaining high standards for responsiveness and client satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, client services, or a related field within media, marketing, or editorial environments.
  • Experience working with global clients across the US, the Gulf, and beyond, with a deep understanding of and appreciation for cultural, business, and geopolitical dynamics. Experience with clients focused on B2B and B2G strategies is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, integrated projects involving multiple stakeholders and deliverables.
  • Experience managing large- and small-format events, digital advertising campaigns, podcasts, and marketing services.
  • Expertise in project management tools and methodologies, with a strong focus on operational efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of and respect for media, journalism, and the importance of editorial independence.

Additional Job Details

  • Based in New York, NY or Washington, DC, with a four-day in-office schedule (Fridays work from home).
  • Flexible hours around events and domestic and international travel as needed.
  • Salary range: $145,000 – $180,000 per year, based on factors including education, experience, and relevant qualifications.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

job.description:
Title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician

Reports to: Director of Safety

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

The DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning and continuously improving the company’s transportation compliance and fleet safety programs across all operations. Reporting directly to the Director of Safety, this role serves as the enterprise subject‑matter expert for DOT/CHP compliance, fleet risk reduction, incident investigation, and telematics-driven performance management.

This position has no direct reports but carries company‑wide authority and accountability for transportation safety outcomes, compliance readiness, and fleet risk mitigation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Own all transportation compliance programs, including DOT/FMCSA (as applicable), CHP, DMV pull‑notice, driver qualification files, medical certification tracking, and onboarding controls.

²  Plan, lead, and support internal and external transportation audits and inspections.

²  Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical SOPs, controls, and field‑ready tools.

²  Lead initiatives to reduce preventable incidents, injuries, and claim severity across CDL and non‑CDL fleets.

²  Conduct transportation incident and collision investigations; perform root‑cause analysis and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions.

²  Partner with Risk Management, Insurance, and Legal on claim documentation, trends, and litigation support.

²  Serve as program owner for fleet telematics and safety technology platforms (e.g., Samsara, Geotab, Lytx or similar).

²  Develop and maintain driver scorecards, coaching workflows, compliance alerts, and trend analysis.

²  Produce monthly dashboards and executive summaries for the VP of Safety and leadership team.

²  Develop and deliver transportation safety training, refresher programs, and remedial coaching.

²  Equip field leaders with coaching tools and clear compliance expectations.

²  Perform field observations, yard reviews, and ride‑alongs as needed.

²  Create and maintain standardized SOPs, checklists, and documentation related to transportation compliance and fleet safety.

²  Lead cross‑functional corrective action plans with Operations, Fleet, HR, and Safety.

²  Support contractor and vendor transportation compliance expectations where applicable.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

²  Preventable incident frequency and severity trends

²  DOT/CHP audit readiness and outcomes

²  Driver coaching completion and improvement metrics

²  DMV pull‑notice and DQ file accuracy

²  Telematics utilization and leading indicator improvement

²  Timely investigation and corrective action closure

 

Qualifications:

²  5+ years of experience in transportation safety, DOT compliance, fleet risk, or safety roles within construction, utilities, logistics, or similar environments.

²  Demonstrated ownership of compliance programs and audits.

²  Strong incident investigation and corrective action leadership skills.

²  Strong analytical capability; working knowledge of Excel and fleet analytics platforms.

²  Experience supporting utility construction or heavy civil operations. (Preferred)

²  Familiarity with California fleet compliance standards and CHP interactions. (Preferred)

²  Experience with safety management systems and telematics‑driven coaching programs. (Preferred)

²  Safety or compliance certifications (CSP, ASP, CHST, accident investigation, etc.). (Preferred)

²  Bilingual Spanish a plus.

²  Reports directly to: VP of Safety

²  Works closely with: Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Risk/Insurance, HR, and Legal

²  Senior Individual Contributor (no direct reports)

²  Combination of office and field environment.

²  Regular visits to yards and jobsites across Southern California.

²  Occasional after‑hours support during serious incidents.

 

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Associate
job.description:

The successful candidate will have 0 to 2 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, business operations, or a related field. Internship or co-op experience is welcomed. This position reports to the Purchasing Manager.

Education / Experience

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - CTV
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

 

#LI-TG1

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

 

Hiring Salary Range: $124,000.00 - 186,000.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.  

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

 

Skydance is an equal opportunity employer (EOE)

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• 6+ years writing software

• 3+ years building Roku applications

• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

• You know OOP, data structures, and algorithms well enough to design systems, not just pass interviews

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• You can explain Roku's memory model, the render-thread/task-thread split, device tiers, and what certification requires

• RESTful API design and data serialization

• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay

• Unit and integration testing on Roku

• HTTP protocol and caching behavior

• Git and GitHub

• You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry

• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns

• You've worked with personalization or recommendation APIs on resource-constrained devices

• E2E testing for connected-device applications

• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)

• GraphQL

• You share AI tools and workflows that save the team time

• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right

• You say "I don't know" when you don't know

• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock you

 

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 

• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day

• Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough

• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what happened

• You track Roku OS releases and adopt new APIs when they solve a real problem, not because they're new

• You write architecture docs, component guides, and Slack explanations that save ten people from asking the same question

• You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one

• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features

• You make the people around you better at their jobs

job.title: Lead AI Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team is part of Enterprise Solutions & Technology. They create a shared AI agent infrastructure. This infrastructure supports teams in Finance, Legal & Business Affairs, Content Operations, Rights, People, and Technology. It helps these teams complete their business workflows using AI. As our Lead AI Engineer, you’ll build secure, production AI applications that orchestrate large language models, enterprise APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and Automation Anywhere bots. Your applications will execute business workflows with human approvals, audit trails and monitoring built in. In this individual contributor role, you will work directly with business stakeholders. You will use a forward deployed model and take responsibility for applications. This means you will discover problems, develop user interfaces, coordinate with multiple agents, test the applications, deploy them, and manage operations. You’ll make application architecture, agent design, tool design and model selection decisions, while collaborating with the hiring manager and architecture review process on platform standards.     Responsibilities
  • Architect and build secure, full stack AI applications using Python, TypeScript, APIs and React or similar user interface frameworks. Integrate LLMs, including Gemini, Claude, GPT and open weight models through Vertex AI and Azure OpenAI, with enterprise systems, MCP tool servers and Automation Anywhere A360 and Agentic Process Automation bots. Support workflows across ERP, HR, ITSM, finance close, electronic signatures and collaboration platforms.
  • Implement coordination across multiple agents using planner and worker, supervisor and handoff patterns with Google Agent Development Kit, Agent Engine, LangGraph or equivalent tools. Build deterministic guardrails, approval gates, role based permissions and complete audit trails so automated actions are explainable, attributable and reversible. Design state management, retries, idempotency and escalation paths for workflows that run over extended periods.
  • Apply enterprise security controls. Use OAuth2/OIDC and ensure service identities have the least privilege access. Manage secrets and implement defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration, like Model Armor. Also, make sure to administer PII properly and maintain audit evidence that meets SOX requirements. Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit and Legal to define and maintain the security and production readiness checklist for agentic applications across the enterprise.
  • Build automated evaluation suites covering task success, groundedness, safety, latency and cost. Develop regression tests, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry tracing of agent steps, token and spend telemetry, SLOs and on call runbooks. Lead production readiness reviews and drive improvements following incidents
  • Partner with business process owners to identify valuable workflows, develop rapid prototypes, define success metrics and ROI, and turn pilots into supported production products. Translate requirements for offshore contractors and vendor engineers, and review their deliverables for quality and security.
  • Contribute reusable MCP servers, agent templates, approval interface components and evaluation harnesses to the shared platform. Create reference architectures and documentation. Mentor engineers in Enterprise Solutions & Technology. Help them understand development practices that encourage self-sufficiency.
  • Support ad hoc projects, including proofs of concept for executive stakeholders and evaluation of emerging models, protocols such as MCP and A2A, and vendor capabilities.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of designing and delivering production LLM applications. The applications should be used by real users on an enterprise scale. They must have features like retrieval augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agents.
  • Expertise in Python or be proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript. Experience in full stack development is required. This means you will create backend services and APIs, like FastAPI or Node. You should also know modern frontend frameworks such as React. It is necessary to have experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Extensive functional experience with at least one major cloud platform. Google Cloud experience, including Vertex AI, Cloud Run/GKE, Pub/Sub and IAM, is preferred; AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. Experience must include Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and CI/CD.
  • Proven experience building agentic systems with orchestration across multiple steps, tool integration including MCP, state management, human approval flows, and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs for correctness, safety and cost.
  • Understand enterprise integration and automation. This includes knowledge of REST and GraphQL APIs. Also, knowledge of event-driven architectures, workflow and business process management concepts, and RPA platforms. Automation Anywhere is preferred; UiPath or Power Automate experience is acceptable.
  • Solid knowledge of application security and compliance. This covers authentication, authorization, secrets management, data privacy, and audit logging. You also need a successful history of passing security and architecture reviews.
  • Great communication skills are important. You need to lead discovery sessions with business partners who might not have technical backgrounds. You should also write clear design documents. Additionally, you will present tradeoffs to senior leaders.
  • Experience coordinating with offshore or globally distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent functional experience.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Experience with Automation Anywhere’s agentic capabilities, including AI Agent Studio, Process Reasoning Engine and Control Room/A360 governance, or building AI agents that invoke RPA bots as tools.
  • Experience with Google’s agent stack, including Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine, Gemini Enterprise and Model Armor, or with Azure OpenAI and Anthropic Claude platforms.
  • Experience authoring MCP servers, working with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol or contributing to open source agent frameworks.
  • Awareness with LLM evaluation tools such as Vertex AI Evaluation, Ragas, DeepEval and Promptfoo.
  • Prior experience in media and entertainment business operations is preferred. This experience can include rights and royalties, content supply chain, finance procedures, and SOX controls. It can also include legal contract workflows. Alternatively, experience in a consulting role with Fortune 500 clients is acceptable.
  • Experience with token budgeting, caching, model routing and user interface design for enterprise applications.

job.description:

job.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a Systems Engineer for its Distribution IT Infrastructure team to manage, test, and maintain our enterprise virtualized infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking systems. In this role, you will deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot modern virtualization platforms (such as VMware vSphere, HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, or Proxmox) to guarantee high availability, scalability, and security across NPR's core distribution technologies.

This role sits at the intersection of physical and virtual infrastructure: you will help stand up new data center hardware and build NPR's private cloud environment on top of it, from rack and cable to hypervisor and host networking.

Working collaboratively with Infrastructure and Security colleagues, you will analyze business workflows, implement structured change management processes, and support capacity planning initiatives to deliver resilient, mission-critical operations for NPR and our nationwide Member station network.

Responsibilities

  • Physical Infrastructure Build-Out: Partner with Infrastructure colleagues to install, rack, cable, and configure new server, storage, and network hardware, including firmware updates, out-of-band management (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC), and RAID/BIOS configuration, to establish the foundation for virtualized workloads.
  • Virtual Infrastructure Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualized systems using enterprise tools (e.g., HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, Proxmox, Nutanix, Incus, or VMware) to support operational reliability.
  • Architecture Evaluation & Testing: Evaluate virtual system architecture, compare existing applications, and create metrics to measure response times and availability for test environments.
  • Change Management Implementation: Recommend and execute system enhancements following established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  • Operational & Capacity Support: Assist the Distribution Infrastructure team in executing cloud/virtualization workflows and capacity planning tools focused on return on investment and business value.
  • Security Alignment & Compliance: Partner with Security Engineers to ensure virtual hosts, operating systems, and network configurations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Workflow & Process Analysis: Analyze and document Distribution IT process workflows, identifying areas for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create comprehensive documentation, procedures, instructions, and training materials for internal colleagues and system users.
  • Incident Escalation & Operational Support: Proactively communicate operational status to management, participate in an on-call rotation, and respond to critical system issues on a 24x7 basis as needed.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and administering servers and networking within a data center environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in the planning, design, deployment, and management of enterprise virtualized cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or open-source hypervisors).
  • Hands-on experience with physical data center hardware, including racking and cabling servers, configuring out-of-band 
  • Competence in DNS administration (BIND preferred).
  • Experience with IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP services.
  • Experience with configuration management (Puppet preferred).
  • Experience creating agentless automation workflows (Ansible preferred).
  • Experience with Mail Transfer Agent administration (Exim).
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2022+) alongside core directory and networking protocols (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS).
  • Practical experience supporting enterprise storage (NetApp or TrueNAS).
  • Comfortable with networking configuration of hosts, switches, and routers, including VLANs, trunking, and NIC bonding/link aggregation as applied to hypervisor hosts.
  • Proven track record as a key contributor or project leader on complex technical initiatives, including the creation of detailed technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in a team environment, handle multiple concurrent projects, and contribute to an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux networking configuration and Cisco switches and routers (Catalyst or Nexus/NX-OS).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript).
  • Experience with enterprise backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
  • Experience with HPE ProLiant or Dell PowerEdge server hardware.
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and relevant industry certifications (VMware VCP, Microsoft, or AWS).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • System Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues across hardware, server, storage, network, and virtualized layers.
  • Structured Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to present technical concepts and write actionable system documentation.
  • Prioritization Under Pressure: Capacity to prioritize tasks effectively during high-urgency system maintenance or operational incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner seamlessly with Security, Network, and Distribution engineering teams.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Commitment to staying current with emerging virtualization tools, cloud platforms, and data center technologies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location

Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $109,350 - $133,650 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. job.title: Senior Mobile Software Architect
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Polyglot Backend Systems: Familiarity with modern backend languages such as Go or PHP in event-driven or microservice architectures.
  • Advanced Caching & Open Source: Experience optimizing edge media caches, working with relational databases/SQL, or contributing to open-source software initiatives.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Technical Governance: Ability to translate complex business and product requirements into clear, practical architectural designs accepted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality Advocacy: Strong commitment to promoting engineering best practices, conducting empathetic code reviews, and elevating overall code quality.
  • Operational Resilience & Diagnostic Vision: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve production incidents under high-urgency conditions during on-call rotation.
  • Structured Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to present software architecture proposals, trade-offs, and technical roadmaps to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Passion for leveraging modern technology to advance public media, accessibility, and audience engagement.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent technical architecture capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

experience

benefits

including the PBS Retirement Plan 403(b); (vi) paid time off (17 days per year), paid sick time

benefits

(12 days per year), paid parental leave (60 days / 12 weeks ), and paid holidays (12 days per year). Details of these benefit plans will be provided upon request. job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is excited to learn the media business end-to-end and grow into sales, client strategy, or revenue operations over time.

Key Responsibilities

Media Planning, Pre-Sale Strategy & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales to support the development of integrated media programs and media plans across newsletters, digital products, custom content, and events.
  • Support pricing inputs, packaging, deal revisions, and rate guidance within established yield and inventory frameworks.
  • Coordinate proposal kick-offs, deal brief creation, internal feasibility checks, cross-functional inputs, and timeline management 
  • Support RFP responses and the creation of polished, visually engaging proposal decks.
  • Prepare for client meetings by compiling research, agendas, and supporting materials; capture notes and draft follow-ups to ensure clear next steps and accountability.

Client Communication & Relationship Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client coordination, ensuring timely communication and follow-through.
  • Build familiarity with client priorities, sensitivities, and goals to anticipate needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure clarity on scope, deliverables, and timelines.

Post-Sale Transition & Program Coordination

  • Support smooth transitions from pre-sale into execution.
  • Maintain client-facing timelines and deliverable trackers.
  • Coordinate campaign launches across newsletters and digital media.
  • Support asset collection, ad specifications, proofs, and confirms in partnership with Ad Ops and Editorial.

Campaign Support, Performance & Optimization

  • Assist with mid-campaign check-ins and performance updates, including basic metric review and insight generation.
  • Help identify potential optimization, added-value, or upsell opportunities in collaboration with Sales.
  • Ensure a consistently high bar for client experience throughout the lifecycle of the program.

Revenue Operations & Internal Coordination

  • Maintain accurate documentation and updates in our CRM (boostr) and workflow tools.
  • Ensure opportunities, products, budgets, and deal details are up to date and accurate.
  • Support maintenance of rate cards, packaging menus, and go-to-market materials.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen pre-sale workflows and cross-functional alignment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • 2–4 years of experience in media, advertising, communications, client services, account coordination, or related commercial role. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Media, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, judgement, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort interacting with clients.
  • Ability to synthesize concepts into actionable next steps.
  • Interest in media planning, integrated programs, and the business of journalism.
  • Ability to operate calmly under pressure and adapt in fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of fast-moving work and shifting priorities
  • High ethical standards and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Comfort managing administrative details, timelines, and a T&E budget responsibly.
  • Boostr experience is a plus.

This position is based in New York, NY.

Comprehensive employee benefits: unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, flexible spending, health savings accounts, life insurance, 401(k), pre-Tax commuter benefits.

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. job.title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs
job.description:
Title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $42.00 - $51.00 per hour
 


Close All Tabs, KQED’s tech and internet culture podcast, is looking for a part-time Engagement  Producer specializing in video to join our team. The show breaks down how the digital world impacts our real lives, and we’re bringing that mission to video. 

You’ll create video and social content for our digital platforms. This includes short-form vertical videos like interview highlights, explainers, behind-the-scenes content, and person on the street interviews. You’ll also create image assets, graphics, and caption copy. 

Working closely with the Close All Tabs podcast team, you’ll adapt the show’s audio storytelling into a visual medium and help refine its look and tone. You’ll take each video from idea to publication: pitching, scripting, shooting, editing/post-production, and posting. You’ll also be responsible for helping grow the show’s social presence, expanding to new platforms, and contributing to audience growth. 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller who wants to combine polished video skills with strange, absurd, and compelling stories from the internet. 

This is a part-time, limited term position reporting to the Senior Editor, Close All Tabs.

 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.


Job duties:
  • Pitch, produce, and edit short-form video content for Close All Tabs’ social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube shorts.
  • Write scripts, production notes, shot lists, and other planning materials
  • Work with the podcast’s producers on a social media plan to promote new episodes 
  • Run single-person or potentially small-crew video production shoots and field work, maintaining professional standards for video and audio recording
  • Direct performance and delivery of host and other on-camera talent
  • Find and license third-party b-roll, photos, music, and other materials, ensuring appropriate rights and permissions
  • Optimize content to perform on each platform (length, format, captions, hashtags, thumbnails, calls to actions) and keep up to date with algorithm changes and new formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episodes and subscriptions) and use the results to shape creative strategy
  • Maintain an organized archive of assets and templates, and streamline production workflows
  • Follow KQED editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and standards for accuracy and fairness
  • Meet production and publishing deadlines while managing multiple assignments

Knowledge/Experience Required
  • Three or more years of video production, video journalism, or multimedia experience (podcast, newsroom, or digital media preferred)
  • Fluency in video editing and post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Final Cut Pro, plus Descript for selecting and editing video.
  • Comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling short- and long-form video, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Strong storytelling instincts: spotting moments that hook viewers, spark emotion, and prompt engagement
  • Experience growing a show’s or brand’s social presence through original, engaging video ideas
  • Strong grasp of how each social platforms works: (Instagram feed, stories, and reels; TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook), including what drives performance and growth
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Solid understanding of journalistic principles, including ethics, accuracy, fairness, attribution, and editorial standards

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Experience working in a public media newsroom or mission-driven journalism organization
  • Familiarity with audio production and sound design
  • Experience with long-form video content, including interviews, video essays, and short documentaries
  • Experience covering technology and the internet, and a real interest in internet culture, online communities, or gaming
  • Experience producing journalism for younger or hard-to-reach digital audiences
  • Experience with professional cameras, lenses, lighting, and audio equipment
  • B.A./B.S. degree in journalism, communications, film, media production, or a related field preferred
  • Love of absurd internet humor a plus

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum.

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment.

  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery. 
  • Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption. 
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations. 
  • Cultivate and manage high-impact relationships with key internal and external partners, driving collaborative initiatives and maximizing mutual value. 

Product Development & Execution:

  • Oversee the entire product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and post-launch iteration, emphasizing agile and iterative development. 
  • Prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic impact, client value, technical feasibility, and business objectives, with a relentless focus on driving meaningful adoption and impact. 
  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable products and features that meet defined requirements, performance standards, and the architectural principles of WPP Open. 
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback.

  • Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM, including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation). 
  • Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain.

  • Strong understanding of marketing data sources, data ingestion, transformation, and reporting challenges. 
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.
