job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Manager, Soundtracks & Marketing, Film Music supports integrated soundtrack, score, artist, social, publicity, awards, and event campaigns across the film slate. Working closely with the SVP, Soundtracks & Marketing, this role supports priority campaigns while independently leading select album, awards, and screening initiatives. The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, collaborative, and able to manage multiple partners, deliverables, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Soundtrack Marketing & Publicity

  • Develop and manage marketing and publicity strategies for soundtracks, scores, singles, composers, and artists.
  • Partner with the SVP on major soundtrack campaigns while independently leading select releases from planning through execution.
  • Liaise with composers, artists, managers, labels, and internal and external marketing teams to establish rollout plans, timelines, key dates, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Create and distribute campaign strategies, release information, assets, and updates to domestic and international partners.
  • Coordinate major-label soundtrack and album campaigns with outside record labels and distribution partners.
  • Work with publicity teams to secure interviews, features, exclusives, and editorial opportunities for composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Prepare priorities and action items before and after executive meetings; create and distribute Back Lot Music press releases and campaign communications.
  • Develop and maintain strong music-industry relationships. DSP, editorial, and music-press contacts are a plus.

Social Media & Digital Marketing

  • Manage Back Lot Music social accounts, content calendars, release posts, and music distribution and smart-link destinations.
  • Coordinate copy, creative, timing, approvals, tagging, and collaborative posts with film accounts, artists, composers, labels, and partners.
  • Create, organize, and distribute social assets and identify catalog, anniversary, talent, and film-marketing moments that extend campaign reach.
  • Ensure messaging and creative remain consistent across social channels and partner campaigns.

Awards Strategy & Submissions

  • Support awards strategies for eligible scores, songs, soundtracks, composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Lead direct submissions, including the GRAMMY Awards, Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA), and Society of Composers & Lyricists (SCL) Awards.

job.title: Local Sales Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WUSA9, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Washington, DC, is seeking a Local Sales Manager. The Local Sales Manager (LSM) is responsible for growing market share and creating brand new TV/Digital business opportunities. The LSM manages and develops the Account Executives and Account Managers on the sales team and develops strategies to win over clients within the market. The LSM oversees performance and holds the team accountable for meeting individual goals and achieving collective objectives for both television and digital.  This position reports to the Director of Sales.  

Responsibilities: 

  • Recruit, retain, and effectively train ‘A’ sales and support talent for your team on how to sell TV and TEGNA’s large portfolio of digital products.  
  • Lead and develop a team of direct reports consisting of Account Executives, Account Managers and manage a handful of dotted-line reports.  
  • Supports sales staff with ride-along coaching, participating in client meetings, developing proposals, and other aspects of the full sales process.   
  • Identify market potential through lead generation and qualification.  
  • Develop a sales strategy for your team and everyone on the team to reach or exceed revenue goals for the station.  
  • Analyze each account to create and maximize ideal marketing executions for clients, and complete appropriate business activity reports and forecasts as required.  
  • Develop strong relationships with local clients, manage key local accounts with your team, and ensure top-shelf service is provided to all accounts.  
  • Review and adjust metrics to monitor sales/market share changes. 
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of large-scale sports sponsorships, including building budgets, developing go-to-market strategies, and developing key relationships to maximize revenue opportunities. 

 

Requirements: 

  • Minimum of 2 years of sales management experience 
  • Track record of successfully achieving or exceeding sales goals in the broadcast TV industry within fast-changing, dynamic environments, spanning all the facets of marketing solutions from linear TV to digital, including OTT.    
  • Established leadership skills and demonstrated ability to develop teams with elite sales and customer service skills.   
  • Strategic thinker and disciplined executor comfortable developing and making recommendations to senior management.  
  • Possess the ability to build inclusive and positive work culture to foster success for the sales team.   
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Wide Orbit Sales, Salesforce, Wide Orbit Traffic & Wide Orbit Analytics, ComScore, Matrix, Media Monitors, and qualitative data.  
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects effectively under deadline pressure.  
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.  
  • Ability to effectively solve problems.  
  • Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners. 

 On-Target Earnings (OTE): Base salary of $130,000–$160,000 annually, plus target variable compensation, for total on-target earnings of $250,000–$275,000 annually. Actual earnings may vary based on performance.

Pay Range$130,000—$160,000 USD

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Cyber Security Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE TEAM

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineering team deploys and manages enterprise SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, and related integrations. It partners with Security Operations and IT teams to maintain effective detection, response, resilience, and security-control coverage.


THE ROLE

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineer 3 is the highest non-lead individual contributor in the solutions engineering team. This role provides advanced technical ownership across one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, architects complex integrations and automation, leads high-severity technical response and major change, establishes engineering standards, and develops the capability of lower-level engineers.


The engineer must be able to become effective quickly in a complex environment and serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing response across critical platforms and ensuring timely escalation. The position operates with broad technical discretion.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Act as technical owner and subject-matter expert for one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, defining reference configurations, lifecycle standards, resilience patterns, capacity requirements, recovery objectives, and measurable service outcomes.
  • Serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing cross-platform triage and response, assigning technical actions, making time-sensitive decisions within delegated authority, and escalating material risk promptly.
  • Architect and deliver complex multi-platform integrations, telemetry and data pipelines, orchestration and automation frameworks, and connections to cloud, identity, endpoint, network, IT service-management, and enterprise data services.
  • Serve as the final internal escalation point before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer or vendor product engineering for systemic failures, scale and performance issues, data-quality defects, high-availability problems, and cross-platform dependencies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and problem remediation for recurring or high-impact failures, ensuring corrective actions address technical, process, monitoring, documentation, and resilience gaps
  • Lead the security engineering workstream during high-severity incidents and readiness exercises, coordinating specialized analysis, emergency tool changes, containment execution, telemetry validation, recovery, and after-action improvement.
  • Define tuning, query, content, detection-support, vulnerability-scan, and telemetry-quality strategies in partnership with Security Operations and control owners; establish measures that demonstrate improvement
  • Lead major upgrades, migrations, platform consolidations, architecture changes, and new capability implementations; own technical design, dependency analysis, risk assessment, test strategy, rollback, readiness, and operational handover.
  • Build and govern reusable automation frameworks and deployment tooling, including code standards, peer review, secrets handling, testing, observability, failure recovery, and maintainability expectations.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead proofs of concept, comparative testing, technical due diligence, and recommendation development; provide evidence for the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer's roadmap.
  • Establish engineering standards for configuration validation, documentation, change quality, disaster recovery, access control, auditability, and operational support across the role family.
  • Use service, risk, coverage, performance, and incident data to identify systemic gaps, develop technical and business cases, and present prioritized recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor Levels 1 and 2, delegate project tasks, assess technical quality, and provide development feedback without assuming formal performance-management authority.
  • Represent Cyber Security Solutions Engineering in architecture, governance, audit, major project, and vendor forums; translate business and control requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Partner with the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer on roadmap planning, capacity, vendor performance, and operating-model improvement.

Level Scope and Accountability

  • Autonomy: Operates with broad technical discretion and without routine supervision within approved strategy, architecture principles, policy, and governance.
  • Technical scope: Critical platform ecosystems, complex cross-platform dependencies, enterprise integrations, and high-risk engineering change.
  • Decision authority: Sets technical methods and standards within delegated scope, approves complex designs and changes, and directs technical response. Escalates policy exceptions, risk acceptance, budget, resource conflicts, and final roadmap decisions.
  • Escalation: Final internal technical escalation before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer, vendor product engineering, architecture governance, or executive risk channels.
  • Leadership: Leads major technical workstreams, design reviews, and capability development. No direct reports, compensation decisions, performance reviews, hiring authority, budget ownership, or final portfolio prioritization.
  • Core-hours accountability: Serves as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing complex response across critical platform ecosystems and ensuring timely escalation of material risk.

 


WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • At least 8 years of direct, hands-on professional or military cybersecurity engineering experience, including at least 3 years serving as a senior technical owner, subject-matter expert, or escalation point for enterprise security platforms in complex environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in multiple security technology domains such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, security orchestration, or comparable platforms, with deep expertise in at least one domain.
  • Deep administration and troubleshooting capability across Linux/Unix, Windows, TCP/IP networking, DNS, PKI and certificates, authentication, APIs, virtualization, public cloud, load balancing, clustering, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable languages, including production coding practices, testing, version control, logging, error handling, and secure secrets management
  • Demonstrated success architecting complex integrations, leading major upgrades or migrations, and resolving systemic or high-impact platform failures
  • Experience leading technical response during significant security incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and driving sustained corrective action.
  • Working knowledge of security and control frameworks and statutory/regulatory mandates such as NIST and ISO 27001, GDPR and CCPA, including the ability to translate control requirements into technical standards and auditable evidence.
  • Strong technical leadership, design-review, mentoring, vendor-management, and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Type A personality and work style: an exceptionally self-directed, decisive, and results-oriented technical leader who acts with disciplined urgency, maintains exacting standards, owns complex outcomes, and drives sustained resolution while remaining measured, collaborative, and risk-aware.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, GIAC GCIA or GCIH, advanced cloud security, architecture, or vendor-specific engineering certification.
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines, orchestration platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, configuration management, or security-content engineering.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed environments, high-volume event platforms, or services with strict availability and response requirements

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. 


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation. 

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

 

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process.  Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

 

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

 

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

job.title: Music Operations Specialist
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Music Operations Specialist 

 

***Please note: We offer flexibility in work location. The successful candidate may be based anywhere in Canada where Rogers operates a radio station.***

 

Who we're looking for:

 

Reporting to the National Music Operations Manager, the Music Operations Specialist plays a key role in shaping the sound of multiple music brands across our network through thoughtful scheduling and playlist management.

 

We’re looking for someone who understands that great music scheduling is both an art and a science. You know how to build effective clocks, rules, and parameters that allow MusicMaster to do the heavy lifting, while also recognizing when a playlist needs the human touch to get the flow just right.

 

What you'll do: 

  • Schedule and maintain music logs for multiple brands and formats.
  • Build & manage clocks, categories, rules, and scheduling strategies.
  • Monitor playlist performance to ensure we’re on strategy.
  • Build reports as needed.
  • Maintain music database(s).

 

What you bring: 

  • Experience with music scheduling and playlist management, preferably using MusicMaster.
  • Strong understanding of music clocks, scheduling rules, rotations, categories, and reporting.
  • Ability to balance data-driven scheduling with creative playlist curation.
  • Familiarity with a variety of music formats and programming philosophies.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 

Bonus Points

  • Experience scheduling multiple music formats.
  • Advanced MusicMaster knowledge, including rule building, troubleshooting, and workflow optimization.

 

What's in it for you?

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential!

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls and the surrounding area remain one of the fastest-growing regions in the Upper Midwest and are home to 300,000 people, constituting more than 30% of the state's population. Healthcare and finance make up much of a diverse and broad workforce. The business climate in South Dakota continues to be one of the top in the nation, fueled by no state income tax and a diverse workforce.

There is never a shortage of activities or events, with summers packed with outdoor festivals and concerts, including free concerts at the Levitt at the Falls outdoor music venue.

Still, many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails and parks, including the namesake of the city, the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! Yes, winters can be challenging, but it does not mean people hibernate. Colder temperatures provide plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. From parades like the annual Parade of Lights down Phillips Avenue to outdoor ice skating parks, life does not slow down in the winter in Sioux Falls.

The city is home to a 12,000-seat arena that is continually hosting major events and entertainment acts, ranging from the Professional Bull Riders, college and semi-professional hockey, indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, and Elton John.

The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, an indoor ice-skating facility, a basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. Multiple award-winning golf courses, both public and private, surround the city, offering a relaxing and challenging day on the links

Culinary appetites never need to look far from being satiated, as there is no shortage of places to eat. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally owned, nationally recognized restaurants and restaurateurs. For those looking for a quick weekend getaway, nothing to fear. You can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five. Since Sioux Falls is centrally located in the Midwest, direct and connecting flights to almost anywhere in the United States are often less than a few hours in length.

Dakota News Now is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a relatively new studio in downtown Sioux Falls, branding all stations under the Dakota News Now umbrella. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week.

Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news and assisting local clientele in achieving their marketing goals.

job.title: Press Operator (38) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

This position is Full-time (40 hr) benefits eligible, schedule is Sunday night through Friday morning, 11:30pm - 7:30am.

The Press Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates belt fold machines, page insert machines, double overlay machines, etc. that fold paper, light weight packets, and board stock in multiple ways.  May apply glue to stock during operation.  The machinery is of varying vintages, manufacturers, and types with multiple variables impacting press performance.  Applies acetate, vinyl overlay (materials sensitive to temperature, pressure, ink, etc.) or insert pages to greeting cards.  Performs make-ready duties and prepares press or multiple presses, and types of presses to run a variety of folds, some with severe die cut design.  Maintains and operates glue systems.  Incumbent may also diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions while assisting operators.  Responsible for specified production, quality checks, and TPM’s.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.

Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on multiple press types with varying controls and production factors (speed, temperature, pressure, etc.). 
  • Read layout, tickets and have an understanding of downstream processes.  
  • Diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions. 
  • Execute the Quality System including preflights, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. 
  • Prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage.
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within the shorter periods of time.
  • Utilize good safety practices.   

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

Internal applicants will be considered in seniority order based on skills, qualifications and performance.  You must address how you meet the basic qualifications of the job in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. In order to be considered for this position:

  • Your performance will be reviewed dating 12-months back from the date the job posting comes down.  You must have been satisfactory in all areas and have no disqualifying CR’s for that full 12-month period in order to be considered. 
  • You must have been in your current job for at least 6 or 12 months, depending on the role.
    • 35, 36, 37 – at least 6 months
    • 38,39,40 – at least 12 months

If additional openings become available within 30 days of the posting coming down and the vacancy is still in an open status, applicants will be selected from the original posting. If interested in this job, please apply now. 

If you are offered and accept this position, you understand that you will be held within this position for 12 months.  If you are offered a new position once you accept, but have been in your position for less than 6 months you will not be able to move to a new role.

  • Ability to frequently transfer stock weighing 20 pounds and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds.  May lift 70 pounds with assistance.

job.title: Weekend Anchor / Senior MMJ
job.description:
WKBT News 8 Now, the CBS affiliate in La Crosse, Wisconsin (DMA 129) is looking for an experienced Weekend Anchor/Senior MMJ who is ready to take the next step in their career. If you are a strong and engaged communicator who wants to cover the stories that matter from the field as well as the anchor desk, this is the opportunity for you. 


Here's what our ideal candidate needs to know: 

  • WKBT is the type of station where you can share your passion with other like-minded storytellers, advance your career, and make an immediate contribution. 
  • We will provide you with the opportunity to grow as a storyteller, do great live shots, and lead in the digital landscape.  
  • You may be tapped to serve as fill-in anchor for other shows as needed. 
  • We provide regular, constructive feedback from an experienced team and an outside storytelling coach. 
  • You'll need a passion to look beyond an event or press release to provide context to the stories you're assigned. 
  • You will have the opportunity to work with a photographer on a regular basis and will not do your own live shots. 
  • We love innovation when it comes to workflow, content, and training, and we want to hear your ideas. 

Qualifications/Requirements: 

  • Two years of anchoring/live reporting experience, preferred. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism or related field. 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including excellent news writing and visual storytelling. 
  • Familiarity with digital video cameras, non-linear editing, and social media platforms. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency with social media platforms and audiences. 
  • Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays if needed. 
  • Ability to lift 30 lbs. of gear and to sit, walk, or stand for long periods of time. 
  • Valid Driver's License and good driving record. 

 

Morgan Murphy Media is a progressive and family-owned business that places our highest values on our employees, the workplace culture, and the communities we serve. WKBT is the CBS affiliate proudly serving western Wisconsin, southeastern Minnesota, and northeast Iowa. In addition to offering an array of traditional broadcast channels and award-winning newscasts, we are at the forefront of the digital and on-demand landscape locally through our website and news, weather, and streaming apps.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate and support diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and our communities.

job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Technical Operations team is seeking an experienced Product Operations Associate to assist with supporting various platforms at NFL Media including: NFL+, NFL.com, NFL app, and Clubs Sites. This person will be expected to immerse themselves within the details of all digital products and become a communication hub for operational activities. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills and demonstrate confidence in a fast-paced environment. This position communicates with Product Management, Technology, Marketing and Sales departments This role will report directly to the Senior Director of Digital Operations.

This is a temporary benefited role spanning 8+ months, paying $2,200.00 - $2,500.00 weekly.  

Responsibilities

  • Serve as central POC for communication and stakeholder management for all NFL's in-market products from product marketing, in-market operational support, content strategy, product enhancements, engineering, business development and legal.
  • Create concise plans and presentation for cross functional teams not limited to senior leadership from process/product ideation to in-market consumption.
  • Develop, manage, and continuously improve processes for scale that help the Digital Programming and Product teams meet their goals more efficiently and effectively.
  • Develop, manage, and enhance business analytics of in-market performance, not limited to KPI measure of operational performance, foster and maintain new technical partnerships with external and internal clients/vendors.
  • Provide operational support for our digital O&O platforms on all gamedays and around League tentpole events, including reporting and prioritization of issues.
  • Manage operational execution and support of live streaming digital shows on NFL.com.
  • Manage content updates within the CMS for various stakeholders within digital content programming, editorial and the League including active NFL.com webpage.

  • Oversee all new/existing partner integrations and operational responsibilities for authentication management for NFL O&O products not limited to MVPDs and Broadcast partners.
  • Serve as central POC for Live Broadcast blackout/retrans management & communications.
  • Maintain relationships with partner support teams who operate within and outside NFL.com support instance.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Help communicate Club product needs.
  • Ensure Service Desk developers have all the information they need to troubleshoot bug tickets.
  • Have an overall understanding of NFL and Club issues for prioritization.
  • Create runbooks and instructional articles to assist clubs with product updates.
  • Act as liaison between Clubs and the NFL streaming services during Preseason.
  • Quickly triage incidents impacting all Clubs.
  • Send release notes to Clubs and communicate platform updates/outages.

 Required Qualifications

  • BS or BA in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field preferred.

  • Ability to supervise employees, handle conflict, manage change, and improve operations.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Prior experience with Content Management Systems (CMS).
  • Prior experience in operational support of a web and mobile based applications.
  • Prior experience managing a JIRA board and writing user story tickets.

  • Experience with markup skills utilizing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is preferred.
  • Proficiency in design via tools such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong Knowledge of 3rd party authentication work streams.
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football.
  • Demonstrate the ability to create and maintain documentation and runbooks.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to understand and document business rules.
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • Excels collaborating with teams.

  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Passion for leading in a collaborative, cross functional team environment.

job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connections, WTVF
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections at WTVF, NewsChannel 5 in Nashville, Tennessee, you’ll serve as a primary connector between the station and the communities of Nashville and Middle Tennessee, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism and create meaningful partnerships.

You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure NewsChannel 5 remains an essential, responsive and trusted part of life across Middle Tennessee.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent WTVF throughout Nashville and Middle Tennessee and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns and story tips are acknowledged, routed and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

Buffalo, New York is a city on the rise — a proud, resilient community with deep roots, genuine warmth, and an exciting future. Sitting at the eastern edge of Lake Erie and just across the border from Canada, Buffalo offers an enviable quality of life at a fraction of the cost of larger metros. The revitalized waterfront along Canalside draws visitors and residents alike year-round, with concerts, ice skating, kayaking, and festivals that celebrate everything Buffalo has to offer. The city's rich architectural heritage — including Frank Lloyd Wright landmarks and the stunning Guaranty Building — gives it a character unlike anywhere else in America.


Buffalo is a food lover's city with a distinct identity. From the birthplace of the Buffalo wing at the Anchor Bar to world-class chef-driven restaurants in Elmwood Village and Larkinville, the dining scene punches well above its weight. The arts community is equally vibrant, anchored by Albright-Knox Northland (now Buffalo AKG Art Museum), Shea's Performing Arts Center, and a thriving live music scene. Sports are a way of life here — Bills fans are legendary for their passion, and the Sabres bring NHL excitement to KeyBank Center each season.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find no shortage of adventure. Niagara Falls is just 20 minutes away, offering one of the world's most iconic natural wonders right in your backyard. The region's state parks, ski areas in the nearby hills, and easy access to the Finger Lakes wine country make Buffalo an ideal home base for those who love to explore. With a strong sense of community, affordable neighborhoods, and a city that genuinely welcomes newcomers, Buffalo is a wonderful place to plant roots and make a real difference.

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Production Coordinator Job ID 10164416 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 10, 2026 Production Coordinator Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Management Operations partners with nearly every division of ESPN and many across The Walt Disney Company to ensure ESPN’s Content business is operating at the highest level of efficiency and productivity. Content leaders focus their efforts on the fan while this team focuses on the personnel and business management aspects of how content comes to life. Together, this team consistently maximizes resources for the greatest impact on our content and bottom line. A Production Coordinator supports the day-to-day workforce planning and business operations of ESPN’s Content division. Scheduling resources, vendor & contract management, and legal & policy adherence will all be job functions this role carries out. This role will also find and create efficiencies in processes and workflows along with interacting with all types of content and leaders across our organization. Responsibilities: Executes workforce planning and business operations for ESPN’s Content division. Works with content leaders to plan, request and allocate resources, schedule personnel and/or facilities, review time entry and expenses, track paid time off, etc. Analyzes content scenarios and creates plans to support initiatives while adhering to resource and financial limits and departmental processes and protocols. Maintains knowledge of the business processes, workforce guidelines, and resource planning required across assigned content areas. Fully understands policies and processes that guide work (Ex. T&E policy, workforce classifications, time entry). Educates, trains, and advises others on policies and processes and promotes adherence. Participates in developing and modifying policy and processes. Partners with and functions as a liaison for various departments (Ex. Production, Operations, HR, Legal, outside entities, etc.) Attends meetings with stakeholders; represents a neutral party in discussions. Participates in developing, implementing, and enhancing technology tools and workflow processes. Provides training to team members, new hires, client groups, and other personnel as needed. Ensures that appropriate timelines are met for all projects and tasks. Deals with time-sensitive and confidential materials and decisions (Ex. budgets, fees, performance). Daily tasks can include: Participate in sourcing, hiring, managing, scheduling, and/or providing feedback on various roles. Train and guide others in the processes of engaging workers and vendors. Process hiring requisitions. Request and/or draft short-form contracts for various roles and/or vendors. Enter, track, and manage contract information in the system of record. Review, approve and reject timecards and expense reports according to Disney timekeeping and travel and expense policies. Create, organize, and distribute various data and reports. Create new vendors in the Disney vendor portal and coordinate with Disney Shared Services on troubleshooting vendor set-ups. During production peak times, remains accessible and may be required to work non-traditional days/hours. Required Qualifications: Minimum of 2 years of business, personnel, production, or operations experience. Strong organizational skills (Ex. budgeting time, prioritizing workload, accuracy, and attention to detail in all tasks). Effective communication skills (Ex. clear and concise in all forms of communication, ability to manage high-volume email, phone traffic, and in-person interactions). Demonstrated ability to take initiative and perform independently with some guidance from management and senior teammates (Ex. suggest ideas and solutions to problems that arise, ability to recognize when an issue is present and provide rectifying solutions). Demonstrated ability to react quickly and positively to a wide variety of sensitive production and personnel situations that arise and are subject to continual change. Experience in various aspects of resource management and business operations (Ex. processing contracts/invoices, creating/maintaining/distributing information, resource scheduling/staffing). Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office programs & platforms (Ex. Office 365, Outlook, Excel, Word, One Note, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams) and Smartsheet or similar programs. Demonstrated passion and commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment that enables everyone to belong and thrive. Preferred Qualifications: Knowledgeable about the sports content landscape. Possesses basic understanding of the production of studio shows, remote events, digital, and/or packaged shows. Understands basic reporting and analytics processes, identifying trends, and developing metrics. Solid analytical and technical critical thinking skills. Basic financial/budgetary management experience. Working knowledge of the following systems/tools: Concur, Kronos, SAP, and business intelligence tools like MicroStrategy. Required Education: High School Diploma or equivalency. Preferred Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience from Vocational School, or in Production, Journalism, Business or related field. #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, Connecticut is $60,400.00 to $80,900.00 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. job.title: Part-Time Sports Content Researcher
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Job ID 10164761 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 13, 2026 Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements You have a head for stats, an eye for a great story, and the range as a writer to be creative and succinct -- and your passion for sports is the beating heart that fuels it all. This is the type of person who thrives as a Sports Content Researcher at ESPN. This position will work on NFL Network and other shows produced in Inglewood, CA, and be part of the company’s larger Research & Graphics squad – with staff also located in Bristol, CT and Charlotte, NC. Our mission is simple to define but incredibly complex to deliver: Provide ESPN’s television, audio, digital and social platforms with statistics, context and historical perspectives that make our sports coverage as interesting to the sports fanatic as it is understandable to the casual observer. It’s no easy feat, but we do it 24/7, and we think we do it better than anyone else. If this sounds like you and you’re up for the challenge, please apply today! Ok, it’s true: You’re in the office on Super Bowl Sunday. And for the NFL Draft. And the NFL schedule release. But the office is ESPN’s production center in Inglewood, CA, and you’re surrounded by people who share your passion. You’re a member of a tight squad of like-minded professionals who feed an endless flow of differentiating content that lands across ESPN platforms. Sports Content Researchers tap their existing reservoirs of knowledge and use ESPN’s vast resources – including access to world-class advanced metrics -- to hone in on the why and how of the sporting events that are most important to ESPN and sports fans. The NFL, college football, and the NBA are year-round staples, with significant coverage of the NHL, WNBA, and college basketball. Any sport could deliver the story of the day, week, or month. Responsibilities Many people say this, but in Research, it really is true: Sports news is constant, so no two days are the same. On any given day or night, you might: Create original full-screen graphics and anchor lead-ins for live shows such as those on NFL Network or any ESPN platform , using research you’ve done and copy you’ve written; Post the most relevant news on the ESPN BottomLine/NFL Network ticker – from Breaking News alerts to in-depth coverage and putting complex news stories into context; Put your deep knowledge to work to create game previews for shows that are informative, factually accurate, and unique enough that even die-hard sports fans really learn something; Collaborate with colleagues for every element of a studio show, from unearthing little-known facts to quickly bringing up relevant stats when things such as trades, coaching changes, or injuries are announced; Provide real-time updates for anchors and announcers while they are on the air; Flex your storytelling muscles by developing interesting segments, and help your colleagues flesh out their own ideas; ESPN is known for its cutting-edge graphics, and you will be one of the people who develop visually appealing, factually revealing visuals for our TV and digital feeds; Drop everything when news breaks and use your deep knowledge of advanced metrics, analytics, and research tools to create supporting content, often with a deadline of minutes or seconds! Working in Research also means you: Work a schedule that will vary by month and/or season -- you’ll get to dive deeply into sports and have enough variety to keep your days and week fresh; Experience professional growth and development – in addition to onboarding, training, and coaching that is a constant, you’ll meet with your supervisor formally twice a month and receive quarterly performance updates. Basic Qualifications: Minimum of 1 year of related experience in sports, statistics, research, or a related field Full availability for this position to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays Broad knowledge of most sports and deep knowledge of the NFL and several others, including awareness of current/historical sports statistics, milestones, news, and events Elite writing and grammar skills. Must have aptitude to research, write air-ready scripts for BottomLine as well as Event and Studio productions Must be able to communicate information accurately Must be able to adhere to strict deadlines and react to breaking news Must be able to follow all Disney, ESPN, and department policies and directives Preferred Qualifications Minimum 2 years of experience working with statistics in an online, television, or print media environment Fluency in reading, speaking, and writing Spanish Demonstrated track record of training others and/or managing team-based projects Required Education High School diploma or equivalent Preferred Education College degree or equivalent #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles is $42,280 to $56,630 per year based on a 28 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with ESPN Productions, Inc, which is part of a business we call ESPN. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. ESPN Productions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Photographer
job.description:
FOX6 is looking to hire a creative, visual storyteller who enjoys collaborating with Newsroom staff to get the latest news into the hands of viewers. You must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be willing to pivot from one assignment to the next.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Not an office job! As a FOX6 Photojournalist, your days will be anything but monotonous. You’ll be in the field chasing breaking news with a reporter and turning stories on a tight deadline. You’ll be tasked with covering local events or even going on your own to capture compelling weather video. You’ll flex your storytelling muscles with long form pieces that you are passionate about. And you’ll create content for digital and social platforms.  We will provide the equipment so you can capture the best sequences, natural sounds and moments to produce compelling stories that our viewers need to know.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Vocational/Technical School degree strongly preferred
  • At least two years of Television News shooting experience, as well as technical knowledge of non-linear editing software, preferably Edius, and photo equipment including lighting equipment
  • Must be physically able to lift, carry and handle 30 to 50 pounds of camera gear, and deal with the realities of a Wisconsin winter or summer
  • Position requires driving
  • Drone license preferred
  • Ability to handle strict deadlines
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work as a team is necessary
  • Working weekend and/or holidays is a possibility
  • Ability to troubleshoot and stay calm during the urgency of live news

*This is a NABET represented position.

job.title: Human Resources Business Partner
job.description:
The Fox Television Stations (FTS) HR team is seeking a business-minded, hands-on HR Business Partner to support our Sales Team, Finance and other corporate functions. This role is for an experienced HR professional who pairs strategic thinking with strong day-to-day execution and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast and streaming environment.

Reporting to the Senior Regional HR Director, the HRBP will own day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle while acting as a trusted advisor to department leadership. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, credibility, and the ability to translate business needs into practical people solutions. This individual will be comfortable navigating change and balancing competing priorities.

The HRBP will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, and Learning & Development, to deliver a consistent and effective employee experience across stations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and advisor to station leadership, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, staffing models, and people priorities
  • Serve as the primary HR resource for employees and managers, providing guidance on policies, procedures, benefits, and employment practices and resolving issues directly
  • Develop a deep understanding of sales, finance and corporate function, and proactively identify people needs and opportunities
  • Lead talent management and performance processes, including talent reviews, succession planning for key roles, development planning, and performance management
  • Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives that strengthen performance, collaboration, and team culture
  • Manage offboarding and exit interview processes, analyzing themes and trends to inform retention strategies and recommendations to department leadership
  • Provide solutions-oriented counsel on employee relations matters, conducting or coordinating investigations and partnering with Employment Legal and HR leadership as appropriate
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation on hiring strategies, recruitment, and competitive offer development
  • Own the new hire experience, including onboarding, orientation, and Form I-9 completion and compliance, and continuously improve onboarding practices in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HR Operations
  • Coach and advise managers on employee development, performance, scheduling challenges, team effectiveness, and management practices
  • Use workforce data, including headcount, turnover, and leave trends, to identify issues, influence decisions, and recommend actions to leadership
  • Ensure accurate and timely employee data in Workday, including new hires, job changes, transfers, promotions, and terminations, and regularly audit station data for accuracy
  • Partner across HR functions to ensure programs and policies are effectively implemented and aligned with department needs
  • Support HR initiatives and special projects that advance FTS and FOX's broader people and business strategies
  • Maintain a strong understanding of employment law, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements across the markets supported
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including Form I-9, required postings, mandatory trainings, and record keeping, and identify and address compliance risks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience supporting complex, fast-paced, or multi-location organizations
  • Experience in broadcast, local media, news, or another 24/7, deadline-driven operating environment strongly preferred
  • Broad HR expertise across the employee lifecycle, including talent management, employee relations, performance management, organizational design, and workforce planning
  • Hands-on experience with core HR operations, including onboarding, Form I-9 compliance, and HRIS transactions, with the ability to both execute directly and improve processes
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies
  • Excellent judgment and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt to executive, management, and employee audiences
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to inform recommendations; experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships across HR functions and with stakeholders in multiple locations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility to support employees across shifts, including occasional early morning, evening, or weekend needs
  • Willingness to travel to supported locations as needed up to 25%
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: System Analyst, Remote IT Operations
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The System Analyst, Remote IT Operations will play a key role in supporting the IT services that keep our live events and remote operations running smoothly. This position blends technical expertise with operational excellence - ensuring our teams are equipped with reliable, secure, and scalable technology, wherever the work takes them.


Responsibilities:

  • Deliver IT support for remote operations, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and network services.
  • Manage inventory, installation, and configuration of remote infrastructure kits.
  • Maintain documentation and updates for LAN/WAN connectivity supporting NBCU remotes.
  • Track equipment and scheduling through the remote operations calendar.
  • Partner closely with Broadcast Engineering, Digital, and Corporate Security to support convergence of broadcast and IT technologies.
  • Oversee coordination with external hardware, software, and communication vendors.
  • Identify and implement new technology initiatives and agentive AI to enhance operational efficiency and performance.
  • Develop and maintain IT and networking dashboards for remote operations.
  • Travel to remote sites to provide IT support during high-profile events.
  • Contribute to additional projects and assignments as required.

 Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent training/experience.
  • 3+ years of strong knowledge of network infrastructure systems and sub-systems (routers, switches, LAN/WAN).
  • Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to collaborate across teams and vendors.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies and IT/broadcast convergence.
  • Ability to effectively influence, energize, and coach others.
  • Willingness to work overtime, weekends, and non-traditional hours as needed.
  • Ability to travel extensively in support of remote events.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Familiarity with AI tools/applications (Co-Pilot)

job.description:
