job.title: Account Executive, KERO
job.description:
We are looking for a driven, creative sales professional who loves helping local businesses grow? KERO in Bakersfield, California is looking for an Account Executive, Local who will be a true partner to the business community — connecting clients to the audiences that matter most through a powerful, multi-platform suite of advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, search strategies, social media, digital display, and e-mail targeting, you'll craft customized campaigns that deliver real results and real return on investment. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making a measurable difference for the businesses in your community, this is your opportunity to shine.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bakersfield is California's ninth-largest city and a place with a character all its own — rooted in agriculture, energy, and a deep musical heritage that gave birth to the Bakersfield Sound, a twangy, West Coast alternative to Nashville country that produced legends like Buck Owens and Merle Haggard. The city is home to the Kern County Museum, a vibrant arts scene, and a calendar full of festivals and community events that reflect its proud, hardworking spirit.

Surrounded by stunning natural landscapes, Bakersfield sits at the southern end of the San Joaquin Valley with easy access to some of California's most spectacular outdoor destinations. The nearby Kern River offers whitewater rafting and scenic hiking, while Lake Isabella is a favorite for boating, fishing, and camping. The southern Sierra Nevada mountains are just a short drive away, putting world-class skiing at Mammoth Mountain and the towering peaks of Sequoia National Park well within weekend reach.

With a lower cost of living than most California metros, Bakersfield gives residents the ability to stretch their dollar further while enjoying a warm climate, a growing restaurant and craft brewery scene, and a close-knit community that takes pride in its roots. The city is well-connected via Highway 99 and is within a two-hour drive of both Los Angeles and the Central Coast — making it an ideal home base for those who want California living without California prices.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Community Connections - KKCO
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections at KKCO, you’ll serve as the station’s primary connector to the Grand Junction community, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism, and create meaningful partnerships. You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns, and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure KKCO remains an essential, responsive, and trusted part of community life.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government, and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism, and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust, and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners, and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns, and story tips are acknowledged, routed, and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership, and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion, and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms, and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills, and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns, and sensitive community issues.

Application Review: Applications received by November 3, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


OUR TEAM:

We’re a team of journalists, storytellers, relationship builders, and community advocates who care deeply about the people and places we serve. At KKCO, we bring different backgrounds, perspectives, interests, and experiences to our work, united by a shared commitment to meaningful local journalism and stronger communities. You’ll work alongside collaborative colleagues who value curiosity, authenticity, responsiveness, and finding new ways to connect with audiences both inside and outside the newsroom.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Grand Junction puts you at the heart of Colorado’s Western Slope, where dramatic landscapes, outdoor adventure, and a strong sense of community come together. With access to hiking, biking, rafting, skiing, and the region’s distinctive high-desert scenery, the area offers plenty of ways to enjoy Colorado life beyond the workday.

As Sr. Manager, Community Connections, you’ll have the opportunity to get to know the people, organizations, and communities that shape Grand Junction and the Western Slope. Whether you’re attending a local event, meeting with community leaders, or discovering the stories people are talking about, you’ll be immersed in the community KKCO serves.

job.title: Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content
job.description:
AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue.

We are seeking a Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content to develop, shoot, produce, and launch original, audience-first video and social franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that expand our shows beyond the core podcast, drive audience growth, and increase the long-term value of our talent and show IP.

Partnering closely with leadership, content, social, production, and marketing, this role will proactively identify programming opportunities, pitch new concepts, and own approved projects from idea through delivery. They will also work with individual show teams to develop more creative, visual, and repeatable in-show formats designed to perform across YouTube, social, and the broader digital ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a highly creative video-first producer and director with exceptional original content instincts and the production experience to turn ambitious ideas into finished programming. They are a creator and storyteller, and understand how talent-led digital brands grow across YouTube and social platforms. They should be equally comfortable developing a franchise, directing talent in the field, managing a production budget and external crew, or helping a show producer build a stronger recurring segment. Strong hands-on video production skills are required.

What You’ll Do

  • Proactively develop, pitch, shoot, and produce premium original video franchises, recurring series, tentpole concepts, and shoulder programming built around AMP Sports shows and talent designed to drive audience growth.
  • Own creative process from concept through delivery, including development, ideation, pre-production through post-production, and final delivery.
  • Partner with show producers to level up existing programming through creative concepts designed to improve audience growth, retention, and engagement.
  • Extend the AMP Sports talent and show IP beyond the core podcast, with a particular focus on premium YouTube video, repeatable franchises, and original concepts.
  • Own the entire production process of original video content in, studio, field, and remote environments, maintaining a high standard of creative and technical execution.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help shape the foundations that power experiences across our global streaming portfolio.

You’ll help evolve our global design system, creating the components, patterns, frameworks, and tools that enable teams to build cohesive, accessible, and scalable experiences across TV, web, mobile platforms.

This role is anchored in systems thinking and sits at the intersection of product design and engineering. You'll partner closely with Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, and Brand teams to turn product needs into reusable solutions, strengthen the connection between design and code, and make it easier for teams to build high-quality experiences at scale.

We’re looking for someone who sees patterns beyond individual screens, enjoys solving complex platform challenges, and believes a great design system should empower teams rather than constrain them.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and evolve our design system. Design scalable components, patterns, and foundations, using thoughtful component architecture, variables, modes, and tokens to support experiences across products and platforms.
  • Bridge design and engineering. Partner closely with engineers to translate designs into production-ready components, defining properties, states, behaviors, and specifications while strengthening design-to-development workflows.
  • Solve at the system level. Identify patterns across products, standardize where it creates value, reduce unnecessary complexity, and turn individual product needs into flexible solutions that can scale across experiences.
  • Drive adoption and enable teams. Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and contribution processes. Partner with teams through design reviews, consultation, and office hours to help them effectively use and contribute back to the system.
  • Design with accessibility at the foundation. Incorporate accessibility into components and patterns from the start, applying WCAG standards at the component level and supporting consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Improve how the system works. Explore tooling, automation, and emerging technologies that can improve system maintenance, documentation, QA, and design-to-code workflows.
  • Shape what’s next. Explore how tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows can improve how we build, maintain, document, and use the system.
  • Balance today's needs with long-term system health. Help prioritize system evolution based on product needs, adoption, and system health while balancing near-term delivery with the long-term sustainability of the system.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2+ years of direct experience building, scaling, or implementing design systems.
  • A portfolio demonstrating design systems work, including your approach to components, patterns, systems thinking, and implementation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, variants, auto layout, variables, modes, and library management.
  • Hands-on experience with design tokens, theming, and scalable component architecture.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to translate design system decisions into production components.
  • Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to identify patterns, understand tradeoffs, and translate complex product needs into scalable solutions.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, visual design, and accessibility, including WCAG standards.
  • Experience designing systems that support multiple platforms, products, or devices.
  • Knowledge of and interest in AI-assisted design and development workflows.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and tradeoffs across Product, Design, and Engineering.

job.description:

Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering


#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

Overview:


The Pluto TV Content Operations team intakes, prepares, and publishes every title on our streaming service. We are a global team, based in the US, South America, and Europe. Each year we support twelve regional instances and tens of thousands of assets for hundreds of partners!

 

We are seeking a Director, Content Operations to guide our US content workflows and team. This role is a true team leader! You will be based in the United States. You will build a skilled, accountable team that keeps growing. You will also be our main voice with partners and teams.

 

You will own the US content pipeline: partner onboarding, ingestion, QC, metadata, packaging, and publishing. Every title ships on schedule, to spec, and at the highest quality! You will also scale the team wisely: developing talent, refining processes, and managing capacity. That way we handle more volume at the same quality and speed.

 

Operational excellence is the standard you set and keep. That means a pipeline that runs smoothly at scale, partners who get clear guidance, and a team energized by finding better ways to work. The ideal candidate pairs a talent for growing people with deep technical skill. You love to invent and automate, using cloud tools and data to build operations that scale.

 

You will work closely with Content Partnerships, Programming, Product, Marketing, and Pluto TV Streaming Operations. You will keep improving the Pluto TV viewer experience. You will also align with our International Content Operations leads in Europe and South America. That keeps global standards, best practices, and one way of working.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Content Delivery & Operational Workflow Leadership

 

  • Oversee the U.S. content operations production workflow, including onboarding, asset delivery, QC, metadata, artwork, closed captions, audio, ad-break structure, and final publishing. 
  • Partner with Programming and Content Partnerships to ensure content scheduling, delivery forecasts, and launch timelines are aligned with platform and partner expectations. 
  • Maintain deep expertise in Pluto TV’s evolving deliverable specifications (video, audio, captions, artwork, metadata, UUID’s, ad markers, localization assets etc.). 
  • Support localization pipelines and delivery of multi-language assets across global markets. 
  • Document, maintain, and continuously refine operational workflows, SLAs, SOPs, and cross-functional 
    communication processes. 

 

Team Leadership & Performance Management 

 

  • Coach and grow a skilled team with clear goals.
  • Plan capacity, coverage, and top tasks.
  • Build a good culture that adapts fast.

 

Partner & Vendor Management 

 

  • Manage daily communication with content partners, labs and preferred vendors. 
  • Oversee vendor bidding, cost analysis, rate negotiations, and operational performance reviews. 
  • Ensure partner expectations are met regarding deadlines, technical requirements, and quality standards. 

 

Cross-Regional Collaboration

 

  • Align U.S. Operations with LatAm/Brazil/Canada and European Content Operations leads on standards, tooling, vendor usage, quality baselines, and global workflows. 
  • Drive consistency across regions while supporting local market nuances (content regulations, ratings practices, localization requirements, etc.). 
  • Participate in global operations meetings and task forces supporting Paramount’s shared streaming infrastructure. 

 

Operational Analytics & KPI’s 

 

  • Track KPIs for output, quality, pace, and partner trust.
  • Build forecasts, budget plans, and staffing plans, and help fix supply chain gaps.

Technology, Tooling & Systems Expertise 

 

  • Maintain proficiency with MAM/CMS tools, cloud-based infrastructures and delivery systems, and automated ingestion workflows (S3, FTP, API, JSON/XML/MRSS feed ingestion). 
  • Partner with Content Systems Product and Engineering to define features that enhance Pluto TV’s content supply chain, automation capabilities, and operational observability. 
  • Ensure operational requirements are represented in tooling roadmaps and platform updates.

Compliance & Standards 

 

  • Follow FCC and platform rules for captions, access, and children's content.
  • Keep up with U.S. and global content rules, ad limits, and ratings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 7+ years in streaming operations, or content supply-chain management. 
  • Leadership experience managing a team of 10+ members.
  • Strong understanding of digital video encoding, UHD, HDR Dolby Vision and acceptance workflows.
  • Experience in defining content systems requirements and working within MAM and CMS’s and scheduling systems. 
  • Experience in managing content compliance elements (Closed Captions & Audio Description) and regional regulatory 
    requirements. 
  • Experience with JSON schema’s, XML and Content Metadata formats.

  • Experience managing vendors, negotiating rates, and evaluating performance. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and industry-standard media operations tools.

Overview

The Data Engineering team is seeking a Data Engineer – Self-Service Analytics & Real-Time Data Platforms. In this role, you will help build scalable data products, semantic layers, and real-time data platforms. These platforms enable trusted, governed, and self-service access to data. You will develop solutions that power BI, analytics, experimentation, AI applications, agents, and conversational analytics experiences.


Key Responsibilities

Self-Service Analytics & Real-Time Data Platforms

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch (ETL/ELT) and near real-time streaming data pipelines. These pipelines will process large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Design and maintain semantic layers, metrics frameworks, and curated data products.
  • Enable self-service analytics through governed and reusable business data models.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, and operational best practices.
  • Develop governed data access patterns for AI, conversational analytics, and MCP-based applications.
  • Build AI-ready data products that support machine learning, GenAI, AI agents, and chatbot applications.
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, BI, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver trusted data solutions.

Data Modeling & Platform Architecture

  • Design scalable data models optimized for analytics, real-time reporting, and AI use cases.
  • Develop reusable semantic and transformation layers that provide consistent business definitions.
  • Drive best practices for data quality, governance, metadata, and discoverability.

 

Required Technical Skills

Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL/ELT Expertise

  • 2–4+ years of experience building and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.
  • Proven experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Composer, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts.
  • SQL & Data Modeling for Analytics & ML
  • Expert-level SQL skills for large-scale transformation and analytics.
  • Experience designing scalable warehouse schemas and ML-ready data layers.
  • Proven experience optimizing complex queries across multi-terabyte datasets.

Programming & ML Data Integration

  • Proficiency in Python (or similar language) for data processing and ML pipeline integration.
  • Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark.
  • Experience integrating data pipelines with ML platforms such as Vertex AI (preferred), Databricks ML, or equivalent. This includes model training, batch/online inference, and pipeline orchestration.

Streaming & Event-Driven Systems

  • Experience building real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures.
  • Ability to work closely with the streaming team to architect and build real-time dashboards using Superset.

Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms

  • Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred).
  • Experience with lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings pipelines, and AI-serving infrastructure is a plus.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2–4+ years of experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or related fields.
  • Solid foundation in modern data engineering principles, distributed systems design, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and operate large-scale production data systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to work in dynamic, high-velocity environments.
  • Motivated, thorough, and committed to engineering excellence and ongoing improvement.

job.description:

LET’S GO!

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

job.title: Director, Digital Video
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

CBS News is looking for a director of digital video to lead development and execution of original YouTube shows and series. The ideal candidate is a skilled producer and editor with demonstrated experience driving watch time on YouTube for news and entertainment brands. This is a hands-on role: You will manage a small team but be expected to produce and edit yourself. You should also be a collaborative people-person, as you will tap into the broader CBS News ecosystem of reporters, producers and editors to help support our slate of shows. This position is onsite Monday through Friday 9 am - 5 pm ET.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 
  • Work across CBS News shows and beats to develop and execute on YouTube-first concepts spanning hard news and features
  • Produce, shoot and edit YouTube-first videos and series across a range of CBS News beats, from breaking news and explainers to features and original programming
  • Edit videos in Adobe Premiere Pro, shaping narrative, pacing, structure, sound and visuals to create engaging, polished content
  • Use YouTube performance and audience insights to guide editorial strategy, story selection, packaging and future content development, with a focus on watch time and revenue
  • Steer the pitch process for YouTube-first videos across CBS News
  • Write and review scripts, cuts, headlines, descriptions and other editorial elements, ensuring content is accurate, compelling, polished and ready for publication
  • Coordinate across Rights & Clearances, Legal, Standards, Graphics and other internal teams to identify and resolve issues, align on priorities and ensure content is accurate and ready for publication

 

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in video production within a fast-paced digital media environment
  • Prior management experience required
  • Demonstrated experience in digital-first video production for high-visibility news and entertainment brands
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, with a strong portfolio of video editing work and a demonstrated ability to provide thoughtful editorial and creative feedback
  • Exceptional writing, editing and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear direction, draft and edit copy quickly, and exercise strong editorial judgment
  • Strong understanding of media production workflows, including asset management and production platforms
  • Proficiency with analytics platforms like YouTube Studio and Tubular, with the ability to translate metrics into actionable editorial and content strategies

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $140,000.00 - 165,000.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.

  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Tooling & Quality Engineering Platforms
Team: Global Quality Engineering (GQE)
Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco


Overview
Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and build
advanced AI‑powered tooling and internal platforms that modernize quality engineering across
the organization. This is not an “in test” role — you will be building production systems,
internal platforms, and intelligent automation services that materially improve engineering
efficiency. You will lead the development of AI‑driven services, RAG pipelines, and automation
accelerators that streamline test authoring, triage, and analysis.

 

Key Responsibilities
● Architect and implement AI‑driven services, micro‑platforms, and developer tools thatsupport GQE.
● Build and optimize RAG pipelines, embeddings systems, and LLM‑powered utilities.
● Develop intelligent automation accelerators that classify failures, detect flakiness, and
recommend fixes.
● Integrate AI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and existing automation frameworks.
● Partner with QE, Platform, and Data Engineering to define requirements and deliver
scalable solutions.
● Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
● Evaluate emerging AI technologies and propose functional applications.

 

Qualifications
● 4+ years of software engineering experience with robust backend expertise.
● Proven experience building production‑grade AI or ML‑powered systems.
● Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, and cloud platforms.
● Hands‑on experience with vector databases, embeddings, and LLM orchestration.
● Experience integrating tools into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
● Strong communication and cross‑functional collaboration skills.

 

Key Competencies
● Technical leadership within a team.
● Strong architectural judgment and design skills.
● Ability to break down complex problems and deliver scalable solutions.
● Mentorship and uplift of junior engineers.


Success Metrics
● Delivery of scalable AI tooling adopted across multiple GQE teams.
● Measurable reduction in triage time and improved automation signal quality
● Increased developer productivity through AI‑powered tools.
● Strong technical influence and mentorship impact

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is looking for a dynamic, business-minded HR Business Partner (HRBP) to support an innovative media company in the Southeast region. Areas of experience will include employee relations, leadership development, performance management, change management, and employee engagement.

The HRBP must be results-oriented and partnership focused, with an approach that is responsive to and aligned with business strategies. Selected candidates will be instrumental in facilitating a high- performance workplace. This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days in the station. Moderate travel will be required to support additional client groups.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with leadership teams on organization and culture change, transformation initiatives, succession planning
  • Provide guidance and coaching to managers and employees on employee engagement, performance management, career development, talent assessment, training, acquisition and retention, and workplace investigations as appropriate
  • Work collaboratively with Human Resources colleagues on special projects and initiatives and best practice sharing
  • React productively to change, effectively work at an operational level with multiple stakeholders, and act quickly and confidently under pressure
  • Understand and adhere to local, state and federal laws regarding employment, wage and hour, OSHA and related laws
  • Provide excellent customer service in terms of responsiveness, time management, and communication
  • Champion and lead efforts to promote a high-performance work environment

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree with a concentration in Human Resources or related degree. Master's degree or HR certification is preferred.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of HR generalist/HRBP experience is required
  • A working knowledge of employment laws and multi-level recruitment experience
  • Proficient knowledge/ability with all Microsoft Office Applications and using social media applications in recruiting
  • Record of success advising managers on the full range of HR/people issues
  • Demonstrate professional presentation and conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly establish effective relationships, collaborate, lead and influence
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and deliver results for multiple stakeholders
  • Strong ethical standards and integrity
  • Union environment and negotiation experience a plus

 

Location and Reporting 

  • Position location is preferred to be Charlotte, NC or Atlanta, GA
  • Reports directly to the Group Human Resources Director, Southeast
  • Moderate travel to support additional client groups #LI-MS1

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

job.title: Inside Sales Account Advisor
job.description:
Remote Inside Sales / Marketing Account Advisor

Remote | High-Activity Inside Sales | Existing Accounts + New Business

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Start Date: January 11th, 2027

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by combining trusted local media, advanced marketing technology, and expert guidance to deliver measurable results. From digital advertising solutions to the reach of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses connect with the right customers and grow with confidence.

As an Account Advisor, you'll play an important role in helping local businesses succeed by managing customer relationships, identifying new opportunities, and recommending advertising strategies that drive results. You'll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where daily activity, consistency, and customer focus are rewarded.

About the Role

Our Account Advisor role is designed for energetic, disciplined sales professionals who thrive in a high-volume environment and enjoy balancing customer relationships with new business development.

In this role, you'll manage an existing book of business while actively prospecting for new clients. You'll conduct a high volume of outbound outreach, build relationships with business owners, recommend customized advertising solutions, and guide clients through short, transactional sales cycles. Every day brings a blend of prospecting, account management, follow-up, and campaign coordination, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys staying busy and seeing the direct results of their effort.

During your first 90 days, you'll learn LocaliQ's products, sales process, and technology while building strong daily habits around prospecting, client management, and pipeline organization. With ongoing coaching and support, you'll quickly develop the confidence to manage your book of business and consistently achieve your performance goals.

Why This Role Stands Out

Base salary of $40,000 plus uncapped commission with first-year on-target earnings of $55,000–$60,000

Three-month commission guarantee to support your onboarding and ramp

100% remote work environment with flexibility to work from home

Existing customer base combined with new business opportunities

Ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development

Recognition programs, contests, and performance incentives

Opportunity to build a long-term sales career with one of the nation's most trusted media organizations

Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more

What You Will Do

Execute a high volume of outbound and inbound sales activity, averaging 50+ calls per day.

Manage and grow an existing portfolio of advertising clients while identifying opportunities for retention, upselling, and expansion.

Prospect for new business through consistent outbound outreach and follow-up.

Recommend customized print and digital advertising solutions that align with client goals.

Guide clients through short, transactional sales cycles with urgency and accuracy.

Process advertising orders, campaign updates, and client requests efficiently.

Maintain organized CRM activity, pipeline management, and accurate documentation using Salesforce and other sales tools.

Balance prospecting, customer communication, administrative work, and campaign management throughout each day.

Partner with internal support teams to ensure a positive client experience and successful campaign execution.

Qualifications

Sales experience in inside sales, customer service, retail sales, business development, or another customer-facing environment preferred.

Comfortable making 50+ outbound calls per day in a metrics-driven environment.

Strong communication skills with confidence speaking with business owners over the phone.

Excellent organization, time management, and multitasking abilities.

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.

Ability to quickly learn CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.

Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are disciplined, resilient, and motivated by activity. They enjoy working in a fast-paced sales environment where consistent effort directly influences results. They stay organized while managing multiple client conversations, maintain a strong sense of urgency, and take ownership of their performance every day.

Successful Marketing Account Advisors are naturally proactive, comfortable making outbound calls, receptive to coaching, and energized by building relationships and uncovering opportunities. They understand that success comes from maintaining consistent daily activity rather than occasional bursts of effort.

Benefits

We believe great performance deserves meaningful rewards, career development, and opportunities for growth.

Base salary plus uncapped commission

Three-month commission guarantee

Fully remote work environment

Career advancement opportunities

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) with company match

Generous paid time off and paid holidays

Ongoing onboarding, training, and coaching

High-performance culture with recognition and incentive programs

Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and sales technology

Apply now and get started.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable

#LI-JF1

job.title: Inside Sales Representative – Recruitment Specialist
job.description:
Inside Sales Representative – Recruitment Specialist

Inside Sales | Remote | Uncapped Earnings | Recruitment Marketing

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Work Arrangement: Remote

Start Date: January 11th, 2027

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses grow through powerful marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results.

In this role, you’ll help small and mid-sized businesses solve one of their biggest challenges: finding and hiring the right talent. You’ll connect businesses with recruitment marketing and advertising solutions designed to help them reach qualified candidates and build stronger teams.

You’ll combine sales expertise with marketing solutions across channels such as SEO, SEM, Social Media, OTT/CTV, Display Advertising, and more to help clients attract the people they need to grow.

About the Role

Our Inside Sales Representative – Recruitment Specialist role is a high-energy, consultative sales position for someone who loves building relationships, uncovering business needs, and turning opportunities into results.

You’ll work with businesses nationwide, prospecting for new clients while also managing and growing your own book of business. From the first cold call or virtual meeting through the close and campaign launch, you’ll own the client relationship and serve as a trusted partner throughout the sales process.

You’ll work closely with Client Success Managers to launch and optimize recruitment campaigns, giving you the opportunity to stay connected to the client beyond the initial sale and help ensure their recruitment marketing efforts deliver results.

This is a role where your activity, consistency, and ability to build relationships directly impact your success and earning potential.

Why This Role Stands Out

$41,000 base salary + uncapped commission

$55K–$60K On-Target Earnings

100% remote work environment with a collaborative, energized team

Opportunity to sell recruitment marketing and advertising solutions that solve real business challenges

Full sales-cycle ownership, from prospecting and discovery through close and account growth

Four weeks of immersive onboarding plus ongoing digital skills development

Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, 401(k), parental leave, tuition assistance, pet insurance, volunteer time off, and more

PTO, floating holidays, and 8 paid holidays

Career development and opportunities to grow within the organization

Backed by the resources, marketing expertise, and reach of LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

What You Will Do

Drive new business through consistent prospecting, cold calling, email outreach, and virtual meetings

Build relationships with small and mid-sized businesses nationwide

Uncover client hiring challenges and recommend recruitment marketing solutions aligned to their needs

Sell solutions across SEO, SEM, Social Media, OTT/CTV, Display Advertising, and more

Manage your own book of business, including closing new business, upselling, and re-engaging past clients

Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and consistently work toward revenue goals

Partner with Client Success Managers to launch, support, and optimize recruitment campaigns

Deliver a strong client experience from the initial conversation through ongoing partnership

Track activity, opportunities, pipeline, and performance using Salesforce

Consistently work toward and exceed sales and activity goals

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree OR 2+ years of inside sales experience, with B2B sales preferred

Strong prospecting and cold-calling skills with confidence initiating conversations with new prospects

Ability to uncover client needs and recommend consultative, solution-based offerings

Strong communication, relationship-building, and closing skills

Comfortable working toward sales goals in a performance-driven environment

Experience with digital marketing or recruitment is a plus

Tech-savvy with experience using Salesforce or another CRM

Competitive, resilient, self-motivated, and highly organized

Strong follow-through and ability to manage multiple opportunities

Team-oriented and comfortable balancing individual accountability with collaboration

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, resilient, curious, and motivated by results. They aren't afraid to pick up the phone, start conversations with new businesses, and work through rejection to find the next opportunity.

You’ll thrive if you enjoy building relationships, asking thoughtful questions, solving business challenges, and seeing your effort translate into results.

You’ll also have the support of a collaborative team. While you’ll own your pipeline and performance, you’ll work closely with Client Success Managers and other internal partners to create strong experiences for your clients.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:Complete immersive onboarding, build your product and recruitment marketing knowledge, develop strong prospecting habits, and begin building a healthy pipeline.

6 Months:Consistently prospect, manage a growing book of business, conduct confident consultative sales conversations, and establish steady performance against revenue goals.

12 Months:Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against quota, grow existing client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand your book of business.

Benefits & Growth

We believe strong performance should be supported with competitive compensation, development opportunities, and the tools needed to build a successful career.

$41,000 base salary + uncapped commission

$55K–$60K OTE

401(k)

Medical, dental, and vision coverage

PTO and floating holidays

8 paid holidays

Four-week immersive onboarding program

Ongoing training and digital skills development

Remote work flexibility

Career growth and advancement opportunities

Collaborative team environment with strong leadership support

Help Businesses Find the People They Need

Businesses can’t grow without great people. In this role, you’ll help them solve that challenge while building valuable sales, marketing, and recruitment expertise of your own.

If you’re ready to build relationships, close deals, help businesses hire great talent, and be rewarded for your results, we encourage you to apply.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $12.55 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of multiple factors, including market location, education level, skills, certifications, and experience. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and may apply based on the role.

If you've spent time in retail, restaurants, hospitality, customer service, or another fast-paced environment, you likely already have many of the skills needed to succeed here.

We'll teach you everything else.

You'll play an important role in keeping daily operations organized and ensuring customer requests are handled accurately and on time. Some of your responsibilities will include:

Responding to customer and sales representative questions by phone and email

Entering information into computer systems and processing public notices

Checking notices and proofs for accuracy and completeness

Monitoring deadlines and helping ensure notices are processed on time

Assisting with questions and coordinating with other teams when needed

Learning department systems and procedures through hands-on training

Every day will bring a mix of responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to learn new things and build confidence in an office setting. You'll have support along the way as you get comfortable with the role.

What We're Looking For

Enjoy working with people and providing helpful customer service

Are comfortable using computers and picking up new programs

Have a good eye for detail and care about accuracy

Can stay organized while managing different tasks

Communicate effectively and professionally

Are reliable, take responsibility, and follow through on commitments

Experience in retail, restaurants, hospitality, call centers, reception, or customer service can be a great foundation for this position.

Whether you're looking to move into your first office role, return to the workforce, or find a change from your current work environment, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Enjoy a More Predictable Workweek

Paid Time Off

Company holidays

Training and development opportunities

A supportive team environment

job.title: Local Investigations Fellowship Expression of Interest
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times offers a menu of programs and opportunities aimed at up-and-coming journalists and professionals from all backgrounds and with various skill levels.

Learn more about career programs here.

The application window for the Local Investigations Fellowship is currently closed and will reopen in summer of 2027.

Cover Letters for the Local Investigations Fellowship include at least one story idea or pitch, but multiple may be sent in each cover letter. Answers to these questions help us assess where you are in the reporting process and what editorial support and resources the local investigative fellowship could offer you.

  1. What is your investigative story idea or area of focus? How would your story expose something new, something no one else has already revealed?
  2. Describe who has been harmed and in what way. Is the harm enough to spark outrage?
  3. Will your story hold someone accountable? Who and how?
  4. What critical records, data and human sources will be required to tell your story? Describe how you have, or could, obtain these critical sources.
  5. What do you need help with to report this story, and what are the barriers?
  6. Can you give us a sense of what has been written about the subject? Please include clips of notable reporting on the topic.

We appreciate proposals that are as detailed as possible. Previous successful applicants have included specifics about what they aimed to prove through their investigations. 

For example, a reporter for The Baltimore Banner had reason to believe that the city’s overdose crisis was the worst in the nation. Mississippi Today had evidence of abuses in local sheriffs offices. And a reporter for The Desert Sun in Palm Springs, Calif., suspected a pattern of deaths inside local jails. 

Please submit five published clips that show excellence — in evocative writing, through high-impact news stories and by highlighting the voices of local communities. Your clips should be uploaded to the additional materials question below. Please include the full text of your clips, not just the links.

What makes a good local investigation?

  • Starts with high stakes
    How does the story affect people’s lives and livelihoods? Their health, safety and basic quality of life?
  • Has a clear line of accountability
    Great investigations have a line of accountability to someone or some group with significant power.
  • Reveals something
    Does your investigation reveal something that someone or some institution is trying to keep secret?
  • Has a clear sense of place
    The most important element for any local investigation: How is it (e.g. the policy, the circumstance or the failure) unique to your community?

job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a growth-stage company dedicated to providing trustworthy, essential news in a format that respects readers' time. We're hiring a reporter to cover Colorado Springs as part of our growing local news initiative.

Why it matters: This reporter will help local residents understand what's happening in their own backyards, getting readers smarter, faster on the news, events and local folkways that matter most to them.

Go deeper: We're looking for a skilled reporter who wants to own the biggest conversations in Colorado Springs and write newsletters that become the talk of the town. Requirements include:

  • Co-authoring a daily Axios newsletter full of insights and scoops that matter most to the Springs
  • Interest in covering many aspects of life in the city
  • Experimenting with and leveraging AI for reporting and newsletter production
  • Writing conversationally, in Axios' Smart Brevity style 
  • Helping to build Axios Local and shaping how our product evolves

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will operate with a startup mentality and an entrepreneurial spirit, and have the following skills:

  • Experience covering Colorado Springs
  • Excellent sources and the desire to create new ones 
  • Ability to break news and create conceptual scoops
  • Omnivorous curiosity about your hometown, no matter how long you've lived there
  • Ideas, ideas, ideas 
  • Comfort flexing some voice and personality in your writing 
  • Proven experience working in a fast-paced news environment and on deadline
