job.title: Assistant Managing Editor, National
job.description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest. 

Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. While the anticipated application deadline is December 31st at 11:59 PM ET, the role may close earlier if a candidate is hired. We encourage interested applicants to apply as soon as possible.

ProPublica is seeking an accomplished senior-level investigative editor to help oversee and elevate the accountability journalism produced by editors and reporters on our national staff and serve as part of ProPublica’s masthead leadership team.

The assistant managing editor, national, will supervise teams of editors and reporters and, depending on the candidate, may also directly supervise one or more investigative reporters. The ideal candidate enjoys the challenge of helping editors and reporters envision the most ambitious and creative paths for their projects; deeply understands and embraces ProPublica’s accountability mission; has a facility for high-level story honing and writing; and is dedicated to helping our editors grow and develop. We’re looking for an experienced editor with sound news judgment who is equally comfortable and adept weighing in on what’s working, or not, in a long-form narrative as in a complicated, multipart investigation.

This position involves juggling a variety of high-level projects, weighing in on story selection and direction, providing top-level guidance and editing, as well as working with staffers from other ProPublica teams, from data and research to video and audience. 

The assistant managing editor, national, will report to the managing editor of the national staff.

What you would be doing:

  • Supervising teams of national reporters and editors working on revelatory, important stories and projects.
  • Providing support and guidance to ensure projects are conceived of and told as ambitiously and creatively as possible.
  • Working with editors and reporters to select stories with the potential for impact, and helping them overcome reporting hurdles
  • Editing, including identifying and fixing structural issues and elevating writing when necessary.
  • Helping teams collaborate with researchers, data visualization reporters, engagement reporters, audience and visual staffers, and story producers.
  • Coaching editors to stretch and develop their skills and ambitions.
  • Serving as a champion for accountability journalism.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • At least 10 years experience overseeing investigative and/or accountability reporting and has managed teams of reporters and editors.
  • A track record as an editor of landing revelatory stories about abuses of power.
  • A passion for and experience with accountability journalism.
  • The ability to juggle many different responsibilities, meet deadlines and handle pressure while remaining calm.
  • Exceptional organizational skills.
  • A collaborative mindset. As a leader, you should work seamlessly with staffers throughout the newsroom. 
  • The ability to adroitly handle fast-breaking stories, monthslong reporting projects and exquisitely written narratives.

This job is full time and includes benefits. 

We’re open to remote candidates based and authorized to work in the United States. Candidates in the New York City region will be expected to work in our office at least two days a week. We also have offices in Washington, D.C.; Atlanta; Chicago; Phoenix; and Berkeley, California. Though not currently in place, an in-person requirement could be introduced at these locations in the future. 

The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $250,000.

This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The final salary figure will take into account a person’s experience, accomplishment and location. ProPublica is committed to paying its staff equitably, and these ranges should not be considered career salary limits or caps.

What you should send us:

  • The most important part by far is your past work. We’d like to see examples of projects that show how you work as both a direct editor and as a top editor. Specifically: 
    • (1) Send us links to the investigative stories you directly edited that you are most proud of. These should be stories where you worked directly with a reporter to shape and guide the focus of an investigation. Don’t be shy — tell us what worked (numbers and evidence of impact welcome) and how you’d do it differently next time. Editing is about far more than moving around words. Show us how you think. 
    • (2) Send us a project or story in which you made a significant difference as a top editor. This should be where you honed the structure or narrative or where you identified missing elements necessary before publication. Let us know how your contributions elevated the work.
  • Your resume.                              

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, but we will continue to consider candidates as long as the posting remains live on our site.

Questions? Send an email to talent@propublica.org. 

No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law. We are dedicated to building an inclusive newsroom and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

Job Summary

The Development Security Operations (DevSecOps) Engineer is a technical role responsible for implementing and maintaining secure software development practices across the organization. Working closely with development, operations, and security teams, this position helps ensure that software delivery processes and environments align with industry best practices while maintaining operational efficiency and strong security controls. The DevSecOps Engineer supports the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle, assists in identifying and mitigating security risks, and contributes to the continuous improvement of security automation, monitoring, and compliance capabilities.

Essential Functions

  • Implement and maintain secure software development practices across the organization by:
    • Performing code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address security vulnerabilities and implement secure coding practices.
    • Providing guidance and support to development teams in implementing secure coding practices and integrating security into the development lifecycle.
    • Work to provide security efforts with DevOps team to secure infrastructure and ensure secure deployment and operation of applications.
    • Work with cross-functional teams to define security requirements, standards, and guidelines for software development projects.
  • Enhance and monitor the tools used within the development and operations process.  This includes:
    • Reviewing and enhancing CI/CD pipelines using Github Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS Code pipeline, and Jenkins.
    • Utilizing tools like Orca Security, Sysdig, Codacy and Azure Log Analytics to monitor and analyze system logs and application code for security vulnerabilities.
    • Staying up to date with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices, and ensure their integration into our software development processes.
    • Secure Image and Artifact Management: Protect container images, build artifacts, and other software packages used in the CI/CD pipeline. Scan these artifacts for vulnerabilities before deploying them and utilize secure registries for storage and distribution.
  • Work on the implementation as well as help maintain a security program.  This includes:
    • Conducting Risk Assessments using frameworks like the OWASP top 10
    • Developing a Risk Treatment Plan
    • Determining and create needed information Security Policies
    • Determining and create needed information Security Objectives
    • Maintain and help develop Security Reports
    • Help implement Security Controls within each dev group
    • Manage vendor relations
  • Work with internal and external team in working on audits, incident response, and/or compliance processes.
  • Work to define requirements and processes for Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity.  After requirements and processes are determined and approved, assist in the facilitation of a DR test.

Required Qualifications

 

  • BA/BS Degree (4- year)
  • 2-5 years of related work experience
  • Have experience managing vendor relationships and running an implementation from start to finish.
  • Has been a team lead or managed a team of security professionals.
  • Experience with a unified, real-time monitoring and analytics platform, such as Azure Log Analytics, Google Cloud Operations (Stackdriver), AWS CloudWatch, Sentry, Splunk or Datadog
  • Experience in at least one programming language (JavaScript, Ruby, Python, PHP, C#)
  • Experience with cloud environment such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience using a CI/CD tool like Github Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
  • Experience with apply frameworks in the Software Development Lifecycle like OWASP top 10, NIST, etc
  • Experience configuring infrastructure and application alerts, alarms, and notifications.
  • Proven experience as a DevSecOps Engineer, Software Security engineer, Security Engineer, or in a similar role
  • Eagerness to work in a highly collaborative team environment
  • Knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices and secure coding principles
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
  • Great verbal and written communication skills
  • Results driven with reliable follow through
  • Comfortable using Git version control.
  • Familiarity with industry security standards and frameworks such as OWASP top 10, NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS benchmarks

job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Manager, Network Infrastructure is responsible for deploying, supporting, securing and managing the lifecycle of AEG Global Technology's network infrastructure across US venues and enterprise environments. This role ensures network services, firewalls, routing, switching, wireless platforms and related operational processes meet Global Technology standards, security requirements, governance controls and business priorities. The role also provides on-site event support across multiple venues and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and participate in an on-call rota.

Essential Functions

  • Line manage US-based network engineers (and contractors as required) and provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, prioritization and performance support in alignment with Global Technology objectives and ensuring service delivery meets established SLAs.
  • Provide escalation support for critical network incidents, including out-of-hours response for venue, event and enterprise-impacting issues.
  • Ensure existing network infrastructure is effectively managed, supported, patched, monitored and secured, including response to vulnerabilities, threats, audit findings and operational risks.
  • Work with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, information security, operations teams and the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology to plan, budget and prioritize network infrastructure projects and service improvements.
  • Project manage network infrastructure initiatives through the full lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, resource scheduling, implementation planning, change management, handover and documentation.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure and supportable network infrastructure solutions that align with Global Technology architecture, security and operational standards.
  • Maintain accurate design documentation, configuration records, operational runbooks, support models and standard operating procedures for all supported network services.
  • Provide technical input and design review for venue technology, business systems, infrastructure, security, cloud and development initiatives where network architecture or connectivity is a dependency.
  • Maintain current knowledge of network, wireless, firewall, automation, monitoring and security technologies and recommend improvements that improve resilience, performance, security and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure network engineering practices, training, knowledge sharing and development plans support consistent delivery of Global Technology standards across venues and enterprise environments.
  • Understand long-term business, venue and event technology objectives and recommend practical network strategies that support secure, resilient and scalable operations.
  • Provide and promote a high standard of service ownership, stakeholder communication and continuous improvement across network operations and project delivery.
  • Undertake other relevant duties or reasonable requests as required by the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology or senior Global Technology leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Information Technology or related area.
  • 4-6 years experience in a similar network infrastructure leadership role, including the design, implementation, support and lifecycle management of large-scale, multi-site and multi-tenant enterprise networks. Experience working with venue, event, corporate or highly available operational environments is preferred.
  • Ability to manage, coach and develop network engineering staff, prioritize work across operational and project demands, and support performance, development and service ownership.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, information security, infrastructure, service desk and senior Global Technology leadership.
  • Understand how technology enables and supports business objectives.
  • Have significant experience configuring, managing and supporting Cisco and Meraki routing, switching, wireless, security appliance and cloud-managed network platforms.
  • Have significant experience configuring and managing Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and related security policy, segmentation, logging and operational governance processes.
  • Have strong experience in network security, including segmentation, zero trust principles, access control, layer 2 security, layer 7 inspection, vulnerability response and secure change governance.
  • Experience working across test, pre-production and production environments.
  • Demonstrate strong expertise across core network technologies, including the OSI model; fibre, CWDM and DWDM transmission services; Ethernet and layer 2 switching, including VLANs, STP, MTU and layer 2 security; IPv4 and IPv6; VRF; GRE; routing protocols such as HSRP, VRRP, OSPF, EIGRP and BGP; route-based IPsec VPNs; multicast; QoS; MPLS and EoMPLS; network security and 802.1x; DNS; DHCP; and RADIUS.
  • Troubleshoot complex network, voice and internet connectivity issues, including packet capture and analysis.
  • Provide root cause analysis for major incidents and document findings for Global Technology and key stakeholders.
  • Produce accurate, detailed reports while maintaining strong attention to detail and following agreed standards.
  • Understand and consistently apply Global Technology standards for architecture, security, monitoring, documentation, vendor management, operational support and change control.
  • Maintain high documentation standards, including architecture diagrams, configuration records, operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, change records, service incidents and post-incident reviews.
  • Apply industry best practices to design and implement secure, practical technology systems and infrastructure.
  • Use initiative, work with minimal supervision, manage time effectively and deliver within agreed timescales.
  • Must be able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support venues and live events.
  • Willing and able to travel domestically.
  • Demonstrate a positive, solutions-focused attitude.
  • Collaborate effectively in a high-performing team environment.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to high-quality delivery.
  • Certification for core technologies is highly preferred.

Reporting to the Vice President of Business Development, this role will manage the full business development lifecycle, from market development and prospecting through solution design, financial modeling, negotiation, contracting and transition to implementation.

The Senior Director will build trusted relationships with senior decision makers, develop customized partnership strategies, and clearly communicate AXS’s ticketing capabilities. This individual will work closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to create compelling proposals, structure commercially sound agreements, and ensure organizational alignment through the sales process.

  • Strong experience with identifying opportunities, developing strategies, and negotiating creative solutions
  • Experience negotiating and executing contracts.

job.description:

Position Summary

The primary responsibilities of the Touring Project Manager are to support the successful execution of tours and live events by coordinating logistics, operational planning, and cross-functional communication. This role serves as a key operational partner to Touring Managers, exercising independent judgment and discretion in managing project timelines, prioritizing tasks, coordinating resources, and resolving routine operational challenges. The Touring Project Manager supports advancing activities, event settlements, documentation management, and stakeholder communications to ensure tours are delivered efficiently and in accordance with company standards. Additionally, this role maintains strong relationships with venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments while proactively identifying operational risks and escalating significant issues when necessary.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day operational execution of tours, events, and live entertainment engagements.
  • Coordinate tour logistics, schedules, timelines, travel arrangements, and operational deliverables.
  • Manage project timelines and ensure key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Support show advancing activities, including venue coordination, artist requirements, production needs, and operational planning.
  • Assist with day-of-show settlements, event reconciliation, and operational documentation.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments regarding assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with artists, managers, promoters, venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
  • Monitor project progress and identify potential operational risks, delays, or challenges.
  • Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing competing operational demands and recommending solutions to support successful event execution.
  • Coordinate internal follow-up activities across Booking, Touring, Production, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, schedules, budgets, reports, settlement materials, and operational records.
  • Support expense tracking, budget monitoring, and financial reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, artist riders, venue requirements, and company operational standards.
  • Escalate significant operational issues, financial concerns, or project risks to Touring Managers and leadership when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, operational efficiencies, and enhanced event execution.
  • Represent the company professionally during events, site visits, meetings, and business travel.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Entertainment Management, Event Management, Communications, Music Business, or a related field; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in project management, event operations, concert promotion, venue operations, artist relations, or related live entertainment roles.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, events, tours, or operational initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of live event operations, touring logistics, event production, and artist relations.
  • Experience supporting show advancing, event execution, settlements, and operational planning.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating projects, prioritizing resources, and resolving operational issues.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience collaborating across multiple departments and managing external stakeholder relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, event management software, and project management tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Knowledge of current trends and best practices within the live entertainment and touring industries.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

 

Payscale: $55,000k-$65,000K

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.description:

We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Utility Operator controls and shades cameras during events for Crypto.com Arena.

Essential Functions:

  • Work with the camera operators to prepare the proper connection and operation at the Camera Control Unit (CCU). This includes properly connecting the camera with the camera cable to the assigned port at one of the media panels. This includes running the cable from the panel to the camera location and making sure any points along the run are taped to the ground with non-stick gaffer’s tape at any point that is considered a trip hazard.
  • During the game, will provide support as the handheld camera is requested to move around to get shots. This includes making sure the extra cable staged by the camera is kept organized and fed out and wrapped up neatly as the camera operator moves from their original position.
  • Act as a guide to the camera operator ensuring their safety from their blind side and behind them. May also need to make supply runs back to the control room such as fresh batteries or tape or a replacement headset.
  • Lift and/or carry a handheld camera which can weigh up to 30 lbs.
  • Must be able to spend time on their feet or be seated throughout the shift, including moving from a seated position to standing and moving quickly such as an unexpected time out that requires quick action.

Required Qualifications:

job.title: Promoted Ads || Business Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE? 

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com. 

 

WHO ARE YOU? 

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!   

 

THE JOB 

The Business Analyst will support data analysis and reporting for the Business Analytics team within Promoted Ads, Ticketmaster’s proprietary advertising platform. Reporting to the Director of Business Analytics, you will maintain accuracy and hygiene across core reporting datasets, collaborate with Business Development to grow the Promoted platform, and coordinate across divisions to build and maintain data pipelines. You’ll apply statistical fundamentals to ground your analysis, while keeping day-to-day work organized through JIRA/kanban and other team tools. This is a foundational role for someone early in their analytics career who is detail-oriented, curious about the “why” behind the numbers, and ready to grow into greater ownership over time. 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 

  • Maintain rigorous data hygiene across core performance reporting and financial accounting workflows, proactively flagging both anomalies and upside opportunities 
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries to pull, validate, and reconcile data across multiple sources 
  • Serve as point of contact for Business Development, client representatives, and other commercial leaders for ad hoc client analytics needs, insights into media performance, and intake for data investigations 
  • Translate data into clear commercial narratives, surfacing the “so what” behind trends for non-technical stakeholders 
  • Liaise between Promoted Business Analytics and counterpart analytics teams to ensure Promoted team’s data pipelines are being properly ingested and distributed to other divisions of the company 
  • Manage day-to-day tracking in Asana, JIRA, and other project management tools, keeping tickets, priorities, and status updates current for the team 
  • Document recurring processes and interdepartmental functions to help build out best practices for Business Analytics team 
  • Identify and deploy AI opportunities for Business Analytics team to expand scale and scope of operations 
  • Communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, adjusting detail and framing based on the audience 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 3+ years of analytical experience, ideally in digital media or advertising 
  • Confident with statistical concepts and understanding of the economics of the digital media ecosystem 
  • Strong attention to detail: proven track record of delivering media and financial reporting with a high degree of accuracy and understanding of nuances of data sources 
  • Experience writing and troubleshooting SQL 
  • Iterating on analytic methodology and output with LLMs  
  • Demonstrated ownership of deliverables and communications to client-facing representatives 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex communication style across technical, cross-functional, and executive audiences 
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where scope may shift based on evolving business priorities 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 
  • Bonus: experience in ticketing, live events, or marketplace/advertising platforms 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS 

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits: 

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)  

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days 

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program 

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support 

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment  

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match  

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.   

 
Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.   

  

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas. 

  

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. job.title: Head of Inclusion Partnerships and Industry Engagement
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

ABOUT WPP

WPP is undergoing its most significant structural transformation in decades. Through Elevate28, we are moving from a holding company model to a single integrated operating company. The EVP WPP is building for the Elevate28 era is anchored on five dimensions – one of which is Inclusion & Belonging. This role ensures WPP shows up in the industry as one company and as a recognised leader in inclusive practice.

Within this transformation, WPP’s Inclusion & Impact (I&I) team is pioneering an innovative, enterprise-wide approach that moves decisively beyond traditional DEI. We treat inclusion as a strategic business enabler—designing and embedding scalable, measurable, and innovative practices directly into our business operations, creative work, client relationships, and workplace culture to shape meaningful behavioral change. This role ensures WPP show up across the creative, marketing, and media ecosystem as one unified company and recognized voice in inclusive practice.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Head of Inclusion Partnerships & Industry Engagement is an enterprise-wide strategic, advisory, and ambassadorial leader who defines where and how WPP shows up globally for inclusion and impact. This role consolidates historically fragmented decisions into a unified WPP strategy—curating where we invest our brand equity, which strategic partners we ally with, which major industry stages we command, and which recognition benchmarks we pursue.

This is a brand positioning, external engagement, and strategically influential role, centered in inclusion. Operating at the intersection of brand reputation, industry engagement, and modern inclusion, you bring deep agency ecosystem fluency and the presence to build immediate credibility with senior executives, brand marketers, and cultural changemakers. You will establish rigorous investment criteria, steward a dedicated global budget, and serve as an articulate champion for WPP—shaping industry behavior, reinforcing client trust, activating diverse talent pipelines, and earning industry recognition.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Strategic Inclusion Partnership & Investment Strategy (40%)
    Establish a criteria-led, enterprise approach to external alliances and partners.
  • Partnership Strategy: Set the global framework for identifying, assessing, and prioritising external inclusion partners, industry bodies, and community organizations – ensuring alignment to the Inclusion & Impact Strategy.
  • Sponsorship Governance: Build and lead an enterprise intake and evaluation model for global industry partnerships, transitioning legacy, ad-hoc agency investments into a cohesive, high-impact One WPP investment strategy.
  • Investment Allocations: Recommend annual allocations from the dedicated sponsorship budget based on strategic fit, audience, and expected impact. Spend tracking and vendor administration sit with P&C Operations and GBS.
  • Partnership Portfolio Leadership: Direct the overall partnership lifecycle – including renewals, tiering, strategic evolution – with guidance from the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Establish Partnership & Sponsorship Framework, with tiering, selection criteria, and an intake process for event and sponsorship requests.
  • Set an Annual Sponsorship Investment Plan recommended and approved within the allocated budget.
  • Consolidate Legacy agency-level commitments into high-yield, unified enterprise partnerships
  1. Industry Presence & Engagement (35%)
    Positioning WPP as a global growth partner centered on inclusion
  • Event Activation: Lead WPP’s inclusion presence at priority industry moments (e.g., Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES, Campaign, Adobe Summit), embedding I&I into mainstage programming, brand roundtables, and other engagements.
  • Frontline Ambassador: Serve as a representative, building relationships with partners, clients, and industry leaders across a range of settings and audiences.
  • Thought Leadership Curation: Translate progressive organizational practices into compelling public narratives; collaborate with Regional Inclusion Directors and MarComms to prepare, position, and amplify diverse executive voices, ERG leaders, and breakthrough creative talent on international stages.
  • Client Co-Creation & Alignment: Partner with client-facing agency leads and the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead to design joint, values-aligned thought leadership platforms and client-partner roundtables that deepen brand relationships.
  • Talent Pipeline Integration: Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure global sponsorships and partnerships alliances actively generate pathways for emerging, diverse creative and strategic talent.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Launch comprehensive Global Industry Activation Plan, that includes details on key messaging and objectives
  • Co-create diverse WPP Thought Leadership & Speaker Bureau.
  • Curate relationships with partners and clients to support business growth and inclusion client opportunities for ongoing engagement.
  1. Industry Recognition, Influence & Impact Measurement (25%)
    Earning recognition for WPP’s inclusive practices through industry benchmarks and measurable business impact.
  • Global Recognition Strategy: Define and lead the enterprise awards and recognition roadmap, identifying high-credibility global, regional, and industry inclusive benchmarks.
  • Integrated Benchmarking Process: Run a shared awards process with Regional Inclusion Directors, GBS team, and the Global Head of Inclusion & Impact.
  • Reputational Narrative Engine: Supply partnership, sponsorship, and award proof points to Talent Acquisition and Marketing & Communications to strengthen WPP’s reputation as an inclusive leader.
  • Impact Reporting: In partnership with the Enterprise Director, Inclusion, Brand, and Client Impact, own the End-of-Year Partnership Impact & ROI Report, using partner and client data provided by the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Unified Global Awards Strategy and submission process in place with Regional Inclusion Directors and GBS.
  • End-of-Year Partnership Impact & ROI Report.
  • Effectively communicate reach, engagement, and talent outcomes linked to sponsorship and partnership investment.

EXPERIENCE & PROFILE

  • Enterprise Strategy Experience: Significant senior leadership experience in communications, marketing, external partnerships, and/or modern inclusion strategy within complex, matrixed global organization.
  • Modern Inclusion Mindset: Passionate about evolving inclusion beyond legacy, compliance-driven HR definitions into an innovative, scalable practice that drives competitive advantage, creativity, and systemic change.
  • Partnership & Sponsorship: Track record shaping partnership or sponsorship strategy and recommending where budget should go.
  • Advertising & Agency Fluency: Familiarity with major cultural and industry moments (e.g., Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES), client marketing expectations.
  • Confident Ambassador: Natural connector, with experience working across various organizational levels and functions.
  • Strategic & Structured: Brings clarity to competing requests, sets criteria, and makes clear recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Collaborative Leader: Demonstrates high emotional intelligence and an inclusive, collaborative leadership style; proven track record of mentoring and elevating direct reports while influencing cross-functional peers across multiple geographies.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who is naturally curious about the world around you? KTTC in Rochester, MN, is looking for a high-energy Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) who is ready to start their career by making a real impact. We’re not just looking for an employee; we’re looking for a storyteller who is eager to share facts, seek the truth, and own the news cycle across every screen—from the TV in the living room to the phone in the palm of a viewer's hand.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do:

• Own the news cycle: Gather, shoot, and edit high-impact content for multiple platforms, ensuring our audience stays informed.
• Pitch with purpose: Come ready to the editorial meeting with researched ideas pitched through Microsoft Teams. You’ll have already made the calls and prearranged interviews to hit the ground running.
• Master the multi-platform: Write and adapt stories for different screens—from the morning news to quick social updates and deep-dive web articles.
• Report live from the scene: Be the first on the ground when news breaks, delivering authoritative and calm live reports that keep our viewers connected.
• Verify and validate: Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and deep research—because accuracy is our foundation.
• Manage your time: Take charge of your daily workflow—from getting out the door for fresh video to editing your final masterpiece before the deadline hits.
• Stay agile: Update stories as they evolve and be ready to fill in on different shifts when the news demands it.

Why You'll Love It Here:

• A launchpad for your career: Join a young, energetic newsroom led by anchors with decades of experience who are eager to mentor the next generation of journalists.
• Growth every day: We believe feedback should happen in real time, not just during a yearly review. You’ll grow faster here than anywhere else.
• Innovation focus: KTTC is evolving on purpose—we’re serious about the future of media and want you to help shape it.
• Community impact: Tell stories that actually matter to the people of Rochester and the surrounding area.
• Supportive culture: We value scrappiness and digital innovation, but we also value our people. You’ll have the tools and the team to do your best work.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• The mindset: Above all else, a relentless desire to learn, seek the truth, and share stories that matter.
• Strong writing chops: You craft scripts and articles that are tight, clear, and compelling (AP style is your best friend).
• Technical potential: While we can teach you to shoot and edit video, a familiarity with camera equipment and systems like ENPS or Edius is a great head start.
• Self-motivated hustle: The ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment without breaking a sweat.
• Versatility: You can manage multiple projects at once and pivot quickly when breaking news hits.
• A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to hit the road and go where the story takes you.
• Human qualities: Empathy for the stories you tell, urgency in how you tell them, and the flexibility to roll with the punches of a dayside shift.

Ready to start your journey and own the news cycle in Rochester? Let’s create something amazing together.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

job.title: Morning Show Co-Host / Producer & Assistant Program Director
job.description:
Position Overview
96.3 KKLZ, Las Vegas' heritage Classic Hits station, is searching for an experienced, creative, and entertaining Morning Show Co-Host to join our established morning team.
We're looking for a dynamic personality with a quick wit, strong conversational instincts, and the ability to connect with listeners through humor, storytelling, and relatable content.
This is a hands-on position requiring a versatile broadcaster who can entertain, create, produce, and execute. The successful candidate will serve as a primary on-air personality while also operating the broadcast console and sharing responsibility for daily show preparation and production.

The ideal candidate brings strong ideas, exceptional chemistry, and a collaborative spirit. We want someone who can lead a conversation, share the spotlight, and help create memorable radio every morning.

In addition to morning show duties, this role will provide hands-on daily support to the Programming Department, assisting with music scheduling, log management, and station imaging maintenance. 

Key Responsibilities
On-Air Performance & Content Development
  • Serve as a primary morning show personality, sharing responsibility for the show's entertainment, content, and overall success.
  • Develop and deliver compelling, original content, including topical discussions, humor, storytelling, interviews, and recurring features.
  • Research and prepare relevant daily topics that resonate with the station's adult audience.
  • Demonstrate strong conversational chemistry, improvisational skills, comedic timing, and the ability to engage listeners.
  • Collaborate with fellow hosts to plan show content, develop creative ideas, and maintain a consistent, entertaining presentation.
Broadcast Operations & Production
  • Operate the broadcast console and automation system during live programming.
  • Execute music, commercials, audio elements, contests, and scheduled programming with accuracy and precision.
  • Maintain proper show pacing, timing, and seamless transitions.
  • Share responsibility for producing, editing, and preparing audio elements, including interviews, comedy bits, recurring features, and other show content.
  • Assist with daily show preparation, organization, and execution without reliance on a dedicated producer.
  • Troubleshoot routine technical issues and coordinate with engineering or programming staff as needed.
Programming & Music Support 
  • Assist the Program Director with daily programming operations, including music scheduling, log editing, and log reconciliation.
  • Coordinate and maintain station imaging, liners, promos, and syndicated programming elements.
  • Monitor on-air execution to ensure format clocks, commercial breaks, and programming standards are met consistently. 
Station & Audience Engagement
  • Participate in station promotions, live appearances, community events, and special programming.
  • Engage listeners through phone calls, contests, social media, and other interactive platforms.
  • Contribute to the station's digital presence through engaging and brand-appropriate content.
  • Collaborate with programming, promotions, and sales teams to support station initiatives.
  • Represent KKLZ and Beasley Media Group professionally on and off the air.

Required Qualifications
  • Professional on-air radio experience, preferably in a live, multi-host morning show environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and deliver compelling, personality-driven radio content.
  • Experience operating a broadcast console and radio automation systems.
  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, improvisational, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, self-motivation, and the ability to independently prepare content.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously during a live broadcast.
  • Strong understanding of radio formatics, show pacing, and audience engagement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, accept direction, and contribute to a positive team environment.
  • Willingness to work early morning hours and participate in occasional station events outside regular broadcast hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Proven success as a primary morning show personality.
  • Experience developing and producing original comedy bits, recurring features, and entertaining audio content.
  • Familiarity with Classic Hits or other mainstream, adult-targeted radio formats.
  • Experience with social media, video production, and digital audience engagement.
  • Knowledge of the Las Vegas market and local community.
  • Hands-on experience with music scheduling software (such as MusicMaster, Selector, or Powergold) and daily broadcast log management. 

The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for a well-rounded broadcaster who loves creating great radio.
Someone who can generate compelling ideas, deliver a great punchline, tell a memorable story, and make their co-host shine. Someone who understands how to balance spontaneity with preparation and entertainment with the demands of a music-intensive format.
You should be equally comfortable behind the microphone, behind the board, and behind the scenes preparing the content that makes a morning show successful.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands that the best morning shows are built on chemistry, creativity, collaboration, and a genuine connection with the audience.

About 96.3 KKLZ
96.3 KKLZ is a heritage Las Vegas radio station delivering Classic Hits, engaging personalities, and strong community connections. As part of Beasley Media Group, KKLZ is committed to creating compelling local radio that entertains and connects with listeners.
Location: Las Vegas, Nevada
Position: Full-Time Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator
Schedule: Weekday mornings, with additional station appearances as needed

job.title: Packaging Operator (37) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Packaging Operator position reports through the Lawrence Production Center and may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty Packaging and/or Counter Packaging departments.  Individuals in these departments operate various machines to package greeting card products and perform the quality inspector role.

      

This position is a Full time position Sunday - Friday, 11:30pm - 7:30am. First shift will be Sunday night and last shift of the week is Thursday night into Friday morning.

 

The Packaging Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates automatic production machines that involve standard or high speeds to produce/package specialty or greeting card products.  Operations may include such activities as winding or spooling, wrapping or banding, folding, packaging product, labeling, and other final production processes. Makes judgment calls in the make-ready and production and/or packaging stages in order to insure quality production. Monitors, troubleshoots and corrects machine malfunctions. Completes required paperwork and/or computer input on specific SAP screens to confirm production and spoilage/scrap. Adheres to quality standards and procedures and initiates adjustments as needed to correct product and/or packaging defects. Prepares and maintains necessary paperwork. May perform quality inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department procedures. Assesses cause of defects, charging responsible operations. Records and inputs pertinent data.      

 

Maintains a neat and safe working environment. Actively engages and asks probing questions regarding press issues or performance.  Performs required preventive maintenance.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities. Identifies potential problems and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation. Demonstrates leadership amongst the team. Flexibility is key as the incumbent will operate multiple machines and perform the quality inspector role, as needed. Incumbent possesses moderate mechanical abilities, but training is obtained on the job. 

 

The Packaging Operator position may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty and/or Counter Packaging departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready procedures and other press adjustments on a variety of equipment with similar skill set.  Prepare the press to run and maintain or exceed the specified quality and production expectations. Troubleshoot from a variety of maintenance issues which may deal with robots, feeders, batches, bow machines, etc.  
  • Set up and operate a variety of automated production and/or packaging type machines, along with continually improving the specified production including throughput, OEE, etc.  May work with the computer systems to track components, order materials, etc. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. Develop an understanding of a wide range of quality systems and product specifications. Help prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage. 
  • Determine sample size and perform audit inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department standard operating procedures. Record all required production and defect information on inspection sheets and in SAP.
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within the shorter periods of time.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities. Identify potential problems and proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Communicate with peers so everyone is current on the day to day process. Creatively think outside the scope to see how you can help others.
  • Utilize good safety practices; understand and follow established safety procedures. Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning including TPM's/MIRC's (monthly inspection, repair & cleaning). Demonstrate mechanical ability by problem solving technical issues on the equipment.

job.title: Production Support Specialist (36) - 1st Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • This position is a full-time, 5-day work week position in the 1st shift from 7:30am to 3:30pm, Monday through Friday.
    Don’t see a shift that works for you? We still encourage you to apply! We’ll work with you to find a shift that fits your lifestyle and gives you the flexibility you need.

The Production Support Specialist in Lawrence has a variety of duties that support production in numerous ways.  Prepares greeting card stock for the Cutter to cut.  Jogs, skids and moves stock to the cutter.  Carries stock to skids and moves finished skids into the outgoing area.  Responsible for complete make-ready, run, monitoring and maintenance.  Removes die cut cards from full sheets either using a hammer or by using an Automatic Card Extractor (ACE).  Performs make-readies on the ACE and prepares rails/bars and press set-up.  Responsible for quality sampling and stacking cards onto skids according to register, blockouts, salvage and spoilage.  Determines when adhesive will be mixed and when test will be performed on the mixture.  Responsible for ensuring that the ingredients are in the area for mixing the adhesive.  Assists the Webtron press operator with press set up and changeover, make-readies, machine adjustments and routine preventative maintenance procedures.  Responsible for supporting the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of the areas, inputting information on the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe, work environment. 

Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Sets up and operates a Gem/Cello machine, wholesale sealer, accumulator and shrink tunnel which shrinks poly film around wholesale unit of specialty items and/or operates a lift truck and keeps track of stock in the OAI.  Performs all paperwork assigned involved in moving stock, either into or out of the department.  Packs finished goods on a packaging line.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.

Important things to know:

  • Position may be in several departments and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

  • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
  • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.
  • The reporting area may change as business needs change.

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on the Gem/Cello machines, ACE press and Webtron presses.  Set up wholesale sealer and pack product into shipping containers.  Mix adhesives and assure the proper ingredients and quantities are available in the area. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage.  Perform quality and/or adhesive test and report results in a timely manner.  Plan and maintain the workflow through the department in accordance with work schedule.  Order and deliver stock, cartons, and other components needed for production to the work area. 
  • Achieve and continually improve specified production including production goals, throughput, etc. during training.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities.  .
  • Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning, including TPM’s.  Move skids of stock into and away from the press, including completion of related paperwork.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.  Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within shorter periods of time.  Effectively communicate information to the next shift to ensure consistency and continuous operation. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Basic Qualifications

  • You’re at least 18 years of age
  • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
  • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
  • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level
  • You have the ability to constantly use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills
  • You have the ability to operate a computer independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HALLMARK

We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

  • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
  • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).
  • Your finances: A 401(k) with a 4% company match vested from day one. Health savings (HSA) or Flexible spending (FSA) accounts.
  • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.
  • Your work environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.
  •  Your career: A career with Hallmark can take you anywhere. Our career paths are shaped by your talents and ambitions. Whether you want to take the next step up in a role you know and love or are looking to move into an entirely new area or location. We can help you do just that.

This role will support the NFL’s departmental leads (three Senior Vice Presidents) with a focus on daily administrative and core operational support across these core functions of the League, in order to drive efficiency and optimize the productivity of these teams and leaders. 

General Administrative Support:

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings and conference calls
  • Manager calendars across different time zones
  • Create and distribute agendas
  • Answer and route telephone calls and incoming mail
  • Arrange and manage travel schedules and travel expenses 
  • Track and process P-Card transactions and expenses
  • Prepare meeting materials and presentations 
  • Create templates for letters and memos
  • Track and maintain department inventory and materials

Operations Support:

  • Creating templated agreements and routing contracts through Docusign and other systems
  • Processing staffing and credential needs for events and meetings

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars, travel arrangements, meeting coordination, and expense reporting.

  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and maintain confidentiality in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating across multiple departments and stakeholders.
  • Experience within sports, media, entertainment, or a similarly fast-paced corporate environment.

job.title: Associate Counsel
job.description:
The Associate Counsel will report to the Senior Vice President, Labor Relations and be responsible for development, negotiation and administration of the NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), including representing the league and clubs in litigation under the CBA.  The holder of this position will represent the league in grievance hearings and arbitrations brought by or against the NFL and supervise outside counsel in the litigation of such matters.  This critical role will require strong investigative and advocacy skills, and the ability to spot and solve issues related to league policies. 

Responsibilities

  • Acquire and demonstrate substantive mastery of the CBA and league policies regulating the conduct of clubs and players.   
  • Litigate grievances on behalf of the league and member clubs under the collective bargaining agreement with the NFL Players Association.  
  • Provide counsel to the league and clubs regarding rights and obligations under the CBA, the Salary Cap system, Player Personnel rules, and other collectively bargained league rules. 
  • Assist in the investigation and enforcement of potential violations of the CBA and related policies regulating player and club conduct.  
  • Draft and review policy directives for NFL players and Clubs. 
  • Interact with outside law firms, consultants and others involved in the administration of the CBA, policies and/or litigation. 
  • Assist in negotiations with the NFL Players Association. 
  • Prepare legal memoranda for clubs regarding policy obligations. 
  • Independently develop and maintain working relationships with club counsel and NFLPA representatives. 

Required Qualifications

  • Law Degree (J.D.); 4 to 6+ years of litigation experience at a top law firm or federal government agency.   
  • Experience conducting and maintaining a docket of litigation matters and internal investigations.   
  • Experience appearing in court or similar settings, interviewing senior executives and drafting investigatory findings.   
  • Experience deposing and cross-examining witnesses.    
  • Experience making presentations to large groups of senior executives. 
  • Familiarity with NFL and other sports’ labor relations. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of production or IT equipment up to 40 pounds.
