job.title: Associate, Transmission (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Media group is looking for a TOC Operator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and demonstrates strong technical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills while supporting live broadcast and transmission operations. The TOC Operator performs a broad range of technical and operational duties, including monitoring systems, coordinating broadcast workflows, and ensuring all technical facility requests are resolved in a timely and effective manner. The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge in operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes and familiarity with other broadcast transmission systems. This role requires a strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows, as well as the ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a fast-paced broadcast environment. As the first point of escalation for broadcast and transmission issues, the TOC Operator is responsible for communicating with Operations and Production Management in a timely and effective manner.  

This long term, benefitted contingent role compensates at $35 to $54 per hour.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the NFL Media Production team, Streaming Video Group, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. 
  • Partner with the Remote Operations team to support the transmission and receipts of feeds for live remote productions, including NFL Network games, the Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and other NFL Network remote projects.  
  • Collaborate with the Streaming Video Group (SVG) to ensure content is captioned across NFL.com, NFL Fast Channel, NFL+ streaming platforms.  
  • Partner closely with the Engineering team to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with a feed or broadcast.  
  • Communicate with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. 
  • Perform test bar setups as needed 
  • Conduct extensive transmission, sync, and fax checks prior to live shows and remote events.  
  • Manage booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen, AT&T Fiber, and Satellite orders. 
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required. 

 Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a broadcast operations environment, including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals, with the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows. 
  • Ability to read audio meters, digital and analog waveform monitors, and set up test bars. 
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them (ex. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, and video issues).  
  • Ability to perform sync and fax checks prior to live broadcasts and events.  
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.  
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple feeds to ensure high broadcast quality.  
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document on-air issues and have maintain excellent telephone etiquette.  
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends and holidays.  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Possess a strong work ethic, positive attitude and leadership qualities.   
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities at the same time.  
  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Minimum 40 hours/week or less as business needs permit

job.title: Manager, Global Consumer Insights & Research
job.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

Responsibilities

Global Fandom Intelligence

  • Monitor fandom, avidity, engagement, and brand health, as well as the drivers of and barriers to each.
  • Analyze cultural, behavioral, and regional differences to identify opportunities to acquire, develop, engage, and monetize fans.
  • Leverage NFL-specific and macro landscape insights to support the development of audience-level strategies by demographic, market, and other relevant segmentation lenses, such as engagement level and football knowledge.

Strategic Insights & Business Planning

  • Support strategic analyses, forecasts, scenario planning, and performance measurement tied to near- and long-range priorities.
  • Connect fan behavior, research findings, and marketplace trends to business opportunities and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations, memos, and key planning documents.

Consumer Insights & Research Execution

  • Support qualitative and quantitative research from objective setting and methodology selection through questionnaire or discussion guide development, analysis, and reporting.
  • Manage day-to-day stakeholder and vendor coordination, timelines, and deliverables across multiple projects.
  • Synthesize primary research, syndicated data, first-party information, and secondary sources into concise, story-driven visuals and recommendations using best-in-class practices.

Brand, Media & Marketing Effectiveness

  • Measure brand campaigns, creative effectiveness, audience sentiment, cultural relevance, and other equity measures across markets and fan segments.
  • Analyze broadcast, streaming, direct-to-consumer, content, and emerging viewing experiences to inform audience growth, media, product, and marketing strategies.
  • Evaluate new products, events, experiences, and fan engagement initiatives across the NFL ecosystem.

Stakeholder Partnership & Team Contribution

  • Build collaborative relationships across the League, Clubs, markets, and external research partners, advocating for fan-centric, insight-driven decisions.
  • Communicate complex research through clear, concise storytelling tailored to varied audiences.
  • Coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, timing, and business relevance.
  • Support junior team members through coaching and project guidance, and improve research processes, reporting standards, and insight socialization.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in consumer insights, market research, strategy, analytics, or a related field.
  • Ability to translate business questions into research objectives and quantitative or qualitative research plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex findings and communicate concise, actionable insights to varied stakeholders.
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience creating executive-ready presentations and insight-driven reports.
  • Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, and relationship-building skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with research methods such as segmentation, surveys, ethnography, interviews, and focus groups, plus familiarity with syndicated media measurement and applied analytics.
  • Proficiency with analytical tools such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience managing vendors and/or analysts; strong people management capabilities preferred.
  • Familiarity with sports and entertainment; knowledge of media and live events is a plus.
  • Experience working with global or multinational businesses and measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
  • Spanish, Portuguese, French, and/or German language proficiency is a plus.
  • Master’s degree in Market Research preferred.

job.title: Manager, Global Social Monetization
job.description:
The NFL’s Marketing department is seeking a Manager, Global Social Monetization to support social revenue priorities across the League and all 32 clubs. This role will track and report on sponsored social content across the ecosystem, help clubs optimize monetized assets through insights and best practices, and manage assigned partnership workstreams. The ideal candidate brings strong social media and analytical experience, along with the ability to collaborate effectively across clubs, internal teams, and external partners. Prior sponsorship experience is a plus. 

Responsibilities:

  • Function as the NFL’s day-to-day point of contact for all 32 clubs on social monetization-related topics.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on branded content trends, platform opportunities, and strategies that help the League and clubs maximize revenue generated through social media.
  • Develop and distribute playbooks, best practices, educational materials, benchmarks, and strategic recommendations for clubs and internal stakeholders.
  • Analyze monetization performance across club and League social channels.
  • Present insights, reporting, and recommendations through club meetings, trainings, internal stakeholder forums, and executive presentations.
  • Own tracking and reporting related to League social monetization initiatives, including sponsorship-related deliverables and business impact.
  • Help operationalize branded content and sponsored social deliverables for @NFL, ensuring timely execution and cross-functional alignment.
  • Identify available social inventory and emerging monetization opportunities, inclusive of opportunities with native platform monetization programs (i.e. Facebook Content Monetization, X Amplify, etc.).
  • Support strategic planning and execution for League content partnerships, including but not limited to Madden, Nike, etc.
  • Partner cross-functionally across a variety of departments and stakeholders to support key business objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or another related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in social media, content partnerships, sponsorship, media, monetization, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Threads, Snap, and Reddit.
  • Experience building or maintaining reporting frameworks.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across levels.
  • Familiarity with social analytics, sponsorship measurement, and monetization reporting tools.

job.title: Manager, Sponsorship New Business
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship New Business, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Given the new business focus of this position, we are seeking candidates with a demonstrated track record of independently sourcing, negotiating, and closing sponsorship or partnership deals, and who can quickly contribute to revenue growth.

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for developing a global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals 
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource  
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world) 
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution 
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives 
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects 
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed 
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

Travel

  • 0 - 10%

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • On-call position working less than 40 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

Travel

  • Limited

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule to include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Less than 29 hours/week when needed.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity. 

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality  
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs   
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look  
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency  
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems   
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards  
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions   
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions   
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors   
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges   
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations   

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments  
  • Extensive experience with Sony broadcast camera systems, including studio and ENG configurations   
  • Experience shading, color correcting, and routing video using frame synchronizers and production systems (e.g., Imagine, Cobalt)   
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video formats, including 1080p, 1080i, and 720p   
  • Working knowledge of SMPTE 2110 or IP-based video workflows

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast production environments  
  • Experience with automated and robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics)  
  • Familiarity with Ultimatte compositing systems and virtual production workflows  
  • Experience working with OLED walls and large-format display environments   
  • Knowledge of HDR and emerging broadcast technologies   

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong eye for color accuracy and visual consistency  
  • Ability to remain calm and make precise technical adjustments under pressure in live broadcast environments   
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across control room, engineering, and production teams   
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple camera feeds and priorities simultaneously   
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot complex video and signal issues in real time   
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to work independently or within a team environment

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs as required for production setup and support   

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Schedule driven by production needs, including live broadcasts and events  
  • Must be available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays   
  • This is a part-time position based on operational requirements up to 29 hours per week
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.

  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

job.title: Sr. Manager, Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.
  • Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.
  • Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.
  • Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts
  • Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.
  • 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.
  • Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.
  • Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.

job.title: VP, International Licensing & Consumer Products
job.description:
The Vice President, International Licensing & Consumer Products, will lead the NFL’s international growth through Consumer Products. The role will lead the development and execution of international Consumer Products strategies to expand the NFL’s presence in priority markets, grow licensing and retail opportunities, and strengthen fan engagement. Working across local markets and global teams, this position will identify and develop new business opportunities, maximize the value of existing partnerships, and build innovative commercial models that drive sustainable revenue and long-term NFL brand growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for leading and managing all licensee accounts with more than 50% of their business generated from the EMEA, LATAM or APAC markets, including product development, retail distribution, and marketing
  • Responsible for setting and achieving annual growth targets and long-range plans for the international CP business
  • Responsible for local account management of global accounts, including product development, retail distribution, and marketing
  • Fan Development/Data Acquisition through international CP partners
  • Liaison to local GMs and marketing teams on all global CP strategy and initiatives
  • Successful International Games execution

Core Responsibilities:

  • New Business
    • Identify and manage international licensing agencies in key territories; lead RFP and negotiations as needed  
    • Lead and execute new business focused on accounts where more than 50% of sales will be derived outside of the US
    • Expand global partner rights through new rights and  development of localized product assortments, retail distribution, and marketing support
    • Identify new retail distribution opportunities and innovative products to drive growth with a specific focus on unique international needs
    • Support GMP with localized Club programs that drive retail revenue or maximize brand exposure for their awarded markets
    • Identify new business models – i.e., licensed events and branded or experiential retail that will drive both revenue and brand awareness
    • Support new LBE initiatives in international markets through marketing, retail execution, and consultation with local country teams
  • Account Management
    • Lead international account strategy to drive NFL Consumer Products revenue growth
    • Own licensing forecasts, performance, and long-term growth plans for internationally focused accounts (>50% of sales come from outside the US) in partnership with Finance and Strategy
    • Develop and own bespoke retail distribution strategies across key markets.
    • Oversee management of licensing agencies and drive them to identify meaningful, strategic new business opportunities
    • Expand global partners by maximizing rights, categories, and geographic reach in collaboration with the Global Licensing team
    • Oversee the local CP leads in managing local teams of key global accounts (e.g., Fanatics, New Era, Topps, etc.) to translate Global account strategy into local implementation across product, retail, marketing, and activations
    • Partner with the GMs and Country marketing leads to understand local opportunities for global and local partners to drive Fan Engagement
    • Drive partner support and engagement in focus markets and at key tentpoles (e.g., Draft, Super Bowl, IGs, and International Watch Parties)
    • Collaborate with local marketing teams to secure revenue-driving marketing / creative for international partners
  • International Football Development Support
    • Partner with Global Licensing and other function heads to ensure on-field partners are supporting strategic League on-field initiatives internationally (e.g., Marketing / Brand, FLAG, International Growth)
    • Act as key liaison to local GMs and marketing teams on new global partner initiatives, i.e., Nike, Wilson
    • Execute implementation of on-field strategies to ensure flawless execution for international accounts
  •  Global / International Collaboration
    • Partner with Global Licensing to ensure the overall consumer products portfolio mix is maximizing fan engagement and revenue
    • Collaborate with Global Licensing leads to ensure partners are activating their rights and that Global partners' rights are being activated in key international markets
    • Provide event retail support and in-market activation support for the larger Global licensing ecosystem by attending site visits, building local relationships, and overseeing market activations in their market
  • Collaboration/Partnership with Strategy Team:
    • Build strategic vision for International Consumer Products long-term to ensure sustainable growth
    • Outline international partner/category insight needs for Consumer Products Strategy to research, investigate, and design to leverage data-based and insights-driven decision-making
    • Provide insights to inform partner strategy planning and forecasting
    • Articulate forecasts and business changes to help shape narrative for ongoing business reviews (e.g., Business Planning, QBRs)
    • Help identify policy challenges and opportunities and support in building business cases for necessary revisions
    • Input into materials for executive-level updates, including EOC, Committee Meetings, and Owners Meetings

Core Categories:

  • Apparel
  • Hardlines
  • Local eCommerce
  • Third Party Retail/DTC
  • On-Field
  • Licensed Events

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 15+ years of experience in Licensing/Consumer Products
  • Proven experience leading teams and developing individuals

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Adaptability & Resilience: The ability to pivot quickly when priorities change, process unexpected disruptions, and bounce back from setbacks.
  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset: An inner drive to learn new things, ask critical questions, and continuously build capabilities rather than staying static.

job.title: VP, Treasury & Risk
job.description:
The Vice President, Treasury & Risk will be a key leader within the NFL Finance organization, responsible for leading enterprise risk management, treasury, insurance, and internal audit functions. This role will strengthen the League’s governance, risk management, and control environment while providing strategic oversight of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking administration, and financial risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Internal Audit and Treasury professionals and manage external/co-sourced service providers as needed
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on risk, controls, governance, liquidity, insurance, and financial stewardship
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the League’s enterprise risk management framework, including enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk monitoring, mitigation planning, and reporting
  • Prepare clear and timely enterprise risk and emerging risk reporting for senior leadership and the Audit Committee
  • Oversee daily cash positioning activities, including liquidity management and cash position optimization
  • Develop short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to support liquidity planning, strategic business decisions, and investments
  • Develop a structure to work cross functionally to optimize working capital
  • Oversee banking administration, banking relationships, investments, and other treasury operations
  • Invest excess cash within approved cash investment guidelines to optimize interest income while preserving liquidity and principal
  • Design, analyze, monitor, and hedge exposures to foreign exchange and interest rate risk
  • Oversee and evaluate insurance programs to help ensure appropriate coverage, administration, and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience across treasury, enterprise risk management, accounting, or finance, including significant leadership responsibility
  • Management experience and proven success leading and developing teams
  • Proven success building functions and creating or improving processes, policies, controls, and reporting
  • Strong executive presence, judgment, communication skills, and ability to influence across a complex organization

We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. The Rights & Accounting fleet oversees products and optimizes workflows that enable TWDC to monetize content including content rights and avails management, content sales and content protection, content accounting, and talent payments. This position might be a great fit if you: Are a curious and efficient engineer who wants to help shape the direction of development and collaborate closely with some of the brightest minds in our organization. job.title: Morning Show Host
job.description:
KTVU FOX 2 is looking for a bold, energetic, and engaging personality to help redefine morning news on Mornings on 2. We're not just looking for someone who can deliver the news. We're looking for someone audiences want to spend their mornings with. This isn't your traditional anchor role. We want a natural conversationalist with a big personality, a great sense of humor, and a passion for news. Someone who can talk about anything, think on their feet, and connect with audiences without relying on a script.

You're a news junkie with strong journalistic instincts who can confidently and naturally discuss a wide range of topics—from politics, crime, and breaking news to sports, entertainment, pop culture, and everything in between. You're authentic, curious, quick-witted, and excited about the future of local news across broadcast, digital, and streaming.

A Snapshot of Your Responsibilities

  • Bring energy, personality, humor, and authenticity to live morning broadcasts.
  • Lead engaging, unscripted conversations and interviews.
  • Cover breaking news, current events, lifestyle, sports, and trending topics with confidence.
  • Create compelling content for broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Connect with local communities and bring fresh ideas to the show.

What You Will Need

  • 3 to 5+ years of news reporting or hosting experience, with the ability to speak knowledgeably and conversationally about a broad range of news and current events.
  • Strong on-camera presence and exceptional live, unscripted communication skills.
  • Deep curiosity about news, culture, and what's happening in the world.
  • Natural charisma, quick thinking, and the ability to connect with different audiences.
  • Strong editorial judgment and journalistic credibility.
  • Passion for digital storytelling and the evolution of local news.
  • Experience in broadcast news, digital media, or streaming.

Nice to Have, But Not a Deal Breaker

  • Familiarity with the West Coast, and especially the Bay Area.
  • An established social media presence or experience building digital audiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Streaming Line Producer
job.description:
Streaming Line Producer (Full-Time)

FOX Television Stations – FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is seeking a sharp, creative, and decisive Streaming Line Producer to lead compelling live coverage across linear television and digital streaming platforms. Reporting to the Executive Producer, you’ll shape rundowns as stories develop, make real-time editorial decisions, and help drive the future of local streaming news.

Bring strong news judgment, crisp writing, control-room confidence, and a digital-first mindset. You’ll use video, sound, graphics, live elements, social platforms, and audience insights to make coverage immediate, useful, and engaging wherever viewers watch.

What You’ll Do

• Lead live coverage and editorial execution. Write, stack, time, and line produce structured newscasts and continuous coverage for linear and streaming platforms; adjust rundowns as news develops; guide breaking-news coverage from the control room; manage multiple live elements; and direct anchors, reporters, field crews, and production teams.

• Create streaming-first, multiplatform content. Develop live streams, explainers, interviews, and presentation elements for digital audiences and the station’s broader content strategy; write broadcast and digital copy; log, clip, and edit video; coordinate graphics; produce interviews and digital video packages; and repurpose content before, during, and after live broadcasts.

• Grow reach through smart distribution and insights. Optimize and distribute video and live content across station digital products and YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram, tailoring presentation to each platform and its audience. Monitor real-time metrics, social feeds, and regional news trends to inform live coverage, story placement, follow-up content, and streaming priorities.

• Collaborate across the newsroom. Partner with anchors, reporters, writers, digital producers, video editors, assignment teams, and production staff to deliver cohesive, accurate, high-quality journalism across platforms.

• Use evolving newsroom technology. Work confidently with iNews, live streaming tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing tools, audience analytics platforms, Outlook, and Workday, while adapting as station technology evolves.

What You Bring

• Experience. Two to four years as a news producer, line producer, or in a similar role in a medium-to-large broadcast newsroom; live streaming or digital-first news production experience is strongly preferred.

• Editorial and live-production strength. Strong news judgment, AP-style writing, and demonstrated control-room leadership, with the ability to manage breaking news, multiple live elements, and intense deadlines. Working knowledge of broadcast law, FCC regulations, journalistic standards, and editorial best practices.

• Multiplatform expertise. A strong understanding of multiplatform storytelling, social media strategy, digital video distribution, and audience engagement.

• Technology fluency. Experience with linear rundown software, live streaming production tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing workflows, and audience analytics, plus the ability to learn evolving systems quickly.

• Education and leadership. A bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, along with clear professional communication, strong collaboration, sound decision-making, and the composure to lead effectively in fast-moving live-news situations.

Additional Information

Benefits

• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.

• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

Work Schedule & Adaptability

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is a 24/7 news operation. This role requires flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, breaking news, and special events. Extended shifts may be required during severe weather, major news events, or emergencies to support continuous coverage across linear and streaming platforms.

Ready to combine strong line-producing discipline with the creativity and speed of digital-first journalism? Apply today and help FOX 5 DC deliver meaningful live coverage across every screen.

job.description:
We’re looking for a highly organized, digitally savvy Executive Assistant to support the General Manager and the executive team of FOX 11 in Los Angeles. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and has the digital fluency to streamline workflows across teams. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide executive-level administrative support including calendar management, travel coordination, meeting preparation, and expense reporting.
  • Serve as a point of contact between the GM and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and follow-up.
  • Anticipate needs and proactively manage priorities to keep projects and deadlines on track.
  • Support organizational efficiency by leveraging modern tools (Slack, Google Suite, etc.) to coordinate across markets.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and other materials as needed.
  • Assist with data gathering and analysis; familiarity with tools such as Adobe Analytics is a strong plus.
  • Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Coordinate with other leadership team members to ensure smooth operations across both stations.

Qualifications

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Slack, Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar), and other collaboration tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to draft professional correspondence and presentations.
  • Digital fluency with a willingness to learn and adapt to new platforms.
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar digital analytics tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with the broadcast or media industry a plus, but not required.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and judgment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

job.title: Senior Manager, Risk Management
job.description:
Fox Corporation is seeking a collaborative and solutions-driven Senior Manager, Risk Management to support insurance-risk management activities across the enterprise. This role plays a critical part in managing the Company’s risk exposure and insurance programs while fostering strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external risk partners.

The ideal candidate is a team player who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and delivering results through trusted partnerships.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review and analyze insurance provisions of contractual agreements and provide risk assessments and recommendations to Legal department, divisions, and management
  • Prepare submission material for procurement of select insurance programs by gathering, analyzing, and preparing exposure data
  • Develop and run various risk reports using the risk management information system (RMIS) to identify and analyze loss trends
  • Work with various internal departments, third-party administrators, and brokers on submission and management of claims, across multiple lines of coverage, through to resolution
  • Work with television/film productions on all insurance and risk management-related needs as well as securing coverage for all artists
  • Collaborate with Legal department on mergers and acquisitions by reviewing target insurance coverages and onboarding of entities once acquired
  • Collaborate with all departments within the Company as well as risk management support service providers
  • Consult with and guide company divisions regarding insurance and risk management-related issues
  • Support policy renewals by overseeing the process of gathering documentation, exposures, and ensuring applications are completed timely and provided to the broker
  • Review insurance policies and endorsements for accuracy
  • Review, data enter, and track incoming certificates of insurance for comparison against contractual wording and FOX’s insurance requirements
  • Issue certificates of insurance in compliance with contractual wording and FOX’s insurance policies
  • Negotiate the renewals and new business for several of our joint venture insurance programs
  • Processing invoices through the spend management platform
  • Handle various special projects, reports and administrative tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years of experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex topics for diverse audiences
  • High attention to detail, discretion, and commitment to confidentiality
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, manage time effectively, and remain organized in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to work both independently and as a collaborative team member
  • Strong customer service orientation and professional presence

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • CPCU, ARM, CRM, CRM-P, or other similar industry designation(s)
  • Risk Management Information Systems experience
  • Finance, Legal, or Media/Entertainment experience

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

AirTable and Compass scheduling for all NBC Sports Digital programming

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, with emphasis on proficiency with Excel

  • Relevant work experience is a plus
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop
  • Keen interest in NBC Sports shows and properties
  • Knowledge and passion for sports and sports media
  • Understanding of coding language and syntax
  • Professional communication skills
  • Outstanding organizational skills
  • Adaptable to changing priorities and workloads
  • Detail and deadline oriented
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks at any given time

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be willing to work in Stamford, CT
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer (with UI/UX expertise) to help build and evolve the web applications and supporting services our teams and audiences rely on every day. You’ll work across the stack, from modern React front ends to the APIs and services behind them, and you’ll be a strong contributor to how we structure, ship, and scale user-facing software. We build with micro-frontends so that teams can deliver independently without sacrificing a cohesive experience, and we embrace agentic software development, using AI agents as real collaborators in design, implementation, testing, and review. You’ll take product requirements and technical briefs and turn them into well-structured, well-tested features, working closely with product, design, architecture, and platform partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate full stack features, from React UIs through to the backend APIs and services that support them.
  • Develop and evolve micro-frontend architectures, including module boundaries, shared component libraries, versioning, and runtime integration across independently deployed applications.
  • Use agentic development methods in day-to-day work: directing AI coding agents, writing effective specs and prompts, reviewing and validating agent-generated code, and building guardrails (tests, linting, CI checks) that keep agent output reliable.
  • Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing, accessibility, performance, and observability across the front end and back end.
  • Contribute to technical design for meaningful features and help break epics into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Share what works in agent-assisted workflows, and help teammates build effective habits and practices.
  • Modernize legacy front ends and monolithic UIs into scalable, maintainable, componentized applications.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and platform teams to deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control and code review practices.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including state management, hooks, performance optimization, and component design.
  • Practical experience with micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa, or equivalent approaches), including managing shared dependencies, design systems, and cross-team integration.
  • Solid backend experience building RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs in a language such as Node.js, C#/.NET, or similar, with a working understanding of databases and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic or AI-assisted software development, and good judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct agent output.
  • Strong grasp of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser performance, and security basics (authentication, authorization, XSS/CSRF).
  • Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and a genuine concern for code structure and maintainability.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-hosted applications in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.

  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach, including a willingness to mentor and learn from teammates.
  • Exposure to Docker, monorepo tooling, or design-system development is a plus.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic consumer web experience is a plus.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive– Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location:  This is a hybrid (in territory + remote), outside sales role supporting a designated geographic territory, Springfield, IL. Success in this position requires regular in-market client and prospect engagement. While much of the work is performed remotely and in the field, periodic attendance at a company office for meetings, training, collaboration, and business activities may be required.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs

Consultative, full-cycle sales

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

EMPLOYEE REFERRAL BONUS ELIGIBLE

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $50,000 and $60,000. $83,333-$100,000 OTE. Uncapped commission with accelerators. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

job.title: Director, Digital Operations
job.description:
The Detroit Free Press, Michigan's largest news organization and the largest metro publication in the USA TODAY Network, is seeking a Digital Director to lead and evolve our digital journalism strategy in one of the nation's most competitive and dynamic news markets.

This senior newsroom leader will be responsible for audience growth, digital innovation, platform strategy and newsroom transformation across freep.com, search, social media, newsletters, video, emerging platforms and AI-powered tools. The Digital Director will oversee the digital team, partner closely with newsroom leadership and help ensure that Detroit Free Press journalism reaches the largest possible audience while driving loyalty, engagement and subscriptions.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, forward-thinking newsroom leader with a deep understanding of audience behavior, digital publishing, analytics and emerging technologies. They are passionate about local journalism and understand how to balance editorial excellence with audience needs. They are equally comfortable leading major newsroom initiatives, analyzing performance data, experimenting with new products and coaching journalists to succeed in an increasingly digital and AI-driven media landscape.

Detroit is one of the most competitive local news environments in America. The Digital Director will play a critical role in ensuring the Detroit Free Press remains the leading source of trusted journalism in the region by continuously improving how we discover, package, distribute and engage audiences with our work.

This role reports to the executive editor and serves as a key member of the newsroom leadership team.

Key responsibilities:

Lead and execute the Detroit Free Press digital audience strategy across all platforms, including freep.com, app, search, social media, newsletters, video, push alerts and emerging platforms.

Manage and mentor the digital team, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.

Partner with editors, reporters, visual journalists and newsroom leaders to maximize the reach, impact and engagement of Free Press journalism.

Use audience analytics, market intelligence and performance data to identify opportunities for growth, improve content strategy and support business objectives.

Lead newsroom SEO strategy, ensuring journalism is optimized for search discovery while maintaining strong editorial standards.

Develop and oversee social media strategy across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky and future platforms.

Drive innovation in digital storytelling, including video, multimedia, newsletters, live coverage and platform-specific experiences.

Lead the newsroom's exploration and adoption of AI tools and workflows, helping journalists responsibly use emerging technologies to enhance reporting, audience engagement, productivity and story optimization.

Monitor audience, platform and technology trends and translate insights into actionable newsroom strategies.

Work closely with product, marketing, consumer revenue and network partners to support audience growth, subscriptions and engagement goals.

Oversee daily digital publishing operations, story presentation and audience-focused coverage planning.

Lead audience development efforts around major news events, breaking news and enterprise journalism.

Help newsroom staff build digital, audience and AI-related skills through coaching, training and professional development.

Represent the Detroit Free Press in network initiatives and collaborate with peers across the USA TODAY Network.

Establish clear audience goals and regularly communicate performance, opportunities and successes to newsroom staff and leadership.

Ensure all audience strategies uphold Detroit Free Press standards for accuracy, fairness, ethics and journalistic excellence.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, media, marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Seven or more years of experience in newsroom management and digital journalism, audience development or a related field.

Proven success leading audience growth initiatives across multiple digital platforms.

Experience managing teams and coaching journalists in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

Strong understanding of SEO, audience development, analytics and digital publishing best practices.

Demonstrated ability to use audience data and performance metrics to inform editorial strategy and decision-making.

Experience overseeing social media strategy and audience engagement efforts at scale.

Excellent news judgment, editing skills and understanding of digital storytelling.

Strong leadership, collaboration, communication and project management skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities and lead through change.

Commitment to innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.

Management experience leading digital strategy for a news organization.

Familiarity with Parse.ly, Google Analytics, Google Search Console and other audience analytics platforms.

Experience developing newsletters, video products, creator-style journalism and other audience-growth initiatives.

Demonstrated experience implementing AI-powered newsroom tools, workflows or audience strategies.

Experience working with subscription growth, reader revenue and audience loyalty initiatives.

Knowledge of emerging audience platforms, digital product trends and changing search ecosystems.

Experience collaborating across editorial, product, marketing and business teams.

How to apply:

We are eager to learn more about you and how your skills align with this role. When you apply, don't limit your submission to a resume. Show us how you've led digital transformation, audience growth and innovation in a newsroom.

Please combine the following into a single document and upload it with your application:

Your resume (one to two pages).

A cover letter explaining your interest in the role and how your leadership experience would help advance the Detroit Free Press' digital strategy and audience growth goals.

A statement (up to one page) describing your vision for the future of local journalism, audience engagement and AI's role in the newsroom.

Links to 3-6 examples of work, projects or initiatives that demonstrate success in one or more of the following areas:

Audience growth and engagement

Digital newsroom leadership

SEO and search strategy

Social media strategy

Subscription or loyalty growth

Video or multimedia storytelling

Innovation and experimentation

AI implementation in journalism

Breaking news and major coverage execution

Show us the work you're most proud of and that best demonstrates your ability to lead a newsroom, grow audiences and help shape the future of local journalism.
