job.title: Director of Financial Planning and Analysis
job.description:
Lee Enterprises is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead the company's financial planning, forecasting, and reporting functions. This position will play a key role in supporting financial decision-making across the organization by delivering accurate financial reporting, actionable insights, and forward-looking analysis.

The Director of FP&A will oversee the corporate FP&A team and partner closely with Finance leadership and operational business units to drive financial performance, improve reporting capabilities, and support strategic business objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the company's annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.

Coordinate financial planning activities across departments and business units, ensuring consistent assumptions, accurate submissions, and alignment with company objectives.

Drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy and financial planning processes.

Financial Reporting

Oversee preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages for executive leadership.

Lead financial variance analysis, including comparisons to budget, forecast, and prior-year results, with clear explanations of key business drivers.

Support preparation of financial materials and analysis for executive leadership, Board of Directors meetings, and quarterly earnings reporting.

Partner with Accounting to ensure financial reporting accuracy, consistency, and alignment with monthly and quarterly close processes.

Business Partnership & Financial Analysis

Monitor company performance through financial and operational KPIs, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

Serve as a key financial partner to departments and business leaders, providing analysis and actionable recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions.

Perform financial analysis related to business initiatives, cost optimization, resource allocation, and investment opportunities.

Develop and maintain models to identify opportunities to improve profitability, manage expenses, and optimize cash flow performance.

Financial Systems & Process Improvement

Oversee administration, maintenance, and ongoing development of the company's financial planning and reporting systems.

Ensure integrity, accuracy, and consistency of financial information across planning, reporting, and accounting systems.

Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline financial processes, and improve productivity through technology.

Develop and maintain financial reporting tools and processes, supporting training and adoption across the organization.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the corporate FP&A team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial reporting, forecasts, and analysis.

Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities, processes, and talent to meet evolving business needs.

Core Competencies:

Strong financial planning, forecasting, financial modeling, and analytical capabilities.

Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate meaningful insights to executive leadership.

Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to develop and motivate team members.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial results and recommendations clearly.

Desire to improve efficiencies through technology, automation, and process improvement.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of deliverables.

Strong attention to detail with a commitment to financial accuracy and reporting integrity.

Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and build productive working relationships.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required.

7+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, accounting, or a related discipline.

Prior experience managing or leading finance professionals preferred.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling required.

Experience with enterprise financial planning, reporting, or ERP systems preferred.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools preferred.

Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.

Location

This position will be located at Lee Enterprises' headquarters office in Davenport, Iowa, with hybrid and remote work arrangements considered for qualified candidates.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

job.title: Senior Video Producer, Pivot
job.description:
Pivot is hiring a Senior Video Producer who will treat our YouTube channel and social video accounts as products in their own right. The successful candidate will use their creativity to produce appealing content and craft strategies that grow each channel.  This is a hands-on role for someone who's obsessed with how YouTube and short-form platforms actually work — not just a content calendar manager, but someone who analyzes the metrics, tests thumbnails and titles, and knows what makes a clip travel. Speed matters as much as strategy here: we record twice weekly, and the producer needs to turn around publish-ready clips fast — same-day or next-day — to capitalize on news moments while they're relevant. You'll also direct a small remote freelance editing team on longer-turnaround pieces. This role blends strategy, fast hands-on editing, and people management.

What You'll Do

  • Turn around quick, publishable social clips fast — same-day or next-day — with clean cuts, captions, pacing, and sound/music design that fit each platform's native style, prioritizing speed without sacrificing quality; this is a daily part of the role. 
  • Write clear, shot-by-shot scripts and edit briefs for social video clips.  
  • Edit short-form social video: clean cuts, captions, pacing, and sound/music design that fit each platform's native style, with fast turnaround as the default expectation. 
  • Optimize clipping workflow with ongoing testing and assessment of AI clipping tools.
  • When necessary, assign and oversee freelance social video editors. (Freelancers are typically reserved for higher-volume days or less time-sensitive content.)
  • Review and QC freelancer cuts for pacing, accuracy, and brand fit, and give direct feedback to keep quality consistent.
  • Partner closely with our podcast production team to guide clip selection and format decisions based on what's performing well.
  • Own YouTube channel strategy end-to-end: titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters, and a dedicated YouTube Shorts pipeline. Run a continuous testing process on titles and thumbnails to improve click-through and retention.
  • Set and manage the posting calendar and platform-specific strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and Threads.
  • Deliver monthly analytics reporting (subscriber growth, average view duration, CTR, follower growth by platform) and use it to inform what gets prioritized editorially on social channels.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes and emerging formats, and bring new ideas to the team proactively.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years running YouTube and/or social channels for a media brand, podcast, or creator, with a track record of measurable audience growth.
  • Fast, efficient video editing skills and a demonstrated ability to hit tight, same-day/next-day turnarounds without cutting corners on quality — this is one of the most important skills for the role.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar, with a portfolio of short-form clips you've cut yourself (captions, pacing, sound design, platform-native formatting).
  • Experience writing or directing edit scripts/briefs for other editors, and comfort managing remote or freelance contributors — assigning work, giving feedback, and holding a quality bar.
  • Deep fluency in YouTube Studio analytics and YouTube Shorts; comfort with tools like TubeBuddy or VidIQ is a plus.

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Do you love uncovering what customers think, feel, and do — then turning those findings into strategies that shape a global brand? Amazon Music's Brand Insights team within the Marketing and Growth organization is looking for a Senior Brand Insights Manager to lead brand tracking and audience insights work that directly influences how we grow and connect with listeners worldwide. In this role, you will manage our global brand health tracker across 14+ markets, develop audience segmentation and profiling analyses, and partner closely with integrated marketing, brand, social media, and country teams to turn complex data into recommendations that drive annual planning, campaign measurement, and audience strategy. You'll work hand in hand with senior leadership across the full Amazon Music organization, ensuring that customer insights sit at the center of every strategic decision.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage the global brand health tracker end-to-end across 14+ markets, from evolving the survey design to vendor management and synthesizing data trends into narrative-driven reports.
• Deliver quarterly and ad hoc reports that track performance across key metrics, surfacing notable trends and changes in brand health
• Leverage first and third-party data to measure holistic brand impact of specific cross-channel activations with target audiences
• Drive ongoing socialization of brand insights and partner with stakeholders (primarily across Marketing verticals) to distill findings into opportunities for optimization and strategic planning
• Conduct meta-analyses to explore strategic questions related to brand impact and the metrics that matter
• Develop audience profiles and segmentation analyses to inform targeting, messaging, and strategy for key listener segments
• Serve as the primary POC for stakeholders across the organization on brand health/measurement and audience insights requests
• Manage ongoing vendor/agency relationships end-to-end, including contract and budget oversight, multi-market fieldwork coordination, and reviewing deliverable reports with actionable feedback
• Build and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools for brand and audience data, partnering with third party platforms and internal data science teams
• Build scalable and nimble research solutions and processes, leveraging automation and AI tools to raise the bar on how insights are produced and consumed across the organization
• Drive measurable impact to the business and customer experience through research adoption and integration into strategic decision-making


A day in the life
Your primary focus is brand tracking and audience insights for Amazon Music on a global scale. You might start the morning reviewing the latest brand health data across multiple markets, identifying shifts in upper and mid-funnel metrics and preparing a narrative for your stakeholders. By midday, you're meeting with the integrated marketing or social media team to walk through how a recent campaign moved key brand metrics and where to optimize next. In the afternoon, you could be building audience segment profiles with internal data science partners or coordinating fieldwork with a vendor across several countries. Between meetings, you're refining dashboards, exploring automation opportunities, and connecting the dots between what the data says and what the business should do about it. Throughout, you're collaborating with country heads and senior leaders to ensure audience strategies and planning frameworks are grounded in real listener behavior.

About the team
As the Amazon Music Global Brand Insights team, we are responsible for producing best-in-class market research and customer insights. Our domain spans four key pillars: 1) Brand, 2) Go-to-Market (GTM), 3) Customer Lifecycle research, and 4) Audience, delivering data-driven, actionable recommendations for our business and brand. Our work is strategic in nature and aims to provide value to the entire organization, worldwide, and we are intentional about seeing insight through to action. Our overarching vision is to help teams across AM feel confident in making customer-obsessed decisions. We humanize complex data into compelling narratives and actionable strategies to drive growth for AM. We utilize a mix of traditional approaches and innovative methods to uncover both near- and long-term opportunities. We sit in the Marketing and Growth org, reporting to the Global Head of Brand Marketing.

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting
- Experience in marketing or marketing research
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- 5+ years experience managing brand health or brand tracking studies (e.g., survey design, fielding, and trend analysis)
- Experience managing external research vendors or agencies, including scoping, fieldwork coordination, and deliverable review
- Experience translating quantitative and qualitative research into written narratives and recommendations for business stakeholders
- 5+ years experience managing multiple concurrent research projects or deliverables on recurring timelines (e.g., quarterly reporting cycles)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Salesforce and Tableau
- Experience with primary research methodologies — survey design, audience segmentation, profiling, and advanced analytical techniques (e.g., regression, driver analysis, meta-analysis)
- Experience leading market research or brand insights across multiple international markets or regions
- Experience measuring brand impact of cross-channel marketing campaigns using first- and third-party data sources
- Experience building interactive dashboards or self-service reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms) in partnership with data science teams
- Experience applying automation or AI tools to scale research production and delivery
- Experience working directly with senior leadership to influence annual planning, campaign strategy, or audience strategy
- Experience in the music, entertainment, media, or consumer technology industry
- Advanced degree (e.g., MBA or Master's) in Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Psychology, Economics, or a related field

POSITION SUMMARY

AccuWeather is seeking a Graphic Designer with strong video and presentation (deck) experience to help translate complex weather data and product stories into clear, compelling visual content. This role sits at the intersection of design, motion, and storytelling, supporting marketing, sales, and executive communications.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design polished, on-brand presentations and decks, collateral, video and any creative asks for sales, marketing, leadership, and client audiences
  • Create video and motion graphics for digital marketing, social media, events, and internal communications
  • Turn complex information into clear, visually engaging stories
  • Maintain consistency with AccuWeather’s brand standards
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and subject-matter experts
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 3+ years of professional design experience (or equivalent)
  • Strong skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Experience with After Effects and Premiere Pro (or similar tools)
  • Advanced presentation design experience (PowerPoint, Google Slides)
  • Strong eye for typography, layout, and visual hierarchy
  • Ability to take feedback and communicate design decisions clearly
  • AI-savvy. Uses it to move faster for concept and rapid visual prototyping
  • UX and in-app design experience

NICE TO HAVE

  • Motion graphics or data visualization experience
  • Figma or collaborative design tools
  • Experience with B2B or data-driven storytelling

About AccuWeather

 AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

job.description:

This is an opportunity to shape the future of a sophisticated advertising technology platform, advancing real-time decisioning, machine learning, AI, and engineering excellence while building the technical foundation for a significantly larger business.

We are looking for an exceptional engineering executive who combines deep technical and architectural judgment, experience leading at scale, strong commercial instincts, and the ability to build outstanding engineering organizations.

job.title: LN Concerts, Production Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Production Manager is responsible for the on-stage, backstage, show settlement, and other technical details of concerts and events at Live Nation-operated venues and third-party venues, including theatres, clubs, amphitheaters, stadiums, and arenas in the local market and surrounding areas.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Manage 70+ shows annually, maintaining an active on-site presence during load-in, show, and load-out with an emphasis on customer (artist/client) service, adherence to timelines, sound restrictions, and cost containment
  • Coordinate between tour production and the building operations.  Advance and communicate presale technical information, including production needs (audio, video, lighting, staging, power, rigging), all rider requirements, layouts, on-sale maps, parking requirements, dressing rooms, etc. 
  • Interface with local contractors (vendors) for all show requirements, including stagehands, runners, security, casual labor, catering, and other rental equipment, with an emphasis on quality, reliability, and costs. 
  • Coordinate and manage approved subcontractors and third-party vendors to ensure safe, efficient, and successful events.
  • Work with the box office to ensure all seats are open and available with excellent sightlines to the performance
  • Work as the Live Nation representative at scheduled shows for the business unit, including production and/or show settlement responsibilities for shows in the market, as directed. 
  • Complete show settlements, when necessary, along with artist and vendor payments for events   
  • Collaborate in a team environment while working with other Production Managers and sharing valuable information about upcoming tours and buildings
  • Submit all invoices and agreements for processing before each event.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Combination 4 plus years’ experience as Production Manager, promoter rep, or event coordinator; general knowledge of venue operations and production preferred
  • Experience with show settlement, encompassing both the building and artist-facing finances
  • Possess strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills with attention to detail/problem solving skills
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Be a self-motivated individual who possesses a “roll up the sleeves attitude” and a “hands-on” style, as well as the aptitude to thrive in a fast-paced, results- oriented environment
  • Ability to travel within the South region as schedule dictates
  • Flexible Schedule (days/nights, late hours, weekends, and holidays)
  • Implementation and execution of all Live Nation policies, procedures, and programs.
  • Must work well under pressure/Even tempered
  • Ability to make clear, concise decisions, sometimes with limited information.
  • Computer proficiency in Windows applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • ROME (Salesforce) experience preferred 
  • OSHA 10 certified (if not, LN will provide) 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Location: Manila, Philippines 

Division: Fan Support

Contract Terms: Permanent

The main function of the Service Resolution team is to support front line Fan Support representatives to resolve fan queries effectively and efficiently.

As part of the Service Resolution Team, you will provide administrative, information support to the Contact Centre to ensure customer satisfaction and excellent employee performance. 

The Fan Support Representative is responsible for resolving complex fan contacts escalated from frontline support teams. This bilingual role delivers an exceptional, empathetic experience for fans in both English and Japanese, taking ownership of cases through investigation, resolution, and clear communication.

  • Communicate professionally and empathetically with fans in English and Japanese, both verbally and in writing. 
  • Liaise with internal teams, event organisers, venues, promoters, payment partners, and other stakeholders as needed to resolve fan issues. 
  • Complete back-office administrative work, including contacting fans about cancelled, postponed, and rescheduled events. 
  • Provide fans with timely information on event changes, ticket options, refunds, exchanges, or other available resolutions in line with policy. 
  • Maintain complete and accurate case notes, customer records, and system updates. 
  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps, or event-related trends and escalate them to the appropriate team. 
  • Handle customer data responsibly and follow all relevant privacy, security, and compliance requirements. 

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS) 

  • Knowledge and Experience of all Ticketmaster applications (desirable not essential).  
  • Customer service background whether face to face or on the phones. 
  • Computer literate with knowledge of Microsoft word and excel. 
  • Educated to GCSE level or equivalent. 
  • The ability to meet targets and deadlines in a busy, fast paced, dynamic environment. 
  • Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and written. 
  • Excellent organization skills and time management capabilities. 

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS) 

  • Fluent written and spoken English and Japanese, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally in both languages. 
  • Previous experience in customer service, contact centre support, case management, or an escalation-focused support role. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex cases independently. 
  • Excellent written communication, attention to detail, and administrative accuracy. 
  • A calm, empathetic, and fan-focused approach, particularly when supporting customers affected by event changes. 
  • Experience using CRM, ticketing, or customer-support systems is preferred. 
  • Comfortable working collaboratively across teams and building effective working relationships with stakeholders. 
  • Able to prioritise workload, meet deadlines, and adapt in a fast-paced environment. 

 

 

  

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER 

 

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.  

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.   

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you. 

 

Our work is guided by our values: 

 

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen. 

 

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team 

 

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent 

 

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities. 

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

job.title: Restaurant Bartender
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Interact with guests in a natural, friendly demeanor
  • Cultivate regular guests and repeat business
  • Successfully complete a pour test prior to every shift, where applicable
  • Suggestively sell both beverages and menu items to guests at the bar
  • Deliver food items and beverage orders promptly
  • Prioritize and organize drink orders
  • Consistently prepare beverages according to standard recipes and venue specifications, abide by all control systems
  • Record any equipment failure and/or safety hazards in bar log
  • Recognize when guests are becoming too intoxicated and refuse further service of alcohol in a courteous and safety-minded manner, bringing it to the attention of a manager
  • Ensure responsible alcohol service per local ordinance alcohol awareness training and HOB alcohol policies
  • Request proper identification for anyone appearing under 30 years of age
  • Maintain HOB safety and sanitation standards
  • Perform Opening/Running/Closing duties according to HOB policy
  • Prepare guest checks (on point of sales terminal) and process payment according to HOB policy
  • Maintain bartender bank
  • Perform cash pull / check out procedures
  • Maintain appropriate Comp and Spill checks
  • Required to occasionally work Special Events that are scheduled throughout the venue

Required:

  • (State or County Licensee or Certification Requirement)/ Responsible Alcohol Awareness Training Certification or Equivalent
  • Ability to work late hours
  • Flexible schedule
  • Cash handling experience
  • Must be able to lift or move up to 25 lbs using proper lifting techniques

job.title: Acting Commissioning Editor, Arts
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

The role

The FT’s arts desk is looking for a commissioning editor to work across the team’s print and digital content on a three-day a week basis to cover a period of parental leave.

The successful applicant will have had several years experience in arts journalism and relish working across a broad range of content, from film and television to music, theatre, visual art, dance, opera and gaming.

 

Your skills

  • Excellent editing skills, with the ability to turn around copy speedily and accurately
  • The ability to conjure up grabby headlines and standfirsts
  • A wide-ranging knowledge of and deep interest in the arts. A passion for pop culture would be a particular asset
  • A willingness to take on tasks big or small, including fact-checking and scheduling
  • A hard-working, ambitious journalist with an eye for detail
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with freelance and staff writers
  • Adept social media skills
  • A creative thinker with a strong teamwork ethic

 

The arts desk produces a wealth of articles online and in print, working to both long and short lead times. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Edit regular reviews that need to be speedily published
  • Fact-check articles
  • Keep in touch with arts and entertainment publicists to maintain a schedule of upcoming events that we may want to feature
  • Manage our digital publishing schedule
  • Maintain schedules with freelance writers
  • Commission features
  • Work with the picture editor on all aspects of story presentation across print, mobile and digital platforms

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Monday 30th November 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

*LI-RS1

job.title: Burson Summer 2027 HBSI (Client-Facing, USA Hybrid)
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Harold Burson Summer Internship (HBSI) Program gives early-career professionals an opportunity to explore the world of communications at a top-tier global communications agency during an exhilarating 12-week experience. 

The HBSI culminates a real-world challenge where interns research, design and present a campaign for a current Burson client to the agency’s senior management, receiving feedback, tips and insights that would ordinarily take years to obtain. The summer internship program offers an invaluable career-development experience. So … are you ready to be a Harold Burson summer intern?  

The program will run from June 7– August 31, 2027, and you will be connected to one of our U.S. offices. The health and well-being of our employees, including you as our future intern, are our top priorities. All our offices are open, and we plan to welcome you to them as many days a week as you'd like, but Burson U.S. is currently following an in-office hybrid policy.  

Please note, this application is for one of our client-facing positions within the following practices: Consumer & Brand, Corporate & Public Affairs, Digital, Health & Wellness, Insights & Intelligence, Performance Media, Transportation, Energy & Industrials, Technology, and Grassroots (Direct Impact). To help you understand our practices and to aid in your decision making when choosing your top three areas of interest, please review the descriptions at the bottom of this post.  

There is a separate application for Creative roles on the Burson HBSI landing page. If you are interested in a Creative role and this client facing role, please feel free to apply for both. They are all still a part of the broader Harold Burson Summer Internship, you will just have a different focus area.  

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):  

  1. Resume 
  2. Cover Letter
  3. Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. As our industry continues to evolve, how we use these tools matters just as much as what they help us achieve. In 500 words, how would you use AI responsibly and thoughtfully while staying true to Burson's core values?

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com. 

What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. 
    • Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most.
    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate. 
  • Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.  

Please note, Burson does not provide any form of relocation/housing assistance. Once hired, it will be up to the individual to find accommodations for the duration of the program.  

#LI-FB1

Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:$15—$19 USD

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our  California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world.     • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate.

job.title: 2027 Graduate Programme - United Kingdom
job.description:
UK Graduate Programme 2027

Pave your career path with FGS Global

We are the best at what we do because we hire people who are open-minded, collaborative and bring diverse perspectives to the table.

If you’re looking to be challenged, want to learn and progress in a fast-paced environment, and have excellent written and verbal communication skills, we want to get to know you.

2027 UK Graduate Programme

We work for some of the world’s most successful and interesting businesses, institutions and individuals helping them to shape and safeguard reputations, and succeed in critical moments. We help leaders engage with multiple stakeholders including investors, media, employees and government. We do this in a range of ways, crafting communication strategies encompassing everything from traditional media through to the latest digital channels and content creation.

What sets us apart has always been clear in the work: the ability to anticipate what's next, influence what matters, and orchestrate outcomes that hold. The knowledge, creativity and passion our people is crucial to our success as a company and why we are a leader in our field.

Do you want to join a world-leading strategic leadership advisory firm?

We’re now welcoming applications for our 2027 UK Graduate Programme

You will be applying for the UK office in London, where you will join one of our brilliant teams

During the graduate programme you will get the opportunity to work on high-stakes, business-critical projects that span some of the world’s largest companies and most complex situations faced by organisations. You’ll encounter issues that make up the global news agenda of the time.

If you are interested in other opportunities, please visit our Join Us page. 

What the programme will involve

The UK graduate programme is based in London but offers our graduates the opportunity to work with colleagues and clients around our international offices. We are a global business, and we work collaboratively across time zones.

Throughout your application for the UK Graduate programme, you will have the opportunity to indicate a preference for one of three pathways:

  • Core consulting – most of FGS Global’s UK activity takes place on this pathway, including Transaction & Financial Communications, Strategy & Reputation and Crisis and Issues Management practices.
  • Digital & creative – This pathway is an opportunity to join the Edmonds Elder by FGS Global team, which offer world leading digital and creative content strategies. This pathway will either mean working very closely with Edmonds Elder or potentially directly as part of their team, depending on your skillset.
  • UK Public Affairs, Policy & Intelligence – This pathway is to work as part of our specialist public affairs and policy offering, which helps clients engage with the UK political environment, and working closely with our colleagues in Brussels, Washington D.C. and all over the world.  

The graduate programme will begin with two joint-training weeks for all participants to truly immerse you in our culture and the type of work we do. Following this, you’ll spend six-months in a structured training and mentorship programme along one of our three pathways, learning both on-the-job and through formal trainings to help develop your knowledge and skillset across communications. This will be across a range of audiences including those involved in public affairs, the media, investors, employees and government.

Our people love the work they do, and the people they do it with, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to get to know your local and global colleagues both socially and professionally.

Through the application process, we select individuals for this programme that we believe will pioneer the future of FGS Global. The intention is for us to invest in your development, and for you to receive a truly immersive learning experience that challenges you and allows you to demonstrate your own entrepreneurial flare. The expectation is that you continue with us after the programme ends as a full-time Associate without any further interviews or assessment.  

Who are we looking for?

  • We are looking for motivated and proactive graduates who welcome a steep learning curve and the chance to collaborate with a wide range of people
  • All roles require individuals who are interested and engaged in how different stakeholders communicate – be it through news outlets, investor presentations, social media, keynote events, or face-to-face conversations
  • We want applicants who are interested in the news agenda, and track emerging issues and current challenges facing society today
  • We want people who will bring their own dynamism and knowledge of how companies and organisations communicate, for example the changing world of digital and social media communications
  • Our core pathway is suited to a wide range of backgrounds and skillsets in line with the criteria above, while the Creative & Digital pathway is best suited to those with a flair for content production and design. While not explicitly required, UK Public Affairs pathway applicants will benefit from a strong understanding of the Westminster system and UK political dynamics
  • Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate that they embody the values our people live by: being ambitious together, working hard while keeping energy levels high, striving for excellence and taking responsibility in all they do
  • We care for and uplift those around us, and expect anyone who joins our team to do their part

 

What we offer you in return

  • We are a diverse, dynamic and caring group of people. We motivate each other, strive to deliver to a brilliant standard and we take the time to celebrate together and learn lessons to improve
  • You will have the opportunity to work with leading communications professionals, learning from the brightest minds in the industry who come from a diverse background
  • You will be working on a diverse mix of clients, across industries, sectors and geographies
  • You will have continuous training and development throughout the programme, with dedicated mentors
  • You will be given the platform to innovate and trusted to demonstrate your entrepreneurial flare
  • You will have access to a range of office perks including regular team socials, free tickets to exhibitions, company discounts, and flexible working policies
  • A competitive salary benchmarked against others in the industry, and we review Associate salaries every six months in line with formal appraisals. We also offer a number of other benefits including gym membership and private health and dental care
  • At the beginning of the programme, we require you to be in the office full time. After this, we expect all colleagues to be in the office the majority of the working week, however we do offer flexibility to work from home at least one day a week

 

Visa, language and relocation requirements

UK

  • Fluent and native-standard English is essential
  • Candidates must have a right to work in the UK
  • Candidates must be able to relocate by the end of August 2027 to begin work on 6th September 2027

 

How the application process works

Step 1. We have developed an FGS Global-specific task that is designed to highlight the brightest, most creative graduates. It will be an opportunity for you to demonstrate your research skills, creative thinking and ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple way. This must be completed in a presentation.

We will also ask you to fill out a short form and send us your CV, as well as specifying which pathway you are most interested in (don’t worry – you can specify interest in more than one). We appreciate the task takes a lot of work, but it gives us the opportunity to assess in a completely blind way based on your abilities and talents.

Presentations and CV’s must be submitted in PDF format. This application must be completed by Friday 15th January 2027 at 23:59 GMT – late applications will not be accepted.  

Our Step 1 review process is entirely anonymous. All application tasks and CVs are assessed blindly with personal identifying information removed prior to review.

Step 2. Successful candidates will be interviewed virtually between 8th and 26th February 2027 and told whether they are through to the final shortlist for our assessment day. You will also take an online scenario test simulating tasks we undertake.

Step 3. We will host an in-person assessment day at our London office on 23rd  April 2027. Further details of the assessment day will be announced in due course.

Successful applicants will start full time in on 6th September 2027.

Apply now

If you’re ready to launch your career and start your journey in strategic communications, apply before Friday 15th January.

job.title: Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world's most ambitious clients.We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a workforce with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

Overview

The Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies across General & Administrative (G&A) spend categories to optimize cost, mitigate risk, improve supplier performance, and support business objectives. This role reports to the VP, Global procurement and partners closely with functional leaders across Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Business Applications, and other corporate functions to deliver strategic procurement solutions and measurable business value. 

 

The successful candidate will lead sourcing initiatives, manage strategic supplier relationships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and drive continuous improvement opportunities across the indirect procurement portfolio. This role requires strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to influence decisions across a diverse set of functional partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Category Strategy & Execution: As key member of the procurement team you will have an opportunity to shape the category strategy across the Stagwell network, driving initiatives that ensure businesses have the right tools, services, and resources at the best possible value.

  • Contractual Organization: Ownership of category contractual life cycle management across MSA, Pricing, Enterprise and other agreements collaborating with Legal, Finance, Brand CFOs and other cross functional departments to ensure contracts are optimized, compliant, and effectively structured to meet the needs of Stagwell’s global network.

  • Vendor Management & Negotiations: Develop and maintain relationships with key vendors, ensuring quality service delivery, owning the state of the partnership, via continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Negotiate favorable terms and pricing based on an in-depth understanding of business needs and spend data.

  • Spend Analysis & Reporting: Work closely with FP&A, Business Applications and ERP teams to track and analyze category spend across all areas of the business. Use data to identify opportunities for cost optimization, strategic sourcing and consolidation.

  • Tool & Product Knowledge: Gain an in-depth understanding of the category tools, products, and services used by Stagwell businesses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to identify gaps, needs, and opportunities to improve operations.

  • Process Improvement: Partner with VP, Global Procurement to assess and improve procurement processes that enhance efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and service quality. This will include but not limited to; Honing operational needs, reporting, dashboards, initiative tracking, tools, communication and data gathering. 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field.

  • 5 - 10+ years of procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading strategic sourcing initiatives and supplier negotiations including but not limited to large-scale software, cloud and technology agreements.

  • Experience managing indirect or G&A spend categories.  

  • Strong analytical, financial, and commercial acumen.  

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and complex stakeholder environments. 

Preferred 

  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, C.P.M., CSCP, or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting a global, multinational organization.

  • Experience using sourcing, contract management, and spend analytics platforms.

  • Knowledge of software asset management, FinOps, cloud economics, and third-party risk management practices. 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $110,000–150,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

Numetrix is seeking an experienced Sales Director to drive new business growth across its audience measurement, mobility data, survey, and research solutions. 

This role is designed for a consultative seller who excels at opening new opportunities, building relationships, and helping clients solve complex business questions through data, research, and measurement. The ideal candidate brings a strong track record of new business development and the ability to translate client needs into tailored solutions rather than relying on a standardized product pitch. 

The successful candidate will work with brands, agencies, media organizations, and other data buyers to develop solutions spanning audience measurement, location and mobility intelligence, survey research, and analytics. 

This is a true hunter role focused on building a book of business, creating net-new opportunities, and driving revenue through a consultative sales approach. 

Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities and build a sustainable sales pipeline across Numetrix's measurement, mobility data, survey, and research solutions. 
  • Develop relationships with decision-makers across brands, agencies, media organizations, and other buyers of data and research solutions. 
  • Lead consultative sales conversations to understand client challenges and translate those needs into tailored solutions.

  • Develop and deliver compelling client presentations, proposals, and business cases. 
  • Partner with research, product, technical, and client teams to develop solutions that address client needs. 
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting while consistently delivering against revenue targets. 
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through additional Numetrix capabilities and solutions. 
  • Maintain knowledge of audience measurement, mobility data, market research, analytics, media, and evolving industry trends. 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B sales or business development experience with demonstrated ownership of new-business and revenue targets. 
  • Proven success generating net-new business and building pipeline through outbound prospecting and relationship development. 
  • Experience selling complex data, analytics, research, measurement, media, AdTech, MarTech, or related solutions. 
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to uncover client needs and connect them to relevant solutions. 
  • Experience navigating multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging senior decision-makers. 
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage opportunities through the full sales cycle and close meaningful new business. 

 

Preferred Background

About the Role:

Global BC is looking for a temporary, full-time Reporter/Producer to serve as the primary voice of weekday radio newscasts on 730 CKNW.

Reporting to the Assistant News Director, this role will deliver timely, accurate news coverage that complements the station’s talk programming while contributing content across Global BC television, digital, streaming, and other platforms.

The position provides full-time hours on a regular Monday-to-Friday schedule and ends in January 2028.

Shifts may vary as operationally required, including mornings, evenings, and weekends.

This is a Group 4 position under the current collective agreement.

You will contribute by:

• Anchoring 730 CKNW weekday radio newscasts and delivering breaking and developing news updates;

• Writing, vetting, producing, and adapting clear, accurate news content for radio and other platforms;

• Conducting interviews and producing radio stories, wraps, clips, and other audio elements;

• Pitching original and enterprise stories and contributing reporting, live hits, packages, online stories, and video as required;

• Working closely with Global BC, BC1, digital, streaming, assignment, and technical teams in an integrated multiplatform newsroom;

• Monitoring feeds, wires, social media, and Global News reporting to keep newscasts current;

• Creating and editing content using newsroom production, audio, video, and desktop editing systems;

• Maintaining Global News’ editorial, legal, ethical, and production standards across all platforms;

• Other duties as required.

Skills and experience you bring:

• Post-secondary education or equivalent experience in journalism, broadcasting, or a related field;

• A minimum of five years of professional news broadcasting experience, or significant experience in a major market, with radio anchor or live on-air delivery strongly preferred;

• Strong news writing, copy-editing, editorial judgment, research, and interview skills;

• Experience creating and adapting content for radio, television, digital, streaming, and social audiences;

• Working knowledge of newsroom production systems and audio editing tools; Grass Valley Stratus/Edius experience is an asset;

• Ability to access and interpret public records and prepare Freedom of Information requests;

• Knowledge of inclusive journalism, Indigenous storytelling, trauma-informed reporting, and the Truth and Reconciliation Commission calls to action;

Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Executive Producer, Mornings - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

The Morning Executive Producer at WPXI Pittsburgh will oversee the morning shift with newscasts on both NBC and Fox. This EP will manage a team of TV producers and writers who create dynamic morning newscasts for one of the top NBC affiliates in the country. The EP works with the team to craft the look of the 4:30a, 5:00a, 6:00am on NBC and the 7-8am newscast on Fox. The EP is responsible for editorial oversight, managing story decisions, story count, flow and placement of every story. This person will set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news within the newscasts and the speed and style in which we get it on the air. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment, with knowledge on social platforms and how to market there.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Lead digital effort to engage viewers as they wake up and look at their phones first
  • Execute strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms
  • Work closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes
  • Craft newscast look by working with the Creative Services Department
  • Manage story count and placement
  • Must be intimate with the rundown
  • Manage story count vs. big story coverage
  • Copy edits stories in the newscast and ensures that they are on target with research objectives
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with anchors, reporters, producers and conducting newscast critiques
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast
  • Ensure the product stays on brand
  • Hold producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery
  • Manage breaking news
  • Ensure that we are aggressive covering breaking news on all platforms
  • Monitor the execution in the control room
     

Administrative – 10% 

  • Lead and manage a team of morning TV producers and writers
  • Manage schedules, goal setting, and employee relations for morning producers

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required  
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment  
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms  
  • Must be a good teacher and leader  
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings
  • Ability to work well with others and deal with employee issues appropriately

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other field of study preferred  
  • Large market experience preferred

This explicitly entry-level position provides first-line technology support to onsite and remote employees across NPG and BERKS companies and locations, including the corporate/home-office environment and shared corporate functions such as IT, Human Resources, Finance, and other business services, as well as broadcast, digital education, technology infrastructure, manufacturing, printing, and newspaper operations. This is the baseline scope and expected work for IT Engineer I. As your experience and technical ability grow, you may be asked to assist IT Engineer II and IT Engineer III teammates for continued learning, backup coverage, and business needs. IT Engineer I supports these priorities through careful triage, security-conscious support, and clear follow-through. What We are Looking For This is an entry-level role. Customer-service experience, foundational computer understanding, a strong interest in technology, and the ability to learn as you go are important. Prior IT support experience, formal education, and certifications are helpful but not required. You should be responsible and comfortable working through unfamiliar issues, while knowing when to communicate, collaborate, or escalate. job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KNXV
job.description:
We're looking for a storyteller who can do it all — shoot, write, report and most importantly - connect with the community. KNXV, ABC 15 in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for a talented Multimedia Journalist to join our newsroom. At ABC 15, you'll be more than a journalist — you'll be a one-person powerhouse who brings the stories of the Valley of the Sun to life across television and digital platforms. From breaking news to in-depth community coverage, your work will inform, inspire and make a real difference in the lives of viewers across one of the nation's fastest-growing markets.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix is one of America's most exciting and sun-soaked cities, offering an extraordinary quality of life for those who call it home. With more than 300 days of sunshine a year, the Valley of the Sun is a playground for outdoor enthusiasts — whether you're hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park, kayaking along the Salt River, or exploring the stunning red rocks just a short drive away in Sedona. The sprawling Sonoran Desert landscape is unlike anywhere else on earth, and it's right at your doorstep.

Beyond the outdoors, the downtown arts district offers a vibrant scene that includes the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest in the Southwest, as well as the Musical Instrument Museum — a one-of-a-kind destination that draws visitors from around the globe. The local food scene reflects the city's rich cultural diversity, from authentic Sonoran-style Mexican cuisine and acclaimed farm-to-table restaurants to a thriving craft brewery and coffee culture. The city also hosts beloved annual events like the Barrett-Jackson car auction and the Waste Management Phoenix Open, one of the most attended sporting events in the world.

For sports fans, Phoenix is a major-league city all the way, home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the WNBA's Mercury, the NHL's Coyotes, and MLB's Diamondbacks. With a booming economy, a young and diverse population, and world-class amenities at every turn, Phoenix isn't just a great place to work — it's a phenomenal place to build a life.
