job.title: Local Sales Manager, WCPO
job.description:
Are you a proven sales leader who knows how to inspire a team, build winning strategies, and drive real results? WCPO is looking for a Local Sales Manager who thrives at the intersection of media, marketing, and leadership. In this role, you'll guide a talented team of Account Executives to help local businesses grow by connecting them with customers through a powerful suite of multi-platform advertising solutions — from broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display, and email targeting. If you're energized by coaching people, developing creative sales strategies, and making a measurable impact in your market, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Cincinnati is a city that punches well above its weight — a vibrant, welcoming river city with a rich history, world-class culture, and a food scene that has earned national recognition. The Cincinnati Art Museum, the Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, and the American Sign Museum are just a few of the cultural gems that make the city a destination in its own right. The revitalized Over-the-Rhine neighborhood, with its stunning 19th-century architecture, craft breweries, and acclaimed restaurants, has become one of the most celebrated urban districts in the Midwest.


Sports are a serious way of life here. Cincinnatians are passionate about the Bengals, the Reds, and FC Cincinnati — and attending a game at Paycor Stadium or Great American Ball Park along the Ohio River is an experience unlike any other. Beyond the stadiums, the region offers beautiful parks, miles of trails along the Little Miami Scenic Trail, and easy access to the rolling hills of both Ohio and Northern Kentucky, making it a great place for hikers, cyclists, and outdoor enthusiasts.


Cincinnati is also an incredibly affordable place to live, with a strong job market, diverse and distinct neighborhoods — from Hyde Park and Oakley to Covington just across the river in Kentucky — and a genuine sense of community. Whether you're raising a family, building a career, or simply looking for a city with authentic character and momentum, Cincinnati delivers on all fronts.

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.

We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Strategic Partner Development to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.


If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Experience building strategic partnerships with digital platforms, including YouTube/Google, to drive revenue growth and content monetization, is strongly preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

job.title: Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response
job.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at the intersection of media innovation and client success? Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind strengthening advertiser and agency relationships while delivering integrated media solutions that span linear television, digital, and streaming/CTV platforms. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the day-to-day execution, delivery, and performance of assigned accounts and campaigns to meet client objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and performance KPIs.
  • Serve as a contact for advertisers and agencies, developing a strong understanding of their business objectives, target audiences, marketing strategies, and performance goals while providing responsive, solutions-oriented support as well as upselling opportunities.
  • Partner with account executives and sales leadership on media plans, proposals, presentations, pipeline management, account growth, retention, and opportunities to increase advertiser investment.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, delivery, and performance; analyze KPIs including CPA, CPL, ROAS, response, conversion, reach, and frequency; and implement optimization strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Analyze campaign and account performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, and develop client-facing reports, campaign recaps, recommendations, and strategic insights.
  • Coordinate the campaign lifecycle from proposal through order entry, trafficking, scheduling, optimization, reporting, makegoods, and reconciliation while maintaining accurate account, campaign, and revenue information in applicable systems.
  • Partner with Sales, Ad Operations, Traffic, Inventory, Research, Marketing, Content, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure effective planning, execution, issue resolution, and delivery of client commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

job.title: Production Manager, Remote & Studio
job.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a Production Manager to plan and execute full-scale productions for live remote events and studio shows, both domestic and international. This role calls for a highly organized, proactive, and quick-thinking professional with strong communication and interpersonal skills. As a representative of Tennis Channel at events around the world, the Production Manager will maintain a professional appearance and demeanor and serve as an ambassador for the network on an international stage.

What You’ll Do

Remote Production

  • Serve as the primary liaison between production teams and a wide range of partners, including facility management, senior production staff, production and technical crews, talent, site operations, vendors, tournament directors, and other network representatives.
  • Coordinate facilities with host venues and broadcasters, including [V&A] bookings, office space, power, venue logistics, shipping, and transmission.
  • Supervise staffing needs for domestic and international remote productions and help source experienced crews for ATP Masters 1000 events.
  • Oversee the acquisition and distribution of production elements such as event footage, music and music cue sheets, graphics, and equipment.
  • Partner with the Travel and Finance teams to coordinate hotel accommodations.
  • Manage credentials, venue access, parking, catering, and crew scheduling.
  • Plan and track rental equipment, logistics, and shipping.

Studio Production

  • Help supervise studio coordination, staff, and facilities alongside the Production Coordinator.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal and external partners during world feed production.
  • Collaborate with production teams to ensure assigned productions meet the network’s creative and technical objectives.
  • Help train new hires in production department processes and procedures.

Across Remote and Studio

  • Create, maintain, and quality-check production books, call sheets, daily crew call times, schedules, trackers, and planning documents using Lasso and established Excel templates.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance and the Production Accountant to manage costs, coordinate crew and show requirements, and ensure timely processing of timecards and contracts/deal memos.

What You Bring

  • Preferred 5+ years of experience in production management or a related role in sports or entertainment production.
  • Proven ability to oversee complex remote productions, manage venue operations and logistics, and work closely with venue management and host broadcasters.
  • Strong ability to multitask and manage several productions from start to finish in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to adapt and thrive in constantly changing environments with unpredictable challenges and a wide range of personalities.
  • Enthusiasm for hands-on work and the resourcefulness to roll up your sleeves and make things happen.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with Smartsheet preferred; familiarity with Lasso is a plus.

Schedule and Travel

  • Domestic and international travel averaging about 4 months per year, including Grand Slams and other tournaments as needed.
  • Willingness to work 50+ hours per week on a flexible schedule that includes days, nights, weekends, and holidays. The tennis season runs January through November, with the heaviest workload from May through September.

About Tennis Channel
 

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 185 television stations in 86 markets affiliated with all the major broadcast networks; and owns Tennis Channel and multicast networks Comet, CHARGE!, ROAR, and The Nest. Sinclair's content is delivered via multiple platforms, including over-the-air, multi-channel video program distributors, and the nation's largest streaming aggregator of local news content, NewsON. job.title: Sales and Marketing Associate
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our sales and marketing team efforts, by helping us to grow our customer base and enhance our brand presence in the market and providing day-to-day business support. This means helping them fulfill orders, manage accounts, craft proposals, create engaging presentations, and develop materials that clearly communicate the benefits of our services. Your creativity will play a huge role here in driving results. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Campaign Development: Work with the sales and marketing team to design and implement campaigns that drive sales and amplify brand awareness across various multimedia platforms.

 

o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.

 

o Data Analysis:  Data-driven decisions are the name of the game! Report and analyze sales data, providing insights to optimize our strategies for better results.

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

 

o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  

 

o A Passion for helping Others: You are committed to collaborate with various people and departments, so being adaptable and open to working with others will help you thrive in this role to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description:
About Criminally Obsessed

Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s true crime media brand, and it is focused on the cases, investigations and stories that capture the public’s attention. Criminally Obsessed brings together compelling crime news and journalism, expert analysis, exclusive interviews and original storytelling and content across digital platforms.

The Criminally Obsessed Daily Show is a daily crime news and analysis program covering the biggest and most compelling criminal stories making headlines across the country. It goes beyond simply recapping the day’s news. Each episode is built around the most interesting development, question, detail or perspective surrounding a case and is led by an interview that drives the conversation. It is a vodcast and podcast, so the production team constructs each episode keeping in mind that the audience will need to be interested visually and audibly. 

About Sinclair

Sinclair is one of the largest media companies in the United States, with an extensive portfolio in digital media, national programming, local television, news, sports, and entertainment. Sinclair’s portfolio is an asset to Criminally Obsessed, with nearly 30 years of archival content, reporters and photographers on the ground, on the scene and in court. 

Sinclair’s strength is in its wide reach combined with its deep connection to local audiences and journalism. The company continues to expand its digital footprint andcontinues to develop content designed for a multiplatform audience.

About the role

Criminally Obsessed is looking for a talented and creative Editor to join the production team behind the daily show. This is more than a technical editing position. We are lookingfor someone who understands storytelling, pacing, visual language and YouTube audience retention – someone who knows how to turn raw material into a compelling piece of content that makes people want to click, watch and keep watching. 

The Editor for Criminally Obsessed is responsible for the editorial preparation, production, post-production, and delivery of daily and episodic content. This role works closely with the Producer, Senior Producer, Production Assistant, the host, and guests to ensure content is accurate, compelling, visually engaging, technically sound, and delivered on deadline.

The Editor is expected to have a strong understanding of true-crime news, storytelling, editorial standards, broadcast and digital production workflows, and the technical requirements necessary to deliver polished content across multiple platforms. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound editorial judgment, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced production environment. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the unique demands of YouTube as a viewing platform and can bring a digital-first approach to editing, with an eye toward creating content that captures attention, sustains viewer interest, and encourages audiences to keep watching. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Attend Content Strategy Sessions to pitch and produce original social-first true crime content
  • Collaborate with assigned producers and talent to research and gather all necessary creative materials for approved projects
  • Work independently to assemble and edit assigned content through all stages of post-production and the review process
  • Utilize the full Adobe Creative Suite and other design tools to create motion graphics, to deliver high-quality content
  • Design social graphics including thumbnails that maintain brand guidelines
  • Make informed editorial decisions around content, episode length, and metadata, optimizing show for maximum audience growth
  • Advise on workflows to ensure production efficiency; educate both internal and external teams on best practices
  • Keep up with latest trends, software updates, and platform changes to help drive innovative ways to create new content

CORE RESPONSIBILITIESPRE-PRODUCTION

  • Once a topic or editorial angle for the Daily Show has been selected, thoroughly familiarize yourself with the case and the planned story.
  • Develop a working knowledge of the key people, locations, timeline, events, and relevant facts associated with each case. 
  • Review and become familiar with all available editorial, archival, photographic,video, audio, and other media assets.
  • Gather, organize, label, and prepare assets for efficient use during the editing process.
  • Research and obtain appropriate guest information, including names, backgrounds, photographs, video, and information required for lower thirds and other on-screen graphics.
  • Review interview shots and technical setup prior to recording to ensure appropriate framing, lighting, video quality, and audio quality.
  • Be available during recordings to identify and troubleshoot technical or visual issues as they arise.
  • Review raw recordings and correct or flag audio, video, or other technical issues to ensure the highest possible quality before editing.

PRODUCTION / EDITING

  • Edit Producer-created papercuts/scripts, A-roll, and other editorial materials into a polished and cohesive Daily Show segment.
  • Review and incorporate media gathered by the Editor, Senior Producer, Producer, or Associate Producer and identified in the papercut.
  • Select and appropriately place B-roll and supporting visual elements to complement the narration, interviews, and editorial beats of each story.
  • Maintain strong visual storytelling throughout each segment, using appropriatepacing, imagery, graphics, sound, and transitions.
  • Proactively communicate with the Producer and Senior Producer regarding editorial changes, creative opportunities, or potential improvements to the visual presentation, audio quality, pacing, and overall flow of the Daily Show.
  • Create and incorporate graphics for the Daily Show, including fullscreens,dates/courtesies, lower thirds, and other required on-screen elements.
  • Ensure graphics, captions, names, dates, and other editorial information areaccurate and consistent with established production standards.
  • Deliver a clean, polished first pass to the Producer/Senior Producer for review.
  • Implement notes, corrections, and editorial changes efficiently and accurately through subsequent edit passes.
  • Maintain appropriate legal courtesies and source attribution for non-Sinclair content in accordance with established standards and requirements.
  • Complete final edits and deliver finished episodes including accurate time codes for designated advertising breaks.
  • Meet established production deadlines while maintaining a high standard of editorial and technical quality.
     

POST-PRODUCTION

  • Archive and properly organize all content and media assets used in each episode in accordance with established file management and archival procedures.
  • Edit and deliver episodes for a digital broadcast tv network
  • Prepare and edit content intended for broadcast on Sinclair news stations and upload completed materials to location.
  • Edit sales-related audio and video advertisements and promotional materials for sponsorships as assigned.
  • Ensure all final deliverables meet applicable technical specifications, formatting requirements, and deadlines.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Stay current on true-crime content creators, podcasts, news organizations, emerging stories, and relevant industry trends, and proactively contribute compelling content ideas during daily editorial meetings.
  • Maintain awareness of developing stories and potential editorial opportunities that may be relevant to Criminally Obsessed.
  • Collaborate effectively with Producers, Senior Producers, Associate Producers, and other members of the production team.
  • Communicate proactively regarding production challenges, scheduling concerns, technical issues, or potential delays.
  • Maintain organized project files, media, and editorial materials to support an efficient production workflow.
  • Perform other job-related duties and special projects as assigned by the manager.
  • Schedule and hours may flex based on business needs, production requirements, breaking news, or other editorial priorities. Occasional after-hours or weekend coverage may be required when warranted.
  • Travel approximately 10–20% as needed for conferences, training, on-site content coverage, or other business-related assignments.
  • Safely lift, carry, and maneuver equipment or production gear weighing up to 25 pounds, while following all applicable safety procedures and protocols.

PROFESSIONAL EXPECTATIONS

  • Demonstrate strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy.
  • Consistently meet deadlines and communicate promptly when priorities or circumstances may affect delivery.
  • Maintain a collaborative, solution-oriented approach when working with the production team.
     
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive, graphic, or confidential subject matter.
  • Follow all applicable company policies, editorial standards, legal requirements, technical specifications, and production procedures.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects from initial preparation through final deliveryand archival.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years hands-on experience in all aspects of video production and post production including shooting, lighting, sound recording & editing, and ability to operate and troubleshoot all associated equipment
  • Highly skilled across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Premiere Rush, Photoshop,After Effects, etc), and other creative software
  • Demonstrated experience editing content for an established YouTube channel, with an understanding of YouTube-specific storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and visual engagement.
  • Experience using YouTube performance metrics, including audience retention and watch time, to inform editing decisions and identify opportunities to improve viewer engagement and overall channel performance
  • Strong understanding of video editing techniques and storytelling
  • Demonstrated experience in motion graphics and creating social media video content
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube and its best practices
  • Proficiency in designing graphics, including thumbnails and infographics
  • An eye for quality content, with an understanding of what plays well across various channels
  • This position requires impeccable spelling and grammar, a deep understanding of social media trends and what works on each platform, vertical video editing skills, and the ability to capture well-composed videos on a phone
  • Must be highly motivated, extremely organized, and come to the position with a uniquely creative mind
  • Flexibility to travel and work nights and/or weekends, as projects call for
  • Only applicants with portfolios, sites, or reels of their work will be considered

job.title: Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Are you ready to help customers get clear, timely answers and a dependable support experience? In this fast-paced role, you will guide digital support requests from intake through resolution, helping stations and sales teams get the information they need to keep campaigns moving.

The Customer Support Manager is a part of a team that manages inquiries through the Digital Helpdesk and responds to questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, access, products, and performance. The team uses a ticketing system to organize and prioritize work, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams and vendors, and keep customers informed until each request is resolved.

We value thoughtful communication, accountability, and a strong focus on service quality. If you enjoy solving problems and making support easier for customers, this role offers a meaningful way to contribute to our digital media work.

Customer Support Duties:

  • Manage customer inquiries in the Helpdesk ticketing system from intake through resolution, organizing, prioritizing, and tracking each request.
  • Respond promptly to customer questions and issues, keep requests moving, and resolve them within agreed-upon time frames and service-level expectations.
  • Answer questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, product access, and performance in clear language customers can understand.
  • Review ticket history, order details, campaign setup, pacing, and available reporting to investigate issues and identify next steps.
  • Resolve requests directly when appropriate and coordinate escalations to Ad Operations, Analytics, Technical Account Support, Product, Engineering, or vendors when additional expertise is needed.
  • Provide clear status updates, explain next steps, and maintain professional communication with customers and internal partners throughout the resolution process.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, supporting details, customer communications, and resolution steps so each request has a clear record and can be followed through to closure.
  • Become an expert in the ticketing system and use its features to manage, monitor, and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Meet or exceed established service-level agreements and other service measures for response, resolution, and ticket quality.

 

Role Requirements

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information in a customer-friendly way.
  • Strong reading comprehension, active listening, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through on open requests.
  • Able to prioritize competing requests and work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, hybrid environment.
  • Able to stay calm, professional, and helpful when responding to customer questions or concerns.
  • Commitment to meeting service-level agreements, response and resolution time frames, and quality standards.
  • Willing to learn, receive feedback, and adapt to changing products, systems, and priorities.
  • Customer service, helpdesk, or digital advertising experience preferred.
  • Experience with Jira or another ticketing system is a plus; able to learn ticket workflows and system features in depth.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, digital campaign delivery, or ad operations is a plus.
  • Candidates must be available during regular US business hours, including Pacific Standard Time as needed 

 

Qualifications

  • College Degree
  • 2+ years job experience ideally in the digital industry

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $20.43 to $24.03. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineer
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr. Manager, Software Engineer Job ID 10163796 Location Buenos Aires, Argentina Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Nov. 17, 2026 Sr. Manager, Software Engineer Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. How will you contribute to our magical experience? Provide strategic leadership across multiple engineering teams that deliver core technology solutions for Disney’s corporate functions and global workforce, setting technical direction and mentoring leaders and engineers so platforms stay reliable, scalable, and aligned with long-term business strategy. The Senior Manager, Software Engineering is a knowledgeable specialist and strategic leader responsible for guiding multiple engineering teams that deliver core technology solutions supporting Disney’s corporate functions and global workforce. In this role, you will set technical direction, mentor leaders and individual contributors, and ensure that platforms and services are reliable, scalable, and aligned with Disney’s long-term business strategies. As a Senior Manager, Software Engineering, you will provide leadership across related teams, setting priorities, allocating resources, and driving engineering excellence for platforms and services that enable Disney’s world-class storytellers and corporate operations. You will translate organizational goals into actionable engineering roadmaps, partner with product and business stakeholders, and cultivate a collaborative, innovative, and strategic culture where managers and engineers can do their best work. This role matters because it connects technology delivery to Disney’s broader vision, requiring strong strategic thinking, planning and prioritization, collaboration, and mentoring skills to be successful. The Senior Manager, Software Engineering will be responsible for: • Envision future possibilities for Disney’s corporate technology platforms and create breakthrough engineering strategies that align with enterprise business objectives. • Define strategies, expectations, and priorities for multiple related teams, connecting their responsibilities to company-wide goals and empowering them to solve both immediate and long-term challenges. • Develop departmental plans and roadmaps, set organizational priorities, and allocate resources to ensure stable operations and high-quality delivery of complex software and platform initiatives. • Build, lead, and mentor a diverse, high-caliber engineering organization, including managers and senior engineers, providing continuous coaching, feedback, and career development support. • Collaborate with product, architecture, and business partners to prioritize work, set goals, and ensure technology solutions and APIs are designed, built, and maintained to high quality standards. • Refine engineering practices, promote Agile and modern delivery methodologies, and define processes that drive operational excellence, observability, and system reliability. • Provide clear, executive-ready communication on engineering progress, risks, and investment needs, serving as a trusted partner to senior technology and business leaders. • Demonstrate care and compassion by being present, building trust, and creating an inclusive environment where Disney values are experienced and everyone’s voice is heard. What we need from you to be part of this story: · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a closely related field. · Advanced level of English (must). · Minimum 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience with 3+ years in management, leading software and solution engineering teams. · Strong strategic thinking and ability to envision and articulate future technology possibilities for corporate platforms and services. · Proven experience planning and prioritizing complex engineering work across multiple teams, aligning delivery with organizational goals. · Demonstrated collaboration skills, with the ability to build partnerships and work effectively with product, architecture, and business stakeholders. · Leadership capability in managing larger teams of professional employees, including first-line leaders and senior individual contributors, with a focus on mentorship and performance management. · Experience driving engineering excellence in areas such as API and service development, platform stability, and quality standards. · Effective executive written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical topics to varied audiences. · Ability to refine engineering practices and promote Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) to improve delivery and reliability. · Experience delivering platform services or APIs using modern, cloud-native and open-source technologies (plus). · Background in large-scale, high-volume systems and components, ideally within a Fortune 100 or similarly complex organization (plus). · Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (such as TOGAF) and the interaction between solution architecture and platform engineering (plus). · Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline (plus). Additional Information: At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas. “You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney Disclaimer This position is with TWDC Argentina S.A., which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (Corporate). Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Description Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. The Observability & Insights group ensures that Disney Streaming’s distributed systems are reliable, performant, and transparent. We build the telemetry, dashboards, alerting, insights pipelines, and developer experience tooling that enable engineers across the organization to understand system health and take action quickly. Job Summary: As a Senior Software Engineer (P3), you will lead the design and implementation of intelligent, AI-driven systems that safeguard the reliability and performance of Disney’s global streaming ecosystem. You will be a technical leader in developing agentic systems, complex machine learning models, and high-throughput real-time pipelines that transform massive telemetry and log datasets into automated detection, root cause analysis, and proactive insights. In this role, you will own the architectural vision for autonomous agents capable of reasoning over complex system behaviors across Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN. You will act as a bridge between engineering, product, and platform teams, translating high-level business needs into scalable AI solutions that reduce operational overhead. As a P3 engineer, you are expected to deliver mission-critical features, mentor junior engineers, and drive engineering excellence through rigorous design reviews and high-quality, production-ready code in a fast-paced, AI-native environment. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Own the design and operation of production-grade, intelligent systems leveraging real-time signals and AI-driven detection to ensure the health of critical services and premium customer experiences. Lead the development of agentic AI systems powered by modern foundation models (e.g., Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT-4). You will define the strategy for automated reasoning, decisioning, and predictive modeling for global-scale system reliability. Oversee the creation of end-to-end data pipelines that process high-volume telemetry and user signals into actionable, automated insights and root cause analysis. Design and maintain scalable APIs and microservices that provide explainability and predictive signals to cross-functional engineering and product stakeholders. Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to embed intelligence into global workflows (incident response, release validation), significantly reducing Time-to-Detect (TTD) and Time-to-Resolve (TTR). Promote engineering best practices, provide technical guidance through code and design reviews, and drive innovation in observability and developer productivity through applied AI. Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Basic Qualifications 5+ years of applicable experience in backend development, with a proven track record of building and scaling AI-powered or data-driven applications. Advanced proficiency with modern models (GPT-4/o1, Claude Opus/Sonnet, Bedrock), including deep experience in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and building complex agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience deploying and monitoring ML systems (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and large-scale data processing (PySpark, Pandas) in production environments. Strong experience with AWS ecosystem and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) at scale. Proven ability to lead technical projects, mentor junior talent, and champion software development best practices (Git, CI/CD, Agile). Expert level use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to accelerate team velocity and maintain high code quality. Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and explain complex AI/technical concepts to both technical and non-technical partners. Preferred Qualifications Experience implementing observability and monitoring systems for high-volume, low-latency production environments. Experience with modern databases and observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, Conviva, MongoDB) handling billions of events. Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design patterns. Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms organization within Disney Entertainment and ESPN Technology is fully responsible for building, enhancing and maintaining high-performance, distributed, microservice-based Advertising Platform across all of Disney online properties, including Hulu and ESPN+. We build and maintain proprietary technology, ranging from ad serving and ad delivery, campaign management, reporting as well as all the integrations internal and external that come with evolving and maintaining a best-in-class video advertising business. Our mission is to advance AI and machine learning capabilities across Ad Platform by delivering scalable, high impact AI/ML and data science solutions that enhance various aspects of ad serving. We are seeking a Senior Manager Machine Learning to join this innovative team. This role offers a unique leadership opportunity for an experienced ML/AI and people leader who thrives at the intersection of technical excellence, strategic impact, and cross-functional collaboration. Job Summary: You will apply your battle-tested experience, deep technical knowledge of software and systems including Machine Learning and AI technologies, and leadership skills to unblock and guide our ML/AI team members to design and build scalable, performant, maintainable, and testable models and pipelines in various domains using industry best practices which are aligned in close collaboration with the ML team in the US highlighting cross-functional collaboration. Daily, you should bring: A willingness and desire to effectively communicate and collaborate across teams and systems on architecture, design, and implementation. A passion for mentoring, learning, and taking on new challenges. A proven ability to work with product teams to translate requirements into well-defined technical implementations, as well as the ability to define technical and operational metrics to measure system health. A keen eye for potential optimizations and enhancements. Kindness and pragmatic optimism. A deep understanding of model development cycles and AI tool usage Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Lead, mentor and guide Data Scientists, Machine Learning and AI engineers to build solutions adhering to industry best practices and deliver scalable solutions including model architecture and algorithm selection. Lead by example and always strive to improve the design for more scalable, cleaner, and decoupled implementations. Drive adoption of best practices in model development, code quality, testing, and documentation. Solid understanding and usage of automated tools (AI) while adhering to company policy. Define strategic direction for machine learning projects and collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders. Oversee end-2-end machine learning workflow, including data collection, model development, deployment and modeling. These are expected to be aligned with the larger platform strategy and tools in collaboration with the global teams to stay consistent across Ad Platforms. Foster innovation by exploring new ML techniques, tools, and technologies. Communicate strategies, progress, and results to leadership and cross-functional teams. Ensure responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, and compliance with privacy and ethical standards. Develop partnerships across the organization to identify and prioritize high-impact ML opportunities. Available for On-Call rotations based on the team’s escalation policy and support schedule for ML/AI solutions Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. 8+ years of relevant industry experience, with at least 2-3 years in a people-management or technical leadership role. Proven ability to translate business problems into scalable ML and GenAI solutions and strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, deep learning, and statistical modeling. Proven experience designing, building, and deploying scalable machine learning models and systems in production. Experience deploying ML/GenAI systems at scale using cloud platforms and MLOps practices Advanced programming proficiency (e.g., Python, Java, or similar); experience with ML/DL frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face). Experience building, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, prompt engineering, model optimization) Demonstrated ability to lead global teams and collaborate across organizational boundaries. Preferred Qualifications: Domain knowledge in the Ad Tech industry Experience working with large-scale data and distributed systems. Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and MLOps pipelines. Track record of innovation and contributions to the ML/AI community (publications, talks, open source). #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Seattle, WA is $182,400 to $244,600 per year and in Santa Monica, CA is $174,100 to $233,500 per year. job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager, Ad Platforms
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager, Ad Platforms Job ID 10165415 Location Seattle, Washington, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 17, 2026 Senior Machine Learning Engineering Manager, Ad Platforms Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms organization within Disney Entertainment and ESPN Technology is fully responsible for building, enhancing and maintaining high-performance, distributed, microservice-based Advertising Platform across all of Disney online properties, including Hulu and ESPN+. We build and maintain proprietary technology, ranging from ad serving and ad delivery, campaign management, reporting as well as all the integrations internal and external that come with evolving and maintaining a best-in-class video advertising business. Our mission is to advance AI and machine learning capabilities across Ad Platform by delivering scalable, high impact AI/ML and data science solutions that enhance various aspects of ad serving. We are seeking a Senior Manager Machine Learning to join this innovative team. This role offers a unique leadership opportunity for an experienced ML/AI and people leader who thrives at the intersection of technical excellence, strategic impact, and cross-functional collaboration. Job Summary: You will apply your battle-tested experience, deep technical knowledge of software and systems including Machine Learning and AI technologies, and leadership skills to unblock and guide our ML/AI team members to design and build scalable, performant, maintainable, and testable models and pipelines in various domains using industry best practices which are aligned in close collaboration with the ML team in the US highlighting cross-functional collaboration. Daily, you should bring: A willingness and desire to effectively communicate and collaborate across teams and systems on architecture, design, and implementation. A passion for mentoring, learning, and taking on new challenges. A proven ability to work with product teams to translate requirements into well-defined technical implementations, as well as the ability to define technical and operational metrics to measure system health. A keen eye for potential optimizations and enhancements. Kindness and pragmatic optimism. A deep understanding of model development cycles and AI tool usage Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Lead, mentor and guide senior individual contributors and managers across data scientists, machine learning and AI engineers teams to build solutions adhering to industry best practices and deliver scalable solutions including model architecture and algorithm selection. Define strategic direction for machine learning projects and collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders. Lead by example and always strive to improve the design for more scalable, cleaner, and decoupled implementations. Drive adoption of best practices in model development, code quality, testing, and documentation. Solid understanding and usage of automated tools (AI) while adhering to company policy. Oversee end-2-end machine learning workflow, including data collection, model development, deployment and modeling. These are expected to be aligned with the larger platform strategy and tools in collaboration with the global teams to stay consistent across Ad Platforms. Foster innovation by exploring new ML techniques, tools, and technologies. Communicate strategies, progress, and results to leadership and cross-functional teams. Ensure responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, and compliance with privacy and ethical standards. Develop partnerships across the organization to identify and prioritize high-impact ML opportunities. Available for On-Call rotations based on the team’s escalation policy and support schedule for ML/AI solutions Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. 10+ years of relevant industry experience, with at least 5 years in people-management managing senior ICs and managers. Proven ability to translate business problems into scalable ML and GenAI solutions and strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, deep learning, and statistical modeling. Proven experience designing, building, and deploying scalable machine learning models and systems in production. Experience deploying ML/GenAI systems at scale using cloud platforms and MLOps practices Advanced programming proficiency (e.g., Python, Java, or similar); experience with ML/DL frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face). Experience building, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, prompt engineering, model optimization) Demonstrated ability to lead global teams and collaborate across organizational boundaries. Preferred Qualifications: Domain knowledge in the Ad Tech industry Experience working with large-scale data and distributed systems. Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and MLOps pipelines. Track record of innovation and contributions to the ML/AI community (publications, talks, open source). #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Seattle, WA is $220,600 to $295,900 per year and in Santa Monica, CA is $210,500 to $282,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Explore this Location Seattle, WA With a thriving food-and-drink scene, eclectic neighborhoods and a stunning coastal setting, Seattle is a dynamic urban enclave nestled in the Pacific Northwest. The city is bounded by Lake Washington in the east and Puget Sound to the west, an ideal location for water recreation and sight-seeing cruises. Your makeup artistry and hairstyling skills guarantee that you can make anyone feel confident in their skin. You will be a member of a team of artists responsible for preparing Fox News anchors, reporters, and contributors to appear on national television. job.title: VP, Hospitality
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is launching a new premium membership business and is hiring a Vice President, Hospitality who will lead the delivery of exceptional, high-touch hospitality and member experiences across Red Seat Ventures' portfolio of premium live entertainment events. This leader will oversee all aspects of event hospitality, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event feedback, ensuring consistent execution of the company's premium service standards across multiple markets.

With primary responsibility for event hospitality operations, the VP will establish the operating models, processes, procedures, and staffing strategies needed to deliver seamless, scalable experiences. This includes overseeing the recruitment, training, scheduling, and development of Suite Hosts, managing venue and hospitality partnerships, and owning the P&L associated with delivering exceptional event experiences.

The VP will also oversee the Member Experience function through a Director, Member Experience, ensuring the team delivers personalized member service, builds strong relationships, and maintains consistent communication and service standards throughout the membership lifecycle. This leader will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to support member satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

This is a highly operational leadership role ideal for an experienced, multi-market hospitality executive who knows how to translate an elevated service vision into repeatable, scalable execution while building and leading high-performing teams.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end hospitality experience at events, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event follow-up, ensuring exceptional service across all markets.
  • Translate the company's hospitality vision into scalable operating standards, processes, procedures, and playbooks that drive consistent execution across events, venues, and markets.
  • Oversee all operational elements of event hospitality, including venue coordination, seating layouts, food and beverage, guest flow, and onsite service delivery.
  • Develop and execute event staffing strategies, including recruiting, training, scheduling, managing, and developing a high-performing team of Suite Hosts across multiple markets.
  • Establish policies, procedures, and escalation protocols for anticipating and resolving event-related issues, ensuring teams are equipped to deliver seamless experiences and respond professionally to member needs.
  • Partner with internal teams, venues, vendors, and hospitality partners to ensure operational readiness, consistent service standards, and exceptional event execution.
  • Own the P&L for event hospitality operations, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, and cost control, balancing premium service delivery with financial discipline.
  • Oversee the Director, Member Experience, providing leadership and strategic direction for the Member Experience team and ensuring consistent service standards, communication protocols, and member relationship management.
  • Build and scale the hospitality and member experience functions as the business grows, developing leadership talent, strengthening operational processes, and ensuring a consistent, premium experience across all markets.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Extensive experience leading complex, multi-location hospitality, event, or guest-service operations, with a demonstrated track record of delivering consistent, high-quality execution across multiple markets.
  • Proven experience building, managing, and developing large hourly or frontline hospitality teams, including recruiting, training, scheduling, performance management, and leadership development.
  • Strong operational leadership skills, with the ability to translate premium service standards into scalable processes, training programs, playbooks, and measurable operating practices.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership and financial acumen, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, cost control, and balancing exceptional service with financial discipline.
  • Experience overseeing high-touch guest or member experiences, with an understanding of how exceptional hospitality, personalized service, and consistent execution contribute to member satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Proven ability to lead managers and cross-functional teams across multiple markets, establishing accountability, service consistency, and operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across markets and maintain a hands-on leadership presence during events, particularly as the business and teams scale.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience delivering high-touch guest experiences within luxury hotels, private clubs, premium hospitality, or other membership-based environments.
  • Experience opening, launching, or scaling hospitality operations across multiple locations or markets.
  • Background working with premium live events, sports, entertainment, or venue-based hospitality.
  • Experience overseeing membership services, guest relations, or customer experience teams responsible for building long-term relationships and driving satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Familiarity with workforce management, scheduling, and labor-planning platforms used to manage distributed hourly teams.
  • Experience working in startup environments or new business incubation teams where operating models, processes, and teams are being built from the ground up.

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
FOX 5 Atlanta (WAGA-TV), the FOX-owned and operated station in Atlanta, GA, is seeking a dynamic, experienced, and authoritative Anchor to join our News team. Reporting to the Vice President, News Director, the Anchor gathers, prepares, writes, and presents news and information across both traditional broadcast and live streaming platforms. This is an on-site, full-time position working a Monday through Friday schedule at our Atlanta studio, with flexibility required to support breaking news and evolving broadcast priorities.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Present news and information on broadcast and live streaming platforms from the studio, in the newsroom, and in the field.
  • Collaborate with Executive Producers and Producers to plan and deliver news content across broadcast and live streaming platforms.
  • Present extended blocks of news content on the station’s live stream in a conversational style without reliance on full scripts.
  • Use interactive tools to promote audience engagement and participation in news content on broadcast and live streaming platforms.
  • Utilize real-time audience data to shape editorial decision-making for broadcast and live stream news content.
  • Plan, arrange, and conduct long-form interviews, both live and recorded, for inclusion in broadcast and live streaming news content.
  • Assume final responsibility for the content and presentation of news stories on broadcast and live streaming.
  • Collaborate with newsroom managers and newscast producers to maintain strong editorial standards across all platforms.
  • Maintain a strong presence on social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, X, and others.
  • Establish and develop contacts with newsmakers, cultivate news sources, and build strong bonds within the community.
  • Make frequent appearances at civic functions, station promotions, and other community outreach events.
  • Establish and maintain a leadership role within the newsroom and the station.
  • Maintain operational agility by performing other duties as required to support evolving business priorities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Five (5) years of experience as a news anchor at a commercial television station.
  • Highly skilled in on-camera performance, reading scripted news copy clearly, and ad-libbing effectively for extended periods.
  • Skilled in writing conversational broadcast copy incorporating appropriate visual elements under daily deadline pressure.
  • Proficiency with newsroom and broadcast production systems/tools, including iNews (or similar NRCS), BitCentral (or similar video production system), LiveU / LU-Smart (or similar live broadcast smartphone apps), Chyron Live Assist Panel, Megaphone, and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong ability to prioritize tasks and perform effectively under strict daily deadline pressure.
  • Proficient in English grammar, spelling, and punctuation.
  • Must communicate clearly and deal effectively and politely with the public in person and over the phone.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule as needed for news coverage.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university in Journalism, Broadcast Communications, or a related field.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This role operates primarily on-site in a fast-paced television studio and newsroom environment, with occasional field reporting and community event appearances. While the core schedule is Monday through Friday, the position requires schedule flexibility to accommodate breaking news, special coverage, evenings, weekends, or holidays as needed.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, and frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands and fingers, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, or crouch, and must be able to lift and/or carry up to 25 pounds.
