job.title: News Reporter/Anchor
job.description:
The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Reporter/Anchor for our evening news block. The person chosen for this role will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

You’ll focus on reporting big news of the day, adding depth and context to stories in our newly formatted early evening news block from 5:00-6:30pm. Then you’ll transition to our redesigned newsroom, where you’ll anchor 90 minutes of live, unscripted news, while operating our Tricaster switcher. You’ll end your day, anchoring our 10pm linear news broadcast from our primary studio.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital-first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless of format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter.  We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have an insatiable curiosity about the world around you, from local and state government and how decisions by elected officials impact our audience to a daily understanding of what’s happening globally and the ability to take complex subjects and make them compelling and relatable.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have a relentless commitment to accuracy in your reporting, whether scripted or unscripted. You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.  Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background. 

We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

WORK OPTION

In Office _________________ This is a temporary position with an expected duration not to exceed (10) months.

Position Summary

As a Broadcasting Assistant, you will play a pivotal role as a liaison between the Broadcast Operations Center, Replay Center, television partners and NBA, WNBA and G League representatives on a nightly basis. NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC News is seeking a seasoned, driven Producer to support newsgathering, storytelling, and live production across all platforms. This role will work closely with a Correspondent and production teams to pitch, develop, report, and execute compelling journalism—from breaking news to in-depth features, investigative reporting to national coverage.

The ideal candidate is a creative journalist with sharp editorial judgment, strong writing and research skills, and the confidence to thrive under pressure. This producer should be equally at home in the field, on location, or in the control room, and adept at delivering both live and taped segments that meet NBC’s highest editorial standards. The ideal candidate is a news junkie who can’t wait to get out the door and, on the road, to cover that next story. This producer should also enjoy storytelling for morning television, an evening newscast and everything in between. The ability to shoot and edit is a plus, along with a sense of what does well on social media or in vertical video formats.

This role is right for you if you’re a versatile storyteller who thrives on urgency and impact. You move seamlessly between producing, reporting, and writing, and you’re as comfortable leading coverage during breaking news as you are crafting enterprise stories. You’re highly organized, competitive, and relentless about accuracy and detail—yet collaborative, adaptable, and energized by working with correspondents and teams under tight deadlines. Most importantly, you’re passionate about journalism that informs, engages, and makes a difference.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Correspondent and show teams to develop, report, and deliver strong, visually compelling stories with clear narratives and well-researched journalism.
  • Pitch, field produce, write, and fact-check stories across NBC News linear and streaming platforms, including daily news, longform pieces, and cross-platform content.
  • Conduct original reporting, deep research, and source interviews.
  • Secure guest bookings in a competitive environment; conduct pre-interviews and prepare talking points.
  • Ability to travel at a moment’s notice to cover a story and commit to staying on the road as long as the story takes.
  • Collaborate with control rooms, senior producers, and editorial teams to build rundowns, write intros, and produce live and taped segments.
  • Oversee field operations, including live shots, remote anchor setups, and breaking news coverage.
  • Track and manage correspondent’s schedule when working with them closely. 
  • Work closely with editors to ensure high-quality video packages, graphics, and sound.
  • Partner with Standards & Legal to ensure all content adheres to editorial and corporate guidelines.
  • Maintain strong communication between the Correspondent, senior leadership, assignment desk and production teams.
  • Contribute ideas for a wide range of content including news-of-day, lifestyle features, celebrity interviews, and human-interest stories.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in network news, cable, or talk show production, including live and taped segments.
  • Strong journalistic writing, research, and editorial judgment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of U.S. politics, current events, pop culture, and lifestyle trends.
  • Experience shooting (DSLR or iPhone) and editing (Avid and/or Adobe Premiere).
  • Strong ability to navigate newsroom tools and technology (Slack, NCX, Latakoo, etc.)
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments under tight deadlines.
  • Must be willing to work nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime with short notice.
  • Must be able to travel frequently, domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; ability to collaborate across teams.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong storytelling ability with creativity in pitching original ideas.
  • Experience working with live programming.
  • Cool under pressure and comfortable managing breaking news situations.
  • A self-starter with strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Knowledge of NBC News Policies, Guidelines, and Practices.

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, based in Dallas, TX, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. This role will report to Miami bureau leadership.

This position is eligible for company-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: 95,000 - 135,000

Position Overview:

As part of the Peacock Data Science team, the Lead Data Scientist will be responsible for creating recommendation and personalization solutions for one or more verticals of Peacock Video Streaming Service.

You’ll collaborate with an international, cross-functional team of engineers, architects, product managers and analysts to identify and prioritize enhancements to Peacock’s personalization models. Your responsibilities will touch everything from feature creation to model development, evaluation, and deployment, and you’ll have opportunities to work on cutting edge machine learning like foundation models and reinforcement learning.

 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.
  • Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture.
  • Drive innovation of the statistical and machine learning methodologies and tools used by the team.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+years of experience in machine learning, data science, or applied research.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, training, tuning, and evaluating deep learning models.
  • Experience building models for commercial recommender systems, personalization, or ranking systems.
  • Strong Python skills with an understanding of computational complexity.
  • Experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
  • Experience taking ML/deep learning models from experimentation through production deployment.
  • Experience with SQL and PySpark for large-scale data processing.
  • Experience with foundation models and Generative AI technologies.
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience in media analytics and application of data science to the content streaming and TV industry.
  • Good understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and graph methodologies.
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, and Databricks (or equivalent).
  • Experience with large-scale video assets.
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools.

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development, project management, and day-to-day operations of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From program development to product management to sales operations, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

The Audience Sr. Product Manager will own the vision, roadmap, and execution of NBCUniversal's audience platform, the products advertisers and internal teams use to build, enrich, forecast, and activate audiences across NBCU's linear, streaming, and digital inventory. This role partners closely with data science, engineering, sales, ad operations, and privacy teams to turn first-party, partner, and third-party data into high-performing, privacy-safe audience segments. The PM will balance scale, accuracy, and ease of use while driving adoption across planning, sales, clean room collaboration, and campaign activation workflows. Success in this role requires deep product judgment at the intersection of audience data, advertiser needs, and media buying and selling workflows.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and day-to-day prioritization of NBCU's audience products, including segment creation, audience discovery, enrichment, and activation tools, balancing new capabilities, platform health, and user needs.
  • Define and evolve NBCU's audience taxonomy and segment strategy across first-party, partner, and third-party data sources, ensuring segments are discoverable, consistent, and valuable for advertisers.
  • Drive the roadmap for audience modeling capabilities, such as lookalike, propensity, and custom advertiser segments, in partnership with data science to improve scale, accuracy, and campaign performance.

job.description:

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de plateformes de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences partout dans le monde. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier ordre par l’entremise de nos importants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision internationaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur notre volonté d’améliorer les communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au service de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

We’re looking for a Producer for an exciting interactive entertainment project to support the creation, tracking, and execution of game assets for a discipline (environment, characters, audio, animation). In this role, you will help teams stay organized by maintaining asset schedules, tracking progress, coordinating priorities, following up on dependencies, and supporting milestone delivery.

You will work closely with craft directors, producers, pod leads, and multidisciplinary teams to define execution strategy of asset production from request through review, approval, integration, and delivery. You will help ensure creative and technical asset goals are translated into clear tasks, visible progress, and reliable execution across disciplines, pods, and pillars.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Formalize asset creation workflows and determine requirements for asset management.
  • Oversee, build and/or maintain asset schedules, task lists, production plans, and milestone deliverables.
  • Track daily progress across assigned teams and ensure asset status is accurate in project tools.
  • Maintain visibility on blockers, dependencies, approvals, reviews, known issues, and next steps.
  • Coordinate priorities between craft directors, product owners, producers, pod leads, and pillar needs.
  • Support asset reviews, feedback sessions, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, or priority conflicts and escalate them to producers or production leadership.
  • Facilitate communication between design, engineering, art, animation, audio, QA, and other departments.
  • Help maintain production tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
  • Work with QA and development teams to ensure asset-related issues are tracked and followed up effectively.
  • Support milestone readiness by helping ensure asset deliverables, dependencies, reviews, and known issues are clearly tracked.
  • Help refine asset workflows, pipelines, tracking practices, and communication habits.
  • Contribute to retrospectives or post-milestone reviews and follow through on actionable improvements.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste de producteur ou productrice dans le cadre d’un projet captivant de divertissement interactif, afin de soutenir la création, le suivi et l’exécution des éléments de jeu pour une discipline (environnements, personnages, audio, animation). Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez les équipes à rester organisées en tenant à jour les calendriers de production des éléments, en assurant le suivi de l’avancement, en coordonnant les priorités, en effectuant le suivi des dépendances et en soutenant la livraison des jalons.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de disciplines, les producteurs et productrices, les responsables de pods et les équipes multidisciplinaires afin de définir la stratégie d’exécution de la production des éléments, depuis la demande jusqu’à la révision, l’approbation, l’intégration et la livraison. Vous contribuerez à faire en sorte que les objectifs créatifs et techniques liés aux éléments soient traduits en tâches claires, en progrès visibles et en une exécution fiable dans l’ensemble des disciplines, des pods et des piliers.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Formaliser les flux de travail liés à la création des éléments et déterminer les exigences en matière de gestion des éléments.
  • Superviser, élaborer et/ou tenir à jour les calendriers de production des éléments, les listes de tâches, les plans de production et les livrables associés aux jalons.
  • Assurer le suivi quotidien de l’avancement des équipes assignées et veiller à ce que le statut des éléments soit exact dans les outils de gestion de projet.
  • Maintenir une visibilité claire sur les obstacles, les dépendances, les approbations, les révisions, les problèmes connus et les prochaines étapes.
  • Coordonner les priorités entre les responsables de disciplines, les responsables de produits, les producteurs et productrices, les responsables de pods et les besoins des différents piliers.
  • Soutenir les révisions des éléments, les séances de rétroaction, les approbations et les mesures de suivi.
  • Repérer les risques, les obstacles ou les conflits de priorités et les signaler aux producteurs et productrices ou à la direction de la production.
  • Faciliter la communication entre les équipes de design, d’ingénierie, d’art, d’animation, d’audio, de QA et les autres services.
  • Contribuer à la tenue à jour des outils de suivi de production tels que Jira, Confluence ou des outils similaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de QA et de développement afin de veiller à ce que les problèmes liés aux éléments soient consignés et fassent l’objet d’un suivi efficace.
  • Soutenir la préparation des jalons en contribuant à assurer un suivi clair des livrables liés aux éléments, des dépendances, des révisions et des problèmes connus.
  • Contribuer à améliorer les flux de travail, les pipelines, les pratiques de suivi et les habitudes de communication liés aux éléments.
  • Contribuer aux rétrospectives ou aux revues post-jalon et assurer le suivi des améliorations pouvant être mises en œuvre.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 8+ years of experience in game production, asset coordination, project coordination, external development coordination, or related production roles.
  • Experience supporting content teams, asset production, or a related production role for a specific discipline.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to track multiple assets, tasks, dependencies, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Strong communication and follow-up skills.
  • Comfortable working with creative and technical teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Ability to clarify next steps, maintain visibility, and keep information organized.
  • Proactive mindset with a willingness to solve problems and remove friction.
  • Experience using JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Interest in AAA game development, asset production, and content pipelines.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment with professionalism and adaptability.

Exigences de base : 

  • 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en production de jeux, en coordination d’éléments, en coordination de projets, en coordination du développement externe ou dans des rôles connexes en production.
  • Expérience dans le soutien d’équipes de contenu, la production d’éléments ou un rôle connexe en production pour une discipline précise.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et grand souci du détail.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi de multiples éléments, tâches, dépendances, priorités et échéances.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en suivi.
  • Aisance à travailler avec des équipes créatives et techniques dans plusieurs disciplines.
  • Capacité à clarifier les prochaines étapes, à maintenir une bonne visibilité sur l’avancement et à garder l’information organisée.
  • Esprit proactif et volonté de résoudre les problèmes et d’éliminer les obstacles.
  • Expérience avec JIRA ou des outils de gestion de projet similaires.
  • Intérêt pour le développement de jeux AAA, la production d’éléments et les pipelines de contenu.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution, avec professionnalisme et adaptabilité.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience with asset pipelines, review cycles, approvals, dependencies, and delivery tracking.
  • Experience with production tracking, asset lists, delivery reporting, or milestone planning.
  • Understanding of agile production, sprint planning, backlog tracking, or milestone execution.
  • Experience working with craft directors, pod leads, artists, designers, engineers, or QA teams.
  • Background in a creative production discipline.
  • Experience with tools such as Confluence, Miro, Perforce, Git, or build tracking systems.

Caractéristiques souhaitées :

More Americans watch NBC News than any news organization in the world. NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:
Production

  • TODAY: Work directly with producers on stories/segments, with Production Managers in the control room and green room, log tapes, conduct research on assigned topics.
  • Weekend TODAY: Assist producers with research and gathering content for upcoming segments, compile different news stories to pitch to producers for segments, log and transcribe interviews for producers and record music hit times for music cues.
  • Nightly News: Log video, research for stories, answer newsroom phones, pitch story ideas, daily distribution of rundown/scripts.
  • Weekend Nightly News: Log video, research for stories, answer newsroom phones, pitch story ideas, daily distribution of rundown/scripts.
  • Dateline: Plan for morning editorial/pitch meeting: log shows, build slide decks, research stories. Log b roll, transcripts and help prepare for edit.
  • Specials: Compile research for editorial preparation, compile research packets, select and compile footage & stills for on-air elements, design and manage graphics, print and deliver scripts.
  • Investigative Unit: Researching, filing records requests, analyzing data, organizing media, and assisting on local shoots.
  • Booking Unit: Assist the team with guest research and upcoming events, manage lists/pitch packets, support the team with in-studio guests/shoots.
  • Business Technology & Innovation Unit: Assist digital, television, and investigative teams with research, newsgathering, and story production, monitor news outlets for breaking news, pitch enterprise news stories.
  • Climate/Weather Unit: Forecast research, WSI Tru Vu Max graphic creation and updating, researching and presenting information on Climate change and Climate solutions.
  • Network Desk: Assist during breaking news by making calls to relevant sources, by listening to radio traffic by EMS or local police, by logging press conferences and by checking social media postings from witnesses and others. Assist w/the logistics of sending NBC News teams (correspondents, producers, crews, engineers, etc) to cover the news on location.
  • Audio Unit: Here’s the Scoop is NBC’s flagship daily news podcast. The Intern will get exposure to all aspects of daily audio and video production, from researching and booking, to writing headlines and interview scripts, studio recording to audio/video editing, postproduction for audio/video platforms and social media.
  • NBC News Now: Research and fact check stories, assist in editing video and graphics, pitch stories for daily and future segments, mine and edit video and sound.

Commerce

  • NBC Selected: Building articles in our CMS, tracking editorial workflow, helping shape new copy flows and more. You will also have the opportunity to write new e-commerce content for the site, as well as update existing content.

Editorial

  • Digital Documentary: Assisting in pre- and post-production including research, gathering, and cataloguing material from NBC archives. You will also be pitching stories and assisting in story development.
  • Digital Platforms: Marketing promotion plans and alerts for top stories. You will be writing different variations of headlines for stories to optimize click-through rate and engagement.
  • Digital Culture & Trends: Writing and reporting stories on pop culture, entertainment, internet trends and lifestyle news. You’ll work alongside reporters and editors to pitch and write stories for NBCNews.com, contribute to breaking news coverage and help cover major pop culture events.
  • Digital Health & Medical: Reporting and writing timely, in-depth original features on a wide range of health topics for the website. The intern will be interviewing experts about medical studies, pitching story ideas, and identifying trends in lifestyle and wellness, including nutrition and women’s and men’s health.
  • Today.com: Assisting editors across TODAY.com’s news/trending and lifestyle teams, and writing for sections including Pop Culture, Health, Food, Parents, Style and TMRW.

Social

  • Social Newsgathering: Using digital platforms to find user-generated content, verify social media-sourced content, interview sources and obtain information for the network's coverage. You will be covering a range of stories from breaking news to investigations and feature topics.
  • NBC News Social, TODAY Social: Helping drive social media production and publication to multiple social media accounts. You will be writing headlines, editing video and graphics, and distributing content across social media platforms.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.

  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: SAMMA Digitizer
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS Evening News, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Project Overview

The CBS News & Stations archive is one of the world’s largest and most valuable collections of its kind. Housing millions of original assets dating back to before the 1950s, it represents an extraordinary record of American history, journalism, culture, and broadcast media.

 

CBS News & Stations has launched a major initiative to digitize, catalog, and enrich more than 3 million film reels, videotapes, and audio reels. This initiative includes one of the largest robotic tape digitization operations in existence, paired with cloud-based systems and AI-supported metadata workflows operating at significant scale.

 

SAMMA is CBS News Archives’ robotic tape digitization system. It is used to migrate legacy videotape formats into digital files as part of the broader preservation and access initiative.

 

Position Summary

CBS News Archives is seeking SAMMA Digitization Operators to support this large-scale archive digitization initiative. These roles are part of the end-to-end digitization workflow, with an initial emphasis on preparing archival videotape media for migration through SAMMA digitization systems.

 

Primary responsibilities will initially include tape preparation, barcode application, tape identification, metadata entry, sorting, staging, workflow tracking, and ensuring a steady supply of prepared tapes for digitization. As operational needs evolve and training progresses, SAMMA Digitization Operators may also be assigned to operate SAMMA digitization systems, monitor ingest workflows, troubleshoot routine workflow issues, perform quality-control checks, and support related archive digitization activities, including film preparation and film digitization workflows.

 

The ideal candidates are detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable following specific workflows, and able to work carefully with physical media and metadata entry. Prior experience with broadcast archives, videotape formats, film handling, digitization, media asset management systems, or production operations is helpful, but not required if candidates are organized, trainable, and consistent.

 

Location, Hours, and Compensation

  • These positions are based onsite at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ.
  • Expected schedule is 40 hours per week. Hours may include nights and weekends depending on operational needs.
  • Hourly rate: $26.44 per hour, equivalent to $54,995.20 annually based on a 40-hour workweek.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end archive digitization workflow, with an initial focus on SAMMA tape preparation and staging.
  • Prepare, barcode, label, sort, organize, and stage videotape media for digitization.
  • Enter and verify identifying metadata, including tape IDs, station IDs, dates, and other available information.
  • Follow established workflows for preparing Beta, U-matic, DVCPro, XDCAM, and other legacy videotape formats.
  • Identify and escalate unclear labels, missing metadata, damaged media, equipment concerns, or workflow questions.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of prep, staging, digitization, and workflow status.
  • Support daily production goals by ensuring media is prepared and available for digitization.
  • As trained and assigned, operate SAMMA robotic tape digitization systems and monitor digitization workflows.
  • Perform basic workflow checks and quality-control steps to confirm successful completion of assigned tasks.
  • As trained and assigned, support film preparation and film digitization workflows, including inspection, labeling, documentation, staging, and scanner support.
  • Handle videotape, film, and related archival media carefully to prevent damage or misplacement.
  • Follow all safety, handling, and operational procedures in the archive workspace.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions carefully.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive but detail-sensitive work.
  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and use of web-based tools or spreadsheets.
  • Ability to read handwritten and printed labels and transcribe information accurately.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work independently once trained, while escalating questions when needed.
  • Comfortable handling physical media, boxes, labels, barcode scanners, and digitization-related equipment.
  • Ability to stand, sit, bend, and move throughout the workday as needed.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes of videotapes or film materials, typically up to approximately 25–35 lbs.
  • Availability to work onsite in Metropark/Iselin, NJ, including nights and weekends as operational needs require.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master Global Finance Workflows: Dive into daily invoice processing and payment execution, troubleshooting system errors and keeping transactions running smoothly in top-tier systems like SAP and Oracle.

  • Solve Financial Puzzles: Assist with operational reporting, reconcile vendor statements, and investigate intriguing discrepancies like credit balances or overpayments.

  • Be the Go-To Contact: Communicate professionally with external vendors, internal business partners, and fellow finance teams to resolve everyday queries.

  • Bring Fresh Ideas: Spot bottlenecks and share your own ideas on how we can make our daily workflows smarter and faster.

  • Education: Ongoing university/college studies (or a recent degree) in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Tech Savviness: Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Familiar with SAP or Oracle? Awesome—that’s a plus! Never used them before? No worries, we’ll give you full, structured training from day one.

  • Languages: Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is a must; Hungarian or any other European language is a great bonus.

  • Mindset:

    • A sharp eye for detail, an analytical brain, and genuine curiosity about how global finance works.

    • Strong communication skills and the ability to juggle priorities without breaking a sweat.

    • A proactive, team-player attitude—you enjoy collaborating in an international environment.

  • Availability: Ready to jump in on short notice, commit to 30–40 hours per week, and join the team in our Budapest office 2–3 days a week (preferably Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

What’s in It for You?

  • Resume-Boosting Tech Skills: Comprehensive training and daily hands-on practice with industry-leading ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) in a global corporate setting.

  • True Flexibility: A 30–40 hour schedule designed to fit alongside your studies, backed by a predictable hybrid setup.

  • Mentorship That Matters: A welcoming, down-to-earth team and direct support from your PTP Manager to guide your learning curve.

Job Title: RtR Analyst – Cash & Banking

About the Role Looking to build your accounting career in a fast-paced, global media environment? We are looking for a detail-oriented RtR Analyst – Cash & Banking to join our Budapest GBS Finance team.

As Skydance (formerly Paramount) builds a next-generation global entertainment powerhouse, our finance operations are evolving too. You will join us on an initial 1-year fixed-term contract (with a planned 1-year extension) to support key cash management operations and process standardization projects.   • Own Cash & Bank Operations: Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multi-currency accounts, and investigate and resolve unallocated cash items and open clearing balances.

  • Month-End Close & US GAAP: Prepare and post cash-related journal entries, bank charges, interest postings, and intercompany cash settlements in line with US GAAP/IFRS standards.

  • Drive Automation & Process Improvement: Actively participate in optimizing automated cash-clearing rules in SAP and BlackLine as workflows transition into our GBS model.

  • Partner Across Finance: Liaise directly with Treasury, Accounts Payable (P2P), Accounts Receivable (O2C), and external auditors to resolve operational queries and maintain strong SOX compliance.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on accounting or finance experience (GL, Cash & Banking, AP/AR, or RtR) within an SSC/GBS or multinational environment.

  • Systems & Tools: Practical knowledge of Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS) and experience with an ERP system (SAP is a strong plus). Familiarity with BlackLine is an advantage.

  • Accounting Fundamentals: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, reconciliations, and month-end cut-off processes.

  • Mindset & Language: Proactive, structured problem-solver with high attention to detail, fluent English (B2/C1, written and spoken), and valid, unrestricted Hungarian work authorization (visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this role).

  • Entertainment & Culture: Complimentary annual SkyShowtime and HBO Max subscriptions, exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings, and cross-team social events.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Executive - Sales, the TEGNA-owned affiliate in , is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to 's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 2-4+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

job.description:
About TEGNA

We are looking for a Data Scientist to help build the data science and applied AI capabilities behind TEGNA’s content platform, the systems that turn a high volume of news and media content into insight, enrichment, and better experiences for millions of users. You’ll work with large, messy, text-heavy datasets and use NLP and large language models to turn them into production solutions that make content more discoverable, better organized, and more useful to editorial, product, and audience teams. You’ll be a technical anchor on the team: framing ambiguous business problems as data science problems, setting the bar for rigor in experimentation and evaluation, and mentoring analysts and mid-level data scientists. You’ll partner with engineering and cloud teams on how models and LLM-based services are deployed, monitored, and operated in production.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and evaluate data science solutions that apply NLP and LLMs to content problems such as classification, tagging and taxonomy, entity extraction, summarization, similarity and recommendation, and semantic search.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, and fine-tuning where it is warranted, with a pragmatic eye on cost, latency, and quality.
  • Own evaluation. Define metrics, build benchmark and golden datasets, and run offline and online experiments (including A/B tests) to show that a solution works, and keep checking that it keeps working.
  • Frame ambiguous business and editorial problems as well-defined data science problems, and help convert epics and tech briefs into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Work with engineers to take models and prototypes into production as reliable services, covering monitoring, drift detection, guardrails, and responsible-AI practices such as hallucination, bias, and content-safety controls.
  • Explore, clean, and model large structured and unstructured datasets, and communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Set standards for reproducibility, experiment tracking, code quality, and documentation across the team.
  • Mentor analysts and mid-level data scientists, raising the overall technical maturity of the team.
  • Partner with engineering and cloud teams (who own infrastructure realization, CI/CD, and standards).
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with models or analytical solutions delivered into production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and the core data science stack (pandas, scikit-learn, and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch), plus solid SQL.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and model evaluation, and the judgment to choose the simplest approach that solves the problem.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP (text classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, embeddings, semantic similarity) and with modern transformer-based approaches.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector databases, and evaluating LLM output quality. Experience with Hugging Face or comparable platforms is expected.
  • Experience taking data science work to production in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and an understanding of MLOps fundamentals: versioning, monitoring, reproducibility, and retraining.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain model behavior, limitations, and trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of mentoring others and elevating team practices.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Media, publishing, streaming, or high-traffic content platform experience is a plus.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or Graph-RAG, with Databricks or a managed vector search platform, or with fine-tuning and evaluating open-source LLMs is a plus.

job.description:
About the Role

Marketplace is seeking a Deputy Managing Editor, Video Content to lead video strategy across shows, reporting teams and digital platforms. This role will determine how Marketplace uses video to extend its journalism, grow audiences and develop sustainable revenue opportunities.

The Deputy Managing Editor will lead Marketplace’s YouTube and social video strategy, develop formats and franchises, and use audience and performance insights to guide investment. The role will initially manage the Director of Social Engagement and align social and video work around shared editorial, audience and revenue goals.

Expected Compensation Range: $160,000 - $172,000 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Remote

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead a cohesive video strategy across Marketplace shows, podcasts, reporting teams and platforms.
  • Identify stories, talent and editorial franchises with strong video potential and bring video into planning early.
  • Lead Marketplace’s YouTube and social video strategy, including programming, packaging, discovery and audience retention.
  • Develop distinctive, repeatable video formats and franchises grounded in Marketplace’s business and economic journalism.
  • Use audience research, analytics and performance data to guide programming, distribution and investment decisions.
  • Partner with Marketplace and APM business teams to develop monetization strategies across advertising, sponsorship, platform revenue and partnerships.
  • Evaluate video initiatives against editorial impact, audience growth, engagement and revenue, and recommend when to test, scale or stop.
  • Manage and provide strategic direction to the Director of Social, including goals, feedback, coaching and professional development.
  • Identify the workflows, tools and resources needed to execute a sustainable video strategy and advise leadership on relevant platform and industry changes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Significant professional experience in video, digital media, journalism, audience development or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing YouTube or digital video strategy across teams or products.
  • Experience using audience analytics to guide content, programming and investment decisions.
  • Experience contributing to audience growth and monetization strategies for digital content.
  • Experience managing, coaching or providing strategic direction to staff.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Deep knowledge of YouTube, including programming, packaging, discovery, recommendations and retention.
  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to connect editorial goals, audience growth and revenue opportunity.
  • Strong understanding of video storytelling, production, programming and distribution.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and understanding of journalism and news content.
  • Knowledge of digital video business models, including advertising, sponsorship, platform monetization and partnerships.
  • Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into clear priorities and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead staff and build alignment across editorial, audience and business teams.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience developing video strategy for a journalism, news, financial media or editorial organization.
  • Experience building or significantly growing a YouTube channel or video portfolio.
  • Experience developing repeatable video formats or franchises.
  • Experience collaborating with revenue, sponsorship or business development teams.

Reporting To This Position:

Director of Social, initially.

job.title: Daily news editor
job.description:
The Salem Statesman Journal and Eugene Register-Guard, the leading news organizations in Salem and Eugene, Oregon, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seek an energetic and collaborative editor to oversee breaking news and public safety, trending news and food and drink content.

You will identify and champion breaking news and exclusive storytelling in our markets and across Oregon and help reporters tell stories with speed and context through any medium to inform and inspire the public. You must possess sound skills in using metrics and analytics, social media and online tools to identify trending topics and be able to edit and produce multimedia content. Collaboration and clear communication with other editors, digital producers, and photographers is expected.

Our ideal candidate has a proven record of identifying breaking and trending news, driving engagement and growing audience, and is comfortable leading coverage on topics including public safety, courts and criminal justice, local government, wildfires, extreme weather and news of the day. Excellent news judgment and organizational skills, the ability to supervise quick-turn daily coverage and pivot as news happens is essential. A strong understanding of Oregon public records and open meeting laws as well as the legal system and law enforcement is required.

This editor will be adept at coaching and motivating journalists, helping them refine their reporting and writing, manage their beats and leverage multimedia storytelling to reach audiences wherever they are. Previous experience in government, crime, and public safety coverage is highly valued.

Salem and Eugene are located in the Willamette Valley, famed for its agriculture and hundreds of vineyards and wineries. The cities are situated between the Oregon Coast and Cascade Mountain ranges and are known for their vibrant food and drink scene, arts and culture as well as outdoor recreation and sports.Responsibilities

Lead breaking news and public safety coverage in Salem and support Eugene as news demands.

Develop and oversee trending and service journalism that delivers timely, useful information to diverse audiences in both markets.

Edit food and drink coverage in Salem and Eugene with a focus on utility and service journalism, exclusive stories and multimedia content.

Mentor seasonal interns across beats with a focus on breaking, trending and service journalism and exclusive storytelling.

Drive innovative storytelling in all formats—written, video, audio, and graphics—to enhance multimedia engagement.

Identify and fulfill training needs to support dynamic, multimedia-focused newsrooms.

Supervise simultaneous production of print and digital news products with emphasis on immediacy and relevance.

Collaborate with editors across the USA TODAY Network on best practices and regional multi-site initiatives.

Be available to work evenings and weekends to ensure around-the-clock coverage of critical news developments.

Requirements

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum 5 years of journalism experience, with at least 2 years in newsroom editing and leadership roles.

Command of media law, libel law, open records law, and ethical standards.

Strong planning and organizational skills, and a proven ability to lead teams in delivering urgent, high-impact news coverage.

Expertise in managing multiple tasks and balancing daily news demands with long-term strategic audience growth.

Ability to make complex stories accessible, with a keen sense for identifying and communicating urgent local issues.

Experience in harnessing public records and data to inform coverage and answer community questions.

Advanced storytelling skills with emphasis on multimedia engagement.

Expert knowledge of audience metrics, social media, and SEO principles for maximizing reach and engagement.

Self-motivation and self-direction and ability to adapt to the evolving needs of a modern newsroom.

Mastery of writing, spelling, grammar, AP and local style.

Able to multitask and excel under the pressures of rapid, deadline-driven coverage.

Understanding of the changing media landscape and a strategic approach to audience and market needs.

Strong competitive instincts, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to public service journalism.

Ability to manage and motivate high-performing teams.

Knowledge of Salem, Eugene and Oregon communities is a plus.

job.title: Junior HR Business Partner (Remote)
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

Location: Remote, U.S.

 

Why this role matters:

We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Junior HR Business Partner to support our HR Business Partner team in delivering a high-quality employee and manager experience across AP. Reporting to the HR Director, News, this role will serve as a key partner to HR Business Partners and business leaders, providing HR support on talent, organizational, and workforce matters.

 

What you will do:

Working closely with HRBPs, HR Operations, and other HR specialist teams, the Junior HR Business Partner will support a wide range of employee and manager needs across assigned client groups. This role will provide hands-on HRBP support on both routine activities and contribute to strategic initiatives led by HRBPs, while partnering directly with managers and employees to resolve issues, coordinate HR processes, and ensure effective delivery of HR services.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as support to HRBPs on a variety of requests, providing guidance and support across a range of day-to-day HR topics and escalating more complex matters as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and HR Operations to support managers and employees and ensure smooth coordination and follow-through on requests and cases.
  • Support managers and HRBPs with employee and labor relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary processes, providing guidance within established policies and practices and escalating complex or higher risk matters as appropriate.
  • Help facilitate employee transfers, mobility-related processes, immigration, and other cross-functional HR activities as needed.
  • Partner with the Talent and HRIS teams to understand data as it relates to people and ensure HRBPs and HR specialist teams are connected on people data.
  • Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and operational initiatives that support team effectiveness and employee experience.
  • Help document and improve HR processes and ways of working in partnership with the HR Operations team.

 

Who you are:

This role is ideal for someone currently in an HR Adviser or Generalist role, with an interest in developing as an HR Business Partner in a fast-paced global environment. The successful candidate will have HR generalist experience supporting employees and managers across the U.S and other countries.

 

The Junior HRBP will support across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, employee and labor relations, manager coaching, employee mobility and organisational change, while helping ensure HR policies practices are aligned with local employment requirements and business needs.

 

The successful candidate will be highly organized, solutions-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable managing a variety of operational, tactical and strategic support activities simultaneously.

 

The successful candidate will be

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong critical thinker who is comfortable evaluating complex situations, navigating ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
  • A collaborative and proactive team player who enjoys solving problems and working across teams.
  • A confident communicator with the ability to build strong working relationships with employees, managers, and HR stakeholders, and is comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders and managing up effectively.
  • Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn across both HRBP and HR Operations disciplines.

 

Required:

  • Up to 3 years of HR experience in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Experience supporting managers and employees across day-to-day HR processes and inquiries.
  • Experience supporting employee relations processes, HR policies, and employee lifecycle. 
  • Experience applying HR policies and employment practices across multiple jurisdictions, including recognizing when local requirements or specialist guidance apply.
  • Experience working with HR systems, maintaining and analyzing employee data with accuracy, and using data to inform decision making.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to drive actions and initiatives through to completion and deliver agreed outcomes in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Experience partnering across all HR functions and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

 

What will set you apart:

  • Experience supporting employees and managers in a unionized environment, or an interest in developing experience in labor relations, preferred.
  • Knowledge of SAP and Success Factors preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, is preferred.

 

Why Join Us? 

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.

 

If you are passionate about people, thrive in a collaborative environment and are committed to driving business success, we encourage you to apply.  

 

Salary & Benefits: 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:   

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage   
  • Retirement benefits   
  • Company paid life insurance   
  • Paid vacation and sick days   
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent   
  • Mental well-being resources   

 

Application deadline is November 18, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET.

 

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Producer, Vox Video
job.description:
WHO WE ARE

Vox candidly shepherds audiences through politics and policy, business and pop culture, food, science, and everything else that matters.

Vox is part of Vox Media, the leading modern media company. We guide our audience from discovery to obsession. We inspire essential conversations about what’s now, what’s next, and what’s possible.

As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

THE ROLE

Vox is looking for an experienced producer and on-camera host to join our award-winning video team. You will be part of a team that creates thoughtful, original midform videos, preserving the explanatory DNA that is essential to Vox, while also developing new video formats and series. 

Top candidates will have a professional background in video journalism with exceptional reporting, scripting, and editing skills. The producer will be expected to pitch, develop and host original video explainers on deadline and produce best-in-class video storytelling that Vox has become known for. The ideal candidate will have an established track record of timely, relevant video journalism, as well as a portfolio of on-camera work. 

This person will also be a creative thinker who wants to experiment with new storytelling formats. We want someone who’s not afraid to try new things and learn from them. There are many ways to create an explainer, and the right candidate will bring innovation and fresh ideas to the position. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Pitch, research, report, script, and host original video stories. 
  • Produce timely, relevant midform videos aligned with the news cycle.
  • Shoot and edit videos in-studio and in the field. 
  • Host videos on camera, bringing a natural presence and a distinct voice to the work.
  • Manage every aspect of video production from start to finish, delivering high-quality results efficiently and on deadline. 
  • Manage multiple projects at various stages of production in a fast-paced setting and maintain a pipeline of work; this role will require strong organizational and time-management skills. 
  • Collaborate closely with journalists across the Vox newsroom to turn our journalism into smart, timely videos.
  • Pitch, develop and test new storytelling techniques, formats, and series.
  • Adhere to all journalistic and legal standards at all times.
  • Complete additional duties as assigned.

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for a creative, enthusiastic producer with a passion for Vox’s explanatory mission. You’ll have:

  • 3-5 years of experience in video journalism. 
  • A portfolio of on-camera journalism that brings clarity to the subject and demonstrates an ability to connect with audiences.
  • A passion for Vox’s mission of helping audiences understand what really matters.
  • An established record of deep research, reporting, scripting and high-quality field production.
  • Expert-level understanding of Adobe Suite, with a high-level of expertise in Premiere and knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Familiarity with YouTube video production and publishing, as well as, vertical video editing tools such as Capcut, Descript.
  • Proficiency with studio lighting setups and field shoots
  • Strong communication, organizational and time-management skills, as well as, attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team player who will enjoy working across the organization.

To apply, please submit a cover letter outlining your skills and experience. Include links to three videos that demonstrate your ability to pitch, develop, script, and edit original video stories. At least one video example should prominently feature your on-camera work.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range$81,000—$101,000 USD

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.
