job.title: Sr. Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary

Define and execute quality strategies for BMI’s music rights, copyright, and technology platforms in partnership with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

Deliver functional, automated, API, data, integration, performance, and security testing for cloud applications and complex data workflows. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate QA while independently validating generated output.

Core Responsibilities

Functional & Data Testing

·       Execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and system tests across UI, APIs, backend services, batch processes, and data workflows.

·       Validate music rights, copyright, ownership, and royalty-related data, including works, cues, writers, publishers, shares, territories, agreements.

·       Validate data integrity and transformations across DB2, PostgreSQL, APIs, and downstream systems using SQL.

·       Develop test strategies, plans, cases, scenarios, and test data; reproduce, document, and track defects through resolution.

Test Automation & AI-Assisted QA

·       Build reusable UI, API, and backend automation with Playwright, Cucumber/Gherkin, Selenium WebDriver, REST-based tools, or comparable frameworks.

·       Integrate automated execution, reporting, regression suites, and quality gates into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

·       Use AI for test generation, automation, synthetic data, documentation, defect analysis, and coverage gaps; independently validate generated tests and results.

Cloud, DevOps & Security Testing

·       Test Azure-hosted applications and distributed services; use Azure DevOps for test planning, work items, defects, and release validation.

·       Troubleshoot applications, APIs, databases, cloud services, and test environments using Datadog, logs, metrics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Test OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and authorization, including sign-in, service-to-service access, tokens, roles, and denied-access scenarios.

Performance & Reliability Testing

·       Run performance, load, scalability, and reliability tests with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or equivalent tools across applications, APIs, databases, and workflows.

·       Validate response-time, throughput, concurrency, and reliability targets; isolate performance hot spots with engineering.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience & Technical Qualifications

·       5–8 years of software QA experience, including substantial hands-on functional testing and automation in Agile teams.

·       Strong cloud testing experience, preferably Microsoft Azure, and hands-on Azure DevOps expertise in test management, defects, and CI/CD automation.

·       Experience testing data-intensive applications, APIs, backend services, batch processing, ingestion pipelines, and distributed systems.

·       Hands-on DB2, PostgreSQL, or comparable database experience, with SQL-based validation of complex transformations.

·       Automation with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Cucumber/Gherkin, or comparable frameworks; API testing with Thunder Client or equivalent tools.

·       Performance testing with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or similar tools, particularly for Java services and data-intensive applications.

·       Practical AI-assisted QA experience with independent output validation; familiarity with Datadog or similar diagnostics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Experience testing OAuth 2.0/OIDC and Microsoft Entra ID, including JWT access tokens, client-credentials flows, and role/permission-based access.

Preferred Domain Experience

Music industry technology or data experience is strongly desired, especially music rights, copyright administration, publishing, royalty processing, repertoire, and ownership data.

Skills & Abilities

·       Bridge business validation and technical troubleshooting; design maintainable automation and apply strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy.

·       Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders; work independently and manage quality across concurrent Agile projects.

Location Requirements

This person must be based in the Nashville area. While the position will have flexibility to work remotely, the candidate must be able to come into the office for the duration of their onboarding, as well as at an ongoing basis as needed.

job.title: Host - new daily show
job.description:
Host, New Daily Show

KNKX | Full-time onsite in Tacoma, WA

Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience


About the Opportunity

KNKX has a strong history of creating memorable, award-winning content. From long-form documentaries to deep reporting, the station has always valued creativity and the stories that matter to Western Washington.

Now, KNKX is launching something new: a daily, one-hour news, interview, and storytelling program airing Monday through Friday at 3 PM. The show will cover the news of the day while making space for arts, culture, and the stories that surprise and connect us as a region.


We are hiring two Hosts for this show. This is a rare chance to be a founding voice of a new program at a station that is investing and growing. In a media landscape where newsrooms are contracting, KNKX is creating something, and the right people get to shape what it becomes.


This position is based in KNKX's Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week. This is a SAG-AFTRA union position.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Be a founding voice of a brand-new daily show and help define its identity from day one.
  • Join a collaborative 6-person production team that values ideas from everyone.
  • Work at a station with deep community trust and a signal that reaches from Vancouver, BC to the Oregon border.
  • Fill a real need: this show is part of KNKX's commitment to serving Western Washington with useful, engaging journalism.


The Role

As Host, you will be one of two on-air voices leading this new program. Reporting to the Executive Producer, and working in partnership with your co-host, and a production team, you will help shape the daily editorial direction, conduct interviews, and deliver a show that is warm, sharp, curious, and grounded in the community.


This is not a role where you show up and read what is handed to you. You are part of the producing force. You bring ideas, you pitch stories, you help decide who gets interviewed and what gets covered. You are also the backstop: the last person to touch something before it goes over the air. That means composure under pressure, the ability to pivot when news breaks, and the instinct to follow a conversation wherever it leads.


Key Responsibilities

On-Air Hosting

  • Host a daily, one-hour live news and culture program, managing show flow, timing, and transitions under live-broadcast pressure.
  • Lead 2-4 daily segments ranging from 10- to 20-minute interviews with newsmakers, community leaders, artists, and experts.
  • Pivot when news breaks. Be willing and able to rework the rundown on the fly during a live broadcast.
  • Interact with listeners through call-in segments and participate in live community events.


Segment Production and Editorial Sourcing

  • Write and edit scripts, intros, commentary, and promotional copy to public radio standards.
  • Source interview subjects and segment topics and pitch ideas in daily team meetings.
  • Collaborate with the Digital Editor to adapt on-air content for digital, podcast, and social media formats.


Community Engagement and Ambassadorship

  • Represent KNKX at public panels, live town halls, station events, fund drives, and community gatherings across Western Washington.
  • Engage authentically with listeners across digital, audio, and social channels to build trust and expand audience reach.
  • Take the show on the road through live remotes and community events.


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Experience: 7+ years of live broadcast experience in radio, television, or a comparable live format. We need someone with time in the saddle who has handled breaking news, quick pivots, and the pressure of live programming.
  • Interviewing Instincts: A skilled, curious interviewer who comes prepared but knows when to put the questions down and follow the conversation where it leads. You seek the "why" behind every story.
  • Collaboration: A team player who brings ideas, collaborates with producers, and contributes to the editorial direction of the show. This is not a role for someone who only cracks open the mic.
  • On-Air Presence: Someone warm, genuine, and authoritative. You connect with people across political, ideological, and geographic lines through empathy.
  • Writing: Sharp, concise broadcast writing for intros, commentary, scripts, and promotional copy.
  • Technical Proficiency: Working familiarity with digital audio workstations (e.g., Audition, Pro Tools, Hindenburg).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Location: This position is based in KNKX's Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week. This is a SAG-AFTRA union position.


Sets You Apart

  • Strong understanding of Pacific Northwest political dynamics, regional history, and Western Washington community issues.
  • Prior experience in public media (NPR/PRI/PRX network ecosystem).
  • Experience hosting or moderating live audience events and community panels.
  • A proven track record of sourcing diverse, non-traditional community voices across ideological and geographic boundaries.
  • A flexible, audience-first mindset. You think about what listeners need, not just what is interesting to you.
  • We want hosts who can handle the hard things and still bring joy and a twinkle in the eye.


About Us

At KNKX we work hard to create a culture where employees feel valued and respected, are trusted and encouraged to be a part of improvements that impact their work, create value, and help build trust in public media. KNKX's vision is to grow and become a more inclusive organization that brings joy, meaning, and understanding into people's lives. We value diverse perspectives and an array of life experiences.

KNKX is a Western Washington public media company, dedicated to bringing jazz, blues, regional news, and NPR programs to the Northwest and beyond. As an independent dual-format station, KNKX employees are energized in their mission to provide the very best music and news content to an audience of more than 400,000 weekly.


How to Apply

Apply here: https://knkx.bamboohr.com/careers/67?source=aWQ9NjE%3D

Submit your:

  • Resume
  • Cover letter detailing your connection to the Pacific Northwest and your editorial philosophy
  • Audio reel (3-5 minutes) featuring live interviews or hosting clips


Compensation and Benefits

Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience

KNKX offers a strong benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with FSA option
  • PTO and holidays, including the full week between Christmas and New Year's
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Disability, life, and AD&D insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


Interview Process

  • One-way video interview (4 short questions recorded on your own time)
  • Phone screening with the myHR Partner hiring team
  • Interview with the KNKX hiring committee
  • Recording a test segment with KNKX on-air talent
  • Final onsite interview


Our hiring management partner is myHR Partner. myHR Partner is not a staffing service or recruiter. All resumes/applications will be reviewed for this position and only for our organization.


Thank you for considering us as a potential employer!


Additional Information and Conditions of Employment:

Prior to hire, references and a background check including criminal record history will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant's suitability and competence to perform in the position. This is a SAG-AFTRA represented position. Union membership will be required as a condition of employment, per the terms of the collective bargaining agreement.


KNKX is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex (including gender identity), marital status, sexual orientation, race, creed, color, national origin, veteran or military status, or the presence of any sensory, mental, or physical disability or the use of a trained dog guide or service animal by a person with a disability. You are welcome to include the name and pronoun you would like to be referred to in your materials and we will honor it. Persons requiring accommodation in the application process, during the recruitment process, or who need this job announcement in an alternative format, may contact the Human Resources Office at knkxhr@myhrpartner.com.

job.title: Motion Designer / Video Producer
job.description:
About Macroscope

Macroscope is building the infrastructure for the next generation of software development, where engineers direct fleets of agents, every change is automatically reviewed and verified, and organizations have a clear understanding of how their products and codebases are evolving.

Our mission is to give engineers more leverage and leaders more clarity, so teams can build better software, faster.

Macroscope is founded by former entrepreneurs who have started and sold multiple companies, and operated as product/engineering executives at public tech companies. We're fortunate to be supported by the best VC firms and angels in the business, including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Thrive Capital, Google Ventures, and Adverb.

About the role

We're hiring a Brand & Motion Designer to own how Macroscope shows up in the world. Every week there are new launches that deserve high craft visual concepts and polished videos to broadcast them.

This is a full-time, in-house creative role. You'll own visual marketing assets, motion design, and video production end to end: animated launch videos, short-form video social content, and a creative pipeline that makes it scalable.

You'll work directly with the founders and our growth marketer, with full creative ownership of the craft.

What You'll Do

  • Own all visual marketing output: UI motion graphics, social video, and ad campaign materials.

  • Proactively find stories—understand the product, watch what the team is shipping and turn it into meaningful content, rather than waiting for briefs.

  • Balance high production value launch moments with a scrappy, always-on cadence of social video between them.

  • Build and own our motion pipeline leveraging coding agents and custom design tools to scale visual craft with product velocity.

  • Evolve and maintain our brand across every surface.

  • Own the story end-to-end: Pitch, design, shoot, edit, animate, and publish yourself.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every feature ships with a launch videos that matches the quality of the product.

  • A steady, recognizable cadence of video and motion content that reinforces our visual identity.

  • Stories surface from inside the company because you found them, and brought them to life.

  • The motion asset pipeline is fast and repeatable instead of a bottleneck.

  • The brand feels coherent and unmistakable everywhere it appears.

Who You Are

  • 2+ years in brand, motion, or video design, with a portfolio of shipped work—launch videos, social content, and motion graphics you made yourself.

  • Full-stack creative: comfortable across animation, editing, design tools, and ideally code-driven video like Remotion or similar.

  • A smart storyteller —you can find the narrative in a technical product update and make people actually care in 30 seconds.

  • Experience with developer or technical audiences strongly preferred; you know the difference between content that developers respect and slop they scroll past.

  • Creatively autonomous: scrappy, fast, self-directed, and happy owning everything from concept to publish.

  • You use AI tools throughout your creative workflow, and you're curious about staying up to date with the latest and greatest.

The base pay for the Brand & Motion Designer position ranges from $150k/year to $300k/year. Pay is based on several factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

About you

  • You are extremely high agency. We are a small startup and we intend to keep an extremely flat organizational structure for as long as possible. Instead of relying on people managers, product managers and heavy processes, we rely on exceptionally talented individuals with high agency to be self-motivated towards contributing to our mission.

  • You want to work at an early stage startup. The default state of any startup is failure. The only way to overcome the daunting odds of making a startup venture successful is for a densely packed group of insanely hard working and talented people to work together to build something useful to and loved by customers. If you're not willing to work extremely hard on something high risk, this startup isn't for you.

  • You act like an owner. You put immense care and craft into what you build because you take responsibility for all parts of the product. You don't walk past broken windows.

  • You care about what we're building. Life's too short to work on something you're not passionate about. We are a small group of ambitious people who want to build something insanely great that we want to use, and that we think every company will want to use. If our mission and product don't resonate with you, we understand and would encourage you to find something that does.

job.title: Investigative Reporter/Anchor
job.description:
Investigative Reporter/Anchor

WCYB/WEMT is seeking an experienced, enterprising, and relentless Investigative Reporter/Anchor to join our award-winning news team. We are looking for a journalist who is passionate about uncovering impactful stories, holding those in power accountable, and delivering meaningful journalism that makes a difference in our communities.

The ideal candidate is a skilled investigator and compelling storyteller who thrives on digging deeper, asking tough questions, and pursuing the facts wherever they lead. This role requires a journalist who can develop original investigations, cultivate trusted sources, and present stories with credibility and confidence both in the field and at the anchor desk.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a strong network of sources and community contacts to generate exclusive investigative and enterprise story ideas
  • Research, pitch, and execute impactful investigative and consumer-focused reports across multiple platforms
  • Identify accountability angles within daily news coverage and pursue deeper reporting opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with newsroom leadership, producers, and digital teams to develop investigations from concept through publication and broadcast
  • Utilize public records, data analysis, FOIA requests, and other investigative tools to uncover stories that serve the public interest
  • Write compelling, accurate, and engaging content for broadcast, digital, and social media platforms
  • Anchor assigned newscasts with professionalism, credibility, and strong news judgment
  • Deliver dynamic live reports and breaking news coverage from the field and studio
  • Create digital-exclusive and extended investigative content to maximize audience engagement
  • Maintain an active social media presence to build audience connections, source story ideas, and promote investigative work
  • Represent the station at community events and public forums as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Proven ability to develop and cultivate sources that lead to impactful, original reporting
  • Strong investigative instincts with a demonstrated commitment to accountability journalism
  • Excellent live reporting, anchoring, interviewing, and storytelling skills
  • Knowledge of public records laws, FOIA processes, computer-assisted reporting, and data-driven journalism
  • Understanding of legal and ethical considerations related to investigative reporting
  • Strong writing, editorial judgment, and news-gathering skills
  • Experience producing content for digital and social media platforms
  • Proficiency in video shooting, editing, and multimedia storytelling
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments
  • Minimum of one year of investigative reporting experience preferred
  • Track record of impactful or award-winning investigative journalism is preferred

At WCYB, your work will matter. For more than 70 years, WCYB has been a trusted source of news and information across the Tri-Cities region, building a legacy of strong local journalism and community service. As the region's leading news organization, we are committed to impactful reporting that informs, empowers, and holds those in power accountable. You'll have the opportunity to pursue meaningful investigations, work alongside an experienced and award-winning team, and tell stories that resonate across our communities. If you're ready to make a difference and grow your career in a newsroom that values enterprise reporting, innovation, and journalistic excellence, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Digital Video Journalist / Social Content MMJ
job.description:
KVII/KVIH has an immediate opening for a Digital Video Journalist / Social Content MMJ in Amarillo, Texas.

We are looking for a creative, self-starting journalist who can create exclusive, platform-first video content for KVII’s digital, streaming, and social audiences. This position is built for someone who thinks like a reporter, shoots like a visual storyteller, edits with urgency, and understands how audiences consume news on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, station websites, mobile apps, and streaming platforms.


This is not a traditional desk-only digital role. The right candidate should be able to write, shoot, edit, publish, and appear on camera when needed, similar to a traditional MMJ. The primary focus will be producing original vertical and social-first content, but stories produced in this role may also be used on KVII’s linear newscasts when appropriate.

KVII serves the Texas and Oklahoma Panhandles, plus four counties in eastern New Mexico. This role is designed to help KVII reach those communities wherever they are watching, scrolling, searching, or streaming.


Responsibilities include:

  • Create original, exclusive digital video content for KVII’s social, mobile, streaming, and online platforms.
  • Produce short-form vertical videos for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook Reels, and Instagram Reels.
  • Pitch, research, write, shoot, edit, caption, and publish stories independently.
  • Identify local stories, community moments, explainers, weather, sports, public safety, consumer, lifestyle, and trending topics that can perform well with digital and social audiences.
  • Develop accountability-focused digital stories that ask questions, seek answers, and follow up on issues important to viewers across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma Panhandle, and eastern New Mexico.
  • Turn viewer concerns, public records, local government decisions, consumer complaints, safety issues, and community problems into clear, fair, accurate, and engaging digital-first journalism.
  • Produce “what happened next” follow-ups that track whether promises were kept, problems were fixed, and public concerns were addressed.
  • Explain how local decisions affect viewers’ lives, including issues tied to schools, roads, taxes, public safety, severe weather recovery, utilities, housing, agriculture, and local government.
  • Turn KVII newsroom content into platform-appropriate social video while also creating original content that starts online.
  • Use strong hooks, natural sound, captions, graphics, pacing, and mobile-first editing to make stories clear, accurate, and engaging.
  • Shoot and edit video in the field using professional cameras, mobile tools, and newsroom editing systems.
  • Appear on camera when needed for explainers, social updates, live streams, and digital-first storytelling.
  • Work with producers, reporters, anchors, photographers, editors, and digital staff to develop content that can live across multiple platforms.
  • Contribute video, sound, interviews, and story elements that may be used in KVII linear newscasts when appropriate.
  • Monitor audience trends, platform performance, analytics, comments, and engagement to help guide future content decisions.
  • Follow KVII and Sinclair editorial standards, copyright rules, legal guidelines, and journalistic ethics.
  • Help grow KVII’s social audience, digital video reach, and connection with younger and mobile-first viewers.
  • Perform other newsroom and digital duties as assigned.

Required skills and qualifications:

  • Strong writing, shooting, and editing skills.
  • Ability to work independently as a digital-first MMJ.
  • Strong understanding of short-form vertical video and platform-specific storytelling.
  • Experience creating content for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to write clean, accurate, conversational copy for digital and social audiences.
  • Solid news judgment and understanding of local journalism.
  • Ability to ask direct questions, pursue follow-ups, and handle accountability stories with fairness, accuracy, and professionalism.
  • Comfort reading public documents, reviewing basic data, requesting information, and turning complex issues into understandable stories.
  • Comfort appearing on camera and conducting interviews.
  • Ability to shoot and edit quickly under deadline pressure.
  • Knowledge of social media trends, audience behavior, captions, thumbnails, hooks, and video pacing.
  • Ability to balance creativity with accuracy, fairness, and newsroom standards.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects at once.
  • Flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, holidays, and breaking news as needed.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.

 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, digital media, or related field.
  • Previous experience as an MMJ, digital journalist, video producer, content creator, social media producer, or accountability reporter.
  • Experience with Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, CapCut, Canva, Photoshop, or similar editing/design tools.
  • Experience using analytics to evaluate performance and improve content strategy.
  • Experience with public records requests, data-driven reporting, source development, or consumer/problem-solving journalism.
  • Knowledge of SEO, social headlines, thumbnails, captions, and mobile-first publishing.
  • Familiarity with newsroom CMS systems, social publishing tools, and streaming platforms.


What we’re looking for:

The ideal candidate is a journalist and creator in one. You should be curious, creative, accurate, and fast. You should know how to take a local story and make it work for someone scrolling on a phone, while still meeting the standards of a professional newsroom.


KVII’s coverage area offers a wide range of content opportunities: severe weather, agriculture, education, high school sports, Texas Panhandle culture, public safety, local government, military, community events, Route 66, and stories from across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma Panhandle, and eastern New Mexico.


Social video is an increasingly important way audiences discover news. Pew Research Center’s 2025 social media research notes that YouTube remains the most widely used social platform among U.S. adults, while Instagram and TikTok continue to be major platforms for younger and mobile-first audiences. This role is designed to help KVII meet viewers where they are while maintaining the credibility, accuracy, and public-service mission of local journalism.

job.title: Senior Staff Editor, Canon
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is seeking a senior staff editor to help its new Canon team develop and publish ambitious, conversation-starting “best of” projects across various topic areas. This is a role for a journalist who can bring organization, momentum and clarity to complex, multi-team projects.

Working closely with the Canon editor and colleagues across the organization, our ideal candidate has a sharp eye for detail and superb organizational and communication skills. They possess an editor's eye as well as a reader-centric mindset. They bring empathy and diplomacy to their work while also holding colleagues and departments accountable for moving a project forward.

The best candidate will have a consistent record of working with and across multiple teams. They will be comfortable managing concurrent projects on short-, medium- and long-term timeframes.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

You will report to the Canon editor.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with the Canon editor to plan and shepherd individual stories, franchises and larger editorial packages from conception through publication
  • You will provide first and second edits on overall projects and individual pieces
  • Create and maintain practical systems for keeping projects on track, including editorial calendars, status updates and action plans
  • Track assignments, drafts, edits, visuals, interactive elements, approvals and publication milestones across multiple projects
  • Facilitate regular check-ins with stakeholders to get updates on progress and establish and disseminate next steps
  • Serve as a connective point for writers, word editors, photo editors, designers and developers, as well as colleagues in audience, product and marketing
  • Organize meetings, prepare agendas, document decisions and follow up on open questions
  • Support publication planning, launch logistics and final handoffs for all Canon projects
  • Lead or support retrospectives after major projects, helping the team learn from what worked and what could be improved
  • Take on related administrative and logistical responsibilities as needed
  • Bring a strong understanding of The Times's standards, style and commitment to journalistic independence to all aspects of the work
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as an editor or project manager at a news organization
  • Experience editing across multiple digital formats
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex editorial or creative projects involving multiple contributors
  • Excellent organizational, written and verbal communication skills, with a sharp eye for detail
  • Ability to manage several projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with journalists and colleagues across the newsroom and other parts of the organization
  • Ability to communicate effectively across levels and functions, from individual contributors to department heads

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working on ambitious digital journalism, cultural coverage, special projects or multimedia packages
  • Strong writing and editing skills
  • Familiarity with collaborative tools used for editorial project management, such as Airtable and Google Sheets

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

The Associate Program Director is the first level of program ownership above the Sr. PM. Reporting to the Group Program Director and managing Sr. Program Managers, Managers, and Associates, this role owns and manages complex, multi-channel Tier 1 programs and the delivery health of that program level, owns account-level scope and SOW, manages staffing across the account team, and co-leads client strategy from the delivery angle in true partnership with the Business Director (and GBD on the largest accounts). This is where a Sr. PM steps into the scoping partnership — beginning to co-own scope and SOW alongside Business Leadership rather than executing against it. The Associate Program Director typically owns one large, multi-channel program or account in partnership with a BD.

Responsibilities

Program & Delivery Health

  • Own program and delivery health across the account; lead internal program coordination at the account level
  • Own account / retainer-level scope tracking and SOW; manage staffing across the account team
  • Escalate capacity needs and scope shifts back to the GPD for redesign

Client Partnership

  • Co-lead client strategy from delivery; hold senior client relationships (director / VP) on operations and scoping
  • Partner with the BD as a true partnership; on the largest accounts, co-lead with the GBD

Team Leadership

  • Lead Sr. PMs, project-focused Managers, and Associates
  • Co-lead junior managers with Business Leadership to identify program-management capability

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Job Description

Are you ready to tackle the complexities of global regulatory compliance and drive innovation in e-invoicing and tax technology? As a member of the Regulatory Affairs team, you can be a part of our journey as the global leader in invoicing compliance.

We, as Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE, are building the world’s largest, open business network. With our cloud-based network, customers can reach any business, anywhere in the world – no matter how many borders their operations may cross. We take care of the technical and regulatory requirements across the entire order-to-cash, purchase-to-pay and freight processes, to give customers data accuracy and security, transparency, and real-time visibility. All this through a single connection.

Global regulatory compliance with e-invoicing and CTC (continuous transaction control) mandates presents a formidable and ongoing challenge for multinationals. The landscape of regulations governing indirect tax and the application of tax technologies is expanding but often involves a lack of uniformity among different regulatory bodies. This complexity, fragmentation, and evolving nature of compliance requirements necessitates a dedicated and knowledgeable team. 


We are seeking an Associate to join ONESOURCE Thomson Reuters’ Regulatory Affairs (RA) team. The RA team has been instrumental in ONESOURCE Thomson Reuters successful global expansion, establishing our position as the global leader in e-invoicing and CTC compliance. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a dynamic and critical area of our business, ensuring that we continue to lead and innovate in this essential field.


Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as Regulatory Associate, you will: 

  • Analyze and investigate requirements and legislation in markets that Thomson Reuters plans to enter
  • Maintain and monitor up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements in markets that Thomson Reuters currently supports
  • Create compliance related content, including blogs and updates, for internal and external readers
  • Collaborate with stakeholders for launching new markets including integration, marketing, delivery, and more departments
  • Present ONESOURCE’s compliance solutions and relevant business cases to customers, curated for both technical and c-level audiences
  • Address queries from internal and external stakeholders, ranging from simple to complex 


Required Qualifications

job.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, FDE
job.description:
Job Description

FDE Engineering teams build AI solutions for customers. When those solutions go live, you make sure they stay reliable, secure and fast, and you decide how the rest of the organization will run them. As a member of the FDE SRE team, you'll own operations across AWS and Azure, set the pipelines and standards every new solution launches with, and champion the best custom builds into the core product. You'll lead and mentor a team of engineers and a growing crew of AI agents, digital teammates you design, deploy and supervise to handle routine monitoring and triage. That frees your team to work on hard problems and on engineering that improves the whole system.

 

Key Responsibilities

·       Operate and own reliability

·       Provide ongoing operational support for FDE-built solutions after handover, whether they run on AWS or Azure.

·       Operate MCP servers and APIs in production, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC and service-account authentication.

·       Own and meet the agreed SLAs for availability, reliability and performance.

·       Set severity levels, alerting and response times, and respond to incidents within them.

·       Provide 24x7 incident-response coverage through an on-call rotation, coordinating coverage with colleagues across time zones.

·       Plan capacity around critical deadlines, set change freezes for those windows, and run a surge on-call rotation when volume peaks.

·       Monitor availability, logs, integration health, failures and usage, and report findings and trends to stakeholders.

·       Create reports and dashboards to monitor capacity, consumption, cost, and solution adoption and usage.

 

Triage and resolve incidents

·       Work with Help Desk / Product Support on triage and routing, and with the FDE engineering team on defect fixes.

·       Take ownership of technical incidents routed by Help Desk / Product Support, from investigation through resolution within the agreed response times, and act as incident commander for high-severity events.

·       Resolve operational, infrastructure, configuration, security, vulnerability, capacity and availability issues that don't need a code change.

·       Troubleshoot queue-, webhook- and batch-based integrations, including retries, stuck or partial jobs and dead-letter queues, and escalate to the owning product team with evidence when the root cause sits in their system.

·       Engage the FDE engineering team only when a software defect is confirmed, with a complete package of logs, reproduction steps, impact and troubleshooting already done. Then see the fix through to release, and update runbooks with the resolution.

·       Run post-incident reviews and feed the learnings into runbooks.

 

CI/CD and environment onboarding

·       Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for new solutions once their landing zones are created, on AWS or Azure depending on the solution.

·       Set version control standards for source control, branching, code review and release management.

·       Provide reusable pipeline templates and standards, so each new solution doesn't need a custom setup.

·       Build deployment automation for each solution across environments, with approvals, rollback and change logging.

·       Integrate security scanning (vulnerability, dependency and secrets checks) and automated regression checks into the pipelines.

·       Onboard each new solution into monitoring, alerting, certificate management and the asset inventory before go-live.

·       Work with the FDE engineering team during handover so that pipelines, runbooks and access are in place before the solution is supported operationally.

·       Own the production-readiness checklist and sign off before a solution enters support. Shadow the FDE team during hypercare.

·       Deploy prebuilt, reusable solutions consistently for additional customers.

 

Automate and improve

·       Automate monitoring, alerting, recurring operational work and repeatable remediation.

·       Build and run AI agents as digital team members that handle alert triage, first-pass diagnosis and repeatable operational work alongside the human team. Keep a person in the loop for high-impact actions, with least-privilege access and full audit logs.

·       Maintain automated regression capability and run periodic regression checks.

·       Maintain the FDE productivity platforms assigned to the SRE team, including evaluation platforms and harnesses.

·       Define and track SLIs, SLOs and error budgets.

 

Security and lifecycle maintenance

·       Protect sensitive client data by enforcing least-privilege production access and keeping each customer's data separate.

·       Coordinate timely remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, dependencies and patches.

·       Manage maintenance, version upgrades, release compatibility and end-of-life planning.

·       Manage certificate renewals, including installing certificates and retiring them in Venafi.

 

Knowledge and handover

·       Maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known-issue records and escalation procedures.

·       Write and maintain approved knowledge articles so Help Desk / Product Support can resolve common issues and route escalations with the right information.

·       Keep Asset Insight and other solution records current.

·       Identify solutions that have become reusable, and advocate for them to be merged into the core product.

·       Work with the product team to make the merge happen: share the operating history, runbooks, pipelines and known issues, and support the operational transition until the product team owns the capability.

 

·       Leadership and mentoring

·       Lead, mentor and coach junior engineers: set priorities, assign and review work, and help them troubleshoot issues.

·       Run the daily team handoff and keep ownership and escalation paths clear across support, engineering and product teams.

·       Raise the engineering bar for the team through reviews, shared standards and example work.

 

Required Qualifications

·       7+ years of overall experience in SRE, DevOps or cloud infrastructure operations, running live, customer-facing solutions.

·       Strong hands-on production experience on AWS (EKS, ECS, networking, IAM, security controls), plus working experience on Azure (AKS, ACR, Entra ID, networking) to support the solutions deployed there.

·       Strong CI/CD experience: designing and maintaining pipelines in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar, including artifact management, environment promotion and deployment automation, with source control, branching and code review practices.

·       Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK or similar). Experience working with landing zones, accounts, subscriptions and environment baselines.

·       Python and shell scripting, used to automate operational work.

·       Experience running LLM or AI applications in production, including provider outages, rate limits, model version changes, re-running evaluations after a change, and tracking token cost per customer.

·       Hands-on experience building automation or AI agents for operational work, connected to ticketing, monitoring and runbook tools, with appropriate guardrails.

·       Docker, container services and Kubernetes in production (ECS or Kubernetes).

·       Experience operating APIs and MCP servers, with OAuth 2.0/OIDC and service-account authentication.

·       Experience troubleshooting event-driven and batch integrations (queues, webhooks, scheduled jobs) and working across teams to resolve them.

·       Observability tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or ELK: metrics, logs, tracing, alert tuning. Experience monitoring across AWS and Azure, and building dashboards and reports on availability, capacity, consumption and cost.

·       Incident, problem and change management in an ITIL-style process (ServiceNow), including post-incident reviews, within agreed severity levels and response times. Comfortable coordinating with colleagues across time zones.

·       Vulnerability and patch management, with scanner tools such as Wiz or Snyk.

·       Experience handling sensitive financial or personal data in production, with least-privilege access and customer data separation.

·       Leadership: experience mentoring engineers, assigning and reviewing work, and leading the team through major incidents. You take ownership, stay calm and decisive under pressure, and give clear, constructive feedback.

·       For the U.S.-based role: U.S. citizenship and experience working in FedRAMP or other government-regulated environments.

 

Preferred Qualifications

·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

·       AI-assisted operations, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation and AI-assisted triage.

·       Experience with LLM evaluation and tracing tools, feature-flag platforms.

·       Reusable pipeline templates, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD or similar) and policy-as-code guardrails.

·       Knowledge of runbooks, KB articles and escalation packages.

·       Certificate management (Venafi) and regression automation.

·       Experience in regulated or enterprise-customer environments (SOC 2 or similar) and 24x7 support models.

·       Experience running a consistent operating model, with shared tooling and standards, across AWS and Azure.

·       Experience moving a custom or project-built solution into a product platform.

job.title: Lead Business Intelligence Analyst (Alteryx)
job.description:
Job Description:


The Lead Business Intelligence Analyst will directly impact sales effectiveness by building the data infrastructure that delivers timely, accurate, and actionable insights to sales leaders and teams. Through scalable data pipelines, robust data models, and automated transformation workflows, the role will ensure opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and performance data is reliable and available across the sales lifecycle, helping teams prioritize activities, improve pipeline health, strengthen forecast accuracy, and track performance against revenue targets. In close partnership with Revenue Operations and its extended teams, the analyst will integrate CRM and other source data into a governed analytics layer, implement data quality checks and monitoring, and automate manual reporting processes. The result is a trusted, performant data platform that enables data-driven decision-making, improves sales execution, and helps the TR Sales Organization maximize productivity and achieve its revenue objectives.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, automated data pipelines that power Revenue Operations and the broader TR Sales Organization, from ingestion through analytics-ready delivery.

  • Develop reusable data models and transformation workflows with built-in data quality checks, validation, testing, and monitoring to ensure accuracy, consistency, and data freshness.
  • Integrate data from Snowflake, Oracle, and Salesforce, optimizing pipelines and warehouse workloads for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Sales Operations, Finance, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust data solutions and governed data assets.
  • Consolidate fragmented data environments, automate manual processes, and establish standardized, version-controlled data assets that support pipeline management, forecasting, and sales performance analytics.
  • Deliver and support reporting and analytics on top of trusted datasets, building dashboards and self-service reports in Tableau, Power BI, or Salesforce CRM Analytics that give sales leaders timely, actionable insights.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve data processes, adopt emerging technologies, and deliver measurable business value through faster, more reliable data and reporting.
  • Work Mode: Hybrid - 2-3 days from office every week.
  • Shift Timing: 2 pm IST to 11 pm IST



Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in data engineering, analytics reporting, or business intelligence.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in dbt, Alteryx, and advanced SQL for data transformation, pipeline development, and automation.
  • Proven experience in data integration, ETL/ELT workflows, data modeling, and data quality management.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Oracle, Salesforce, or similar enterprise data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or Salesforce CRM Analytics.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Responsable de publications juridiques (niveau débutant)


Joignez-vous à notre équipe mondiale de doctrine juridique afin de repérer, créer, éditer et maintenir du contenu juridique de haute qualité pour des plateformes telles que Westlaw, les publications imprimées et ProView. Ce poste de niveau débutant requiert de solides compétences éditoriales et une excellente capacité à entretenir des relations professionnelles afin d’assurer la qualité de notre collection de doctrine juridique de renommée mondiale.

Le poste est offert en mode hybride et requiert une présence au bureau une journée par semaine. Il est disponible à Montréal.


À propos du poste

À titre de responsable de publications juridiques, vous serez appelé à :

  • Rechercher, examiner et maintenir du contenu doctrinal juridique, tout en soutenant les processus de production et les projets liés aux produits en ligne, imprimés et numériques.
  • Gérer les relations avec des collaborateurs internes et externes afin de respecter les calendriers de publication, les normes de qualité et les échéances de livraison.
  • Vous tenir au courant des tendances du marché juridique et de l’évolution du droit.
  • Démontrer votre expertise, votre efficacité et votre curiosité dans l’utilisation de Westlaw et d’autres outils de recherche juridique.
  • Rédiger, réviser et mettre à jour du contenu juridique secondaire, y compris des conseils pratiques, des faits saillants et d’autres ressources. Repérer et organiser les principaux enjeux juridiques.
  • Vérifier l’exactitude et l’exhaustivité du contenu juridique.
  • Mettre à profit vos connaissances et votre expérience juridiques pour tester et valider des solutions d’intelligence artificielle en collaborant avec diverses équipes afin de créer des jeux de données de référence (« gold data »), ainsi que tester et évaluer les résultats produits par les modèles.
  • Établir les priorités et communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes dans le cadre de la production de contenu juridique, tout en comprenant le rôle et les responsabilités de chaque collaborateur et l’incidence de leur contribution sur le travail global.
  • Développer une maîtrise des systèmes internes nécessaires à l’exercice de vos fonctions et acquérir une connaissance approfondie des contenus et produits de Thomson Reuters ainsi que de ceux de la concurrence.

À propos de vous

Vous êtes un bon candidat pour ce poste si vous possédez les qualifications suivantes :

  • Diplôme en droit obtenu d’une faculté de droit reconnue.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français (poste à Montréal).
  • Expérience en pratique du droit, en édition juridique ou expérience équivalente fortement souhaitée; une expérience au sein d’une revue juridique ou d’un journal étudiant constitue un atout.
  • Esprit d’initiative et aptitude démontrée pour la recherche et la rédaction juridiques, notamment à l’aide de Westlaw, Practical Law, CoCounsel ou d’autres outils de recherche juridique.
  • Esprit analytique capable de résoudre des problèmes complexes grâce à la logique et à la collaboration.
  • Capacité à prendre des décisions rapidement tout en maintenant des standards de qualité élevés.
  • Aptitude à interpréter, analyser, organiser et communiquer des concepts juridiques complexes.
  • Aisance dans un environnement de travail dynamique, évolutif et au rythme soutenu.
  • Capacité à gérer efficacement plusieurs priorités et projets avec énergie et détermination.
  • Esprit d’équipe positif, flexible et adaptable, capable de travailler efficacement dans un environnement collaboratif.
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication orale et écrite avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes à Thomson Reuters.
  • Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Office 365.

Joignez-vous à nous pour avoir un impact significatif sur la communauté juridique en contribuant à la diffusion de contenu doctrinal de premier ordre à l’échelle mondiale.

job.title: Editorial Lawyer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We’re now looking for an Editorial Lawyer to provide legal support and advice to our publications. 

 

The GNM Editorial Legal Department provides pre- and post- publication legal advice to all our editorial departments. You’ll be working alongside some of the top journalists and editors. The editorial lawyers have worked on many exciting news and investigative projects.

 

About the Role

Editorial lawyers work closely with our journalists and editors to make sure that what we publish is legally defensible. This involves reading stories before they are published and checking for legal risk in areas such as defamation, privacy and data protection, contempt and copyright. It can be a fast moving and demanding environment. In addition to this pre-publication review, editorial lawyers also advise on the merits of any court cases that may be threatened and / or filed against GNM, working with the appropriate journalists, editors and executives to define a strategic defence and/or approve settlements of disputes where warranted, as well as selecting, retaining, managing, and evaluating any outside solicitors or counsel as needed.

 

Pre-publication legal and editorial code review on a real-time basis on all content-related issues

 

Managing pre and post publication litigation (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions)

 

Contributing to policy and lobbying discussions and documents

 

About You

  • 2-4 years post qualified experience or equivalent

  • Experience of civil and/or criminal litigation including ability to handle own caseload

  • Background in/knowledge of media law (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions and broadcast

  • Ideally proven experience of pre and post publication litigation work

  • Background in / knowledge of complaint handling and responding

  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role

 

We actively encourage applications from candidates from other groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media and legal profession. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at the Guardian. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve,

where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for.

 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Please contact Sean on sean.brinkley@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

 

Culture & wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace.

 

You will also have the opportunity to hear unique insight from our journalists in our morning conference, a live discussion on the news story of the day.

 

We offer great tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including free yoga and pilates. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Learning & development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships. 

 

Our working environment

We take pride in our surroundings and are pleased to offer versatile meeting rooms and colourful communal areas. We have a brilliant canteen that caters to breakfast, lunch and dinner, with views overlooking Regent’s Canal.

 

Additional benefits & policies

We offer 30 days annual leave per annum, plus an additional 5 day holiday purchase scheme. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, healthcare, sick pay and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Client Relationship Manager
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role

The Reader Revenue Group (RRG) unites the subscription and licensing businesses of the Financial Times. This allows crafting opportunities for broader, deeper, and longer-term relationships globally.

Within RRG, Corporate Licensing provides FT content to organisations worldwide through solutions ranging from group and enterprise subscriptions to customised data feeds. Our Americas team works collaboratively to strengthen customer relationships and drive sustainable commercial growth.

We are looking for an experienced Client Relationship Manager to lead and grow a portfolio of Corporate and Government customers throughout the Americas.

In this role, you will take charge of customer retention, revenue growth, and renewal strategy. You will build diligent connections with senior partners and see opportunities to grow accounts over time.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys handling sophisticated customer relationships, navigating commercial discussions and delivering long-term value to clients.

job.title: Night News Editor
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI. 

 

The Role
The FT is looking for a sharp, sure-footed editor to help run its London night news operation. This is a demanding role at the heart of the newsroom, requiring the judgement to make big editorial calls and the skills to commission, edit and present high-profile FT’s journalism.

The London evening is often when the big stories of the day can take a decisive turn. From wars and geopolitical crises to market-moving corporate deals, the night editor needs to respond quickly to breaking developments and decide what matters most to FT readers.

The editor will be responsible for running the FT's UK homepage during the shift, making calls on news priorities and ensuring stories are presented with strong headlines, images and graphics.

Night news commissions breaking news that can cut across all the main newsdesks. The team also plays an important role revising stories for publication, upholding the FT's high standards for accuracy and quality.

The night news operation must work closely with the New York desk, co-ordinating coverage so important stories are handled smoothly between time zones.

We are open to appointing an experienced editor to lead the London night news team, or a strong candidate to join it in a senior editing role. The person taking on leadership responsibility would be expected to set priorities, support colleagues and manage the team.

 

Working arrangements

The role is based in London and involves evening shifts and regular Sunday working. The existing pattern is four night shifts a week, but we are open to discussing different working arrangements with candidates that would ensure the needs of the news operation are met.

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help

job.title: Account Executive, Technology - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

OUR TEAM  

This role offers the opportunity to develop under the guidance of some of the best in the industry and gain first-hand experience working on high-profile international brands. The experience of the 20+ team enables us to deliver integrated communications, from corporate, B2B and consumer communications, to digital & social, influencers, analyst relations, content marketing and public affairs. We understand technology ecosystems, consumer and business audiences, and the power of the influencer.  

Having a passion for technology is essential for this role as you will be working with several of the world’s leading technology brands. We believe that technology has the power to enhance human experience and performance as we enter a new era of intelligence. Whether it’s the latest enterprise software or the hottest consumer device, as we progress into a new era defined by the advancements in AI, it’s crucial we continue to tell human-first stories. 

THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES  

The team is looking to recruit an Account Executive to work with some of its leading global technology brands (opportunities to work for B2B and consumer). The role involves working on media relations, network coordination and account management to reach primarily consumer audiences. Key responsibilities include: 

  • Supporting on day-to-day media liaison, developing solid media relationships and managing media requests and product reviews 
  • Developing press materials, from press releases and blogs, to Q&As and briefing documents, with a high level of attention to detail 
  • Handling junior client relationships, developing a strong rapport with your day-to-day contact 
  • Overseeing the creation of coverage and activity reports for clients   
  • Managing press briefings, product launches, conferences and similar events for clients 
  • Attending and contributing ideas in internal brainstorms, contributing to generating creative ideas in response to client briefs 
  • Monitoring and keeping abreast of relevant industry news in order to build an understanding of industry trends, competitive landscape and how they impact clients 

 

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES  

  • A positive and proactive attitude to seeking out opportunities to add value to clients and teams 
  • A fan of technology that enhances human progress, with an understanding of the consumer technology market, who is excited by its future within society and business 
  • Experience in the technology and/or telecoms sectors – ideally both, but technology experience is a must 
  • A media hound and storyteller who loves to craft compelling pitches and knows how to sell them to business, trade and national media 
  • A global outlook, with the ability to transfer skills across both UK and global client work 
  • Organisational skills and the ability to tightly manage relationships with international Burson offices 
  • Attention to detail and an appreciation of time management 

#LI-BC1 

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary: 

As an Account Associate you are learning how our business works, and you are the ‘go-to’ person on your team for getting things done. You have a strong focus on day-to-day project management and are learning to understand and appreciate the core skills that will enable you to develop effective client relationships. You are efficient, reliable, and learning to work under pressure.

 

Responsibilities:

Client delivery

  • Be the ‘go-to’ person on your team for completing tasks, identify tasks you can take on and proactively offer your support

  • Take ownership of meetings (internal and external) ensuring: relevant team members are available; they have everything they need to run it (status reports, agendas, etc.); the necessary logistics are in place (room bookings, etc.)

  • Capture accurate minutes from meetings (internal and external), ensuring all internal actions are completed according to the timelines

  • Prepare timelines prior to the commencement of each project (prepared in consultation with relevant team members)

  • Begin to build relationships with your clients, through regular contact (calls/emails)

  • Manage external suppliers on client projects, ensuring they deliver to budget and timelines

  • Organise logistics for small to medium sized external meetings/events, ensuring that costs are aligned with the budget

  • Ensure professional contact with KOLs when undertaking key tasks (e.g. booking travel)

  • Start to build your knowledge of your client’s strategy by staying on top of all emails and saving down files appropriately

  • Tailor your communication to your team members’ ways of working (i.e. Teams vs. emailing, identifying the most appropriate person to respond to questions)

  • Actively participate in the briefing process when you’re being assigned work – arrange the meeting, do any pre-reading, interrogate the brief to confirm your understanding of the project, deadlines and budget

 

Core skills

  • Maintain an awareness of your time and deliverables, thinking ahead to plan and prioritise your work effectively, regularly updating your teams on progress and any challenges (share solutions with your team as soon as they arise)

  • Gain proficiency on VVPM, uploading, tagging and managing items for approval

  • Focus on attention to detail and develop a full understanding of what ‘client ready’ means – reflect this in your work generally, and particularly for externally-facing outputs

  • Gain experience in referencing and proofing accurately

  • Develop written materials following a detailed brief, which may include story flows/drafts/amendments/referencing, and manage internal review timings

Personal development

  • Buddy new AA starters, sharing your insights and experiences to support their professional development

  • Ask questions in a structured way (i.e. accumulating questions and organising a meeting with the relevant person to discuss)

  • Seek feedback and proactively feedback to improve individual and team performance

Financial management

  • Develop a clear understanding of the relevant RC financial processes (e.g. raising job codes, purchase orders, managing Salesforce opportunities, requesting time moves, etc.) and support your account teams as required

  • Begin to draft budgets, talking your account lead through your rationale

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time

Agency environment

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, your clients’ companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

  • Familiarise yourself with the ABPI Code of Practice and ensure that your work is always compliant

 

Required skills and experience:

  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Performs tasks with a sense of urgency and has the confidence to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills

  • Open minded and eager to learn – the more you put in, the more you get out!

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

 

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected.
