job.title: Office Assistant
job.description:
Opportunity  

Brunswick is seeking a reliable and organized Office Assistant with at least 12 months of administrative experience to support daily office operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable handling a variety of clerical and coordination tasks in a fast-paced office environment.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract role, based 5 days per week in our London office.

About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Preparing and formatting documents, presentations and correspondence.
  • Processing expenses and timesheets accurately and efficiently.
  • Providing general day-to-day office support, including photocopying, printing and binding documents.
  • Providing cover for the Core Assistant team, including coordinating travel arrangements and logistics, preparing agendas, managing invitations and taking meeting notes.
  • Supporting the coordination of client meetings, events and hospitality arrangements.
  • Acting as a professional and trusted point of contact for clients and colleagues via telephone and email.
  • Assisting with health and safety, fire warden responsibilities and compliance-related activities.
  • Supporting general London office administration, including coordinating weekly office activities and arranging employee photography.
  • Undertaking other ad hoc administrative duties as required to support the smooth running of the London office.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 12 months’ experience in an office environment
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) or similar tools.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Professional attitude and attention to detail.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

Our Benefits

In addition to life assurance, group income protection, and employer pension contribution, we offer:

  • 25 days’ annual leave entitlement (excluding bank holidays) plus an additional day of leave for your birthday.
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Family Leave policies - Maternity, Paternity, Shared Parental & Adoption.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Headspace for Work membership, Corporate Gym Memberships and discounts
  • Financial wellbeing benefit schemes – Season Ticket Loan, Tenancy Deposit Loan and Cycle to Work.
  • Complimentary artisan coffee, tea and snacks, served by our own barista in our café.
  • Daily breakfast and lunch served twice a week in our café.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Accounting Manager / Senior Accounting Manager
job.description:
Overview of the Firm 

FGS Global helps the world's most influential leaders move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments.

We work as one team across geographies and disciplines - bringing together specialists with backgrounds in communications, finance, law, government, journalism, data science, and digital. Whatever the moment demands, we combine multidimensional perspectives to help leaders anticipate what's next, engage the stakeholders who matter, and drive meaningful outcomes.

Across 31 global offices, we draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. This collaborative approach has established FGS as a market leader: we are consistently ranked Band 1 for Crisis & Risk Management and Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners, and were ranked the #1 Global M&A PR firm by deal value and deal count for four consecutive years (Mergermarket, 2025).

 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Accounting Manager to join our Asia finance team in Hong Kong. Reporting to the Head of Finance, Asia, and working closely with the Finance Operations Senior Manager, this role plays a key part in the accounting operations of the firm across the Hong Kong, Singapore, and China entities, with key responsibility for the month-end close, financial reporting, and tax compliance, as well as supporting the statutory and group audits. The role places a strong focus on income statement analysis to provide insight into revenue and cost performance.

The ideal candidate will be a qualified accountant who combines strong technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, takes accountability for their deliverables, and communicates clearly with senior internal and external stakeholders. They will be comfortable operating in a fast-paced professional services environment and contributing to continuous improvement in processes and controls. Experience with VAT/GST filing across Singapore and China jurisdictions will be highly regarded.

 

Responsibilities

  • Reporting to Head of Finance, this role is a key Act as a key member to perform the month-end closing, including revenue recognition, accruals, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis.
  • Work closely with Global Accounting Team to drive alignment and compliance with Group Policy and Accounting Standards and to support audits and tax filings.
  • Perform detailed monthly income statement analysis, explaining revenue and cost movements against prior periods, budget and forecast, and identifying trends, anomalies and risks.
  • Ensure departmental costs are accurately recorded, coded, and allocated to the correct cost centres, reviewing cost reports and resolving variances with budget holders on a timely basis.
  • Review and deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and management reports, providing analysis and commentary on key variances to the Head of Finance and regional leadership.
  • Support the statutory and group audit processes together with Finance Operations Senior Manager.
  • Manage tax filing obligations across Hong Kong, Singapore, and China, including GST/VAT compliance, corporate income tax, and withholding tax matters, and liaise with external tax advisers.
  • Partner with operational teams on cost budgeting and reforecasting to support business to drive cost control.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to drive cost optimisation, analysing spending trends and recommending practical cost-saving initiatives to the Head of Finance and business leaders.
  • Partner with global finance teams and external service providers on group reporting, intercompany, and consolidation matters.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls and accounting policies, and drive process and system improvements to enhance efficiency in the Asia finance function.
  • Support ad hoc finance projects as required.

 

Desired Skills & Qualities

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related discipline from a recognised university.
  • A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. HKICPA, ACCA, CPA) is required.
  • 10-15 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a professional services or multinational environment. Audit firm experience is an advantage.
  • Solid technical accounting knowledge, with experience applying US GAAP and/or IFRS/HKFRS.
  • Strong analytical skills with a proven track record in income statement analysis, able to translate financial results into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.
  • Proven experience supporting statutory audits and managing tax filings across multiple jurisdictions; familiarity with Singapore GST and China VAT filing will be highly considered.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with ERP or accounting systems such as NetSuite is strongly preferred.
  • Strong team player, with the ability to guide and support junior team members.
  • Hands-on, highly organised, and able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic working environment.
  • Treasury experience is a plus but it is NOT a must.
  • Proactive, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the confidence to engage senior stakeholders, auditors, and advisers.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Cantonese is preferred and be ready to join global calls

Position Summary

Bottle Rocket helps clients plan, build, and improve digital products, leading with defined, outcome-oriented offerings. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine at the top of the sales funnel and a key driver of the company’s growth. This role owns outbound prospecting, turning a strong volume of leads into calls, calls into meetings, and meetings into new clients.

The ideal BDR is driven, tenacious, and a great active listener. They understand the front-end digital experience and the back-end that enables it. They can distill the needs behind a prospect’s business challenges, connect them to the right Bottle Rocket solution, and hand a well-qualified opportunity to the Business Development Executive team.

Essential Functions

  • Drive a high volume of outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and multi-touch cadences) to create a consistent flow of new leads
  • Convert leads into live conversations, and conversations into qualified first meetings booked for the Business Development Executive team
  • Own and consistently hit weekly and monthly targets for activity, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline generated
  • Lead outreach with Bottle Rocket’s productized offerings, positioning each around the business problem it solves rather than a list of services
  • Spot buying signals in research and discovery calls, and connect them to the right Bottle Rocket services:
    • Strategy & Research (Experience Strategy, Research & Insights): unclear priorities, fragmented experiences, a new idea to validate
    • Design & Build (Design & Development, Experience Optimization): aging or low-rated apps, redesigns, falling engagement or conversion
    • Enterprise Engineering (Technical Modernization, Cloud Enablement, AI & Data, Application Engineering): legacy platforms, cloud migration, AI pilots, integration gaps
  • Research and build targeted account and contact lists in priority industries (Healthcare, Gaming, Hospitality, Financial Services, and QSR) with Business Development leadership

The programme will consolidate CRM platforms and processes, standardise core client, pipeline and opportunity management practices, and strengthen the data, integration and governance foundations needed to provide a trusted global view of our clients.

We’re looking for a Global Programme Director, CRM to lead this transformation end to end, turning our ambition into an executable global programme and bringing together business, technology, data, architecture and change teams across agencies and markets.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who can navigate the complexity of a federated global organisation, challenge legacy ways of working and drive the decisions, delivery discipline and adoption needed to establish a common global CRM capability.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the global CRM transformation vision, roadmap and delivery strategy, translating strategic ambition into a clear, executable multi-year programme across agencies and markets.
  • Lead the consolidation and simplification of CRM platforms and processes, establishing a clear approach to global standardisation while managing legitimate local requirements.
  • Drive the adoption of common global processes across client and contact management, pipeline and opportunity management, forecasting, client planning and cross-agency collaboration.
  • Lead programme delivery across CRM product, architecture, data, integrations, security, testing, migration, cutover and deployment, working closely with Enterprise Technology and business leaders.
  • Ensure CRM integrates effectively with the wider enterprise technology landscape and that client, account, contact and opportunity data is structured, governed and managed consistently.
  • Own the integrated programme plan, governance, dependencies, RAID, assurance and stage-gate process, providing clear visibility of delivery confidence, risk, decisions, budget and benefits.
  • Define and lead the global deployment, business readiness and adoption strategy, sequencing agencies and markets based on value, readiness, data quality and change capacity.
  • Establish robust go/no-go, cutover, hypercare and stabilisation processes to protect business continuity and ensure each deployment is successfully embedded.
  • Own the programme business case, budget, forecast and benefits framework, ensuring investment remains linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • Manage system integrators, CRM product partners and other third parties against clear deliverables, commercial commitments, milestones and quality expectations.
  • Act as the principal programme interface for executive sponsors and senior agency, market, technology and functional leaders, creating alignment and driving timely decisions.
  • Challenge complexity, local exceptions and assumptions that could undermine the global outcome, balancing business requirements with simplicity, scalability and long-term value.
  • Build and lead a high-performing, global matrixed programme team spanning programme management, product, process, architecture, data, testing, change and deployment.
  • Create an evidence-led delivery culture built on transparency, disciplined decision-making, early escalation and shared accountability for outcomes

What you'll need:

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale, multi-year global transformation programmes within a complex, matrixed or federated organisation.
  • Significant experience delivering major enterprise CRM transformation, ideally involving platforms such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • A strong understanding of how CRM transformation connects technology, business process, operating model, data and organisational change, rather than treating CRM as simply a technology implementation.
  • Experience consolidating fragmented platforms or processes and establishing greater global standardisation across multiple businesses, markets or geographies.
  • Strong programme leadership across areas such as architecture, integration, master data, data migration, testing, security, deployment and business readiness.
  • A proven track record of managing complex programme governance, integrated plans, interdependencies, risks, stage gates and executive-level assurance.
  • Strong commercial and financial capability, including ownership of significant programme budgets, business cases, forecasting, benefits realisation and vendor performance.
  • Experience managing system integrators, software providers and strategic delivery partners in complex enterprise environments.
  • Exceptional senior stakeholder leadership, with the presence and credibility to influence executive sponsors, challenge constructively and secure decisions across competing priorities.
  • Experience leading large, geographically dispersed and matrixed teams across business and technology functions.
  • Strong change and adoption capability, with experience embedding new processes and ways of working and measuring whether transformation has genuinely landed.
  • The ability to translate complex programme, technology and data issues into clear executive-level decisions, risks and trade-offs.
  • A pragmatic, resilient and outcome-focused leadership style, comfortable operating through ambiguity and making difficult decisions when delivery is at risk

Desirable

  • A recognised programme or project management qualification such as MSP, PgMP or PRINCE2.
  • CRM platform certification or deep delivery experience within an enterprise Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 environment.

job.title: OKTA Engineer - SSO
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Senior Identity and Access security Engineer is responsible for governing who, and what, can access DTS systems, data, APIs, tools, workflows and AI-enabled capabilities.

This is a hands-on governance and control role, reporting into the SVP Security and Compliance. The role ensures that access across DTS is appropriate, auditable, reviewed, least-privileged and aligned with security, privacy, compliance and client commitments.

The scope covers traditional human access, external users, privileged access, service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, dataset access, and the emerging governance of AI agents and agentic workflows.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Security, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal/DPO, TechOps, Enterprise Technology and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure DTS has a clear and controlled model for access across platforms such as WPP Open, Choreograph, InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve and related DTS capabilities.

 

What you'll be doing:

1. Identity and access governance framework

Define and maintain the access governance framework for DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining access governance standards, processes and control expectations.
  • Establishing how access should be requested, approved, provisioned, reviewed, revoked and evidenced.
  • Ensuring access governance covers internal users, external users, clients, partners, vendors, service accounts, machine identities and AI agents.
  • Aligning identity and access governance with DTS architecture, security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.
  • Ensuring access governance is practical for product and engineering teams to implement.

 

2. Access reviews and recertification

Own the process for regular access reviews and recertification across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining the scope, frequency and evidence requirements for access reviews.
  • Coordinating access reviews for critical DTS systems, production environments, privileged roles, sensitive datasets, client-facing platforms and administrative tools.
  • Ensuring access review outcomes are tracked, remediated and evidenced.
  • Identifying stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Escalating overdue, high-risk or unresolved access issues through the appropriate governance channels.

 

3. Privileged access governance

Ensure privileged access across DTS is properly controlled, justified and auditable.

This includes:

  • Reviewing access to production systems, cloud environments, security tools, databases, CI/CD tooling, administrative consoles and sensitive platforms.
  • Supporting least-privilege, just-in-time and time-bound access models where appropriate.
  • Working with Cloud and Platform Security and Infrastructure to improve privileged access controls.
  • Ensuring privileged access risks are visible in the DTS risk register where required.

 

4. External user, client and partner access governance

Govern access for external users, clients, agencies, partners and vendors.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for external user onboarding, approval, permissions, expiry and offboarding.
  • Ensuring external access has a clear business owner and justification.
  • Supporting access governance across client workspaces, agency environments, partner integrations and shared collaboration areas.
  • Working with Product and Engineering to ensure tenant, workspace and client-level isolation is appropriately governed.
  • Tracking risks related to stale accounts, vendor access, partner permissions and external user overprivilege.

 

5. Service account, machine identity and API access governance

Govern non-human access across DTS systems and platforms.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for service accounts, machine identities, automation users, API keys, tokens, secrets and integration credentials.
  • Ensuring non-human access has clear ownership, purpose, scope, rotation, expiry and auditability.
  • Working with Product, Engineering, Cloud Security and Infrastructure to reduce unmanaged credential risk.
  • Ensuring service accounts and machine identities are included in access reviews.
  • Supporting stronger governance of API access, token issuance, credential lifecycle and integration permissions.

 

6. AI and agentic access governance

Define and oversee the governance model for AI agents and agentic workflows across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining how AI agents are identified, permissioned, monitored, reviewed and revoked.
  • Ensuring agents have clear ownership, scoped permissions and auditable actions.
  • Defining which agent actions require human approval or additional control.
  • Governing agent access to APIs, tools, datasets, workflows, client environments and production capabilities.
  • Ensuring agents act within delegated authority and cannot exceed the permissions of the user, system or business process they represent.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and Security to ensure agentic workflows are designed with clear action boundaries.
  • Working with the Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead to test whether agent permissions and action boundaries can be bypassed.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering to ensure AI access models support permitted use, minimisation and data protection requirements.

7. Data access governance

Govern access to sensitive, client, partner and WPP-owned data across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for dataset access approval, review, revocation and evidence.
  • Supporting data classification from an access-control and security-governance perspective.
  • Ensuring access to sensitive data is role-based, purpose-based, least-privileged and auditable.
  • Supporting controls for cross-client, cross-market, cross-agency and partner data access.
  • Ensuring data access governance supports InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open and other DTS data collaboration use cases.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering on data minimisation, permitted use, retention and privacy-by-design requirements.
  • Ensuring data access risks are surfaced through the DTS risk process.

 

8. Governance of access to tools, workflows and actions

Ensure access governance extends beyond systems and datasets into tools, workflows and actions.

This includes:

  • Defining governance for access to operational tools, workflow automation, orchestration systems, AI tools and administrative actions.
  • Ensuring high-risk actions are subject to appropriate approval, logging and monitoring.
  • Supporting segregation of duties across sensitive workflows.
  • Ensuring automated workflows and agents have clearly scoped authority.
  • Working with Security Operations to ensure high-risk access and actions are visible in monitoring and detection processes.

 

9. Auditability, evidence and reporting

Maintain clear evidence of access governance and support audit and assurance requirements.

This includes:

  • Producing access governance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, client assurance, internal audit and risk reviews.
  • Working with the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure access controls, reviews, exceptions and remediation actions are documented.
  • Reporting on access review completion, high-risk access, overdue actions and access control gaps.
  • Supporting client and audit questions related to identity, access, privileged roles, service accounts, AI agents and data access.
  • Ensuring access governance is repeatable, measurable and auditable.

 

Who you'll be working with:

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer will be accountable for:

  • DTS identity and access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews and recertification.
  • Privileged access governance.
  • External user, client, partner and vendor access governance.
  • Service account, machine identity, API key and token governance.
  • AI agent identity, permission and action governance.
  • Dataset and sensitive data access governance.
  • Governance of access to tools, workflows and high-risk actions.
  • Access governance evidence for audit, compliance and client assurance.
  • Escalation of material access risks into the DTS risk process.

 

What you'll need:

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience in identity governance, access management, IAM, security governance, GRC, data access control or platform security.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, access reviews, privileged access and segregation of duties.
  • Experience governing access across SaaS platforms, cloud environments, APIs, data platforms or enterprise technology estates.
  • Knowledge of identity platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID or similar.
  • Understanding of service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, secrets and non-human access governance.
  • Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, delegated authority and tool-access governance would be highly valuable.
  • Understanding of data classification, dataset access governance, privacy-by-design and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture, product, engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy and compliance teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to coordinate reviews, evidence, remediation and reporting.
  • Ability to translate complex access issues into clear risks, controls and practical actions.

 

Leadership expectations

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer is expected to:

  • Be structured, disciplined and pragmatic.
  • Bring clarity to complex access and permission models.
  • Challenge excessive, unclear or poorly governed access.
  • Work constructively with product and engineering teams to design workable controls.
  • Avoid creating unnecessary bureaucracy while ensuring access is properly governed.
  • Treat human, machine and agent access as part of the same control landscape.
  • Escalate material access risks clearly and early.
  • Support DTS in building a secure, auditable and scalable access governance model.

 

Success measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

  • DTS having clear identity, access and data access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews completed on schedule with evidence.
  • Reduction in stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Stronger governance of privileged access and production access.
  • Clear ownership and review of service accounts, machine identities, API keys and tokens.
  • Defined governance for AI agent identities, permissions and actions.
  • Improved auditability of access to data, APIs, tools, workflows and production systems.
  • Better alignment between identity, security, privacy, architecture, product and engineering teams.

job.title: WPP Production | Freelance Print Production Manager
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 


ポジション概要
本ポジションは、当社の最重要クライアントのビジネス目標達成を支援するため、世界水準のコミュニケ ーション制作を高い品質で開発・実行する役割です。勤務地は東京です。 プリント・プロダクションマネージャーは、さまざまな素材に印刷する制作物について、優れたプロジェ クトマネジメントスキルを活かし、制作スケジュールを管理します。対象となる制作物には、パッケージ 、各種販促物、店舗ウィンドウおよび店内グラフィック、イベント用グラフィック、サイネージ、ギフト カード、プレミアム・販促品などが含まれます。 候補者には、高い色彩分析力に加え、プリプレス、大判・小判のオフセット印刷、各種加工技術に関する 幅広い知識が求められます。また、デジタル媒体および写真媒体の制作経験と、現場での施工・設置作業 を監督した経験が必要です。

主な業務内容
• 印刷案件を管理し、サプライヤーへ適切なブリーフィングを行います。必要に応じて、印刷管理業務 を外部のプロダクションエージェンシーへ委託します。
• 色校正、カラーマネジメント、印刷工程においてサプライヤーを監督します。これには、印刷現場お よび製本現場での確認、加工、品質管理、キット内容の抜き取り確認が含まれます。キットの梱包お よびフルフィルメントに最適な方法を提案し、定期的にフルフィルメント現場を訪問します。
• 外部のプロダクションエージェンシーが上記サービスを提供する場合、その業務を監督します。 • 他チームと密接に連携し、エージェンシーおよびサプライヤーが制作仕様とスケジュールを厳格に遵 守していることを確認します。
• 色に関するガイダンスを提供し、品質管理に最適な方法について助言します。
• 外部ビジネスパートナーとともに印刷現場に立ち会い、必要に応じて品質や使用素材の観点から納品 物を最適化します。 • すべてのプロジェクトについて、制作状況をクライアントへ随時報告します。 

応募要件
• 大学卒業資格を有し、広告代理店または企業内のグラフィックデザイン部門において、4～6 年の印刷 制作経験があること。
• 主体性があり、高い整理・管理能力を備えていること。複数の業務を同時に進めることに優れ、プレ ッシャーのある状況でも落ち着いて対応し、チームの一員として効果的に働けること。
• Adobe Creative Suite の使用経験があれば望ましいですが、必須ではありません。
 • 業務上必要な出張に対応できること。

このポジションで重視される専門性
• 印刷制作における進行管理、スケジュール管理、サプライヤーおよび外部エージェンシーのマネジメ ント
• プリプレス、オフセット印刷、大判・小判印刷、製本・表面加工・仕上げ工程に関する実務知識
• 色校正、カラーマネジメント、品質管理、印刷立ち会いに関する専門性
• 店舗・イベント向けグラフィックやサイネージなどの現場施工・設置監督経験


WPP Productionについて

私たちWPP Productionは、WPPグループ内のあらゆるコンテンツプロデューサー、スタジオ、そして制作（クラフト）の専門家を結集し、ひとつの繋がった組織として統合されたグローバル・プロダクション・カンパニーです。

世界最高峰の人間によるクラフトマンシップ（熟練した制作技術）と次世代テクノロジーを融合させ、大規模なマルチチャネル・コンテンツシステムを企画・デザインし、世界へと届けています。

国境のないボーダレスなコラボレーションを前提に構築され、深い制作技術の専門性に裏打ちされた私たちは、常時稼働（Always-on）かつAI主導で動く現代のマーケティング世界のために設計された「プロダクション・エンジン（制作の中核）」です。　なお、WPP ProductionはWPPグループの一員です。

job.title: Communications Director
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

 

The Communications Director is responsible for the organization, development, and oversight of comprehensive and integrated communications objectives and message positioning in support of established ministry goals. Responsible for the implementation of internal and external communications initiatives, including public relations initiatives and serves as an official spokesperson for the ministry. Works closely with senior leadership on the development and administration of communication plans and strategies. Supervises staff and outside consultants/vendors responsible for the development and production of strategic communications content for employees, media, and community functions.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Proactively influence our culture, leading by example in demonstrating collaboration, empowerment, innovation, creativity and service, while being a faithful witness on and off the job of K-LOVE’s mission to create compelling media that inspires and encourages our listeners to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.
  • As a member of leadership, contribute to long term planning and vision implementation through identification of strategic Marketing initiatives, collaboration, prioritization, communication, and evaluation of results, while preserving K-LOVE’s reputation for integrity and excellence.
  • Engage Chief Marketing & Communications Officer on communication issues, trends, and proposals for strategic initiatives and delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with other departments such as Programming, Engagement, and other departments.
  • Assist with strategic planning and implementation for communication strategies with a focus on communication goals, timelines, budgets, results tracking, and celebration.
  • Assess communication performance against both annual goals and plans. Provide strategic recommendations based on operational analysis, research, and projections, cost identification and allocation, and resource analysis. Ensure tools and systems are in place to provide critical operational and project information to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer and others, and make actionable recommendations on both strategic goals and operational constraints.
  • Provide leadership for the communication function and team, ensuring ministry wide collaboration and facilitating appropriate resolution of issues, and competing priorities. Ensure alignment of communication Initiatives with Ministry objectives.
  • Consult with senior leadership to provide communication strategies that protect, promote, and enhance the reputation of the organization.
  • Review and approves the work product of department staff, outside departments, and external vendors and freelancers to ensure quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.
  • Manage the communication strategy and direction for acquisitions, internal communication initiatives, newsletters, and ministry special events.
  • Oversee the writing and production of special reports, executive messages, fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, etc.
  • Provide strategic communication support to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer and the Ministry Leadership Team in the form of talking points, speeches, and other resources.
  • Plans and directs administrative, financial, and operational activities for the department as needed and requested by senior management. Organize and prioritize critical issues and required information to facilitate efficient decision making.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, English, or related field, or combination of education/training with relevant experience.
  • Six plus years of communications and/or public relations experience is required.
  • Experience directing and/or managing comprehensive strategic communications, media relations, and related teams preferred.
  • Strong writing skills including a working knowledge of AP Style required.
  • Experience working closely with creative teams on the design and production of creative products that support strategic communication goals.
  • Effective communication skills written, verbal, listening, and presentation are required.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with all levels of the organization, including senior management. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is required.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Operations & Innovation Specialist
job.description:
Operations & Innovation Specialist 

(Milwaukee, WI)

Good Karma Sports is seeking a full-time Operations & Innovation Specialist to join the Home Office Innovation Team, with a dedicated focus on supporting our Digital business & teammates.


This role will help teammates work smarter by identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation, and technology.


The ideal candidate is curious, creative, analytical, and action-oriented. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how things work, challenging the status quo, experimenting with new technology, and turning ideas into meaningful operational improvements.


Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build strong relationships with teammates to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes across departments and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate existing workflows, recommend improvements, and design, build, test, implement, and maintain AI-enaabled solutions and automations that improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Partner with leadership and the Home Office Innovation Team to prioritize projects and execute improvements.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to identify new ways to improve productivity and operations.
  • Develop clear processes, documentation, and training materials that help teammates adopt new solutions.
  • Support the successful rollout and ongoing adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of innovation initiatives, including time saved, improved efficiency, and increased operational capacity.
  • Collaborate with the Home Office Innovation Team and other teammates across Good Karma Sports to share successful solutions, improve workflows, and implement best practices.
  • Complete additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports by demonstrating our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for AI, emerging technology, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows and translate challenges into practical solutions.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code/no-code tools, CRM systems, or reporting tools is a plus.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and support change across teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance experimentation, execution, accuracy, and responsible technology use.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn new platforms and systems.
  • Valid driver’s license required.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a full-time, in-office, exempt salaried position offering a competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for growth as responsibilities and impact expand.

The position may require occasional evenings and weekends depending on project needs and operational priorities.


Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 25, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY. 

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. 13 News is a Gray Television station and the CBS affiliate in Tucson, Arizona. 70 years strong! We are the best local television station in Southern Arizona and the #1 digital platform. We are committed to the highest standards of excellence in our local news, entertainment, information, and public service programming. We produce 62 hours of live, televised newscasts per week between KOLD and our shared services partner, KMSB Fox 11. If you’ve never been to Tucson, let us tell you all the things you’ll love: Plentiful sunshine, natural beauty, diverse culture, active lifestyles, great food, hundreds of miles of hiking trails, breathtaking views, unforgettable sunsets, challenging biking trails, community events, accessible natural locations for all ages… it would have been quicker for us to just say you’ll love it all.

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • Your starting pay will be between $19.80 - $23.30 depending on your shift.

      -or-

Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.

job.title: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence (Remote)
job.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

Hallmark’s Data & Business Intelligence organization turns enterprise data into trusted insights that help teams across Hallmark make better, faster decisions. We build and manage the data platforms, pipelines, semantic models, and analytics solutions that support critical business areas including retail, product, consumer, merchandising, planning, finance, and executive reporting.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

We are looking for an experienced BI Engineer to design and build scalable, governed analytics solutions that enable trusted and intuitive access to enterprise data. This role will focus on developing Power BI semantic models, reusable business/context layers, and self-service analytics capabilities, leveraging Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and AI-assisted development practices. The ideal candidate will have 6–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or related areas, with strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, dimensional modeling, semantic model development, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. This role also requires an AI-first engineering mindset. The engineer will be expected to use approved AI capabilities to accelerate development, testing, documentation, optimization, and modernization while maintaining accountability for the quality, security, and maintainability of production solutions.

This is a progressive role that will be filled at the level based on the skills and experience of the selected candidate.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $110,000. Final compensation varies based on several factors.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States.
  • This is a progressive role designed to grow with you. We’ll match the job level to your skills and experience so you can hit the ground running and keep building your career.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • At lease 6 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including semantic model development, DAX, Power Query/M, dimensional modeling, Power BI Service, data security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and developing dimensional data models using star schemas, facts, dimensions, aggregations, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building shared and reusable semantic/business layers, rather than primarily developing individual reports.
  • Experience developing and implementing self-service analytics capabilities for business users.
  • Experience developing and optimizing SQL queries for performance and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Experience developing analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Understanding of modern analytical architectures spanning data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers.
  • Experience designing or developing modern analytical architectures that include data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Generative AI or AI coding assistants into real-world development workflows.
  • Ability to use AI effectively to generate, review, refine, and troubleshoot SQL, DAX, M, semantic-model metadata, documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Experience using AI across multiple stages of the development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, troubleshooting, optimization, and documentation.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness rather than accepting generated code without appropriate engineering review.
  • Experience applying responsible AI development practices, including data protection, security, validation, governance, and human accountability

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, and data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating and optimizing Power BI with Snowflake.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures and curated analytical data products.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git integration, deployment pipelines, source control, and DevOps practices for BI and analytics solutions.
  • Experience establishing BI governance, semantic-model standards, common metric definitions, and self-service analytics frameworks.
  • Experience modernizing legacy BI/reporting platforms to Power BI, Fabric, Snowflake, or other modern cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, business glossaries, or Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience developing AI-enabled accelerators, agents, reusable prompts, or automated development workflows for BI and analytics engineering.
  • Experience applying AI to accelerate BI modernization, report migration, semantic modeling, metadata management, testing, and self-service analytics.

 

COME JOIN US! Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.

Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Service Desk Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the PGA of America’s Service Desk. The Service Desk Supervisor ensures the delivery of high-quality technical support, drives process improvements, leads automation and documentation initiatives, and acts as a systems administrator for key organizational applications. This position also coordinates with the Event Technology Product Manager to ensure adequate support coverage during championship and travel seasons, including on-site event support as needed. This position is expected to provide advanced (Tier 3) technical support, lead technical projects, and coordinate with vendors and other technology teams as needed.

  • Create, implement, and support Service Level Agreements (SLAs), keeping ticket queues moving, documentation precise, and processes efficient.
  • Monitor and optimize ticket queues, prioritizing by urgency and business impact.
  • Ensure thorough documentation of issues, resolutions, and processes in the ticketing system.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex (Tier 3) technical issues, including hardware, software, network, and AV.

  • Deploy, manage, and maintain inventory for end-user and event devices.

Process Improvement, Automation & Documentation

The Software Engineer V is a highly experienced technical leader responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and continuously improving software systems that create meaningful business outcomes for the PGA of America and its members. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong product judgment, ownership, and collaboration. The Software Engineer V partners closely with Product Managers, designers, business stakeholders, and other engineers to translate complex business challenges into simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Partner directly with Product Managers and stakeholders to understand business needs, shape product requirements, and define effective technical approaches.


Translate ambiguous or complex business problems into elegant, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.


Lead the architecture and design of major software components, systems, and features.


Facilitate and contribute to collaborative Architecture Decision Record reviews to establish clear, durable technical direction.


Apply sound engineering practices, including test-driven development, behavior-driven development, code reviews, automated testing, observability, and continuous delivery.


Build, deploy, monitor, maintain, and improve reliable web applications and services throughout the software development life cycle.


Use modern AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery. Tools may include Cursor or comparable platforms.


Identify and implement improvements to engineering tools, processes, systems, and workflows that increase delivery velocity and product quality.


Proactively reduce technical debt and improve the maintainability, performance, security, and scalability of existing systems.


Communicate work, decisions, risks, prototypes, and learnings transparently through tools such as GitHub, Slack, and team demonstrations.


Manage project priorities, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables with a high degree of ownership and accountability.


Seek and incorporate customer, member, business, and market insights to inform high-value digital products and experiences.


Mentor and develop engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, design reviews, pairing, and constructive feedback.


Contribute to a culture of innovation, inclusion, continuous improvement, and high performance.


Help attract, develop, and retain a world-class engineering team.


INCLUSION:


Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 


SHARED VALUES: 

 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing. 


SUPERVISION:


No supervisory responsibilities. 


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:


No financial responsibility.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:


Bachelor’s Degree (B.A.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. 


Ten or more years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering production systems.


Demonstrated experience leading the architecture, implementation, and delivery of complex software applications or services.


Demonstrated experience with modern software development practices, including automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, observability, version control, and secure software development.


Experience working in cross-functional product teams and influencing technical direction without relying solely on formal authority.


Strong experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, preferably in AWS environments using CloudFormation, CDK, or comparable technologies.


SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: 


Job Knowledge/Technology:  Must have knowledge of and deep experience developing web applications and services using technologies such as Ruby on Rails, REST and/or GraphQL APIs, Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL; expert-level understanding of web application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and relational databases; strong knowledge of system design, scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability; the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and select appropriate solutions based on business needs, user impact, cost, risk, and long-term sustainability; and proficiency with modern development, collaboration, and productivity tools, including GitHub, Slack, and related platforms. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders.


Ability to travel up to 5%.


This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

In addition, to ensure full equality of opportunity in all operations and activities of the organization, every staff member employed by the PGA shall be selected under fair employment procedures that provide equal employment opportunities to all people. job.description:
Are you a sales professional who thrives on helping businesses grow? WPTV, The E.W. Scripps NBC affiliate in West Palm Beach, Florida, is seeking an Account Executive who will serve as a trusted advisor to local businesses, delivering innovative multi-platform advertising solutions that drive real results. You'll combine strategic thinking with relationship-building skills to help clients reach their customers through everything from broadcast television to cutting-edge digital marketing platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.

  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.

  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.

  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.

  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.

  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.

  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.

  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.

  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience.

  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred.

  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred.

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused.

  • Highly creative and innovative thinker.

  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills.

  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills.

  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels).

  • Strong time management and organizational skills.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint).

  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.).

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission

  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone

  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

West Palm Beach offers the perfect blend of professional opportunity and Florida lifestyle. Located in the heart of Palm Beach County, this vibrant coastal city boasts year-round sunshine, pristine beaches, and a thriving cultural scene. The downtown area features world-class dining, entertainment at CityPlace and Clematis Street, and the renowned Norton Museum of Art. Sports enthusiasts enjoy spring training baseball, professional golf tournaments, and easy access to water activities from fishing to sailing. The region's strong economy supports diverse industries beyond tourism, while maintaining a relaxed atmosphere that makes work-life balance achievable. job.description:

Scripps Sports is seeking a dynamic Scripps Sports Partnership Lead in Salt Lake City who will drive revenue growth by selling linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions across our acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory. You'll work with regional and national accounts to create customized advertising packages that connect brands with passionate sports fans.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.

  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City offers an unbeatable combination of urban sophistication and outdoor adventure. Nestled against the stunning Wasatch Mountains, you'll have world-class skiing and snowboarding at resorts like Park City, Alta, and Snowbird just 30-45 minutes from downtown. In warmer months, enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in Big and Little Cottonwood Canyons, or explore the unique landscape of the Great Salt Lake.

The city itself boasts a thriving downtown with excellent restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant arts scene including the Utah Symphony, Ballet West, and numerous galleries. Temple Square and the historic neighborhoods showcase the city's rich heritage, while the growing tech sector has earned Salt Lake City recognition as the "Silicon Slopes." With 300 days of sunshine annually, a lower cost of living than many major metros, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Salt Lake City provides an exceptional quality of life.

Sports fans will love being home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake (MLS), and Utah Hockey Club (NHL), plus easy access to outdoor recreation that rivals anywhere in the country. The city's central location also makes it a convenient hub for exploring Utah's "Mighty Five" national parks and other Western destinations.

If you're ready to do work that matters in one of the country’s most exciting cities, we have a great opportunity for a Producer with NewsChannel 5, The E.W. Scripps CBS affiliate in Nashville. You'll help inform, connect and serve communities across Middle Tennessee. Whether it’s breaking news, severe weather or the stories that make a difference in people’s everyday lives, this is an opportunity to be part of a newsroom that keeps its community at the center of the story.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and organize newscasts or local programs. 
  • Write story development and showcasing.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine content needs.
  • Enhance content with graphics, video, research, and station branding.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions.
  • Oversee live broadcast and up to the minute editorial decisions.
  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Post content to station's Web sites.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience  in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Avid local news consumer: knows daily news, events, trends and happenings on a local level
  • Strong vision and ability to advance stories
  • Excellent interpersonal communicator
  • Extraordinarily passionate about writing; courageous and creative storyteller with attention to even tiny details - choosing the perfect words, grammar, spelling
  • Highly organized
  • Highly adaptable - fast paced, deadline driven environment
  • Strong self-motivation
  • Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws and strong editorial judgement
  • Able to use web analytics
  • Proficient with newsroom computer systems, MS Office a plus 
  • Flexible work hours may be required, including holidays, weekends and evenings

Nashville is a city with plenty of personality, and there’s a lot more to it than its famous music scene. From live music and pro sports to great restaurants, parks, neighborhoods and weekend getaways across Middle Tennessee, there’s always something to explore. You can catch a show, spend an afternoon outdoors, find your new favorite local spot or simply soak up the energy of Music City. job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WGBA
job.description:
WGBA, the NBC affiliate in Green Bay, Wisconsin, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for an experienced Multimedia Journalist. In this role, you'll research, write, shoot, and edit stories for TV, digital, social platforms, and a 24/7 stream. You'll dig for community based stories that are hyper-local and matter to the viewers the station serves. Green Bay is a close-knit community with big-time energy and is home to the Packers. Downtown Green Bay has a growing mix of local restaurants, breweries, and the Titletown District, with year-round events along the Fox River. Whether you love summer on the water or a snowy Friday night at the game, this is a place where there's always a story worth telling. Apply today!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

job.title: Senior Reporter, KSBY
job.description:
At KSBY, we believe local journalism is most powerful when it happens where the story is unfolding. As our Senior Reporter, you'll be the face of our morning news coverage, bringing viewers the stories, voices, and issues that matter most across California's Central Coast. You'll spend your time in the field, reporting, developing exclusive stories, building community relationships, and serving as a trusted ambassador for the station. If you're a passionate storyteller who thrives on being where the news happens and enjoys connecting with the community you serve, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Generate original story ideas and develop content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Front morning newscast, report from the field and turn leading content for other newscasts.
  • Research, write, and deliver accurate, compelling stories that inform and engage audiences.
  • Cultivate a strong network of sources to uncover exclusive and enterprise reporting opportunities.
  • Identify the best angle, approach, and storytelling techniques for each assignment.
  • Serve as a mentor and resource for newer reporters in the newsroom.
  • Represent KSBY throughout the community by participating in station and local events.
  • Meet daily and long-term production deadlines while managing multiple stories and priorities.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle to cover assignments throughout the viewing area.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of reporting or related journalism experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company requirements
  • Ability to drive regularly as part of daily news-gathering responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional reporting and storytelling skills across multiple platforms
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities
  • A dynamic on-air presence with the ability to connect authentically with viewers
  • Advanced critical thinking and sound news judgment
  • The ability to develop enterprise stories and pursue leads independently
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset and a positive newsroom attitude.
  • A passion for community engagement and relationship building
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

OUR TEAM:

KSBY's newsroom is made up of curious, dedicated journalists who believe in the value of local news and community connection. We work collaboratively, support one another's growth, and celebrate great storytelling in all forms. Our team brings diverse experiences, perspectives, and interests to the newsroom, creating an environment where creativity, innovation, and public service journalism thrive.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Located along California's spectacular Central Coast, San Luis Obispo offers an exceptional quality of life with a unique blend of coastal beauty, outdoor adventure, and small-town charm. From world-class beaches and scenic hiking trails to renowned wineries, farmers markets, and a vibrant downtown, the region provides endless opportunities to explore and connect with the community you'll cover.


Whether you're catching sunrise along the Pacific, enjoying local restaurants and festivals, or discovering hidden stories throughout the Central Coast, San Luis Obispo is a place where professional fulfillment and personal lifestyle come together.

job.title: Video Editor
job.description:
News 4-Fox 11 is looking for a creative, detail-oriented News Video Editor to help bring local stories to life across broadcast and digital platforms. You’ll edit video for daily newscasts, breaking news and special projects while collaborating with reporters, photographers, anchors and producers. This role requires strong visual storytelling, accuracy and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom.

Responsibilities include:

  • Edit video for daily news coverage, special projects and digital platforms.
  • Receive and organize video feeds from news bureaus and other sources.
  • Work with newsroom staff to build compelling video elements for newscasts.
  • Meet daily deadlines and maintain accuracy and journalistic standards.

 

Preferred qualifications: A college degree or at least one year of related experience; familiarity with video-editing software; strong communication skills; and the ability to work collaboratively. Previous Sinclair station postings include similar responsibilities and qualifications.
