job.title: Morning Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
WCTI has an exciting opportunity for a full-time Morning News Anchor/Reporter. We are looking for a strong journalist who can lead morning newscasts with credibility, connect with viewers, and deliver meaningful stories across television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with excellent news judgment, a clear understanding of current events, and a passion for enterprise reporting. You should be able to dig for stories, conduct thorough research, write with clarity and edge, and use compelling storytelling and strong television production to make each story impactful and memorable. Dynamic live television and reporting skills are essential.

Responsibilities:

  • Anchor and help produce morning newscasts
  • Report, shoot, write, and edit news stories for broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Develop and pitch original, enterprise story ideas daily
  • Deliver live reports and breaking-news coverage as needed
  • Research, write, and present stories that are accurate, engaging, and relevant to the Eastern Carolina community
  • Maintain an active and professional social media presence to build your brand, promote stories, and connect with viewers
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, assignment editors, and the newsroom team to deliver high-quality coverage
  • Perform other duties as assigned by news management


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Previous anchoring experience is required
  • At least one year of on-air reporting experience is required
  • Live-shot experience is required
  • Strong writing, verbal communication, and on-camera presentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to enterprise stories and tell them creatively across platforms
  • Sound editorial judgment, strong research skills, and a commitment to journalistic ethics
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively in a collaborative newsroom environment
  • A valid driver’s license and good driving record are required
  • A link to recent work or a demo reel is required
     

Why WCTI/WYDO?

At WCTI and WYDO, you'll tell stories that matter while serving communities across Eastern North Carolina. You'll gain hands-on experience covering everything from breaking news and severe weather to enterprise and community-focused reporting—all while working in a newsroom committed to developing the next generation of journalists.

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel

job.title: Security Specialist
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Security Specialist Job ID 10164561 Location Southington, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 17, 2026 Security Specialist Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements The Global Security & Safety department is dedicated to protecting the safety, security, and well-being of ESPN employees, guests, facilities, and assets. Our team provides security and safety services across ESPN-owned and leased facilities, as well as remote events around the world. If you are a customer-focused security professional who can remain calm under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and provide a welcoming presence while maintaining a safe and secure environment, we encourage you to apply and Be A Part Of The Story! Responsibilities: Greet, screen, and assist employees, visitors, vendors, and guests in accordance with established security procedures. Enforce company security, access control, and parking policies consistently, professionally, and fairly. Monitor ESPN facilities and identify, address, and report potential safety and security hazards. Perform access control duties at high-traffic exterior posts, including vehicle and truck inspections in accordance with established procedures. Conduct X-ray screening of packages and mail following required certification and operating procedures. Monitor fire alarm control panels, interpret alarm indicators, determine the type and location of emergencies, and initiate the appropriate response within established timeframes. Complete and issue hot work permits and perform required inspections and fire watch assignments in designated hot work areas. Respond to medical, fire, security, and other safety-related emergencies and incidents in accordance with training and established protocols. Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive incident and security reports. Provide a professional security presence at on-campus and off-campus events. Assist with traffic and crowd management by operating gates, establishing barricades, and directing vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Perform routine security system checks and provide general assistance and information to employees and visitors. Assist with scheduling maintenance for company fleet vehicles and operate company transportation as required. Support Command Post and Global Operations Center operations and complete additional security-related assignments as needed. Basic Qualifications: Minimum of one year of customer service or related professional experience. Minimum of two years of experience in security, law enforcement, public safety, military security, or a related field. Valid Connecticut Driver's License and Connecticut Guard Card. Ability to successfully complete required pre-employment screening, including applicable background, DMV, and drug screening requirements. Flexibility to work varying schedules, including weekends, holidays, overtime, and adjusted days off as business needs require. Strong customer service, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and make effective decisions in high-pressure or emergency situations. Ability to take command of challenging situations while remaining calm, professional, and diplomatic. Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, guests, leadership, emergency responders, and other partners. Ability to work independently and carry out responsibilities within established policies, procedures, and guidelines. Professional demeanor and the ability to represent ESPN appropriately in all interactions. Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook and Word. Ability to operate company vehicles and transportation as required. Required Education: High School Diploma or equivalent. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $44,700 to $59,800 per year. The base pay actually offered will into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with ESPN, Inc, which is part of a business we call ESPN. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. ESPN, Inc is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Senior Account Executive, Advertising Sales
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).


Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a data-driven, results-oriented Senior Account Executive to drive podcast and digital media sales for some of the most recognized names in the creator marketplace. This role spans across multiple platforms—including Podcast, YouTube, and Social Media—offering a unique opportunity to work with high-profile creators and innovative brands.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive business development by identifying and cultivating relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders across advertising agencies and brands.

  • Develop and deliver tailored sales presentations that clearly articulate value and drive incremental revenue.

  • Prospect and pitch new business, expanding Red Seat Ventures’ footprint and share of client advertising budgets.

  • Sell various ad formats, including host-read endorsements, Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), video, and custom branded content integrations.

  • Manage the full sales cycle—from initial outreach and proposal creation through negotiation, closing, and post-sale account management.

  • Ensure flawless campaign execution, overseeing all aspects of delivery, reporting, and client satisfaction.

  • Create custom marketing and media solutions that align with client goals and optimize results across multiple platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to strategically manage high-value accounts and negotiate complex, multi-platform partnerships.
  • Deep relationships with direct clients as well as audio and digital buyers at major agencies. 
  • Understanding of the media landscape and evolving advertising ecosystem, including data-driven sales, branded content, and creator monetization models.

job.title: Field Photographer, NY Bureau
job.description:
Fox News is looking for an experienced Field Photographer to join our New York Bureau. In this role, you will cover breaking news and planned events domestically and internationally, collaborating with photographers, field technicians, satellite truck operators, engineers, producers, and reporters. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in fast-moving breaking-news environments, including protests, rallies, civil unrest, and conflict zones, using traditional ENG cameras. You must also be comfortable supporting high-end, multi-camera productions with full-frame cinematic cameras and professional lighting techniques. This physically demanding position requires long hours, extensive travel, and the ability to safely lift and transport heavy equipment. This is a Tuesday - Saturday schedule. 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deployed across all FOX News Media platforms, including FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business (FBN), and FOX Nation, and Fox Weather as coverage demands
  • Operate Sony ENG broadcast and cine cameras and manage file-based workflows
  • Edit using Adobe Premiere
  • Lead multi-camera and full-frame camera assignments
  • Configure audio for single and multiple camera set-ups
  • Operate LiveU and Starlink transmission systems
  • Safely operate company-owned and rental vehicles

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional field photography experience
  • Strong video photography and non-linear editing experience
  • Advanced lighting skills, including experience with long format shoots
  • Working knowledge of field audio mixers and multi-camera audio routing
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies and satellite newsgathering vehicles
  • Willingness to train on satellite-camera crew vehicles and larger vehicles
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure breaking-news environment
  • Flexibility to work across bureau, shooting, editing, and satellite-truck operations as needed
  • Availability to travel extensively and deploy on short notice for a 24-hour news operation, including overtime and weekends
  • A valid driver’s license, clean driving record, and valid passport; CDL preferred

job.title: Membership Advisor, Arena
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with leading brands, creators, and organizations to build and scale digital-first media businesses. We combine strategic insight, creative excellence, and operational rigor to deliver content-driven platforms that engage audiences and drive sustainable growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures, in partnership with FOX Corporation, is launching a new membership-based business centered around premium live entertainment experiences. We are seeking Regional Sales Directors to drive new memberships through compelling, relationship-driven sales experiences that convert interest into long-term membership.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, the Membership Advisor  will play a critical role in driving new memberships through high-touch, relationship-driven sales experiences. This role is ideal for an accomplished sales professional who thrives in a startup-style growth environment and excels at engaging discerning high-net-worth individuals. Success in this role requires the ability to convert trial experiences into long-term memberships while representing the brand with professionalism, credibility, and integrity.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive consistent new memberships by managing a robust pipeline of qualified prospects from initial outreach through close, using CRM, internal tools, and sales enablement systems to track activity, forecasting, and performance
  • Engage prospective members across multiple touchpoints, including phone, email, text, in-person meetings, and live event experiences, serving as the primary sales contact
  • Educate prospects, deliver tailored presentations, and convert trial experiences into memberships
    Actively initiate and participate in pipeline development activities, including networking, referrals, and partner relationships
  • Collaborate closely with Member Experience and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and a seamless transition from prospect to active member
  • Represent the brand at live events, trials, and hosted experiences, building trust, capturing insights, and advancing opportunities through the sales funnel
  • Maintain accurate and timely reporting of sales activity, pipeline health, and forecasted revenue in CRM
  • Contribute to the development of best practices, playbooks, and processes as the organization scales

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in a sales role with a proven track record of closing high-value opportunities, ideally with high-net-worth individuals or premium clients
  • Strong ability to build and sustain relationships through trust, credibility, and consultative selling
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline, track activity, and forecast revenue
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to individuals and small groups
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment where performance is closely tied to results
  • Highly self-motivated, organized, and capable of managing multiple opportunities while traveling frequently within territory

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience selling in hospitality, luxury services, private clubs, live entertainment, or experiential offerings
  • Background in startup environments or newly launched business units
  • Experience leveraging relationships and informal networks to generate referrals and new business
  • Familiarity with live event environments, premium venues, or membership-based models

job.title: Associate Sales Director
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Associate Sales Director to join our Emerging Business Sales Team. Associate Sales Directors establish new business, agencies, and client groups to secure advertising investment and ensure success of campaigns. You will tailor and pivot the NYT pitch and solution based on advertisers' needs and goals. Through a consultative approach, you will pitch to clients our full New York Times portfolio, which includes The Athletic, NYT Cooking, Wirecutter, NYT News, Games, Audio, and more.

About the Role

Your primary goal is to grow and diversify advertising revenue. You are a team player and contribute to the goals and success of The NYT's Advertising Department, and our mission. You will participate in an Incentive Compensation Program for account-based revenue as determined by Advertising Department Leadership. This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Head of Emerging Business. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Exceed assigned revenue goals by understanding client needs and recommending advertising solutions that support their goals.
  • Respond to inbound advertising inquiries, understand the advertiser's goals, qualify opportunities
  • Prospect for new business and identify potential advertisers and opportunities across assigned industries.
  • Build client relationships through thoughtful follow-up and communication by phone, email, and meetings.
  • Manage the RFP (Request for Proposal) process and create clear sales presentations for clients.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the Advertising department to share insights and deliver the best possible results for our advertisers.
  • Develop knowledge of New York Times advertising products, sales strategies, and standards.
  • Maintain opportunities in Salesforce to ensure sales management has a clear view of your pipeline and client interactions.
  • Attend and conduct client meetings and outings, being a professional ambassador for New York Times Advertising.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 1+ years professional experience
  • 1+ years of experience selling integrated digital advertising solutions
  • Experience building trusted client and agency relationships

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.
  • Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.
  • Shape, maintain, and execute the company’s long-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero-trust architecture standards.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time.
  • Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices.
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Skills:

  • Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3).
  • Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement.
  • Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
  • Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling).
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility.

What success looks like:

  • Security & Compliance: Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long-term security roadmap.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least-privilege access standards.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity.
  • Security Tooling Adoption: Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk.
  • Threat Detection & Response: Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Security Leadership: Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation.
  • AI Defense & Security: Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI-driven threats and emerging attack vectors.

job.title: LN Media & Sponsorship || Regional Brand Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Regional Brand Manager helps build and strengthen client relationships while owning the day-to-day delivery and fulfillment of strategic marketing partnerships for local and national brands. This Indianapolis-based role at 2 Amphitheaters and 2 Clubs and theaters collaborates with clients, venue teams, and internal partners to bring programs to life across multiple categories. 

  • Account Ownership: Take ownership of your assigned sponsorship programs and commitments while building strong relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Strategic Client Partnership: Engaging with brands year-round to understand evolving goals, bring forward ideas to optimize programs, and plan for future growth.
  • Market Ownership: Becoming the go-to expert on your venues, inventory, market, and open opportunities.
  • Venue Excellence: Preparing venues and sponsorship assets for the season and delivering consistent, high-quality execution on show days.
  • Financial Performance: Account forecasting, budget management, accounts payable, reporting, data analytics, and identifying trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with Sales to understand client commitments, strategy and planning to shape programs, product specialists to deliver the right solutions, and fulfillment and venue teams to execute each element; keeping everyone aligned and informed along the way.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

The best Brand Managers stay hungry. They keep learning, deliver consistently internally and externally, show up to every type of client interaction prepared and present, push to consistently meet client and divisional standards, and take ownership of the outcome, not just the task. Here's what that looks like day to day.


Account Ownership & Client Strategy

  • Know the business inside and out: how Live Nation Media & Sponsorship contributes to company revenue, the products and assets we offer, what's in each of our venues, where the sales team is focused, and which teams you'll partner with to deliver every client commitment.
  • Know your regional and national clients just as well, including their objectives, KPIs, audiences, and what success looks like to them, so you can put the right Live Nation products, inventory, and business solutions to work for them.
  • Execute regional and national sponsorship programs in line with contract deliverables, timelines, and venue requirements, from strategic planning through measurement.
  • Serve as a key day-to-day contact for assigned accounts, venues, and markets, in partnership with the relevant account and venue teams.
  • Hold yourself to a high standard with everyone you work with: be professional, be a great teammate, manage your time, follow through on every commitment, and own your results.
  • Coordinate the sponsorship contract process with Legal and other teams, tracking approvals and helping move agreements forward accurately and on time.
  • Manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor spending and financial risk, and partner with Finance on related financial documents, accurate reporting, and revenue recognition.
  • Build relationships beyond day-to-day client contacts and stay connected with clients year-round through regular meetings and conversations about their evolving business goals and priorities.
  • Create client-facing pacing updates, recaps, reports, and presentations that use KPIs and client feedback to communicate results and recommend ways to optimize programs.
  • Partner with Sales on renewal planning, using client insights and program results to identify opportunities to strengthen and grow each partnership.

Market Excellence & Venue Readiness

  • Become the go-to expert on your market(s), including venue operations, sponsorship inventory, existing partner programs, sales opportunities, market dynamics, and ways to operate more efficiently.
  • Own sponsorship execution on assigned show days, coordinating on-site logistics, activations, venue requirements, and sponsorship event staff from pre-show through close.
  • Lead preseason preparation so every sponsorship asset and activation area is ready by opening day, and partner with venue teams on end-of-season winterization.
  • Partner with Regional Sales and National Brand Management to spot opportunities and shape sponsorship packages using available inventory, client needs, and venue capabilities based on local nuances.

Concert Execution & Staffing

  • Serve as on-site sponsorship coverage at assigned concerts and key engagements, including client hospitality and custom events.
  • Plan schedules and sponsorship coverage across 100+ shows each year, balancing overlapping events, activation deadlines, and staffing needs.
  • Schedule, train, and direct Sponsorship Event Staff for assigned events and alternate show coverage, providing clear briefings, execution guidance, and post-event follow-up.
  • Keep clients and internal partners informed with clear, timely communication on show announcements, presales, day-of-show needs, and post-event follow-up.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build strong relationships with venue teams, Sales, Legal, Finance, SES, senior leadership, and other Live Nation partners to keep programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with Brand Management counterparts across regions to share best practices, resolve challenges, and strengthen consistency across regional and national programs.
  • Stay curious. Bring audience insights, marketing trends, and emerging technologies to the table to develop fresh activation ideas and keep programs ahead of the curve.
  • Support additional sponsor-related projects and department priorities as requested by management.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, entertainment, marketing consulting, sales, advertising, or activation agencies.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Strong client service instincts, diligent follow-up, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and a calendar of 100+ shows a year at the venue, balancing overlapping schedules, staffing needs, and client deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, venue teams and event staff.
  • A proactive, organized, and collaborative working style. You anticipate needs, meet deadlines, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow, with the drive to stay engaged, ask questions, and show up prepared and present every day.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adjust priorities, respond to changing business needs, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Experience coordinating event staff to deliver flawless on-site programs.
  • Familiarity with marketing programs that connect in-person experiences with digital components preferred.
  • Knowledge of consumer and market research, with the ability to translate insights into client recommendations and performance reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Asana, Airtable, Slack, Keynote, AI tools, social media tools, or graphic design applications preferred.
  • Strong financial management skills, including the ability to maintain multiyear budgets, monitor expenses, and prepare reliable forecasts.
  • Attention to detail when reviewing program and financial results, including the ability to identify errors, explain trends, and highlight opportunities.
  • A passion for music, live events, branding, and current entertainment trends.
  • Ability to be based in the Indianapolis area, provide regular on-site coverage at assigned venues, and travel within the market and surrounding areas as needed, including nights and weekends.
  • Reliable transportation to and from assigned venues and the office.
  • Ability to lift items weighing up to 50 pounds as needed.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

THE ROLE

The LATAM Tax Director owns the tax function for Live Nation Entertainment’s Latin American operations (including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru). This individual contributor sets the regional tax strategy, makes and recommends the tax decisions affecting the region, and is accountable for the accuracy, efficiency and risk posture of direct tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing and global minimum tax matters across all LATAM jurisdictions.


Operating with a high degree of independence, the Director defines how the region responds to a rapidly evolving Latin American tax landscape, determines the positions the company takes on complex and often unprecedented technical matters, and serves as the authoritative tax voice to regional and corporate leadership. Fluency in Spanish is required.
 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Regional Tax Strategy & Governance

  • Own the LATAM tax strategy, including the annual and multi-year regional tax plan, and align it with corporate tax, finance and business objectives.
  • Establish the governance framework, policies and controls under which tax is managed across LATAM jurisdictions, and hold the region accountable to them.
  • Determine and document the company’s technical tax positions for the region, exercising independent judgment on complex, ambiguous and precedent-setting matters.
  • Own the regional tax risk profile: identify, quantify, prioritize and mitigate exposures, and escalate material matters with a clear recommended course of action.
  • Anticipate and interpret regulatory change (SAT in Mexico, AFIP in Argentina, Receita Federal in Brazil and other comparable authorities), assess business impact, and direct the company’s response.


Tax Provision, Compliance & Reporting

  • Oversee LATAM direct and indirect tax compliance — income tax, VAT/IVA and withholding taxes — and ensure appropriate governance and consistency across jurisdictions.
  • Own the tax provision and reporting for LATAM entities under US GAAP and IFRS, including the judgments underlying uncertain tax positions, valuation allowances and effective tax rate drivers.
  • Lead LATAM implementation of and compliance with Pillar Two and Country-by-Country Reporting, including data readiness, modeling of outcomes and the region’s filing strategy.
  • Direct the regional tax calendar and set the standard for quality, timeliness and audit-readiness of all filings and disclosures.
  • Serve as the region’s decision-maker and technical authority in partnership with the U.S. and global tax teams on matters affecting LATAM.

Transfer Pricing & Intercompany

  • Own the tax implications of intercompany transactions across the region and the design and defense of regional transfer-pricing positions.
  • Direct the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation, local files and intercompany agreements, and approve the methodologies applied.
  • Assess the regional impact of changes to the intercompany operating model and recommend structural adjustments to leadership.

Audit & Controversy

  • Lead LATAM tax audits and controversy end to end, including strategy, negotiation posture, settlement recommendations and coordination of consistent positions across countries.
  • Own root-cause analysis of audit findings and drive the process, documentation and control changes required to eliminate recurring exposures.
  • Manage regional tax advisor and external auditor relationships, including selection, scope, budget, performance and resolution of tax matters.


Transactions & Structuring

  • Lead and advise on LATAM tax planning for cross-border transactions, repatriations and cash-movement strategies, and recommend the approach the company adopts.
  • Own tax due diligence for regional M&A and joint ventures, evaluate identified exposures, and advise deal teams and senior leadership on materiality and mitigation.
  • Determine the optimal structure for new entities, joint ventures and market entries, and direct implementation.
  • Evaluate the existing regional structure for tax inefficiencies and lead the design and execution of optimization initiatives.
  • Negotiate tax provisions, permanent establishment protections, and indirect and withholding tax terms in transaction documents, in partnership with Legal.

Process, Systems & Controls

  • Lead the tax workstream for the Cumulus SAP rollout across LATAM, setting the standard processes, procedures and best practices for the region.
  • Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities enabled by expanded data and ERP functionality.
  • Own the design and operating effectiveness of tax-related internal controls for LATAM, including Sarbanes-Oxley documentation, and guide local teams through financial audit requirements.


Stakeholder Leadership & Influence

  • Act as the senior tax business partner for LATAM, advising regional and corporate leadership on the tax consequences of business decisions and influencing outcomes accordingly.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Treasury and Human Resources on payroll tax, permanent establishment, employment structuring and other cross-functional tax matters.
  • Represent the company with tax authorities, external advisors and industry groups on LATAM tax matters.
  • Build regional tax capability by mentoring and developing finance and accounting colleagues across LATAM, and by delegating and reviewing the work of advisors and junior professionals.

Scope & Decision Authority

  • Individual contributor with no direct reports; leads through influence, delegation to external advisors, and direction of in-country finance teams.
  • Sets policy and strategy for the LATAM tax function with a one- to three-year horizon.
  • Operates with minimal supervision; work is reviewed for strategic alignment rather than technical accuracy.
  • Regularly communicates and negotiates with executive leadership, external advisors and tax authorities on matters of material financial consequence

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law or a related field; CPA, Contador Público, tax law qualification or Master’s in Taxation strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 12 years of progressive international tax experience, including substantial LATAM multi-jurisdiction responsibility gained in a multinational corporate tax department, Big 4, or comparable professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a regional or multi-country tax function, including accountability for technical positions, risk and audit outcomes
  • Deep technical command of LATAM direct and indirect tax regimes, transfer pricing, tax treaties, permanent establishment risk and cross-border structuring.
  • Working knowledge of Pillar Two / OECD BEPS 2.0 and Country-by-Country Reporting, with practical implementation experience preferred.
  • Strong US GAAP and IFRS tax accounting and provision expertise (ASC 740 / IAS 12).
  • • Proven ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders and to translate complex technical matters into clear business recommendations
  • Experience leading tax workstreams within an ERP implementation (SAP preferred)

job.title: Director, Incident Response & Security Operations
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


We are seeking an extremely technical Director to serve as Live Nation Entertainment’s Incident Commander and lead Incident Response for the US region. When an incident hits, you run it: you direct the investigation, drive containment and remediation, brief executives, and coordinate with Legal, outside counsel, and our incident response retainer firm.


Reporting to the Vice President, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) and Operations, you will also own the functions that feed incident response: our 24x7x365 Security Operations team, detection engineering, and threat intelligence, across Live Nation Entertainment’s global technology environment. You will partner with two regional IR leads to deliver follow-the-sun coverage for a global business.


This is a leadership role for a hands-on responder. You can review a packet capture, challenge a forensic timeline, and explain business impact to the executive team on the same day. You own the budget, vendor relationships, and metrics for the function, and you are accountable for faster detection and containment, better incident outcomes, and using automation and AI to help a large, global team work faster and make better decisions.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Incident Response & Incident Command

  • Lead all security incidents as Incident Commander, from triage through closure, including ransomware, eCrime, business email compromise (BEC), account takeover, insider threats, data exposure, and third-party or supply-chain compromise
  • Conduct and manage incident response investigations, including host and network forensic analysis (packet capture, NetFlow, proxy, DNS, and firewall logs), log and memory analysis, malware triage, and timeline reconstruction, with defensible evidence handling and chain of custody
  • Personally step into or take over investigations when they stall, escalate, or need senior technical judgment
  • Lead cloud incident response across AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as SaaS and identity platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), including response to credential, token, and control-plane abuse
  • Coordinate with two regional IR leads on follow-the-sun coverage, including structured handoffs of active incidents at each shift change (status, evidence, open actions, and pending decisions) so investigations continue without losing context
  • Own incident remediation: build tactical and strategic remediation plans tailored to each incident, drive containment, eradication, and recovery with Infrastructure, Engineering, Cloud, and business owners, verify that remediation is complete, and turn root-cause findings into new detections and hardening across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Coordinate with outside counsel, including investigations conducted under attorney-client privilege, and with Legal, Privacy, and Communications on regulatory, contractual, and public-company disclosure decisions (e.g., SEC cyber disclosure rules, GDPR, U.S. state breach-notification laws, PCI DSS)
  • Own and mature the Cyber Security Incident Response Plan, playbooks, escalation paths, and out-of-band communication plans (for when email, chat, or identity systems are compromised) in line with NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0; run executive and technical tabletop exercises at least annually
  • Prepare the team and decision playbooks for high-impact scenarios, such as ransomware, extortion, and bot, credential-stuffing, or DDoS attacks during major on-sales and live events; work with Legal, the cyber insurer, and executives on decisions like system shutdown, restoration priorities, and engagement with threat actors

Incident Communication

  • Brief the CISO and executive leadership during and after incidents in plain business terms: what happened, impact, risk, decisions needed, and next steps; support communications with regulators and other external parties in coordination with Legal
  • Communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology clearly to responders, engineers, and partner teams during active incidents
  • Write or review incident reports, root-cause analyses, and after-action reports for accuracy, consistency, and completeness

Security Operations, Detection Engineering & Threat Intelligence

  • Own 24x7x365 monitoring, triage, and escalation, with defined service levels for alert response and incident handling
  • Lead detection engineering: own detection strategy and coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and drive detection-as-code, testing, tuning, and false-positive reduction across SIEM, EDR/XDR, NDR, cloud, and identity telemetry; lead proactive threat hunting informed by intelligence and incident findings
  • Lead the threat intelligence function: set intelligence requirements with the business, track threat actors relevant to ticketing, live events, and e-commerce, and turn intelligence into detections, hunts, and executive briefings
  • Partner with Vulnerability Management and Penetration Testing on zero-day response and on red and purple team exercises that validate detection and response

AI, Automation & Metrics

  • Use AI technologies to improve decision-making and efficiency across incident response and operations, such as AI-assisted triage, enrichment, investigation summaries, and SOAR playbooks, with clear human oversight, quality checks, and measured results
  • Prepare the team to detect and respond to threats against AI-enabled products and agents used across the business
  • Define, track, and report metrics, including mean time to detect, contain, and remediate; share of incidents detected internally; detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK SLA attainment; closure of post-incident actions; and automation and AI impact

Team Leadership

  • Lead, build, and scale a 24x7x365 team of incident responders, SOC analysts, detection engineers, and threat intelligence analysts, including managers, across multiple countries and time zones; hire, develop, and retain top talent
  • Set the strategy, operating model, and capability roadmap for incident response and security operations, and run incidents, projects, and priorities with clear plans, owners, and deadlines
  • Coach and mentor the team, and build an inclusive culture of accountability, composure under pressure, and continuous learning, including blameless post-incident reviews

Budget, Vendors & IR Retainer

  • Own the budget (headcount, tooling, and services) and vendor relationships, including the incident response retainer, MDR/MSSP partners, and threat intelligence providers; manage retainer hours, scope, and readiness, and hold vendors accountable to contractual SLAs

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Experience serving as Incident Commander on high-severity, business-impacting incidents
  • Extremely technical, hands-on background: proven experience conducting and managing incident response investigations in large enterprises, including ransomware, eCrime, BEC, and targeted intrusions
  • Hands-on experience in network forensic analysis, with a strong understanding of network architecture, security control placement, and baselining normal traffic, plus host forensics (Windows, macOS, Linux), memory analysis, and basic malware triage
  • Cloud incident response experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure (deep experience in at least one), plus identity investigations across Active Directory and Entra ID, and SaaS investigations
  • Track record of incident remediation: building and driving remediation plans to verified completion
  • Strong ability to communicate with executives and regulators, and to communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology effectively to internal teams
  • Experience coordinating with outside counsel, cyber insurers, and law enforcement during incidents
  • Proven experience using AI technologies to improve decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, increase efficiency, and drive business outcomes
  • 12+ years in cyber security, including 8+ years in incident response or digital forensics
  • 6+ years leading technical teams, including at least 3 years managing managers, with a track record of leading large, geographically distributed teams across countries and time zones in a 24x7x365 environment
  • Experience with SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM), EDR/XDR (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender), SOAR, and NDR platforms; able to write and review queries and detection logic
  • Experience owning a budget and managing vendors, MDR/MSSP partners, and incident response retainers
  • Ability to influence and drive action across teams you don’t manage, including during disagreements under pressure
  • Highly organized, with strong program management discipline and a track record of defining and reporting operational metrics
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-61, ISO/IEC 27035, and MITRE ATT&CK, and of regulatory requirements relevant to a global, public, payment-processing company (e.g., PCI DSS, SEC cyber disclosure rules, GDPR)
  • Calm, decisive judgment under pressure, high ethical standards, and discretion with confidential information
  • Availability 24x7 for escalations and major incidents, including nights, weekends, and holidays; some domestic and international travel
  • Ability to pass a background check, in accordance with applicable law
  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Desirable

  • Experience leading a detection engineering function (detection-as-code, ATT&CK coverage, testing and tuning)
  • Experience leading a threat intelligence function (intelligence requirements, actor tracking, turning intelligence into detections and hunts)
  • Incident response consulting experience at a leading firm, or experience leading a large enterprise CSIRT
  • Experience in ticketing, e-commerce, live events, media, or other high-traffic consumer platforms
  • Relevant certifications, such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCFR, GCTI, GSOM, CISSP, or a cloud security certification (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft SC-200, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer)
  • Experience building or maturing an AI-enabled SOC or agentic security workflows

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

WHO ARE WE?

Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world, promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking, and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Production Manager is responsible for the on-stage, backstage, show settlement, and technical details of concerts and events at Live Nation-operated Venues.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Coordination between tour and/or client production and the LN venue.  Advancing and obtaining presale technical information, including production needs, rider requirements, staging and capacity changes.
  • Interface with local contractors (vendors), tours, clients renting Live Nation venues and venue production teams for all show requirements, including stagehands, runners, security, casual labor and rental equipment, with an emphasis on quality, reliability and cost.

You embody our core values of Keep It Simple, Be Inquisitive, Win Together, and Own It. You're naturally curious: you want to learn how things work, from the source systems to the business processes behind the data, so you can find ways to improve them. You're a versatile high performer who makes AI part of how you work. You are skilled in building consensus, making data-driven decisions, and delivering world-class data products, with AI as a force multiplier. You persuasively advocate for an idea, but you stay open-minded and prioritize rigorously. You have a bias toward action. Most of all, you love to dig in and build amazing things with your team, always pushing the envelope.


THE ROLE

Live Nation Core Data Services (CDS) team is looking for a Product Manager to create internal data products, primarily for marketing and operations teams. A major part of this role is helping engineering teams ingest data sources from operations worldwide into a single global data platform on which our data products are built. You'll work with internal customer groups to ideate, define, build, and launch data products that drive outcomes across business functions and markets. This includes onboarding data from new business domain streams, enforcing data contracts, and shaping domain models before the first layer of transformations lands.

 

This is a key role on an entrepreneurial team with the resources, exposure, and customer base of the world's leading live entertainment company. The person we're looking for will combine passionate product management with discipline and a keen attention to detail, and will build trust throughout the business. We need research and iterative validation driving technical solutions. We need someone who manages a roadmap and backlog, often feeding more than one engineering team, and who clearly defines success criteria and post-launch measurement requirements, all of which is found in their documentation. You'll also help us raise the bar on how a product team works with AI, both in your own workflow and in making our data easy for AI tools and agents to use.

 

This role is built for growth: as you establish yourself, you'll take on additional domains and broader responsibility. It's a highly visible role on a high-performing, global team.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more data domains, and connect priorities to business outcomes.
  • Get up to speed quickly on in-flight work, producer relationships, and stakeholder commitments.
  • Lead discovery with internal customers and source-system producers; translate business needs into clear technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Work with source-system teams on data contracts, agreeing on shape, grain, and quality before data lands.
  • Partner with data engineers on delivery, from intake and design through launch, adoption, and iteration; manage dependencies and surface risks early.
  • Define and track success metrics for your area: adoption, freshness, data quality, and consumer impact.
  • Investigate data directly: write SQL against production data to validate requirements, profile sources, and confirm that what shipped is correct.
  • Own documentation for your domain (definitions, lineage, tags, and known gaps) so people and AI tools can find and trust the data.
  • Use AI tools daily for discovery, analysis, requirements, and documentation, and share what works with the team.
  • Communicate status, trade-offs, and changes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

 

AI COMPETENCIES

  • Hands-on AI use: You use AI assistants and coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, or Databricks Assistant and Genie) as part of daily work: drafting SQL, synthesizing research, prototyping, and drafting specs.
  • Critical evaluation: You check AI output against source data and real behavior before acting on it or sharing it, and you can explain why an answer is wrong.
  • AI-ready data: You understand what makes data usable by AI, and you build that into your product requirements.
  • Specs that agents can execute: You write requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for an engineer, or an engineer's AI agent, to build from without guessing.
  • Responsible use: You know the basics of how LLMs work (context, retrieval, hallucination) and apply data privacy and governance rules when data is used with AI tools.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of product management experience, ideally on data, platform, or technical products.
  • A strong data background; experience in BI, analytics, or data engineering is a plus.
  • Experience connecting directly to data sources and writing your own SQL. Familiarity with Python, Spark, or Databricks, enough to read a notebook or pipeline and follow what it does, is a big plus.
  • Working knowledge of how data moves from source to consumption (ingestion, modeling, and delivery) in batch and streaming systems.
  • Demonstrated, practical use of generative AI tools (AI assistants, prompt engineering, agent workflows) to improve your own work, with examples you can walk through.
  • Experience writing requirements that turn business needs into technical requirements, plus Jira and agile story writing.
  • Working knowledge of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, including consent and data subject requests, and how they shape data products.
  • Experience with customer or behavioral data is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable facilitating discussions across technical and business teams.
  • Comfortable managing several projects at once and prioritizing between competing stakeholders.
  • Willingness to work across time zones and outside normal hours when needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A passion for live music and events is a plus.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to inclusion and fairness

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

The role / Position overview

The FT's B2B division licenses content and information solutions to organisations worldwide. We're looking for a driven Business Development Manager to grow our corporate licensing business across the Banking and Financial Services sector in North America.

You'll develop and implement a strategic sales plan, build relationships with senior decision-makers and win new business. Supported by a Sales Development Representative and colleagues across marketing and customer success, you'll join a collaborative team with opportunities to grow as we expand across the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a strategic sales plan to drive growth across the North American Banking and Financial Services sector.
  • Take ownership of achieving annual new business revenue targets.
  • Handle the assigned travel budget efficiently, prioritising face-to-face meetings with prospective clients.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to identify and deliver activities that support new business acquisition.
  • Work closely with customer success colleagues to find opportunities and coordinate activities that drive new business.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior decision-makers and key collaborators at prospective client organisations.
  • Represent the Financial Times at relevant industry events, building networks and developing an understanding of emerging sector trends.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities and opportunities in Salesforce.

Required skills / experience

  • Shown track record of developing new business and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience in solution-based sales, ideally within the online information or subscription services industry.
  • Experience selling into the Banking and Financial Services sector.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to articulate a compelling value proposition to senior partners.
  • Ability to work independently, handle priorities and maintain motivation in a remote working environment.
  • Strong initiative, commercial awareness and a proactive approach to identifying new business opportunities.
  • Ability to build effective networks and relationships both internally and externally.
  • Well-developed influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to secure commitment from prospective clients and internal collaborators.

What's in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is 90,000-95,000, along with a commission package. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skills; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs. The disclosed range estimate is for our NYC office and has not been adjusted for other locations.

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may use AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

SPRING INTERNSHIP 

APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR STUDENTS: 11/20/2026 

SPRING INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DATES: 1/11/2027 – 4/16/2027  

*The Songwriters & Composers Wing Intern position pays county/state minimum wage rates, based on work location. 

 

 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

 

The Recording Academy Songwriters & Composers Wing is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team. 


Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others. 


Our paid Internship Program offers a unique opportunity for full-time college students (juniors or seniors) to gain on-site training in office administration, events management and artist relations, in exchange for college credit. Candidates should be energetic, hard-working and have aspirations of a career in the music industry. 

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 

  • Internship duration is for a semester (12 weeks or equivalent). 
  • Hours are part-time (20-24 hours a week). 
  • Intern will work with the chapter office on local events during regular business hours as well as some evenings and weekends. 
  • Internship will provide in-depth exposure to professional recording industry techniques and practices. 
  • Projects may include assistance with event management, educational programs, newsletters, membership recruitment, database management, demographics analysis, and administrative office support. 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE  

 

  • Currently enrolled in a college/university. One year of course work towards degree in related field is preferred. 
  • Letter from school stating that intern will receive college credit for the Recording Academy internship. 
  • Display an interest in music and commitment to a career in the recording industry. 
  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills. 
  • Exhibit proficient computer skills. 
  • Be a junior, senior or graduate student. 


PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES:   

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.   


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time. The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.   

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES 

 

RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators. 

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY 

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation. 

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION 

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives. 

 

MUSICARES 

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs. 

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM 

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include GRAMMY in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

This is a 24-week contract from January 4  - June 20, 2027, and can be based anywhere in Canada.


NOTE: If you are an internal candidate applying for this contract, it is advisable to let your manager know so that they are supportive when it comes to releasing you for the job if you are the successful candidate.


Now or Never is a show that jumps into the action with Canadians who are doing things that take a bit of extra nerve, and nudges listeners to make a leap too. Now or Never pursues stories that are personal, “now” and original. We shine a light on Canadians in authentic moments of vulnerability, and make an extra effort to capture action as it’s unfolding.


As an Associate Producer for Now or Never, you always have your eyes and ears open for people who are in the middle of a Now or Never moment. You are a dogged chaser, relentless about tracking down guests and fearless about getting personal.  


As an idea-generating machine, you come up with original and focused story ideas and pitch them effectively in meetings. 


You love coming up with creative treatments for all platforms, including digital and social.  And you are experienced in gathering sound and images in the field, and weaving those elements into a compelling story arc. 


You are a strong critical thinker and solid journalist. You have a deep understanding and appreciation of diversity of perspective, opinion and experience, and reflect that in the content you create. 


Working under the direction of Now or Never’s Senior Producer, the Associate Producer will be expected to deliver one to two stories per week from inception to execution.


Key Tasks:


  • Generating and pitching focused story ideas and treatments which adhere to Now or Never mission and values
  • Chasing, pre-interviewing and booking guests; writing scripts; and recording audio in the field 
  • Identifying the best method for gathering sound and visuals for a story, whether it’s a field recording, studio link, video call, etc. and ensuring the appropriate technical resources are in place
  • Preparing scripts, background, and question lines and ensuring hosts are briefed prior to interviews
  • Editing audio and multitrack sound mixes quickly and creatively 
  • Producing story segments for web and social platforms using CBC style and employing digital storytelling best practices
  • Actively participating in story meetings and evaluation of all aspects of the production in feedback meetings and listening parties
