Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Data Protection Specialist, to design, lead and evolve the Corporation’s data security program. 

In this role, you will provide technical and operational leadership to safeguard sensitive data and personal information throughout the data life cycle (collection, processing, storage, transmission, archiving and destruction). You will collaborate closely with Legal Services, privacy officers, enterprise architects and IT Operations to align data security with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Define data security strategy: Develop and refine the road map for the Corporation’s data protection program.
  • Implement data classification: Establish and deploy data classification policies and frameworks.
  • Administer data protection technologies: Select, deploy and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) tools.
  • Protect cloud and hybrid environments: Design security controls tailored to cloud-hosted data and hybrid architectures.
  • Partner on compliance and policy frameworks: Work closely with the policy, compliance and legal affairs lead to align security controls with statutory requirements.
  • Manage the data security risk register: Document, maintain and map risks related to confidentiality, potential data breaches and approved exceptions.
  • Adjudicate and govern exception requests: Evaluate, document and follow up on exception requests when standard security controls cannot be immediately applied, ensuring appropriate compensating controls are established.
  • Lead data breach response: Actively participate in investigations of suspected or confirmed data breaches in co-ordination with the Information Security, Legal Services and Incident Response teams.
  • Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
  • Assess program maturity: Plan and conduct periodic evaluations, performance reviews and audits of data protection controls to identify gaps, measure maturity progress and formulate recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years’ experience in data protection, privacy security, DLP or data governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
  • Proven track record of implementing and evaluating technical data protection programs within large, complex organizations.
  • Deep technical expertise in data protection, including cryptography (encryption at rest and in transit, PKI), DLP tools (network, endpoint, cloud), CASB technologies and SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Young people are struggling to land that first job at a time when artificial intelligence and technology are changing the workforce. Canadians are faced with a myriad of complex economic realities.


We’re looking for people who are excited to show up to work knowing anything can happen on their watch, thrives when news breaks, and have a keen interest in the way money and the economy shapes the lives of Canadians.


On the business beat, you will focus on the intersection of money and everyday life. This means looking beyond the market and financial headlines to break down and bring home complex economic stories.

You will actively track economic, corporate, consumer and policy shifts both nationally and in your region with the goal of helping Canadians understand the financial and money forces that are affecting their lives.


Your task would be to break news and build a pipeline of memorable original stories. You'll experiment with various formats and platforms, from graphics and social media to radio and TV. You’ll have the voice and reporting chops to explain business news and bring to life economic stories.

About the First Peoples Program


The First Peoples: Tell Us a Story initiative is a specialized professional development program designed to build bridges between First Peoples and Radio-Canada. It aims to amplify Indigenous voices in the media while nurturing lasting, reciprocal relationships with Indigenous communities.


Building on the success of its 2025 pilot, the initiative returns this year with a redesigned format. This paid training opportunity has been expanded to eight (8) weeks and will focus on the craft of storytelling. Throughout the program, you will hone your skills through hands-on workshops led by both Indigenous and non-Indigenous media professionals. You will also have a dedicated platform to share your stories, showcase your culture, language and lived experiences, and highlight your community's achievements.


We are looking for four (4) individuals from First Nations, Inuit or Métis communities ready to take the next step in their media careers.


The program runs full time for eight (8) weeks, from February 1st to March 26, 2027. Full-time availability, Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (ET) for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.


This program is in hybrid mode (remote work with required travel to Montreal and a regional station).


Candidates must meet the following eligibility requirements:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Self-identify as First Nations, Inuit or Métis.
  • Be available full time for the duration of the program (February 1st to March 26, 2027).
  • Be willing and able to travel for three (3) separate five-day sessions during the eight (8) weeks (travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada).
  • Be able to work and communicate in French (reading, writing and speaking). 

Who You Are:

  • You have a working proficiency in French across speaking, reading and writing. 
  • You have a genuine curiosity about news and current affairs, paired with a passion for storytelling.
  • You have an open, collaborative attitude.
  • You are eager to learn new things.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace tools is an asset.

Program Overview:

As part of this second cohort, you will complete an eight-week learning curriculum running from February 1st to March 26, 2027.


The program includes the following:

  • Orientation and Onboarding: Settle into the cohort and preview your training plan through a combination of virtual sessions and in-person activities in Montreal. 
  • Theory Instruction (Three (3) weeks, Virtual): Build foundational journalism skills across digital writing, audio/radio storytelling and video production, culminating in one (1) to three (3) portfolio-ready pieces. 
  • Regional Station Placement: Shadow and work alongside Radio-Canada journalists at a regional station to experience the day-to-day rhythm of an active newsroom.
  • Professional Development (Virtual): Take part in sessions designed to support your learning and development. 
  • Closing Week (Montreal): Wrap up the program alongside your peers with a final week of hands-on activities. 

Workplace and Technical Requirements :

The theory instruction will take place primarily online; however, you must be available to travel to Montreal and to a regional station during designated periods. All required travel and accommodation expenses are fully covered by Radio-Canada.


Please note:

  • You must have access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection.
  • You must have access to a desktop computer, laptop or iPad Pro. 
  • Any specialized production gear required for your training modules will be provided by Radio-Canada for the duration of the program. 

Full-time availability for the entire eight-week program is mandatory.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Role Vision and Impact

 

The Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

 

The mission of this strategic role is to protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations. The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

 

Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the Board of Directors (BoD), the Audit Committee, the CBC/Radio-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET) and the T&I Management Executive Team (MET).

 

Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations

  • Develop, champion and execute an enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
  • Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
  • Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
  • Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

 

Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and Broadcast/Operational Technology (OT) Environments

  • Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
  • Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

 

Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance

  • Oversee the governance function responsible for developing, maintaining and enforcing policies, standards, security architecture principles, exception management and industry frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, AI frameworks).
  • Lead the third-party and partner risk management program (covering vendors and technology contracts) in close collaboration with the Legal Services and Procurement teams.
  • Co-develop a governance, compliance and ethical framework for the enterprise-wide use of AI and generative AI, assessing specific risks throughout their life cycle.
  • Ensure strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., Quebec’s Law 25, GDPR and sector-specific requirements).
  • Drive a cybersecurity culture and awareness program focused on lasting behaviour change across the organization.

 

Defence Operations, SOC and Crisis Management

  • Oversee the performance and modernization of the Security Operations Centre (SOC), advanced detection tools (SIEM, EDR/XDR, automation) and continuous threat monitoring.
  • Direct major security incident response operations and lead technology crisis management, from detection to full business recovery.
  • Oversee regular penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and cyberattack simulation exercises across IT, broadcast and distribution environments.

 

Identity and End-User Technology

  • Guide the strategic vision for Identity and Access Management (IAM, PAM) to provide secure, simple and frictionless access for all staff and contractors.
  • Collaborate closely with the End-User Technology teams to align security with a modern, efficient and intuitive employee experience.

 

Financial Management and Team Engagement

  • Plan and optimize the cybersecurity department’s overall budget and partner with internal procurement teams to negotiate major technology contracts.
  • Inspire, coach and develop a team of directors and senior managers — fostering excellence, innovation and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead with the heart.

 

Qualifications, Experience and Core Competencies

 

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, computer engineering, business administration (IT concentration) or a related field.
  • At least one recognized executive-level professional certification: CISSP, CISM, CCISO, CISA or CRISC.

 

Professional Experience

  • Seven to 10 years of experience managing professional teams or equivalent.
  • Deep expertise in technology architecture, cloud security, network infrastructure, cryptography, and identity and access management (IAM).
  • Ability to provide collaborative leadership within the organization to see complex, transformational initiatives through to completion.
  • Demonstrated skills in planning, organizing and engaging teams.
  • Proven ability and track record in leading cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to work with cross-functional, agile teams or on projects that have multi-team dependencies.
  • Ability to distil complex issues into clear, concise presentations and reports.
  • Expertise in the various technologies typically used by journalists in a newsroom.
  • Knowledge of business practices, including drafting plans and specifications, contracts, negotiation, finance, and IT management software.
  • Knowledge of software development and the technology infrastructure required for product delivery.
  • Knowledge of workflows for content acquisition, management and distribution, with a focus on storytelling.
  • Innovative approach to technical and operational challenges, paired with sound judgment to protect CBC/Radio-Canada from legal liability and financial loss.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with an ability to engage and influence stakeholders and partners at every level of the organization.
  • Excellent ability to listen to and communicate with people having different points of view or competing business objectives.
  • Experience implementing product governance models.
  • Ability to travel occasionally between Montreal and Toronto.
  • Bilingualism (English and French), both spoken and written.

CBC News is expanding its financial and consumer storytelling to help Canadians navigate complex economic realities. Affordability remains top of mind for most Canadians. Young people are struggling to land that first job at a time when artificial intelligence and technology are changing the workforce. Canadians are faced with a myriad of complex economic realities.


We’re looking for people who are excited to show up to work knowing anything can happen on their watch, thrives when news breaks, and have a keen interest in the way money and the economy shapes the lives of Canadians. 


On the business beat, you will focus on the intersection of money and everyday life. This means looking beyond the market and financial headlines to break down and bring home complex economic stories.  You will actively track economic, corporate, consumer and policy shifts both nationally and in your region with the goal of helping Canadians understand the financial and money forces that are affecting their lives.


Your task would be to break news and build a pipeline of memorable original stories. 

You'll experiment with various formats and platforms, from graphics and social media to radio and TV. You’ll have the voice and reporting chops to explain business news and bring to life economic stories.


Data excites you. You use charts, graphs and explainers to provide clarity and context in our storytelling. This role emphasizes mobile-first and vertical video storytelling tailored to reach younger, diverse, and underserved audiences where they consume media.

  • Participates in all aspects of the production; and brings a willingness to appear on camera for production shoots, as required.
  • Experience writing short-form and vertical video for presentation on mobile and streaming platforms that describes complex business, financial and consumer information in a clear and concise manner.

  • Solid journalistic skills, including an understanding of legal risk, and demonstrated understanding of CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.

In this role, you'll build new agency and brand relationships, manage and grow your own book of accounts, and turn test campaigns into ongoing, scaled programs. You'll work closely with senior sellers, leadership and teams across the company to drive new business and carry out digital campaigns.   • Manage and grow a book of assigned accounts and agencies.
  • Meet quarterly and annual revenue goals according to the sales plan.   • Help move performance-driven advertisers from initial test campaigns to ongoing programs, using results data to show value and grow spend.

  • Provide responsive, high-quality service to drive customer satisfaction for direct response accounts.
  • Partner with the operations organization to set proper expectations with customers and meet their needs.
  • Build presentations and proposals for brands and agencies.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders, including product marketing, research, account management and more, to maximize advertising revenue.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

Required Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in media, digital, audio, advertising or direct response sales (or a related client-facing role)
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude
  • Knowledge of performance marketing concepts (e.g., CPA, ROAS, attribution)
  • Familiarity with digital and social platforms; in-depth knowledge of podcasts a plus
  • Organized and self-motivated, able to manage multiple accounts and priorities
  • Results-driven and eager to grow within a national sales organization

Preferred Experience:

  • 3+ years of account executive, sales or sales planner experience, ideally with direct response or performance advertisers
  • Experience with podcast advertising, including host-read campaigns
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and audio attribution or measurement partners

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

Your precision and professionalism ensure that every show, every ad, and every moment reaches our audience with clarity and impact. You help us fulfill our promise to be there for our listeners—whether they’re commuting, working, or winding down—making you an essential part of the iHeartMedia mission.

  • Social Media creation of content

  • Operate broadcast console and studio equipment during live and pre-recorded shows.
  • Monitor on-air programming for quality, timing, and compliance with FCC regulations.
  • Coordinate with talent, producers, and traffic teams to ensure smooth transitions and accurate commercial placement.

The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Multi-Market Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer (Level B)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTTV Fox 11 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Transmitter and Studio Engineer to support both our primary broadcast transmitter facility atop Mt. Wilson and our  West Los Angeles production studios.

This role is perfect for a technician with strong troubleshooting instincts who wants a diverse workday. You will split your time between maintaining cutting-edge television studio gear and taking ownership of our high-power transmission systems.

Key Responsibilities

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

  • Primary Site Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

  • Infrastructure & Power: Monitor critical site support systems, including site-located IT systems, microwave and terrestrial signal transport systems, satellite downlinks, UPS and generator systems, and other site-located equipment.

  • Emergency Restoration: Respond to transmitter outages, which includes driving up to the Mt. Wilson site in various weather conditions to keep the station on the air.

  • Compliance: Ensure the transmitter site complies with FCC standards.

Studio & Control Room Maintenance (West LA)

  • Broadcast Equipment Repair: Install, configure, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, and audio consoles.

  • Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain the central router, master control systems, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless video and audio delivery.

  • Newsroom IT Support: Assist with the upkeep of newsroom computer systems, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, and automation systems (like Sony ELC).

  • System Integration: Wire and integrate new equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast gear as our studio technology evolves.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

  • Experience: 2–3 years of experience in electronics repair, studio AV setup, IT/networking, or military technical roles. (A technical degree or equivalent training is highly valued).

  • Technical Aptitude: A solid grasp of signal flow, electrical safety, and how to use basic tools (such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and hand tools).

  • IT Knowledge: Basic IT/networking skills (IP addresses, subnets, switches, PC’s ).

  • Driving & Logistics: Must have a valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and the confidence to drive mountain roads in rain, fog, or light winter conditions.

  • Physical Demands: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders, and work comfortably behind equipment racks.

  • Availability: Ability to work a flexible schedule, including being on-call for emergency transmitter or critical studio outages during off-hours.

  • Cable Management: Experience with soldering, custom cable fabrication, and reading schematics.

Nice to Haves (But Not Required):

  • Any background in amateur (Ham) radio, telecommunications, or basic RF. Training will be available on the high power transmitter systems.

  • 2 Year degree (or higher) in a technical subject such as IT, Electronics, etc.  

  • Experience with SMPTE 2110, compressed signal encoding/decoding, DANTE, NDI

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Reporter/Anchor for our evening news block. The person chosen for this role will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.


You’ll focus on reporting big news of the day, adding depth and context to stories in our newly formatted early evening news block from 5:00-6:30pm. Then you’ll transition to our redesigned newsroom, where you’ll anchor 90 minutes of live, unscripted news, while operating our Tricaster switcher. You’ll end your day, anchoring our 10pm linear news broadcast from our primary studio.


Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital-first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless of format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter.  We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have an insatiable curiosity about the world around you, from local and state government and how decisions by elected officials impact our audience to a daily understanding of what’s happening globally and the ability to take complex subjects and make them compelling and relatable.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have a relentless commitment to accuracy in your reporting, whether scripted or unscripted. You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.  Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background. 


We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

job.title: Manager, TV Audio Infrastructure
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This position requires weekly travel to WWE shows (Raw, Smackdown, Live Events and PLE's), both domestically and internationally, based on the show schedule.


Position Summary

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

 

Technical Leadership

  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
  • Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

Project Management

  • Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
  • Demoing new audio technologies.

Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
  • Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

 

Operational Support

  • Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
  • Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
  • Understanding Dante platforms.
  • Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
  • Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
  • Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
  • Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

Key Competencies

  • Broadcast systems infrastructure
  • Audio engineering expertise
  • Project planning and execution
  • Problem-solving under pressure

job.title: Production Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are:

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This is a contract position through end of August 2027. This role requires heavy travel from late May through late June. Candidates must be available for an extended international travel commitments during this period and comfortable with a fixed-term engagement.

What You’ll Do:


This is a fantastic opportunity to join IMG as a Production Coordinator, where you’ll be at the center of a fast-paced, high-profile sports production, driving planning, logistics, and shoots alongside a seasoned production team.

If you’re organized, proactive, and excited by sports, this is your chance to be part of something truly special.


Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Provide key production coordination support across the production, working closely with the Production Management team to ensure the smooth running of the production in the office, remote hub, and onsite.
  • Organize shoots and onsite bookings, including arranging clearances, film permits, and associated logistical planning such as transport, accommodation, and catering.
  • Book and coordinate crew, including onboarding, scheduling, and creating Work Orders via the payment portal.
  • Liaise with third‑party suppliers and process invoices as required.
  • Liaise with internal departments (including Legal, HR, Finance, and Immigration) to assist with securing visas and work permits when required.
  • Create and distribute detailed call sheets and risk assessments, acting as a key point of contact for crew.
  • Track costs on a daily basis, working closely with the Accounts Assistant to monitor spend, process invoices, and raise purchase orders.
  • Troubleshoot and respond to ad‑hoc production queries and duties in conjunction with the Production Manager.
  • Complete post‑production paperwork, including music cue sheets, PAPs, and archive and music clearances where applicable.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with internal facility providers and external suppliers.
  • Assist with the creation and distribution of production documentation, including call sheets and studio information.
  • Champion IMG’s Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion initiatives and actively support the organization's mental health programs.
  • Assist in implementing all health and safety procedures, including risk assessments.
  • Work closely with colleagues across pre‑production, production, and post‑production to support IMG’s GreenToScreen sustainability goals and reduce the production’s carbon footprint wherever possible.
  • Carry out other duties within the scope and purpose of the role as required.

Skills and Abilities

  • Positive, professional, and proactive approach to work.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • A collaborative team player with clear and confident communication skills.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and manage workload effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Calm, resilient, and solutions‑focused under pressure.
  • Able to work independently with initiative, as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Computer literate with experience using a range of project management and production tools.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven experience in a Production Coordinator role, ideally with international experience across a range of projects, including live OBs and/or remote production operations.
  • Strong ability to support cost management of production budgets, working closely with Production Managers and Finance teams.\
  • Knowledge of production and post‑production technologies and workflows.
  • Understanding and practical experience of archive and music clearance processes.
  • Knowledge of production insurance and health and safety requirements.
  • Experience working directly with clients and on‑screen talent.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational capability.
  • Confidence in managing large crew teams during pre‑production and event time.
  • Experience working with international teams and stakeholders where English is not a first language (essential).
  • Multi‑language skills (desirable).

Working Conditions

  • The work location is Stamford, CT
  • This is a fixed term contract until August 2027
  • Some international travel may be required

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is seeking a hardworking, enthusiastic, and travel-ready Production Assistant to join our TV Production Road Crew. The Road Crew is a division of WWE Media, responsible for executing all aspects of TV production on the ground for WWE’s weekly lineup of shows including RAW on Netflix, SmackDown, NXT, Premium Live Events and more. The Road Crew is a group of highly motivated and talented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, high stress environment.

  • Work directly with WWE’s Executive Producer and Director regarding the execution of all show related elements
  • Collaborate with WWE’s Creative Team and Producers on overall show direction
  • Coordinate backstage crews for LIVE and pre-taped segments and vignettes
  • Communicate directly with WWE’s broadcast partners including Netflix, USA, The CW, and Peacock
  • Work closely with Partners regarding in-show integrations
  • Coordinate rehearsals with Producers and Talent
  • Work seamlessly with WWE HQ’s Media and Business divisions including Domestic & International production, Promos, Digital/Social, Graphics, Global Partnerships, Talent Relations, Communications, Music and many more
  • Liaise with WWE Superstars, On-Air Talent, WWE Executives, and Business Partners
  • Field Produce Off-Site Shoots and Events with WWE Talent and Executives
  • Keep current with WWE programming, storylines, talent, partners and products
  • Positions to include: Commercial AD, Tape AD, Floor Manager, Stage Manager

 

Qualifications:

  • Previous LIVE TV or production experience strongly preferred
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • This position will require extensive travel (90%)

Job Summary: Job Requirements This Supervising Director role is responsible for the supervision of personnel and projects across Studio, Remote and/or Event productions, as well as the direction of the department’s most complex and highest profile productions. The Supervising Director will work within the department to maintain the quality of presentations through oversight while providing direction across multiple departments through collaboration. In addition, will work in conjunction with Coordinating Producers to provide support and guidance on content philosophy and execution. The Supervising Director should possess strong production and technical knowledge, and demonstrate leadership qualities in all interactions and decisions. The Supervising Director will assist in the development of Director s, Associate Director s and Stage Managers. Responsibilities: • Oversight of multiple studio, remote and/or REMI production projects. • Collaborates with production partners to launch productions and maintain standards, plus identifies workflows to suit changing business needs. • Organizes and leads meetings for assigned projects, both within and across departments, to develop production and operational strategies. • Proficient with all aspects of set design, animation packages, show budgets and remote planning. • Has expert ability to direct the broadest possible range of productions including ESPN’s highest profile shows. • Responsible for staff oversight with concentration toward Associate Director s and Stage Managers. • Provides consistent and comprehensive feedback to Director s, Associate Director s and Stage Managers. • Establishes regular feedback and review sessions with all members of Directing. • Participates in the weekly Directing management meeting. • Leads teams to drive innovation and new workflows that embrace technology. • Builds monthly schedules for Director s, Associate Director s and Stage Managers. • Identifies, implements and tracks staff development opportunities. • Contributes to the team’s recruitment and retention objectives. • Holds staff accountable to maintain the Directing Department performance standards. Qualifications: • Minimum 7 years directing experience with demonstrated leadership and mentorship skills. • In-depth knowledge and proficiency with live directing. • In-depth knowledge and proficiency with production equipment and facilities. • Strong ability to think and react quickly to rapidly changing situations in a high pressure environment. • Strong interpersonal skills. • Travel may be required. Preferred Qualifications: • Demonstrated proficiency with all aspects of set design, animation packages, show budgets and remote planning. • Appreciation of popular culture and assistance in defining ESPN viewer tastes. • Ability to assess and evaluate job performance, leadership skills, directing skills, forward thinking. • Bilingual (English/Spanish). KTTV Fox 11 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Transmitter and Studio Engineer to support both our primary broadcast transmitter facility atop Mt. Wilson and our  West Los Angeles production studios.

This role is perfect for a technician with strong troubleshooting instincts who wants a diverse workday. You will split your time between maintaining cutting-edge television studio gear and taking ownership of our high-power transmission systems.

Key Responsibilities

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

  • Primary Site Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

  • Infrastructure & Power: Monitor critical site support systems, including site-located IT systems, microwave and terrestrial signal transport systems, satellite downlinks, UPS and generator systems, and other site-located equipment.

  • Emergency Restoration: Respond to transmitter outages, which includes driving up to the Mt. Wilson site in various weather conditions to keep the station on the air.

  • Compliance: Ensure the transmitter site complies with FCC standards.

job.description:
Job Title

Workflow Engineer, 1

Job Description

AI Workflow & Automation Engineering

  • Prototype and productionize new AI-driven automations.

  • Design and implement Slack features including slash commands, message actions, interactive modals, triage flows, and user-friendly bot behaviors.

  • Develop frameworks, templates, and reusable automation components to accelerate future workflow builds — both for code-first builds and for our low-code stack (n8n, Zapier, Google Workspace Studio).

  • Raise concerns when a proposed approach has technical risk, and help shape a better path forward.

Retrieval, Data Pipelines & AI Quality

  • Build and refine retrieval pipelines, vector stores, data-sync workflows, hashing/diffing systems, and content preprocessing pipelines.

  • Implement structured outputs, evaluation loops, hallucination prevention methods, and AI quality assurance systems.

  • Maintain and improve RAG pipelines using content from Confluence, Google Sheets, Jira, Slack logs, and other internal knowledge sources.

Backend, Reliability & Production Readiness

  • Build and maintain backend services, REST APIs, and serverless orchestrators powering our internal automation platforms.

  • Implement logging, monitoring, retry logic, structured error handling, and observability to keep our automations production-grade.

  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows, testing practices, and version-controlled deployment patterns.

Cross-Team Enablement & Expansion

  • Partner with teams across People Inc. to identify processes that can benefit from intelligent automation or AI augmentation.

  • Translate business needs into reliable automated workflows and internal tools.

  • Contribute to documentation, change management procedures, and the overall evolution of People Inc.'s internal AI platform.

  • Take initiative to propose new AI-enabled enhancements, systems, or assistants the organization has not yet defined.

What You'll Likely Work On in Your First 6 Months

  • Dottie as a service: help extract Dottie (our L1 tech support triage agent) from the existing in-process #it-techsupport implementation into a standalone API, define quality metrics, and onboard at least one new consuming surface.

  • Reusable build patterns: turn our "Slack workflow + AI matcher + Apps Script" pattern into proper templates with example code, intake forms, and stakeholder-facing docs so future builds ship faster.

  • Stack-level upgrades: identify where our current Sheets-based audit logs, Apps Script glue, and ad-hoc retrieval should graduate to more durable infrastructure, and help drive the migration where it makes sense.

Required Skills

Background

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Core Engineering

  • Solid experience with Python and JavaScript; comfort working in Apps Script, or willingness to become fluent.

  • Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integrations.

  • Experience building and shipping services that have run in production.

AI & LLM

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, OpenAI APIs, embeddings, retrieval pipelines (RAG), and prompt engineering.

  • Familiarity with data normalization, indexing, content segmentation, and retrieval basics.

Cloud & Systems

  • Experience with Google Cloud, particularly Cloud Functions (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM a plus).

  • Experience building on Slack via the SDK, Bolt, or Events API, including interactive UI components.

  • Experience integrating with Jira and similar APIs.

Preferred Skills (Not Required)

  • Experience with low-code or iPaaS tools (n8n, Zapier, Make) used alongside code.

  • Background in agentic workflows or LangChain.

  • Exposure to observability tools and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience designing systems with reliability and a real user-experience focus.

  • Experience operating internal tools — running them, watching usage, iterating — not just building them.

  • Knowledge of Confluence APIs, content hashing, or knowledge retrieval.

  • Experience containerizing AI workloads (Docker) or working with vector databases.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Engineers who think in systems, not isolated tasks.

  • Builders who enjoy being a strong technical contributor on a small team and want their work to ship and get used.

  • Developers who care about reliability, uptime, and high-quality user experience.

  • Technologists who stay curious about emerging AI advancements and adopt them responsibly.

  • Problem-solvers energized by complex, cross-functional technical challenges.

job.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Product Manager

Job Description

About The Position

We're seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product strategy for our knowledge graph and content platform that connects People Inc.'s content, taxonomy, usage rights, and audience signals across 30+ brands, reaching over 100M users monthly. Alongside our content system of record, it powers discovery, personalization, and editorial tooling through GraphQL APIs, search and indexing, and vector-based retrieval. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and product strategy: building scalable, reusable, self-service capabilities that let other teams ship faster without custom work from us.

As a senior IC partner to the engineering leads of Graphene Foundation, Graphene Services, and Search, you will define and champion the roadmap for core platform capabilities and shape how our services are consumed by both developers and AI agents. Success requires technical depth, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance long-term architectural coherence with the tactical needs of consuming teams. This role reports to VP of Product, Core Platform.


Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.
 

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategic Roadmapping

  • Define and maintain a roadmap across the Foundation (content store, GraphQL engine), Services (APIs, relationships, taxonomy, validation), and Search (indexing, site search, internal search) sub-teams, aligned with company goals and engineering priorities.
  • Prioritize investments against the platform's guiding principles: a connected foundation, trust and transparency, enabling intelligence, and self-service.
  • Make deliberate tradeoffs, focusing as much on what not to build as what to include.
  • Define and track platform leverage metrics, such as team adoption, time to first integration, engineering hours saved, search relevance and latency.

Platform-as-a-Product Thinking

  • Champion the platform as a product, not a set of endpoints, through careful, opinionated curation.
  • Avoid the "feature shop" trap by recognizing patterns across brand and team requests and designing extensible, self-service capabilities, such as a generic relationship service that can link data from many sources.

Cross-Org Orchestration

  • Lead multi-team initiatives that span platform engineering, editorial, Data Science and consuming program teams.
  • Partner with editorial, legal, and rights stakeholders as the platform becomes the source of truth for asset rights, attribution, and lineage.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between teams, aligning stakeholders around shared technical outcomes and influencing without authority.

Internal Developer Experience

  • Treat internal product development teams as primary customers, improving API and schema usability, documentation, and onboarding.
  • Lower the barrier to entry so external teams can integrate without hands-on support from our team.
  • Build strong feedback loops and solve real developer pain points with empathy and insight.
  • Shape agent-ready interfaces, such as MCP servers for search, that let other teams and AI agents use our capabilities on a self-service basis with appropriate access controls and guardrails.

Operational Excellence

  • Partner with engineering to ensure reliability, stability, and performance of GraphQL, indexing, and retrieval services as data volume and audience-signal complexity grow.
  • Champion SLOs, observability, and data quality as foundational product attributes, and treat maintenance and stability as first-class roadmap work.


 

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education: Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, and/or equivalent experience.


Experience: 5+ years in product management, including 3+ years owning platform, API, data, or developer-facing products in a B2B or internal tools setting.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong technical fluency with API-driven platforms, including GraphQL or similar schema-based APIs, data modeling, and distributed system tradeoffs; able to read schemas and technical designs and challenge them constructively.
  • Working knowledge of search and retrieval systems, including indexing, relevance, and vector databases; experience with knowledge graphs, taxonomy, or metadata systems is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns and emerging agentic tooling, such as MCP, and a point of view on how platform services should be exposed to AI agents.
  • Proven success leading technical products that span multiple teams or business units.
  • Deep fluency in partnering with engineers on architecture, tradeoffs, and system design.
  • Track record of avoiding reactive build cycles by thoughtfully prioritizing platform focus and extensibility.
  • Ability to define and use data to measure platform outcomes, including adoption, reliability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, able to influence without authority and translate technical tradeoffs for senior engineering, editorial, and business stakeholders.

job.title: Art Director
job.description:
Job Title

Art Director

Job Description

People Inc. is the largest digital and print publisher in America. From mobile to magazines, nearly 200 million people trust us to help them make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. has more than 40 iconic brands, including PEOPLE, Entertainment Weekly, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, Food & Wine, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, and Southern Living. We are building engaging experiences that excite users and amplify the voices of our brands.


We are seeking an Art Director — New Initiatives to work closely with the Senior Creative Director and partners across marketing, editorial, product, commerce, and growth. This new role specializes in branding and marketing design for paid memberships and premium products, including Southern Living Insiders, as well as other cross-brand and net-new initiatives. The Art Director will help develop distinctive identities, launch campaigns, and scalable creative systems that express the value of premium experiences and engage audiences across channels.


As Art Director — New Initiatives, you will be responsible for leading the visual development and execution of high-visibility, high-value initiatives from concept through launch and ongoing optimization. You will create and evolve identity systems, premium brand expressions, and integrated marketing campaigns; translate strategy into clear, compelling creative; and provide flexible senior-level design capacity that can shift as organizational priorities change.


Responsibilities

Own assigned branding, campaign, and premium product design projects from brief through launch and ongoing optimization, following established processes to ensure smooth delivery of creative assets.

Partner with the Senior Creative Director to establish the visual direction for Southern Living Insiders and other priority initiatives, ensuring execution is distinctive, premium, and consistent across teams and channels.

Lead the creation of identity systems, launch assets, integrated marketing campaigns, and scalable toolkits and templates that work cohesively across digital experiences, editorial touchpoints, and promotional channels.

Collaborate with marketing, editorial, product design, commerce, growth, and cross-brand partners to translate business goals and audience insights into effective creative.

Build and maintain identity guidelines and creative systems, and continually optimize work using campaign performance, audience learning, and stakeholder feedback.


II. Essential Job Functions


Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


30%

Creative Direction

Provide creative direction for Southern Living Insiders and other new initiatives; communicate brand standards clearly and ensure a consistently premium level of execution across internal teams and external partners.


30%

Design

Use business requirements, audience insights, and stakeholder feedback to design premium visual assets, including identity systems, launch materials, integrated marketing campaigns, static and motion creative, and reusable templates.


30%

Collaborate Across Marketing, Editorial, Product, Commerce, and Growth

Lead the visual direction for launches, acquisition and retention campaigns, audience engagement, editorial integrations, and cross-brand initiatives.

Present strategic design concepts and solutions, articulate the rationale behind the work, and build consensus among a broad range of stakeholders.

Help build and maintain a collaborative, inclusive, and creatively ambitious culture within the design team.

Lead and participate in brainstorming and critique sessions that foster big-picture thinking, strengthen concepts, and raise the bar on craft and premium brand expression.


10%

Process Management

Keep project plans and tickets up to date, communicate progress and dependencies, maintain organized files and reusable assets, monitor stakeholder feedback, and meet deadlines across multiple concurrent initiatives.


III. Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered.


Education:

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent education and experience


Experience:

3–5 years as an Art Director and 5–10 years as a designer, with experience leading brand and marketing work from concept through execution


Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Strong typography skills

Strong integrated brand and marketing campaign design skills

Strong identity system and brand guideline development skills

Working knowledge of motion graphics

Proficient in Figma

Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects, and Premiere

Experience in publishing, media, membership, subscription, or other premium consumer products

A portfolio demonstrating brand identities, premium product launches, and integrated marketing campaigns

Self-directed, adaptable, and comfortable moving between priority initiatives

Strong attention to detail

Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills

A collaborative team player ready to work in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

Job Title

Principal Product Manager

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 


People Inc. is seeking an experienced and strategic Principal Product Manager to lead initiatives across our Health portfolio, with a focus on product innovation, healthcare professional experiences, and companion apps. In this role, you’ll own the product strategy and roadmap for key experiences that help audiences take action on their health and create new opportunities for business growth.


As a senior individual contributor, you’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data science, editorial, marketing, and commercial teams to build intuitive, trusted, and innovative experiences that drive engagement and deepen loyalty.



Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 
In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team: | The Team and/or Brand.

The Health product team develops and executes the roadmap for People Inc.’s Health portfolio, including HEALTH and Verywell Health. Its work spans consumer products, healthcare professional offerings, and advertising innovation, with a focus on connecting trusted health information to useful experiences across our brands and partner platforms.



About The Positions Contributions:

Weight %

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

25% - Product Leadership

  • Drive the long-term product vision and strategy for key initiatives across the Health portfolio.
  • Establish and track measurable goals and KPIs aligned to user needs and business objectives.
  • Act as the voice of the user, advocating for intuitive, impactful experiences that build audience trust.
  • Maintain a strong product point of view that connects consumer value with commercial opportunity.

25% - Product Discovery & Delivery

  • Lead discovery processes including problem framing, research, prototyping, and validation.
  • Translate insights into actionable product solutions through iterative experimentation and refinement.
  • Manage the full product development lifecycle in partnership with engineering, design, and external partners.
  • Ensure timely, high-quality execution of roadmap initiatives.

20% - Strategic Roadmapping

  • Define and evolve a product roadmap that balances near-term wins with long-term growth.
  • Integrate brand priorities, user feedback, commercial opportunities, and technical constraints.
  • Proactively communicate roadmap updates and rationale to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Adapt roadmap direction based on performance outcomes, business priorities, and audience behavior.

20% - Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with business leaders, engineering, design, editorial, marketing, and commercial teams to align goals and priorities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional decision-making with clarity, transparency, and influence.
  • Build strong partnerships that enable cohesive execution across brands and external partners.

10% - Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with analytics and data science to design experiments, define success metrics, and measure impact.
  • Use data to inform product direction, validate hypotheses, and surface new opportunities.
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights to support continuous product improvement.



The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: B.S. or B.A. required and/or equivalent experience.

Experience: 7+ years in product management, with substantial experience leading consumer-facing digital products and launching new experiences.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Proven success leading products that span multiple teams or business units, ideally in health, media, or consumer technology.
  • Deep understanding of analytics, consumer engagement, A/B testing, and agile product processes.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous opportunities into clear product strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Strong commercial judgment and an orientation toward outcomes, user needs, and brand integrity.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority and align cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience with mobile apps, AI-powered experiences, healthcare professional products, or advertising and sponsorship models is a strong plus.
  • An understanding of privacy and audience trust considerations in health-related products.

Job Title

Senior Enterprise Security Engineer

Job Description

People Inc is looking for a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer with a demonstrated track record of innovative thinking, technical expertise, and execution. You’ll be responsible for maintaining (and raising) the security posture across our infrastructure and end-user SaaS applications and endpoints, designing and implementing enterprise security solutions, and reducing toil through automation.


As a highly visible professional within the Security team, you will be responsible for helping to set technical direction for enterprise security, managing technical projects, and partner with other groups within the organization to deliver tools and services that align with our security roadmaps.


Remote or Hybrid 3x a month 

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance to one of our offices in New York, Des Moines, Birmingham, Los Angeles, orChicago, the expectation is to work from the office three times per month.


About the Position's Contributions:

Security Engineering

  • Harden systems for cyber resilience including Operating Systems, and Network Devices and SaaS platforms
  • Architect and design log management systems to collect security events across multiple log sources
  • Perform orchestration and automated response (SOAR)
  • Oversee vulnerability remediation

Architecture And Design

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to security architecture activities and initiatives
  • Define security architecture roadmaps and/or strategy
  • Determine security requirements and security controls
  • Provide design and oversight into identity and access management (IAM)
  • Perform threat modeling and reporting

Data Loss Prevention

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to data loss prevention activities and initiatives
  • Develop and implement strategies for Data Loss Prevention and architect and design DLP solutions and technologies
  • Perform risk assessments to identify gaps in DLP coverage

Identity And Access Management (IAM)

  • Architect and design IAM solutions and technologies including Single Sign On (SSO), Multi-factor authentication, Password-less authentication
  • Evaluate and inspect current IAM access permissions to verify their ongoing necessity
  • Conduct risk-based analysis of users and groups across the enterprise and cloud infrastructure

Compliance

  • Oversee adherence to internal policies or standards
  • Understanding various compliance standards
  • Interpret standards, requirements and their application to the enterprise environment
  • Provide leadership, guidance and subject matter expertise to compliance and audit teams
  • Recommend, document and monitor the implementation of any prescribed corrective actions resulting from risk assessments

About You:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security with 3+ years of experience as a Security Engineer with a focus on securing end user SaaS applications, user endpoints, and associated infrastructure.
  • Experience with hardening infrastructure including network devices, and operating systems.
  • Experience deploying and customizing security tools.
  • Fluent in one or more modern coding languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, etc.).
  • Experience with one or more infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
  • Experience with one of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with one or more authentication technologies (Okta, Keycloak).
  • Experience with one or more LLM/GCP technologies (ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Google Gemini, etc.)

Interpersonal Skills

  • Passion for enterprise security and continuous learning.
  • Able to concisely communicate security risks to both technical and business audiences.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, and as part of a team.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work effectively.
