job.description:
Job Title

Benefits Manager

Job Description

The Benefits Manager will assist with the design, implementation, administration, and promotion of our employee benefits programs across People Incorporated. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Benefits, this individual will collaborate to ensure that People Incorporated’s benefit offerings remain highly competitive, fully compliant with regulations, and aligned with overall organizational goals. This role requires an experienced professional with vendor management expertise and project management skills to support benefit initiatives, manage partner relationships, and drive program rollouts.


The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.


About The Position

Benefits Strategy & Administration

  • Manage employee benefits programs across the People Incorporated portfolio, including healthcare, life/disability, 401(k), voluntary benefits, and leave management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for employee benefit questions, policy interpretations, and operational concerns.
  • Evaluate existing benefit vendors and assist with RFPs and implementations as needed.
  • Oversee the annual open enrollment process, including plan design decisions, benefits administration system testing, multi-channel communications, onsite events, and employee education.

Vendor Management & Strategic Partnerships

  • Manage benefit vendor relationships, brokers, consultants, and administration partners to ensure all issues are escalated and resolved quickly and appropriately.
  • Assist with monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for benefit vendors, ensuring high-quality execution, accountability, and continuous performance review.
  • Lead benefits billing for multiple vendors including tracking administrative and claims costs and managing the intercompany billing process.
  • Act as a key contact point for vendor service issues, financial reconciliations, and operational discrepancies.

Project Management & Process Optimization

  • Manage  projects related to benefits system integration, policy updates, structural plan changes, and process optimization.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestone tracking for key HR and benefits initiatives. Coordinate with vendors to track updates.
  • Tracks the status of contracts. Coordinates with Legal and Vendors as necessary to facilitate the review and approval of contracts.
  • Partner with HRIS and our 3rd party  benefits administrator to ensure seamless integrations, early detection of any issues, and oversight of the resolution.

Compliance & Governance

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant federal, state, and local laws and regulations governing benefits, including ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, ACA, and HIPAA.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements across all benefit programs, assisting with required filings and disclosures including Form 5500s, 1095-Cs, RxDC, and non-discrimination testing.
  • Perform regular plan audits and risk assessments in collaboration with internal and external audit teams.

Communication & Education

  • Establish a benefits calendar with different benefits communication and promotion strategies from the various benefit partners. Enhance employee engagement, understanding, and program utilization.
  • Maintain an employee resource database within the benefits administration system and ensure all materials are up to date.
  • Partner with our vendors to coordinate employee education sessions for 401k and other benefit plans. 
  • Coordinate communication campaigns across all subsidiaries, ensuring accurate distribution lists and advance planning with the internal communications team.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CEBS or CBP certifications are a plus.


Experience: 5+ years of experience in benefits administration with demonstrated experience managing multiple benefits plans and programs.


Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated track record in vendor management, evaluating existing benefit vendors, and assisting with RFPs and implementations.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing multiple projects, cross-functional HR technology, and deadlines.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations governing employee benefits (ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, ACA, HIPAA, etc.).
  • Adept in benefits administration systems and HRIS, especially Workday.
  • Experience supporting varied populations, including hourly, part-time, salaried, union, and retirees.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with a data-driven approach to interpreting data, decision-making, and plan performance evaluation.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across departments and companies.

% Travel Required (Approximate): ~5%

job.description:
Job Title

Principal Designer

Job Description


About The Position:


People Inc. is looking for a Principal Designer to take on some of the company’s most varied, visible, and important work.


You’ll work directly with the Chief Communications Officer and Chief Design Officer on the work that most visibly represents People Inc.: our events, our brand identity, our sites, what we put in front of investors, and the spaces we work in. Much of it has no precedent, so not every project starts with a defined brief. You’ll collaborate with leadership to frame the problem, and along with the Senior Creative Director, develop the concept and creative direction and bring it to life.


That means pairing ambitious creative thinking with close attention to the details that make the work successful. For events, you’ll work directly with vendors, production companies, and internal partners to carry the design through production, and stay involved through on-site execution. You’ll bring fresh ideas for what our events can be and the resourcefulness to make the most of the budget, spaces, materials, and time available.


You’ll lead other designers and outside partners project by project while staying hands-on. This is a role for someone highly experienced and influential who loves making the work and seeing it through.


In-office Expectations: At least three days per week at our 225 Liberty Street headquarters in New York City.


About The Team:

_____________________________________________________________________________


The Design Group at People Inc. brings together multiple teams supporting Revenue Design, Brand & Editorial Design, Product & UX Design, Design Systems, Creative Operations, Transactional Creative, and Events.

 

This role will work across corporate, brand, communications, and experiential design, partnering closely with senior leadership and designers across the organization.


About The Positions Contributions:


Weight %

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


Corporate, Brand & Communications Design ›› 70%

  • Lead high-visibility work from problem definition through final execution, including:
    • People Inc. Villa at Cannes, People Talks, Dinner with People, and Brand Showcases
    • People Inc. and People Incorporated sites, corporate and brand identity, and presentation systems
    • Investor Relations materials, including earnings decks, campaigns, and employee communications
    • Office and experiential design, video walls, sizzle reels, and other motion-led experiences
  • Work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional partners to establish creative direction, present work, make decisions, and maintain a high standard of craft. 


Creative Direction, Mentorship & Design Development ›› 30%

  • Define loosely defined problems and develop clear creative approaches before execution.
  • Direct designers, agencies, and creative partners project by project; provide feedback, run creative reviews, and mentor designers and emerging leaders.
  • Introduce new tools and approaches, including AI, when they improve the quality or efficiency of the work.
  • Remain accountable for the quality of the result without requiring an ongoing people-management structure.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education:


Bachelor's degree preferred in design, graphic design, visual communication, or related field, and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:


  • 10+ years of professional design experience
  • A portfolio demonstrating refined taste and sound creative judgment across multiple disciplines and formats, including completed events and experiential work
  • Demonstrated experience taking event design from concept through production and on-site execution, with direct responsibility for the details of the finished experience
  • Experience working directly with vendors, fabricators, and production companies, including reviewing production specifications, materials, proofs, and installation details
  • Experience working at a high-profile company, brand, agency, or organization where design is highly visible and the bar for the work is high
  • Experience maintaining a cohesive brand across formats and partners, and contributing to its thoughtful evolution
  • Experience across brand, corporate communications, print, digital, presentation, experiential, environmental, and campaign design
  • Broad expertise across brand, corporate communications, print, digital, presentation, experiential, environmental, and campaign design

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:


  • A clear point of view about design and the ability to clearly articulate your ideas
  • The ability to move fluidly between concept, direction, and hands-on design
  • Meticulous attention to detail and the ownership to carry work through its final execution
  • A resourceful approach to making ambitious work happen: you see constraints as creative challenges and find possibilities in the spaces, materials, and resources at hand.
  • The ability to work within a strong corporate brand, recognize and correct drift, and identify where thoughtful evolution can strengthen the identity
  • Expert proficiency in design software (Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma) and presentation software (G-slides, PPTX)
  • Experience using AI and emerging design tools, including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and the judgement to identify when and how they can be used to improve the quality of creative, efficiency, and productivity. 
  • Working knowledge of motion and video workflows, and the ability to help direct them
  • A collaborative, direct, and low-ego approach, with the confidence to challenge an idea when there’s a better one

Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations

Job Description

About The Position: 

The Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations provides high-level administrative and governance support to the Deputy General Counsel and legal leadership team, focusing on board management and corporate governance. job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse.


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next.


We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our technology team and work on the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with a focus on infrastructure services, data pipelines, and identity enrichment. Along the way you’ll also participate in the product development of data-dependent systems such as AI answer services, personalization systems, machine learning, and audience services.


You will build and maintain the foundational data services that power analytics and machine learning for our newsroom, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge thoughtful digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, product managers, and data teams, contributing to high-performance systems.


Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based data pipelines supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps, and information services.
  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery inside AWS and GCP.
  • Develop and maintain data ETL pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code (Python preferred).
  • Collaborate with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs.
  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.
  • Write and present ideas clearly. Document functional requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and agile sprint ceremonies.

Qualifications:

Must-Haves

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field.
  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark
  • Working knowledge of common AWS and/or GCP services
  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)
  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tooling, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.
  • Familiarity with web standards and protocols.
  • Comfort with code reviews, writing unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and exposure to end-to-end testing frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, thoroughness, and an eagerness to learn.
  • Proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries.
  • Exposure to personalization and recommendation systems.
  • Comfortable with the CLI, Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)
  • Familiarity with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices.
  • Scaling techniques in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshooting and debugging experience with internet services.
  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus)

Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 


We are seeking an experienced, highly analytical, and execution-oriented Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation. In this role, the incumbent will work closely with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and the senior leadership team to build and operationalize enterprise capabilities. Key responsibilities include translating strategic priorities into actionable business decisions, aligning resources around our highest-value opportunities, and driving measurable results.

 

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between executive-level problem-solving and practical implementation. The successful candidate will help establish the frameworks, processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable leaders to make informed decisions, prioritize investments, manage competing resources, and accelerate strategic initiatives.

 

The ideal candidate combines the analytical rigor of a management consultant with the pragmatism of an operator. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning complex business questions into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Importantly, this role serves as an enabler and facilitator of enterprise strategy. Business leaders retain accountability for decisions and execution within their respective functions.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Enterprise Strategy & Executive Alignment

  • Partner with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and executive leadership to translate the enterprise operating model into actionable priorities, processes, and governance.
  • Facilitate executive alignment on strategic priorities, organizational objectives, decision rights, and resource allocation.
  • Help define the Strategy Team’s mandate, operating model, engagement approach, and partnership with business functions.
  • Prepare executive presentations, decision briefs, and recommendations to support critical business decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen cross-functional alignment and accelerate enterprise-wide initiatives.

 

Strategic Portfolio & Initiative Management

  • Establish and maintain a consolidated view of enterprise initiatives, strategic investments, resources, ownership, milestones, and expected business outcomes.
  • Develop consistent evaluation frameworks to assess initiatives based on strategic alignment, financial and operational value, ownership, and execution capacity.
  • Facilitate portfolio reviews and recommend opportunities to accelerate, continue, sequence, redesign, or discontinue initiatives.
  • Identify resource constraints, competing priorities, dependencies, and opportunities to redirect capacity toward higher-value business objectives.
  • Establish transparent portfolio reporting and tracking mechanisms.

 

Business Strategy & Decision Support

  • Lead and support high-priority strategic engagements across the organization, translating complex business questions into actionable recommendations.
  • Develop business cases, financial analyses, scenario models, and strategic assessments to inform investment and resource decisions.
  • Create structured decision-making frameworks that clearly outline business questions, supporting evidence, alternatives, financial implications, risks, and recommendations.
  • Work backward from defined decision milestones to ensure strategic engagements produce timely, actionable outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, and organizational alignment.

 

Strategy Operations & Governance

  • Design and implement the Strategy Team’s operating processes, including initiative intake, prioritization, engagement selection, and delivery tracking.
  • Establish and facilitate regular enterprise strategy reviews, portfolio reviews, and executive decision forums.
  • Develop governance tools, templates, decision logs, dashboards, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Clarify roles and responsibilities across executive sponsors, initiative owners, working teams, and decision-makers.
  • Streamline existing reporting and meeting structures to improve decision velocity and reduce unnecessary administrative processes.

 

Enterprise Performance & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Product, Editorial, and Revenue leadership to connect enterprise strategy with financial investment, organizational capacity, and business performance.
  • Develop an enterprise scorecard and key performance indicators to measure strategic progress, financial impact, execution, audience growth, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Monitor initiative performance, identify barriers to execution, and facilitate timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
  • Support change management and organizational adoption of new strategy processes and operating practices.
  • Build the capabilities, tools, and knowledge transfer necessary to establish a sustainable Strategy Operations function.

 

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, or a related discipline; advanced degree or MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business operations, enterprise transformation, or strategy execution.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise prioritization, portfolio management, and strategic operating frameworks.
  • Strong financial acumen, including business case development, financial modeling, investment analysis, and resource planning.
  • Proven ability to partner with CEOs, C-suite executives, and senior functional leaders.
  • Experience facilitating complex business discussions, challenging assumptions, and navigating competing priorities and resource tradeoffs.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, executive communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex information and ambiguity into concise insights, options, and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Media, digital publishing, advertising, audience development, subscription, product, or technology experience strongly preferred.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

  • The Senior Systems Engineer helps keep The Washington Post’s identity, collaboration, endpoint, and core IT service platforms secure, reliable, and available.
  • This role serves as a senior technical resource for Identity and Access Management, supporting Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, and automated user-lifecycle processes.
  • Through hands-on systems engineering, administration, integration, and automation, this role improves the reliability and efficiency of technology services used across the organization.
  • Working with IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, HR, and other partners, this role helps translate operational and security requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • As an individual contributor, this role provides technical guidance and project leadership but does not have formal people-management responsibilities.

What Motivates You

  • You enjoy solving complex systems and infrastructure problems through careful analysis and hands-on technical work.
  • You are interested in identity management, enterprise platforms, automation, and secure service delivery.
  • You look for practical ways to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and strengthen operational controls.
  • You take pride in building solutions that are documented, supportable, and sustainable for the broader team.
  • You are comfortable responding to immediate operational needs while continuing to improve the underlying systems and processes.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, administrators, engineers, and business partners to solve shared problems.
  • You value sharing your knowledge and helping colleagues develop their technical capabilities.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Administer and improve Identity and Access Management services, including Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, and role-based access, supporting secure and reliable access to enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement automated provisioning, deprovisioning, and access-change workflows within established security and platform standards, improving the accuracy and timeliness of identity administration.
  • Develop and maintain integrations among platforms such as Workday, Okta, Active Directory, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, and ServiceNow, improving the consistency of data and service workflows.
  • Engineer and support assigned enterprise platforms, which may include Google Workspace, storage and collaboration services, endpoint-management tools, asset-management systems, and ITSM platforms, maintaining reliable day-to-day operations.
  • Use APIs, scripting, and systems-management tools to automate recurring administrative and operational processes, reducing manual effort and preventable errors.
  • Troubleshoot complex incidents involving identity, access, integrations, endpoints, systems administration, and enterprise applications, restoring service and identifying corrective actions.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Compliance to implement approved security configurations, access controls, and remediation plans, reducing identity and infrastructure risk.
  • Support the technical implementation of data-retention requirements, legal holds, and e-discovery requests in partnership with Legal, Cybersecurity, and designated data owners, ensuring requests are executed accurately and securely.
  • Contribute technical expertise to system upgrades, platform changes, integration projects, and service improvements, helping projects meet operational, security, and delivery requirements.
  • Maintain system documentation, technical procedures, integration records, and operational runbooks, improving service continuity and reducing reliance on individual knowledge.
  • Recommend improvements to system configurations, workflows, and working methods, strengthening the effectiveness and reliability of the IT Operations team.
  • Provide technical guidance, cross-training, and mentoring to engineers and administrators, helping colleagues resolve issues and work effectively within established standards.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Five or more years of relevant experience in systems engineering, systems administration, enterprise infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SSO integrations, multifactor authentication, access provisioning, and role-based access controls.
  • Experience administering Google Workspace in a large or complex environment, including experience with the Google Admin SDK, OAuth, and service accounts.
  • Hands-on experience integrating enterprise systems, SaaS applications, IAM tools, HR platforms, or IT service-management platforms.
  • Proficiency in at least one relevant scripting language, such as Python, JavaScript, Bash, PowerShell, or Google Apps Script.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and troubleshooting system-to-system integrations.
  • Practical experience implementing identity, endpoint, configuration, or access controls in partnership with cybersecurity or compliance teams.
  • Experience supporting ITSM, CMDB, asset-management, endpoint-management, storage, or enterprise collaboration platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to identify root causes and resolve issues involving multiple systems.
  • Ability to manage assigned projects and technical work independently while recognizing when decisions or risks require escalation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring without formal supervisory authority.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, or other modern systems-engineering practices is preferred.
  • Experience supporting legal holds, e-discovery, data retention, or information-governance processes is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, training, and practical experience.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$108,700 - $181,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

This role translates business performance, market dynamics, and operating decisions into clear financial insight that helps leaders invest wisely, manage risk, and build sustainable revenue.

Reporting within the FP&A organization, the Manager leads planning, forecasting, and performance analysis for assigned revenue businesses while developing financial talent and strengthening the tools, processes, and partnerships that support informed decision-making across the company.

 

What Motivates You

  • You are energized by helping mission-driven media organizations build durable, diversified revenue models.
  • You enjoy translating complex financial and operating data into clear insights that guide decisions.
  • You value collaborative partnership with leaders across Product, Marketing, Sales, Newsroom, Data Analytics & Insights, and Finance.
  • You are motivated by improving planning processes, models, and reporting so teams can act with greater clarity and confidence.
  • You take pride in developing financial talent and creating an inclusive, accountable team environment.

 

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range plans for assigned revenue streams, producing aligned financial plans that support enterprise priorities and growth goals.
  • Develop driver-based revenue models that connect pricing, volume, pipeline, customer behavior, and other operating metrics to reliable financial outcomes.

This role provides dedicated people and delivery leadership for the team while partnering closely with Android, Staff Engineering, Product, and shared engineering teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences quickly and predictably.


This is a hands-on engineering management role. The Manager, Software Development will set priorities and assignments, develop engineers, remove blockers, identify delivery risks early, and establish clear accountability for delivering approved work to readers, while remaining close enough to the technology to guide difficult engineering decisions. The manager is expected to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests on a regular basis, and will partner with Staff Engineers and feature leads to verify progress, identify misalignment, and follow work through to release.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep iOS engineering knowledge, sound technical judgment, and a disciplined approach to execution. This manager will help the team ship faster while maintaining the architecture, performance, reliability, quality, and technical health readers expect from The Washington Post’s flagship mobile experience. The role is data-driven: priorities, estimates, improvements, and results are tracked against agreed baselines and measured by evidence, such as time to users, commitments met, blocker resolution time, and app stability and performance, not by activity or opinion.


What Motivates You

  • You want to help bring The Washington Post’s journalism to readers through high-quality mobile experiences.
  • You measure success by the value delivered to users and how quickly it reaches them.
  • You develop engineers through direct feedback and clear expectations, and you judge your impact by their growth.
  • You care about predictable execution. You know the real remaining work, test whether estimates and status reports are credible, and surface risk before it becomes a missed commitment.
  • You want to stay technically hands-on, writing code, prototyping, and reviewing pull requests to solve problems, evaluate approaches, and stay connected to the systems your team builds.
  • You care deeply about mobile architecture, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • You enjoy removing blockers and working across engineering and product teams to move complex work forward, while leaving ownership with the people who hold it.
  • You hold yourself to the standard you set for others: you own your commitments, communicate risk early, and confirm that issues are closed.
  • You look for wasted effort and ways to improve how teams work, and you measure whether those improvements create value.
  • You enjoy building AI agents and automation that solve real mobile engineering problems, and you care about proving that they work and that people actually use them.
  • You stay current on the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple platform releases, Swift language and concurrency changes, and AI-assisted development in Xcode, and you know which changes are worth adopting and when.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead and develop the software engineers responsible for The Washington Post’s iOS app, providing timely feedback, career development, performance management, and coaching that builds independent ownership and accountability.
  • Establish priorities and assignments, set delivery baselines, and track progress against estimates through to availability for users. Report on measures such as time to users, commitments met by the agreed date, and blocker resolution time, and surface material delivery risks early with clear facts, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.
  • Address performance concerns promptly and directly, set clear expectations, and confirm that behavior and results improve.
  • Partner with the Android Manager, Staff Engineers, Product, feature leads, and shared teams to sequence work, resolve dependencies and blockers, and keep mobile initiatives aligned without taking over others’ ownership.
  • Provide technical leadership across iOS architecture and development in partnership with Staff Engineers, helping the team make sound decisions on application design, performance, testing, maintainability, and platform best practices across Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Objective-C, and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Track changes in the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple OS releases and design updates, Swift and Swift Concurrency evolution, and agentic and AI-assisted tooling in Xcode, and turn them into clear recommendations on what the team should adopt, when, and at what cost.
  • Stay hands-on by writing code, building prototypes, and reviewing pull requests to solve technical problems, evaluate approaches, and set the quality bar for the team.
  • Establish and reinforce engineering practices that support robust testing, code quality, application performance, reliable releases, and the long-term health of the iOS platform.
  • Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary work, technical debt, and opportunities to improve engineering processes and productivity, setting a baseline before each change and measuring the benefit afterward against its cost, rework, and any regressions.
  • Partner with Product and engineering leadership to balance reader experience, business priorities, delivery commitments, and long-term technical health.
  • Build and roll out AI agents and automation that solve iOS and mobile engineering problems, including crash and issue triage, test generation, code review assistance, release workflows, estimation, and detection of stalled work. Verify their output, keep human accountability for decisions, and measure whether they remove delay and effort or only move it.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional native iOS development experience with the iOS SDK, including Swift and modern iOS tools and frameworks, and experience building and releasing production mobile applications.
  • Substantial experience writing production iOS code and designing app architecture, including modular design, concurrency, performance, and testable code, with the ability to review pull requests and architecture proposals at a senior level, evaluate tradeoffs, and diagnose and fix defects.
  • Experience directly managing software engineers, including coaching, career development, and performance management, with a record of timely, specific feedback and of coaching engineers toward independent ownership.
  • Experience leading complex engineering work from planning and estimation through implementation, testing, release, and production support, including setting priorities, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks, and revising forecasts as evidence changes.
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, version control, and software delivery practices for production mobile applications.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with experience partnering effectively with Product, senior technical contributors, other engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, including escalating material risks promptly.
  • Experience defining and using engineering metrics and delivery data, including baselines and targets, to identify bottlenecks, make decisions, and demonstrate improvement in team effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge of the current iOS platform, Swift, and Xcode tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience developing and releasing large-scale consumer iOS applications to the App Store.
  • Experience with modern iOS technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, App Intents, Apple’s latest design system, on-device AI frameworks, or comparable technologies; familiarity with Objective-C and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Experience with mobile performance optimization, debugging, memory management, and application reliability.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs, third-party SDKs, or other services into native mobile applications.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for the full mobile application lifecycle, including architecture, development, automated testing, CI/CD, release, observability, and production support.
  • Experience coordinating engineering work across iOS, Android, backend, platform, or other shared technical teams.
  • Experience improving engineering productivity, delivery predictability, or development processes and measuring the impact of those improvements.
  • Experience mentoring engineers across career levels and partnering effectively with Staff-level or other senior technical contributors.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents or automation that solve real iOS or mobile engineering problems, with verification of the output and measured benefit.
  • Experience with agentic development workflows in Xcode and with connecting agents to engineering tools such as issue trackers, CI, crash reporting, and source control, for example through Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Software Engineer — Publishing Platform


Downtown Music Publishing is looking for a driven individual to join us as a Software Engineer to help build our next-generation music publishing platform from the ground up. You'll help in shaping the architecture, tooling, and engineering culture of a catalog management platform that powers musical work registration, rights tracking, and royalty collection for publishers worldwide. Currently seeking candidates local to the Nashville Area.


What you'll do

●      Design and implement a schema-first GraphQL API (Apollo Server) over PostgreSQL, including multi-tenant data isolation (row-level security), type-safe query layers, and performance patterns like DataLoader batching.

●      Develop React/TypeScript (Next.js) interfaces used by both internal teams and clients to manage catalogs, registrations, and data-quality workflows.

●      Build AI-native features as a core part of the product: AI-assisted data ingestion and matching, agent-accessible APIs via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM-powered workflows using the Vercel AI SDK and Amazon Bedrock.

●      Work in an AI-augmented, spec-driven development workflow — architecture specs, agent-assisted implementation, and rigorous automated review are how the team ships, not an experiment on the side.

●      Own components end-to-end: design, implementation, integration testing against real databases, deployment (AWS CDK), and operational responsibility.

●      Model and implement music publishing domain logic — works, writers, shares, agreements, and society registration formats (e.g., CWR) — with the precision that financial and rights data demands.


You are / have


●      Bachelor's degree in computer science, software development, or equivalent experience.

●      5+ years of experience developing web-based software solutions.

●      Experience architecting new systems or services from scratch — you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you document the "why" behind decisions, not just the "what."

●      Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js across the full stack.

●      Solid relational database fundamentals: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query performance in PostgreSQL (or similar).

●      Experience with both traditional software development lifecycle and agentic software development — including spec-driven development, AI-augmented engineering, and working effectively with coding agents.

●      Interest in the music industry — prior experience with rights management, royalties, or metadata standards (CWR, DDEX, ISWC/ISRC) is a plus, not a requirement.


Ideally, significant experience with some of the following technologies or similar tools:


Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Apollo Server, schema-first), PostgreSQL, etc.

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, modern state management (e.g., Zustand)

AI/Agents: Vercel AI SDK, SpecKit, CodeX, Amazon Bedrock, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM tool design.

job.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

Universal Music Group is building an Applied AI and Machine Learning function to help our teams discover and develop artists, connect with fans, make stronger commercial decisions, and protect the integrity of the music ecosystem.


We are looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to build, ship, and operate reliable machine learning and AI systems that create durable value across UMG. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software and systems expertise with practical knowledge of the AI and ML lifecycle.


You will turn models, data products, and AI workflows into maintainable production capabilities across revenue forecasting, artist, catalog intelligence and talent scouting, release marketing, and rights and ecosystem integrity. The role focuses on reproducible development, rigorous evaluation, safe deployment, observability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement.


How you’ll CREATE:

Core MLOps & Production Infrastructure

  • Lead initiatives from problem framing and data assessment through deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and sustained adoption (versus reach a well-evidenced decision not to build).
  • Build and operate reliable ML and LLM-powered workflows, including retrieval and grounding, structured outputs, tool and API integrations, orchestration, batch or real-time inference, CI/CD, and safe rollback.
  • Establish AI evaluation and observability using representative and adversarial test sets, regression tests, human review where appropriate, traces, drift detection, latency, quality, safety, usage, and cost metrics.

Data & Feature Engineering

  • Build reliable data and feature pipelines from streaming consumption data, release metadata, social campaign data, catalog information, and commercial finance systems; monitor completeness, freshness, anomalies, and data lineage.
  • Develop and operate models across personalization, recommender systems, search and ranking, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and decision support—choosing a simpler reliable approach whenever is appropriate.

Business Stakeholders

  • Move generative and multimodal AI capabilities from prototypes into dependable, cost-effective workflows that help people make decisions and take action.
  • Partner with ML scientists, data engineers, product managers, designers, domain experts, A&R, Marketing, Finance, and labels; contribute to architecture, code reviews, mentoring, and pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • Ship production ML or AI capabilities that improve a meaningful UMG decision or workflow.
  • Establish automated evaluation and regression coverage for AI workflows, with trusted measures for quality, safety, latency, cost, and business usefulness.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, performance, scalability, or cost-efficiency of existing workflows.
  • Move a prototype or manual process into a dependable workflow used for a real decision, such as allocating marketing spend, prioritizing an A&R opportunity, reviewing a forecast, or investigating an integrity alert.
  • Raise the technical bar through documentation, reviews, and mentorship.
  • Effective collaboration and communication with business stakeholders, labels, central teams, and other non-technical partners.

Bring your VIBE:

  • A bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in software, machine learning, data, or platform engineering with ownership of production systems and ambiguous, high-impact problems.
  • Experience engineering modern AI systems, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval, grounding, structured generation, tool use, safety controls, and human review, with clear evaluation and monitoring practices.
  • Strong Python and software engineering skills, including testing, code review, version control, debugging, maintainable design, and experience with a second production language or equivalent systems experience.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and ML platforms. UMG workloads use GCP and BigQuery; experience with services such as Vertex AI, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer is valuable, while equivalent AWS or cloud-agnostic experience is also relevant.
  • Experience building and operating data pipelines, distributed systems, APIs, services, workflow orchestration, model serving, batch or online inference, and refresh or retraining processes.
  • Ability to collaborate across technical and business disciplines, communicate tradeoffs clearly, take ownership without formal authority, and choose a simpler reliable solution when it is better than a more complex model.

job.description:

Job Summary:

As a key member of the UMG Operations Center, the Identity Operations Engineer operates and continuously improves UMG’s hybrid identity, access, authentication, privileged-access, and identity-governance services. The role provides specialist operational support across Workday-driven identity lifecycle processes, Saviynt/IGA, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, MFA, PAM, enterprise application integrations, and connected services.


The position will be a team player working to maintain reliable identity integrations and resolve operational issues involving joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, rejoiners, application access, entitlements, authentication, privileged accounts, and non-human identities. The role includes incident, request, change, problem, access-review, audit-evidence, monitoring, and automation activities. The role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud, Observability, ITSM, security, regional IT teams, and external providers. Effective communication skills are a must, all while being sensitive to a wide diversity of cultural and technical backgrounds in a global business environment.


Job Functions:

  • Apply least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, secure administration, and identity-governance best practices to protect UMG information resources from unauthorized use, inappropriate access, disclosure, damage, or loss.
  • Troubleshoot and resolves issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions.
  • Investigate and resolve specialist escalations from AD Services and TechOps IAM queues, including application-role access, SecAdmin access, reference-user comparisons, disabled application accounts, access removals, and entitlement issues.
  • Provide ITIL-based operational support across identity services, including incident, request, change, problem, and major-incident participation. Maintain clear ServiceNow assignment, evidence, troubleshooting notes, resolution details, and closure criteria.
  • Operate and troubleshoot identity lifecycle integrations, including joiner, mover, leaver, contractor, rehire/rejoiner, and exception scenarios. Investigate failed provisioning tasks, reconciliation issues, orphaned accounts, and mismatches between authoritative HR data, IGA records, directories, and target applications.
  • Support Workday-driven lifecycle processes and Saviynt/IGA workflows, including access requests, approvals, entitlement ownership, access reviews, remediation, audit evidence, and provisioning/reconciliation failures.
  • Operate and support on-premises and cloud identity services and their configuration, including Active Directory domain services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Duo, YubiKey/FIDO/PIV authentication, CyberArk/PAM, Saviynt/IGA, Splunk, Active Roles where applicable, PingOne/Aura where applicable, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, and connected enterprise applications.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra enterprise applications and federation integrations, including SAML, OIDC/OAuth, claims, redirect URIs, app registrations, group assignments, Conditional Access, Microsoft Graph, certificates, and token/authentication failures.
  • Support privileged and non-human identities, including elevated accounts, service accounts, application accounts, RPA accounts, resource/test accounts, B2B/guest identities, and accounts requiring vault onboarding, password rotation, or ownership validation.
  • Support MFA and authentication operations, including Duo, YubiKey, FIDO/PIV, recovery/reset workflows, OAuth-token issues, and authentication failures across workforce and application services.
  • Complete the key metric reporting and analysis for the Identity Management environment as required.
  • Work to ensure audit tasks related to Identity Management are completed on time, with participation of appropriate parties. Maintain auditable evidence for access approvals, reviews, privileged access, lifecycle actions, exceptions, and remediation.
  • Participate in security incident response teams as needed, including identity compromise, suspicious authentication, privileged-access, credential, and account-containment activities.
  • Utilize industry best practices for appropriate standards, processes, procedures, tools, and documentation.
  • Ensure the maintenance, patching, operating, and monitoring of IAM systems is in place and completed on schedule. Use Splunk and observability service dashboards to identify failures, trends, and emerging operational risk.
  • Maintain accurate ServiceNow CMDB relationships for identity services, configuration items, application integrations, owners, support groups, and dependencies; identify and report stale or incomplete CMDB data.
  • Participate in developing automation to reduce the time spent on routine tasks.
  • This is a shift-based role supporting UMG’s 24/7 follow-the-sun Technical Operations Center. The role participates in scheduled shifts, weekend/public-holiday coverage, on-call rotation, and structured handoffs with regional operations teams

Essential:

  • Solid technical skills in the Identity Management space, including Active Directory and Entra ID.
  • Minimum of five years directly related experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • A strong ability for troubleshooting and problem analysis is required, along with the ability to clearly communicate the results of problem analysis to business stakeholders, IT support teams, and network providers to quickly and effectively resolve operational issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting and solving issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions
  • Hands-on experience operating and supporting Active Directory and Entra ID, including directory services, delegated administration, group policy, OUs, sites/replication, identity synchronization, enterprise applications, federation, Conditional Access, and authentication.
  • Hands-on experience with Saviynt or another IGA platform, including access requests, approvals, entitlement administration, access reviews, failed-task remediation, reconciliation, and audit evidence.
  • Experience with identity lifecycle integrations from an authoritative HR source such as Workday, including joiner/mover/leaver, contractor, rehire, and exception handling.
  • Customer service driven/focused with a proactive and positive can-do approach. Demonstrates commitment to organization’s policy framework and practices continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience and skills with systems such as M365 and ServiceNow are required. Experience using ServiceNow for IAM incidents, requests, changes, knowledge, evidence, assignment groups, and CMDB relationships is required.
  • Demonstrated current work experience supporting integrated IAM solutions such as Entra ID, Active Roles where applicable, Duo, PKI, and CyberArk/PAM
  • Working knowledge of site-reliability/operational-engineering principles, monitoring, automation, and safe use of AI-assisted tools.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Solid written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills

Desirable:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, a closely related field, or comparable education and experience.
  • Experience with at least two of the following is desirable: PingOne/Aura, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, Microsoft Graph, SAML/OIDC/OAuth, enterprise application onboarding, or secrets/service-account rotation.
  • Experience integrating or troubleshooting ServiceNow orchestration with identity platforms, directories, SaaS applications, or enterprise applications is desirable.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 identity, group, collaboration, and federation dependencies.
  • Experience using PowerShell, Python, JSON/REST, Microsoft Graph, SQL, or comparable scripting/API technologies for IAM automation and troubleshooting. Legacy Java, SOAP, or database experience
  • IT Certifications including MCSE Certification specialization in Identity Management, Certified Access Management Specialist (CAMS), and ITIL Foundations certifications desired

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – Streaming & Social within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how artists are discovered, audiences are understood, and content performance is optimized; trusted consumption data becomes a strategic enterprise asset. In this role, you will ensure UMG's streaming and social data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume music consumption data at enterprise scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, documentation, prototyping, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable data-driven decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise data products and domain-specific data marts that serve as the authoritative source of truth for music consumption and streaming/social engagement across UMG. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent audience insights, artist development, repertoire strategy, marketing effectiveness, forecasting, and executive decision-making. By establishing trusted, governed, and semantically rich data products, you will help create the enterprise data foundation that enables AI-driven insights and intelligent decision-support across UMG.

You will partner closely with Global Insights, Commercial Strategy, Digital Business, Marketing, Label Analytics, Data Engineering, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring consumption & social data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role reports to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Global Insights, Label Analytics, Marketing, Finance, and Digital Business teams to define trusted business metrics, KPIs, and standardized consumption definitions.

  • Define scalable dimensional models and semantic layers supporting streaming activity, audience engagement, artists, releases, tracks, playlists, social engagement, territories, and commercial performance.
  • Establish authoritative data products that serve as the source of truth for music consumption performance across labels, artists, releases, and markets.
  • Standardize business definitions for metrics, including streams, listeners, followers, saves, playlist reach, engagement, audience growth, chart performance, market share, and consumption trends.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with internal and external consumption data providers to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of consumption data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve business outcomes by applying AI to music consumption, audience behavior, and content performance while maintaining strong governance and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of product management experience supporting digital music, streaming, audience analytics, media, entertainment, or digital content organizations.
  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of the digital music ecosystem, including streaming platforms, social media platforms, audience measurement, and music consumption trends.
  • Experience working with music consumption datasets, including streaming activity, artist performance, release performance, audience engagement, playlists, social signals, and chart data.
  • Familiarity with industry data providers and platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, TikTok, Meta, Luminate, Chartmetric, SoundCloud, Pandora, or similar consumption and audience analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of artist lifecycle analytics, audience development, catalog performance, playlisting, fan engagement, and commercial music performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.

job.title: Reporter, State AGs
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking two aggressive, enterprising reporters to cover state attorneys general as national political and policy actors. Each reporter will be a founding member of POLITICO's new State AGs team, and will report on how AGs are shaping tech, energy, health care, consumer protection and antitrust policy regionally and nationally, and the dynamics shaping multistate and partisan coalitions.

 

The reporters will cover four overlapping areas:

  • The anchor states. California, New York, Texas and Florida run the most powerful AG offices in the country, and their actions on tech, finance, energy and health care often set national standards.
  • Other key states. The offices that drive coalition strategy and national policy fights, including Illinois, Massachusetts, New Jersey and Washington on the Democratic side, and Tennessee, Missouri, Louisiana and Utah on the Republican side.
  • A redrawn AG map. November's elections gave Democrats AG offices in Texas, Ohio, Georgia, Iowa and Kansas. The beat will follow how those offices take shape and how Republican AGs respond.
  • Coalition dynamics. How multistate coalitions form and fracture, who leads and who follows, how DAGA and RAGA shape them, and where AGs of both parties find common ground.

 

A deep source network inside AG offices of both parties will be essential, going well beyond public filings and press releases. Those sources will drive exclusive news on investigations and lawsuits, along with reporting from inside coalition conversations on which cases to bring, which companies to target and which states will sign on.

 

The beat will focus closely on how AGs decide where to intervene, against business or against the federal government. Democratic AGs have become the front line of legal resistance to the Trump administration, while Republican AGs have often acted as its partners and force multipliers. The beat will also track how coalitions form, who leads them and who follows, where AGs of both parties find common ground, and how the office has become a launchpad for national ambition.

 

The policy portfolio will include health care, antitrust, AI and tech platforms, consumer protection, climate and energy, financial services, ESG and DEI, labor, and the limits of federal power — the enforcement fights where AGs are most active and where their actions carry the biggest consequences for companies and investors.

 

The reporters will work hand in hand with POLITICO's California, New York and Florida teams, which already cover their states' AGs closely as political figures and policymakers.

 

What You'll Need:

  • Reporting experience covering politics, policy, government or the law
  • A demonstrated ability to break news and deliver original, incisive reporting
  • Deep familiarity with state politics and with the state-federal legal battles of the past decade
  • The ability to build a network of sources in AG offices, DAGA, RAGA, or the legal and political circles around them
  • A strong interest in the personalities, rivalries and ambitions that drive AG offices
  • An entrepreneurial spirit and eagerness to help build an exciting new part of our journalism
  • The ability to juggle fast-moving breaking news with ambitious enterprise reporting
  • The ability to write clearly, accurately and efficiently on deadline for an influential, professional audience
  • A collaborative spirit and willingness to work with reporters and editors across POLITICO's state, legal and policy teams
  • A rigorous commitment to fair-minded, accurate and nonpartisan journalism

 

We’re open to candidates based in Arlington, VA (HQ); New York, NY; or Sacramento, CA. If you’re not near one of our offices, we still encourage you to apply.

 

Compensation: $90,000-$140,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

POLITICO is seeking an ambitious, enterprising reporter to cover the legal and corporate ecosystem around state attorneys general as part of a new POLITICO newsletter. job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a skilled video producer/editor for a daily technology show. In this role, you’ll oversee recording sessions, make creative and editorial decisions to shape episodes, ensure high quality and accuracy, and edit episodes to completion. 


The show is a companion product to a daily newsletter, and you’ll work closely with the hosts, newsletter authors, and editors to highlight the best reporting and analysis each day — while building a distinct product that stands alone and features the unique strengths of a conversational format.


Our shows are multiplatform products, with audio, video, and social media elements. The ideal candidate is a strong video editor; experience with audio editing is a strong plus. Please note your skillset in your application. 


This is a Sunday-Thursday role and requires some evening work to produce a daily early-morning show (the estimated schedule is 2pm-10pm EST). We’ll consider candidates to work out of our HQ (Arlington, VA), New York, San Francisco or Sacramento.


Who You Are:

  • An experienced producer with a track record of writing scripts or briefings for shows and translating complex reporting into compelling pod/vodcasts. 
  • A strong session producer with experience coaching talent and working with experienced hosts and newer voices. 
  • A skilled video editor able to produce tight, polished edits on a deadline
  • A keen follower of tech and AI news, with an interest in how those overlap with politics and policy. 
  • Experienced in multiplatform distribution, finding production efficiencies between audio, video and social media, and producing for different channels and audiences
  • A team player, great at giving and taking notes and working across different teams of people

  • Collaborate with hosts, editors, and the audio/video team to identify daily topics
  • Edit and publish clean, final cuts of episodes, often under tight deadlines
  • Write headline and caption copy for podcast feeds, YouTube and other social platforms
  • Partner with teams across the newsroom on distribution and publishing
  • Monitor episode performance metrics and use audience insights to inform future episodes

  • 3+ years’ experience in podcast or video production, with significant experience in news, politics, or policy

  • Strong communication skills for coordinating with hosts, editors and cross-functional partners

Job Description:

POLITICO is looking for a Team Manager, Customer Success to manage a team of 10 Customer Engagement Specialists and develop scalable customer engagement practices that drive product adoption, customer value, Wallet Retention Rate, and retention rate across the US Professional Subscriptions business. This senior manager level role will focus on coaching and developing team members, driving team performance, and executing strategies that strengthen customer engagement and retention.


POLITICO's mission from the very beginning was to win the audience. We dedicate ourselves to providing accurate, non-partisan, impactful information to the right people at the right time so that they can act with confidence and speed. We experiment to avoid being disrupted and we have fun disrupting others. And we are not afraid to risk failure if it means being the best at what we do.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of 10 Customer Engagement Specialists, fostering a high-performing team culture focused on growth, accountability, and results.
  • Partner with the Managing Director, Customer Success to develop and execute strategies that drive customer engagement, product adoption, Wallet Retention Rate, and overall retention.
  • Establish team goals, performance expectations, and scalable processes to improve customer onboarding, engagement, training, and support.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and professional development to strengthen individual and team performance.
  • Leverage customer health, usage, and engagement data to identify opportunities, address risks, and improve the customer experience.
  • Collaborate with Account Management and Customer Success leadership to align customer engagement efforts with broader business goals.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Technology, and Data teams to share customer insights and drive improvements across the business.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client services, customer engagement, or a related field, preferably within SaaS, subscription, or information services.
  • Proven experience managing, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of driving performance and results.
  • Ability to build and improve scalable processes that strengthen customer engagement, product adoption, and retention.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills, with a passion for developing people.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using customer data and performance metrics to identify opportunities and drive decisions.
  • Ability to collaborate across departments, manage competing priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
